PAITE: A tungin Pathianin lei leh van a siam.
ENGLISH: In the beginning God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” After “God,” the Hebrew has the two letters “Aleph Tav” (the first and last letters of the Hebrew alphabet) as a grammatical marker. created the heavens and the earth.

PAITE: Huan, lei a siaa a vuak kia ahi; tui thukpi tung a mialin a mial hi. Pathian khain tui tungte a opkhum hi.
ENGLISH: Now the earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep. God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, Vak hongom hen, a chi a: huchiin vak a hongomta hi.
ENGLISH: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, Vak a ena, hoih a sa mahmah; huchiin Pathianin vak leh mial a khenta hi.
ENGLISH: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin vak, sun, achia, mial, jan, a chi hi: huchiin nitaklam a oma, jinglam leng a om, a ni khatnaah.
ENGLISH: God called the light “day,” and the darkness he called “night.” There was evening and there was morning, one day.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, tui leh tui kalah vansin om henla, huaiin tui leh tuite khen hen, a chi.
ENGLISH: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathianin, vansin a bawla, vansin nuaia tui omte leh vansin tunga tui om a khenta: huchibang a honghita hi.
ENGLISH: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin vansin, Van, achia. Huchiin nitaklam a oma, jinglam leng a om, a ni nihnaah.
ENGLISH: God called the expanse “sky.” There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, Van nuaia tuite mun khatah om khawm uhenla, gam keu hongdawk hen, a chi a; huchiin huchibang a honghita hi.
ENGLISH: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear”; and it was so.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, gam keu, Lei, achia; tui om khawmte, tuipite, a chi hi: huan Pathianin huai a ena, hoih a sa mahmah hi.
ENGLISH: God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas.” God saw that it was good.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, leiin loupate, anteh chi nei te, thei sing, lei amau chi omdan ding banga gah, agah sunga a chi omte omsak hen, a chi a, huchiin huchibang a honghita hi.
ENGLISH: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seed, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with its seed in it, on the earth”; and it was so.

PAITE: Huchiin, leiin loupate, anteh amau chi omdan ding banga chi neite, sing a mau chi omdan ding banga gah, a gah sunga chi omte a omsakta hi: huan Pathianin huai a ena, hoih a sa mahmah hi.
ENGLISH: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with its seed in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

PAITE: Huchiin, nitaklam a oma, jinglam leng a om, a ni thumnaah.
ENGLISH: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, sun leh jan khenna dingin vansin ah tanvakte om u henla, huaite chiamtehnate, hunbite, nite, kumte, theihna ding hi uhen:
ENGLISH: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years;

PAITE: Lei tanvak dingin van vansin tanvakte din om uhen, a chi a: huchiin, huchibang a honghita.
ENGLISH: and let them be for lights in the expanse of sky to give light on the earth”; and it was so.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathianin tanvak thupipi nih a bawlta; tanvak thupi zopen sun vaihawm dingin, tanvak thupi lou zopen jan vaihawm dingin, a bawl hi: aksite leng a bawl hi.
ENGLISH: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin huaite lei tanvak dingin van vansin ah a koihta,
ENGLISH: God set them in the expanse of sky to give light to the earth,

PAITE: Sun tunga leh jan tunga vaihawm ding leh vak leh mial khen dingin: huchiin, Pathianin huai a ena, hoih a sa mahmah hi.
ENGLISH: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

PAITE: Huchiin, nitaklam a oma, jinglam leng a om, a ni linaah.
ENGLISH: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, tuiten thilsiam tangthei henna neite tampi pawtsak uhenla, vasate leng van vansin hawm heuhou ah, leitungah leng uhen, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: God said, “Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of sky.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathianin tuipi thil thupi lian pipite a siama, thil hing tangthei chiteng, tuiin a pawt sak, amaute chi omdan ding bangin a siam hi: Pathianin huai a ena, hoih a sa mahmah hi.
ENGLISH: God created the large sea creatures, and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, Chi tampi suangin hongpung unla. Tuipi tuite dimsak unla, vasate leng lei ah pung uhen, chiin a vualjawl hi.
ENGLISH: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

PAITE: Huchiin, nitaklam a oma, jinglam leng a om, a ni ngana ah.
ENGLISH: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, Leiin thil hing amau chi omdan ding bang chiatin; gante, ganhingte, gamsate, amau chi omdan ding bang chiatin pawtsak uhen, a chi a: huchiin, huchibang a honghita hi.
ENGLISH: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind”; and it was so.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathianin gamsa amau chi omdan ding bang chiatin, gamte amau chi omdan ding bang chiatin, leia thil khupboha paite tengteng amau chi omdan ding bang chiatin a bawla: huan, Pathianin huai a ena, hoih a sa mahmah hi.
ENGLISH: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, I kibatpihin, ei mahmah bangin, mi I bawl dia, amau tuipia ngasate tungah, tunga leng vasate tungah, gan tungah, leitung tengteng tungah thu I neisak ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: God said, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathianin amah kibatpihin mi a siama, Pathian kibatpih mahmahin ahi a siam; pasal leh numei a siamta hi.
ENGLISH: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin amau a vualjawl a: Pathian mah in a kiang uah, Chi tampi suang dingin hongpung unla, lei luah dim unla, na thuthu un omsak un; tuipia ngasa tungah, tunga leng vasate tungah, thil hing leitunga khupboh a paite tengteng tungah leng thu nei un, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

PAITE: Huan, Pathian mahin, ngai un, leitung tengtenga anteh chinei om chiteng leh sing chiteng, sing chinei gah omnate, ka honpia hi; na an ding uh ahi ding:
ENGLISH: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

PAITE: Huan, leia sa chiteng kiangah, tunga leng vasa chiteng kiangah, thil, leitunga khupboha pai, henna nei chiteng kiangah a an ding un loupa hing chiteng ka pia hi, a chi a: huchiin, huchibang a honghita.Huan, Pathianin a thil bawl khempeuh a ena, ngaiin, hoih a sa mahmah, Huchiin, nitaklam a oma, jinglam leng a om, ani gukna ah.
ENGLISH: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food”; and it was so.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin a thil bawl khempeuh a ena, ngaiin, hoih a sa mahmah, Huchiin, nitaklam a oma, jinglam leng a om, ani gukna ah.
ENGLISH: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

PAITE: Huan, hiaite Noa tapa Sem te, Japheth te suante ahi uh: tuichim tun nungin tapate bang a nei chiat uhi.
ENGLISH: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

PAITE: Japheth tapate Gomer te, Magog te, Madai te, Javan te, Tubal te, Mesek te, Tiras te ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

PAITE: Huan, Gomer tapate Askenazi te, Riphath te, Togarma te ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

PAITE: Huan, Javan tapate Elisa te, Tarsis te leh Kittim te, Dodanim te ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

PAITE: Huaite akipanin ahi, Jentelte tuikulh gamtea amau gama a kikhenjak uh; amau pau bang jel leh amau nam bang jelin, amau chite lakah.
ENGLISH: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

PAITE: Huan, Ham tapate Kus te, Mizraim te, Phut te, Kanaan te ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

PAITE: Huan, Kus tapate Seva te, Havela te, Sabta te, Raam te, Sabtek te ahi uh: huan, Raam tapate Sheba leh Dedan ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

PAITE: Huan, Kusin tapa Nimrod a neia. Amah lei ah mi hattak a hong hi panta hi.
ENGLISH: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

PAITE: Toupa maah sabengmi hattak ahia; Huaijiakin ahi, Toupa maa sabeng hattak Nimrod bang ahi, a chih nak uh.
ENGLISH: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh.”

PAITE: Huan, a lal kipatna Sinar gama, Babel khua te, Erek khua te, Akkad khua te, Kalneh khua te ahi.
ENGLISH: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

PAITE: Huai gam akipanin a pawta, Assuria gamah a luta, Ninevi khua te, Rehob-Ir khua te, Kala khua te.
ENGLISH: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

PAITE: Ninevi leh Kala kikalah Resen khua te a sata! Huai Resen khua kho thupi ahi.
ENGLISH: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (the same is the great city).

PAITE: Huan, Mizraimin Ludte, Anamte, Lehabte, Naphtuhte,
ENGLISH: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

PAITE: Pathruste, Kasluhte (Philistinte pawtna) te a suangta hi.
ENGLISH: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

PAITE: Huan, Kanaanin ta masa Zidon a neia, Heth leng a nei laia:
ENGLISH: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

PAITE: Jesbuste, Amorte, Girgaste;
ENGLISH: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

PAITE: Hivte, Arkate, Sinte;
ENGLISH: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

PAITE: Arvadte, Zemarte, Hamathte a suanga; huai nungin Kanaante namte a dalh jakta uhi;
ENGLISH: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

PAITE: Huan, Kanaante gamgi zidon khua akipanin, Gerar lam juanin, Lasa khua tannin ahi.
ENGLISH: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as you go toward Gerar, to Gaza; as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, to Lasha.

PAITE: Huaite Ham suante ahi uh, amau namte bang jel leh amau pau bang jelin amau gam lamahte lah amau chite lakah.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their languages, in their lands, in their nations.

PAITE: Huan, Sem, Ever tate tengteng suangpa, Japheth uin leng tate a nei hi.
ENGLISH: To Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.

PAITE: Sem tapate Elam te, Assur te, Arpaksad te, Lud te Aram te ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

PAITE: Huan, Aram tapate Uz te, Hul te, Gether te, Mas te ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

PAITE: Huan, Arpaksadin tapa Selah a neia; huan, Selahin tapa Ever anei hi.
ENGLISH: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

PAITE: Huan, Eberin tapa nih aneia: khat min peleg ahia, a dam laiin lei lah khanin a omta ngala; a nau min Joktan ahi.
ENGLISH: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

PAITE: Huan, Joktanin tapa Almodad te, Seleph te, Hazarmaveth te, Jerah te;
ENGLISH: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

PAITE: Hadoram te, Uzal te, Diklah te;
ENGLISH: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

PAITE: Obel te, Abimael te, Sheba te;
ENGLISH: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

PAITE: Ophir te, Havel te Jobab te a neaia: huaite tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

PAITE: Huan. A omna uh Mesa akipanin, suahlam tang Sephar lam juanin ahi.
ENGLISH: Their dwelling was from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

PAITE: Huaite Sem suante ahi uh, amau namte bang jel leh amau paute bang jelin, amau gamlam teah, amau chite bang jelin.Huaite Noa suante namte ahi ua, a suante un bangjelin a chite uh lakah; tuichim tun nungin huaite akipanin ahi; leia chi chih a dalh uh.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their languages, in their lands, after their nations.

PAITE: Huaite Noa suante namte ahi ua, a suante un bangjelin a chite uh lakah; tuichim tun nungin huaite akipanin ahi; leia chi chih a dalh uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations. Of these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

PAITE: Huan, leia mi tengteng pau khat leh thugen dan khat ahi ua.
ENGLISH: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, suahlama a kisuan jel laiun Sinar gamah phaijang a mu ua; huaiah a tengta uhi.
ENGLISH: It happened, as they traveled east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

PAITE: Huan, Kisa un; teklei I bawl dia, hoih takin I hal ding, a kichita uhi. Huchiin, suang sikin teklei a nei ua, suanghukna sikin, longnai a nei uhi.
ENGLISH: They said one to another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

PAITE: Huan, Kisa un, khopi i bawl dia, insang a vum van sun dingin I bawl dia, I min I thangsak ding uh; huchilouin jaw lei pumpiah hihdalhin I omkha ding, a chi uh.
ENGLISH: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make ourselves a name, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

PAITE: Huan, Toupa mite taten khopi leh insang a lam khawng uh en dingin a hoh suka.
ENGLISH: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan ngai dih ua, mipi te pumkhat ahi ua, a vek un lah pau khat a nei ngal ua; hiai thil a hih pan uhi; tun jaw a thilhih tup himhimte uh leng kham vual a hita kei ding.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

PAITE: Kisa un, I va hoh suk ding, pau a kitheituah theihlouhna ding un, huailaiah a pau uh I vasuklamdangsak ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Toupan amaute huai akipanin lei tengteng ah a dalhsaka: huchiin a kho bawl uh a tawpsanta uhi.
ENGLISH: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

PAITE: Huaijiakin a min Babel a chi uh; Toupan amaute leitung tengteng ah a dalhsakta hi.
ENGLISH: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

PAITE: Hiai Sem suante ahi uh. Sem kum ja a upa ahi, tuichim tun nung kum nih nungin tapa Arpaksad a nei hi.
ENGLISH: This is the history of the generations of Shem. Shem was one hundred years old and became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

PAITE: Huan, Arpaksad a neih nungin Sem kum za nga a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Arpaksadin, kum sawmthum leh kum nga a hihin, tapa Selah a neia:
ENGLISH: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

PAITE: Huan, Selah a neih nungin Arpaksad kum zali leh kum thum a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Selahin, kum sawm thum ahihin, tapa Eber a neia:
ENGLISH: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber:

PAITE: Huan, Eber a neih nungin Selah kum zali leh kum thum a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: and Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Eberin, kum sawm thum leh kum li a hihin, tapa Peleg a neia:
ENGLISH: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

PAITE: Huan, Peleg a neih nungin Eber kum zali leh kum sawm thum a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Pelegin, kum sawm thum ahihin, tapa Reu a neia:
ENGLISH: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

PAITE: Huan, Reu a neih nungin Peleg kum zanih leh kum kua a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Reuin, kum sawm thum leh kum nih a hihin, tapa Serug a neia:
ENGLISH: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

PAITE: Huan, Serug a neih nungin Reu kum zanih leh kum sagih a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Serugin, kum sawm thum ahihin, tapa Nahor a neia:
ENGLISH: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

PAITE: Huan Nahor a neih nungin Serug kum zanih a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Nahorin, kum sawm nih leh kum kua ahihin, tapa Terah a neia:
ENGLISH: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

PAITE: Huan, Terah aneih nungin Nahor kum za leh kum sawm leh kum kua a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Terahin, kum sawm sagih ahihin tapa Abram te, Nahor te, Haran te a nei hi.
ENGLISH: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

PAITE: Huan, hiaite Terah suante ahi uh. Terahin tapa Abram te, Nahor te, Haran te a neia; huan, Haranin tapa Lota a nei.
ENGLISH: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

PAITE: Huan, Haran a pianna gama, kaldaite khua Ur ah, apa Terah main a si hi.
ENGLISH: Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees.

PAITE: Huan, Abram leh Nahorin ji a nei ua; Abram ji min Sarai ahia: Nahor ji min Haran tanu Milka ahi, Haran Milka pa leh Iska pa ahi.
ENGLISH: Abram and Nahor took wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran who was also the father of Iscah.

PAITE: Huan, Sarai a chiinga; ta himhim a neikei.
ENGLISH: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

PAITE: Huan, Trahin tapa Abram te, a tapa tapa (Haran tapa) Lota te, a mou, a tapa Abram ji Sarai te a pia; huan, Kanana hoh dingin Kaldaite khua Ur akipanin a pawt khawmta uhi; huan, Haran khua a hongtun un, huailaiah a tengta uh.Huan, Terah damsung kum za nih leh kum nga ahi a: huan, Terah Haran khuaah a sita hi.
ENGLISH: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

PAITE: Huan, Terah damsung kum za nih leh kum nga ahi a: huan, Terah Haran khuaah a sita hi.
ENGLISH: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan, Abram kiangah, na kha lama kipan leh na tanaute laka kipan leh na pa in akipan pawt inla, gam ka honetsak ding lamah pain:
ENGLISH: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Get out of your country, and from your relatives, and from your father’s house, to the land that I will show you.

PAITE: Huchiin, chi thupi mahmahin ka honbawl dinga, vual ka hon jawl dinga, na min ka hih thupi ding; huan, nang vualjawlna hiin:
ENGLISH: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

PAITE: Huan, nang hon vualjawl peuhmah ka vualjawla dinga, hon hamsiat peuhmah ka hamsiat ding: nangah leia nam chih a nuamsa ding uh, achia.
ENGLISH: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who curses you. All of the families of the earth will be blessed in you.”

PAITE: Huchiin Abram Toupan a kianga a gen bangin a kuantaa; Lota leng a kiangah a kuan sam hi: huan, Abram Haran khua akipan a pawt laiin kum sawm sagih leh kum nga a upa ahi.
ENGLISH: So Abram went, as Yahweh had spoken to him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed out of Haran.

PAITE: Huan, Abramin a ji Sarai leh, a nau tapa Lota leh, a sum kaihkhawm tengteng uh leh, Haran khua a a mi neihte tengteng uh a pi a; Kanan gam a hoh dingin a pawtta ua; huan, Kanan gam a tungta uhi.
ENGLISH: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls whom they had gotten in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. Into the land of Canaan they came.

PAITE: Huan, Abram huai gamah Sekem mun phain, Moreh tosaw tanin, a pai jela. Huailaiin, Kanante huai gamah a om uh.
ENGLISH: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. The Canaanite was then in the land.

PAITE: Huan, Toupa Abram kiangah a kilaka, hiai gam na suante kiangah ka pe ding, achia: huchiin, huailaiah, a kianga kilak Toupa adingin, maitam a dohta hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your seed or, offspring .” He built an altar there to Yahweh, who appeared to him.

PAITE: Huan, huai a kipanin Bethel suahlam a tang ah a kisuana, huai laiah a puanin a kaita a, a tumlamah Bethel a oma, a suahlamah Ai khua a om hi: huailaiah Toupa a dingin maitam a doh nawna. Toupa min a lou hi.
ENGLISH: He left from there to the mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh and called on the name of Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Abram Sim gam lam juanin a kisuan lailai hi.
ENGLISH: Abram traveled, going on still toward the South.

PAITE: Huan, huai gamah kial a keta a: huan, huai gam a nak kial mahmah jiak un, Abram Aigupta gama om tadih dingin a paisukta.
ENGLISH: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, Aigupta gam a lut dinga a kisak laiun, a ji Sarai kiangah, ngaiin, numei melhoih tak na hi chih ka thei hi:
ENGLISH: It happened, when he had come near to enter Egypt, that he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

PAITE: Huchiin, hichi ahi ding Aiguptaten nang a honmuh ding un, hiai a ji eive, a chi ding ua: huan, kei a hon that mai ding uh, nang bel a honhawi ding uh.
ENGLISH: It will happen, when the Egyptians will see you, that they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

PAITE: Nang jiaka hoih taka ka om theihna dingin leh nang vanga ka hin theihna dingin, asanggamnu ka hi, hehpihtakin chi jelin a chi hi.
ENGLISH: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi a, Abram Aigupta gam alut leh, Aiguptaten numei a mu ua, a mel hoih a sa mahmah ua.
ENGLISH: It happened that when Abram had come into Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

PAITE: Pharo mi lianten leng a mu ua, Pharo kiangah a hoihdan a gen uh: huchiin, numei Pharo in ah a pi lutta uh.
ENGLISH: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

PAITE: Huan, aman Sarai jiakin Abram hoih takin a hiha: huchiin belamte, bawngte, sabengtungpate, sikhapate, sikhanute, sabengtungnute, sangawngsaute a neih lohta hi.
ENGLISH: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan Abram ji Sarai jiakin Pharo leh a inkuante bawl namaiin a bawlta kei hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pharoin Abram a sama, ka tunga na thilhih bangchidan a maia? Na ji ahi chih bang dia honhilh lou na hia? Ka sanggam nu ahi, bangdia chi na hia?
ENGLISH: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

PAITE: Huaijiakin akeimaw ka ji dinga ka naneih hial: ahihleh, tuin enin na ji, pi inla, pai mangin, achia.Huan Pharoin a tungthu ah mi kiangah thu a piaa, huchiin amah a vakhata ua, a ji toh, a neih tengteng toh.
ENGLISH: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

PAITE: Huan Pharoin a tungthu ah mi kiangah thu a piaa, huchiin amah a vakhata ua, a ji toh, a neih tengteng toh.
ENGLISH: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they brought him on the way with his wife and all that he had.

PAITE: Huan, Abram Aigupta gama kipanin a pawta, Sim gamah ah a pai tou taa, a kiangah a jite, a neih tengtengte, Lotate a pi tou sam uhi,
ENGLISH: Abram went up out of Egypt: he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him, into the South.

PAITE: Huan, Abram gante, dangkate, dangkaengtein a hausa mahmaha.
ENGLISH: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

PAITE: Huan, Sim gam akipanin Bethel tan a pai jela, Bethel leh Ai kho kikala, a tunga a puanin omna ah;
ENGLISH: He went on his journeys from the South even to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

PAITE: Atunga a maitam dohna mahmahah; huan, huaiah Abramin Toupa min a lou hi.
ENGLISH: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the name of Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Lota Abram kianga pai samin, belam honte, bawnghonte, puaninte a ni sama.
ENGLISH: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

PAITE: Huan, a omkhawmna ding un gam a kichingta kei hi: a van neih ulah a thupi mahmah ngala, huchiin a om khawm thei nawn mahmah kei uh,
ENGLISH: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together: for their substance was great, so that they could not live together.

PAITE: Huchiin, Abram gan pute leh Lota gan pute kalah kiselna hongpawtta a: huai laiin Kanante leh Peizte huai gamah a om uh.
ENGLISH: There was a strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite lived in the land at that time.

PAITE: Huchiin, Abram, Lota kiangah, hehpihtakin, nang leh kei kalah, na gan pute leh ka gan pute kalah zong kiselna om kei hen; unau lah I hi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between me and you, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we are relatives.

PAITE: Gam a pumpiin a om ka hia? Hehpihtakin ka kianga kipan tuam om maiin: nang veilama na pai leh, kei taklamah ka pai ding; ahihkeileh, nang taklama na pai leh, kei veilamah ka pai ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Lota a daka, Zoar kho lam juanin, Jordan phaijang tengteng, Toupa huan bang, Aigupta gam bangin, gam chiha tui tampi omna ahi chih a theia, Toupan Sodom leh Gomorra khua a suksiat ma lah ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

PAITE: Huchiin Lotain Jordan phaijang tengteng a telta a; huan, Lota suahlamah a kisuana; huchiin a kikhenta uh.
ENGLISH: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves the one from the other.

PAITE: Abram bel Kanan gamah a oma, Lota bel phaijang khuate ah a oma, a puanin Sodom kho phain a suan jeljel hi.
ENGLISH: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

PAITE: Huan, Sodom mite Pathian mitmuhin nakpi taka hoihlou leh khialin a om uhi.
ENGLISH: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, a kianga kipana Lota a om tuam nungin, Toupan Abram kiangah, dak inla, na omna akipanin mallamte, simlamte, suahlamte, tumlamte enin;
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

PAITE: Na gam muh tengteng na kiangah leh na suante kiangah khantawn a dinging ka honpe ding ahi.
ENGLISH: for all the land which you see, I will give to you, and to your offspring forever.

PAITE: Huan, na suante leia leivui bang maiin ka bawl ding; huchiin min leia leivui a sim seng uleh, na suante leng sim seng ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then your seed may also be numbered.

PAITE: Thou inla, gam a dung a vaiin pal suakin; na kianga honpe ding ka hi, a chi a.Huchiin, Abramin a puanin a suana, Hebron a om Mamre tosaw kiangah a tengta a, huaiah Toupa a dingin maitam a doh hi.
ENGLISH: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its breadth; for I will give it to you.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Abramin a puanin a suana, Hebron a om Mamre tosaw kiangah a tengta a, huaiah Toupa a dingin maitam a doh hi.
ENGLISH: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Sinar kho kumpipa Amraphelte, Ellasar kho kumpipa Ariokte, Elam kho kumpipa Kedorlamomerte, Goiim kho kumpipa Tidalte dam laiin hichi ahia.
ENGLISH: It happened in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,

PAITE: Amau bel Sodom kho kumpipa Bera a sim uh. Gomorra kho kumpipa Birsate, Admah kho kumpipa Sinabte, Zeboiim kho kumpipate Smeberte, Bela kho kumpipate leng a sim ua, (huai tuh Zoar ahi).
ENGLISH: that they made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar).

PAITE: Huan hiai tengteng Siddim guam ah a pang ua, (huai guam Tuipi Al ahita).
ENGLISH: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (the same is the Salt Sea).

PAITE: Kum sawm leh kum nih singin Kedorlaomer nuaiah a om ua, a kum sawm leh kum thumna ah a helta uh.
ENGLISH: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year, they rebelled.

PAITE: Huchiin, a kum sawm leh kum lina ah Kedorlaomer leh a kianga kumpipa omte a hong ua, Asteroth-karnaim khua ah Rephaimte a that ua, ham khua ah Zusimte a that ua, Kariathaim jangah Emimte a that ua,
ENGLISH: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

PAITE: A omna Seir tangah Elparan phain, Horte a that ua, (El-paran gamdei juala om ahi).
ENGLISH: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to Elparan, which is by the wilderness.

PAITE: Huan, a kik nawn ua, Enmispet a tungua (huai Kades ahita), Amelekte gam a mi teng leh, Amorte, Hazazontamar khua a omte leng, a that nawn uh.
ENGLISH: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (the same is Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

PAITE: Huchiin, Sodom kho kumpipate, Gomorra kho kumpipate, Adma kho kumpipate, Zeboiim kho kumpipate, Bela kho kumpipate a pawt ua, (Bela khua Zoar khua ahita); huan, Siddim guam ah amau sual dingin a pangta uhi.
ENGLISH: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim;

PAITE: Elam kho kumpipa Kedorlaomerte, Goiim kho kumpipa Tidalte, Sinar kho kumpipate Amraphelte, Ellasa kho kumpipa Ariokte sual dingin; kumpipa li in kumpipate nga a sual uh.
ENGLISH: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

PAITE: Huan, Siddim guam longnai khukin a dim a; huan, Sodom leh Gomorra kho kumpipate a taikek ua, huai laiah a kia ua, ke valte tang ah a tai touta uhi.
ENGLISH: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there, and those who remained fled to the hills.

PAITE: Huchiin, Sodom leh Gomorra mite sum tengteng leh a nek ding tengteng uh a la ua, a paita uh.
ENGLISH: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

PAITE: Lota, Abram unau tapa, /Sodom khua a om, a sumte toh a la ua, a paita uhi.
ENGLISH: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

PAITE: Huan, mi khat taikhia a hongpaia, Hebru mi Abram a hilha; amah bel Amor mi Mamre tosaw kiang khawngah a om. Mamre Eskol unau leh Aner unau ahia; huai mite Abramte toh pangkhawm ahi uh.
ENGLISH: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. Now he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and these were allies of Abram.

PAITE: Huan, Abramin a ta salin a pi uh chih a jak takin, a inna piang, amah mi, chilsiamsa, za thum leh sawm leh giat a pi khia a, Dan kho phain a delhta.
ENGLISH: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.

PAITE: Huan, jan in amau sual dingin amah leh a sikhate a kihawmjak ua, (Hoba Damaska kho mallamah a om).
ENGLISH: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

PAITE: Huan, sum tengteng a honla kik nawn vek a, a ta Lota leh a sum tengteng a honla kik nawn veka, numeite leng a honpi nawna mi dang tengteng toh
ENGLISH: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative, Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

PAITE: Huan, Kedorlaomer leh a kianga kumpipa omte that a pai nungin Sodom kumpipa Save guamah Abram dawnin a hoh suka, (Save guam kumpipa guam a hita).
ENGLISH: The king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

PAITE: Huan, Salem kho kumpipa Melkisedekin tanghou leh uain a honla a; amah bel Pathian Tungnungpen siampu ahi.:
ENGLISH: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.

PAITE: Huan, aman Abram a vualjawla. Lei leh van neipa, Pathian Tungnungpen Abram vualjawlin omhen:
ENGLISH: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:

PAITE: Na melmate na khuta honpepa, Pathian Tungnungpen, phatin om hen, achia. Huan, Abramin amah bangkim sawm a khat a pia hi.
ENGLISH: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

PAITE: Huan, Sodom kho kumpipan Abram kiangah, mite honpia inla, sumte jaw nang kineih maiin, a chi.
ENGLISH: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods to yourself.”

PAITE: Huan, Abramin, Sodom kumpipa kiangah, lei leh van neipa, Toupa, Pathian Tungnungpen lamah ka khut ka jakta hi.
ENGLISH: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

PAITE: Khauzang khat kia leng, khedap khau khat kia leng, na neih himhim kala kei ding, huchilouinjaw, Abram jaw kei hauhsak ahi, na chi kha ding:Tangvalte nek mang leh, ka mi paipihte tantuan kia loujaw kala kei ding; Anerte, Eskolte, Mamreten a tantuan uh la uhen, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

PAITE: Tangvalte nek mang leh, ka mi paipihte tantuan kia loujaw kala kei ding; Anerte, Eskolte, Mamreten a tantuan uh la uhen, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

PAITE: Huai thilte khitin, Abram lau ken, kei na phaw leh na kipahman thupitak mai ka hi, chiin, Toupa thu Abram kiangah mang bangin a hongtunga.
ENGLISH: After these things the word of Yahweh came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

PAITE: Huan, Abramin, Aw Toupa Pathian, bang non pe dia, ta neilouin ka om den sina, ka goukempa lah Damaska khuaa Eliezer ahi ngala? A chi a.
ENGLISH: Abram said, “Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

PAITE: Huan, Abram mahin, ngaiin, chi himhim lah non suahsak ngal keia: enin, ka in a piang ka gouluahding ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: Abram said, “Behold, to me you have given no seed: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

PAITE: Huan, ngaiin, huai mi na gouluahding ahi kei ding; nangmah gila honggah ding ngei na gouluahding ahi zo ding, chiin, Toupa thu a kiangah a tunga.
ENGLISH: Behold, the word of Yahweh came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

PAITE: Huan, amah inpuaa ah a pi khiaa, Van lam en inla, aksite na sim theih leh sim himin, achia. Huan, amah mahin, a kiangah, Na suante huchibang ahi ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So shall your seed be.”

PAITE: Huan, aman Toupa a ginga, huchiin, amah huai a diktatnain a sehsakta hi.
ENGLISH: He believed in Yahweh; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.

PAITE: Huan, a kiangah, hiai luah dinga honpe dia Kaldaite khua Ur akipana honpi khia huai Toupa ka hi, achi a.
ENGLISH: He said to him, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, Toupa Pathian aw, ka luah ding chih bangchin ka thei ding? a chi a.
ENGLISH: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

PAITE: Huan, aman, a kiangah, bawngla kum thum a upa, kelpi kum thum a upa, vakhu leh vapal nou honlain, a chi a.
ENGLISH: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

PAITE: Huchiin, huai tengteng a honla, a lai takah a phelkhap chiata, a phel khat a phel khat lam dohin a koih chiat jela; vasate bel a phelkhap kei hi.
ENGLISH: He brought him all of these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

PAITE: Huan, vasa sasial nete saluangte tunga atuk chiangin Abramin a hawlkhe jel hi.
ENGLISH: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

PAITE: Huan, ni tum dia a kisak sialsial laiin, Abram a na ihmu hithita; huan, ngaiin, a mial a mial, thil mulkimhuai petmahin amah a honkhuha.
ENGLISH: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

PAITE: Huan Pathianin Abram kiangah, na suante amau gam louah mikhual in a om ding uh, a na uh a sepsak ding uh chih teltakin theiin; huan, kum za li a hihgenthei ding ua;
ENGLISH: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your seed will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

PAITE: Huan, a na uh a sepsakte chi uh leng ka ngaihtuah ding: huan, huai khit chiangin sum tampi neiin a hongpawt ding uhi.
ENGLISH: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth,

PAITE: Nang bel na pipute kiangah lungmuang takin na pai dinga; na lu a kelsam pou vekin a honvui ding uh.
ENGLISH: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried in a good old age.

PAITE: Huan, suan lina ah hiailaiah a hongpai nawn ding uh; Amorte khelhnate lah a kim nai ngal keia, a chi a
ENGLISH: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, ni tuma, khua a hongmialin, ngaiin, halzulna meikhu lunglung leh meisel kuang luahluah huai sa phelkhapte kala paipai a hongoma.
ENGLISH: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

PAITE: Huai niin Toupan, hiai gam, Aigupta lui akipan lui lianpi (Euphrates lui) phain, na suante kiangah ka peta:
ENGLISH: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your seed I have given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

PAITE: Kente, Kenizte, Kadmonte,
ENGLISH: the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

PAITE: Hitte, Perizte, Rephaimte,Amorte, Kanante, Girgahte, Jebuste toh leng ka pe laia, chiin, Abram kiangah thu a khungta hi.
ENGLISH: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

PAITE: Amorte, Kanante, Girgahte, Jebuste toh leng ka pe laia, chiin, Abram kiangah thu a khungta hi.
ENGLISH: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

PAITE: Huan, Sarai Abram jiin ta himhim a neihsak keia; huan, Saraiin Aiguptami sikhanu khat a neia, huai mi min Hagar ahi.
ENGLISH: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

PAITE: Huan, Saraiin, Abram kiangah, ngai dihve, Toupan lah ta ka neih honphal loua; hehpihtakin ka sikhanu kithuahpih in; amah laka kipana tate ka neih khak leh, achia. Huchiin, Abramin Sarai thu a juita.
ENGLISH: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my handmaid. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

PAITE: Huchiin, Abram ji Saraiin Abram Kanan gama kum sawm a om nungin, a sikhanu Aiguptami a pia, a pasal Abram kiangah a ji kia om dingin a pia hi.
ENGLISH: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her handmaid, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

PAITE: Huan, Hagar a kithuahpiha; huan amah a gaita: huan, a gai chih a kitheih takin a pi a simmoh maimaha.
ENGLISH: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
