PAITE: Ngai un, pasal kithuahpih ngei nailou tanu nih ka nei ahi; honhehpih unla, amau na kiang uah kon pikhe ding, hoih na sak bangun a tunguah na hih nading uh; hiai mite tungah jaw bangmah hih mahmah kei un, Huaijiakin ahi, ka in sunga a honglut uh, achia.
ENGLISH: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

PAITE: Huan, amau, honhon maiin, a chi ua, Huan, amau mahin, hiai mi soplai hiaia om dingin a hong pem luta, vaihawmpa a om a tum viala: tunjaw amau tunga hih sangin na tungah a hih hoih semsem ding uh, a chi ua. Huan, mi (Lota) a bohta ua, kongkhak suse dingin a honnaih ua.
ENGLISH: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now will we deal worse with you, than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and drew near to break the door.

PAITE: Himahleh miten a khut uh a golh khia ua, Lota a kiang uah in sungah a kailut ua, kongkhak a khak bikbek uh.
ENGLISH: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

PAITE: Huan, kongkhak bula mite, a lian a neuin, a mit uh a tosak ua, huchiin kongkhak a muzou kei uhi.
ENGLISH: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

PAITE: Huan, miten, Lota kiangah, hiai mite lou hiaiah inkuanpihte dang na nei hia? na makpapa leh, na tapate leh, na tanute leh, kho sunga na neih peuhmahte khua akipanin pi khiain:
ENGLISH: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whoever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

PAITE: Toupa maa a kikou husa a nathupi jiakin hiai khua hihmang ding ka hi uh; hihmang dingin Toupan lah a honsawl ngala, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”

PAITE: Huchiin Lota a pai khiaa, a tanute kitenpih, a makpate kiangah a vagena, thou unla hiai khua akipan pawt un, Toupan khua hihmang sin ahi, achia. Himahleh a makpate ngaihin chiamnuih thugen bang lel ahi.
ENGLISH: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city.” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

PAITE: Huan, phalvakin, angelten, Thou inla, na ji leh hiaia na tanu nih omte piin; huchilouin jaw hiai kho gawtna ah na mang tel kha ding uh, chiin, Lota a nohta ua.
ENGLISH: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife, and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

PAITE: Himahleh a awltat mahmah lai ngala; huchiin, Toupan amah a hehpih jiakin miten a khut leh, a ji khut leh a tanu nihte khut a len ua: huchiin a pikhia ua, kho polamah a koihta uh.
ENGLISH: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi a, polamah a pikhiak khit un, Na hinna dingin taikhiain; na nunglam nga kenla, Phaijang himhim ah leng khawl ken; hua tang sang ah suahtak sanin, huchilouinjaw na mang tek kha ding hi, achia.
ENGLISH: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

PAITE: Himahleh Lotain a kiang uah, ka Toupa, huchijaw hi kei hen:
ENGLISH: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

PAITE: Ngaiin, na sikhain na hehpihna a mua, nang na chitna na liansaka, huai chitna ka hinna humbitin ka tungah na langsak ahi; hua tang sang ah jaw ka tai theikei ding, thil hoihlou takin a honphain ka si kha ding:
ENGLISH: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

PAITE: Ngaiin, hua khua taina dingin a nai pena, kho neu chilik leng ahi ngala: aw, huailaiah (kho neu chilik ahi ka hia?) hontai sak jawin, huchiin ka hing ding hi, achia.
ENGLISH: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, a kiangah, Ngaiin, huai thil tungtangah leng kon mang hi, na kho gen ka hihmang dah ding.
ENGLISH: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

PAITE: Kin inla, huailaiah taiin; huailai na tun mateng lah bangmah ka hih thei sin ngal keia, achia. Huaijiakin huai kho min dingin Zoar a sata uh.
ENGLISH: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar. Zoar means “little.”

PAITE: Lota Zoar khua a tunin leitungah ni a hongsuak khinta.
ENGLISH: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan Sodom leh Gomorra kho tungah van a Toupa kianga kipanin kat leh mei a zu saka;
ENGLISH: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

PAITE: Huchiin, huai khuate leh, Phaijang tengteng leh, khua a mite tengteng leh, leitunga thil poute a hihmang vek hi.
ENGLISH: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

PAITE: A ji bel Lota nung lama kipanin a lehngata, chi khuam a hongsuakta hi.
ENGLISH: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

PAITE: Huan, Abraham bel takin Toupa maa a dinna munah a hohtou a:
ENGLISH: Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Sodom leh Gomorra kho lam leh Phaijang gam tengteng lam a ena, a en gigea; huan, ngaiin, huai gam a meikhu halzulna meikhu bang maiin khu tou ngoingoi hi.
ENGLISH: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and looked, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, Pathianin Phaijang khuate a hihman laia, Lota manthatna laka kipanin a sawlkhia hi.
ENGLISH: It happened, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

PAITE: Huan, Lota Zoar khua akipan a pai toua, tangah a oma, a tanu nihte leng a kiangah a om uh. Zoar khua ah lah a om ngam ngal kei ua; huan, amah leh a tanu nihte kohawm ah a omta uhi.
ENGLISH: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

PAITE: Huan, a upa jawin, a naupang jaw kiangah, I pa a upataa, khovel tengteng dan banga honkithuahpih dingin lei ah lah pasal khat lel leng a om nawn ngal keia:
ENGLISH: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

PAITE: Kisain, I pa uain I dawnsak dia, huchiin I pa chi suan bei loua I bawl theihna dingin a kiangah I lum ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s seed.”

PAITE: Huchiin, huai janin a pa uh uain a dawnsakta ua: huan, a upa jaw a luta, a pa kiangah a valuma; huan, aman a lup lam a phawk keia, a thoh nawn lam leng a phawk sam kei hi.
ENGLISH: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, a jingin a upa jawin a naupang jaw kiangah, ngaiin, jan janin ka pa kiangah ka luma; tu janin leng uain I dawn sak nawn dia; huan, nang lut inla, I pa chi suan bei loua I bawl theihna dingin a kiangah valum samin, achia.
ENGLISH: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine again, tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s seed.”

PAITE: Huchiin, huai janin leng a pa uh uain a dawn sak nawn ua: huan, a naupang jaw a thou a, a kiangah a valumtaa; huan, aman a lup lama phawk keia, a thoh nawn lam leng a phawk sam kei.
ENGLISH: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

PAITE: Huchibangin Lota tanu nihten a pa uh lakah nau a pai tuaktuak uhi.
ENGLISH: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

PAITE: Huan, a upa jawin tapa a nei a, a min din Moab a sa: huai mi tulaia Moabte suangpa ahi.Huan, a naupang jawin leng tapa a neia, amin dingin Ben-Ammi a saa: huai mi tulaia Ammon suante suangpa ahi hi.
ENGLISH: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

PAITE: Huan, a naupang jawin leng tapa a neia, amin dingin Ben-Ammi a saa: huai mi tulaia Ammon suante suangpa ahi hi.
ENGLISH: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

PAITE: Huchiin, lei leh van a tung ua omte tengteng toh zoh ahita hi.
ENGLISH: The heavens and the earth were finished, and all their vast array.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin ni sagih niin a nasep a zoua; ni sagih niin a nasep tengteng a khawl santa hi.
ENGLISH: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathianin ni sagih ni a vualzawla, atangta hi: huai nia Pathianin a siam leh a bawl a nasep tengteng a khawl san jiakin.
ENGLISH: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work which he had created and made.

PAITE: Lei leh van a bawla a om lai ua a suante uh hiaite ahi uhi, Toupa Pathianin lei leh van a bawl niin.
ENGLISH: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. God made the earth and the heavens.

PAITE: Huan, leia loupa himhim leiah a om naikei ua, leia anteh himhim leng a pou naikei uhi; Toupa Pathianiin lah leitungah vuah a zu sak nai keia, leilet dingin pasal leng a om nai sam kei hi;
ENGLISH: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

PAITE: A hihhangin leia kipanin mei a hongsuaka, leitung tengteng a nom sak hi.
ENGLISH: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

PAITE: Huan, Toupa Pathianin leitunga leivuiin mi a bawla, a nakvangte ah hinna hu a ha luta; huchiin, mi mihing a hong hita hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

PAITE: Huan, Toupa Pathianin suahlamah, Eden ah, huan a bawla; a pasal bawl huaiah a omsakta hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

PAITE: Huan, leitunga kipanin Toupa Pathianin sing mithip tak leh nek tuak chiteng a pou saka; hinna sing leng huan laizangah a pou sak hi, a sia leh a pha theihna sing leng.
ENGLISH: Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the middle of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

PAITE: Huan, Eden akipanin huan nomsak dingin lui a luang paisuaka; huaia kipanin a ka jaka, ka li a hong hita hi.
ENGLISH: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became four heads.

PAITE: A khatna min Pison ahi: huaipen Havila gam tengteng kualkhumlui ahi, huailaiah dangkaeng a om;
ENGLISH: The name of the first is Pishon: this is the one which flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

PAITE: Huai gama dangkaeng hoih taka hi; huailaiah bedolak leh onik suang a om.
ENGLISH: and the gold of that land is good. There is aromatic resin and the onyx stone.

PAITE: Huan, lui nihna Gihon ahi; huaimah Kus gam tengteng kualkhumlui ahi.
ENGLISH: The name of the second river is Gihon: the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

PAITE: Huan, lui thumna min Hiddekel ahi; huai bel Assuria gam suahlama luang ahi. Huan, lui lina tuh Euphrates ahi.
ENGLISH: The name of the third river is Hiddekel: this is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

PAITE: Huan, Toupa Pathianin pasal a pia, Eden huanah a kem ding leh a veng dingin a koihta hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

PAITE: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, pasal kiangah, Huana sing chiteng gahte na utut na ne thei hi;
ENGLISH: Yahweh God commanded the man, saying, “Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat;

PAITE: A sia leh a pha theihna sing gah bel na ne ding ahi kei; na nek leh na nek ni mahin na si ngei ding ahi, chiin, thu a pia.
ENGLISH: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it; for in the day that you eat of it you will surely die.”

PAITE: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, Pasal amah kiaa a om a hoih kei; amah panpaih ding a kithuahpih dia kilawm ka bawlsak ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh God said, “It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper suitable for him.”

PAITE: Huan, Toupa Pathianin leitung akipanin gam sa chiteng leh tunga leng vasa chiteng a bawlta; a min ding ua bang sak ding ahia chih theihna din Adam kiangah a honpi khawm hi: huan, thil hing chiteng a min uh Adam in a na phuah a min uh ahi den hi.
ENGLISH: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature, that was its name.

PAITE: Huchiin, Adam in gan tengteng, tunga leng vasa tengteng gamsa chiteng a min uh a phuahsak chiat hi: a hihhangin Adam adingin panpih a kithuahpih dia kilawm a om kei hi.
ENGLISH: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper suitable for him.

PAITE: Huchiin, Toupa Pathianin nuamtakin Adam a ihmu saka, huchiin a ihmutaa; huan, a nakguh khat a laa, atang dingin sa a pang dimsak hi:
ENGLISH: Yahweh God caused a deep sleep to fall on the man, and he slept; and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

PAITE: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, Adam akipana a lak nakguh numei dingin a bawla, Adam kiangah a honpita hi.
ENGLISH: He made the rib, which Yahweh God had taken from the man, into a woman, and brought her to the man.

PAITE: Huan Adamin, hiai hial jaw ka guh bang guh neia, ka sa bang sa nei ngei ahi; pasal akipana lak khiak ahih jiakin, Numei, chih ding ahi ding, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

PAITE: Huaijiakin pasalin a nu leh a pa a paisan dinga, a ji lamah a belh ding: huchiin sa khat a hong hita ding uh.Huan, Adam leh a ji a nih un vuaktangin a om ua, a zum tuan kei uh.
ENGLISH: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

PAITE: Huan, Adam leh a ji a nih un vuaktangin a om ua, a zum tuan kei uh.
ENGLISH: They were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

PAITE: Huan, Abraham huaia kipanin sim gam lam juanin a kisuana, Kades khua ah a omta dih laia.
ENGLISH: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin a ji Sara, ka sanggamnu ahi, achia: huchiin, Gerar kumpipa Abimelekin mi a sawla, Sara a vapi sakta.
ENGLISH: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

PAITE: Himahleh, Pathianin janin a mangin Abimelek kiangah a honga, a kiangah, Ngaiin, na numei pi jiakin misi phet na hita, mi ji lah ahi ngala, achia.
ENGLISH: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken. For she is a man’s wife.”

PAITE: Abimelekin bel, a kithuahpih nai tadih keia; huchiin, Toupa, chi diktatte leng na hihlum sin ahia?
ENGLISH: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

PAITE: Amah mahin, ka kiangah, ka sanggamnu ahi, a chi alah? Huan, amah ngeiin leng, ka sanggampa ahi, a chi behlap ngala: lungtang hoihtak pu leh khut siangthou tak nei kawmin hiai ka hih ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister?’ She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands have I done this.”

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin a mangin, ahi, hiai lungtang hoih tak pu kawma na hih ahi chih ka theia, huchiin ken leng ka tunga na khelh ding kon kham ahi: Huaijiakin ahi, amah na khoih ka phal louh.
ENGLISH: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

PAITE: Huchiin tuin huai mi ji pe kik nawnin; amah lah jawlnei ahi ngala, a honthum sak dinga, huan, na dam ding hi: na piak kik nawn kei le jaw, na si ngei ding chih thei maiin, nang leng na neih tengteng toh achia.
ENGLISH: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Abimelek bel takin a thoua, a sikhate tengteng a sama, a bil uah huai thu tengteng a hilha: huan, miten a lau mahmah uh.
ENGLISH: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

PAITE: Huchiin, Abimelekin Abraham a sama, a kiangah, ka tung ua na thil hih bangchidan ahia oi? Bang lamah ahia na tunga ka khelha, kei leh ka khua leh tuite tunga thil gilou thupi tak na hon tut? Thil hih tuak louh tak ka tungah na hihta, achia.
ENGLISH: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

PAITE: Huan, Abimelek mahin Abraham kiangah, Bang na mua, hichibanga thil na hih maijen? A chi nawna.
ENGLISH: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin, hiai khau ah Pathian kihtakna a om hetkei ngei dinga, ka ji jiakin a honthat mai ding uh chih ka ngaihtuah jiak ahi.
ENGLISH: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

PAITE: Huailouin ka sanggamnu leng ahi hima, ka pa tanu ahi a, ka nu tanu bel ahi kei; huan ka jiin a hong omta ahi:
ENGLISH: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, Pathianin ka pa in akipana a honvakvaihsak laiin, a kiangah, hiai na hehpihna ka tunga na latsak ding ahi; ka tunna peuhmah uah, Ka sanggampa ahi, honchi jelin ka chi him ahi, achia,
ENGLISH: It happened, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

PAITE: Huan, Abimelekin belamte leh bawngtalte leh, sikhapate leh sikhanute a pia, Abraham kiangah a piaa, a ji Sara leng a pe kik nawnta hi.
ENGLISH: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

PAITE: Huan, Abimelekin, Enin, ka gam a ja akei hiam, na utna peuh ah omin, achia.
ENGLISH: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

PAITE: Huan, Sara kiangah, Enin na sanggampa dangka sang khat ka peta a: ngaiin, na kianga om tengteng lakah nang din mit khuhna ding ahi; na tung thu himhim ah na dik nawn vekta ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Abraham Pathian kiangah a thuma: huan, Pathianin Abimelek leh a ji leh a sikhanute a damsak nawna; huchiin tate a nei nawnta.Abraham ji Sara jiakin Toupan Abimelek inkote tengteng lah a chingsa vekta ngala.
ENGLISH: Abraham prayed to God. God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

PAITE: Abraham ji Sara jiakin Toupan Abimelek inkote tengteng lah a chingsa vekta ngala.
ENGLISH: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan a gensa bangin Sara a veha, Toupan a gensa bangin Sara tungah leng a hihsaka.
ENGLISH: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

PAITE: Huchiin, Sara a gaia, Pathianin a kianga agen hun seh takin Abraham a tek nungin tapa a neihsakta hi.
ENGLISH: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin, a tapa neih, Sarain a neihsak, amin dingin Isaak a saa.
ENGLISH: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac. Isaac means “He laughs.”

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin, Pathianin a kianga thu a piak bangin a tapa Isaak ni giat a chinin a zek a sumsaka.
ENGLISH: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

PAITE: Abraham a tapa Isaak a neih laiin kum ja a upa ahi.
ENGLISH: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

PAITE: Huan, Sarain, Pathianin honnuisakta; a ja mi chihon honnuihpih ding uh, achia.
ENGLISH: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

PAITE: Huan, amah mahin, Sarain naungekte a honpom ding chih, kuan ahia Abraham kianga genna dan thei ding? a tek nungin tapa ka neihsakta achia.
ENGLISH: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham, that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

PAITE: Huan, naungek a hongkhangliana, a nawinek a tawpsakta ua: huan, Isaak a nawinek a tawpsak ni uh Abrahamin ankuang thupi a luita hi.
ENGLISH: The child grew, and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

PAITE: Huan, Aiguptami Hagar tapa, Abraham a dinga a neihpan, a nuihsan lai Sarain a mua.
ENGLISH: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

PAITE: Huaijiakin Abraham kiangah, hiai sikhanu leh a tapa delhkhia in: hiai sikhanu tapa ka tapa Isaak gouluah pih ding ahi theikei ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this handmaid and her son! For the son of this handmaid will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

PAITE: Huan, hiai thu a tapa jiakin Abraham ngaihin thil hoihlou tak ahi.
ENGLISH: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

PAITE: Himahleh Pathianin Abraham kiangah, Naupang tungtang thu leh na sikhanu tungtang thu na ngaihin thil hoihlou tak hi kei hen; Sarain na kianga thu a gen tengteng juiin; Isaak ah na suante a chi ding uh la ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your handmaid. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For from Isaac will your seed be called.

PAITE: Huan, sikhanu tapa ah leng, na suan a hih jiakin, chi chih tham ngial ka honbawl ding, achia.
ENGLISH: I will also make a nation of the son of the handmaid, because he is your seed.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Abraham bel takin a thoua, tanghou leh tuithawl tui a dim a laa, Hagar kiangah a piaa, a liangkolou ah a suansaka, naupang mah leng, a paisak taa; huchiin a paia, Beer-seba gamdai ah a vak a vakta hi.
ENGLISH: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

PAITE: Huan, tuithawl a tui a hong omta keia, huchiin naupang loubuk munkhat ah a koihta mai hi.
ENGLISH: The water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

PAITE: Huan, Naupang si ding ka en ngam kei, a chih jiakin a paia, gamla kuamah, thal kap phakna ding bangah, a majawn ah a vatuta khong khonga. Huchiin, a majawn ah a tua, ngaihtakin a kapta hi.
ENGLISH: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin naupang aw a jaa; huan, Pathian angelin van akipanin Hagar a sama, a kiangah, Bang na chia ahia Hagar? Lau ken: na omna naupang aw Pathianin a ja hi.
ENGLISH: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What ails you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

PAITE: Thou inla, huai naupang phong inla, na khutin lenin, amah chi thupi taka bawl ding ka hi, achia.
ENGLISH: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him in your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin a mit a hihvak saka, tuileh a muta hi; huchiin a vapaia, tuithawl ah tui a dim dima, naupang a dawnsakta hi.
ENGLISH: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the bottle with water, and gave the boy drink.

PAITE: Huan, naupang kiangah Pathian a om jela, a hong khanglian jela; gamdai ah a om tou jela, thalkap siam a honghita.
ENGLISH: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.

PAITE: Paran gamdai ah a oma; huan, anun Aigupta gam akipanin ji a guan hi.
ENGLISH: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, huailai khawngin Abimelek leh a sepaih pawl heutu Phikolin Abraham kiangah, na thil hih peuh Pathian na kiangah om jeljela:
ENGLISH: It happened at that time, that Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

PAITE: Huchiin tuin hiailaiah Pathian min lou inla, kei leh ka tapa leh ka tapa tapa leng khem louin, ka honna hehpih khittaksa bangin kei leh na omna gam hehpih thuk sam dingin ka kiangah kichiam ve leh! chiin a gena.
ENGLISH: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

PAITE: Huan Abrahamin, Ka kichiam ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

PAITE: Huan, Abimelek sikhaten tuileh a suh jiak un Abrahamin Abimelek a sala.
ENGLISH: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

PAITE: Huan, Abimelekin, hiai thil hihpen kua ahia, ka thei himhim kei: nang lah non hilh ngal keia, tuni ngallouin ka za nai himhim kei, achia.
ENGLISH: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, neither did I hear of it, until today.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Abrahamin belamte leh bawngtalte a pia, Abimelek kiangah a piaa; huan, a nih un thu a khungta uhi.
ENGLISH: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin a belam hon laka belamnou a nu sagih a koih tuama.
ENGLISH: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

PAITE: Huchiin, Abimelekin, Abraham kiangah, Belamnou a nu sagih a tuama na koih bang achia ahia? achia.
ENGLISH: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves mean?”

PAITE: Huan, aman, Hiai tuileh kei leh ahi chih na hontheihpihna dingin hiai belamnou a nu sagih ka khut akipan na lak ding ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

PAITE: Huaijiakin huailai mun Beer-seba ahia; huailaia a nih ua kichiam jiak un.
ENGLISH: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, Beersheba can mean “well of the oath” or “well of seven.” because they both swore there.

PAITE: Huchiin, Beer-seba ah thu a khungta uh; huan, Abimelek a thoua, a sepaih pawl heutu Philok toh, Philistinte gamah a pai nawnta uh.
ENGLISH: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin, Beer-seba ah meilah sing a suana, huaiah Toupa khantawn Pathian min a loua.Huchiin, Abraham Philistinte gamah sawtpi a om.
ENGLISH: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and called there on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

PAITE: Huchiin, Abraham Philistinte gamah sawtpi a om.
ENGLISH: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, huai thilte nungin Pathianin Abraham a zeeta, a kiangah, Abraham, achia; huan, aman, Hiaiah ka om hi, achia.
ENGLISH: It happened after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, Na tapa, na tapa neih sun, na ittak, Isaak mah, pi inla, Moria gamah pai inla, huai ah kon hilh ding tang khat ah halmanga pumpiakna a dingin lanin, achia.
ENGLISH: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there for a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

PAITE: Huan, Abraham bel takin a thoua, sabengtung a bawla, a kiangah sikha tangval nih a pia, a tapa Isaak toh, huan, halmanga pumpiakna a dingin sing a eka, a thoua, Pathianin a hilhna mun lamah a paita hi.
ENGLISH: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

PAITE: Huan, ni thum niin Abraham a daka, a mun gamla piah a mu a.
ENGLISH: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

PAITE: Huchiin, Abrahamin a sikha Tangvalte kiangah, hiaiah sabengtung toh na om unla, kei leh naupang hua pamah ka vahoh ding ua; huan, Pathian ka vebe ding ua, na kiang uah ka hong kik nawn ding uh, achia.
ENGLISH: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go yonder. We will worship, and come back to you.”

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin halmanga pumpiakna sing a laa a tapa Isaak a posaka; aman mei leh temta a tawia; huchiin a nih un a pai khawmta uh.
ENGLISH: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

PAITE: Huan, Isaakin a pa Abraham a houpiha, Pa, achia; huan, aman, bawi, hiaiah ka om, achia. Huan, aman endih, mei leh sing lah a oma; hileleng halmanga pumpiakna ding belamnou lah koiah? achia.
ENGLISH: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin, bawi, Pathianin amah adinga halmanga pumpiakna ding belamnou a ngaihtuah tawm nakeh, achia: huchiin a nih un a pai khawm jel uh.
ENGLISH: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin a hilhna mun a vatungta uh; huan, Abrahamin huailaiah maitam a doha, sing achiang khawma, a tapa Isaak a gaka, maitama sing tungah a lumsaka
ENGLISH: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin a khut a lika, a tapa thahna dingin temta a laa.
ENGLISH: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

PAITE: Huan, Toupa angelin van akipanin amah a samta. Abraham, Abraham, achia: huan, aman, hiaiah ka om, achia.
ENGLISH: The angel of Yahweh called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, naupang tungah na khut kha ken, amah bangmah chih sam ken: na tapa, na neihsun mahmah leng na it louh jiakin Pathian na kihta chih tuin ka theita ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy, neither do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

PAITE: Huan, Abraham a daka, a ena, huan, ngaiin, a nunglamah belampa a ki a singbawka awk a na om a oma: huchiin, Abrahamin belampa a vamana, huai a tapa sikin halmanga pumpiakna dingin a lan zotaa.
ENGLISH: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

PAITE: Huchiin, Abrahamin huai lai mun min dingin Jehova-jire a saa: tuni tanin, Toupa tangah ngaihtuah hina ve, a chih jel bangun.
ENGLISH: Abraham called the name of that place Yahweh Will Provide or, Yahweh-Jireh, or, Yahweh-Seeing . As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

PAITE: Huan, Toupa angelin a nihveina dingin van akipanin Abraham a sam nawna.
ENGLISH: The angel of Yahweh called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

PAITE: Hiai thil na hih jiak leh na ta neih sun na it louh jiakin; kei mahmahin ka kichiam, Toupan a chi:
ENGLISH: and said, “I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

PAITE: Ka honvualjawl ngeingei dinga, vana aksi zah leh tuipi piaua piaunel zahin na suante ka pungsak ngeingei ding; na suanten a doute uh kulh kongkhak a neihsak ding uh;
ENGLISH: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your seed greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your seed will possess the gate of his enemies.

PAITE: Ka thu na man jiakin na suan ah khovel a chi chih a na vak ding uh, chiin,
ENGLISH: In your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because you have obeyed my voice.”

PAITE: Huchiin Abraham sikha Tangvalte kiangah akik nawna, huan, a thou ua, Beer-seba ah a om nilouh uhi.
ENGLISH: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, huai thilte nungin, mi’n Abraham kiangah, Ngaiin, Milkain leng na nau Nahor tate a neihsakta ve, chiin, a hilh ua;
ENGLISH: It happened after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

PAITE: A ta masa Uz ahi a; a nau Buz ahi a, Kemuel Aram pa toh;
ENGLISH: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

PAITE: Chesedte, Hazo, Pildaste, Jidlapte, Bethuelte leng ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

PAITE: Huan, Bethuelin tanu Rebeka a neia; huai giatte Milkain Abraham nau Nahor a neihsak ahi.A mei, a min Reumain leng Tebahte, Gahamte, Tahaste, Maakte leng a nei hi.
ENGLISH: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

PAITE: A mei, a min Reumain leng Tebahte, Gahamte, Tahaste, Maakte leng a nei hi.
ENGLISH: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

PAITE: Huan, Sara damsung kum ja leh kum sawm nih kum sagih ahi: huaite Sara damsung kum ahi.
ENGLISH: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

PAITE: Huan, Sara Kanan gama Kiriatharba khuaah a sia, (huai Hebron khua ahi): huan, Abraham Sara tunga om kitum ding leh kap dingin a honga.
ENGLISH: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (the same is Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

PAITE: Huan, misi luang maa kipan a thoua, Heth suante kiangah,
ENGLISH: Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

PAITE: Na lak uah mikhual leh pemta lel ka hi a; ka misi luang ka muh louh dinga ka vui theihna dingin na lak uah vuina mun gou dingin honpia un, chiin a gena.
ENGLISH: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

PAITE: Huan, Heth suanten Abraham a dawng ua, a kiangah,
ENGLISH: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

PAITE: Ka toupa, hon ngaikhiain, nang ka lak ua lal thupitak na hia: ka han uah na deihna penpenah na misi viin: na misi na vuina dingin ka lak uah kuamahin ka han uh honpiak ka it kei ding uh, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Abraham a thoua, huai gam mi, Heth suante, chibai a buka.
ENGLISH: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

PAITE: Huan, ka misi ka muh louh dinga ka vui pha na sak uleh, honngaikhia unla, Zohar tapa Ephron kiangah honnget sak un,
ENGLISH: He talked with them, saying, “If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

PAITE: A lou tawa om, a neih, Makpel kokhuk honpe dingin, na lak ua vuina mun ding gou dingin aman hun na sak zahzah uh la henla honpe leh, chiin, a houpiha.
ENGLISH: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him give it to me among you for a possession of a burying-place.”

PAITE: Huan Ephron Heth suante lakah a tu nilouha: huchiin, Hit mi Ephronin Heth suante theihin, a kho kulh konga lut peuhmah nangawn theih in,
ENGLISH: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

PAITE: Hilou e, ka toupa, hon ngaikhiain: lou ka honpia, a sunga kokhuk om leng ka honpia; ka chipihte tate mitmuhin ka honpia hi: na misi vuiin, chiin, Abraham a dawnga.
ENGLISH: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

PAITE: Huan, Abraham huai gama mite maah a kuna, chibai a buka.
ENGLISH: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

PAITE: Huan, huai gama mite theihin Ephron kiangah, Pha na sak phot leh hehpihin hon ngaikhiain; lou man pen jaw kon pe ding; keia kipanin la inla, tualai kia ah ka misi ka vui ding hi, chiin, a gena.
ENGLISH: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

PAITE: Huan, Ephronin Abraham a dawnga, a kiangah,
ENGLISH: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

PAITE: Ka toupa, hong ngaikhiain: leimun, dangka sekel za li hu lel jaw, nang leh kei adingin gen tham ahi ahia? na misi vui maiin, achia.
ENGLISH: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Abrahamin Ephron thu a juita a; huan, Abrahamin, Heth suante theihin Ephronin dangka a gen zah, dangka sekel za li, sumsinte zat jel, a buk a, Ephron kiangah a peta hi.
ENGLISH: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

PAITE: Huchiin, Ephron lou, Mamre toh kijawn Makpel gam a om, a lou toh, a sunga kokhuk om toh, lou a sing om tengteng toh, a lou gi kim tengtenga sing omte toh.
ENGLISH: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

PAITE: Heth suante mitmuhin, a kho kulhkonga lut peuhmahte mitmuhin, gou dingin Abraham kiangah piak kipin a omta hi.
ENGLISH: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

PAITE: Huai nungin Abrahamin a ji Sara Kanan gam a Mamre toh kijawn (huai Hebron khua ahia) Makpel lou a kokhuk ah a vuita hi.Huchiin, lou leh a sunga kokhuk om vuina mun gou dingin, Abraham kiangah Heth suanten a pe kipta uh.
ENGLISH: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

PAITE: Huchiin, lou leh a sunga kokhuk om vuina mun gou dingin, Abraham kiangah Heth suanten a pe kipta uh.
ENGLISH: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham for a possession of a burying place by the children of Heth.

PAITE: Huan, Abraham a hong upataa, a hong tek mahmah taa: huan, Toupan Abraham thil bangkimah a vualjawl hi.
ENGLISH: Abraham was old, and well stricken in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin, a sikha, a inkuanpihte laka upapen, a neih tengteng tunga thuneipa kiangah, Hehpihtakin na khut ka pheipi nuiah golhin:
ENGLISH: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

PAITE: Huchiin, Toupa, van Pathian leh lei Pathian louin, ka omna Kanan mite nungak laka mi ka tapa ji dinga neihsak lou dingin, ka hon kichiamsak ding ahi:
ENGLISH: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

PAITE: Ka gam lama, ka tanaute kianga hoha, ka tapa Isaak ji na neihsak zo ding ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

PAITE: Huan, sikhain, a kiangah, Numeiin hiai gam lamah honjui nuam khol kei dia: na tapa na hong pawtna gam lamah ka pi kik nawn ding ahi diam? A chia.
ENGLISH: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin, a kiangah, ka tapa huailaia pi kik nawnlou dingin pilvangin.
ENGLISH: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

PAITE: Toupa van Pathian, ka pa in akipan leh ka pianna gam a kipan hon pikhepa leh hon houpihpa leh, hiai gam na suante kiangah ka pe ding, chia, ka kianga kichiampan, amah ngeiin a angel na maah a paisak dinga, huai akipanin ka tapa ji na hon neisak ding hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your seed or, offspring .’ He will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

PAITE: Huan, numeiin a hon zuih nop kei leh, ka kianga na kichiamna thu ah na siang mai ding; a bang a bang hitaleh, ka tapa huailaiah na pi kik nawn ding ahi kei, achia.
ENGLISH: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this my oath. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

PAITE: Huchiin, sikhain a khut a pu Abraham pheipi nuaiah a golha, huai thu ah a kiangah a kichiamta hi.
ENGLISH: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

PAITE: Huan, sikhain a pu sangawngsau laka sangawngsau sawm a kaia, a pu thil hoih chiteng tawiin, a pawttaa: huchiin a thoua, Mesopotamia gam a, Nahorte khua aha hoha.
ENGLISH: The servant took ten camels, of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

PAITE: Huan, nitaklama, numeite tuitawi dinga a kuan hun lai tak un, dainawla tuileh kiangah a sangawngsaute akhukdinsak a.
ENGLISH: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

PAITE: Huan, Aw Toupa, ka pu Abraham Pathian, hehpihtakin tuniin hon lohchingsak in, ka pu Abraham tungah hehpihna langsakin.
ENGLISH: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

PAITE: Enin, tuikhuk kiangah ka dinga, khua a mite tanute leng tuitawi dingin a hongkuan uh:
ENGLISH: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

PAITE: Huchiin, hichi hihen, nungak kuapeuh kianga, hehpihtakin ka dawn dingin na tui bel niamsak dih ve, ka chiha, huan, aman, Dawnin, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding, chi peuhmah, huai mi ngei na sikha Isaak a dinga na mi seh hihen; huan huaiah ka pu tungah hehpihna na langsak chih ka thei ding hi, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ and she will say, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, a gen khit main, ngaiin, Abraham nau Nahor ji Milka tapa Bethuel tanu Rebeka tui bel a liangjang a puain a hongkuana.
ENGLISH: It happened, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

PAITE: Huai nungak a mel a hoih mahmaha, nungak siangthou ahi a, pasal himhimin a kithuahpih ngei hetkei uh. Huan, tuikhuk ah a pai suka, a tuibel a dimsaka, a pai tou nawna.
ENGLISH: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin, neither had any man known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

PAITE: Huan, sikha amah tuak dingin a taia, Hehpihtakin na tuibel a tui tawm chik hondan sak ve, achia.
ENGLISH: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, dawn ve, ka toupa, achia; huan, kintakin a tuibel a khut in a dom khe suka, a dawnsak hi.
ENGLISH: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him drink.

PAITE: Huan, a dawn nungin, na sangawngsaute dingin leng a dawn kham masiah uh ka tawi jel ding, achia.
ENGLISH: When she had done giving him drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have done drinking.”

PAITE: Huan, kintakin a tuibel a gan kuangah a teia, tui tawi dingin tuileh lamah a tai nawna, a sangawngsau tengteng a dingin leng a tawitawi hi.
ENGLISH: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

PAITE: Huan, sikhain a lohchingsak leh saklouh theihna dingin a dai didea.
ENGLISH: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, sangawngsauten a dawn kham takun sikhain dangkaeng bilbah makhai buk leh, a khut a dinga tau nih dangkaeng dangka sawm buk a suaha;
ENGLISH: It happened, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

PAITE: Huan, a kiangah, kua tanu na hia? Hehpihtakin hin hilh in. Na pa in ah ka giahna ding uh mun om ding hia? achia.
ENGLISH: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to lodge in?”

PAITE: Huan, aman, a kiangah, Bethuel, Milka tapa, Nahor adinga neihsaknu tanu ka hi, achia.
ENGLISH: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

PAITE: Huan, amah mahin, a kiangah, buhpawl leh gan an ka hau tuaktuak ua, giahna mun leng ka nei uh, achia.
ENGLISH: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.”

PAITE: Huchiin, sikhain a lu a kunsaka, Toupa chibai a buk hi.
ENGLISH: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, ka pu tunga a hehpihna leh a takna tawp tuanlou, toupa, ka pu Abraham Pathian, phatin om hen: kei leng, Toupan ka pu unaute in lamah hon na pi eive, achia.
ENGLISH: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me in the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

PAITE: Huan, nungak a taia, huai thute a nu inkuanpihte a vahilh hi.
ENGLISH: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

PAITE: Rebekain sanggam pasal a neia, a min Laban ahia: huchiin, Laban a pawta, tuikhuk lamah, mi kiangah a vatai taa.
ENGLISH: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

PAITE: Hichi ahia, bilbah leh a sanggamnu khut a taute a mua, min huchi khachiin honchi, chia, a sanggamnu Rebeka thu gente a jak takin, huai mi kiangah a hohta a; huan, ngaiin, amah tuikhuka sangawngsaute kiangah a na ding gige a.
ENGLISH: It happened, when he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” that he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

PAITE: Huan, Labanin, nang Toupa vualjawl pa, hong inla, ka in ah lutin; bangdia inpua a ding nilouh? in leh sangawngsaute adingin mun ka bawl khinta, achia.
ENGLISH: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

PAITE: Huan, huai in ah a luta, huan Labanin sangawngsau van a phela; huan, sangawngsaute adingin buhpawl leh gan an apia a, akhe leh a lawmte khe silna dingin tui a pia hi.
ENGLISH: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

PAITE: Huan, Abraham sikha maah nek ding a lui ua; himahleh, aman, ka hong na san thu kagen mateng ka ne kei ding, achia. Huan, aman, gen ve, achia.
ENGLISH: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” He said, “Speak on.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, Abraham sikha ka hi.
ENGLISH: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan ka pu nakpiin a vualjawla, mi liantak a honghi a: Toupan a kiangah belam honte, bawng honte, dangkate, dangkaengte, sikhapate, sikhanute, sangawngsaute, sabengtung te leng a pia.
ENGLISH: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

PAITE: Ku pu ji Sarain tek ningin ka pu adingin tapa a neia: amah kiangah a neih tengteng a pe vek hi.
ENGLISH: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

PAITE: Huan, ka puin, ka omna gama Kanante nungak laka ka tapa ji dinga na neihsak ding ahi kei:
ENGLISH: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

PAITE: Ka pa in lamah, ka tanaute kiangah hohin, ka tapa dingin ji na neihsak zo ding ahi, chiin, hon kichiamsaka.
ENGLISH: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

PAITE: Huan, ken ka pu kiangah, Numeiin honjui nuam kei kha ding, ka chia.
ENGLISH: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

PAITE: Huan, aman, ka kiangah, Toupa a maa ka om jelnain a angel na kiangah honsawl dinga; na hohna dingah hon lohchingsak ding; huchiin, ka tapa dingin ka tanaute leh ka pa inkuanpihte laka ji dingin na neihsak ding hi:
ENGLISH: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son of my relatives, and of my father’s house.

PAITE: Ka tanaute kiang ngeia na tun chiangin ka kianga na kichiamna apat na siang ding; nungak a honpiak kei uleh ka kianga na kichiamna akipan na siang ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Then will you be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

PAITE: Huchiin, tuniin tuikhuk ka hongtunga, Aw, Toupa, ka pu Abraham Pathian, ka paina ah na hon lohchinsak ding leh, enin, tuikhuk kiangah ka ding hi:
ENGLISH: I came this day to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

PAITE: Huan, hichi hi hen, nungak tui tawi dinga hongkuan, kuapeuh kianga, hehpihtakin dawn dingin na tuibel a tui tawm chik honpe ve, ka chih a;
ENGLISH: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

PAITE: Huan, aman, ka kianga, dawnin, sa sangawngsaute ading leng ka tawi ding, chi peuhmah, huai mi ngeingei ka pu tapa adinga Toupa numei seh hihen, ka chia.
ENGLISH: and she will tell me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

PAITE: Huan, ka lungsim a ka gen khit main, ngaiin, Rebeka a tuibel puain a hongkuana; huan, tuikhuk ah a paisuka, tui a tawia; huan, a kiangah, hehpihtakin tui hondawnsak ve, ka chia.
ENGLISH: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

PAITE: Huan, aman kintakin a liangjang akipan tuibel a dom khiaa, dawnin, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding, achia: huchiin ka dawna, sangawngsaute leng a dawnsaka.
ENGLISH: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

PAITE: Huan, ken, kua tanu na hia? chiin, ka donga. Huan, aman, Bethuel, Nohar tapa, Milkhain a neihsakpa tanu, achia: huan bilbah abil ah ka batsaka, taute leng a khut ah ka bunsak.
ENGLISH: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

PAITE: Huan, ka lu ka kunsaka, Toupa chibai ka buka, Toupa, ka pu Abraham Pathian, ka pu unaupa tanu a tapa adinga ji dia neisak dinga lampi diktaka honpipa, ka phat hi.
ENGLISH: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

PAITE: Huchiin, tuin ka pu na hehpih ua, a tunga chihtak peta na hih ding uleh honhilh un; na hih kei ding uleh leng honhilh un; huchiin taklam hiam, veilam hiam, ka nga thei ding hi, achia.
ENGLISH: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

PAITE: Huan, Laban leh Bethuel in a dawng ua, hiai thil Toupa kianga kipana pawt ahi: a sia a pha leng na kiangah ka gen theikei uh.
ENGLISH: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

PAITE: Enin, Rebeka na maah a om hi, pi inla, pain, Toupan a gensa bangin na pu tapa ji dingin om hen, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, Abraham sikhain a thu uh a jak takin lei siin Toupa chibai a buk hi.
ENGLISH: It happened that when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Abraham sikhain dangka suang kizepnate leh, dangkaeng kizepnate leh, silh leh ten a lakhia a, Rebeka kiangah a pia a: a sanggampa kiangah leh a nu kiangah leng thil manpha pipi a pia hi.
ENGLISH: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

PAITE: Huan, amah leh a lawmten a ne ua a dawn ua, a giakta ua; huan, jingsangin a thou ua ka pu kiangah honpaisakta un, achia.
ENGLISH: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

PAITE: Huan, a sanggampa leh a nuin, naunu ni sawtlou chik ni sawm lel bek, ka kiang uah om tadih hen; huai khit chiangin a kuan nading, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, a kiang uah, hon zekai sak kei dih ua, Toupan leh ka hohna ah hon lohching sakta ngala; ka pu kianga ka pai theihna dingin, honsawl zomai ve ua, achia.
ENGLISH: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

PAITE: Huan, amau, naunu ka sam ding ua, amah kam mahmah kihoupih leh, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Rebeka a sam ua a kiangah, hiai mipa kiangah na pai nuam maw a chi ua, huan, aman, pai nuam ve ning e, achia.
ENGLISH: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

PAITE: Huchiin, a sanggamnu uh Rebeka leh, a donnu leh, Abraham sikha leh a lawite a paita uhi.
ENGLISH: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

PAITE: Huan, Rebeka a vualjawl ua, a kiangah, ka sanggamnu uh aw, nang sing ngenta sang tampi nu honghi inla, na suanten amau hote kulh kongkhak neihsak uhen, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your seed possess the gate of those who hate them.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Rebeka a thoua, a sikhanute toh, sangawngsaute tungah a tuang ua, mi a juita uh; huchiin Abraham sikhain Rebeka a pi a, apaita.
ENGLISH: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

PAITE: Huan, Isaak Beer-lahai-roi lam akipan a honga, Sim gama om ahi ngala,
ENGLISH: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

PAITE: Huan, Isaak nitaklam pawnah kingaihtuah dingin a pawtkhia a: huan a daka, a ena, huan ngaiin, sangawngsau hongpaite a mu hi.
ENGLISH: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.

PAITE: Huan, Rebeka a daka, Isaak a muhtakin sangawngsau tunga kipan a kuma.
ENGLISH: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she dismounted from the camel.

PAITE: Huan, Abraham sikha kiangah, pawna hondawn dinga hongpai kua ahia? Achia. Huan, sikhain, ka pu eive, achia: huchiin a kikhuhna puan a laa, a kikhuhta hi.
ENGLISH: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

PAITE: Huan, sikhain a thilhih tengteng Isaak a hilha.Huan, Isaakin Rebeka a nu Sara puan in ah a pi luta, huan, Rebeka a la a, a ji a honghita a; huan amah a it mahmah a: huchiin Isaak a nu sih nungin leng a hong lungmuang theita hi.
ENGLISH: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

PAITE: Huan, Isaakin Rebeka a nu Sara puan in ah a pi luta, huan, Rebeka a la a, a ji a honghita a; huan amah a it mahmah a: huchiin Isaak a nu sih nungin leng a hong lungmuang theita hi.
ENGLISH: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin ji dang a neia, amin Ketura ahi.
ENGLISH: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

PAITE: Huan, aman Joksante, Jedante, Midiante, Isbakte, Suahte a neihsaka.

ENGLISH: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

ENGLISH: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin aneih tengteng Isaak kiangah a pia.
ENGLISH: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

ENGLISH: but to the sons of Abraham’s concubines, Abraham gave gifts. He sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.

ENGLISH: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

ENGLISH: Abraham gave up the spirit, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

PAITE: Huan, a tapa Isaak leh Ismaelin Hit mi Zohar tapa Ephron loua, Mamre phak maa Makpel kokhuk ah a vuita ua;
ENGLISH: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,

ENGLISH: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, Abraham sih nungin, Pathianin a tapa Isaak a vualzawla; huan, Isaak Beer-lahai-roi kiangah a om hi.
ENGLISH: It happened after the death of Abraham that God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

ENGLISH: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

ENGLISH: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

ENGLISH: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

ENGLISH: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

ENGLISH: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

PAITE: Huan, a ji a chin jiakin Isaakin Toupa a ji adingin nget petmahin a ngetsak a: huan, Toupan a ngetna a ngaihkhiak saka, huchiin a ji Rebeka a gai.
ENGLISH: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

PAITE: Huan, a nau paite a sungah a kisual ua; huan, aman, hichi bang ahih ngal leh, bangjiakin ahia ka hin leh? Achia. Huchiin Toupa dong dingin a kuantaa.
ENGLISH: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it be so, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan, a kiangah, Na sul ah chi nih a om uh, na gil sunga kipanin nam nih a kikhen ding uh: nam khat nam khat sangin ahatzaw dinga; huan, a upa jawin a naupangjaw na a sem ding achia.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

PAITE: Huan, a nau neih a hunin, ngaiin, a sul ah phik a hong omta ua.
ENGLISH: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

PAITE: Huan a masajaw a sana san seksawk, puan mulbanga mul thiapthuapin a hongpawta, huchiin amin dingin Esau a sa uh.
ENGLISH: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

PAITE: Huai nungin a nau a pawt nawna, a khut in Esau khetul a len gige a; huchiin amah min dingin Jakob a sa uh: huan, Rebekain amaute a neih laiin Isaak kum sawm guka upa ahi.
ENGLISH: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

PAITE: Huan, naupangte a hongkhangliana ua: huan, Esau sabet siam, gammi ahi a; Jakob bel mi mawl, puanin a teng mi ahi.
ENGLISH: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

PAITE: Huan, Isaakin, a sakhi sa a nek jel jiakin, Esau a ita; Rebekain bel Jakob a it jaw hi.
ENGLISH: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

PAITE: Huan, Jakobin be a huana; huan, Esau gam kuan a hongtunga, a tawl mahmaha:
ENGLISH: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

PAITE: Huan Esauin Jakob kiangah, hehpihtakin na be huan hon nesak in; ka bah mahmah mai, achia. Huaijiakin ahi, a min dia Edom a chih uh.
ENGLISH: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

PAITE: Huan, Jakobin, na ta masa hihna honleisak phot lechin, achia.
ENGLISH: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

PAITE: Huan, Esauin, Ngaiin, si dekdek ka hi ngala: ta masa hihna kia kei dingin bang a phatuam dia? A chia.
ENGLISH: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

PAITE: Huan, Jakobin, Tuniin ka kiangah kichiam photin, achia; huan, a kiangah a kichiama: huchiin ata masa hihna Jakob kiangah a khawng maimah ta.Huan, Jakobin Esau tanghou leh a be huan a piaa; huchiin a ne a, a dawna, a thoua, a paita; Huchibangin Esauin a ta masa hihna a ngaineu hi.
ENGLISH: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

PAITE: Huan, Jakobin Esau tanghou leh a be huan a piaa; huchiin a ne a, a dawna, a thoua, a paita; Huchibangin Esauin a ta masa hihna a ngaineu hi.

PAITE: Huan, huai gamah, Abraham damlaia kial ke masapen chih louh, kial a hong ke nawna. Huchiin, Isaak bel Philistinte kumpipa Abimelek kiangah Gerar khua ah a vahoh suka.

ENGLISH: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

PAITE: Huan, Bilha a gai a Jakob ta a neihsak ta.
ENGLISH: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

ENGLISH: Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

ENGLISH: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her handmaid, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

PAITE: Huchiin, Lea sikha nu Zilpa in Jakob tapa a neihsak a.
ENGLISH: Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid, bore Jacob a son.

PAITE: Huan, Lea in vangphat huai mah ei achia: huchiin amin dingin Gad a sa a.
ENGLISH: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

PAITE: Huan, Lea sikha nu Zilpa in Jakob tapa dang a neihsak nawn a.
ENGLISH: Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid, bore Jacob a second son.

ENGLISH: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, ka kiangah, ka pasal non suh thil duai ahi hia? ka tapa jawl ai leng hon suh na tum nawn lai maw? Achia. Huan, Rakil in, ahihkeileh, n tapa jawl ai sikin tu jan in a hon lupih ding achia.
ENGLISH: She said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”

PAITE: Huan, nitaklam in Jakob gamlak a kipan hong tunga, huan Lea a dawn dingin a kuan a, non kithuahpih ding ahi; ka tapa jawl ai in kon khel ta ngal a achia. Huchiin, huai jan in a lupih ta hi.
ENGLISH: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.

PAITE: Huan, Pathian in Lea thumna a ngaikhia a, huchiin a gaia, Jakob tapa ngana a neihsak nawna.
ENGLISH: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

ENGLISH: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my handmaid to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

PAITE: Huan, Lea a gai nawna, Jakob tapa gukna a neihsak nawna.
ENGLISH: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

PAITE: Huan, Lea in, Pathianin van hoih tak a hon neisak a; tuin jaw ka pasal, tapa guk ka neihsak tak jiakin, ka kiangah a teng ta ding, achia: huchiin, amin dingin Zebulun a sa a.
ENGLISH: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

PAITE: Huchiin a gaia, tapa a neia: Pathianin ka minsia a la mang, achia:
ENGLISH: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

PAITE: Huan, Toupan tapa dang honpiak beh hen, chiin, a min dingin Joseph a sa hi.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, Rakil in Joseph a neih nungin Jakob in, Laban kiangah, kei ka omna ngei ah, ka gam lam ua ka pai na dingin hon paisak ta in aw.
ENGLISH: It happened, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

PAITE: Huan, amah mahin, na loh ding sep inla, honhilh dih, huchiin ka honpe ding hi, achia.
ENGLISH: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, a kiangah, bangchin na na ka sema, bangchin na gan ka kiangah a om ua na thei akei hiam.

PAITE: Ka hong main tawm chik kia na neia, tuin jaw tampi a hong phata uhi; ka kalsuanna lam peuh ah Toupan nang a honvualjawl jel hi: Ahihhangin chik chiangin ahia kei inkuante adia ka sep khiak sam ding? Achia.
ENGLISH: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

PAITE: Huan, aman, bang ka hon pe dia? Achia. Huan, Jakobin, bangmah na honpiak ding ahi kei: Hiai thil na hon hihsak leh na gan hon ka khah dia ka ching nawn ding.
ENGLISH: He said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

PAITE: Tuniin na gan hon ka va enkhe vek dia, belam laka a vom gial petmah a gial leh a voma gial zekzek leh a vom peuhmah, kel laka a kanga gial petmah a gial leh a kanga gial zekzek te huaia kipan ka pi tuam jel dinga: huan, tuban huchibanga hong piang peuhmah ka loh ding ahi takei dia leh.
ENGLISH: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

PAITE: Huchiin, tuban, na mit muha khelha ka omna thuah na hongpai hun chiangin, ka diktatna in a hondawnsak mai ding: kel laka a kanga gial petmah a gial lou leh, a kanga gial zekzek lou leh, belam laka a vom lou ka kianga na muh peuhpeuh ka guk in na sep mai ding ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be counted stolen.”

PAITE: Huan, Labanin, ngaiin, na gen bang tak hile ake, achia.
ENGLISH: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

PAITE: Huchiin, huai nitak in kel tal a kanga gial tan leh a kanga gial zekzek teng leh, kelnu a kanga gial petmah a gial leh a kanga gial zekzek teng a kanna om peuhmah, belam, belam laka a vom tengteng toh a pi tuama, a tapate khut ah a pia a;

ENGLISH: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

ENGLISH: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

PAITE: Huan, Jakob in belamnou te khawng a koih tuma, huan, ganhonte Laban gan hon laka a gial tan leh a vom tengteng lam a ngasak jela; amah gan honte a koih tuam jela, Laban gan lakah a koih kei.
ENGLISH: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in the flock of Laban: and he put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi a, gan hat deuhte a hong gai pat peuh chiang un chiang laka a gai pat theihna ding un, Jakob in tui luanna ah, gan mitmuhin, chiangte a koih jela;
ENGLISH: It happened, whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;

PAITE: Ahihhangin gan a hat kei leh, a koih kei jel: huchiin a nou hat lou deuhte jaw Laban a ahi jela, a hat deuhta bel Jakob a ahi jel hi.Huchiin, Jakob nakpiin a hongpung a, ganhon hon thupi tak, sikhanute, sikhapate, sangawngsaute, sabengtungte a neita hi.
ENGLISH: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

PAITE: Huchiin, Jakob nakpiin a hongpung a, ganhon hon thupi tak, sikhanute, sikhapate, sangawngsaute, sabengtungte a neita hi.

ENGLISH: He heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. From that which was our father’s, has he gotten all this wealth.”

ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

ENGLISH: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

ENGLISH: It happened during mating season that I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

PAITE: Huan, Jakob Suria mi Laban theihlouh kalin a guk pai mang hi: a paimang ding thu a hilh kei hi.
ENGLISH: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

PAITE: Ka pa Pathian, Abraham Pathian, Isaak kihtak, ka kianga om lou hi ngial lehouh, tuin vuaktang lela honpaisak ngeingei ding na hi. Pathianin ka haksat thuakdan leh ka sepgim dan a mua, Tujana honvau ahi, achia.
