PAITE: Huan, Pathianin jana a mangin Israel a houpih a, Jakob, Jakob, achia.
ENGLISH: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, hiaiah ka om, achia. Huan, aman, kei Pathian, na Pathian, ka hi: Aigupta gama hoh suk lau ken; huailaiah chi thupi takin ka honbawl ding hi:
ENGLISH: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

PAITE: Aigupta gamah na kiangah ka hong dinga; huan, ka honpi tou nawn ngeingei ding: huan, Joseph in na sih hun chiangin na mit a honbawl sak ding hi, achia.
ENGLISH: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph will close your eyes.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Jakob Beer-seba akipanin a pawta: Israel taten a pa uh Jakob leh a ta neu chikchik te uhleh a jite uh tuanna dinga Pharo in kangtalai a khak te ah a tuang sak uhi.
ENGLISH: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

PAITE: Huchiin, Jakob leh a suante tengteng in kanan gama a lamkhiak uh, a gante u leh a vante uh, a tawi ua, Aigupta gama tungta uh:
ENGLISH: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his seed with him,

PAITE: A tapa te, a tupa te, a tanu te, a tunu te, a suante tengteng, Aigupta gamah a lut pihta hi.
ENGLISH: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his seed with him into Egypt.

PAITE: Huan, hiaite Israel suan Aigupta gama lut, Jakob leh a tapate min ahi: Reuben Jakob ta masa.
ENGLISH: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

PAITE: Huan, Reuben tapate Hanok te, Pallu te, Hezron te, Karmi te ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

PAITE: Huan, Simeon tapate Jemuel te, Jamin te, Ohad te, Jakin te, Johat te, Kanan numei laka a tapa Saula te ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

PAITE: Huan, Levi tapa te Gerson te, Kohat te, Merari te, ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

PAITE: Huan, Juda tapate Er te, Onan te, Sela te, Perez te, Zerah te ahi ua: Er leh Onan bel Kanan gamah a sita ua. Perez tapate Hezrun leh Hamul ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

PAITE: Huan, Issakar tapate Tola te, Puva te, Ioba te, Simron te ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

PAITE: Huan, Zebulun tapate Sered te, Elon te, Jhaleel te ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

PAITE: Huaite tengteng Lea tapa, a tanu Dina toh, Padanaram gama Jakob a neihsakte ahi uhi: a tapate leh a tanute tengteng sawm thum leh thum ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

PAITE: Huan, Gad tapate Ziphion te, Haggi te, Suni te, Ezbon te, Eri te, Arobdi te, Areli te ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

PAITE: Huan, Aser tapate Imna te, Isva te, Isvi te, Beria te ahi uh, a sanggamnu uh Sera toh: huan, Beria tapate Beber leh Malkiel ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

PAITE: Huaite Zilpai Laban in a tanu Lea kianga a piakpa tapa te ahi ua, huaite Jakob a neihsaka, mi sawm leh gukte.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

PAITE: Huan, Jakob ji Rakil tapate Joseph leh Benjamin ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in Aigupta gamah tapa Manassi leh Ephraim a neia, huai mite On kho siampu Potipher tanu Asenathin amah a neihsak ahi.
ENGLISH: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

PAITE: Huan, Benjamin in tapate Bel te, Bekor te, Asbel te, Ger te, Naaman te, Ehi te, Ros te, Muppim te, Huppin te, Ardi te ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

PAITE: Huaite Rakil tapa Jakob a neihsakte ahi uh: a vek un sawm leh li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

PAITE: Huan, Dan tapa Husim ahi.
ENGLISH: The son of Dan: Hushim.

PAITE: Huan, Naphtali tapate Jahzeel te, guni te, Jezer te, Sillem te ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

PAITE: Huaite Bilhai Laban in a tanu Rakil kianga a piakpa tapate ahi uh, huaite Jakob a neihsaka: a vek un sagih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

PAITE: Jakob tapate jite simlouh in Jakob kianga Aigupta gama lut a khala pawt tengteng a vek un sawm guk leh guk ahi uhi;
ENGLISH: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct descendants, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in Aigupta gama tapa a neihte nih ahi ua: Jakob inkuanpihte tengteng, Aigupta gam a lutte, sawm sagih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

PAITE: Huan, Jakob in, Gosen gam lam lampi na nakawk muh dingin, Juda bel Joseph kiangah a hoh masa saka;
ENGLISH: He sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

PAITE: Huchiin, Gosen gamah lutta uh. Huan, Joseph in a kangtalai a bawlkhola, Gosen gamah a pa dawn dingin a hih tou hi; huan, a kiangah a kigena, a ngawnga kunin a kap nilouh hi.
ENGLISH: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

PAITE: Huan, Israel in, Joseph kiangah, dam dama na oma, na mel ka muh nawn jiak in tun jaw ut leh sita leng le, achia.
ENGLISH: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in, a unaute leh apa inkuanpihte kiangah kava hoh tou dia, Pharo ka hilh dinga, a kiangah, ka unaute leh ka pa inkuanpihte, huai Kanan gama omte, ka kiangah a hongtung ta uh;
ENGLISH: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

PAITE: Amaute ganvulmi ahihjiakun belam chingmite ahi uh; a belam honte u leh a bawng honte uh leh a neih tengteng uh ahonpo vek hi, chiin, kava gen ding.
ENGLISH: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi dinga, Pharo in nou a honsapa, bang nasem na hi ua? a honchih hun chiangin,Nou, na sikha te, honsuangte akipan, naupang chik ka hihlai ua kipan in tu tanin gan vulmi ka hi uh, na chi ding uh: huchiin, Gosen gamah na om thei ding uhi, achia. Belam chingmite himhim lah Aigupta mite kih lamtak ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

PAITE: Nou, na sikha te, honsuangte akipan, naupang chik ka hihlai ua kipan in tu tanin gan vulmi ka hi uh, na chi ding uh: huchiin, Gosen gamah na om thei ding uhi, achia. Belam chingmite himhim lah Aigupta mite kih lamtak ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Joseph in Pharo a vahilh a, a kiangah, kapa te, ka unaute, a belam honte uh, a bawng honte uh, a neih tengteng u toh Kanan gam akipan a hongtung sukta ua: huan, ngaiin, Gosen gamah a om uh, achia.
ENGLISH: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”

PAITE: Huan, a unaute laka kipan mi nga a pia, Pharo a theisak a.
ENGLISH: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

PAITE: Huan, Pharo in, a unaute kiangah, bang na sem na hi ua? Achia. Huan, amau. Pharo kiangah, na sikhate, kou honsuangte akipan, belam chingmite ka hi uh, ach ua.
ENGLISH: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”

PAITE: Huan, amau mahin, Pharo kiangah, hiai gam a om tadih dinga hong ka hi uh; ka gam uah lah na sikhate belam honte a dingin nek ding a om nonta keia; kial lah Kanan gamah a nak kiak mahmah ngala; huchiin hehpihtakin na sikhate Gosen gamah hon omsakin, achi ua.
ENGLISH: They said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”

PAITE: Huan, Pharo in, Joseph a houpiha, na pa leh na unaute na kiangah a hongta ua:
ENGLISH: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.

PAITE: Aigupta gam a kiching mahmah hi; na pa leh na unaute gam hoihna tata ah tengsak ve: huan, a lak ua mi thilhihthei tak theihna nei ngial om lehouh ka gan tunga heutu dingin bawl in, achia.
ENGLISH: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in apa Jakob a pi luta, Pharo maah a dingsak a: huchiin Jakob in Pharo a vualjawl a.
ENGLISH: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

PAITE: Huan, Pharo in Jakob kiangah, kum bangzah na hita a? Achia.
ENGLISH: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How many are the days of the years of your life?”

PAITE: Huan, Jakob in, Pharo kiangah, ka khualzin nung jaw kum ja leh kum sawm thum ahia: ka damsung kumte khawng a tomin, a haksa ahi, a honsuangte a khualzin lai ua a damsung kum u leng pha zou kei ing achia.
ENGLISH: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The days of the years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”

PAITE: Huan, Jakobin Pharo a vualjawl nawna, Pharo kianga kipanin a pawtta hi.
ENGLISH: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

PAITE: Huchiin, Joseph in apa leh a unaute tenna a bawlsaka, Pharo thupiak bangin Aigupta gama, gam hoihpen takah, Ramases gam a gou dingin a peta hi.
ENGLISH: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

PAITE: Huan. Joseph in apa leh a unaute leh apa inkuanpihte tengteng a inkuan u bangjelin nek ding a pia a, a vakta hi.
ENGLISH: Joseph nourished his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

PAITE: Huan, huai gam tengteng ah nek ding himhim a om takei a; kial lah a nak kiak mahmah ngala, huchiin kial jiakin Aigupta gam leh Kanan gam a bahta hi.
ENGLISH: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in, a buh leina man un, Aigupta gam leh Kanan gam a dangka om tengteng a khawmsak veka; huan, Joseph in huai dangka Pharo in ah a tawi a.
ENGLISH: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

PAITE: Huan, Aigupta gam leh Kanan gama dangka tengteng a zat bei khit un, Aigupta mi tengteng Joseph kiangah a hong ua, nek ding honpia in aw; na ma a si maimah ding ka hi ding uam? Dangka lah om nawnta ngal kei a, achi ua.
ENGLISH: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in, na gante uh honpe mei un; dangka a om nawn kei leh na gan man un nek ding ka honpe ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”

PAITE: Huchiin, a gante uh Joseph kiangah a honpi ua: huan, Joseph in huai sakol man ding leh, belam hon man ding leh, bawng hon man ding leh sabengtung man dingin dek ding a pe jela: huai kumin a gan tengteng uh man in nek ding a pia a, a vak chiat hi.
ENGLISH: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.

PAITE: Huan, huai kum a bei a, kum a hong thak nawn in a kiangah a hong nawn ua, a kiangah, ka dangka tengteng uh ka zat beitak dan u leh, pu aw, ka ganhon te uh nanga a hihtak dan bang, pu aw, nang lakah ka im kei ding uh; pu aw, na mit muhin ka pumpi u leh ka gamte uh kialou bangmah a omta mahmah kei hi:
ENGLISH: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.

PAITE: Na ma ah kou leh ka gam uh mangthang maimah ding hi ve ung maw? Koumau mah ka gam u toh nek dingin honlei maiin, huchiin, koumau leh ka gam uh Pharo sikhate hi mai nung: huan, silou a mi hinga dama ka om theihna ding un, gam a siatlouh na ding, buh chi honpia in, achi ua.
ENGLISH: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Joseph in Pharo a dingin Aigupta gam tengteng a leisak ta a; kial a tung ua a nak tun mahmah jiakin Aigupta miten lah a lou uh a juak chiat ngal ua; huchiin gam Pharo a ahi vekta.
ENGLISH: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.

PAITE: Mite Aigupta gamgi tawp khatlam a kipanin khatlam tawp phain, khuate ah a kisuansakta a.
ENGLISH: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.

PAITE: Siampu te gam kia a lei keia: siamputen Pharo akipan tantuan a nei ua, Pharo in a piak atantuan uh a ne jel ua; huaijiak in a gam uh a juak kei uhi.
ENGLISH: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.

PAITE: Huai nungin, Joseph in, mite kiangah, ngai un, tunin na gam utoh noute Pharo a dingin ka honleita a: hiai, hiaiah nou a dingin buh chi a om, lei ah na ching ding ua.
ENGLISH: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

PAITE: Huan, buh lak hun chiangin hichi ahi ding. Pharo a dingin sehnga suah seh khat jel na pe ding ua, a sehli noumau a ahi ding, huaibel lou a chin nawn dingin, noumau leh na inkuanpihte uh nek dingin, na tanu neu chikchik te uh nek ding ahi ding hi, achia.
ENGLISH: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”

PAITE: Huan, amau, nang ka hinna uh na humbitta: pu aw, honhehpih inla, Pharo sikhate ka hi mai ding uh, achi ua.
ENGLISH: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Joseph in Pharo in seh nga suah seh khat a muh jel ding thu, Aigupta gam a dingin tutanin danin a bawlta hi: siampute gam kia ahi, Pharo a hilou.
ENGLISH: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.

PAITE: Huan, Israel in Aigupta gama, Gosen gamah tenna a bawlta a: huailaiah a kihih-inbul ua, chi tampi a suang ua, nakpi takin a pungta uh.
ENGLISH: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

PAITE: Huan, Jakob bel Aigupta gamah kum sawm leh kum sagih a om a: huchiin, Jakob damsung kum kum ja leh kum sawm li leh kum sagih a hita hi.
ENGLISH: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.

PAITE: Huan, Israel sihna hun a hiongnaita a: huchiin, a tapa Joseph a sama. A kiangah, na honhehpih theih leh, hehpihtak in huai na khut ka pheipi nuaiah golh inla, hon hehpihin, ka tungah chihtaktakin hih in: hehpihtakin Aigupta gamah honvui mahmah ken;
ENGLISH: The time drew near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,

PAITE: Hon suangte kianga ka ihmut hun chiangin, nang Aigupta gam akipan na hon jawngkhe dinga, amaute vuina mun ah na honvui zaw ding ahi, achia. Huan, aman, na chih bangin ka honhih ding hi, achia.Huan, aman, ka kiangah kichiamin leh, achia: huchiin, a kiangah a kichiamta hi. Huan, Israel lukhung siin a kunta a.
ENGLISH: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” He said, “I will do as you have said.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, ka kiangah kichiamin leh, achia: huchiin, a kiangah a kichiamta hi. Huan, Israel lukhung siin a kunta a.
ENGLISH: He said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.

PAITE: Huan, huaite nungin hichi ahia, Joseph kiangah, ngaiin, na pa a chi ana, achi ua. Huchiin, a tapa nihte Manassi leh Ephraim a kiangah a tonpiha,
ENGLISH: It happened after these things, that someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

PAITE: Huan, Jakob kingah, ngaiin, na tapa Joseph na kiangah a hong hi, chiin. A hilh ua: huchiin, Israel a kihalhsaka, lupna ah a tuta a.
ENGLISH: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

PAITE: Huan, Jakob in, Joseph kiangah, Pathian bangkim hihthei Kanan gama Luz khua ah ka kiangah a kilaka, a honvualjawla,
ENGLISH: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

PAITE: Ka kiangah, chi tampi ka honsuangsak dinga, ka honhihpung lai ding, chi tuamtuam omkhawm in ka honbawl ding; huan, hiai gam na nunga na suante kiangah khantawn gou dingin ka pe ding, honchi a.
ENGLISH: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your seed after you for an everlasting possession.’

PAITE: Huan, na tapa nihte, Aigupta gama na neihte, keia ahi uh; Ephraim leh Manassi, Reuben leh Simeon bangmah in, keia ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

PAITE: Huan, hiai mite nunga ta ne neihte nanga ahi ding uh, a goutan uah a ute uh min a kikoppih mai ding uh.
ENGLISH: Your issue, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

PAITE: Huan, kei tungthu ahihleh, Paddan gam a kipana ka hong laiin Rakil pen Kanan gamah lamkalah, Ephtath khua a gamla kuam ahihlaiin, ka kiangah a si a: huailaiah Ephrath kho lampi ah ka vuita, (huaibel Bethlehem khua ahi), achia.
ENGLISH: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there in the way to Ephrath (the same is Bethlehem).”

PAITE: Huan, Israel in Joseph tapate a ena, hiaite kuate ahi ua? achia.
ENGLISH: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in, apa kiangah, hiaite ka tapa, Pathian in hiai laia honpiak te ahi uh, achia. Huan, aman, hehpihtakin ka kiangah honpiin, amau kana vualjawl ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”

PAITE: Israel mit bel a upat jiakin a chim nawn kei a, huan, aman ana tawp a, ana pom a.
ENGLISH: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see. He brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

PAITE: Huan, Israel in, Joseph kiangah, na mel muh ka lamen nawn keia, himahleh, ngaiin, Pathian in, na suante mel nangawn a honmusakta hi, achia.
ENGLISH: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your seed also.”

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in amau apa pheikal akipan a kai khia a, a maia lei siin chibai a buka.
ENGLISH: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in a nih un a kai a, Ephraim pen a khut taklamin Israel khut veilam pangah a kai a, Manassi pen a khut veilamin Israel khut taklam pangah a kai a, honpi nai a.
ENGLISH: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.

PAITE: Huan, Israel in a sawk kalh teitei a, a khut taklam in a sawka, Ephraim a naupang jaw siipah a nga a; Manassi lah ta masa ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph a vualjawla, honsuangpa Abraham leh Isaak ama a a om jelna Pathian, tuni tana ka damsung tengtenga honvakpa Pathian,
ENGLISH: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,

PAITE: Gilou tengteng a kipan hon tanpa angel in naupang te vualjawl hen; huan, ka min leh honsuangpa Abraham leh Isaak min amau minin pu uhen; huan, khovel laizang ah mipa thupitak hi dingin hongpung uhen, achia.
ENGLISH: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.”

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in apan akhut taklam Ephraim sipa a ngak a muhin a lungkim takei a; huchiin apa khut Ephraim sipa kipan Manassi sipa suan dingin a domkanga.
ENGLISH: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in, apa kiangah, pa, hichibang ding ahi kei: hiai ahi ta masa, na khut taklam a siipah nga jaw in, achia.
ENGLISH: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father; for this is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”

PAITE: Himahleh, apa a ut keia, ka thei hi, ka tapa aw, ka thei hi: amah leh nam a gen thamin a om sam dinga, amah leng a thupi sam ding: Ahihhangin a naupa amah sangin a thupi zo dinga, a suante leng chi tuamtuam tamtak a hong hi ding uh, achia.
ENGLISH: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his seed will become a multitude of nations.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Jakob in, Israelten, Ephraim leh Manassi bangin Pathianin nang honomsak hen, chiin, noumau min louin ahon vualjawl jel ding uh, chiin huai niin, amau a vualjawl a: huchiin Ephraim Manassi maah a omsakta hi.
ENGLISH: He blessed them that day, saying, “In you will Israel bless, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.

PAITE: Huan, Israel mahin, Joseph kiangah, ngaiin, si ding ka hita hi: himahleh Pathian jaw na kiang uah a om ding a, nou hon suangte gamah a honpi lut nawn ding.Huailou leng, na unaute tantuan sangin tan khat in ka honpe tuan hi, ka namsau leh ka thalpeu a Amor te khut akipan ka laksak pen, achia.
ENGLISH: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

PAITE: Huailou leng, na unaute tantuan sangin tan khat in ka honpe tuan hi, ka namsau leh ka thalpeu a Amor te khut akipan ka laksak pen, achia.
ENGLISH: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”

PAITE: Huan, Jakob in a tapate a sama hichibang in a gena, Ni nanungte a na tung ua thil hongtung dingte ka honhilh theihna ding in hong kihawm un,
ENGLISH: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

PAITE: Nou Jakob tapate aw, hong kikhawm unla, ngaikhia un; na pa uh Israel thu ngaikhia un.
ENGLISH: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

PAITE: Reuben, nang ka ta masa, ka thilhihtheih na ka hatna gah masapen na hi; san penna leh thuneih penna nanga ahi.
ENGLISH: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

PAITE: Himahleh tui banga kiplou na hi, tungnung penna na neikei ding; na pa lupnapi na kah jiak in: huchihlai in huai lah na hihbuah a: ka lupna ah a kah hi.
ENGLISH: Boiling over as water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

PAITE: Simeon leh Levi te na unau ahi uh; a namsaute uh sisan suahna vanzat ahi.
ENGLISH: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

PAITE: Ka kha aw, nangjaw a kikupna uah vakigolh ken; ka thupina, nang jaw a kikhopna uah tel ken; a heh un mi a that ua, a genhak un bawngtal tha a sat uhi.
ENGLISH: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

PAITE: A hehna un hamsia dong hen, hangsan tak ahi ngala; a thangpaihna un leng hamsia dong hen, hinse tak ahi ngala: Jakob te in amau ka kikhensak dinga, Israel te in ka hih dalh ding hi.
ENGLISH: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

PAITE: Juda, nang jaw na unauten honphat ding uh: na khut lah na doute ngawngah na nga dinga; na tapate lah na maah a kun ding uh.
ENGLISH: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

PAITE: Juda jaw humpinelkai nou ahi; ka tapa, na sa keih lah na paitouh santa: na kuna, humpinelkai bangin na boka, humpinelkainu mahbang ngalin: kuan ahia thousak ngam ding.
ENGLISH: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

PAITE: Lalchiang lah Juda akipan amang kei ding, vaihawmpa chiang lah a khe kala kipanin a mang sam kei ding, Silo a hongpai ma teng; nam chihin amah thu a mang ding uh.
ENGLISH: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. To him will the obedience of the peoples be.

PAITE: A sakolnou grep gui ah khih dinga, a sabengtungnou lah grep gui hoih chi-ah a khih ding hi. A puansilhte uain in a sawp dinga, a puan lah grep sisan in a sawp lai ding hi:
ENGLISH: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

PAITE: A mit te lah uain suksanin a om ding ua, a hate lah nawitui sukngouin a om ding uhi.
ENGLISH: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

PAITE: Zebulun tuipi geiah a teng dinga: long khawlna luipiau ahi ding; a gamgi lah Zidon ah ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

PAITE: Issakar bel sabengtung hat tak belam huang kala kual ahi.
ENGLISH: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

PAITE: Khawl lah hoihin a theia, gam leng hoihin a thei; huchiin banghiam khat po dingin a liangjang a niamsaka, kuli na semin sikhain a hongomta hi.
ENGLISH: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

PAITE: Danin a mite, Israel nam laka nam khat hi samin, vai a hawmsak ding.
ENGLISH: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

PAITE: Dan bel lamlian gul, lampi a gul gial, a tunga tuang thalkiak ek khopa sakol khe a tu nakpa ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Dan will be a serpent in the way, an adder in the path, That bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

PAITE: Aw Toupa, na hotdamna ka ngak gige hi.
ENGLISH: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.

PAITE: Gad, galin a sual ding ua, himahleh aman a khetul lam uah a sualzo ding hi.
ENGLISH: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

PAITE: Aser, a nek a hoh ding, kumpite nek chi kim taktak a piangsak ding hi.
ENGLISH: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will yield royal dainties.

PAITE: Naphtali zukpi khak ahi: thu hoih pipi a gen jel hi.
ENGLISH: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

PAITE: Joseph bel hiang gan nuam tak ahi, tuikhuk kianga hiang gah nuam tak; ahiang nawnsawnten suang bang a thuam uh.
ENGLISH: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

PAITE: Thalkapmiten amah nakpi takin a hihgenthei ua, a kap ua, a simmoh ua:
ENGLISH: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecute him:

PAITE: Himahleh, amah thalpeu khauh takin a om gige, a khut thate lah Jakob Mi Hatpa khuta (huaia kipan belam chingmi, Isreal suangpa, a hongom a: )
ENGLISH: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

PAITE: Na pa Pathian, nang honpanpihpa dinga-Bangkimhihtheipa, tunglam van vauljawlnate, nuailam bok gige tui thuktak vualjawlnate, nawite leh sul vualjawlnate, nangmah honvualjawl dingpa ngei hihhatin a om hi.
ENGLISH: even by the God of your father, who will help you; by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

PAITE: Na pa vualjawlnate, honsuangte vualjawlna sangin khantawn tang tawpkhawk phain a thupi zo ta hi: huaite bel Joseph lu ah a om dinga, a unaute kiang akipan hihtuama ompa sip ah a om ding.
ENGLISH: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of your ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

PAITE: Benjamin bel ngia duhgawl ahi: jingsangin asa koih a ne dinga, nitaklamin a gallak a hawm ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the spoil.”

PAITE: Huaite tengteng Israel nam sawm leh nam nihte ahi uh: huai thute leng amaute vaualjawlna a kiang ua a pa uh thu gen ahi; vualjawlna a tan ding gun bang jel un a vualjawl chiat hi.
ENGLISH: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his blessing.

PAITE: Huan, amau thugou a siaha, a kiang uah, Ka chipihte kianga pia om ding ka hita: Hit mi Ephron lou a kokhuk, honsuangte kiangah honvui un.
ENGLISH: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

PAITE: Kanan gam a Mamre maa Makpel lou a kokhuk, Abrahamin, kivuina mun gou dinga, Hit mi Ephron akipana a lou toh a lei ah:
ENGLISH: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

PAITE: Hiailaiah Abraham leh a ji Sara a vui ua: huailaiah Isaak leh a ji Rebeka a vui ua; huailai mahah Lea ka vuia:
ENGLISH: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

PAITE: Lou leh a sunga kokhuk om lah Heth suante akipana lei ahi, a chi a.Huan, Jakobin a tapate kianga thugou a siah khitin a khete lupna ah a nga toua, a kha a khaha, a chipihte kiangah piin a om samta hi.
ENGLISH: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

PAITE: Huan, Jakobin a tapate kianga thugou a siah khitin a khete lupna ah a nga toua, a kha a khaha, a chipihte kiangah piin a om samta hi.
ENGLISH: When Jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the spirit, and was gathered to his people.

PAITE: Hiai Adam suante tuan na laibu ahi. Pathianin mi a siam niin Pathian batpihin amah a bawla;
ENGLISH: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

PAITE: Pasal leh numeiin amau a siama; amau a vualzawla, a min uh Adam, a chi, amau siama a om ni un
ENGLISH: He created them male and female, and blessed them, and called their name “Adam,” “Adam” and “Man” are spelled with the exact same consonants in Hebrew, so this can be correctly translated either way. in the day when they were created.

PAITE: Huan, Adamin, kum ja leh kum sawmthum ahihin, amah bang mahmah, amah kibatpih ngei tapa a neia; a min din Seth a sa hi;
ENGLISH: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

PAITE: Huan, Seth a neih nungin Adam kum za giat a dam laia: tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
ENGLISH: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huchiin, Adam dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm thum ahia; huan a sita hi.
ENGLISH: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

PAITE: Huan, Sethin, kum ja leh kum nga ahihin, tapa Enosa a neia:
ENGLISH: Seth lived one hundred five years, and became the father of Enosh.

PAITE: Huan, Enosa a neih nungin Seth kum za giat leh kum sagih a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi:
ENGLISH: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huchiin, Seth dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm leh kum nih ahia; huan, a sita hi.
ENGLISH: All the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

PAITE: Huan, Enosain, kum sawm kua ahihih, tapa Kenan a neia:
ENGLISH: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

PAITE: Huan, Kenan a neih nungin Enosa kum za giat leh kum sawm leh kum nga a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn laia:
ENGLISH: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan, eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huchiin, Enosa dam sung tengteng kum za kua kum nga ahi a: a sita hi.
ENGLISH: All the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

PAITE: Huan, Kenanin, kum sawm sagih ahihin, tapa Mahalalel a neita:
ENGLISH: Kenan lived seventy years, and became the father of Mahalalel.

PAITE: Huan, Mahalalel a neih nungin Kenan kum za giat leh kum li a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi:
ENGLISH: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of sons and daughters

PAITE: Huchiin, Kenan dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm ahia: huan, a sita hi.
ENGLISH: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

PAITE: Huan, Mahalalel, kum sawm guk leh kum nga ahihin, tapa Jared a neia:
ENGLISH: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and became the father of Jared.

PAITE: Huan, Jared a neih nungin Mahalalel kum za giat leh kum sawm thum a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn laia:
ENGLISH: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huchiin, Mahalalel dam sung tengteng kum za giat leh kum sawm kua leh kum nga ahia: huan, a sita hi.
ENGLISH: All the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

PAITE: Huan, Jared in, kum ja leh kum sawm guk leh kum nih a hihin, tapa Enok a neia:
ENGLISH: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, and became the father of Enoch.

PAITE: Huan, Enok a neih nungin Jared kum za giat a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn laia:
ENGLISH: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huchiin, Jared dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm guk leh kum nih ahi: huan a sita hi.
ENGLISH: All the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

PAITE: Huan, Enokin, kum sawm guk leh kum nga a hihin, tapa Methusel a neia:
ENGLISH: Enoch lived sixty-five years, and became the father of Methuselah.

PAITE: Huan, Methusel a neih nungin Enok kum za thum sung teng Pathian toh a omkhawm ua, tanu leh tapate a nein awn laia:
ENGLISH: Enoch walked with God after he became the father of Methuselah three hundred years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Enok dam sung tengteng kum za thum leh kum sawm guk leh kum nga ahia:
ENGLISH: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

PAITE: Huan, Enok Pathian toh a om khawm ua: huan a omta keia; Pathianin a la mang ta ahi.
ENGLISH: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.

PAITE: Huan, Methusel, kum ja leh kum sawm giat leh kum sagih a hihin, tapa Lamek a neia:
ENGLISH: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, and became the father of Lamech.

PAITE: Huan, Lamek a neih nungin Methusel kum za sagih leh kum sawm giat leh kum nih a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn laia:
ENGLISH: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huchiin Methusel dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm guk leh kum kua ahia: huan, a sita hi.
ENGLISH: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

PAITE: Huan, Lamekin, kum ja leh kum sawm giat leh kum nih a hihin tapa a neia:
ENGLISH: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of a son,

PAITE: Huan, hiai ngeingeiin Toupa hamsiat khum leitung jiaka a nasepna leh khuta I sepgimnaah honlungmuan ding, chiin, a min din Noa a sa hi.
ENGLISH: and he named him Noah, saying, “This same will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, because of the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”

PAITE: Huan, Noa a neih nungin Lamek kum nga leh kum sawm kua leh kum nga a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nein awn laia:
ENGLISH: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

PAITE: Huan, Lamek dam sung tengteng kum za sagih leh kum sawm sagih leh kum sagih ahia; huan a sita hi.Huan, Noa kum za ngaa a upa ahi: Noain tapa Sem te Ham te leh Japheth te a nei.
ENGLISH: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

PAITE: Huan, Noa kum za ngaa a upa ahi: Noain tapa Sem te Ham te leh Japheth te a nei.
ENGLISH: Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph in apa mai a, sia, a kaha, a tawptawpa.
ENGLISH: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

PAITE: Huan, Josephin a sikha damdawi siamte a pa luang muat theiloua bawl dingin thu a piaa: huchiin damdawi siamten Isreal luang muat theilouin a bawlta uhi.
ENGLISH: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

PAITE: A luang bawlnain ni sawm li a zang ua, muat theiloua bawlnain ni huchizah ala nak ahi: huan, ni sawm sagih suang teng Aiguptaten amah a kah uhi.
ENGLISH: Forty days were fulfilled for him, for that is how many the days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for him for seventy days.

PAITE: Huan, amah a kah nite uh a bei nugin Josephin Pharo inkuante a houpiha, Hehpihtakin Pharo bila jak dingin, Ka pan, Ngaiin, si ding ka hita,
ENGLISH: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

PAITE: Kanan gam a ka han ka tohsa ah, hiailai ngeiah na honvui ding ahi, chiin, a honkichiamsaka, Huchiin, hehpihtakin ka pa hon vaposak inla, huan, ka hong pai nawn mai ding, a chi hi, chiin, gen un, a chi a.
ENGLISH: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”

PAITE: Huchiin, Pharoin, A honkichiamsak bangin na pa vapo tou ve, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Joseph bel a pa vui dingin a vahoh toua: huan, Pharo sikha tengteng, a innkuan laka upate leh Aigupta gam upa tengteng leh,
ENGLISH: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

PAITE: Joseph inkuanpihte tengteng leh, a unaute leh, a pa inkuanpihte, a kiangah a vahoh tou a: a tanu neu chikchikte uleh, a belam honte uleh a bawng honte kia uh Gosen gamah a nusia ua.
ENGLISH: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

PAITE: Huan, a kiang uah kangtalaite. Sakol tungtuang mite toh, a hih ua; huchiin pawl lianpi ahi uh.
ENGLISH: There went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.

PAITE: Huan Jordan lui gala Atadia phual a tuang ua, huailaiah nakpitakin a kah ua: ni sagih a pa sunna a bawl hi.
ENGLISH: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

PAITE: Huan, hiai gama a mi Kananten, Atada phual a a mi sun uh a muh un, Hiai Aiguptate misi sunna thupital ahi, a chi ua: huaijiakin huai mun minin Abel-Mozraim a sa ua, huai Jordan lui gala om ahi.
ENGLISH: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

PAITE: Huan, a tapaten a thupiak bang jelin a hihsak ua:
ENGLISH: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,

PAITE: A tapten Kanan gamah a jawng lut ua, Abrahamin, kivuina mun gou dinga, Hit mi Ephron akipana a lou toh a lei Mamre maa Makpel lou a kokhuk ah a vuita uhi.
ENGLISH: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph bel, a pa a vui khitin, amah leh, a unaute leh, apa vui ding a kianga hohtoute tengteng toh, Aigupta gamah a pai nawnta uhi.
ENGLISH: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph unauten a pa uh si a ngaihtuah un, Josephin hon mudah dinga, a tunga I thil hihkelh tengteng uh phu i tunguah kim sipsipin a honla kha ding e aw, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all of the evil which we did to him.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Joseph kiangah hilh dingin thu a khak ua, Na pan a sih main hichiin thu a pia,
ENGLISH: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

PAITE: Hichiin Joseph kiangah, hehpihtakin na unaute tatlekna leh a gilouhna uh ngaidamin, na tungah thil a hih leh a hihkhial na uh, chiin, na gen ding uh, a chi, chiin: huchiin hehpihtakin na pa Pathian sikhate tatlekna ngaidamin, a chi ua. Huan, a kianga a gentak un Joseph a kapta hi.
ENGLISH: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

PAITE: Huan, a unaute leng a vahoh ua, a maah a khupboh chiat ua; huan, Ngaiin, na sikhate ka hi uhi, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

PAITE: Huan, Josephin, a kiang uah, Lau kei un: Pathian sika om ka hi hia?
ENGLISH: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

PAITE: Nou jaw ka tungah thil gilou hih lungsimin na pu ua; himahleh Pathianin tuni bangin, mi tampi hing leh dama humbitna dinga, thil hoih a suahsak a lungsim put ahi jaw ngala.
ENGLISH: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save many people alive.

PAITE: Hichiin lau kei un: noute leh na ta na nau chikchikte ka hon vak jel ding, a chi a. Huchiin, a lungmuana, kam siam takin a houpih chiat hi.
ENGLISH: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will nourish you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph bel, amah leh apa inkuanpihte toh, Aigupta gamah a om ua: Joseph kum ja leh kum sawm a dam hi.
ENGLISH: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

PAITE: Josephin Ephraim ta, tusawn thum chiang a mu a: Manassi tapa Makir tate leng Joseph phei tungah a piang ua.
ENGLISH: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

PAITE: Huan, Josephin a unaute kiangah, si ding ka hita hi: himahleh Pathianin a hongveh ngeingei ding hi, hiai gam akipanin a hongpi khiain. Abraham te, Isaak te, Jakob te kianga kichiama piak achiam gamah a honpi tou ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

PAITE: Huan, Josephin Isreal suante a kichiam saka, Pathian in a hongveh ngeingei dinga, ka guhte hiai akipanin na jawng tou ding uh ahi, a chi a.Huchiin, Joseph bel, kum ja leh kum sawm a upa a hihin, a si a: huan, a luang muat theilouin a bawl ua, Aigupta gamah kuang ah a koih uh.
ENGLISH: Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Joseph bel, kum ja leh kum sawm a upa a hihin, a si a: huan, a luang muat theilouin a bawl ua, Aigupta gamah kuang ah a koih uh.
ENGLISH: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, leitungah mi a hongpung ua, tanute a honnei chiat ua.
ENGLISH: It happened, when men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

PAITE: Pathian tapaten mite tanute mel hoih takin a mu ua; huchiin, a deihlam chiatte uh ji dingin a honnei jel uhi.
ENGLISH: that God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took for themselves wives of all that they chose.

PAITE: Huchiin, Toupan, ka khain mi khantawnin a sual nilouh louh kei ding, amaute lah sa ahi ngal ua: ahihhangin kum ja leh kum sawmnih a dam ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; yet will his days be one hundred twenty years.”

PAITE: Huai, lain miliante leiah a om ua; huai nungin leng Pathian tapaten mite tanute a kithuahpih ua, amau toh tate a neih jel laiun, huaite nidanglaia mihat, mi minthangte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters. They bore children to them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan, leiah mi gitlouhdan thupi ahi chih leh, a lungtang lunggeldan gilou ngen ahi ngitnget chih a na thei hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

PAITE: Huchiin, leitunga mi a bawljiakin Toupa a kisika, lunggimnan a neih loh hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

PAITE: Huchiin, Toupan, Ka mi siam leitung akipan ka hihmang mai ding; mite, sate, ganhingte tunga leng vasa te tannin; ka bawl jiakin ka kisik ahi, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground; man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky; for I am sorry that I have made them.”

PAITE: Noain bel Toupa hehpihna a mu hi.
ENGLISH: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.

PAITE: Noa suan hiaite ahi uh. Noa midik ahia, a dam tonpihte lakah gensiatbei ahi: Noa Pathian toh a om khawm uh.
ENGLISH: This is the history of the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

PAITE: Huan Noain tapa thum Sem, Ham, leh Japheth a nei.
ENGLISH: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

PAITE: Huan, Pathian mitmuhin lei a se khintaa, lei hiamgam nain a dim khinta hi.
ENGLISH: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin lei a en a, huan ngaiin, a se khinta; sa tengtengin lah leitungah a omdan uh a hihse khinta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin Noa kiangah, sa tengteng beina ka maah a hongtungta; amaute jiakin lei hiamgam nain a dim khinta ngala; huchiin, ngaiin a lei nasanin ka hihmang ding.
ENGLISH: God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

PAITE: Nang dingin meilah singin long bawlin; longah dantante na bawl ding ahi. A sunglam leh a pawlam meilah naiin na jut vek ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

PAITE: Huan, hiai na bawl dingdan ahi: Long dung lam tong za thum hi henla, a vailam tong sawm nga hi henla, asanlam tong sawm thum hi hen.
ENGLISH: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship will be three hundred cubits, its breadth fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

PAITE: Longah tohlet na bawl dinga, a tunglam tong khat chianga na zoh ding ahi; huan, long kongkhak a pangah na bawl ding a; chial nuainung leh chial nihna leh chial thumna nei in na bawl ding ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

PAITE: Huan, Ngaiin, kei mahmahin, sa tengteng, hinna hatna pai khempeuh, van nuaia kipan hih mangthang dingin, leitungah tuichim ka tungsak ding hi; leia thil chih om a si ve ding uh.
ENGLISH: I, even I, do bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.

PAITE: Ahihhangin ka thukhun na tungah kakipsak zo dinga, longah na lut ding ahi; nang na lut ding ahia, na tapate leh na ji leh, na tapate jite leng na kiangah a lut sam ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

PAITE: Huan, sa tengtenga thilhing chiteng laka pat, chichih nihnihin, na kiangah hinsak dingin longah na pi lut ding ahi: a nu leh a pa jel a hih ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

PAITE: Vasate amau chi omdan bang chiatin, gante amau chi omdan bang chiatin, chi chih nin nihin, na hinsak dingin, na kiangah a hongpai ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort shall come to you, to keep them alive.

PAITE: Huan, na annek tengteng uh la inla, na kiangah koih khawm in; huchiin, nang leh amau adin an ahi ding uh, a chi hi.Huchibangin Noain a hih a; Pathianin a kianga thu a piak tengteng bangin a hihta hi.
ENGLISH: Take with you of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

PAITE: Huchibangin Noain a hih a; Pathianin a kianga thu a piak tengteng bangin a hihta hi.
ENGLISH: Thus Noah did. According to all that God commanded him, so he did.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan, Noa kiangah, nang leh na inkuanpihte tengteng longah lut un; nang jaw tulai khangthak lakah ka mitmuhin mi diktat na hihna ka honthei hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

PAITE: Sa siang chiteng lakah, a pa leh a lawmnu, kop sagih jelin: sa sianglou laka, a pa leh a lawmnu chiat toh, kop khat jel, na kiangah na pi ding hi;
ENGLISH: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

PAITE: Tunga leng vasa laka zong, a nu leh a pa chiat, kop sagih jelin, leitunga chi khah dinga hinsak dingin.
ENGLISH: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

PAITE: Ni sagihin a sam laia, huai khit chiangin leitung ah ni sawm li leh jan sawm li sungteng vuah ka zu sak dinga; ka thil hing bawl chiteng leitung akipan ka hihmang ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. Every living thing that I have made, I will destroy from the surface of the ground.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Noain Toupan a kianga thu a piak tengteng bang jelin ahihta.
ENGLISH: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

PAITE: Huan, leitunga tuichim a hongtun lain Noa kum za guka upa ahi.
ENGLISH: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

PAITE: Huan, tuichim a tun ding jiakin Noa longah a luta, a tapate leh a ji leh a tapate jite leng a kiangah a lut sam uh.
ENGLISH: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the waters of the flood.

PAITE: Sa siang laka leng, sa sianglou laka leng, vasa laka leng, leitunga khupboha pai chiteng laka leng,
ENGLISH: Clean animals, animals that are not clean, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

PAITE: Pathianin Noa kianga thu a piak bangin, a nu leh a pa chiat, a kop kopin, Noa kiangah longah a luta uh.
ENGLISH: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

PAITE: Huan, ni sagih nungin leitung ah a tungta.
ENGLISH: It happened after the seven days, that the waters of the flood came on the earth.

PAITE: Noa kum za guk a hih kum, a kha nihna ni sawm leh ni sagih niin, huai ni mahin tui thuk zapi nak tengteng a hongpuak jaka, van tohlette leng a hong kihongta hi.
ENGLISH: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep were burst open, and the sky’s windows were opened.

PAITE: Huan, ni sawm li leh jan sawm li sung teng leitungah vuahpi a zutaa.
ENGLISH: The rain was on the earth forty days and forty nights.

PAITE: Huai ni mahin Noa te, Noa tapa Sem te, Ham te, Japheth te, Noa ji te longah a luta ua, a tapa jite thum leng a kiangah a lut sam ua;
ENGLISH: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship;

PAITE: Amaute a lut ua, sa chiteng amau chi omdan bang chiatin, ganhing leitunga khupboha pai chiteng amau chi omdan bang chiatin, vasa chiteng, amau chi omdan bang chiatin, vasa chiteng, kah nei chiteng leng a lut uh.
ENGLISH: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

PAITE: Huchiin, sa tengteng hinna hatna pai himhimte, a kop kopin Noa kiangah longah a luta uh.
ENGLISH: They went to Noah into the ship, by pairs of all flesh with the breath of life in them.

PAITE: Huan, a lutte Pathianin a kianga thu a piak bangin sa tengteng laka a nu leh a pa jelin a lut uhi: huan Toupan amah a khak khumta hi.
ENGLISH: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; and Yahweh shut him in.

PAITE: Huan, tuichim leitung ah ni sawm li sung teng a tunga; tui a hongkhanga, long a lama, leitung tunglamah a dom kangta hi.
ENGLISH: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

PAITE: Huan, tui a hong om juajua a, leitung tunglamah a khanin a hong khangta hi, long tui tungah a kilam jel hi.
ENGLISH: The waters prevailed, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

PAITE: Huan, leitung tunglamah tui nakpiin a hongom juajua taa; van nuaia tang sang tengteng a tumkhin vekta hi.
ENGLISH: The waters prevailed exceedingly on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

PAITE: Tong sawm leh tong nga hiala sangin tui a hongom zeizoia; tangte tupmangin a omta uhi.
ENGLISH: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.

PAITE: Huchiin, sa leitunga tangthei tengteng, vasate, gante, sate, ganhing leitunga khupboha pai chitengte, mi chitengte toh a si khinvekta uh:
ENGLISH: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

PAITE: A nak ua hinna kha hatna omna tengteng, gama om khempeuh te, a si khin vekta uh.
ENGLISH: All in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, of all that was on the dry land, died.

PAITE: Huchiin, leitunga thil hing chiteng omte, mite, gante, ganhingte, tunga leng vasate toh hihmanin a om uh; lei akipan hihmanin a omta uh: Noa longa a kianga omte kia hawiin a om uhi,Huan, tui tuh ni ja leh ni sawm nga sungteng leitungah a omta hi.
ENGLISH: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

PAITE: Huan, tui tuh ni ja leh ni sawm nga sungteng leitungah a omta hi.
ENGLISH: The waters prevailed on the earth one hundred fifty days.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin, Noa leh longa a kianga thil hing chiteng leh gan tengteng omte a theigigea: huan, Pathianin leitung lamah huih a nungsak a, huchiin tui a hongdai panta hi.
ENGLISH: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

PAITE: Tui thukpi nakte leh van tohlette leng a hongkikhakta a, van akipana vuah hongju leng theu sakin a hong omta a;
ENGLISH: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

PAITE: Huchiin, tui lei apan a kiam giaigiai taa; huchiin, ni ja leh ni sawm nga a man nungin tui a hong tawm deuhta hi.
ENGLISH: The waters receded from the earth continually. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters decreased.

PAITE: Huchiin, long a kha sagihna ni sawm leh ni sagih niin Ararat tangah a hong kingata hi.
ENGLISH: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

PAITE: Huan, tui a kha sawmna tannin a kiam giaigiai jela; huan, kha sawmna ni khat niin mual vumte a hongkimuta hi.
ENGLISH: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.

PAITE: Huan, ni sawm li nungin hichi ahia, Noain a long tohlet bawl a hongta a;
ENGLISH: It happened at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

PAITE: Huan, va ak khat a khah kheta a; huai a pawt kheta a, lei akipan tui a kan khit masiah a vial lenlen hi.
ENGLISH: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

PAITE: Huan, leitungah tui a tawmta hia tawm nailou chih theihna dingin vakhu a khah khe nawna;
ENGLISH: He sent out a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

PAITE: Himahleh vakhuin tukna ding him him a mu keia, a kiangah longah a kik nawna, tui lah leitung pumpiah a om lai ngala: huchiin, polamah a khut a golh khiaa, a man a long sungah a kiangah a la lut nawn hi.
ENGLISH: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned to him into the ship; for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

PAITE: Huan, ni sagih dang a ngak nawn laia; huan, vakhu long akipanin a khah khe nawna;
ENGLISH: He stayed yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

PAITE: Vakhu nitaklamin a kiangah a honglut nawna; huan, ngaiin, a mukin olive nah loh tung a hontuaha; huchiin, Noain leiah tui a tawmta chih a theita hi.
ENGLISH: The dove came back to him at evening, and, behold, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

PAITE: Huan, ni sagih dang a ngak nawn jela; huan, vakhu a khah khe nawna; huan, a kiangah a hong kik nawn ta kei hi.
ENGLISH: He stayed yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, a kum za guk leh kum khatnaah, a kha khatna ni khat niin, tui lei a kipan a kangta: huchiin, Noain, long khuhna a koihsuana, a ena; huan, ngaiin leitung a hulta hi.
ENGLISH: It happened in the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dried.

PAITE: Huan, a kha nihna ni sawm nih leh ni sagih niin lei a hulta hi.
ENGLISH: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

PAITE: Huan, Pathianin Noa kiangah thu a genna,
ENGLISH: God spoke to Noah, saying,

PAITE: Long akipan pawtin, nang pawt inla, na ji leh na tapate leh na tapate jite leng na kiangah pawt uhen.
ENGLISH: “Go out of the ship, you, and your wife, and your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

PAITE: Sa tengteng laka thil hing chiteng na ompih te, vasate, gante, ganhing leitunga khupboha pai chiteng te toh na kiangah pikhiain, leitungah chi pha taka chi tampi suanga a hongpunna ding un, chiin.
ENGLISH: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Noa a pawta, a tapate leh a ji leh a tapate jite leng a kiangah a pawt uhi;
ENGLISH: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

PAITE: Sa chitengte, ganhing chitengte, vasa chitengte, leitunga tangthei peuhmah te amau chi omdan bang chiatin long akipan a pawta uhi.
ENGLISH: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

PAITE: Huan, Noain Toupa dingin maitam a bawla; huan, sa siang chiteng laka leh vasa siang chiteng laka a laa, maitamah halmang pumpiaknate a lanta.
ENGLISH: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

PAITE: Huan, Toupan tua namtui a jaa; huan, Toupan, a lungsimin, Mi jiakin leitung ka hamsiat nawn kei ding, mi lungsim ngaihtuahnate lah naupang neu a hih a pana gilou ahi ngala; tua ka gawt bangin thil hing chiteng leng ka gawt non sam kei ding.Lei om laiteng buh leh buh lak te, kho vot leh kho lum te, nipi leh phalbi te, sun leh jan te a bei kei ding, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake, because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I ever again strike everything living, as I have done.

PAITE: Lei om laiteng buh leh buh lak te, kho vot leh kho lum te, nipi leh phalbi te, sun leh jan te a bei kei ding, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.”

PAITE: Huan; Pathianin Noa leh a tapate a vualjawla, a kiang uah chi tampi suang dingin hongpungin, lei luah dim un;
ENGLISH: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

PAITE: Nou kihtakna leh launa leia sa chiteng leh tunga leng vasa chitengin a nei ding uh; huaite leh, leia khupboha pai tengteng leh tuipi ngasate tengteng na khut ua piak ahita uh;
ENGLISH: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that the ground teems with, and all the fish of the sea are delivered into your hand.

PAITE: Thil hing tangthei chitengte noua dingin nek ding ahi ding ua; anteh hing kon piak bangin bangkim ka honpe vek hi;
ENGLISH: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As the green herb, I have given everything to you.

PAITE: Ahihhangin, sa a hinna, a sisan toh na ne khawm ding uh ahi kei;
ENGLISH: But flesh with its life, its blood, you shall not eat.

PAITE: Huan, na sisan uh, na hinnate uh sisan phu, ka la ngei ngei ding; sa chiteng lakah ka la ding: mi lakah leng. Mi chih a unaute uh lakah, mi hinna phu ka la chiat ding;
ENGLISH: I will surely require your blood of your lives. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

PAITE: Kuapeuh mi sisan suahmi mi mahin amah sisan a suah sam ding ahi: Pathian batpiha mi lah bawl ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

PAITE: Huan, nou chi tampi suangin hongpung un; leiah tampi nei unla, a tungah hongpung un, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”

PAITE: Huan, Pathian, Noa kiang leh a kianga om a tate kiangah,
ENGLISH: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

PAITE: Huan, ngai un, lei mahmahin na kiang uah leh nou nunga na suante kiang leng ka thukhun ka hihkip hi;
ENGLISH: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

PAITE: Na kiang ua thil hing chiteng om, na ompih uh vasate, gante, na ompih uh leia sa chitengte kiangah leng; long akipana hong pawt tengteng, leia sa chiteng kiang nangawnah.
ENGLISH: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

PAITE: Huan, na kiang ua ka thukhun hihkip ding; sa tengteng leng tuichima hihmanin a omta kei ding uh; lei hihse dingin tuichim a tung nawn sam kei ding hi, chiin, a gen hi.
ENGLISH: I will establish my covenant with you: all flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood, neither will there ever again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

PAITE: Huan, Pathian mahin, keileh nou leh na kiang ua thil hing chiteng omte kala, suan tawp neiloua om jel te dingin, hiai ka thukhun chiamtehna ahi ding:
ENGLISH: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

PAITE: Meiah ka sakhituihup ka jamsaka, huai kei leh lei kala thukhun chiamtehna ding ahi ding.
ENGLISH: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be for a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi dinga, leitunga mei ka kaisakin sakhituihup meiah a kimu ding,
ENGLISH: It will happen, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

ENGLISH: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

PAITE: Huan, Noa tapa long akipana pawtte Sem te, Ham te, Japheth te ahi uh: Ham Kanaan pa ahi.

ENGLISH: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these, the whole earth was populated.

ENGLISH: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

PAITE: Uain a dawna, a khama; huchiin a puanin ah a lum khialta hi.
ENGLISH: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

PAITE: Huan, Ham Kanaan pain, a pa lumkhial a mua, inpuaa a naute nih a hilha.
ENGLISH: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

ENGLISH: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

PAITE: Huan, Kanaan hamsiatin omhen; a unaute sikhate sihka ahi ding, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be servant of servants to his brothers.”

PAITE: Toupa, Sem Pathian phatin omhen; Kanaan a sikha in om hen.
ENGLISH: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

PAITE: Pathianin Japheth hihlian henla, huan, Kanaan a sikhain om hen, achi lai hi.
ENGLISH: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

PAITE: Huan, Noa tuichim tun nungin kum za thum leh kum sawm nga a dam.Huchiin, Noa damsung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm nga ahi. Huan a sita hi.
ENGLISH: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a sam a, kihoupihna puan inn a kipan in a houpih a,

PAITE: A thillat pen bawng hon lak ate, haltum thillat a hih leh a pa, gensiatbei a lat ding ahi: amah TOUPA ma a pom a hih theihna ding in kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul a lat ding ahi

PAITE: Huan, Aron tapa, Nadab leh Abihute'n a mei lakna uh a la tuaktuak ua, huai ah mei-am a koih ua, gimlim a buak ua, a thupiak louh pi in TOUPA ma ah mei zat louhchi a lan uh.

PAITE: Huan, kihoupihna puan in kongpi a kipan na pawt ding uh ahi kei, huchilou in zaw na si ding: TOUPA sathau, nilhchi na tunguah a om ngal a, a chi a. Huchi in Mosi thu bang in a hih uhi.
ENGLISH: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of Yahweh is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Aron a houpih a,

ENGLISH: “Drink no wine nor strong drink, you, nor your sons with you, when you go into the Tent of Meeting, that you don’t die: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations:

PAITE: Huaibel a siangthou leh a siangthoulou leh a siang leh a sianglou na khen theihna ding uh leh.

PAITE: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a a kiang ua a gen, thupiak tengteng Israel suante na sinsak theihna ding uh ahi ding, chi in.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Aron kiang ah leh a tapa damlai Eleazar leh Ithamarte kiang ah, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a, tangbuang thillat lak bangte la unla, maitam bul ah silngou tellou in ne un: thil siangthou ahi ngal a:

PAITE: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a nang a tuam leh na tapate a tuam a chih ziak in mun siangthou ah na ne ding uh ahi: huchi bang a thupiak a om ka hi.
ENGLISH: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire: for so I am commanded.

PAITE: Huan, a awm vei leh a liang taklam vei pen mun siang ah na ne ding uh; nang leh na tapate leh na tanute toh: Israel suante lemna thillat kithoihna nang a tuam leh na tapate ding a seh ahi ngal a;

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in khelh thoihna kel pen ngentel tak in a zong a, huan, ngaidih, a na halkhin tham uh ahi a: huchi in, Aron tapa damlai, Eleazar leh Ithamar tungah a heh a,

ENGLISH: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, this day they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before Yahweh; and such things as these have happened to me: and if I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the sight of Yahweh?”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in huai a zak in a lungkim ta hi.
ENGLISH: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih unla, Leitung a gamsa tengteng lak a na nek ding uh thilhingte hiai ahi.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.

PAITE: Gamsa lak a chin ka, chin ka paisuak, eknel hai chi peuhmah na ne thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.

PAITE: Himahleh eknel hai hiam, chin ka paisuak hiam lak ate hichibangte zaw na nek ding uh ahi kei; sangawngsau, eknel hai leleng, a chin a kak louh ziak in; nou ding in a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because he chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, he is unclean to you.

PAITE: Huan, zupi, eknel a hai na a, a hihhang in a chin a kat louh ziak in; nou ding in a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: The coney, because he chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, he is unclean to you.

PAITE: Huan, zusapi, eknel a hai na a, a hihhang in a chin a kat louh ziak in, nou ding in a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: The hare, because she chews the cud but doesn’t part the hoof, she is unclean to you.

PAITE: Huan, vok, a chin a ka a, a ka paisuak na a, a hihhang in eknel a hai louh ziak in; nou ding in a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: The pig, because he has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, he is unclean to you.

PAITE: Tui a khate leh lipte neilou photphot zaw nou ding in thil kihhuai ahi.

ENGLISH: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have legs above their feet, with which to hop on the earth.

PAITE: Innhik, tangteuh, thankik dokdawn leh zusa.

PAITE: Huan, a sih ua bangpeuh a delhkhum uh, a nin zel ding; vanzat photphot sing a bawl tui-um-belsuan hiam, puan hiam, savun hiam, sai-ip hiam leng hi hen aw, tui a diah ding ahi, huan, nitak lam tan in a nin ding; huai khit chiang in a siangthou ta ding hi.
