PAITE: Leibel, a bang mahmah a kiakna peuhpeuh na hihtam zel ding uh ahi, a sung a om tengteng a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: Every earthen vessel, into which any of them falls, all that is in it shall be unclean, and you shall break it.

PAITE: Huai bel a nek chi om tengteng leng huai a om tui a diahsa himhim, thil nin ahi ding; huan, dawn chi, dawn theih chi tengteng leng, huai bel a himhim zaw thil nin ahi ding.
ENGLISH: All food which may be eaten, that on which water comes, shall be unclean; and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

PAITE: Huan, thil bangpeuh a luang up a banglai peuh in a delhkhum sa photphot thil nin ahi zel ding; tanghou kanna hiam, kan lumna bel hiam leng hihtap vek ding ahi, a nin khin a, nou a ding in thil nin ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces: they are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

PAITE: Himahleh tuikhuk hiam, tuibem, tui chin khawm hiam a nin kei ding a, a luang uh sikkhak peuhmah a nin ding.
ENGLISH: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is a gathered shall be clean: but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.

PAITE: Huan, haichi, chin ding himhim zaw a luang uh a banglai peuh in na delhkhum ta leh, a nin kei.
ENGLISH: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.

PAITE: Himahleh haichi, tui a diahsa a luang un a koilai peuh in delh leh, nou ding in thil nin ahi.
ENGLISH: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

PAITE: Gamsa na nek theih chi himhim u leng si leh, a luang khoih mi peuhmah nitak lam tan in a nin ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If any animal, of which you may eat, dies; he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: A sa ne peuhmah in a puante uh sawp ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding: huan, a luang lami in leng a puante a sawp ding ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding.
ENGLISH: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, ganhing leitung a a bok a vak chi tengteng thil kihhuai ahi ua, nek ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

PAITE: A tholh a kitholh chi leh khe li a pai chi hiam, khe tampi nei chi hiam, leitung a bok a vak chi himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei, thil kihhuai ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

PAITE: A bok a vak chi himhim in na kihihthanghuai ding uh ahi kei, na kihihbuah louhna ding un, huaite in na kihihnin ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps, neither shall you make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled thereby.

PAITE: Kei zaw TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a; huaiziak in kisiangthou sak unla, siangthou in om un; kei lah ka siangthou ngal a, leitung a teng, a bok a vak, a bang chi mah in kihihbuah kei un.
ENGLISH: For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy: neither shall you defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

PAITE: N Pathian uh hi ding a Aigupta gam a kipan a nou hon pikhia TOUPA lah ka hi ngal a: kei ka siangthou ngal a, huaiziak in nou leng na siangthou ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

PAITE: Hiai pen gamsa leh vasate leh tui a teng chi thil hing chiteng leh lei a a bok a vak chi chitengte tungthu a dan ding ahi.Siangthou leh siangthoulou khenna ding leh, gamsa nek theih chi leh gamsa nek theihlouh chi khenna ding in, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

PAITE: Siangthou leh siangthoulou khenna ding leh, gamsa nek theih chi leh gamsa nek theihlouh chi khenna ding in, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel’ suante kiang ah, Numei in nau a pai a tapa a neih leh nisagih a nin ding a; numei dan ngeina hun lai a a nit bang in a nin ding hi.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.

PAITE: Huan, a ni giat ni in a zek mong vun sum ding ahi.
ENGLISH: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

PAITE: Sisan ziak a kisiangsak in ni sawmthum leh ni thum a om naklai ding ahi; a kisiansak ni a kim mateng thil siangthou himhim a khoih ding ahi kei hi, mun siangthou a leng a lut ding ahi sam kei.
ENGLISH: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

PAITE: Nau numei a neih lebel numei dan ngeina hun lai a a nit bang in nipikal nih a nin ding; huan, sisan ziak a kisiangsak in ni sawmguk leh ni guk a om lai ding ahi.
ENGLISH: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

PAITE: Huan, tapa hiam, tanu hiam ziak a kisiansak ni a kim tak in haltum thillat ding in belamnou kum khat a upa leh khelh thoihna ding in vapal nou hiam, vakhu hiam kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah siampu kiang ah a hon tawi ding ahi:
ENGLISH: “‘When the days of her purification are completed, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering:

PAITE: Huan, aman TOUPA ma ah a lan ding a, kilepna a bawlsak ding a, huchi a sisan pawtna a kipan siangthou ahi ding. Hiai pen pasal hiam, numei hiam neinu a dia dan ahi.Huan, a neih in belamnou a chin kei leh vakhu kop khat hiam, vapal nou kopkhat hiam a tawi ding ahi: khat pen haltum thillat ding in, khat pen khelh thoihna ding in: huan, siampu in kilepna a bawlsak ding a, huchi in a siangthou ta ding, chi in gen in, chi in.
ENGLISH: and he shall offer it before Yahweh, and make atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.

PAITE: Huan, a neih in belamnou a chin kei leh vakhu kop khat hiam, vapal nou kopkhat hiam a tawi ding ahi: khat pen haltum thillat ding in, khat pen khelh thoihna ding in: huan, siampu in kilepna a bawlsak ding a, huchi in a siangthou ta ding, chi in gen in, chi in.
ENGLISH: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons; the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Mi a sa vun a vun hiam, a khem hiam, a bol hiam, a vun a phak hileh kilawm a kimuh leh siampu Aron kiang ah hiam, a tapa, siampute lak a kuapen hiam kiang a pi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “When a man shall have a rising in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest, or to one of his sons, the priests:

PAITE: Huan, siampu in sa vun a hii pen a na en ding a, huan, a hii omna lai a mul a kaan a, a hii pen a sa vun sang a thuk a a kimuh leh phak hii ahi hi: huan, siampu in amah a na en ding a, mi nin a hih a phuang ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body: and if the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; and the priest shall examine him, and pronounce him unclean.

PAITE: A sa vun a bolte a kan a vun sang a thuk a a kimuh kei leh, a mul a kaan kei leh hii nei mi pen siampu in ni sagih a khumtuam ding a,
ENGLISH: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in ni sagih ni in amah a en ding a: huan, ngaidih, a hii pen a ngeingei a a muh a, a hii pen vun a a zamzak kei leh siampu in ni sagih mah a khumtuam nawn ding a:
ENGLISH: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day, and, behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested, and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in ni sagih ni in a en nawn ding a: huan, ngaidih, hii pen a mial a, hii pen a vun a a zamzak kei leh siampu in a siangthou chih a phuang ding ahi: a khem lel ahi: a puante a sawp ding a, a siangthou ding.
ENGLISH: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day; and behold, if the plague has faded, and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

PAITE: Himahleh a siansak na ding a siampu a ki-etsak nung a a khem pen a vun a a zamzak mahmah leh siampu a ki-ensak nawn ding ahi:
ENGLISH: But if the scab spreads on the skin, after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a na en ding a, huan, ngai in, a khem pen a vun a a zamzak leh siampu in a nin chih a phuang ding: phak ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.

PAITE: Mi'n phak hii a vom leh siampu kiang a pi ding ahi;
ENGLISH: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a na en ding a, huan, ngaidih, vun a a kang a om khiak a, a mul a kaansak a, a bawk dulh hethut a hih leh,
ENGLISH: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white rising in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the rising,

PAITE: A sa a phak kumlui om ahi a, siampu in a nin chih a phuang ding a, khumtuam ding ahi kei a, nin ahi ngal a.
ENGLISH: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is unclean.

PAITE: Huan, a phak pen vun a a zamzak mahmah a, a hii veimi a vun, a lu a kipan a a khe lek tan a siampu theihtheih chiang phak in a bop leh, sampu in a en ding a;
ENGLISH: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest;

PAITE: Huan, ngaidih, phak in a sa tengteng a bop suak sa a hihleh, hii veimi a siang chih a phuang ding ahi: a kaang khinta a, a siangthou ta ahi.
ENGLISH: then the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

PAITE: Himahleh a sa a dulh hethut leh, a nin ding a.
ENGLISH: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

PAITE: Siampu in sa dulh hethut a en ding a, a nin chih a phuang ding ahi: sa dulh hethut pen a nin ahi; phak ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

PAITE: Hiamahleh sa dulh hethut pen a na lamdan nawn a, a na kaan nawn leh siampu kiang ah a hoh ding a,
ENGLISH: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest;

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a na en ding; huan, ngaidih, a hii a kan leh siampu in hii veimi a niin kei chih a puang ding ahi: a siangthou ta ahi.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.

PAITE: Huan, sa vun a meimatum om, a dam a,
ENGLISH: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,

PAITE: A meimatum a mun a na kan san hiam, kang san deuh a na bol hiam a hihleh, siampu in a et ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and in the place of the boil there is a white rising, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest;

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a na en ding a, huan, ngaidih, vun sang a thuk a kimuh a, a mul a kaan leh siampu in a nin chih a phuang ding ahi: phak hii ahi a, meimatum in hong suakkhia ahi.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall examine it; and behold, if its appearance is lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

PAITE: Himahleh siampu in a na et a, huan, ngaidih, mul kang a om louh a, a mial sim phet a hihleh, siampu in ni sagih a khumtuam ding a:
ENGLISH: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

PAITE: Huan, vun a a zamzak leh siampu in a nin chih a phuang ding ahi: hii ahi.
ENGLISH: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.

PAITE: Himahleh a bol ngou pen a omna ngei a a om a, a zamzak kei leh meimatum pawn lel ahi a; siampu in a siangthou chih a phuang ding ahi.
ENGLISH: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

PAITE: Huan, vun a sa mei in kang leh, mei a a kat a sa hong pol leh, ngou-san sim hiam, ngou hiam in;
ENGLISH: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,

PAITE: Siampu in a na en ding a, ngaidih, a polna lai tak a mul pen a kaan a, huchia vun sang a thuk a a kimuh leh phak ahi a, meikat a hong omkhia ahi: huchi in siampu in a nin chih a phuang ding ahi, phak hii ahi.
ENGLISH: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin; it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

PAITE: Himahleh siampu in a na et a, huan ngaidih, pol a mul kang a om kei a, vun sang a thuklou a, mial deuh lel a hihleh, siampu in ni sagih a khumtuam ding a;
ENGLISH: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t lower than the skin, but is faded; then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in ni sagih ni in amah a en ding a, vun a a zamzak mahmah leh siampu in a nin chih a phuang ding ahi, phak hii ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

PAITE: Huan, a pol pen a omna ngei a a om thek a, vun a a zam zak kei leh, a mial deuh lel a hihleh meikat bawk lel ahi a, siampu in a siangthou chih a phuang ding ahi: meikang pawn ahi lel hi.
ENGLISH: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is the scar from the burn.

PAITE: Huan, numei hiam, pasal hiam in a lu ah hiam, a khamul lak ah hiam hii a vei leh,
ENGLISH: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

PAITE: Siampu in hii pen a na en ding a; huan, ngaidih, vun sang a thuk a a kimuh a, mul eng ngat tak a om leh siampu in a nin chih a phuang ding ahi; meimasungtum ahi a, lu hiam khamul hiam phak ahi hi.
ENGLISH: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is an itch, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in meimasungtum hii pen a et a, huan, ngaidih, vun sang a thuklou a a kimuh a, a mul vom a om keileh siampu in meimasungtum hii veimi pen ni sagih a khum tuam ding a;
ENGLISH: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate him the person infected with itching seven days.

PAITE: Huan, ni sagih ni in siampu in hii a en ding a, huan, ngaidih, meimasungtum a zamzak louh a, mul eng a om kei leh, meimasungtum vun sang a a thuk a a kimuh keileh,
ENGLISH: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,

PAITE: Met ding ahi a, meimasungtum laitak bel a met ding ahi kei; huan, siampu in meimasungtum neimi ni sagih dang a khum tuam nawn ding a;
ENGLISH: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch; and the priest shall shut him up who has the itch seven more days.

PAITE: Huan, ni sagih ni in siampu in meimasungtum a en nawn ding a: huan, ngaidih, meimasungtum pen vun a a zak louh a, vun sang a thuk a a kimuh leh, siampu in a siangthou chih a phuang ding ahi; huan, a puante a sawp ding a, a siangthou ta ding hi.
ENGLISH: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

PAITE: Himahleh meimasungtum pen a kisansak nung a a vun a a zamzak mahmah leh,
ENGLISH: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

PAITE: Siampu in amah a na en ding a, huan, ngaidih, meimasungtum pen vun a a zamzak leh, siampu a ding in mul eng zon a kipahmoh chitchiat kei ding; a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

PAITE: Himahleh meimasungtum pen a ngeingei a a muh a, mul vom a pou leh, meimasungtum a dam ahi a, a siangthou ahi; siampu in a siangthou chih a phuang ding ahi.
ENGLISH: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested, and black hair has grown in it; the itch is healed, he is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

PAITE: Huan, numei hiam, pasal hiam, a sa vun uah pol, pol ngou kilhkelh na om leh siampu in a en ding a;
ENGLISH: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots;

PAITE: Huan, ngaidih, a sa vun ua pol pen mialngou sim lel a hihleh pol lel ahi a, vun a hong suak ahi, a siangthou hi.
ENGLISH: then the priest shall examine them; and behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash, it has broken out in the skin; he is clean.

PAITE: Mi a sam a pulh siang leh, lugiau ahi; himahleh a siangthou ahi.
ENGLISH: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

PAITE: A sip sam a pulh siang leh talngalh ahi; himahleh a siangthou ahi.
ENGLISH: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, he is forehead bald. He is clean.

PAITE: Himahleh lugiau hiam ah, talngalh hiam ah, hii san sim a ngou a om leh, a lugiau hiam, a talngalh hiam a hong om phak ahi hi.
ENGLISH: But if there is in the bald head, or the bald forehead, a reddish-white plague; it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

PAITE: Huchi in siampu in a na en ding a, huan, ngaidih, a lugiau hiam, a talngalh hiam a hii hong bawkkhia pen a ngou-san hehut a, sa vun a phak bang a a kimuh leh,
ENGLISH: Then the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the rising of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh,

PAITE: Mi phak ahi a, a nin ahi; Siampu in a sian louhna a phuan ngeingei ding ahi, a phakna a lu ah ahi.
ENGLISH: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.

PAITE: Phak, hii vei zaw a puante bohkek ahi ding a, a samte a khah ding a, a muk tung lam a tuam ding a, Sianglou, sianglou, chi in a kikou ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

PAITE: Phak in a bop sung teng a nin ahi ding a; a nin ahi a, a om tuam ding ahi; a omna ding dainawl ahi.
ENGLISH: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. Outside of the camp shall be his dwelling.

PAITE: Puansilh leng, samul puan hiam khau zang ngat puan hiam leng; gat hiam, phan hiam leng; khau zang ngat hiam, samul hiam leng, savun hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam leng;
ENGLISH: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;

PAITE: Savun hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam phak hii a om a, huai hii puansilh hiam, savun ah hiam,
ENGLISH: whether it is in warp, or woof; of linen, or of wool; whether in a skin, or in anything made of skin;

PAITE: Gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam a hing sim hiam a a dawkkhiak leh, phak hii ahi a, siampu et ding ahi.
ENGLISH: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of skin; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in hii a na en ding a, hii omna ni sagih a khumtuam ding a;
ENGLISH: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

PAITE: Huan, ni sagih ni in hii a en ding a, hii pen puansilh, gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, savun, bang ding peuh a leng a zat uh savunte ah hiam, a zam leh hii pen phak kip mahmah chi ahi a, a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

PAITE: Puansilh, gat hiam, phan hiam, samul hiam, khau zang ngat ham, savun a bawl chi himhim hiam, phak omna peuhmah a hal ding ahi; phak kip mahmah chi ahi ngal a, hal ngei ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of skin, in which the plague is: for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a na et a, huchia, ngai dih, puansilh, gat hiam, phan hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim ah leng hii pen a zam kei leh
ENGLISH: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

PAITE: Hii omna siampu in sawp thu a pe ding a, ni sagih dang a khum tuam nawn ding:
ENGLISH: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing in which the plague is, and he shall isolate it seven more days.

PAITE: Huan, hii omna sawpkhit nung in siampu in a en nawn ding a, huan, ngai dih, hii lat dan a kidan keileh, hii pen zam kei mahleh, a siangthou tuan kei, mei a na hal ding ahi: a kip chi ahi; a sung lam hiam, a po lam hiam a giau zong hi heh.
ENGLISH: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a na et a, huchia, ngai dih, sawp khit nung a mial sim lel a hih leh puansilh a kipan hiam, savun a kipan hiam, gat a kipan hiam, phan a kipan hiam a botkhe ding a:
ENGLISH: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

PAITE: Huan, puansilh pen, gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, savun bawl ahte hiam a lat lailai leh, a hong pawt nawn ahi; hii omna pen na hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn with fire that in which the plague is.

PAITE: Huan, puansilh, gat hiam, phan hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl chi himhim hiam na sawp a, hii in a nutsiat leh sawp nawn ding ahi a, huchi in a hong siangthou ta ding hi.Hiai bel, puansilh, samul hiam, khau zang ngat hiam, gat hiam, phan hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim hiam a phak hii om a siangthou leh a siangthoulou phuanna dan ding ahi hi, chi in.
ENGLISH: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

PAITE: Hiai bel, puansilh, samul hiam, khau zang ngat hiam, gat hiam, phan hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim hiam a phak hii om a siangthou leh a siangthoulou phuanna dan ding ahi hi, chi in.
ENGLISH: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Hiai phak siansak ni a hihdan ding ahi ding: siampu kiang a pi ding ahi:
ENGLISH: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing. He shall be brought to the priest,

PAITE: Huan, siampu dainawl ah a paikhe ding a; huan, siampu in a en ding a, huan, ngai dih, phak pen a phakna hii a dam leh
ENGLISH: and the priest shall go forth out of the camp. The priest shall examine him, and behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

PAITE: Siampu in a kisian sak ding mi tuh vasa hing siangthou nih leh sidar sing leh khauzang san leh husop tawisak ding in thu a pe ding:
ENGLISH: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in vasa khat pen leibel ah lui tui tungah goh ding in thu a pe ding a:
ENGLISH: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

PAITE: Vasa hing pen, sidar singte, khauzang sante, husopte, vasa hing toh a tawi ding a, luitui tung a vasa gohsa sisan ah a diah vek ding a:
ENGLISH: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

PAITE: Huan, phakna lak a kisiangsak ding mi sagih vei a theh ding a, a siangthou chih a phuang ding, huan, vasa hing pen gamlak ah a khah ding hi.
ENGLISH: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

PAITE: Huan, a kisiangsak ding mi in a puante a sawp ding a, a kimet mai vek ding a, a kisil ding ahi; huchi in a hong siangthou ding: huan, huai khit chiang in giah phual ah a hoh ding a, himahleh a puan inn po lam ah ni sagih a om ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi ding a, a ni sagih ni in a lu sam tengteng leh a khamul leh a mit khu multe a met mai ding a, a mul tengteng a met mai ding: huan, a puante a sawp ding a, a kisil ding ahi: huchi in a hong siangthou ta ding.
ENGLISH: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water, then he shall be clean.

PAITE: Huan, ni giat ni in belamnou a pa nih gensiatbei leh belamnou a nu khat gensiatbei, kum khat a upa leh tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nel mahmah epha mun sawm a khen mun thum sathau a mek leh sathau log khat a tawi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb a year old without blemish, and three tenths of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

PAITE: Huan, a siang sakpa siampu in kisiang sak ding mi leh huai thil kihoupihna kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah a koih ding:
ENGLISH: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in belamnou pa khat pen sathau log khat toh a la ding a, tatlek thoihna ding in a lan ding a, TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding in a vei ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, khelh thoihna leh haltum thillat a goh zelna mun uh, mun siangthou ah belamnou pa pen a gou ding ahi: khelh thoihna siampu a tuam ahi bangmah in tatlek thoihna leng siampu a tuam ahi ngal a: thil siangthou mahmah ahi hi:
ENGLISH: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in tatlek thoihna sisan a la ding a, kisiang sak ding mi bil tak lam mongte, a khut tak lam khutpite, a tak lam khepite siampu in a nuh ding a;
ENGLISH: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

PAITE: Huan, sathau log khat a tuh siampu in a la ding a, amah khutpek vei lam ah a sung ding a;
ENGLISH: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

PAITE: Siampu in a khut vei lam a sathau ah a khut tak lam zung a diah ding a, sathau in TOUPA ma ah a khut zung in sagih vei a theh ding
ENGLISH: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, a khut a sathau om laitengteng in kisiang sak ding mi bil tak lam dawn bang, a khut tak lam khutpi bang, a khe tak lam khepi bang ah tatlekna kithoihna sisan tungah a nuh ding ahi:
ENGLISH: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a khut a om laitengteng in kisiang sak ding mi lu a nuh ding a; huan, siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilepna a bawl sak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in khelh thoihna a lan ding a, a siangthou louhna ziak a kisiang sak ding mi pen kilepna a bawl sak ding a; huan, huai khit in haltum thillat a gou ding;
ENGLISH: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness: and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

PAITE: Huan, siampu in haltum thillat leh tangbuang thillat maitam ah a lan ding a, siampu in kilepna a bawl sak ding hi.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

PAITE: Huan, mi genthei a hih a, huchi bang a chitkei leh, belamnou pa khat tatlek thoihna, kilepna bawl sakna ding a vei ding leh tangbuang thillat ding a tangbuang nel mahmah epha mun sawm a khen mun khat, sathau a zut, sathau log khat toh a tawi dia;
ENGLISH: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

PAITE: Huan, vakhu kop khat hiam, vapal nou kop khat hiam, a neih zoh zaw lamlam; khat pen khelh thoihna, khat pen haltum thillat ding ahi ding.
ENGLISH: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

PAITE: Ni giat ni in a kisian sakna ding in siampu kiang ah kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah a hon tawi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huchi in siampu tatlek thoihna belamnou leh sathau log khat a la ding a, huan, vei thillat ding in TOUPA ma ah siampu in a vei ding ahi;
ENGLISH: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, tatlek thoihna belamnou pen a gou ding a; siampu in tatlek thoihna sisan a la ding a, kisiang sak ding mi bil tak lam dawn bang, a khut tak lam khutpi bang, a khe tak lam khepi bang a nuh ding hi:
ENGLISH: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in sathau amah khutpek vei lam ah a sung ding a;
ENGLISH: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a khut vei lam a sathau khenkhat a khut tak lam in TOUPA ma ah sagih vei a theh ding;
ENGLISH: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a khut a sathau in kisiang sak ding mi bil tak lam dawn bang, a khut tak lam khutpi bang, a khe tak lam khepi bang ah tatlek kithoihna sisan tung tak ah a nuh ding hi:
ENGLISH: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

PAITE: Huan, siampu khut a sathau om laiteng in TOUPA ma a kilepna bawl sak ding in kisiang sak ding mi lu a nuh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, vakhu hiam, vapal nou hiam, a neih zoh lamlam khat a lan ding a;
ENGLISH: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he is able to afford,

PAITE: A neih zoh lamlam, khelh thoihna ding in khat, haltum thillat ding in khat, tangbuang thillat toh: huan, siampu in kisiang sak ding mi pen TOUPA ma ah kilemna a bawl sak ding hi.
ENGLISH: even such as he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before Yahweh.”

PAITE: Hiai bel phak hii vei, kisian sakna dan bang a chinloute a dia dan ahi, chi in.
ENGLISH: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Luah ding a ka hon piak Kanan gam na lut chiang un, na luah ding uh gam koi inn pen ah leng phak hii ka koih leh,
ENGLISH: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

PAITE: Huai in neitu in, Hiai inn ah hii hileh kilawm tak om leh kilawm ka sa, chi in siampu a hong hilh ding ahi:
ENGLISH: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

PAITE: Huan, siampu hii en ding a a lut ma in inn sung a thil om tengteng a buah a suah louhna ding in inn pen a hihvuak ding in siampu in thu a pe ding a; huai khit in siampu in a en ding in a lut ding hi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

PAITE: Huan, hii a en ding a, huan, ngai dih, hii in a hing lam sim hiam a san lam sim hiam a baang a nekkuak a, baang sang a kiam a a kimuh leh,
ENGLISH: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall;

PAITE: Siampu pen inn a kipan kongpi ah a pawt ding a, ni sagih in a khak ding:
ENGLISH: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

PAITE: Huan, ni sagih ni in siampu in a va en nawn ding a, huan, ngai dih, hii baang a a na zamzak leh hi omna suang tak lakkhiak a,
ENGLISH: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

PAITE: Dainawl a nin paihna mun a paih ding in siampu in thu a pe ding:
ENGLISH: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city:

PAITE: huan, inn sung lam a kiat kimvel sak ding a, huan, suang zutbitna a kiatkhiak uh pen dainawl mun nin ah a sung ding uhi:
ENGLISH: and he shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over, and they shall pour out the mortar, that they scraped off, outside of the city into an unclean place.

PAITE: Huan, suang dang a la ding ua, huai suangte mun ah a koih ding ua; huan, suang zutbitna dang a la ding a, inn a hu ding hi.
ENGLISH: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

PAITE: Huan, suang a lakkhiak a inn a kiat a a huk khit nung a hii inn a a hong dawk nawn leh, siampu a va lut ding a, va en nawn ding hi;
ENGLISH: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house, after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered;

PAITE: Huan, ngai dih, hii inn a a na zamzak leh huai inn a phak a kip chi ahi a, a nin ahi
ENGLISH: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

PAITE: Huai inn a phel dia, a suang khawng, a sing khawng, a suang zutbitna tengteng leng; huan, dainawl ah mun nin ah a nawnkhiak vek ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

PAITE: Kuapeuh huai inn khak sung himhim a lut taphot nitak lam tan in a nin lai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, kuapeuh huai inn a lum taphot in a puante uh a sawp ding uh. Huan, kuapeuh huai inn a ann ne taphot in a puante uh a sawp ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

PAITE: Huan, siampu a lut a, a et kimvel a, huan, ngai dih, huai in huk hoih a hih nung a hii a zamzak keileh, inn a siangthou chih siampu in a phuang ding, hii a kikhinmang tak ziak in.
ENGLISH: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

PAITE: Huan, inn sian sak na ding in vasa nih leh sidar sing leh khau zang san leh husop a tawi ding a;
ENGLISH: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.

PAITE: Huan, vasa khat pen lei bel ah lui tui tungah a gou ding a;
ENGLISH: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

PAITE: Huan, Sidar sing leh husop leh khau san leh vasa hing pen a la ding a, vasa gohsa sisan ah leh lui tui ah a diah ding hi.
ENGLISH: He shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

PAITE: Huan, inn sagih vei a theh ding: huan, inn, vasa sisan bang, khau san bang in a siang sak ding:
ENGLISH: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

PAITE: Vasa hing pen bel khua a kipan in gamlak ah a lengkhe sak ding ahi: huchi in a hong siangthou ta ding hi.
ENGLISH: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

PAITE: Hiai pen phak hii chichih leh meimasungtum tungthu a dan ahi;
ENGLISH: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

PAITE: Puan a phak om leh inn ate a dia van,
ENGLISH: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

PAITE: Bawk bang, khem bang, pol bang a dia van,A sianthou louhna mun leh a sianthouna mun kawkmuh na ding in hiai phak tungthu a dan ahi, chi in.
ENGLISH: and for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

PAITE: A sianthou louhna mun leh a sianthouna mun kawkmuh na ding in hiai phak tungthu a dan ahi, chi in.
ENGLISH: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih unla, a kiang uah, Mi kua leng sa a thil a pawt leh a thil pawt ziak in a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

PAITE: A thil pawt sung teng a nin ahi: a sa ah a pawt gige hiam, pawt tawpta hiam zong hileh, a nin himhim ahi.
ENGLISH: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

PAITE: Thil pawt mi lupna a lupna peuhmah a nin ding; huan, a tutna peuhmah leng a nin lai ding a.
ENGLISH: “‘Every bed whereon he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

PAITE: Huan, kuapeuh a lupna khoih peuhmahte'n a puante uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Thil pawt mi tutna a tu peuhmahte'n a puante uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: He who sits on anything whereon the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Kuapeuh thil pawt mi sa khoih peuhmah in a puante uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, thil pawt mi in mi ninlou chil a siat leh a puante a sawp ding a, a ksil ding ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Tuan na bangpeuh a leng thil pawtmi a tuan leh a nin ding.
ENGLISH: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

PAITE: Kuapeuh a kingaihna sa nung thil khoih peuhmahte nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh; huan, huai thil la suan mi peuhmah in a puante uh a sawp ding uh, a kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, kuapeuh thil pawt mi in a khut sillou a a khoih peuhmah in a puante uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: “‘Whoever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, thil pawt mi leibel khoihsa zaw suktap ding ahi; huan, sing vanzat tengteng silsiang vek ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

PAITE: Huan, thil pawt mi bel, a thil pawt hih siangthou a hih leh, a kisian sakna ding in ni sagih a kipe ding a, a puante a sawp ding a; huan, luitui ah a kisil ding a; huchi in a hong siangthou ta ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

PAITE: Huan, a ni giat ni in vakhu kop khat hiam, palva noukop khat hiam tawi in TOUPA ma ah kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah a hoh ding a, siampu a pe ding ahi:
ENGLISH: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest:

PAITE: Huan, siampu in khelh thoihna ding in khat, haltum thillat ding in khat a len ding hi; huan, siampu in a thil pawt thu ah TOUPA ma ah kilepna a bawl sak ding.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.

PAITE: Kuapeuh kithuahna chi amah a kipan a pawt leh a pumpi in a kisil vek dia, nitak lam tan in a nin ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, puansilh khawng, vun khawng kithuahna chi omna peuhmah sawp siang a silsiang vek ding ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding
ENGLISH: Every garment, and every skin, whereon the semen is, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, numei a luppih leleng a nih ua a kisil tuaktuak ding uh ahi, huan, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Numei in thil pawt a neih a, a sa a thil pawt bel si a hihleh ni sagih sung a nin ding; huan, kuapeuh amah khoih taphot nitak lam tan in a nin ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, a nit sung a lupna peuhmah a nin ding a, a tutna peuhmah leng a nin lai ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

PAITE: Lupna khoih peuhte'n a puante uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Kuapuah a tutna khoih peuhmahte'n a puante uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Lupna a thil om hiam, a tutna a thil om hiam khoih peuhmahte nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: If it is on the bed, or on anything whereon she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Kuapeuh in a luppih ua, a nitna a ban uleh ni sagih a nin ding ua; a lupna peuh uh lupna a nin ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lies shall be unclean.

PAITE: Huan, numei a nit hun ngeina hilou a ni sawtkuam tak a si a pawt hiam, a nitdan ngeina sang a sawt a si a pawt hiam a hihleh, a nitna dan ngeina sung a a om zel bang in si pawtmi a nit sung teng in a om tei ding hi; a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period; all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period: she is unclean.

PAITE: A si pawt sung teng a lupna a lupna taphot a nitdan ngeina hun lai a a lupna bang ahi ding a; a tutna peuhmah a nitdan ngeina hun lai a a nit bang in a nin ding.
ENGLISH: Every bed whereon she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period: and everything whereon she sits shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

PAITE: Kuapeuh huai thil khoih peuhmahte a nin ding ua, a puante uh a sawp ding ua, kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding uh.
ENGLISH: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Himahleh a si pawt pen hih siangthou a hihleh, ni sagih a kipe ding a, huai nung in a hong siangthou ta ding.
ENGLISH: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

PAITE: Huan, a ni giat ni in vakhu kop khat hiam, vapal nou kop khat hiam a tawi ding a, kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah siampu a hong pe ding ahi.
ENGLISH: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in khelh thoihna ding in khat, haltum thillat ding in khat a lan ding ahi; huchi in siampu in si pawt mi a nitna thu ah TOUPA ma ah kilepna a bawl sak ding ahi
ENGLISH: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.

PAITE: Hichi bang in Israel suante a nitna ua kipan na hih tuam ding uh ahi, a lak ua ka biakbuk a hih buah khak chiang ua leng a nitna ziak ua a sih louhna ding un.
ENGLISH: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in their midst.’”

PAITE: Hiai bel thil pawt mite leh nit loh a kithuahna chi pawt mite a dia dan ahi;A nitna ziak a china nu bang, thil pawt nei mipa bang, numei-pasal, numei a nit lai ua luppihte a ding leng, chi in.
ENGLISH: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean thereby;

PAITE: A nitna ziak a china nu bang, thil pawt nei mipa bang, numei-pasal, numei a nit lai ua luppihte a ding leng, chi in.
ENGLISH: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

PAITE: Huan, Aron tapa nihte'n TOUPA a va naih ua a sihloh nung un TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a;
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before Yahweh, and died;

PAITE: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Na unau Aron houpih inla, puanzak sung mun siangthou ah, bawm tung a chitna tutphah ma ah chiklai in leng hon lut hetkei heh, a si kha ding hi; chitna tutphah tungah, mei in ka hong kihil sin ahi.
ENGLISH: and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother, not to come at all times into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die: for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

PAITE: Hichi bang in Aron pen mun siangthou ah a hoh ding ahi: khelh thoihna ding in bawng tuai, haltum thillat ding in belampa toh.
ENGLISH: “Herewith shall Aaron come into the sanctuary: with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

PAITE: Puan malngat puannak siangthou a silh ding a, a sa khuhna ding in puan malngat pheitawm a bun ding, puan malngat dial a khim ding ahi: hiaite puansilh siangthou ahi a; a kisil masa dia, a silh phet ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante mipi houna kelpa nih khelh thoihna ding in leh haltum thillat ding in belampa khat a tawi ding.
ENGLISH: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

PAITE: Huan, Aron in amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngpa pen a lan ding a, amah leh a innkote a ding in kilepna a bawl ding.
ENGLISH: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

PAITE: Kel nih a kai ding a, kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah a koih ding.
ENGLISH: He shall take the two goats, and set them before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, Aron in kel nih tungthu ah ai a san ding a, khat TOUPA a tuam ahi ding a, khat Azazel a tuam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats; one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

PAITE: Huan, Aron in TOUPA a tuam dia puk kel a la ding a, khelh thoihna ding in a lan ding hi.
ENGLISH: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

PAITE: Azazel a tuam dia pukpuk kel bel kilepna bawlna ding a Azazel a ding a khah ding in TOUPA ma ah a hing in a koih ding hi.
ENGLISH: But the goat, on which the lot fell for the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away for the scapegoat into the wilderness.

PAITE: Huan, Aron in ama a tuam khelhna bawngpa pen a la ding a, amah leh a innkote a ding in kilepna a bawl ding a, amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngpa pen a gou ding ahi;
ENGLISH: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA ma a maitam a kipan meilakna mei-am a khat a la ding a, gimlim mahmah gawizan ngingei pham khat toh puanzak sung lam ah a hon lupih ding a;
ENGLISH: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil:

PAITE: Gimlim khu in thu theihpihna tung a chitna tutphah a bopna ding in TOUPA ma a mei ah gimlim a buak ding a, sihna a tuah louhna ding in;
ENGLISH: and he shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the testimony, so that he will not die.

PAITE: Huan, bawngpa sisan bangzah hiam a la ding a, a khut zung in chitna tutphah suah lam pang a theh ding a, a khut in chitna tutphah bul sisan in sagih vei a theh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

PAITE: Huan, mipi a tuam khelh thoihna kel pen a gou ding a, a sisan bawngpa sisan a bawl bang in a bawl ding a, chitna tutphah leh chitna tutphah bul a theh ding hi;
ENGLISH: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

PAITE: Israel suante nitnate ziak leh a nitnate uh, a khelhna tengteng uh ziak in mun siangthou a ding in kilepna a bawl ding: huaimah bang in, a nitnate uh lak a om, kihoupihna puan inn a ding in leng a bawl sam ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and he shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting, that dwells with them in the midst of their uncleanness.

PAITE: Mun siangthou a kilepna bawl ding a a lut lai in, amah leh a innkote leh Israel mipte a ding in kilepna a bawl khit a a hong pawt khiak masiah kuamahmah peuh puan inn sung a a om ding uh ahi kei hi
ENGLISH: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

PAITE: TOUPA ma a maitam lam ah a pawt ding a, huai a ding in kilepna a bawl ding a, bawngpa sisan leh kel sisan bangzah hiam a la ding a, maitam kite ah a kimvel in a tat ding hi.
ENGLISH: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

PAITE: Huan, a khut in sagih vei a theh ding a, a siangsak ding a, Israel suante nitnate lak a kipan a hih siangthou ding.
ENGLISH: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, mun siangthou leh kihoupihna puan inn leh maitam a ding a kilepna a bawl khit in kel hing pen a lan ding:
ENGLISH: “When he has made an end of atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

PAITE: Aron in kel hing lu tungah a khut langnih a koih ding a, a tungah Israel suante ginatlouhna tengteng, a tatlekna tengteng, a khelhna tengteng uh tan in a samkhe ding a; huaite kel lu tungah a nga ding a, mi khat a sehkholhsa un gamdai lam ah a pi mang ding:
ENGLISH: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is in readiness.

PAITE: Huan, kel in a thulimlouhna tengteng uh luahlouh gamah a po ding a, kel bel gamdai ah a khah ding hi.
ENGLISH: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall let the goat go in the wilderness.

PAITE: Huan, Aron kihoupihna puan inn ah a lut ding a, mun siangthou a lut lai a puan malngat puansilh a silh a suah ding a, huailai ah a nuse ding hi;
ENGLISH: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

PAITE: Huan, mun siangthou ah a kisil ding a, a puansilh a silh ding, a hong pawtkhe ding a, amah a tuam haltum thillat leh mipi a tuam haltum thillat a lan ding a, amah leh mipi a ding kilepna a bawl ding.
ENGLISH: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

PAITE: Huan, khelh thoihna thau maitam ah a hal ding.
ENGLISH: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

PAITE: Huan, Azazel a tuam kel khahmi kuapeuh in a puante uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding ua, huai khit chiang in a omna mun lam uah a pai nawn ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: “He who lets the goat go for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

PAITE: Khelh thoihna bawngpa leh khelh thoihna kel sisan kilepna a bawlna ding a mun siangthou a a lutpih uh dai po lam ah a paipih ding ahi; a vun, a sa, a ek a hal ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried forth outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

PAITE: A hal mi in a puan a sawp ding a, a kisil ding a, huai khit in om mun lam ah a pai nawn ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

PAITE: Huan, hiai na khantawn dan ding uh ahi: kha sagihna, huai kha ni sawm ni in na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding ua, na gam ua mi him hiam, gamdang mi na lak ua teng hiam in nnasep bangmah a sep ding uh ahi kei hi:
ENGLISH: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, the native-born, or the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you:

PAITE: Hiai ni in noute hih siangthouna ding in noute ding in kilepna bawl ahi sin hi; huchi in TOUPA ma ah na khelhna tengteng lak ua kipan na siangthou ding uhi.
ENGLISH: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins you shall be clean before Yahweh.

PAITE: Nou ding in khawl kinkenna ni ahi a, na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding uh; khantawn dan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls; it is a statute forever.

PAITE: Huan, siampu, a pa sik a siampu hi ding a sathau nilh ding leh hihtuam mi ding in kilepna a bawl ding a, puan malngat puansilh siangthou a silh ding a; mun siangthou a ding in kilepna a bawl ding; kihoupihna puan inn leh maitam a ding in kilepna a bawl sam ding hi;
ENGLISH: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

PAITE: Huan, siampute leh mipi hon a ding in kilepna bawl nawn lai ding.A khelh tengteng uh ziak a kum chih a khat vei Israel suante a dia kilepna bawl na khantawn dan ding uh ahi, a chi a. Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in a hih hi.
ENGLISH: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

PAITE: A khelh tengteng uh ziak a kum chih a khat vei Israel suante a dia kilepna bawl na khantawn dan ding uh ahi, a chi a. Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in a hih hi.
ENGLISH: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Aron leh a tapate leh Israel suante tengteng houpih inla, a kiang uah, Hiai TOUPA thupiak ahi:
ENGLISH: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded,

PAITE: Israel innko lak a mi himhim bawngpa hiam, belamnou hiam, kel hiam giahmun hiam, dainawl hiam a gou a,
ENGLISH: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel, who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

PAITE: TOUPA biakbuk ma a TOUPA a ding a thillat ding a kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul a hon tawilou peuhmah, huai mi sisan suah a ngaih ahi ding; sisan suah ngei ahi, huai zaw a chipihte lak a kipan tuamkoih a om ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to offer it as an offering to Yahweh before the tabernacle of Yahweh: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people.

PAITE: Huaibel, Israel suante'n a kithoihnate uh, gamlak a kithoihnate uh a honlak ua, TOUPA a ding ngei a kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul a, siampu kiang a ahon lak ua, TOUPA a dia lemna thillat kithoihna ding a kithoihna theihna ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul a maitam sisan in a theh ding a, a thau TOUPA ding in gimlim tak in a hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the altar of Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

PAITE: A angkawm sekna uh kelpa kiang a a kithoih nawn ding uh ahi ta kei, chih pen. Hiai bel a suante uh zel tan a khantawn ding dan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’

PAITE: Huan, a kiang uah, Israel innko mi himhim hiam, gamdang mi a lak ua tengte hiam in haltum thillat hiam, kithoihna hiam,
ENGLISH: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

PAITE: TOUPA kiang a kithoihna ding a kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul a hon tawilou a om uleh huai mi a chipihte lak a kipan tuamkoih a om ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to sacrifice it to Yahweh; that man shall be cut off from his people.

PAITE: Huan, kuapeuh Israel innko lak mi hiam, gamdang mi a lak ua teng hiam, bang sisan leng ne peuhmah, huai sisan ne mi tungah ka mai ka gumsak ding a, a chipihte lak a kipan in tuamkoih in ka omsak ding.
ENGLISH: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

PAITE: Sa hinna pen sisan ah a om ngal a: na hinna ding ua kilemna bawl ding a maitam tung a nou ka hon piak ahi: hinna ding a kilemna bawlna pen sisan mahmah lah ahi ngal a.
ENGLISH: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

PAITE: Huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, Kuamah in sisan na ne ding uh ahikei, gamdang na lak ua teng in leng sisan a ne ding uh ahi samkei, ka chi ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante lak mi hiam, gamdang mi a lak ua teng hiam, gam va vak a sa hiam, vasa hiam a, nektheih chi a hon tut leh a sisan a pawt ding a, leivui a a vuh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten; he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

PAITE: Sa tengteng hinna thu ah a sisan leh a hinna kibang geih ahi; huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, Bang sa sisan mawngmawng na ne ding uh ahi kei, sa tengteng hinna a sisan ahi ngal a; kuapeuh a nene tuamkoih a om ding ahi.
ENGLISH: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life: therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

PAITE: Huan, amah sisih a si hiam, sa keih hiam nene, huai gam a mi him hiam leng hi hen aw, a puan uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding uh ahi, nitak lam tan in a nin ding ua; huaizoh in a hong siangthou ta ding uh.A sawp kei ua a kisil kei ngial uleh houh a thulimlouhna moh a po ding uh ahi, ka chi hi, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening: then he shall be clean.

PAITE: A sawp kei ua a kisil kei ngial uleh houh a thulimlouhna moh a po ding uh ahi, ka chi hi, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah, Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah, Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.

PAITE: Na omna masa uh Aigupta gam mite hih bang in hih kei unla, ka hon pilut na ding Kanaan gam mite hih bang in leng hih sam kei un.
ENGLISH: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived: and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you; neither shall you walk in their statutes.

PAITE: Ka vaihawmte na pom ding ua, ka dante zui in na mang ding uh ahi: Kei bel TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
ENGLISH: You shall do my ordinances, and you shall keep my statutes, and walk in them: I am Yahweh your God.

PAITE: Huaiziak in ka dan leh ka vaihawmte na mang ding uh ahi: huaibel mi'n a hihleh a hinloh ding hi: Kei bel TOUPA mah ka hi.
ENGLISH: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances; which if a man does, he shall live in them: I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Kuamah in na tanau nute uh mawngmawng a vuaktanna uh lem ding in na zuan ding uh ahi kei: Kei TOUPA pen ka hi.
ENGLISH: “‘None of you shall approach anyone who are his close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Na pa vuaktanna, na nu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei: na nu ahi a, a vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

PAITE: Na pa zi vuaktanna na lem ding ah kei, na pa vuaktanna ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife: it is your father’s nakedness.

PAITE: Na sanggamnu, na pa tanu hiam na nu tanu hiam, na pianpih hiam, na pianpih louh hiamte vuaktanna leng na lem ding ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home, or born abroad.

PAITE: Na tapa tanu hiam, na tanu tanu hiam vuaktanna, a vuaktanna uh na lem ding ahi kei. A vuaktanna uh nang vuaktanna ahi ngal a.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness: for theirs is your own nakedness.

PAITE: Na pa zi tanu, na pa suan vuaktanna, na sanggamnu ahi, a vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

PAITE: Na pa sanggamnu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei; na pa tanaunu nai ahi hi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister: she is your father’s near kinswoman.

PAITE: Na nu sanggamnu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na nu tanaunu nai ahi ngal a.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister: for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

PAITE: Na pa sanggam a vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, a zi na zuan ding ahi kei, na nu ahi hi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, you shall not approach his wife: she is your aunt.

PAITE: Na mounu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na tapa zi ahi a, a vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na tapa zi ahi a, a vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law: she is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

PAITE: Na sanggampa zi vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na sanggampa vuaktanna ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife: it is your brother’s nakedness.

PAITE: Nutate vuaktanna na lem ding uh ahi kei; a vuaktanna lem ding in a tapa tanu hiam, a tanu tanu hiam na la ding ahi kei; na tanau naite ahi ua; gitlouhna lianpi ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

PAITE: Na zi sanggamnu, a vuaktanna lem ding in na zi a damlai siah, na neih ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is yet alive.

PAITE: Huan, numei a nitdan ngeina a a nit sung in a vuaktannna lem ding in na zuan ding ahikei.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

PAITE: A lak a kihihnin ding in na innvengpa zi na luppih ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

PAITE: Molek a dia mei a lutsak ding in na gil a gah himhim na pe ding ahi kei a, na Pathian min na hihse ding ahi sam kei hi: Kei TOUPA ka hi hi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not give any of your children to sacrifice to Molech; neither shall you profane the name of your God: I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Numei bang in pasal na kithuahpih ding ahi kei: thil kihhuai ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not lie with a man, as with a woman. That is detestable.

PAITE: Kihihnitna ding in ganta hinhim na kithuahpih ding ahi kei, numei himhim kithuahsak ding in ganta ma ah a ding ding ahikei hi; gitlouhna tungtuan ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it; neither shall any woman give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

PAITE: Hiaite ah, a bangmahmah ah kihihnin kei un; hiai thil tengteng ah na ma ua ka delhkhiak khitsa namte a na nin khin ta ua;
ENGLISH: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

PAITE: A gam leng a nin khin ta hi: huaiziak in huai a a thulimlouhna ka gawt a, gam in a sung a omte a lokhe khin vek hi.
ENGLISH: The land was defiled: therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

PAITE: Huaiziak in nou zaw ka dante, ka vaihawmte na zuih ding uh ahi, hiai thil kihhuai a bangmahmah na hih ding uh ahi kei, na gam ua mi him hiam, gamdang mi na lak ua teng hiam leng:
ENGLISH: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

PAITE: (Hiai thil kihhuai tengteng na ma ua hiai gam a omte'n a na hihkhin ua, gam mah leng a nin khin ta hi: )
ENGLISH: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land became defiled);

PAITE: Na ma ua om nam a lokhia mah bang in na hihnit ua gam in a hon luak tei louhna ding in.
ENGLISH: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

PAITE: Kuapeuh hiai thil kihhuai a bangmahmah hih mi zaw a chipihte lak a kipan koihtuam in a om ding uh.Huaiziak in hiai thil kihhuai na ma ua a chin bang uh na chin tei louh na ding un leh huai a na kihihnit louhna ding un ka thupiak na zuiah ding uh ahi: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

PAITE: Huaiziak in hiai thil kihhuai na ma ua a chin bang uh na chin tei louh na ding un leh huai a na kihihnit louhna ding un ka thupiak na zuiah ding uh ahi: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs, which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them: I am Yahweh your God.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

ENGLISH: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

PAITE: Na lat nitak un leh a zing a nek ding ahi: ni thum ni tan a om a om leh hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day: and if anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

PAITE: Ni thum ni a nek a hih zenhouh leh thil kihhuai ahi a; pomsak ahi kei ding.

ENGLISH: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

ENGLISH: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.

ENGLISH: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
