PAITE: Min a mounu a luppih leh hihlup tuaktuak ding ahi uh; thulimlouhna tungtuan hih ahi ua, a sisan moh uh a tunguah a om ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have committed a perversion; their blood shall be upon them.

PAITE: Min numei a luppih banga pasal a luppih leh thil kihhuai mahmah a hih tuaktuak ahia, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi uh; a sisan moh uh a tunguah a om ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

PAITE: Min nuta jia a neih leh thulimlouhna mahmah ahi, na lak ua thulimlouhna a om louhna dingin amah leh amau nihte leng hihlup ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burned with fire, both he and they; that there may be no wickedness among you.

PAITE: Min ganta a luppih leh hihlup ngeingei ding ahi, ganta leng a hihlup ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

PAITE: Huan, numeiin ganta a vanaiha, a kithuahsak leh numei na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi, ganta leng: hihlup ngeingei ding ahi ua; a sisan moh uh a tung ua a om ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If a woman approaches any animal, and lies down with it, you shall kill the woman, and the animal: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

PAITE: Min a sanggamnu, a pa tanu hiam, a nu tanu hiam a laka a vuaktanna a muha, aman leng a vuaktanna a muh leh thil zumhuai mahmah ahi, a chipihte uh suante mitmuha hihman ding ahi uhi; a sanggamnu vuaktanna a lem ahi, a tatlekna moh a po ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man takes his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness; it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

PAITE: Huan, min numei a kizen louh laia a luppiha, a vuaktanna a lem leh a si pawtna lem ahi a, amah leng a si pawtna lem ahi a, huchiin a chipihte uh laka kipan hihman tuaktuak ding ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness; he has made naked her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

PAITE: Huchiin na nu sanggamnu hiam, na pa sangnu hiam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei; a sanggam nai vuaktanna bawl ahi: a thulimlouhna moh uh a po ding uh.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister; for he has made naked his close relative: they shall bear their iniquity.

PAITE: Min a pangak ji a luppih leh a pangak vuaktanna lem ahi; a khelh moh uh a po ding ua, suanlehpak beiin a si ding uh.
ENGLISH: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

PAITE: Min a unaupa ji a neih leh thil nin ahi: a unaupa vuaktanna lem ahi a, suanlehpak louin a om ding uh.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity: he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

PAITE: Huchiin ka thupiak tengteng, ka vaihawm tengteng na pom ding ua, na jui ding uhi: huchiin om dinga ka honpina gamin nou a honlo khe kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do them; that the land, where I am bringing you to dwell, may not vomit you out.

PAITE: Na ma ua ka delhkhiaksa nam dangte na jui ding uh ahi kei: hiai thil tengteng a hih sek ua, huaijiakin ka kih ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I am casting out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

PAITE: Ahihhangin nou kiang ajaw, A gam uh, nawitui leh khuaiju luanna gam na luah ding ua, na luah ding un ka honpe ding: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, nam dangte laka honhihtuampa ka hi.
ENGLISH: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am Yahweh your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

PAITE: Huaijiakin sa siang leh sianglou leh vasa siang leh siang lou na khentuam ding ua; sa hiam, vasa hiam lei a a vaka vak thoh chi himhim hiam nou adia sianglou dia ka sehtuamtein na hinna uh na kihhuai sak ding uh ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and you shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

PAITE: Keia dingin mi siangthou na hi ding uhi; Kei TOUPA lah ka siangthou ngala, keia na hihna ding un namdangte lakah nou ka honseptuama, ka nahihkhinta hi.Pasal leng numei leng dawi aisansiam jawl hiam, bumsiam hiam jaw hihlup ngeingei ding ahi: suanga denlup ding ahi uh hi: a sisan moh uh a tunguah a om ding hi, chi nawn laiin, chiin.
ENGLISH: You shall be holy to me: for I, Yahweh, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

PAITE: Pasal leng numei leng dawi aisansiam jawl hiam, bumsiam hiam jaw hihlup ngeingei ding ahi: suanga denlup ding ahi uh hi: a sisan moh uh a tunguah a om ding hi, chi nawn laiin, chiin.
ENGLISH: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium, or is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi kiangah, Aron tapa, siampute houpih inla a kiang uah, A chipihte uh laka misi jiakin kuamah a kihihnin ding uh ahi kei;
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people;

PAITE: A tanau nai, anu uh, a pa uh, a tapa uh, a tanu uh, a unau uh,
ENGLISH: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

PAITE: A sagngamnu uh, a ompih lai uh nungak, pasal nei nailoute jiakin a hihleh a kihihnin thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

PAITE: A chipihte uh laka a intekpen a hih jiak un a kihihinin un a thanghuai ding uh ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

PAITE: A lu uh a met giau ding uh ahi kei, a kha mul sik tuak uh leng a tan ding uh ahi sam keia, a sa uh leng a at ding uh ahi kei lai hi.
ENGLISH: “‘They shall not shave their heads, neither shall they shave off the corners of their beards, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

PAITE: A Pathian uh adingin mi siangthou ahi ding uh a, a Pathian min uh a hemsak ding uh ahi kei hi; TOUPA adia meia thillate, a Pathian uh a dia nek ding ansiah te a lan sek uh ahi: huaijiakin a siangthou ding uh ahi;
ENGLISH: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God; for they offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, the bread of their God; therefore they shall be holy.

PAITE: Numei, kijuak hiam, min hem hiam, a pasal maksa hiam a kitenpih ding uh ahi kei: a Pathian uh dingin mi siangthou ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane; neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband: for he is holy to his God.

PAITE: Huaijiakin na siangthou ding ahi; na Pathian adia nek dingin ansiah a lan jel ngal ua, nanga dingin mi siangthou ahi ding uhi: Kei, TOUPA nou honhihsiangthoupa lah ka siangthou ngala.
ENGLISH: You shall sanctify him therefore; for he offers the bread of your God: he shall be holy to you: for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.

PAITE: Siampu kuapeuh a tanu kijuaka a kihihthanghuai leh a pa a hihthanghuai ahi a, hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father: she shall be burned with fire.

PAITE: A unaute laka siampu lalpen, a lu sathau nilh chia nilhsa, puansilh silh dinga hihtuamsain a sam a khah ding ahi kei, a puante a bot kek ding ahi kei,
ENGLISH: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, nor tear his clothes;

PAITE: Misi luang omna ah a lut ding ahi keia, a nu hiam, a pa hiam jiakin a kihihthanghuai ding ahi sam kei.
ENGLISH: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

PAITE: Mun siangthou akipan a pawtkhe ding ahi keia, a Pathian mun siangthou a hihthanghuai ding ahi sam kei lai hi; a Pathian sathau nilh chia hihtuamna lah a tungah a om ngala: Kei TOUPA ka hi.
ENGLISH: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Ji dingin nungak siangthou a kitenpih ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

PAITE: Meithai hiam, maksa hiam, numei minhem hiam, kijuak hiam te jaw a kitenpih ding ahi keia, amah chipih, nungak siangthou ji ding in a kitenpih ding ahi.
ENGLISH: A widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute, these he shall not marry: but a virgin of his own people shall he take as a wife.

PAITE: Huan, a chipihte laka a suante a hihthanghuai ding ahi kei: Kei TOUPA, a hihsiangthoupa lah ka hi ngala, chiin, a chi a.
ENGLISH: He shall not profane his seed among his people: for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”

PAITE: Huan TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Aron kiangah, A suante uh jel tana na suante uh laka paulam ding nei peuhmahin a Pathian nek ding ansiah lan dingin honjuan kei hen.
ENGLISH: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your seed throughout their generations who has a blemish, may approach to offer the bread of his God.

PAITE: Kuapeuh paulam ding nei peuhmahin a honnaih hetlouh ding uh ahi: mittawte, kehbai te, nakpek te, akan avala om peuhmahte,
ENGLISH: For whatever man he is that has a blemish, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

PAITE: Khe kitante, khut kitante,
ENGLISH: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

PAITE: Nungkun te, mi neu luate, mit kizenzou loute, mi kijun loute, lip kaite, chiltang kitamte:
ENGLISH: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles;

PAITE: Siampu Aron suan gensiatding nei himhimin TOUPA adia meia thillat lan dingin a honnaih ding uh ahi kei: gensiatding nei ahi ua, a Pathian uh nek ding ansiah lan dingin a honnaih het louh ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest who has a blemish, shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a blemish, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

PAITE: A Pathian uh nek ding ansiah, a siangthou leh a siangthou pen leng a ne thei tuaktuak ding uh.
ENGLISH: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

PAITE: Ahihhangin, gensiat ding nei a hih jiak un puanjak suangah hiam, maitam kiang naiah hiam jaw a hongpai theikei ding uh, ka mun siangthoute a hihthanghuai kha ding uhi; Kei TOUPA, amaute hihsiangthoupa lah ka hi ngala, chiin, chiin.Huchiin Mosiin Aron leh a tapate leh Israel suante tengteng kiangah a chita hi.
ENGLISH: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a blemish; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosiin Aron leh a tapate leh Israel suante tengteng kiangah a chita hi.
ENGLISH: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Aron leh a tapate kiangah gen inla, Israel suante thil siangthou, kei dia a latte uh laka kituamjial uhen, ka min a hemsak kha ding uhi: Kei TOUPA ka hi.
ENGLISH: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.

PAITE: A kiang uah, Na suante uh jel tana na suante uh tengteng laka mi, kuapeuh nin pipi-a Israel suanten TOUPA adia a lat uh thil sianthou a honnaih uleh kei akipan sat khiaka om ding ahi: kei TOUPA ka hi.
ENGLISH: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your seed throughout your generations approaches the holy things, which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Aron suan kuapeuh phak hiam, thil pawt hiamin a sianthou masiah thil siangthoute laka a nek louh ding ahi. Huan, misi hihnit hiam, chi amah akipana pawt khoih peuhmah.
ENGLISH: “‘Whoever of the seed of Aaron is a leper or has an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;

PAITE: A nit theihna, a vaka vak thoh thil himhim hiam, mi amaha kipana a nitna ban theihna hiam, nitna bangmapeuh nei hiam khoihtaphot,
ENGLISH: or whoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he has;

PAITE: Huchibang khoihmi jaw nitak lam tanin a nin dinga, huan, a kisil keileh thil siangthoute laka anek louh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his body in water.

PAITE: Huan, ni a tum leh a siangthou ta ding hi: huai khit chiangin thilsiangthoute laka a ne theita ding, a nek ding a hih jiakin.
ENGLISH: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

PAITE: Kihihnitna dingin amah sih a si hiam, sa keih hiam a ne ding ahi kei: Kei TOUPA ka hi.
ENGLISH: That which dies of itself, or is torn by animals, he shall not eat, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Huaijiakin ka thupiak a pom ding ahi; huchilouinjaw a kihihthanghuaina uah a khelh moh uh a po ding uhi, a sih loh ding uh: Kei TOUPA, amaute hihsiangthoupa ka hi ngala.
ENGLISH: “‘They shall therefore follow my requirements, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

PAITE: Gam dang min thil siangthou a ne ding uh ahi kei; siampu kianga gamta hiam, kiloh hiamin thil siangthou a ne ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

PAITE: Ahihhangin siampuin kuahiam amah sum a alei leh, huai miin a ne thei ding; huan, a ina piangten a nek ding a ne sam ding uh.
ENGLISH: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.

PAITE: Siampu tanuin gam dang mi a kitenpih leh vei thillat, thil siangthoute laka a ne ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

PAITE: Ahihhangin siampu tanu ta neilouin meithaiin hiam, mak hiama a oma, a pa in lama a kik nawn leh a nungak lai mah bangin a pa nek ding a ne sam ding hi; himahleh gam dang miin a ne ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread: but no stranger shall eat any of it.

PAITE: Min theilou-a thil siangthou a nek leh a mun ngaa khena mun khat a koih behlap dinga, thil siangthou pen siampun a pe ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

PAITE: A thil siangthoute uh nein mohna tungsaktu, thulimlouhna moh kipsak dingin Israel suante thil siangthou,
ENGLISH: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,

PAITE: TOUPA kianga a latte uh a hihbuah ding uh ahi kei; Kei TOUPA, amaute hihsiangthoupa lah ka hi ngala, chiin, chiin.
ENGLISH: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Aron leh a tapate leh Israel suante tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah, Israel laka om, gam dang mi hiam, kuapeuh a thillat uh, haltum thillat dia TOUPA kianga a lat uh, a thuchiamna uh hiam, mahni ut thua thillat hiam lan peuhmaten.
ENGLISH: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering;

PAITE: Santak na hih theihna ding un bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam, a pa gensiatbei na lat ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without blemish, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

PAITE: Gensiat kai himhim jaw na lat ding uh ahi kei; honpomsak tak lah ahi sin ngal keia.
ENGLISH: But whatever has a blemish, that you shall not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

PAITE: Kuapeuh thuchiam hihbuching ding hiam, mahni ut thua-a thillat ding hiam lemna thillat kithoihna ganhon laka hiam, a belam hon laka hiam TOUPA kianga lantaphotin, pom tak a hih theihna dingin gensiatbei alat ding ahi; gensiat kaina himhim a om ding ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; no blemish shall be therein.

PAITE: A mittaw bang, a guh tan bang, a bai bang, meima nei bang, chibawk bang, phak bang, TOUPA kianga na lat ding uh ahi kei, meia thillat dingin TOUPA kiangah maitamah na lan ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: Blind, injured, maimed, having a wart, festering, or having a running sore, you shall not offer these to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.

PAITE: Mahni ut thu-a thillat dingin bawngpa hiam. Belamnou hiam akan avala om hiam, tom lua hiam leng na lan thei ding uh; thuchiamna dingin bel pomsak ahi kei ding.
ENGLISH: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

PAITE: A chiltang sut dup hiam, sut jak hiam, sut tap hiam, keh hiam jaw TOUPA kiangah na lan ding uh ahi kei, na gam uah huchibang jaw ki thoihna dingin na zang ding uh ahi sam kei.
ENGLISH: That which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut, you shall not offer to Yahweh; neither shall you do thus in your land.

PAITE: Gam dang mi akipana lain huaite laka himhim jaw na Pathian uh nek ding ansiah dingin na lan ding uh hi lou ahi, huaia siatna leh gensiat kaina a om jiakin; pom sak theih na hi kei ding uhi, chiin, chiin.
ENGLISH: Neither shall you offer the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner of any of these; because their corruption is in them. There is a blemish in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Bawngpa hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam, a hongpian chiangin a pi kiangah ni sagih a om ding ahi, ni giat ni akipan huai nunglamin TOUPA adia meia thillat dingin pom theih ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “When a bull, or a sheep, or a goat, is born, then it shall remain seven days with its mother; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

PAITE: Bawngpi hiam, belampi hiam, anou toh ni khatin na gou ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

PAITE: Huan, kipahthugenna kithoih dia TOUPA kianga na kithoih hun chiang un san tak na hih theihna ding un na kithoih ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

PAITE: Huai niin nek bei ding ahi, a jingchiang tanin bangmah na sit ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
ENGLISH: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Huaijiakin ka thupiakte na pom ding ua, na jui ding uh ahi; Kei TOUPA ka hi.
ENGLISH: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, ka min siangthou na hemsak ding uh ahi kei, Israel suante lakah pahtawiin ka om ding ahi.Kei noute honpahtawipa, na Pathian uh hi dinga Aigupta gam akipan noute honpikhia TOUPA ka hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi. chiin.
ENGLISH: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,

PAITE: Kei noute honpahtawipa, na Pathian uh hi dinga Aigupta gam akipan noute honpikhia TOUPA ka hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi. chiin.
ENGLISH: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah, TOUPA ankuanglui hunbi hiaite ahi.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

PAITE: Ni guk nasep ding ahi a, ni sagih ni bel chiktaka laka khawlna, khawmpi siangthou ahi; bang nasep himhim na sep ding uh ahi kei: na omna peuh uah TOUPA adingin khawlni ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.

PAITE: TOUPA ankuanglui hunbi, khawmpi siangthou, a hun geihgeiha na bawl ding uh hiaite ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

PAITE: Kha khatna, ni sawm leh ni li ni nitak lam TOUPA Paikan Ankuangluina ahi.
ENGLISH: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.

PAITE: Huan, huai kha mah ni sawm leh ni nga ni TOUPA adia tanghou silngou soh louh angkuangluina ahi: ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

PAITE: A ni khat niin khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, nasep himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

PAITE: Ni sagih sungin meia thillat TOUPA kiangah na lan ding ua: a ni sagih ni pen khawmpi siangthou ahia, na himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei, chiin, chiin.
ENGLISH: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation: you shall do no regular work.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah, Kon gam piak ding na va tun ua, huailaia buh khawng na lak hun chiang un, na buh thak masate uh phal khat siampu kianga nontawi ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its the harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest:

ENGLISH: The meal offering with it shall be two tenth parts of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

PAITE: Na Pathian ading ua thillat na lat ma un, huai ma himhimin a tanghouin hiam, a kanin hiam, a vuiin hiam ane ding uh ahi kei: hiai bel na omna peuh ua na suante jel uh tana na khantawn dan ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall eat neither bread, nor roasted grain, nor fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

PAITE: Huan, khelh thoihna dingin kelpa khat leh kilepna thillat kithoihna dingin belamnou a pa nih kum khata upa na lat ding uh ahi.

ENGLISH: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

PAITE: Huan, huai ni mah na sep ding ua, nou adingin khawmpi siangthou ahi dinga, na himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei: hiai bel na omna peuh uah na suante jel uh tanin na khantawn dan ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall make proclamation on the same day: there shall be a holy convocation to you; you shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

PAITE: Huan, na lou ua buh na lak chiang un na lounawl jul uh la vek kei un, a sang leng na zong ding uh ahi kei: mi genthei leh gamdang mi adin na hawi sak ding uhi: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chiin, chiin.
ENGLISH: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap into the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest: you shall leave them for the poor, and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

ENGLISH: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA min gense peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi: mi tengtengin suanga a den ngeingei ding uh: TOUPA min a gensiat u leh gam dang mi leng, hiai gama mi him leng hihlup ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He who blasphemes the name of Yahweh, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: the foreigner as well as the native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.

PAITE: Si khopa ganta tunga khut kha peuhmahin a dit ding ahi: hin sikin hin.
ENGLISH: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

PAITE: Huan, min a insakinkhang a melsiatsak leh a hih bang geih a tunga hih sam ding ahi;
ENGLISH: If anyone injures his neighbor; as he has done, so shall it be done to him:

PAITE: Guh kitan sikin guh kitan, mit sikin mit, ha sikin ha; mi a hihmelsiat bangin a tungahleng hih sam ding ahi.
ENGLISH: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has injured someone, so shall it be done to him.

PAITE: Ganta hihlum peuhmain a dit ding ahi; mi hihlum peuhmah hihlup sam ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

PAITE: Gam dang mite ading leh hiai gama mi himte adingin dan kibang khat na neih ding uh ahi: Kei TOUPA na Pathian ka hi hi, na chi ding ahi, chiin.Huchiin Mosiin Israel suante a houpiha, hamse loupa pen dainawl ah a pi khia ua, suangin a deng uh, Israel suanten TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangin a hihta uh.
ENGLISH: You shall have one kind of law, for the foreigner as well as the native-born: for I am Yahweh your God.’”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosiin Israel suante a houpiha, hamse loupa pen dainawl ah a pi khia ua, suangin a deng uh, Israel suanten TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangin a hihta uh.
ENGLISH: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought out him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan TOUPAN Sinai tangah Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses in Mount Sinai,

PAITE: Na lou ah kum guk sung thil na ching dianga, na grep huan kum guk sung na sat nou dinga, a gahte na la ding:

ENGLISH: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and the grapes of your undressed vine you shall not gather. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

ENGLISH: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

ENGLISH: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

ENGLISH: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

ENGLISH: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

ENGLISH: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

PAITE: Jubili khit a kum zah bang jelin na insakinkhang thil na lei dinga, buhlehbal tun kum tam dan dungjuiin na kiangah a juak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

PAITE: A kum tam dan dungjui jelin aman na khangsak dinga, huan, a kum tawm dan dungjuiin aman na kiamsak dinga; buhlehbal tun kum tam dungjuiin na kianga juak ahi hi.
ENGLISH: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

PAITE: Na kikhem ding uh ahi kei, na Pathian laudan na siam ding u hi: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngala.
ENGLISH: You shall not wrong one another; but you shall fear your God: for I am Yahweh your God.

PAITE: Huaijiakin ka thusehte na jui in ka vaihawmte na pomin laudan na siam ding ahi; huchiin tua gamah lungmuangin na teng ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

PAITE: Gamin a gah a suah dinga, niang leh taiin na ne un na ta ding ua, lungmuang takin na vateng ding uhi.
ENGLISH: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

PAITE: A hih leh, a kum sagih kumin bang ka neta ding ua? Ngai dih, bangmah lah ka ching kei ua, ka thil tungte uh lah ka lasam kei ua, chi na hih uleh,
ENGLISH: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase”;

ENGLISH: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

ENGLISH: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

PAITE: Na gam luah tengteng uh, tat kik thepthup na phal ding uhi.
ENGLISH: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

ENGLISH: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

PAITE: Huan, min a tat sakmi ding a neih louha, a hong kitoha, a tatna khop a neih leh,
ENGLISH: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it;

PAITE: A khot kum sut henla, a khotnapa kiangah a val pe nawn hen; huchiin a gam a luah nawn ding.
ENGLISH: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

PAITE: A maha dia a tatkik nawn theih kei lebel a khotsa pen Jubili kum tanin a leipa khutah om hen; huan, Jubili kumin a pawt nawn dinga, aman a gam a luah nawn ding hi.
ENGLISH: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee: and in the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

PAITE: Huan, kulh nei khuaa in min a juak leh a juak akipan kum khat ngial sungin a tan nawn thei ding; kum khat vingveng sungin tat nawn theihna a nei ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

PAITE: Kum khat sunga a tat theih kei leh kulh nei khuaa in pen khantawnin a suante jel tanin leng a leimi-a ahi bikbek ding ahi, Jubili chiangin leng a pawt tuan kei ding.
ENGLISH: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

PAITE: Kulh neilou khuaa inte bel singtang gam banga seh ahi dinga, tat theih ahi dinga, Jubili chiangin a pawt ding.
ENGLISH: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be reckoned with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

PAITE: Himahleh Levi-tepawl khua, a tantuam khua ua inte jaw Levi-tepawlin chiklai peuhin leng a tan thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: “‘Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, the houses in the cities of their possession, the Levites may redeem at any time.

PAITE: Huan, Levi-tepawl laka min a tat kei leh juaksa in leh a tantuan khua pen Jubili chiangin a pawt ding: Levi-tepawl khuaa inte Israel suante laka a tantuam uh ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

PAITE: A khokim khawng ua loute bel juak theih ahi kei ding, a khantawn tantuan uh ahi ngal a.
ENGLISH: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

PAITE: Huan, na unau a hongentheiha, nang a hongbelh leh nana kep ding ahi; mikhual, na kianga teng banga na na ompih ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support him among you; then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

PAITE: Amah laka dangka hiam, thil hiam, a pung la ken, Pathian laudan siam jawin: na unau na kianga a teng theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: Take no interest from him or profit, but fear your God; that your brother may live among you.

PAITE: A pung delhin na sum na leitawi sak ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

PAITE: Kei na TOUPA na Pathian uh, Kanaan gam honpepa leh na Pathian uh hi dinga Aigupta gam akipana honpikhepa ka hi hi.
ENGLISH: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

PAITE: Huan, na unau a hongentheiha, na kianga a hong puk lut leh sikha banga na zat ding ahikei.
ENGLISH: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you; you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

PAITE: Kilohmi bang leh na kianga teng sam bangin na kiangah a om ding ahi: Jubili kum tanin na na a sem ding.
ENGLISH: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee:

PAITE: Huai khitin na kianga akipan a pawt dinga, amah leh a tate toh, huan, amau inkuanngei ah a lut nawn ding uh, a pi leh pute in leh lou a luah nawn ding uhi.
ENGLISH: then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

PAITE: Aigupta gam akipana ka pi khiak, ka sikhate ahi ngal ua, sikha khota khot ding ahi kei uh.
ENGLISH: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

PAITE: Khel takin a lakah na om ding ahi kei, na Pathian laudan na siam jawk ding ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

PAITE: Sikhanu leh sikhapa na neih dingte na kim ua nam laka mi, sikhanu leh sikhapa dingin na lei ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have; of the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

PAITE: Huan, na lak ua teng gam dang mi leh na gam ua piang a inkote uh laka mite leng na lei thei sam ding uh; huaite na mi na sa uh ahi ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Moreover of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

PAITE: Huan, na nung ua na tate uh gouluah dingin, a mi a sa ua a neih ding un amau dingin na bawl ding uh; huai laka mite na khantawn sikha ding un na nei ding uh: himahleh na unau Israel suante laka khel takin na om ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them may you take your slaves forever: but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

PAITE: Gam dang mi hiam, na kianga teng kuahiam honkhophata, a kianga na unaupa a honggentheiha, na kianga gam dang mi hiam, na kianga teng kiang hiama, gam dang mite suan inko laka hiam a puk lut leh.
ENGLISH: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family;

PAITE: Khotsa a hih nungin tat nawn theih ding; a unaute laka khatin amah a tan thei ding.
ENGLISH: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

PAITE: A pangakin hiam, a pangak tapain hiam a tan thei ding; a chite laka a tanau naiin hiam a tan thei ding hi; huan, amah leng a hongphat nawn leh a kitanthei ding hi.
ENGLISH: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

PAITE: A puklut na pa toha puklut akipana Jubili kum nawn ding sut khawm uhenla a puklut man a kum omdanin ahi dinga; huan kilehmi dia goih sut bang jela sut sak ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; according to the time of a hired servant shall he be with him.

PAITE: Kum tampi a om lai leh a tatna manpen a belh sung hu toh kituak man a piak kik nawn ding ahi.
ENGLISH: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

PAITE: Jubili kum tunna ding kum tawm chik kia om phet ahihleh sut khawm uhen; a om kum tamdan dungjuiin a tatna man a piak kik ding ahi.
ENGLISH: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

PAITE: Kum khat bi jela goih kilohmi bangin a bel ding hi: Na mitmuhin khel takin a bawl ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him: he shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

PAITE: Huchibang lama tat a hih kei lehleng, Jubili kumin a pawt dinga, amah leh a tate toh.Israel suante lah ka sikhate ahi ngala ua, Aigupta gam kipan ka pi khiak, ka sikhate ahi uh; Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
ENGLISH: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee, he, and his children with him.

PAITE: Israel suante lah ka sikhate ahi ngala ua, Aigupta gam kipan ka pi khiak, ka sikhate ahi uh; Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
ENGLISH: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

PAITE: Milim na bawl ding uh ahi kei, milim bawl tawm hiam suang phuh hiam na dingsak ding uh ahi kei, biak dingin na gam uah milim tuanna suang na phut ding uh ahi sam kei: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngala.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, neither shall you raise up an engraved image or a pillar, neither shall you place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it: for I am Yahweh your God.

PAITE: Ka khawlnite na tang ding ua, ka mun siangthou na zahtak ding uh ahi: Kei TOUPA ka hi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Ka thusehte na mang ding ua, ka thupiakte na pom ua na man uleh vuahtuite a hun hunin ka kesak dinga,
ENGLISH: “‘If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

PAITE: Leiin thil a honpiang sak dinga, gama singten gah a suang ding uhi.
ENGLISH: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

PAITE: Na phual ua buhin grep loh hun aman pha dinga, na grep loh un thil chin hun a man pha ding; na tanghou uh nianglehtaiin na ne ding ua, na gam uah lungmuang takin na teng ding uh.
ENGLISH: Your threshing shall reach to the vintage, and the vintage shall reach to the sowing time; and you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

PAITE: Hiai gam galmuang takin ka omsak dinga, na lum pihpeh ding ua, kuamahin a honlausak kei ding uh; gamsa hoihlou te hiai gam akipanin ka hawl jak dinga, namsauin na gam uh a tuansuak sam kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid; and I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

PAITE: Na melmate uh na delh ding ua, na ma uah namsaua thahin a om ding uhi.
ENGLISH: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

PAITE: Mi ngain ja a delh ding ua, jain sing a delh ding uh: na melmate uh na ma uah namsaua thahin a om ding uh.
ENGLISH: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

PAITE: Huan, ka hondieh sak dinga, chi tampi ka hon suangsak ding hi; huan, na lak uah ka thukhun ka hihkip ding.
ENGLISH: “‘I will have respect for you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

PAITE: Huan, sawtpi na kepsa uh a luite na ne ding ua, a thak koihna dingin a luite na la khe ding uh.
ENGLISH: You shall eat old store long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

PAITE: Huan, na lak uah ka biakbuk ka omsak dinga: ka hinnain nou a honnungngatsan kei ding.
ENGLISH: I will set my tent among you: and my soul won’t abhor you.

PAITE: Na lak uah ka teng dinga, na Pathian uh ka hi dia, huan, nou leng ka mite na hi ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

PAITE: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, a sikha uh na hih louhna ding ua Aigupta gam akipana noute honpikhepa ka hi; na hakkolte uh ka hihtan dinga, ding tangin kahonpai sak ding.
ENGLISH: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves; and I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.

PAITE: Ahihhangin ka thu na pom kei ua, hiai thupiak tengteng na zuih kei ua, ka thusehte na deih kei ua.
ENGLISH: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments;

PAITE: Na hinna un ka vaihawmte a muhdaha, ka thupiak tengteng jui loua ka thukhun na bohsiat uleh ken leng na tunguah hiai ka hih ding;
ENGLISH: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;

PAITE: Na tunguah thil lauhuai mahmah, na hinna uh netum leh na mit uh susia kumjawnna leh khodam khawng ka lengsak ding: huan, na haichite uh bangmah lou dia ching na hi ding ua, na melmate un a ne jel ding uhi.
ENGLISH: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away; and you will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

PAITE: Na tunguah ka mai ka gum sak dinga, na melmate uh ma ah na vuallel ding uh: nou honmudahten na tunguah vai a hawm ding ua, kuamah delh louhin na tai ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

PAITE: Huan, huchi pipi aleng ka thu na pom kei lai uleh na khelhnate uh jiakin sagih vei ka hon gawt lai ding hi.
ENGLISH: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

PAITE: Na hatna uh ki-otsakna ka su se dinga, na van uh sik bangin ka bawl ding, ne lei un sumsah bangin:
ENGLISH: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like brass;

PAITE: Huan, na tha uh na pai thawn lel ding ua: na gam un thil a piangsak kei dinga, gama singten gah a suang sam kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: and your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

PAITE: Kei kalhlama na om ua, ka thu na pom kei uleh na khelhna uh dung juiin a mun sagihin na tunguah gawtna ka tungsak ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

PAITE: Huan, na lak uah gamsate ka honpai sak dinga, huaiin na tate uh a honlaksak ding, na gantate uh a hon keih sak ding ua, kiamlam na manoh hiaihiai ding uh, na lampite uh ahontulta ding hi.
ENGLISH: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number; and your roads will become desolate.

PAITE: Huchi aleng ka thununna na pom tuan kei ua, kei honkalh lama na om lailai uleh kei leng nou kalh lamin ka om ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If by these things you won’t be reformed to me, but will walk contrary to me;

PAITE: Kei mahmahin na khelhnate uh jiakin sagih vei ka hon gawt ding.
ENGLISH: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

PAITE: Na tunguah namsau ka leng sak dinga, huaiin thukun phu a la dinga, numau kho sung chiat ah na kibawm khawm ding ua: huan, na lak uah hi ka leng sak dinga, melmate khuta piak na hi ding uhi.
ENGLISH: I will bring a sword upon you, that will execute the vengeance of the covenant; and you will be gathered together within your cities: and I will send the pestilence among you; and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

PAITE: Na muanpi pen uh tanghou ka tawpsak hun chiangin numei sawmin omna khatah a om ding ua, na tanghou uh buk chitchiat jelin a honpe nawn ding ua; na ne ding ua, na kham tuan kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight: and you shall eat, and not be satisfied.

PAITE: Huchi tengteng a leng ka thu na pom kei ua, kei kalhlama na om lailai uleh hehtakin noute kalhlamin ka om dinga;
ENGLISH: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me;

PAITE: Na khelhnate uh jiakin sagihvei, kei mahmahin ka hon gawt ding hi.
ENGLISH: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath; and I also will chastise you seven times for your sins.

PAITE: Na tate uh sa na ne ding ua, na tanute uh sa na ne nalai ding uh.
ENGLISH: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

PAITE: Huan, na mun sangte uh ka chimsak dinga, na milimte uh ka puksak dinga, na luang uh na milimte uh luang tungah ka pai ding; huan, ka hinna-in nou a honmu nuam kei ding.
ENGLISH: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

PAITE: Na khuate uh ka gamsak dinga, na mun siangthoute uh ka hawmsak dinga, na gimlimte uh ka dik kei ding.
ENGLISH: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation, and I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

PAITE: Huan, gam ka hawmsak dinga; na melma uh huaia omten lamdang a sa ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein will be astonished at it.

PAITE: Huan, nam dangte lakah ka hondalh sak dinga, nou hon delhjui dingin namsau ka phawi ding; huchiin na gam uh a hawm dinga, na khua te uh a gam ding.
ENGLISH: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you: and your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

PAITE: Huan, gamin a hawm sung teng leh na melmate uh gama na om sung un a khawlnite ah nuam asa ding; huai hun chiangin gam a khawl dinga, a khawlnite ah nuam a sa ding hi.
ENGLISH: Then the land will enjoy its sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

PAITE: A hawm sung tengin a khawl ding; na ten lai ua na khawlni ua khawl tei sek loute pen.
ENGLISH: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your sabbaths, when you lived on it.

PAITE: Huan, na lak ua mi om sunte, a melmate uh gamah a lungtang sung uah bahna ka omsak ding; huan, nahthel gingin leng a delh dinga namsau laka kipana taikek bangin a taikek ding ua, kuamah delh louhin a puk ding uh.
ENGLISH: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies: and the sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword; and they will fall when no one pursues.

PAITE: Kuamah delh khol louhin namsau delh bang maiin a kipal puk lemlum ding ua: na melmate uh na dal dingin hatna himhim na neikei ding uh.
ENGLISH: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues: and you will have no power to stand before your enemies.

PAITE: Nam dangte lakah na mangthang ding ua, na melmate uh gamin nou a hon gai ding.
ENGLISH: You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will eat you up.

PAITE: Huan, na lak ua om sunte na melmate uh gamah a thulimlouhna jiakun, a mui hiaihiai ding uh: a pi leh pute un a thulimlouhnate uh a muih loh ding bang un amau leng a muih loh sam ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

PAITE: A khelh uh ka tunga a khelhna uh jiak leh a thulimlouhna uh leh a pi leh pute uh thulimlouhna leh kei honkalhlama a om jiak un,
ENGLISH: “‘If they confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary to me,

PAITE: Kei leng amau kalhlama ka oma, amelmate uh gama ka omsak dante a kitheihmohbawl kei ding ua; a lungtang ua sum louh a kiniamkhiak ua, a thulimlouhna uh jiaka gawtna a pom uh leh, Jakob kianga ka thukhun ka theigige ding;
ENGLISH: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies: if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity;

PAITE: Isaak leh Abraham kianga ka thukhunte leng ka theigige dinga;
ENGLISH: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

PAITE: Huan, a gam mah leng ka theigige ding hi. Gam leng a kihep mang san ding ua, amau om loua a hawm sungin a khawlnite ah nuam a sa ding; ka vaihawmte a deihlouh jiak uh leh a hinna un ka thusehte a muhnop louh nak jiakin, a thulimlouhna uh gawtna a pom ding uh ahi:
ENGLISH: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them: and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

PAITE: Huchi pipiin leng a melmate uh amaute hihmang thang ding leh a lak ua ka thukhun bohsiain ka paikhe kei dinga, ka mudah sam kei ding: Kei TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi ngala:
ENGLISH: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God;

PAITE: A Pathian uh ka hih theihna dinga nam chihta mitmuha Aigupta gam akipan ka pi khiak, a pipute uh thukhun amate jiakin ka theigige zo ding: Kei TOUPA ka hi, chiin, chiin.Hiaite Sinai tanga Mosi zanga amah leh Israel suante kala TOUPAN a bawl thupiak te, vaihawm te leh dante ahi hi.
ENGLISH: but I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”

PAITE: Hiaite Sinai tanga Mosi zanga amah leh Israel suante kala TOUPAN a bawl thupiak te, vaihawm te leh dante ahi hi.
ENGLISH: These are the statutes, ordinances and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kianga uah, Min bang hiampoimoh tuam tungthu-a thu achiamleh a mihing na seh hun bangin TOUPA atuam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man makes a vow, the persons shall be for Yahweh by your valuation.

PAITE: Pasal a hih leh na seh dan ding kum sawmnih akipana kum sawmguka upa mun siangthou sekel bang, dangka sekel sawmnga hu ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Your valuation shall be of a male from twenty years old even to sixty years old, even your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

PAITE: Numei a hih leh na seh dan ding sekel swmthum ahi ding.
ENGLISH: If it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

PAITE: Huan, kum nga akipana kum sawmniha upa ahihleh, na seh dan ding pasal sekel sawmnih numei bel sekel sawm ahi ding.
ENGLISH: If the person is from five years old even to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

PAITE: Huan, kha khat akipana kum ngaa upa ahihleh, na seh dan ding pasal bel dangka sekel nga, numei bel dangka sekel thum ahi ding.
ENGLISH: If the person is from a month old even to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

PAITE: Huan, kum sawmguk akipan a tunglam a hihleh, na seh dan ding pasal bel sekel sawm leh nga, numei bel sekel sawm ahi ding.
ENGLISH: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if it is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

PAITE: Ahihhangin na seh sanga a gentheih leh siampu kiangah pi ding ahi dia, siampuin a nasep ding; thuchiammi zoh hun bang bang saimpuin a nasep ding.
ENGLISH: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to the ability of him who vowed shall the priest value him.

PAITE: Huan, thillat, TOUPA kianga a lat ding uh gan a hih leh kuapeuhin TOUPA adia huchibang a piak peuh uh thil siangthou ahi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If it is an animal, of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.

PAITE: A hih lamdang ding ahi kei, a sia a phain, a sia a hoih khen ding ahi sam kei: gan gan maha a khen teitei leh a nihin a khenna toh thil siangthou ahi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.

PAITE: Huan, gan siangthou lou, TOUPA kianga lat ngei louh chi a hih leh, gan pen siampu maa a koih ding ahi;
ENGLISH: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

PAITE: Huan, siampuin a hoih dan bangin a man hun a nasep ding: nang siampuin na seh dan bangbang ahi jel ding.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall value it, whether it is good or bad. As you the priest values it, so shall it be.

PAITE: Ahihhangin a tat nawn taktak sin leh na seh zah munngaa khena mun khat a behlap ding ahi.
ENGLISH: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

PAITE: Huan, min a in TOUPA tuam dia a lat ding leh a hoih leh hoih louh dungjuiin siampuin a seh ding ahi: siampu seh bangbang ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad: as the priest shall evaluate it, so shall it stand.

PAITE: Huan, a lanmiin a in pen a tat nawn ding leh a man dinga na seh zah mun ngaa khena mun khat a behlap ding ahi, huchiin amaha ahi nawn ding.
ENGLISH: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

PAITE: Huan min a gama lou akhen TOUPA tuam dinga a lat sin leh na seh dan ding a chi tuh dung jui jelin ahi ding. Barli buh homer khat mun dangka sekel sawmnga man ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it: the sowing of a homer 1 homer is about 220 litres or 6 bushels of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

PAITE: A lou pen Jubili kum akipana lat a hih leh na seh bang ahi tou pek ding.
ENGLISH: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

PAITE: Jubili kum nunga a lat a hihleh bel siampuin aman Jubili tun nawnna ding kum dungjui jelin a sep dinga, na seh dan akipana a kiam hun bawl ahi ding.
ENGLISH: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

PAITE: A lanmiin a tat nawn taktak ding leh a man na seh zah mun ngaa khena mun khat a behlap dinga, amaha ahi nawn ding.
ENGLISH: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

PAITE: Lou pen a tat nop louh hiam, mi dang kianga a khot hiam a hih leh tat nawn theih a hita kei ding:
ENGLISH: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

PAITE: Jubili kuma a pawt nawn hunin lou pen TOUPA adia siangthou, amaha tuam siangthou bang ahi, siampu ading ahi ding.
ENGLISH: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a field devoted; it shall be owned by the priests.

PAITE: Amah gama him hi lou, lou a leisa, min TOUPA kianga a lat leh,
ENGLISH: “‘If he dedicates to Yahweh a field which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

PAITE: Jubili kum tanin na seh dan bangain siampuin a man a seh sak dinga, na seh bangin TOUPA adinga thil siangthou dingin huai niin a piak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Jubili kumin a leina pa, a gamneipa mahin a tang nawn ding.
ENGLISH: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

PAITE: Na seh dan tengtengmun siangthou sekel bang jel ahi ding hi; sekel khat bel gera sawmnih ahi ding.
ENGLISH: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

PAITE: Ahihhangain ganta laka piang masapen, a pian masak pen jiaka TOUPA tuam dinga sehsa peuhmah jaw kumahin a lan ding ahi kei: bawngtal leng belam leng hi heh, TOUPA tuam ahi hi.
ENGLISH: “‘Only the firstborn among animals, which is made a firstborn to Yahweh, no man may dedicate it; whether an ox or sheep, it is Yahweh’s.

PAITE: Huan, gan siangthou lou a hih leh na seh dan bangin tat ding ahi dia, ahuan, a mun ngaa khena mun khat a behlap dinga hi; huan, tat ahih keileh, na seh dan banga khot ding ahi.
ENGLISH: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it: or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

PAITE: Ahihhangin min a neih laka bangpeuh, mihing hiin, ganta hiin, a neihsa lou hitaleh, TOUPA kianga a piaksa juak ding ahi keia; tat ding leng ahi kei; tua bang thil peuhmah TOUPA adingin siangthou pen ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man shall devote to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy to Yahweh.

PAITE: Kuapeuh si dia vaihawmsak, mihing laka kipana manthatsak ding, tat ding ahi kei, amah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘No one devoted, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.

PAITE: Gam sunga sawm-a-khat peuhmah, gamsunga haichi hitaleh, sing gah hitaleh, TOUPA-a ahi; TOUPA adia thil siangthou ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, min a sawm-a-khat a tat nop leh, mun ngaa khena mun khat a behlap ding ahi.
ENGLISH: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

PAITE: Bawng leh belam sawma khat thu-ah, ganvulmi chianga chiamtehsa nangawn leng, a sawmna jel TOUPA adia siangthou ahi ding.
ENGLISH: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huai gan tuh a hoih hia, hoih lou, a enchian ding ahi kei, a khek ding leng ahi sam kei; a kheka ahihleh, a khek pen leh a khekna pen leng a nih un siangthou ahi ding ua; tat ding ahi kei hi.Hiaite Israel suante dinga TOUPAN Sinai tang Mosi kianga thupiak a piakte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: He shall not search whether it is good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he changes it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

PAITE: Hiaite Israel suante dinga TOUPAN Sinai tang Mosi kianga thupiak a piakte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

PAITE: Huan, a thillat lemna thillat kithoihna a hih a, bawng hon lak a a lat leh, TOUPA ma ah gensiatbei a lan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings; if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before Yahweh.

PAITE: A thillat lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, kihoupihna puan inn kongpibul ah a gou ding: huan, Aron tapa, siampute'n maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron’s sons, the priests shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

PAITE: Huan, lemna thillat kithoihna a TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a lan ding a: a sungkua thau leh a gilboh tengteng leh,
ENGLISH: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

PAITE: A kal nihte leh a tuam thau a phuk chin a om leh a sin tuam lam, a kalte toh kigawm in a suah ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

PAITE: Huan, Aron tapate'n maitam ah, mei a sing om tung a haltum thillat tungah a hal ding uhi: huai bel TOUPA a ding a gimlim tak, mei a thillat ahi.
ENGLISH: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, lemna thillat kithoihna a TOUPA a ding a a thillat belam hon lak ate a hihleh, a nu leng hita hen aw, a pa zong hita leh, gensiatbei a lat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

PAITE: A thillat a belamnou a lat leh TOUPA ma ah a lan ding a:
ENGLISH: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;

PAITE: A thillat lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, kihoupihna puan inn kongpi ah a gou ding: huan, Aron tapate'n maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh ding uhi.
ENGLISH: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

PAITE: Huchi in lemna thillat kithoihna ate, TOUPA ding a mei a thillat a lan ding a: a thaute, a mei thau mahmah a tawn in, a kawngguh tan in a la vek ding a; a sungkua thaute, a gil boh tengtengte,
ENGLISH: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is on the inwards,

PAITE: A kal nihte leh a phuk chin a om a tuam thau leh a sin tuam a lap, a kalte nangawn toh a suah ding ahi
ENGLISH: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in huai maitam ah a hal ding ahi: huai bel TOUPA a dia mei a thillat nek ding annsiah ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.

PAITE: A thillat kel a hih leh TOUPA ma ah a lan ding a:
ENGLISH: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh:

PAITE: Huan, a lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, kihoupihna puan in kong ah a gou ding a; huan, Aron tapate'n maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: and he shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

PAITE: Huan, huai a a thillat pen a lan ding a, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat tak; a sungkua thau leh a gilboh tengteng leh,
ENGLISH: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

PAITE: A kal nihte leh a phuk chin a om a tuam thau leh a sin tuam lam, a kalte toh nangawn in a suah ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

PAITE: Huan, huai pen siampu in maitam ah a hal ding ahi: gimlim ding a mei a thillat nek ding annsiah ahi a; a thau tengteng TOUPA a tuam ahi.Sathau hiam, sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei chih na suante uh ding a banban in na omna phot uah khantawn a thuseh ahi ding, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.

PAITE: Sathau hiam, sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei chih na suante uh ding a banban in na omna phot uah khantawn a thuseh ahi ding, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah, TOUPA'N thil hih louh ding a thu a piakte, a bangpeuh leng min na hihkhial kha in, a bangpeuh leng na hita leh,
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them:

PAITE: Sathaunilh siampu in mipite tung a mohpaihna tungsak a a hihkhelh leh, a thilhih khelhsa khelh thoihna ding in TOUPA kiang ah bawng tuai gensiatbei, khelh thoihna ding in lan hen.
ENGLISH: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin, which he has sinned, a young bull without blemish to Yahweh for a sin offering.

PAITE: Bawng pen kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah hon kai ding a, bawng lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, TOUPA ma ah huai bawng a gou ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, sathau nilh siampu in bawng sisan bangzah hiam a la ding a, kihoupihna puan inn ah a hon tawi ding a:
ENGLISH: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in sisan ah a khut a diah ding a, a khenkhat TOUPA ma ah, mun siangthou puanzak bul ah sagihvei a theh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, before the veil of the sanctuary.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in TOUPA ma ah kihoupihna puan inn a gimlim lim tak maitam kite ah sisan pen bangzah hiam a tat ding: huan, bawng sisan tengteng kihoupihna puan in kongpi kiang a haltum thillat maitam bul ah a sungkhe ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out all of rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, khelh thoihna bawng thau tengteng a la vek ding a; a sungkua thau leh a gilboh tengteng,
ENGLISH: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering off of it; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

PAITE: A kal nihte leh a phuk chin a om a tuam thau leh a sin tuam a lam, a kal nihte nangawn toh a suah ding a;
ENGLISH: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away,

PAITE: Lemna thillat kithoihna bawngpa a kipan lak bang in, huan siampu in haltum thillat maitam ah a hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: as it is taken off of the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

PAITE: Huan bawng vunte, a sa tengtengte, a lu toh, a khete toh, a sungkuate a ekte,
ENGLISH: The bull’s skin, all its flesh, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung,

PAITE: A bawng pumpi toh dainawl lam mun siang ah, vut paihna ah a paipih ding a, sing tungah a hal ding: vut paihna ah a hal ding hi.
ENGLISH: even the whole bull shall he carry forth outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. Where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.

PAITE: Huan, Israel mipi tengteng in a sukhelh khak ua, mipi mitmuh a sel a hih a, TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu a piakte, a bang mahmah a hih ua,
ENGLISH: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

PAITE: Siamlouh a tan ua, a thil gilou hih uh theih khiak a hong hih leh, mipi in khelh thoihna ding in bawng tuai a lan ding ua, kihoupihna puan inn kong ah a hong kai ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, nite upaten TOUPA maah bawng lu tungah a khut uh a koih ding ua; huan bawng tuh Toupa maah goh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before Yahweh; and the bull shall be killed before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, sathau nilh siampu in kihoupihna puan inn ah bawng sisan bangzah hiam a hon tawi ding a:
ENGLISH: The anointed priest shall bring of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting:

PAITE: Huan, siampu in sisan ah a khutzung a diah ding a, puanzak bul ah TOUPA ma ah sagih vei a theh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.

PAITE: Huan, sisan pen kihoupihna puan inn a TOUPA ma ah maitam ki ah tamlou a tat ding a, sisan tengteng kihoupihna puan inn kongpi kiang a haltum thillat maitam bul ah a sungkhe ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before Yahweh, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, a thau tengteng a la vek ding a, maitam ah a hal ding.
ENGLISH: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

PAITE: Huchi bang in bawng tuh a hih ding a; khelh thoihna bawng a hih bang geih in hiai leng a hih ding ahi: huan, siampu in kilepna a bawl ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: Thus shall he do with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so shall he do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

PAITE: Huan, bawng tuh dainawl lam ah a paipih ding a, bawng masa a hal bang in a hal ding ahi: huai bel mipi a dia khelh thoihna ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall carry forth the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

PAITE: Vaihawmtu in thil a hihkhelh a, TOUPA a Pathian in hih louh ding a thu a piak tengteng a bangmah a hih khak a, siamlouh a tan a,
ENGLISH: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which Yahweh his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty;

PAITE: A thil gilou hih theihsak a hih leh a thillat ding in kel, a pa, gensiatbei a hon kai ding a:
ENGLISH: if his sin, in which he has sinned, is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without blemish.

PAITE: Kel lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, TOUPA ma ah haltum thillat a goh zel na uah a gou ding ahi: huai bel khelh thoihna ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in khelh thoihna sisan a khut zung in tamlou a pik ding a, haltum thillat maitam kite ah a tat ding a, haltum thillat maitam bul ah a sisan a sungkhe ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

PAITE: Huan, a thau tengteng lemna thillat kithoihna thau a hal bang in maitam ah a hal ding ahi: huan, a khelhna tungthu ah siampu in kilepna a bawl saang ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

PAITE: Huan, vantang lak a mi a kuamahmah in TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu a piakte a bangmahmah hihkhial ka in, siamlouh na tang ta leh,
ENGLISH: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and is guilty;

PAITE: A thil gilou hih theihsak a hihleh a thillat ding in kel, a nu gensiatbei, a thilhih khelhsa khelh thoihna ding in a honkai ding ahi.
ENGLISH: if his sin, which he has sinned, is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has sinned.

PAITE: Khelh thoihna lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, haltum thillat na mun ah khelh thoihna a gou ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in sisan a khutzung in tamlou a pik ding a, haltum thillat maitam kite ah a tat ding a, a sisan tengteng maitam bul ah a sungkhe ding ahi.
