PAITE: Huan, a thau tengteng lemna thillat kithoihna thau lak bang un a la vek ding a; huan, siampu in TOUPA a ding in gimlim ding in maitam ah a hal ding ahi; huan, siampu in kilepna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from off of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

PAITE: Huan, khelh thoihna ding a thillat ding belamnou a hon tawi leh, a nu, gensiatbei a hon tawi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish.

PAITE: Khelh thoihna lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, haltum thillat a gohna uah khelhna thoihna ding in a gou ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in khelh thoihna sisan a khutzung in tamlou a pik ding a, haltum thillat maitam kite ah a tat ding a, sisan tengteng maitam bul ah a sungkhe ding ahi:Huan, a thau tengteng, belamnou thau, lemna thillat kithoihna a lak bang in a la vek ding a; huan, siampu in TOUPA a ding a mei a thillat bang in maitam ah a hal ding ahi: huan, siampu in a thil hihkhelhsa tung thu ah a kilepna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

PAITE: Huan, a thau tengteng, belamnou thau, lemna thillat kithoihna a lak bang in a la vek ding a; huan, siampu in TOUPA a ding a mei a thillat bang in maitam ah a hal ding ahi: huan, siampu in a thil hihkhelhsa tung thu ah a kilepna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

PAITE: Kuapeuh a thil muh hiam, a thil zak hiam a theihpih a hih a, kichiamsakmi aw a zak a leng gen nuamlou a thil a hihkhelh leh a thulimlouhna moh a po ding:
ENGLISH: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears the voice of adjuration, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

PAITE: Huan, kuapeuh in thil siangthoulou himhim, gam sa sianglou luang hiam, gan sianglou luang hiam, a vak a vak thoh ganhing sianglou luang hiam theilou a leng a khoih a, a hong sianthou kei leh siamlouh a tang ding:
ENGLISH: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

PAITE: Huan, mihing leng a sianthou louhna bangpeuh hihen aw, a sianthou louhna theilou a leng a khoih leh a theihkhiak hun chiang in siamlouh a tang ding:
ENGLISH: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

PAITE: Huan, kuapeuh in thil hoihlou hiam, thil hoih hiam hih ding a kam a theilou a leng a kichiam zialzial leh, akoi-abang hitaleh, a kichiam zialzialna theihkhiak hun chiang in siamlouh a tang ding:
ENGLISH: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty of one of these.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi ding a, hiai thilte khat a leng siamlouh a tan chiang in a khelhna a phuang ding a;
ENGLISH: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned:

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding in belam hon lak a a nu, belamnou hiam, kel hiam a thil hihkhelhsa man ding in TOUPA kiang a lan ding in a khelhna thoihna a hon tawi ding a; siampu in a khelh tungthu ah kilepna a bawlsak ding.
ENGLISH: and he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh for his sin which he has sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

PAITE: A neih in belamnou a chinzoh kei leh TOUPA kiang a lat ding in a khelhman ding in a khelh thoihna ding in vakhu nih hiam, palva nou hiam a hon tawi ding ahi; khat khelh thoihna ding in, khat haltum thillat ding in.
ENGLISH: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to Yahweh; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

PAITE: Siampu kiang ah a hon tawi ding a, aman khelh thoihna ding in a lan masa ding a, phelsuahlou in a lu a ngawng ah a hektan ding hi:
ENGLISH: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering, and wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

PAITE: Khelh thoihna sisan maitam pang ah tamlou a theh ding a, huan sisan omlai teng maitam bul ah a takkang sak ding uh ahi: huaibel khelh thoihna ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

PAITE: Huan, a khatpen dan dungzu in haltum thillat ding in a lan ding a: huan, siampu in a thil hihkhelhsa tungthu ah lemna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

PAITE: Ahihhang in a neih in vakhu nih hiam, vapal nou nih hiam a chin kei leh a khelhman thillat ding in khelh thoihna ding in tangbuang nel dimdem, epha mun sawm a khen a mun khat a hon tawi ding a; sathau a buak ding ahi kei a, a tungah begaw a koih ding ahi sam kei a, khelh thoihna a hih ziak in.
ENGLISH: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he shall bring his offering for that in which he has sinned, the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, neither shall he put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

PAITE: Siampu kiang ah a hon tawi ding a, siampu in theih gigena ding in a pham khat a la ding a, maitam tungah TOUPA a di'n mei a thillat bang in a hal ding ahi: Huaibel tatlek-thoihna ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. It is a sin offering.

PAITE: Huan, huai thil lak a bangmah leng a hihkhelhsa tungtang thu ah siampu in kilepna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding: a omlai teng tangbuang thillat bangmah in siampu tantuam ding, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Kuapeuh in thil a hihkhelh a, TOUPA thil siangthoute tung a a khelh khak leh, a khelh thoihna, belam hon lak a belampa gensiatbei, mun siangthou sekel bang in, dangka sekel bangzah hiam gun a na ngaih, tatleek kithoihna ding in TOUPA ding in a honkai ding ahi:
ENGLISH: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly, in the holy things of Yahweh; then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

PAITE: Huan, thil siangthou tung a na hih dik louh khitsa tuh a din ding a, a mun nga a khen a mun khat a behlap ding a, siampu a pe ding ahi; huan, siampu in tatleek thoihna belampa in kilepna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong in the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

PAITE: Kuapeuh in thil a hihkhelh a, hih louh ding a TOUPA'N thu a piakte a bangmah leng a hih leh, theikei mahleh siamlouh a tang himhim ding a, a thulimlouhna moh a po ding.
ENGLISH: “If anyone sins, and does any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done; though he didn’t know it, yet he is guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

PAITE: Huan, belam hon lak a belampa gensiatbei, na ngaih a kilawm hun, tatleek thoihna ding in siampu kiang a hon kai ding ahi: huan, siampu in theilou a a hihkhelh khak tungthu ah kilepna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding:Huaibel tatleek thoihna ahi: TOUPA ma ah siamlouh tang ahi mahmah ahi, chi in.
ENGLISH: He shall bring a ram without blemish from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

PAITE: Huaibel tatleek thoihna ahi: TOUPA ma ah siamlouh tang ahi mahmah ahi, chi in.
ENGLISH: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Kuapeuh in thil hihkhial in, TOUPA thu tatleek khum taleh, sum kepsak thu ah hiam, leep thu ah hiam, guktaak thu ah hiam a innsak-innkhangte khem in, a innsak-innkhangte zuaubawl taleh,
ENGLISH: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

PAITE: Ahihkei leh, van mangte mu in, khem in, zuau in kichiam leh, hiai thil tengteng a bangmah leng a hihkhelh leh,
ENGLISH: or has found that which was lost, and dealt falsely therein, and swearing to a lie; in any of all these things that a man does, sinning therein;

PAITE: Hichi ahi ding a, a khial ngei a hih a, siamlouh a tan leh a vangukte, khem a a thil lakte, a kiang a sum kepsakte, van mang a topte,
ENGLISH: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

PAITE: Zuau a a kichiamna thil bangpeuh leng a ditnawn ding ahi; a kim sipsip in a din nawn vek ding a, a mun nga a khen a mun khat a val in a behlap ding: siamlouh a tan ni in, a neitu a pe ding ahi.
ENGLISH: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely; he shall restore it even in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. To him to whom it belongs he shall give it, in the day of his being found guilty.

PAITE: A tatleek thoihna, belam hon lak a, na ngaih a kilawm hun, belampa gensiatbei tatleek thoihna ding in TOUPA ding in siampu kiang ah a honkai ding ahi:
ENGLISH: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilepna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding, siamlouh tanna ding a thil a hih peuhmah tungthu ahte, chi in.
ENGLISH: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Aron leh a tapate kiang ah, Hiai haltum thillat dan ding ahi: haltum thillat pen maitam tung a a halna ah zankhua in a zingchiang tan in a om ding a; huan, maitam a mei pen a am nilouh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in a puanmalngat puansilh a silh ding a, a sa khuhna ding in a puan malngat khekol a teng ding a; huan, maitam a haltum thillat kang vute a la ding a, maitam pang ah a koih ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen breeches upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

PAITE: Huan, a puansilh siangthou a suah ding a, puansilh dang a silh ding a, a vute dainawl lam mun siang ah a paipih ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

PAITE: Huan, maitam tung a mei ap sak nilouh ahi ding a, a mit ding ahi kei; huan, siampu in zingsang teng in sing a khul ding a, haltum thillat a koih hoih ding a, huai ah lepna thillatte thau a hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning: and he shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

PAITE: Maitam ah mei a am gige ding a, a mit ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

PAITE: Huan, hiai hi tangbuang thillat dan ding ahi: Aron tapate'n maitam bul ah, TOUPA ma ah a lat ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.

PAITE: Huan, aman a pham khat in tangbuang thillat tung a begaw tengteng a lakhe ding a, huaibel TOUPA ding a gimlim tak, theih gigena ding in maitam ah a hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial, to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, lak bangte Aron leh a tapate'n a nek ding uh ahi: huaibel mun siangthou ah silngou soh louh in a ne ding ua; kihoupihna puan inn kongtual ah a ne ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Silngou soh a kan ding ahi kei. Mei a ka thillat a a tantuan ding ua ka piak ahi; huaibel khelh thoihna leh tatleek thoihna bang a thil siangthou tak ahi.
ENGLISH: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

PAITE: Aron suan pasal tengteng in a nek ding uh ahi. Huaibel TOUPA a dia haltum thillat tungthu a na suante zel uh tan a khantawn dan ahi ding: kuapeuh huaite khoih peuhmah hihtuam ahi ding uh, chi in thu pia in, chi in.
ENGLISH: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Sathau nilh a a om ni a Aron leh a tapate'n TOUPA kiang a a lat ding uh thillat pen hiai ahi; tangbuang thillat dia lat zel ding, tangbuang nel dimdem epha sawm a khen a mun khat, zingsang in a kim, nitak in a kim.
ENGLISH: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

PAITE: A kidiah suak khit chiang in na hon la lut ding a: a kitam nengneng in tangbuang thillat TOUPA a ding in gimlim di'n na lan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

PAITE: A tapate lak a a sik a pangmi, sathau nilh siampu in a lan ding a: khantawn dan ding bang in TOUPA a di'n haltum vek ahi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burnt to Yahweh.

PAITE: Siampu tangbuang thillat peuhmah haltum vek ding ahi a, nek hetlouh ding ahi, chi in.
ENGLISH: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Hiai hi khelh thoihna dan ding ahi: haltum thillat goh zelna ah khelh thoihna leng TOUPA ma a goh ding ahi: huaibel thil siangthou tak ahi.
ENGLISH: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.

PAITE: Khelh thoihna lantu siampu in a ne ding a; kihoupihna puan in kongtual ah, mun siangthou ah nek ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Kuapeuh huai sa khoih peuhmah a siangthou ding uh: huan, a sisan in pen bangpuan peuh leng a theh leh, a banna peuhmah mun siangthou ah na sawp ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

PAITE: A huanna leibel pen sukkhap ding ahi: sum bel a huan a hih lebel nawt siang a khuah siang ding ahi.
ENGLISH: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

PAITE: Pasal siampu tengteng in huai a ne ding uh ahi: huaibel thil siangthou tak ahi.Khelh thoihna, a sisan, mun siangthou a kilepna bawlna ding a kihoupihna puan inn a hong kitawi pen nek ding ahi kei hi: mei a haltum ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Every male among the priests shall eat of it: it is most holy.

PAITE: Khelh thoihna, a sisan, mun siangthou a kilepna bawlna ding a kihoupihna puan inn a hong kitawi pen nek ding ahi kei hi: mei a haltum ding ahi.
ENGLISH: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten: it shall be burned with fire.

PAITE: Huan, Hiai tatleek thoihdan ding ahi: thil siangthou tak ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering. It is most holy.

PAITE: Haltum thillat a goh zelna ua tatleek kithoihna leng goh ding ahi: huan, a sisan a maitam theh kimvel ding ahi.
ENGLISH: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

PAITE: Huan, a thau tengteng a lat ding ahi: a mei thau takte, a sungkua thaute,
ENGLISH: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

PAITE: A kal nihte leh a boh thau, a phuk kiang a thau leh a sin tuam lap, a kalte nangawn in a suahkhe ding a:
ENGLISH: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away;

PAITE: Huan, siampu in TOUPA ding a mei a thillat ding in maitam tungah a hal ding ahi: huaibel tatleek thoihna ahi.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.

PAITE: Pasal siampu tengteng in a ne ding ua: mun siangthou a nek ding ahi: huaibel thil siangthou tak ahi.
ENGLISH: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

PAITE: Tatleek thoihna pen khelh thoihna bangmah ahi a, dan khat ahi: huai a kilepna bawltu siampu in, huai a tan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

PAITE: Siampu, kuapeuh haltum thillat latsaktu siampu ngei in haltum thillat dia a lat vun a pumtan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

PAITE: Huan, a kanna a kan tangbuang thillat peuhmah, sikbel a kan leh kuang a kan tengteng a lantu siampu a tuam ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is dressed in the pan, and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

PAITE: Tangbuang thillat tengteng sathau a mek leng, a gaw leng a dang bang mah in Aron tapate tengteng in a kihawm dialdial ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

PAITE: Huan, hiai pen mi'n TOUPA kiang a a lat ding, lepna thillat kithoih dan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh.

PAITE: Kipahthu genna dia a lat leh kipahthu genna kithoihna ding in sathau a zut silngou hel louh tanghou leh sathau a zut silngou hel louh tanghoupa didekte leh sathau a mek tangbuang nel mahmah kidiah suak a lat tel ding ahi.
ENGLISH: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

PAITE: Kipahthu genna ding a a lemna thillat kithoihna ah tanghou silngou hel a lat tel ding ahi.
ENGLISH: With cakes of leavened bread he shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving.

PAITE: Huan, huai a thillat teng a TOUPA a dia vei thillat a ding in khat chiat a lan ding a; lemna thillat sisan a thehtu siampu a tuam ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

PAITE: Huan, kipahthu genna dia a lepna thillat kithoihna sa pen thillat a lat ni mah a nekgaih ding ahi a; a zingchiang tan a bangmah sit ding ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

PAITE: Ahihhang in a thillat kithoihna pen thuchiam hiam, amah ut thu a thillat hiam ahih leh a kithoihna a lat ni mah a nek ding ahi: huan, nek bang a zingchia nek ding ahi:
ENGLISH: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice; and on the next day what remains of it shall be eaten:

PAITE: Ahihhang in kithoihna sa a ni thum ni tan a om lailai bel hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: but what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

PAITE: A lenna thillat kithoihna sa ni thum ni tan a a nek uleh, pomsak ahi kei ding a, a lantu leng a lan a sim ahi sam kei ding: thil kihhuai ahi ding a, kuapeuh a ne in a thulimlouhna moh uh a po ding uh.
ENGLISH: If any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

PAITE: Huan, sa, thil siangthoulou himhim toh kisukha nek ding ahi kei a, hal ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘The flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the flesh, everyone who is clean may eat it;

PAITE: Huan, sa a siangthou peuhmahte'n a ne ding ua, lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam, siangthoulou pi a netu bel, huai mi zaw a chipihte lak a kipan tuamkoih ding ahi
ENGLISH: but the soul who eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

PAITE: Huan, kuapeuh in thil siangthoulou himhim, mi siangthoulou hiam, gan siangthoulou hiam, thil kihhuai siangthoulou hiam himhim a khoih a, lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam a nek leh huai mi a chipihte lak a kipan tuamkoih a om ding ahi, chi in Aron leh a tapate houpih in, chi in.
ENGLISH: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam thau na ne ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

PAITE: Amah sih a si thau leh sa keih thau thil dang bang ding hiam a zat theih ahi ding: nek bel na ne himhim ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

PAITE: Kuapeuh, TOUPA a dia min mei a thillat a lat uh sathau ne zaw, huai mi a netu a chipihte lak a kipan a tuamkoih ding ahi hi.
ENGLISH: For whoever eats the fat of the animal, of which men offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

PAITE: Na omna peuh uah sisan himhim, vasa hiam, gamsa hiam sisan na ne ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

PAITE: Kuapeuh hita leh, sisan ne himhim zaw, huai mi zaw a chipihte lak a kipan a tuamkoih ding ahi, chi in Israel suante houpih in, chi in.
ENGLISH: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: TOUPA kiang a lemna thillat kithoihna lan peuhmah in, TOUPA a ding a a thillat a lemna thillat kithoihna a kipan a hong lat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

PAITE: TOUPA a ding a mei a thillat amah khut mahmah in a hon tawi ding a; a thau a awm toh a hon la ding ahi, a awm pen TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding a vei a hih theihna ding in.
ENGLISH: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in maitam ah a thau a hal ding a: a awm bel Aron leh a tapate a tuam ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

PAITE: A liang tak lam pen kilepna thillat kithoihna a kipan vei thillat ding in siampu na piak ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

PAITE: Aron tapate lak a lemna thillat sisan leh thau lantu kuapeuh in a tantuan ding in a liang tak lam a tan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

PAITE: A awm leh a liang a vei zel uh pen Israel suante a lemna thillat kithoihna a kipan ka la tuam a, Israel suante khantawn silbawl dan ding in siampu Aron leh a tapate ka pia ahi, chi in Israel suante kiang ah gen in chi in.
ENGLISH: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

PAITE: Hiai ahi siampu nna sem a TOUPA nnasem ding a a lat ni nungsiah a TOUPA ding a mei a thillat a kipan Aron tantuan leh a tapate tantuan ding;
ENGLISH: This is the anointing portion of Aaron, and the anointing portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;

PAITE: Amau sathau a nilh ni a Israel suante'n a piak ding ua TOUPA'N thu a piak. Hiai hi khantawn a a suante zel tan a a hih dan ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

PAITE: Hiai hi haltum thillat, tangbuang thillat, khelh thoihna, tatleek kithoihna dan;Sinai gamdai a Israel suante'n thillat TOUPA kiang a lat ding a thu a piak ni a Sinai tang a TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak khum.
ENGLISH: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meal offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of peace offerings;

PAITE: Sinai gamdai a Israel suante'n thillat TOUPA kiang a lat ding a thu a piak ni a Sinai tang a TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak khum.
ENGLISH: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Aron a tapate toh pi inla, puansilhte, nilhchi sathaute, khelh thoihna bawngpate, belampa nihte, tanghou silngou sohlouh bawm khat toh tawi inla;
ENGLISH: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

PAITE: Huan, mi tengteng kihoupihna puan inn kongpi kim ah omkhawm sak in, chiin.
ENGLISH: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in TOUPA'N thu a piak bang in a hih a; mi tengteng kihoupihna puan inn kongpi kim ah a omkhawm ua.
ENGLISH: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in kikhawmkhawmte kiang ah, Hiai ahi TOUPA'N hih ding a thu piak pen, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Aron leh a tapate a honpi a, a sil a.
ENGLISH: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

PAITE: Huchiin puanak a silhsak a, kawnggakna in a gak a, puanaktual a silhsak a, siampu puanak in a tuam a, siampu puanak gakna siam tak a gat in a gak a, huai in a gak belh.
ENGLISH: He put the coat on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him, and fastened it to him with it.

PAITE: Huan, awm tuamna a thuah a; huan, awmtuamna ah Urim leh Thumin a koih a.
ENGLISH: He placed the breastplate on him; and in the breastplate he put the Urim and the Thummim.

PAITE: Dial a khimsak a, huan, dial pang mal lam ah dangka-eng pek, hihtuam chiamtehna siangthou a thuah a, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in.
ENGLISH: He set the turban on his head; and on the turban, in front, he set the golden plate, the holy crown; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in nilhchi sathau a la a, biakbuk leh a sung a thil om tengteng a nilh a, a siangthousak chiat a.
ENGLISH: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

PAITE: Huan, huai mah in sagihvei maitam a theh a, maitam leh a tui-um-belsuan tengtengte, maiphiatkuang leh a thunna siangthou sak ding in a nilh hi.
ENGLISH: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

PAITE: Huan, a siangthou na ding in nilhchi sathau Aron lu ah a buak a, a nilh a.
ENGLISH: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Aron tapate a honpi a, puanak a silhsak a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in.
ENGLISH: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with coats, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, khelh thoihna bawngpa a hon kai a, Aron leh a tapate'n khelh thoihna bawngpa lu tungah a khut uh a koih uh.
ENGLISH: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

PAITE: Huan, a gou a; Mosi in sisan a la a, huaibel maitam a dia kilepna bawlna ding in a khutzung in maitam ki ah a kimvel in a tat a, maitam a siang sak a, maitam bul ah sisan a sung a, a siangthou sak hi.
ENGLISH: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

PAITE: Huan, a gilboh tengteng, a sin a lap, a kal nihte leh a thau a la a, maitam ah Mosi in a hal hi.
ENGLISH: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

PAITE: Bawngpa pen bel a vun toh, a sa toh, a ek toh, dainawl ah a hal a, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in.
ENGLISH: But the bull, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, haltum thillat belampa pen a lan a, Aron leh a tapate'n belampa lu tungah a khut a koih uh.
ENGLISH: He presented the ram of the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

PAITE: Huan, a gou a: Mosi in maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh.
ENGLISH: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

PAITE: Huan, belampa a sem a, a lu leh a sabakte leh a thau a hal hi.
ENGLISH: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

PAITE: Huan, a sungkua leh a khete a sil a; belampa pen maitam ah a vek in a hal khin: huaibel gimlim ding a haltum thillat ahi a: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi; TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in.
ENGLISH: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, belampa dang, hihtuamna belampa pen a hon lan nawn a: Aron leh a tapate'n belampa lu tungah a khut uh a koih uh.
ENGLISH: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in a gou a, a sisan a la a, Aron bil taklam dawn bang, a khut tak lam khutpi bang, a khe tak lam khepi bang a nuh hi.
ENGLISH: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Aron tapate a pi a, a bil tak lam dawn bang, a khut tak lam khutpi bang, a khe tak lam khepi bang a nuh hi: huan, maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh hi.
ENGLISH: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

PAITE: Huan, a thaute, a mei thau takte, a gilboh tengteng a a sin tuampen a lapte, a kal nih leh a thau leh a liang tak lam a la a:
ENGLISH: He took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right thigh;

PAITE: TOUPA ma a tanghou silngou soh louh bawm a kipan tanghou silnou soh louh khat leh sathau a mek tanghou pei khat leh tanghou pei pa khat a la a, sathau tung leh a liang tak lam tungah a khoih a:
ENGLISH: and out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat, and on the right thigh.

PAITE: Huan, a vek in Aron khutpek tungah leh a tapate khutpek tungah a koih a, TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding in a vei hi.
ENGLISH: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in a khut a kipan a la a, haltum thillat tungah maitam ah a hal a; huabel gimlim ding a a hihtuam na ahi: TOUPA ding a mei a thillat ahi.
ENGLISH: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in a awm a la a, TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding in a vei a: hihtuam na belampa a Mosi tantuan ahi, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in.
ENGLISH: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in nilhchi sathau a kipan leh maitam sisan a a la a, huai in Aron leh a puansilh a theh a; a tapate leh a tapate puansilh a theh a; a tapate leh a tapate puansilhte leng; Aron leh a puansilh a hih siangthou a, a tapate leh a tapate puansilhte leng.
ENGLISH: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Aron leh a tapate kiang ah, Kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah sa pen huan unla, Aron leh a tapate'n a nek ding uh ahi, chia thu ka piak bang in, huai ah hihtuamna bawm a tanghou toh ne un.
ENGLISH: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the flesh at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

PAITE: Huan sa leh tanghou nekbangte na hal ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: What remains of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

PAITE: Na kihihtuam na ni uh chin masiah kihoupihna puan inn kongpi pawtsan lou in ni sagih na om ding uh ahi: ni sagih noute a hon hihtuam sin ngal a.
ENGLISH: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

PAITE: Tuni a hihsa bang in, nou a ding a kilepna hon bawlsak ding, hih ding in TOUPA'N thu a peta hi.
ENGLISH: What has been done this day, so Yahweh has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

PAITE: Kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah ni sagih, sun leh zan na om nilouh ding ua, na sih louhna ding un TOUPA thupiak na zuih ding uh ahi, huchi bang a thupiak a om ka hi.Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi zang a hih ding a thu apiak tengteng Aron leh a tapate'n a hih uhi.
ENGLISH: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

PAITE: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi zang a hih ding a thu apiak tengteng Aron leh a tapate'n a hih uhi.
ENGLISH: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.

PAITE: Huan, Hichi ahi a, a ni giat ni in Mosi in Aron leh a tapate leh Israel upate a sam a:
ENGLISH: It happened on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

PAITE: Huan, Aron kiang ah, Khelh thoihna ding in bawngnou a pa leh a haltum thillat ding in belampa gensiatbei tuaktuak kai inla, TOUPA ma ah lan in.
ENGLISH: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante kiang ah, Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa, huan haltum thillat ding in bawngnou leh belamnou kum khat a upa tuaktuak gensiatbei chiat.
ENGLISH: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

PAITE: Leh bawngpa leh belampa TOUPA ma a lepna thillat a lat ding in hon kai unla; huan, sathau a mek tangbuang thillat toh: tuni in na kiang uah TOUPA a hong lang sin ahi, chi in hilh in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in thu a piak bang in kihoupihna puan inn kong ah a hon kai ua; huan, mi tengteng in a va naih ua, TOUPA ma ah a va ding uh.
ENGLISH: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in, Hiai ahi na hih ding ua TOUPA'N thu a hon piak: huchi in TOUPA thupina na lak uah a hong lang ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do: and the glory of Yahweh shall appear to you.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Aron kiang ah, Maitam hon naih inla, na khelh thoihnate, na haltum thillatte lan inla, nang a ding leh mipite a ding in kilemna bawl in: huan, mipite thillat pen lan inla, amau a ding in kilepna bawl in, TOUPA thupiak bang in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them; as Yahweh commanded.”

PAITE: Huan, Aron in maitam a va naih a, amah a tuam a khelh thoihna bawngnou a gou a.
ENGLISH: So Aaron drew near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

PAITE: Huan, Aron tapate'n sisan a kiang ah a lan ua, sisan ah a khutzung a diah a, maitam kite ah a tat a, sisan pen maitam bul ah a sung a:
ENGLISH: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:

PAITE: Khelh thoihna thaute, a kalte, a sin tuam pen lapte bel maitam tungah a hal a, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in.
ENGLISH: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, a sa leh a vun dainawl ah a hal.
ENGLISH: The flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

PAITE: Huan, haltum a thillat pen a gou a; Aron tapate'n sisan a pua ua, aman maitam kimvel in a theh.
ENGLISH: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

PAITE: Haltum thillat sabak khatkhat in a lu toh a pia ua, aman maitam ah a na hal a.
ENGLISH: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burned them upon the altar.

PAITE: Huan, a sungkuate, a khete a sil a, maitam ah haltum thillat tungah a hal a.
ENGLISH: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

PAITE: Huan, mipite thillat pen a lan a, mipite khelh thoihna kel a kai a, a gou a, a ma a mah bang in khelh thoihna di'n a lan hi.
ENGLISH: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

PAITE: Huan, haltum thillat a lan a, a dan bangbang in a lan hi.
ENGLISH: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

PAITE: Huan, tangbuang thillat a lan a, huailai a a pham khat a la a, zingsang lam a haltum thillat chih louh leng maitam ah a hal lai hi.
ENGLISH: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.

PAITE: Huan, mipte a tuam dia lepna thillat kithoihna bawngpa leh elampa leng a gou a; huan, Aron tapate'n a sisan a pia ua, maitam a kimvel in a theh hi;
ENGLISH: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar,

PAITE: Huan, bawngpa thau leh belampa thaute, a mei thau takte, a gilbohte, a kalte, a sintuam pen a lapte leng a pia ua:
ENGLISH: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver:

PAITE: A thau pen a awm tungah a koih ua, huan, aman a thau pen maitam ah a hal hi.
ENGLISH: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar:

PAITE: Huan, a awm leh a liang tak lam pen Aron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in a vei a; Mosi thupiak bang in.

PAITE: Huan, Aron in mipi lam ah a ban a zak a, a vek un vual a zawl a; huan, khelh thoihna leh haltum thillat leh, lemna thillat a lat khit in a hon pai suk.
ENGLISH: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi leh Aron kihoupihna puan inn ah a va lut ua, huan, a hong pawtkhe nawn ua, mipite a vualzawl ua; huan, TOUPA thupina mi tengteng ah a hong lang hi.Huan, TOUPA ma a kipan mei a hong pawtkhia a, haltum thillat leh thaute maitam ah a kangman ta a: huan, mipi tengteng in huai a muh un a kikou zuazua ua, a khupboh khekhup uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to all the people.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA ma a kipan mei a hong pawtkhia a, haltum thillat leh thaute maitam ah a kangman ta a: huan, mipi tengteng in huai a muh un a kikou zuazua ua, a khupboh khekhup uhi.
ENGLISH: There came forth fire from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar: and when all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

PAITE: Aigupta gam akipan a hongpawt uh kum nih kum, kha nihna, ni khat niin Sinai gamdai ah kihoupihna puanin ah TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

PAITE: Israel saunte a omkhawm tengteng, a chi chiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin pasal tengteng sim vekin;
ENGLISH: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one;

PAITE: Kum sawmnih akipan tunglam Israel laka galkap thei chiang peuhmah nang leh Aronin a pawlpawlin na sim vek ding uhi.
ENGLISH: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall number them by their divisions.

PAITE: Huan, na kiangah nam chih laka khat, inkuana lupen jel a om ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: With you there shall be a man of every tribe; everyone head of his fathers’ house.

PAITE: Huan, hiaite na kianga om dingte min ahi: Reuben nama Sedeur tapa Elizur,
ENGLISH: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

PAITE: Simeon nama Zurisaddai tapa Selumiel.
ENGLISH: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

PAITE: Juda nama Amminadab tapa Nahson.
ENGLISH: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

PAITE: Isakar nama Zuar tapa Nethanel.
ENGLISH: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

PAITE: Zebulun nama Helon tapa Eliab.
ENGLISH: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

PAITE: Joseph tate, Ephraim nama Ammihud tapa Elisama: Manasseh nama Pedahzur tapa Gamaliel.
ENGLISH: Of the children of Joseph: Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud. Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

PAITE: Benjamin nama Gideoni tapa Abidan.
ENGLISH: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

PAITE: Dan nama Ammisaddai tapa Ahiezer.
ENGLISH: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

PAITE: Aser nama Okran tapa Pagiel.
ENGLISH: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

PAITE: Gad nama Deuel tapa Eliasaph.
ENGLISH: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

PAITE: Naphtali nama Enan tapa Ahira.
ENGLISH: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

PAITE: Hiaite mipite tel, a pi leh pute uh nama lupen Israel inkuana lupente ahi uh, chiin.
ENGLISH: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

PAITE: Huchiin Mosi leh Aronin huai mi a min uh a lohte uh a pi ua:
ENGLISH: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

PAITE: Mipi tengteng kha nihna, ni khat niin a sam khawm vek ua; a chichiin, a inkuan kuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam teng a pipute uh min a taklang uhi.
ENGLISH: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

PAITE: TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangin Sinai gamdai ah a simta hi.
ENGLISH: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

PAITE: Israel tapa upapen, Reuben tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin pasal kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Reuben nam, a simte uh sing li leh sang guk leh za nga ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

PAITE: Simeon tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin pasal kum sawmnih akipan tunglam galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were numbered of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Simeon nam, a simte uh sing nga leh sang kua leh za thum ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

PAITE: Gad tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin pasal kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Gad nama, a simte uh sing li leh sang nga leh za guk leh sawmnga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

PAITE: Juda tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizomdan bangjelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thie teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Juda nama, a simte uh sing sagih leh sang li leh za guk ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were sixty-four thousand six hundred.

PAITE: Isakar tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizom dan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Isakar nama, a simte uh sing nga leh sang li leh za li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Zebulun tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh kizom dan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Zebulun nama, a simte uh sing nga leh sang sagih leh za li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Joseph tate laka Ephraim tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Joseph, of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Ephraim nama, a simte uh sing li leh za nga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

PAITE: Manase tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Manase nama, a simte uh, sing thum leh sang nih leh za nih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

PAITE: Benjamin tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

PAITE: Benjamin nama, a simte uh, sing thum leh sang nga leh za li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Dan tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

PAITE: Dan nama, a simte uh, sing guk leh sang nih leh za sagih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

PAITE: Aser tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

PAITE: Aser nama, a simte uh, sing li leh sang khat leh za nga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

PAITE: Naphtali tate suante a chichiin, a inkuankuanin, a min uh tamdan bang jelin kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei teng a sim ua;
ENGLISH: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

PAITE: Naphtali nama, a simte uh, sing nga leh sang thum leh za li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Huaite ahi uh, Mosi leh Aronin Israel lupen sawm leh nih, inkuana lupente toh a simte.
ENGLISH: These are those who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: they were each one for his fathers’ house.

PAITE: Huchiin Israel suan a inkuankuan ua kum sawmnih akipan tunglam, galkap thei chiang teng, Israel gamate sim ahi uh;
ENGLISH: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel;

PAITE: A simte teng uh nuai guk leh sang thum leh za nga leh sawmnga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: even all those who were numbered were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

PAITE: Levite pipute jaw a simtel kei uh.
ENGLISH: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

PAITE: TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Levi chi jaw na simtel ding ahi keia, Israel mite lakah na simtel ding ahi sam kei:
ENGLISH: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

PAITE: Levite jaw theihsakna biakbuk kemmite leh van tengteng kemmite dia seh jawk ding ahi: biakbuka van tengteng a zong jel ding ua, a kem ding ua, tua biakbuk a kimvelin a omkhum ding uh.
ENGLISH: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle, and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

PAITE: Huan, biakbuk malama a pai chiangin Leviten a phel ding ua; huan, biakbuk kaih ding chiangin Levite mahin a kai nawn ding uh; nam dang a hongkigolh peuhmah hihlup ding ahi.
ENGLISH: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suanten amau mun chiat ah, a pawlpawlin a tamdan uh dungjui jelin a puaninte uh a kai ding uh.
ENGLISH: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

PAITE: Leviten Israel suante khawmpi tunga hehna a omlouhna dingin theihsakna biakbuk kimvelah a akai ding uhi; Leviten theihsakna biakbuk a kep ding uh ahi, chia thu a nagentak jiakin,Huchibangin Israel suanten ahih uh; TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak tengteng bangin, huchibangin a hih uh.
ENGLISH: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

PAITE: Huchibangin Israel suanten ahih uh; TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak tengteng bangin, huchibangin a hih uh.
ENGLISH: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Dangka pengkul nih bawl inla; sekthohin bawlin: mipite sap khawmna ding leh pawtsakna dinga na zat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.

PAITE: Huai a kimut chiangin mipi tengteng na kiangah kihoupihna puanin kongkhak bulah a hongkikhop vek ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, khat lel a mut uleh Israel mipite heutu intekpente kia na kianga a honpai khawm ding uh ahi ding.
ENGLISH: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

PAITE: Huan, gallau muta na mut uleh suahlam panga omte a pawt ding uh ahi ding,
ENGLISH: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

PAITE: Huan, gallau muta na mut nawm uleh simlam panga omte a pawt ding uh ahi; a pawtna ding un gallau mut banga a mut ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

PAITE: Ahihhangin mipite hongpai khawmna dingin na mut peuhmah ding ua, gallau muta bel mut louin.
ENGLISH: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

PAITE: Aron tapa siamputen pengkul a mut ding uh ahi; huai nou dingin na suante uh tana khantawn dan ding ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

PAITE: Na gam ua melma nou honnuaisiahte dou dinga na kuan chiang un gallau mutin pengkulte na mut ding uh ahi; huchiin TOUPAN na Pathian ma uah theihgige na hi ding uh, na melmate uh lakah humbit na hi ding uh.
ENGLISH: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

PAITE: Nuam na sak ni te un, a hunbia na ankuangluinate uah, na kha thakte uah na halmang thillat uahte leh na kilemna thillat kithoihnate uah pengkul na mut ding uh ahi; huchiin na Pathian ma uah noua dingin theihgigena ahi ding: kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chiin.
ENGLISH: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

PAITE: Huah, kum nihna kha nihna, huai kha ni sawmnih niin, hichi ahi, meipi meipi theihsakna biakbuk tung apat a tungkah sangta hi.
ENGLISH: It happened in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.

PAITE: Huchiin Israel suante a paidan uh dungjuiin Sinai gamdai akipana a pawt uh; huan Paran gamdai ah meipi a khawlta.
ENGLISH: The children of Israel went forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

PAITE: Mosi zanga TOUPA thupiak bangin a pawt phot ua.
ENGLISH: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

PAITE: A masapenin Juda pawlte a pawl uh tamdan dungjui jelin a pawt ua: a heutu Aminadab tapa Nason ahi.
ENGLISH: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

PAITE: Isakarte heutu zuar tapa Nethanel ahi.
ENGLISH: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

PAITE: Zubulunte heute Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
ENGLISH: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

PAITE: Huan, biakbuk a phel ua, Gerson tapa leh Merari tapa biakbuk zongmite a pawt ua,
ENGLISH: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

PAITE: Huan, Reubente a pawl uh tamdan dungjuiin a pawt ua: a heutu Seder tapa Elizur ahi.
ENGLISH: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

PAITE: Simeonte heutu Zurisadai tapa Selumiel ahi.
ENGLISH: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

PAITE: Gadte heute Deuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
ENGLISH: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

PAITE: Huan, Kohathten mun siangthou a zong ua, a pawt uh: huan a dangten a tun tak un biakbuk a nalam ua.
ENGLISH: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

PAITE: Ephraimte a pawl uh tamdan dungjuiin a pawt ua: a heutu Emihud tapa Elisam ahi.
ENGLISH: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

PAITE: Manasete heutu Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
ENGLISH: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

PAITE: Benjaminte heutu Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
ENGLISH: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

PAITE: Huan, a nanungpenin Dante a pawl uh tamdan dungjuiin a pawt uh: a heutu Amisadai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
ENGLISH: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

PAITE: Aserte heute Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
ENGLISH: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

PAITE: Naphtalite heute Enan tapa Ahir ahi.
ENGLISH: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

PAITE: Huchibang ahi Israel suante a pawl uh tamdan dungjuia a paidan uh; huchibang takin a pawtta uh.
ENGLISH: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi sungpa Midianmi Reuel tapa Hobab kiangah, Mosiin, Kon pe ding, TOUPAN a chihna munah ka hoh sin ua, ka kiang uah hong sam inla, hoihtakin na tungah ka hih ding uh: TOUPAN Israel suante tungtang thu lah hoihtakin a genta ngala, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

PAITE: Aman a kingah, Ka hong dah mai ding, kou gama ah ka tanaute kiangah ka pai zo mai ding, a chi.
ENGLISH: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, Hongpai san mahmah ken, gamdai ah lah giahbuk satna ding na thei zo ngala, kou dingin mit na honghi ding hi.
ENGLISH: He said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi dinga, ka kiang ua na hong tei aleh, ahi, hichi ahi dinga, TOUPAN thil hoih hohhihsak bangjelin ka honhihsak sam jel ding uhi, a chi a,
ENGLISH: It shall be, if you go with us, yes, it shall be, that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPA tang akipana ni thum lamah a pai uh; huan, TOUPA thukhun bawm amau adinga kingakna mun lem zongin a ma uah ni thum lam ah a na pai masa.
ENGLISH: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of the covenant of Yahweh went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

PAITE: A buk ua kipan a pawt un TOUPA meipi sunin a tunguah a om jel hi.
ENGLISH: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, huai bawm a pawt sin peuhmah chiangin Mosiin, TOUPA aw, hongkisa inla, na melmate hawljak inla, nang honhote na maah taikek uhen, a chi jel a.Huan, a kingakna peuhin, TOUPA aw Israel mipite kiangah hongkik nawnin, a chi jel uhi.
ENGLISH: It happened, when the ark went forward, that Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

PAITE: Huan, a kingakna peuhin, TOUPA aw Israel mipite kiangah hongkik nawnin, a chi jel uhi.
ENGLISH: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

PAITE: Huan, Mippen TOUPA jakin phunhatte bangin thil hoihlou pipi a gen nak ua; huai TOUPAN a najakin a hehta hi; huchiin TOUPA mei a lak uah a hongkisaa, a giahna polam uh a kang juajua hi.
ENGLISH: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger was kindled; and Yahweh’s fire burnt among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

PAITE: Huchiin mipiten Mosi a sam ua; huan, Mosi TOUPA kiangah a thuma, mei a mitta hi.
ENGLISH: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.

PAITE: Huailai mun min Tabera a chi uh, TOUPA mei a lak ua a hongkak jiakin.
ENGLISH: The name of that place was called Taberah Taberah means “burning” , because Yahweh’s fire burnt among them.

PAITE: Huan, a lak ua nam dang toh kilaktenten sa lunggulhna a hon neita ua; Israel suan te leng a kap nawn ua, Kua ahia sa nek ding honpe ding?
ENGLISH: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us flesh to eat?

PAITE: Ut leh daha Aigupta gama ngasa i nek jelte I theigigea, tangmaite, mazelte, phulun sialnek chite, vaiphulunte, phulun ngoute leng;
ENGLISH: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

PAITE: Himahleh tuin I guhngek uh a keu khinta, bangmah lamet ding mahmah a omkei, manna lel loungal, a chi uh.
ENGLISH: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

PAITE: Manna bel koriander tang bang, a latdain jaw tuikepsuang bang ahi.
ENGLISH: The manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like the appearance of bdellium.

PAITE: Miten a tom khawm ua, gawinelna ah a gawi nel ua, sumte bangah a su ua, belte bangin a huan ua, tanghoute bangin a bawl uh: nekin sathaua kan tanghou bang ahi.
ENGLISH: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

PAITE: Giahna muna jana dai a kiakin manna leng a hongkia.
ENGLISH: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

PAITE: Huan, mipite a inkuankuan un a puanin kongkhak chiat uah a kap uh chih Mosiin a naja a; huan, TOUPA a heh mahmaha; Mosi leng a lungkimkei hi.
ENGLISH: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the anger of Yahweh was kindled greatly; and Moses was displeased.

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPA kiangah, Bangjiakin ahia na sikha non sukgim, bangchidan ahia na mit ka tunlouhna, hiai mite tengteng puakgik ka tunga na ngak?
ENGLISH: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated with your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

PAITE: Hiai mipite tengteng ka suan ahi uh maw? A pi leh pute uh kianga kichiama piak na chiam gama pi lut dingin, Naupommiin nawitui ne lai a pom bangin na angsungah pomin, na honchih dinga ka pikhiak hon?
ENGLISH: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them forth, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers?’

PAITE: Hiai mipi tengteng piak ding koi akipanin ahia sa ka neih ding? Ka nek ding un sa honpiain, chia kapin lah a honsual ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Where could I get meat to give to all this people? For they weep to me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

PAITE: Hiai mipi tengteng keimah kiain ka po zou kei, kei dingin a gik lua hi.
ENGLISH: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

PAITE: Hichibanga honhih ding na hihleh, honhehpih inla, honsisak vanglakin, honhihgenthei nawn kei mahmahin, a chi a.
ENGLISH: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi kiangah, Israelte upa, mipite upa leh a heutu uh hia na theih mi sawmsagihte ka kiangah honpi khawm inla, kihoupihna puanin ah nangmah toh ding khawm din honpiin.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

PAITE: Huchiin ka hongpawt dinga, huailaiah ka hon houpih ding: huan, nang a kha pen a tunguah ka koih ding; nang kian po louin mipite puakgik a hon puakpih ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you not bear it yourself alone.

PAITE: Huan, nang mipite kiangah, Jingchiang adingin kihihsiangthou vek unla; huchiin sa na ne tawk ding uh: Sa nek ding kuan ahia honpe sin? Aigupta gama nuam I saksak utoh, chiin TOUPA jakin na kap ua; huaijiakin TOUPAN sa nou a honpe ding hi, na ne tawk ding uh.
ENGLISH: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves against tomorrow, and you will eat flesh; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us flesh to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you flesh, and you will eat.

PAITE: Nikhat kia, ni nih kia, ni sawm kia, ii, ni sawmnih kia leng na ne kei ding ua;
ENGLISH: You will not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,

PAITE: Himahleh kha khat pumlum, na nakvang ua a hongpawt khiaka nou dia kihhuai a honmghih matan na ne ding uh; na lak ua om TOUPA na deih louh ua, Aigupta gam akipan bangdia pai khia I hi ua? Chia, a maa na kah jiak un.
ENGLISH: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because that you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

PAITE: Huan, Mosiin, ka ompih mipite khea pai thei ngen leng nuai guk ahi uh: kha khat pumlum nek ding sa ka pe ding, na chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.’

PAITE: Belam hon leh gan hon zong gohsak lehang, a kham ding ua hia? tuipia ngasa tengteng leng matsak vek leng zong, a khamzou ding ua hia? achi a.
ENGLISH: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN, Mosi kiangah, TOUPA khut a tomta ahia? Na tungah ka thu banga a tun leh tun louh na thei mai ding, achi a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosi a pawta, TOUPA thu mipite a hilh hi: huan, mipite upa sawmsagihte a sam khawma, Puan in kimah a dingsak hi.
ENGLISH: Moses went out, and told the people the words of Yahweh; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

PAITE: Huchiin, TOUPA meipi ah a hongsuka, a honghoupiha, amah a kha pen upa sawmsagihte tungah a koiha; huan, hichi ahia, kha a tung ua a koihtakin thu a gen bualbual ua; himahleh huchibang a hihhih nawnta kei uhi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders: and it happened that when the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

PAITE: Himahleh buk ah mi nih a om lai ua khat min Eldad ahi, khatpen min Medad ahi: kha a tunguah a oma, simte laka tel ahi uh, kihoupihna puanin ah bel a hoh tei kei uh: buk ah thu a gen bualbual uh.
ENGLISH: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested on them; and they were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

PAITE: Huchiin tangval khat a vataia, Mosi a vahilha, Eldad leh Medadin buk ah thu a gen bualbual mai uh, achi a.
ENGLISH: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

PAITE: Huan, Nun tapa Josua, a tuailai akipana Mosi nasempan a dawnga, Ka pu Mosi, kham ve, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

PAITE: Huan, Mosiin a kiangah, Kei jiakin thik na hi hia? Pathian mi tengteng jawlnei hi vek le uh, TOUPAN a tunguah tua kha koih chiat leh chih laitaka! A chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosi buk ah a lut nawna, amah leh Israelte upate toh.
ENGLISH: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA kiang akipanin huih a hongnunga, tuipi lam akipan vengkeng a honmut lenga, buk lehlamsang ni khat lam, a lehlamsang ni khat lam tuaktuak dimsuakin buk kima tong nih khawng dinga sangin a kesaka.
ENGLISH: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

PAITE: Huan, mipiten huai nitum leh jankhua leh, a jing nitumin vengkeng a vatom khawm uh: a tom tawmpenin leng homer sawm a tom: buk kimah amau achiat a phou uhi.
ENGLISH: The people rose up all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; 1 homer is about 220 litres or 6 bushels and they spread them all abroad for themselves around the camp.

PAITE: Huan, huai sa a nek lai uh, a nek khit ma un, mipite tungah TOUPA a heh mahmaha, mipite hipi thupi mahmahin TOUPAN a gawtta hi.
ENGLISH: While the flesh was yet between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of Yahweh was kindled against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.

PAITE: Huaimun min dingin Kibrot-hattava a chi uh; huaiah sa duhgawlna neite a vui jiakun.Huan, Kibrot-hattava akipanin mipite Hazeroth ah a pai ua; Hazeroth ah a omta uh.
ENGLISH: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, Kibroth Hattaavah means “graves of lust.” because there they buried the people who lusted.

PAITE: Huan, Kibrot-hattava akipanin mipite Hazeroth ah a pai ua; Hazeroth ah a omta uh.
ENGLISH: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

PAITE: Huan, Miriam leh Aronin Mosiin Kus numei ji dia a neih jiakin a gensiaua; Kus numei bel a nei ngei ngala.
ENGLISH: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

PAITE: Amau, Mosi kiangah kia hia TOUPAN thu a gen tuam? Ei kiangah leng a gen sam ka hia? a chi ua.
ENGLISH: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

PAITE: Huai TOUPAN a naiaa. Mosi bel leitunga mihing tengteng dia migi petmah ahi.
ENGLISH: Now the man Moses was very humble, above all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi leh Aron leh Miriam kiangah TOUPAN, Na thum un hongpai suk unla, kihoupihna puanin ah hongpai un, a chi guiha. Huchiin a thum un a vahoh uh.
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA meipi ding ah a hongpai suka, Puan in kongkhak ah a hong dinga. Aron leh Miriam a sama; huan, a nih un a hongpai suk ua,
ENGLISH: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

PAITE: Huan, aman, Ka thu ngaikhia un; na lak ua jawlnei na om uleh amah kiangah kei TOUPA kilaknain ka kihil dinga, manglamin ka houpih ding.
ENGLISH: He said, “Hear now my words. If there is a prophet among you, I Yahweh will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

PAITE: Ka sikha Mosi jaw huchibang ahi kei; ka inkote tengteng ah jaw a muanhuai ahi.
ENGLISH: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

PAITE: Amah toh jaw paukamin thuguk om louin teltakin ka kihou ding ua; TOUPA mel leng a mu ding; huaijiakin ka sikha Mosi bangchidana gense ngam na hi ua? a na chi a.
ENGLISH: With him I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPA a tunguah a heh mahmaha, a pai nawn ta hi.
ENGLISH: The anger of Yahweh was kindled against them; and he departed.

PAITE: Huan, puan in tunga meipi a kikhintaa; huan, ngaiin, Miriam vuk bang maia ngouin a hongphakta; Aroin Miriam a ena, ngaiin, phak a na hita mai hi.
ENGLISH: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

PAITE: Huchiin Aronin Mosi kiangah, ka pu aw, ka tunguah khelhna nga mahmah ken, haihuai takin ka na hih ua, ka na khialta uhi.
