ENGLISH: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

PAITE: Mi a nu sul akipan a hongpawt tung akipana sisa phial mahmah bangin om mahmah kei hen, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosiin, Pathian aw, damsak nawn dihve, chiin TOUPA a ngen hi.
ENGLISH: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi kiangah, A pan a mai chil a siat hilhialin leng ni sagih a zakta sin kei ding maw? Dainawl ah ni sagih bu le uh, huaichiangin pi lut nawn hileh, achi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

PAITE: Huchiin Miriam pen dainawl ah ni sagih a bu manga; Miriam a pi lut nawn ma un mipite a kisuan kei uh.Huai khintin mipite Nazeroth akipan a pawt ua, Paran gamdai ah giahbuk a sat uhi.
ENGLISH: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

PAITE: Huai khintin mipite Nazeroth akipan a pawt ua, Paran gamdai ah giahbuk a sat uhi.
ENGLISH: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante ka piak, Kanan gam vaenkhe dingin mite sawl dih ve; a nam inko chih ua mi, a intekpapen lak ua mi khat chiat jel na sawl ding ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosiin Paran gamdai akipanin TOUPA thupiak bangin a kuansakta chiat hi; a vek un Israel suante laka intekpapen chiat ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.

PAITE: Hiaite a min uh ahi; Reuben nam laka mi Zakur tapa samu.
ENGLISH: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

PAITE: Simeon nam laka mi Hori tapa Saphat.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

PAITE: Juda nam laka mi jephune tapa Kaleb.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

PAITE: Isakar nam laka mi Joseph tapa Igal.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

PAITE: Ephraim nam laka mi Nun tapa Hose.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

PAITE: Benjamin nam laka mi laka mi Raphu tapa Palti.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

PAITE: Aebulun nam laka mi Sodi tapa Gadiel.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

PAITE: Joseph nam (Manase nam a chih uh) laka mi Susi tapa Gadi.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

PAITE: Dan nam laka mi Gemali tapa Amiel.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

PAITE: Aser nam laka mi kikael tapa Sethur.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

PAITE: Naphtali nam laka mi Vopsi tapa Nabi.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

PAITE: Gad nam laka mi Maki tapa Geuel.
ENGLISH: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

PAITE: Hiaite gam enkhe dinga Mosiin a sawlte min ahi. Nun tapa Hose Mosiin Josua a chi.
ENGLISH: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

PAITE: Huchiin Mosiin Kanan gam enkhe dingin amaute a sawla, a kiang uah, Simlam lampi ah pai phot unla, tangte khawng kahtou unla:
ENGLISH: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country:

PAITE: Huai gam bangchi bang ahia chihte, huaia teng mipite a hat uh hia hatlou chih te a tawm uleh a tam te uh;
ENGLISH: and see the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

PAITE: A omna gam uh a hoih hia hoihlou chihte, a omna khuate uh bangchi bang ahia, puanin maimah hia kulh nei chihte,
ENGLISH: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

PAITE: Huan, huai gam lei hoih hia lei gawng, a gammang hia manglou chih te vaenkhia unla. Huan, hangsan takin om unla, mi gam theigahte honpua un, a chi a. Grep gah masa gah hun laitak ahi.
ENGLISH: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.”

PAITE: Huchiin a pawt touta ua, Huai gam Zin gamdai akipana Hamath lutna Rehob tanin a enkhe vek uh.
ENGLISH: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

PAITE: Simlam ah a hohtou phot ua, Hebron a vatung ua, huailaiah Anak suan Ahinamte, Sesaite, Talmaite a om uh. (Hebron bel Aigupta gama Zoan kilam ma kum sagiha kilam khin ahi).
ENGLISH: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

PAITE: Huan, Eskil guam a vatung ua, huaiah grep gah bawm khat ahiang toh a sat tan ua, chiangin mi nihin a jawng uh: pomgranet theite leh theipite leng pua uh.
ENGLISH: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

PAITE: Huailai bel Eskol guam a chi ua; Israel suanten huai akipan grep bawm a sat khiak jiak un.
ENGLISH: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

PAITE: Huan, gam a vaetkhiakna uah ni sawmli a tam ua, a hongnawnta uhi.
ENGLISH: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

PAITE: Huchiin Paran gamdaia Kades ah Mosi leh Aron leh Israel suan mipi tengteng kiang a hongtung ua, a kiang uah leh mipi tengteng kiangah thu a hontun ua, huai gam theite a lak uhi.
ENGLISH: They went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them, and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

PAITE: Huan, a kiangah, Na honsawlna gamah ka hoh ua, bawngnawitui leh khuaiju luanna a nahi ngeingut; hiai a gama thei ahi.
ENGLISH: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us; and surely it flows with milk and honey; and this is its fruit.

PAITE: Himahleh a gama mi omte mi hat pipi ahi ua, khuate leng kulhnei, thupi taktak ahi: huan, Anak suante leng ka mu uhi.
ENGLISH: However the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

PAITE: Amalekte Simlam gamah a gam ua; Hitte, Jebuste, Amorte, tanggam ahte a om uh: huan, Kanante bel tuipi gei leh Jordan lui dungah a om uh, chiin a hilh ua.
ENGLISH: Amalek dwells in the land of the South: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the hill country; and the Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosi maah Kalebin mipite a daisak khekhup a, Kisa tou zok ni, vala tou zok ni, I zou ngeingei ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.”

PAITE: Himahleh a hohpihten, I vazou thei vek kei ding e, ei sangin lah a hat ngal ua, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

PAITE: Huchiin Israel suante kiangah a vagam etkhiak uh, Gam enkhe dinga ka vavakna uh, a sunga mi tengte nek khit hatmi ahi ua; huan, a mi om ka muhte uh mi awmkhauh pipi ahi uh.Huan, huaiah Anak suante, mi liante, awmkhauh pipi ka vamu u; khaupe bang lelin ka kimu ua, amau leng khaupe ek bang lelin a honmu uh, chiin a hoihlou lamin a gen uh.
ENGLISH: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

PAITE: Huan, huaiah Anak suante, mi liante, awmkhauh pipi ka vamu u; khaupe bang lelin ka kimu ua, amau leng khaupe ek bang lelin a honmu uh, chiin a hoihlou lamin a gen uh.
ENGLISH: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

PAITE: HUCHIIN omkhawmte tengteng aw suak hialin a kap ua; huai janin mite a kapkap uhi.
ENGLISH: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

PAITE: Israel suante tengteng Mosi tung leh Aron tungah a phun ua: omkhawmte tengtengin a kiang uah, Aigupta gamah pathianin honhihlum geih hileh aw! Ahihkeileh gamdai ah honna hihlum geih hileh aw!
ENGLISH: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said to them, “Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would that we had died in this wilderness!

PAITE: Bangachia namsaua si maimah dinga Pathianin hiai gama honpi ahi de aw? I ji I tate lah mat maimah ding ahi ngal ua: Aigupta gama kik nawn eia dia hoihzo lou ding hia? a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be a prey: wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

PAITE: Huchiin a kihou khawm ua, Heutu bawl ni e, Aigupta gamah kik nawn ni, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: They said one to another, “Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosi leh Aron Israel suante mipi omkhawm tengteng maah a khupboh uh.
ENGLISH: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, Nun tapa Josua leh Jephune tapa Kaleb, gam vaenkhete laka telten a puan uh a botkek ua:
ENGLISH: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes:

PAITE: Israel suante omkhawm tengteng kiangah, Enkhe dinga ka vavakna gam uh gam hoihtak ahi.
ENGLISH: and they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.

PAITE: I tung ua TOUPA a kipah leh huai gamah a honpi ding, honpe ding: huai nawitui leh khuaiju luanna gam.
ENGLISH: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us; a land which flows with milk and honey.

PAITE: TOUPA tungah hel kei phot leu chin, huai gama mite leng lau samkei un, I an ding uh ahi mai ua, a kihumbitna uh bangmah ahi kei; TOUPA I kiang uah a om hi, amau kihta kei un, chiin a gen uh.
ENGLISH: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”

PAITE: Himahleh omkhawmte tengtengin suanga den a sawm uh. Huchiin TOUPA thupina kihoupihna puanin Israel suante tengteng maah a honglangta hi.
ENGLISH: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The glory of Yahweh appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPAN Mosi kiangah, Hiai mipiten bangtan ahia honthuseh louh dina ua, a lak ua chiamtehna ka hih sek nangawna leng bangtan ahia hontaksan sin louh uh?
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

PAITE: Hiin ka gawt dinga, ka in-gam sak dinga, nangmah ah a sang ua thupi leh thilhihthei jaw nam ka bawlkhe zo mai ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosiin TOUPA kiangah, Aigupta miten a za kha ding uh; hiai mite lah a lak ua kipana na thilhihtheihnaa na pikhiak ahi ngal ua;
ENGLISH: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them;

PAITE: Hiai gama mite a hilh ding ua: hiai mipite lakah na om chih a zata uh; kimaituah hialin lah a honmuta ngal ua, na meipi a tunguah a om sek a; huan, sunin meipi ding, janin meiin a ma uh lah na pi jel ngala.
ENGLISH: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are in the midst of this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

PAITE: Hiai mipite na thahgam leh na minthangna ja namten.
ENGLISH: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

PAITE: TOUPAN hiai mite kichiama achiam gama a pi theihlouh jiakin gamdai ah a hihlum ahi, chiin a hon genkhe ding uh.
ENGLISH: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

PAITE: Tuin ka honngen ahi, ka TOUPA thilhihtheihna hihthupiin om hen, thu a na gentak dungjuiin,
ENGLISH: Now please let the power of the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

PAITE: TOUPA jaw lungnel tak, migitna hau, thulimlouhna te, tatlekna te ngaidam sek; moha sehte khah ngeiloupa, pate thulimlouhna jiaka tate, tate ta nawnte, suan thumna leh suan lina tana leng gawt sek ahi na na chih.
ENGLISH: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and that will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

PAITE: Na migitna a thupi bang ngei leh Aigupta gam akipana tutana na ngaihdam bangin mipite thulimlouhna ngaidam dih ve, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and according as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN, Na thu bangin ka ngaidam hi:
ENGLISH: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word:

PAITE: Himahleh ka hinna leh TOUPA thupinain a hondimsak ding lei tengteng louin ka gen hi;
ENGLISH: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Yahweh;

PAITE: Aigupta gam leh gamdaia ka thupina leh ka thillamdang hihte mu a, huchi pipia leng sawm vei tak honzeet lailaia, ka thu jui lou lai mi tengtengin;
ENGLISH: because all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

PAITE: A pipute uh kianga kichiama ka chiam huai gam a mu kei hial ding uh; a lak ua kei honngaineute mawngmawngin leng a mu sam kei ding uh:
ENGLISH: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it:

PAITE: Ka sikha Kalebin bel lungsim dang a puta, a honzuih taktak jiakin, amah jaw a vahohna gamah ka pi ding, a suanten a luah ding uh.
ENGLISH: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him will I bring into the land into which he went; and his seed shall possess it.

PAITE: Khaile, Amelekte leh Kanante huai gamah a om ua: jingchiangin kihei unla, Tuipi san lampi lam gamdai ah lut un, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: Now the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley: tomorrow turn, and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds .”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi leh Aron a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Hiai mi thulimlou omkhawmte, ka tunga phunphunte bangtan ahia ka dohtheih ding? Israel suante phunna, ka tunga a phunnate uh ka ja hi.
ENGLISH: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

PAITE: A kiang uah, Ka hinna louin ka gen hi, ka bilbuk ngeia na gen bang un na tunguah ka hih ding:
ENGLISH: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you:

PAITE: Na luang uh gamdai ah a om dinga; na lak ua simsa mi tengteng, kum sawmnih akipan tunglam ka tunga phunphun teng,
ENGLISH: your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against me,

PAITE: Banjak hiala, Ka honomsak ding, ka chih gamah Jephune tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Josua kia loungal na lut kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: surely you shall not come into the land, concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

PAITE: Ahihhangin, Mat ding lel ahi ding uh, na chih uh na tate uh ka pi lut dinga, na dihlouh gam uh a thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: But your little ones, that you said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

PAITE: Noubel na luang uh hiai gamdai ah a om ding.
ENGLISH: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

PAITE: Na tate uh gamdai ah kum sawmli a tamvak ding uh, gamdaia na luangte uh a mawk man masiah na kijuakna uh amau a thuak loh ding uh.
ENGLISH: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies be consumed in the wilderness.

PAITE: Gam na vaetkhiak ni zah uh, ni sawmli, ni khat tangin kumkhat jel, kum sawmli sung tak na tatlekna uh na thuak loh ding ua, huchiin ka tupdan ka hihlamdan na thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

PAITE: Kei TOUPAN mi ginalou omkhawm honnanga omkhawmte tungah hia ka hih ngei ding ka nachita a: hiai gamdai ah a mangthang ding ua. Huailaiah a si ding uh, TOUPAN a chi, chi un, chiin.
ENGLISH: I, Yahweh, have spoken, surely this will I do to all this evil congregation, who are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

PAITE: Huan, gam enkhe dinga Mosi mi sawl hongkik nawnten, gam omdan a hoihlou lama genin amah tungah omkhawmte a phunsak hi,
ENGLISH: The men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,

PAITE: Huai gam omdan a hoihlou lama gente ngei TOUPA maah hiin a sita uh.
ENGLISH: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.

PAITE: Gam enkhe dinga hohte laka Nun tapa Josua leh Jephune tapa Kaleb bel a si tei kei uhi.
ENGLISH: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

PAITE: Huan, Mosiin huai thute Israel suante tengteng a hilha: huchiin mipite a lungkhamta mahmah uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

PAITE: Huchiin jingpiinn a thou ua, mual vum ah a hohtou ua, Ngaiin, ka hongpai uhi. TOUPAN a honchiamna mun ah ka hoh ding uhi, ka na khialta uhi, achi ua.
ENGLISH: They rose up early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised: for we have sinned.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosiin, Lamzanna ahi kei ding chih thei napia bangdinga TOUPA thupiak bohse himhim na hi ua?
ENGLISH: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?

PAITE: Na lak uah TOUPA a om ngal keia, melmate hihlup lel dingin hohtou kei un.
ENGLISH: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that you not be struck down before your enemies.

PAITE: Na ma uah Amalekte leh Kanante a om uhi, namsaua hihlup na hi phet ding uh: TOUPA na lehngatsantak jiak un na kiang uah TOUPA a om kei ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you shall fall by the sword: because you are turned back from following Yahweh, therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

PAITE: Himahleh mualvuma hoh a tum teitei ua: ahihhangin TOUPA thukhunnabawm leh Mosi jaw buk akipan a pawt kei uhi.Huchiin huai muala om Amalekte leh Kanante a hongkuan suk ua, a sual ua, Horma tanphain amau a sat puk phengphung maimah uhi.
ENGLISH: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, and Moses, didn’t depart out of the camp.

PAITE: Huchiin huai muala om Amalekte leh Kanante a hongkuan suk ua, a sual ua, Horma tanphain amau a sat puk phengphung maimah uhi.
ENGLISH: Then the Amalekite came down, and the Canaanite who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down, even to Hormah.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah, Na omna ding uh gam kon piak na tun chiang ua,
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

PAITE: TOUPA kianga meia thillat, halmang thillat hiam, thuchiam tangtung dinga na kithoihna uhiam, noumau utthu a thillat hiam, na ankuanglui hunbi uh hiam, ganhon laka hiam, belam hon laka hiam TOUPA adinga gimlim bawl ding hiama na lat chiang un:
ENGLISH: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock;

PAITE: TOUPA kianga thillat lanmi peuhin tangbuang thillat, tangbuang nelte epha mun sawma khena mun khat, sathau hin mun li akhena mun khata meka a lat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of oil:

PAITE: Huan, dawnding thillat dia uain hin mun li akhena mun khat halmang thillat hiam, kithoihna hiama belamnou min kima na bawl ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: and wine for the drink offering, the fourth part of a hin, you shall prepare with the burnt offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

PAITE: Huan, belamtala tangbuang thillat, tangbuang nelte, epha mun sawma khena mun nih, sathau hin mun thuma khena mun khat mek na bawl ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil:

PAITE: Huan, dawnding thillat dia TOUPA adinga gimlim dinga uain hin mun thuma khena mun khat na lat ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

PAITE: Halmang thillat dinga hiam, thuchiam tangtun dinga kithoihna ding hiam, TOUPA kianga lemna thillat ding hiama bawngtal na hih chiang un:
ENGLISH: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh;

PAITE: Bawngtal lat toh kitonin tangbuang thillat tangbuang nelte epha mun sawma khena mun thum sathau hin kimkhata mek na lat ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: then shall he offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil:

PAITE: Huan, dawnding thillat dia uain hin kimkhat, TOUPA dinga gimlim meia thillat na lat ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huchibangin bawngtal te, belamte, belamnou apa te, kelnou te a min kim ua hih ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Thus shall it be done for each bull, or for each ram, or for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

PAITE: A tamdan uh dungjui jelin na bawl ding ua, a tamdan uh bangjelin na lan ding uhi.
ENGLISH: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

PAITE: Huai gama piang tengtengin hichibang jelin TOUPA adia gimlim meia thillat a lat chiang un a hih ding uhi.
ENGLISH: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, nam dang mi na kiang ua tengsa him hiam, kuapeuh na kiang ua teng jeljel dingte hiamten leng TOUPA adinga gimlim meia thillat lan nuam peuhin na hih bangbang ua a hih sam ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; as you do, so he shall do.

PAITE: Na suante u tan adinga mipite leh nam dang na kiang ua omte adin leng dan khat kia a om ding ahi; TOUPA maah nam dangte noumau bang geih ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations: as you are, so shall the foreigner be before Yahweh.

PAITE: Nou ading leh na kiang ua nam dang omte adingin dan khat leh hindan kibang khat kia a om ding, chiin, chiin.
ENGLISH: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah, Hichi ahi dinga, ka honpina ding gam na vatun ua,
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

PAITE: Huai gam tanghou na nek chiang un, TOUPA kiangah vei thillat na lan ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.

PAITE: Na tanghou mek masapen lak ua beu khat vei thillat dia na lat ding uh ahi: phuala vei thillat dia na vei bang un na vei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering: as the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

PAITE: Na suante uh tanin na tanghou mek masapen uh TOUPA kianga vei thillat dinga na lat jel ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: Of the first of your dough you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.

PAITE: Huan, hiai thupiak tengteng, TOUPAN Mosi kianga a gen, na zuih louh ua na bohsiat uleh,
ENGLISH: “‘When you shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which Yahweh has spoken to Moses,

PAITE: TOUPAN thu a piak tung akipana na suante uh tan adia Mosi zanga thu a piak tengteng,
ENGLISH: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;

PAITE: Hichi bang ahi dinga, omkhawmten theiloua a hihkhak uh ahihleh, omkhawm tengtengin halmang thillat TOUPA dinga gimlim dingin bawng tuai khat a lan ding ua, a dan ngeina bangin tangbuang thillat leh dawn ding thillat toh, khelhna kithoihna dingin keltal khat leng a lan tel ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: then it shall be, if it be done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

PAITE: Huan, siampuin Israel suante omkhawm tengteng adingin lemna a bawl dinga, ngaihdam ahi ding uh, hihkhak ahihjiak leh a thillat uh. TOUPA adia meia thillat leh a hihkhelh uh tanga khelhna kithoihna a lattak jiak un:
ENGLISH: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error:

PAITE: Israel suante omkhawm tengteng ngaihdam ahi ding ua, a lak ua nam dang omte leng; mipi tengtengin a hihkhak uh ahih jiakin.
ENGLISH: and all the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for in respect of all the people it was done unwittingly.

PAITE: Huan, min theiloua thil a hihkhelh leh khelhna kithoihna dingin kelnu khat kum khata upa a lat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘If one person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

PAITE: Thei loua TOUPA maa hihkhialmi adingin siampuin lemna a bawl ding hi; huchiin ngaihdam ahi ding,
ENGLISH: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs, when he sins unwittingly, before Yahweh, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

PAITE: Thei loua hihkhialmi adin, Israel suante, huai gama piangte adin leh nam dangmi na lak ua omte dingin leng dan khat na neih ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

PAITE: Himahleh a kisaktheih jiaka hih ahihleh, huai gama piang hiam, nam dang hiam leng hileh TOUPA gensia ahi a: huai mi a chipihte laka kipan satkhiak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, the same blasphemes Yahweh; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

PAITE: TOUPA thu a musita, a thupiak a bohsiat jiakin, huai mi satkhiak geih mai ding ahi, a thulimlouhna moh aman a po ding, chiin, chiin.
ENGLISH: Because he has despised the word of Yahweh, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be on him.’”

PAITE: Israel suante gamdaia a om lai un mi khat khawlnia singpua a mu ua,
ENGLISH: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

PAITE: A singpuak mumiten Mosi leh Aron leh mipite kiangah a pi uh.
ENGLISH: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

PAITE: Bangchia hih ding ahia chih genkhiak nailouh ahih jiakin tanna in ah a khum uh.
ENGLISH: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi kiangah, Huai mi hihlup ngeingei ding ahi, dainawl ah mipi tengtengin suanga a den ding uh ahi, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangin mipi tengtengin dainawl ah a pi ua, suangin a denglumta uhi.
ENGLISH: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante kiangah, a suante uh tanpha a a puan mong ua a gei bawl ding leh, a mong teng geia a dum khak dingin chiin:
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes or, tassels (Hebrew tzitzit) in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe or, tassel of each border a cord of blue:

PAITE: Huai a mong na et ua, TOUPA thupiak tengteng na theihgige ua na zuihna ding un leh; kijuaka na om jel bang ua na lungtang uh deih leh na mit uh la lampeuh deiha na om louhna ding un:
ENGLISH: and it shall be to you for a fringe or, tassel , that you may look on it, and remember all the commandments of Yahweh, and do them; and that you not follow after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you use to play the prostitute;

PAITE: Ka thupiak tengteng na theihgige ua na zuih ua, na Pathian ua dinga na siangthou theihna ding un ahi.Na Pathian uh hi dinga Aigupta gam akipan nou honpikhepa TOUPA na pathian uh ka hi. Kei TOUPA na pathian uh ka hi, chiin.
ENGLISH: that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

PAITE: Na Pathian uh hi dinga Aigupta gam akipan nou honpikhepa TOUPA na pathian uh ka hi. Kei TOUPA na pathian uh ka hi, chiin.
ENGLISH: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”

PAITE: Levi tapa Kohat, huai tapa Izar, huai tapa Kora pen Eliab tapate, Dathan leh Abiram leh Peleth tapa On, Reuben tate toh mite a pi ua:
ENGLISH: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

PAITE: Israel suante, mi langsal deuhdeuh mipi lak a heutu vaihawmmi dia telte lak a mi zanih leh sawmngate toh Mosi mah ah a va kisa ua:
ENGLISH: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown;

PAITE: Mosi leh Aron sawm in a kikhawm ua, a kiang uah, Na ut lua uh, Na ut lua uh, mipte lah a siangthou chiat ngal ua, TOUPA lah a lak uah a om ngal a: bangziak in ahia TOUPA mipi omkhawmte tung a na kikoih tungnun tuam uh? A chi ua.
ENGLISH: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them: why then lift yourselves up above the assembly of Yahweh?”

PAITE: Mosi in huai a zak in a khupboh a:
ENGLISH: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face:

PAITE: Huan, Kora leh a pawlte tengteng kiang ah, Zingchiang in TOUPA'N amah ate leh a siangthoute a taklang ding; a kiang ah a hon pai naisak ding: a mi tel huai ngeingei a kiang ah a hon pai naisak ding.
ENGLISH: and he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, “In the morning Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him: even him whom he shall choose he will cause to come near to him.

PAITE: Hichi in hih un, Kora leh a pawlte tengteng aw, zingchiang in meilakna khawng tawi unla;
ENGLISH: Do this: take censers, Korah, and all his company;

PAITE: Huai lai ah mei koih unla, TOUPA ma ah gimlim buak un: huan, TOUPA'N a tel peuhmah a siangthou ding: Levi tapate aw, na ut lua uh, chi in a gen a.
ENGLISH: and put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow: and it shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Kora kiang ah, Nou Levi tapate aw, ngaikhia unla,
ENGLISH: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

PAITE: TOUPA biakbuuk nasep sem ding leh, khawmpi na sem dia khawmpite ma a ding a amah kiang a hon om naisak ding a, Israel Pathian in Israel khawmpite a kipan a nou a hon om sak, nou a dia thil neuchik phet a kilang hia;
ENGLISH: Is it a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the tabernacle of Yahweh, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

PAITE: Huan, amah kiang ah a hon om naisak ta a, na kiang a na unau Levi tapate tengteng: siamputna leng na zong uhia?
ENGLISH: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? and do you seek the priesthood also?

PAITE: Huaiziak in nang leh na pawlte tengteng TOUPA nang in na kikhawm uh ahi. Huan, Aron in bang a hih a ahia, a tung a na phun uh?, a chi.
ENGLISH: Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against Yahweh: and Aaron, what is he that you murmur against him?”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Elia tapa Dathan leh Abiram a sam sak a: amau, Kong paitou kei ding uh:
ENGLISH: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up:

PAITE: Gamdai a hon hihlum ding in nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a kipan no'n pikhiak thil neuchik hia? Ka tunguah na kilalsak nawn ngal a
ENGLISH: is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

PAITE: Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gamah non pilut kei a, lou ding leh grep huan gou ding lah no'n pe kei: hiai mite mitte na mialsak sin ahia? Ka hong paitou kei hial ding uh, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi a heh mahmah a, TOUPA kiang ah, a thillat uh sang ke'n: a sabengtung uh khat lel leng ka la kei ding, kuamah leng ka hihna kei ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering: I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Kora kiang ah, Zingchiang in nang leh na mi kikhawmte nang toh, amau toh Aron toh TOUPA ma ah na om un:
ENGLISH: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow:

PAITE: Huan, a meilakna uh tawi chiat uhenla, gimlim buak uhenla, TOUPA ma ah a meilakna uh hontawi uhenla, meilakna zanih leh sawmnga hontawi uhen; nang leh Aron in leng na meilakna uh tawi tuaktuak un, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: and each man take his censer, and put incense on them, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer.”

PAITE: Huchi in mi chih in a meilakna uh a tawi ua, mei a koih ua, gimlim a buak ua, Mosi leh Aronte toh kihoupihna puan inn kongkhak ah a va ding uh.
ENGLISH: They each took his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

PAITE: Huan, Kora in mipi tengteng amau nang in kihoupihna puan in kongkhak ah a omkhawm sak a: huan, mipi tengteng tungah TOUPA thupina mipite a hong langta hi.
ENGLISH: Korah assembled all the congregation against them to the door of the Tent of Meeting: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to all the congregation.

PAITE: Huch in TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Hiai mipi lak a kipan kihuikhia un, a hon hihman guih theihna ding in, chi in.
ENGLISH: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

PAITE: Huchi in amau a khupboh ua, Pathian aw, sate tengteng kha Pathian, mikhat khelh ziak in mipi tengteng tungah na heh dia hia?, a chi ua,
ENGLISH: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Mipite kiang ah, Korate, Dathante, Abiramte buk a kipan dansan un, chi in gen in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi a thou a, Dathan leh Abiramte kiang ah a va hoh a; Israelte upate'n a zui uh.
ENGLISH: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

PAITE: Huan, omkhawmte kiang ah, Hiai migiloute puan in a kipan in pawtkhia un; a bangmah uh khoih kei un, huchilou in zaw a khelhna tengteng uah na pang kha ding uhi, chi in a gen a.
ENGLISH: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

PAITE: Huchi in Korate, Dathante, Abiramte buk a kipan a pawtkhe duamduam ua; huan, Dathan leh Abiram a puan inn ua kipan a hong pawtkhia ua, a puan inn kongkhak uah a zite uh, a tapate uh, a tanu neuchikchikte toh a ding ua.
ENGLISH: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in, Kei mah lungsim a pawtkhia a hih ahih kei a, hiai thil hih ding in TOUPA'N a hon sawl ahi chih hiai ah na thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

PAITE: Hiai mite mi tengteng dan bang lel mah a a sih ua, mi tengteng gawt bang lel a gawt a hih ua leh Pathian in hon sawl lou ahi ding
ENGLISH: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.

PAITE: TOUPA'N thil thak a bawl a, lei in kam a ka a, amau leh amau a tengteng a valh a, Seol ah a hing a a lut ule bel hiai mite'n TOUPA ana ngaineu uh ahi chih na thei ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: But if Yahweh make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain to them, and they go down alive into Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. ; then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi a, huai thu tengteng a gen khit in a nuai lei uh a hong khangkham phok mawk a:
ENGLISH: It happened, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground split apart that was under them;

PAITE: Huchi in lei in a kam a ka a, a innkuan un Kora mite tengteng, a van tengteng utoh a valhkhin vek hi.
ENGLISH: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men who appertained to Korah, and all their goods.

PAITE: Huchi in amau-leh-amau a tengteng Seol ah a hing in a tum vek ua, lei in a kam a chih khum a, omkhawmte lak a kipan a mangthang ta uhi.
ENGLISH: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. : and the earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

PAITE: Huchi in a kim ua Israelte tengteng a kikou husa uah a taizak ua, Lei in ei leng hon valh kha ding, a chi uh.
ENGLISH: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA a kipan in mei a hong pawt khia a, gimlim lanmi zanih leh sawmngate a hong kanglum ta hi.
ENGLISH: Fire came forth from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

PAITE: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Nangman mei zaksak inla, siampu Aron tapa Eleazar mei a kipan a meilaknate lakhe ding in hilh in, thil siangthou ahi ngal a;
ENGLISH: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire yonder; for they are holy,

PAITE: Amau hinna tung a giloute meilaknate ngei leng; huan, maitam khuhna kuang ding in sek hi hen: TOUPA ma a lat ahi a, huaiziak in a siangthou ahi, huai Israel suante a ding achiamtehna ahi ding chi in.
ENGLISH: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives; and let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Yahweh; therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

PAITE: Huan, siampu eleazar in mi kangte dal meilaknate a la a; maitam khuhna ding in a sekta uhi:
ENGLISH: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

PAITE: Israel suante a ding a theih gigenate, Aron tate hilou nam dang himhim, TOUPA ma a gimlim hal ding a a hongpai nailouhna ding un; Mosi zang a a kiang a TOUPA'N a gen bang in.
ENGLISH: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, who isn’t of the seed of Aaron, comes near to burn incense before Yahweh; that he not be as Korah, and as his company: as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.

PAITE: Himahleh a zingsang in, TOUPA mite na hihlum uhi, chi in Israel suante mipi tengteng Mosi leh Aron tungah a phun uh.
ENGLISH: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi a, Mosi leh Aron tung a mipi a phun khawm lai un, kihoupihna puan inn lam a nga ua; huan, ngai in, meipi in a hon khuh a, TOUPA thupina a hong lang hi.
ENGLISH: It happened, when the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the Tent of Meeting: and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Yahweh appeared.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi leh aron kihoupihna kongkhak ah a hoh ua.
ENGLISH: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Hiai mipi lak a kipan kihemkhia un, ka hon hihmang guih theihna ding in, chi in. Huan amau a khupboh ua.
ENGLISH: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Aron kiang ah, Na mei lakna tawi inla, maitam a kipan mei koih inla; gimlim buak inla, mipi kiang ah paipih meng inla, amau a ding in lemna bawl in: TOUPA kiang a kipan hehna a hong suak ahi; hi a leng pan lellel hi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, and put fire from off the altar in it, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”

PAITE: Huan, Aron in Mosi gen bang in a tawi a, omkhawmte lak ah a tailut a, huan ngai in, huai hi mipi lak ah a hong leng pan a; huan gimlim a buak a, mipi a ding in lemna a bawl hi.
ENGLISH: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and behold, the plague has begun among the people: and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

PAITE: Misi leh mihing kikal ah a ding a, hi a dang ta hi.
ENGLISH: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

PAITE: Huchi in Kora tungtang thu a simte simlouh in hia si tengteng singkhat leh sang li leh za sagih ahi uh.Huan Aron kihoupihna puan inn kongkhak ah Mosi kiang ah a kiknawn a, huchi in hi a bei ta.
ENGLISH: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides those who died about the matter of Korah.

PAITE: Huan Aron kihoupihna puan inn kongkhak ah Mosi kiang ah a kiknawn a, huchi in hi a bei ta.
ENGLISH: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting: and the plague was stayed.

PAITE: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a innkuan chih uh tuam ding in chiang khat chiat zel, a innkuan uh dungzui zel a a innteek pen tengteng zah, chiang sawm leh nih la lechin; huan, achiang uah a min uh gelh in.
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take of them rods, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods: write every man’s name on his rod.

PAITE: Huan, Levi chiang ah Aron min gelh in: a innkuan chih uh a ding in chiang khat zel ahi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall write Aaron’s name on the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

PAITE: Huan, i kihouna, kihoupihna puan inn thutheihsakna ma ah na koih ding ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi ding a, mi ka tel ding chiang a sel ding a: huchi in Israel suante phunna, na tung a a phunna uh ka hihdai ding hi, chi in,
ENGLISH: It shall happen, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you.”

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi in Israel suante a houpih a, a innteek pente tengteng un amau innkuan chih tuam ding in, innteek pen chih in chiang khat zel, chiang sawm leh nih a pia uh: Aron chiang leng achiang lak uah a tel sam hi.
ENGLISH: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi in thu theihsakna biakbuk ah TOUPA ma ah huai chiangte a koih hi.
ENGLISH: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the tent of the testimony.

PAITE: Huan a zing in hichi ahi a, Mosi theihpihna puan inn ah a va hoh a; huan, ngai in, Levi innkuante a dia Aron chiang a sel a, pakmum a suah a, a pakpalh a, vaisuaklu min a suang hi.
ENGLISH: It happened on the next day, that Moses went into the tent of the testimony; and behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and put forth buds, and produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in TOUPA ma a kipan chiang tengteng Israelte tengteng kiang ah a lakhia a; a na en ua, amau chiang khat a la uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

PAITE: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Helhat tate ahi uh chih theihsak zelna ding in Aron chiang thu theihsakna bul ah koih nawn in; huchi in ka tung a a helna uh na hihdaihsak thei ding hi, a sihlouhna ding un, a chi a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their murmurings against me, that they not die.”

PAITE: Huchi bang in Mosi in a hih a: TOUPA'N thu a piak bang in a hih hi.
ENGLISH: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante'n Mosi kiang ah, Ngai in, mangthang ka hi uhi, ka segawp ta uhi, ka segawp khin vekta uhi.TOUPA biakbuk hon naih peuhmah a si zel ua; mangthang vek ding ka hi ding uam? A chi uhi.
ENGLISH: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

PAITE: TOUPA biakbuk hon naih peuhmah a si zel ua; mangthang vek ding ka hi ding uam? A chi uhi.
ENGLISH: Everyone who comes near, who comes near to the tabernacle of Yahweh, dies! Will we all perish?”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Aron kiang ah, Nang leh na tapate leh na innkuan un mun siangthou thulimlouhna moh na po ding uh: huan, nang leh na tapate'n na siampu nna uh thulimlouhna moh na po ding uh.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

PAITE: Huan, Levi chi, na pa chi na unaute'n nang a hon zui tei ua, na nasepna a septheihna ding un na kiang nai ah omsak inla; himahleh nang leh na tapate thutheihsakna biakbuk bul ah na om ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, bring near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you: but you and your sons with you shall be before the tent of the testimony.

PAITE: Na nasep a hon huh ding ua, Puan inn lam nasep tengteng a tang ding ua, himahleh mun siangthou tu-um-belsuan leh maitam pen hon naih kei uhen, a sih louhna ding un, amau hiam, nang hiam leng.
ENGLISH: They shall keep your commands, and the duty of all the Tent: only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they, nor you.

PAITE: Puan inn nasepna tengteng ah kihoupihna puan inn nna pen a tang ding uh: nam dangten nou a hon naih ding uh ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: They shall be joined to you, and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent: and a stranger shall not come near to you.

PAITE: Huan, nang mun siangthou nasep leh maitam nasep pen na tang ding, Israel suante tung a hehna a om nawn louhna ding in.
ENGLISH: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary, and the duty of the altar; that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, ngai in, ke'n na unau Levite Israel suante lak a kipan ka tel khia a, kihoupihna puan inn nna sem ding in TOUPA kiang a piak, nang a dia thilpiak ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: I, behold, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are a gift, given to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, nang leh na tapate'n maitam leh puanzak sunglam thu ah na siampu nasep uh na sem ding uh; huan nang nna na sem ding, siampu nasep na nasep ding in ka hon pia hi: nam dang hong kigolh peuhmah hihlup ahi ding uh, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil; and you shall serve: I give you the priesthood as a service of gift: and the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Aron a houpih a, Ngai in, ken kei dia vei thillat, Israel suante thillat tengteng tan in nang leh na tapate khantawn a na tantuam ding un ka hon pia ahi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “I, behold, I have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel; to you have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

PAITE: Mei a hal val thil siangthoute nang a ahi ding a; a thillat chiteng uh, a tangbuang thillatte uh, a khelhna thoihna thillate uh, a mohna thoihna thillat uh ka kiang a a lat dingte uh tan in nang leh na tapate tuam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

PAITE: Thil siangthou ne in huai na ne ding ua, pasal teng in a ne ding uh; na tuam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

PAITE: Hiaite na tuam ahi ding: tangbuang thillat dia a thilpiak uh, Israel suante vei thillat tengteng tan in: nang leh na tapate leh tanute toh khantawn a na tantuam ding un ka hon pia ahi: na inn a mi siangthou tengteng in a ne thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

PAITE: Sathau hoih pente, grep hoih pente, buh hoih pente, gah masa pen TOUPA a ding a a piak uh ka hon pia hi.
ENGLISH: “All the best of the oil, and all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh, to you have I given them.

PAITE: A lou ua gah min masa pen TOUPA a dia a hon tawi uh nang a ahi ding a; na inn a mi siangthou tengteng in a ne thei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

PAITE: Israelte thillat tengteng nang a ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

PAITE: TOUPA a dia a piak uh sul hong masa pen peuhmah mihing leng gan leng nang a ahi ding: a hihhang in a ta tung pen zaw na tat ngeingei ding ahi ding, gan siangthou lou nou suakkhe masa pen leng na tat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal shall be yours: nevertheless you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

PAITE: Kha khat a hih in tat dingte tatna man na sehdan bang in, mun siangthou a sekel hihdan bang a sekel nga a na tat ding ahi (sekel pen gera sawmnih ahi).
ENGLISH: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, after the shekel of the sanctuary (the same is twenty gerahs).

PAITE: Himahleh bawngtal suakkhe masa pente, belam suak khe masa pente, kel suakkhe masa pente na tat ding ahi kei a: a siangthou uhi: a sisan uh maitam ah na theh ding a, TOUPA ding in gimlim di'n a thaute uh mei a thillat di'n na hal ding ahi
ENGLISH: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

PAITE: A sa uh nang a ahi ding, vei thillat om leh a liang taklam pang nang a ahi bang in,
ENGLISH: Their flesh shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

PAITE: Thil siangthou vei thillat, Israel suante'n TOUPA a ding a a latte uh khantawn a na tantuam ding uh ka hon pia hi; TOUPA ma a nang leh na tapate leh na tanute toh khantawn chi thukhun ahi ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: All the wave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, have I given you, and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever: it is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your seed with you.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Aron kiang ah, A gam uah goutan na neikei ding ua, a lak uah leng tantuan na neisam kei ding uh; Israel suante lak a na tantuan leh na goutan kei ka hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, Levi tate bel ngai in, nasepna, puan inn nasepsep a nasep man uh Israel gam a sawm a khat tengteng ka pia ahi.
ENGLISH: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Tua kipan in Israel suante'n kihoupihna puan inn a hon naih ding uh ahi kei; khelh moh pua in a si kha ding uh.
ENGLISH: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

PAITE: Levite'n bel kihoupihna puan inn nasep a sem ding ua; amau thulimlouhna moh a po ding uh, hiai na suante tan a dia dan ahi ding a: huan, Israel suante lak ah goutan a neikei ding uh.
ENGLISH: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations; and among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

PAITE: Israel suante'n sawm a khat TOUPA a dia vei thillat dia a lat uh Levite goutan ding in ka pia ahi; huaiziak in a kiang uah, Israel suante lak ah goutan a neikei ding uh, ka na chita him hi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance: therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Huai thu khawng lou ah leng Levite houpih inla, a kiang uah, Na goutan ding ua Israel suante sawm a khat ka hon piak na lak chiang un, huai sawm a khat a kipan sawm a khat TOUPA kiang ah vei thillat ding in na lan ding uhi.
ENGLISH: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.

PAITE: Huchi in na vei thillat uh phual a buh leh uain tung masa pen ding a sim ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Your wave offering shall be reckoned to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the winepress.

PAITE: Huchibang in Israel suante lak a sawm a khat na lak tengteng uate leng TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan zui zel ding hi, huan huai TOUPA vei thillat pen siampu Aron na piak ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

PAITE: Na thil dawn tengteng ua a hoih pen, a siangthou pen zel TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Out of all your gifts you shall offer every wave offering of Yahweh, of all its best, even the holy part of it out of it.’

PAITE: Huaiziak in a kiang uah, Huai a hoih pen na vei chiang in Levite phual a tung leh uain tung bang a sim ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the winepress.

PAITE: Koilai peuh ah leng na ne thei ding uh, nou leh na innkuan pihte un leng; kihoupihna puan inn a na nasep man uh ahi ngal a.A hoih pen na vei uh leh a khelh moh na po kei ding ua, Israel suante thil siangthou na hih thanghuai kei ding ua, na si kei ding uhi, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: You shall eat it in every place, you and your households: for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: A hoih pen na vei uh leh a khelh moh na po kei ding ua, Israel suante thil siangthou na hih thanghuai kei ding ua, na si kei ding uhi, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best: and you shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Hiai TOUPA thupiak dan ahi: Israel suante bawngla san, dem bei, gensiat bei, hakkol bulhsak ngei het louh hon kai ding in hilh in:
ENGLISH: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded: Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no blemish, and which was never yoked.

PAITE: Huan, siampu Eleazar na pe ding a, huan, aman dainawl ah a pikhe ding a, a maah kua hiam in a hihlup ding ahi:
ENGLISH: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her forth outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face:

PAITE: Huan, siampu Eleazar in a khut in a sisan a la ding a, kihoupihna puan inn malam ah a sisan sagih vei a theh ding.
ENGLISH: and Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

PAITE: Huan, kua hiam in huai bawngla a mit muh in a hal ding; a vunte, a sate, a sisante, a ekte toh a hal ding.
ENGLISH: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

PAITE: Huan, siampu in sidar sing leh husop leh khausan a la ding a, bawngla a hal uah a pailut ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

PAITE: Huan, siampu in puansilhte a sawp ding a, a kisil ding a, huai khit in giahphual ah a hoh ding a, nitaklam tan in siampu a siangthou kei ding.
ENGLISH: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, a hal mi in a puansilhte a sawp ding a, a kisil dinga nitaklam tan in a siangthou kei ding.
ENGLISH: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

PAITE: Huan, mi thanghuai lou in bawngla vu a lakhawm ding a, dainawl mun siang ah a koih ding a, Israel suante mipi suante ding in kisian sakna tui dia zat ding ahi: huai bel khelh thoihna ahi
ENGLISH: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water for impurity: it is a sin offering.

PAITE: Huan, bawngla vu hih khawm min a puansilhte a sawp ding a, nitaklam tan in a siangthou kei ding: hiai Israel suante ding in leh nam dang a kiang ua omte ding in khantawn dan ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening: and it shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

PAITE: Kua luang leng a khoihmi peuhmah ni sagih a siangthou kei ding uh;
ENGLISH: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days:

PAITE: Huai mi a hihleh ni thum ni in a kisiangsak ding a, ni sagih ni in a siangthou ding; himahleh, ni thum ni a a kisiansak kei leh ni sagih ni in leng a siangthou kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: the same shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

PAITE: Kuapeuh kua luang leng a khoih a, a kisiansak kei leh TOUPA biakbuk a hihnin ahi; huai mi pen Israel mite lak a kipan a satkhiak ding ahi; kisiansakna tui a tung a thehlouh a hihziak in a siangthou kei ding; a sianthou louhna a tungah a om lai ahi.
ENGLISH: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of Yahweh; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet on him.

PAITE: Puan inn a mi a sih leh hiai a dan ding ahi: puan inn a lut peuhmah leh puan inn sunga om peuhmah te ni sagih a siangthou kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

PAITE: Huan, tui-um-belsuan kihong, a sitna a sit louh peuhmah a nin ahi.
ENGLISH: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

PAITE: Huan gamlak ah nam kua thah hiam, misi luang hiam, mihing guh hiam, han hiam a khoih leh ni sagih a siangthou kei ding.
ENGLISH: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

PAITE: Huan, a siangthou loute tuam ding in khelh thoihna vu a la ding ua, bel ah tuikhuk tui toh a sung ding uh:
ENGLISH: “For the unclean they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

PAITE: Huan, mi siang in, husop a la ding a, tui ah a diah ding a, puan innte, tui-um-belsuan tengtengte, huailai a om mi tengteng, guh hiam, thah luang hiam, misi luang hiam, han hiam khoih mite a theh ding a:
ENGLISH: and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, and on all the vessels, and on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave:

PAITE: Huan, mi siang in ni thum ni leh ni sagih ni in mi siang lou a theh ding a, ni sagih ni in a hih siangthou ding a; a puansilhte a sawp ding a, a kisil ding a, nitaklam in a hong siangthou ta ding hi.
ENGLISH: and the clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify him; and he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

PAITE: Mi siangthou lou kisiangsak lou in bel TOUPA mun siangthou a hihnit ziak in huai mi pen omkhawmte lak a kipan a satkhiak ding ahi; kisiansakna tui a theh louh ahi a, a siangthou lou ahi.
ENGLISH: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh: the water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.

PAITE: Hiai amau a ding in khantawn dan ding ahi: kisiansakna tui a theh peuhmah in a puansilhte a sawp ding ua; huan, a kisiansakna tui khoih peuhmah nitaklam tan in a siangthou kei ding uh.Huan, mi siangthou lou in a khoih peuhmah a siangthou kei zel ding a; huan, huai mi khoih mi kuapeuh nitaklam tan in a siangthou kei ding uhi, chi in.
ENGLISH: It shall be a perpetual statute to them: and he who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

PAITE: Huan, mi siangthou lou in a khoih peuhmah a siangthou kei zel ding a; huan, huai mi khoih mi kuapeuh nitaklam tan in a siangthou kei ding uhi, chi in.
ENGLISH: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi leh Aron a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Israel suanten a inkuan chiamtehna uh tak chiatin a pawl uh hihdan bangin a puanin uh a kaih ding uh ahi: kihoupihna puan ngat chiatin a kimvelin a kai ding uh.
ENGLISH: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses: at a distance from the Tent of Meeting shall they encamp around it.”

PAITE: Ni suahnalam suahlam panga a pawl uh tamdan dungjui jela puanin kai dingte Juda pawlte ahi ding uh; huan, Juda tate laka lupen ding jaw Aminadab tapa Nason ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan, sing sagih leh sang li leh za guk ahi uh.
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

PAITE: Huan, amah zoma puanin kai dingte Isakar chi ahi ding uh: Isakar tate laka lupen ding jaw Zuar tapa Nathanel ahi ding:
ENGLISH: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan sing nga leh sang li leh za li ahi uh:
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Huan, Zebulun chite: Zebulun tate laka lupen ding jaw Helon tapa Eliab ahi ding:
ENGLISH: The tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan, sing nga leh sang sagih leh za li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Apawl uh tamdan bang jelin Judate a simte uh nuai khat leh sing giat leh sang guk leh za li ahi uh. Amauten ma a kaih jel ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: All who were numbered of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

PAITE: A pawl uh tamdan bangjelin a simlam pangah Reubente pawl a om ding uh; Reuben tate laka lupen Seduer tapa Elizur ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan, sing li leh sang guk leh za nga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

PAITE: Huan, a zoma, kai dingte Simeon chi ahi ding uh: Simeon tate laka lupen ding jaw Zurisadai tapa Selumiel ahi ding:
ENGLISH: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan, sing nga leh sang kua leh za thum ahi uh:
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

PAITE: Huan, Gad chite: Gad tate laka lupen ding Reuel tapa Eliasaph ahiding:
ENGLISH: “The tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan, sing li leh sang nga leh za guk leh sawmnga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

PAITE: Reubente tamdan nuai khat leh singa nga leh sang khat leh za li leh sawmnga ahi uh; a pawl uh dungjuiin. A zomin amau a pawtkhe ding uh uhi.
ENGLISH: “All who were numbered of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

PAITE: Huchiin kihoupihna puanin akipankhe dinga, Levite bel a laiah a om ding uah, a omna thuthu jelin a pawlpawlin a pai chiat ding uh.
ENGLISH: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

PAITE: A pawl tamdan thuthuin a tumlam pangah Ephraimte a om ding uh: Ephraim tate laka lupen ding jaw Amihud tapa Eliasam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan, singa li leh za nga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

PAITE: Huan, a zomin Manase chi ahi ding ua; Manase tate laka lupen ding Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi ding:
ENGLISH: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan, sing thum leh sang nih leh za nih ahi uh:
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

PAITE: Huan, a zom nawmin Benjamin chite: Benjamin tate laka lupen ding Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi ding:
ENGLISH: “The tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

PAITE: Huai sima om, a pawlte tamdan, sing thum leh sang nga leh za li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: His army, and those who were numbered of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Huan, Ephraimte tamdan nuai khat leh sang giat leh ja ahi uh. Huan a zom zom nawnin a paikhe ding uh.
ENGLISH: “All who were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

PAITE: A pawl uh tamdan bangjelin Dante a mallam pangah a om ding uh: Dan tate laka lupen ding Amisadai tapa Ahiezer ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

PAITE: Huai sima omte, a pawlte tamdan, sing guk leh sang nih leh za sagih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

PAITE: Huan, a zoma puanin kai dingte Aser chi ahi ding uh: Aser tate laka lupen ding Okran tapa Pagiel ahi ding:
ENGLISH: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

PAITE: Huai sima omte, a pawlte tamdan, sing li leh sang khat leh za nga ahi uh:
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.

PAITE: Huan, a zom nawmin Naphtali chite: Naphtali tate laka a lupen ding Enan tapa Ahir ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “The tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

PAITE: Huai sima omte, a pawlte tamdan, sing nga leh sang thum leh za li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Dante tamlam nuai khat leh sing nga leh sang sagih leh za guk ahi uh. Huan, amauten a pawlpawla pawtkhiain nung a hondan jel ding uhi.
ENGLISH: “All who were numbered of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

PAITE: Hiaite Israel suante inkuan tenga ami simte uh, a tamdan uh nuai guk leh sang thum leh za nga leh sawmnga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were numbered of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

PAITE: Levite bel Israel suante laka sim ahi kei uhi, TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangin.Huchibangin Israel suanten a hih ua; TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangjelin a pawlpawlin puanin a kai uh; huan, huchi mahbangin a chichiin, a inkuankuan jel un a kipankhe sek uhi.
ENGLISH: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huchibangin Israel suanten a hih ua; TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak bangjelin a pawlpawlin puanin a kai uh; huan, huchi mahbangin a chichiin, a inkuankuan jel un a kipankhe sek uhi.
ENGLISH: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante, omkhawm tengteng huai kha khatna in Zin gamdai a lut ua: huan, mipite'n Kades ah giahbuk a sat uh; huai ah Miriam a si a, huai ah a vui uh.
ENGLISH: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month: and the people stayed in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

PAITE: Huan, omkhawmte'n tui a neikei ua; Mosi leh Aron tungtang thu ah a kikhawm ek ua,
ENGLISH: There was no water for the congregation: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

PAITE: Huan, mipi in, TOUPA ma a i unaute a sih lai un Pathian in honna hihlum geih ta mai leh aw!
ENGLISH: The people strove with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!

PAITE: Bang ding a TOUPA mipite si ding a gamdai a pilut na hia, kou leh ka gante utoh?
ENGLISH: Why have you brought the assembly of Yahweh into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

PAITE: Bangziak in ahia hiai gam hoih lou pi a hon pilut ding a Aigupta gam a kipan non pawtsak mahmah? Buh-leh-balte, theipite, grep kungte, pomgranette omlouhna mun ahi, tui dawn ding mahmah lah a om sam kei hi, chi in Mosi a sual ek ua.
ENGLISH: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi leh Aron mipi lak a kipan kihoupihna puan inn kongkhak ah a hoh ua, a khupboh ua; huan, TOUPA thupina a kiang uah a hong kilang a,
ENGLISH: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to them.

PAITE: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Chiang la inla, omkhawmte omkhawm sak inla, nang leh na unau Aron toh, huai suangpi a mitmuh ua a tui pawtsak ding in hilh in; suangpi a kipan tui na lakkhiak sak ding; huchi in omkhawmte leh a gante na dawnsak ding hi, chi in.
ENGLISH: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it give forth its water; and you shall bring forth to them water out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi in TOUPA ma a kipan chiang a thupiak bang in a la a.
ENGLISH: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.

PAITE: Mosi leh Aron in omkhawmte suangpi bul ah a omkhawm sak ua, a kiang uah, Helhatte aw, ngai un, hiai suangpi a kipan tui ko'n lakkhiak sak ding uh hia? a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels; shall we bring you water out of this rock for you?”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in a ban a zak a, suangpi achiang in nihvei a sat a; huchi in tui a hong pawt zuazua a, omkhawmte leh a gante un a dawn uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice: and water came forth abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their livestock.
