PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron kiang ah, No'n gintak louh ua Israel suante mitmuh a no'n pahtawi louh ziak un hiai omkhawmte ka piak gamah na pilut kei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

PAITE: Hiai Meriba tuite ahi: Israel suanten TOUPA a sual ek ua, huailai a pahtawi a a om tak ziak in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Kades a kipan in Edom kumpipa kiang ah mi a sawl a, Na unaupa Israel in hichi bang in a chi, Ka tung ua thuakna hongtung tengteng na thei a:
ENGLISH: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the travail that has happened to us:

PAITE: Ka pipute uh Aigupta gam a a hohsuk ua, sawtpi Aigupta gam a ka om bang uh, Aigupta mite'n kou leh ka pipute hoihlou tak a hon bawl bang uh:
ENGLISH: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians dealt ill with us, and our fathers:

PAITE: Huchi in TOUPA ka sam ua, ka aw uh a na za a, angel a hon sawl a, Aigupta gam a kipan a hon pikhia a: huan, ngai in, na gam naihpen khua Kades ah ka om ua;
ENGLISH: and when we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and brought us forth out of Egypt: and behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of your border.

PAITE: Hehpihtak in na gam ka tawn paisuak ding uh aw: lou hiam, grep huan khawng ah hiam ka pai kei ding ua, tuileh tuite leng ka dawnsak kei ding uh: kumpipa lamlian ah ka pai zel ding ua, na gam ka khen masiah uh taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah leng ka pial kei ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: “Please let us pass through your land: we will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go along the king’s highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

PAITE: Huan, Edom in a kiang ah, No'n palsuak ding ahi kei, no'n pal leh hon sual ding in namsau toh ka hong kuan ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

PAITE: Huchi in Israel suante'n a kiang ah, Lamlian ah ka paitou ding ua; huan, kou leh ka gan un na tui ka dawn uh leh a man ko'n pe ding uh: thil dang bangmah hih lou in a pai in ka paisuak mai ding uh, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink of your water, I and my livestock, then will I give its price: let me only, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

PAITE: Huan, aman, Paisuak lou ding, a chi a. Huchi in Edom mipite tampi toh, mihat taktakte toh amau sual ding in a hong kuan ta a.
ENGLISH: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

PAITE: Edom in Israel mite a gam a a pai uh a phalta kei; huchi in Israel mite'n a kiksan nawnta uhi.
ENGLISH: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

PAITE: Huchi in Kades a kipan in a pawt ua; Israel suante, mipi tengteng in Hor tang a vapha uh.
ENGLISH: They traveled from Kadesh: and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron, Edom gam naih Hor tang ah a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

PAITE: Aron pen a chipihte kiang a pi ahi ding: Meriba tuite a ka thu nang a na hel ziak un Israel suante ka piak gamah a lut sin kei hi.
ENGLISH: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

PAITE: Aron leh a tapa Eleazar Hor tang ah hon pitou in:
ENGLISH: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

PAITE: Aron pen a puansilhte hawk sak inla, a tapa Eleazar silh sak in: Aron pen a chipihte kiang a pi ahi ding, huailai ah a si ding, chi in.
ENGLISH: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be taken, and shall die there.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in a hih a: mipi tengteng mitmuh in Hor tang ah a paitou ua.
ENGLISH: Moses did as Yahweh commanded: and they went up into Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi in Aron puansilh a hawk sak a, Eleazar a silh sak a: huan, Aron pen mualvum ah a sita: huan, Mosi leh Eleazar mual a kipan a paisuk uhi.Huan, mipi tengteng in Aron a si chih a theih un, Israelte tengteng in ni sawmthum a sun uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

PAITE: Huan, mipi tengteng in Aron a si chih a theih un, Israelte tengteng in ni sawmthum a sun uhi.
ENGLISH: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, Kanan mi, Arad Kumpipa simlam a om in Israel mite Atharim lampi ah a hong pai uh chih gen ging a na za a; huchi in Israel mite a sual a, sal mat bang a nei hi.
ENGLISH: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard tell that Israel came by the way of Atharim; and he fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

PAITE: Huan, Israel mite'n TOUPA kiang ah thu achiam ua, Hiai mite ka khut ua no'n piak leh a khuate uh ka hihmang ding uh, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

PAITE: Huchi in TOUPA'N Israel mite thu a pom a, Kanan mite a pia a, amau leh a khuate a hihmang uhi; a mun min ding in Horma a sa uhi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and the name of the place was called Hormah.

PAITE: Huan, Hor tang a kipan in Tuipi San lam ah Edom gam pai kualkhum in a pai ua: a lampi ziak in mipi lungsim a lungkim kei hial hi.
ENGLISH: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds , to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

PAITE: Mipite'n Pathian leh Mosi kalh in, Gamdai a si ding a bang dia Aigupta a kipan hon pikhia na hia? Tanghou lah om lou, tui lah om lou: hiai tanghou kihhuai lah ka hinna un a kih hi, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: The people spoke against God, and against Moses, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, and there is no water; and our soul loathes this light bread.”

PAITE: Huchi in TOUPA'N mipi lak ah gul gukhah chite a sawl a, mite a tu ua, Israel mite tampi a si uhi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many people of Israel died.

PAITE: Huan, mite Mosi kiang ah a hoh ua, TOUPA leh nang kal ah ka na pau uh ka na khial ta uhi, I lak ua gulte hihmang ding in TOUPA kiang ah thum dih ve, a chi ua; huchi in mite Mosi in a thumsak hi.
ENGLISH: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh, and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Gul gukha chi, a lim bawl inla, khuam ah khai in; huan, hichi ahi ding a, gul tuk mi peuhmah in huai a et uleh a dam ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a fiery serpent, and set it on a standard: and it shall happen, that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi in dal gul a bawl a, khuam ah a khai a; huan, hichi ahi a, gul tuk mi peuhmah in dal gul a et uleh a dam zel uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses made a serpent of brass, and set it on the standard: and it happened, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked to the serpent of brass, he lived.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante a paizel ua, Oboth ah giahmun a bawl uh.
ENGLISH: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

PAITE: Huan, Oboth a kipan in a pai nawn ua, ni suahna lam Moab gamdai bul Ije-abarim ah giahbuk a sat uh.
ENGLISH: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

PAITE: Huai a kipan in a painawn ua, Zered guam ah giahbuk a sat uh.
ENGLISH: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

PAITE: Huaiziak in TOUPA kidounate laibu ah, Supha a Vaheb, Arnon guamte,
ENGLISH: Therefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

PAITE: Ar omna lam a luangsuk luitate tui, Moab gamgi bul a om ah.
ENGLISH: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

ENGLISH: From there they traveled to Beer: that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

PAITE: Huan, Israelte'n hiai la a sa uh: Aw tuikhuk, hong kikhoh khia inla, a kiang ah lasa un:

PAITE: Hesbon a kipan in mei a pawt a, Sihon khopi a kipan in meikuang: Moaba a Ar a kang khin a, Arnon mun sangtoute.
ENGLISH: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

PAITE: Huchi in amah leng, a tapate leng, hawi himhim neilou in a mite tengteng toh a that ua; a gam a luahsak uh.

ENGLISH: God met Balaam: and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

ENGLISH: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

ENGLISH: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

ENGLISH: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?

PAITE: Amau lah suangpi tung khawng a kipan in ka mu ngal a, tang a kipante khawng in amau ka mu a, tang a kipante khawng in amau ka mu a, ngai in, nam tuam petmah ahi uh, namte lak a sim louh ding ahi uh.
ENGLISH: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

PAITE: Aman a dawng a, TOUPA'N ka kam a a koih ka gen ding mah hilou ding maw? a chi a.
ENGLISH: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”

PAITE: Huan, Balak in a kiang ah, Mun dang ah hoh nawn dih ni e, huai a kipan in na thei vek ding: a omna chiangchiang uh na mu ding, a vek un zaw na mukhin khol kei ding: huai a kipan in hon hamsiat sak in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them; you shall see but the utmost part of them, and shall not see them all: and curse me them from there.”

PAITE: Huchi in Zophimte omna Pisga vum ah a pitou a, maitam sagih a bawl a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belamtal khat a lan a.
ENGLISH: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

PAITE: Huan, Balak kiang ah, Pam a TOUPA ka va houpih sung in na halmang thillat bul ah na ding thek in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet over there.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Balam a na kituahpih a, a kam ah thu a koih a, Balak kiang ah kiknawn ta inla, a kiang ah, va gensawn in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

PAITE: Huan, a kiang ah a va hoh a, ngai in, a halmang thillat bul ah a na ding nilouh a, Moab mi liante leng a kiang ah a om tei ua. Huan, Balak in a kiang ah, TOUPA'N bang a na gen a? a chi a.
ENGLISH: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”

PAITE: Huchi in aman thu a gen ta a, Thou inla, Balak, ngaikhia in: Zippor tapa, ka thu ngai in:
ENGLISH: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

PAITE: Pathian zaw zuauhat mihing phet ahi kei, kisik hat mihing tapa leng ahi sam kei. A gensa a hih kei dia hia? A na gen sa a hih piching kei dia hia?
ENGLISH: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor the son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?

PAITE: Ngai in, vualzawl ding in thu ka mu a, vual a zawl khin a, ka hih lamdang theikei.
ENGLISH: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

PAITE: Jakobte thulim louhna himhim a mu kei a, Israelte ah phengphitna a mu sam kei: TOUPA a Pathian uh a kiang uah a om a, a lak uah kumpipa pahtawina husa a om hi.
ENGLISH: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

PAITE: Aigupta a kipan in Pathian in a pikhia a, gam bawngtal tha bang a nei ua,
ENGLISH: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

PAITE: Jakobte tungah bumhaina a om kei, Israelte tungah leng khimhaina a om sam kei. Jakobte leh Israelte kiang ah Pathian thilhih hihlat zel ahi!
ENGLISH: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What has God done!

PAITE: Ngai in, mipite humpinelkaipi bang in a thou ua, humpneikai bang in a dinthoh ua; a sa mat uh a nek ma un a lum kei ding uh, a mat uh sisan a dawn ma un, a chi.
ENGLISH: Behold, the people rises up as a lioness, As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

PAITE: Huan, Balak in Balaam kiang ah, Hamsiat kenla, vualzawl leng vualzawl ken, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

PAITE: Himahleh Balaam in a dawng a, Balak kiang ah, TOUPA'N a gen tengteng ka hih ngeingei ding ahi, chi in ka hon hilh khin ahi kei maw? a chi a.
ENGLISH: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’”

PAITE: Huan, Balak in Balaam kiang ah, Hong dih mun dang ah ka honpi nawn deh; huai a kipan in no'n hamsiat sak Pathian in a phal kha zenzen hiam, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse me them from there.”

PAITE: Huchi in Balak in Balaam gamdai suk et Peor vum ah a pitou a.
ENGLISH: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

PAITE: Huan, Balaam in Balak kiang ah, Hiai lai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belamtal sagih hon suktuah sak in, a chi a.Huan, Balak in Balaam gen bang in a hih a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belamtal khat a lan hi.
ENGLISH: Balaam said to Balak, “Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bulls and seven rams.”

PAITE: Huan, Balak in Balaam gen bang in a hih a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belamtal khat a lan hi.
ENGLISH: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

PAITE: Huchi in, Israelte vualzawl sak TOUPA deihlam ahi chih Balaam in a theih in ni dang a a hih bang in khimhaina lam hih ding a hoh lou in gamdai lam a zuan zo ta.
ENGLISH: When Balaam saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to meet with enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

PAITE: Huan, Balaam a vandak a, Israel mite a nam dan uh dungzui zel a om a mu a; huan, Pathian kha a tungah a hong tung hi
ENGLISH: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

PAITE: Huan, hiai thu a gen a, Beor tapa Balaam vak:
ENGLISH: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eye was closed says;

PAITE: Pathian thute za a, Bangkim hihthei a kilakna mu a khup a puk mit hong vak ta in,
ENGLISH: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

PAITE: Jakobte aw, na puan innte uh hoih hina mah e, Israelte aw, na biakbukte uh!
ENGLISH: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your tents, Israel!

PAITE: Guam bang in a kiphah zeizoi a, lui dung a huante bang in, TOUPA suan tosaw bang in, lui dung a sidar singte bang ahi uh.
ENGLISH: As valleys they are spread forth, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

PAITE: A baltin a kipan in tui a luangkhe ding a, a chi tui tampi ahte a om ding a, a kumpipa Agag sang in a thupi ding.
ENGLISH: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

PAITE: Aigupta a kipan Pathian in a pikhia a, gam bawngtal tha bang a nei uh, nam dang a melma uh a nekhin ua, guhte uh a hihzan vek ding uh, a thal un a kap pailet ding uh.
ENGLISH: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall eat up the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

PAITE: A kun ua, humpinelkai bang in a kual ua, humpinelkai bang mai in; kuan a tokthou dia? Hon vualzawl peuhmahte vualzawl in om uhenla, hon hamsiat peuhmahte hamsiat in om uhen, a chi a.
ENGLISH: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

PAITE: Huchi in Balaam tungah Balak a heh mahmah a: Balak in Balaam kiang ah Ka melmate hamsiat ding in ka hon sam a, tu in, thumvei tak amau na vualzawl ta,
ENGLISH: Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

PAITE: Huaiziak in na omna ah paimang in: thupi tak a hon tawisang ding ka hoh chih na hi a; himahleh, ngai in, TOUPA'N nang kon tawisang a dal ahi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Therefore now flee you to your place! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”

PAITE: Huan, Balaam in Balak kiang ah, Na mi sawlte kiang ah leng ka gen him kei maw.
ENGLISH: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers who you sent to me, saying,

PAITE: Balak in a inn dangka leh dangka-eng a dim in hon pe sin mahleh, a hoihlam hiam, a selam hiam keimah lungsim a suak mawng in TOUPA thu khen lam ah bangmah ka hih theikei: TOUPA'N a gen peuhmah ka gen ding, chi in?
ENGLISH: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh, to do either good or bad of my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?

PAITE: Ngai in, ka mite kiang ah ka pai ta ding a, hong in, hiai mite'n tunung chiang a na mite tung a a hihdan ding ka hoh hilh ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Now, behold, I go to my people: come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

PAITE: Huan, hiai thu a gen a. Beor tapa Balaam mit vak:
ENGLISH: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eye was closed says;

PAITE: Pathian thute za a, Tungnungpen theihna a, Bangkim hihthei a kilakna mu, a khup a puk a mit hong vak ta in;
ENGLISH: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:

PAITE: Amah ka mu a, tua a om bang hilou ka en a, nai chik a bang hilou in: Jakob a kipan in aksi a hong suakkhe ding a, Israel a kipan in lalchiang a hong dingkhe ding a, Moab gam tawn in a sun pailet ding a, buaina ta tengteng a hihniam ding hi.
ENGLISH: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and break down all the sons of Sheth.

PAITE: A melma Edom leh Seirte a tang ta ding a; Israel tan a hoih sun teng.
ENGLISH: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemies, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

PAITE: Jakob a kipan in kua hiam a lal ding a, khua a omsunte a hihmang ding, a chi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

PAITE: Huan, Amalek lam a nga a, thu a gen a, Amalek bel nam bul pen ahi na a, a dawn lam manthatna ahi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, But his latter end shall come to destruction.”

PAITE: Huan, Ken lam a nga a, thu a gen a, Na omna mun zaw a kip a, na bu suangpi a seh ahi.
ENGLISH: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

PAITE: Assurte sal a hon pimang uh tan in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

PAITE: Huan, thu a gen nawn a, Pathian in hichi bang a a hih in kua a hing thei dia leh?
ENGLISH: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

PAITE: Himahleh Kittim gam a kipan in longte a hong tung ding a, Assur a hihgim ding ua, Eber a hihgim ding ua, amah leng a mangthang ding, a chi a.Huchi in Balaam a thou a, a kholam ah a paita: Balak leng a pai sam hi.
ENGLISH: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

PAITE: Huchi in Balaam a thou a, a kholam ah a paita: Balak leng a pai sam hi.
ENGLISH: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

PAITE: Huchi in, Israelte Sittim ah a om ua, huan, Moabte tanute a kithuahpih chiat ta ua:
ENGLISH: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab:

PAITE: A pathiante uh kiang a kithoihnate uah achial ua; huchi in a ne ua, a pathiante uh chibai a buk tei ta uh.
ENGLISH: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods; and the people ate, and bowed down to their gods.

PAITE: Huan, Israelte'n Baalpeor mah a pom tei ta ua; huchi in Israelte tungah TOUPA a heh mahmah hi.
ENGLISH: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor: and the anger of Yahweh was kindled against Israel.

PAITE: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Mipite heutu tengteng pi inla, TOUPA hehna kihtakhuai tak mai Israelte tung a kipan a a kikhinmang theihna ding in sun khovak ah TOUPA mah ah awklum sak in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Israelte vaihawm mite kiang ah, Baal-peor pom peuhmahte hihlum vek un, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

PAITE: Huan, ngai in, Israel lak a mi khat in kihoupihna puan inn kongkhak a a kah laitak un Mosi mitmuh in leh Israelte omkhawm mitmuh in Midia numei khat a unaute kiang ah a hon pi a
ENGLISH: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, siampu Aron ta Eleazar tapa Phinehasa a muh leh omkhawmte a kipan a thou a, teipi a la ta hi;
ENGLISH: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the midst of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand;

PAITE: Huan, Israel mi puan inn sung ah a delh lut a, Israel mi toh a nih un a sun pailet a, numei pen a gil ah. Huch in Israel suante tung a gawtna a dai ta hi.
ENGLISH: and he went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huai mi gawtna a site sing nih leh sang li ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Siampu Aron ta Eleazar tapa Phinehasa in ka thik bang a a lak ua a mullitna in ka hehna Israel suante lak a kipan a kikhinkhe sak ta a, huchi ka mullitna in Israel suante ka hihmangthang kei ding.
ENGLISH: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

PAITE: Huaiziak in, Ngai in, ka kilemna thukhun a tungah ka khung ding a;
ENGLISH: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace:

PAITE: Huan, amah leh a nung a a suante ding in khantawn siamputna thukhun ahi ding a; a Pathian a dia mullit, Israel suante ding a kilemna a bawl ziak in, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: and it shall be to him, and to his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

PAITE: Israel mi a thah uh, Midia numei toh a thah uh min Zimri, Simeonte lak a a innkuan inntek pen Salu tapa ahi.
ENGLISH: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

PAITE: Huan, Midia numei a thah uh min Kozbi, Zur tanu ahi: amah Midiate innkuan lak a heutu ahi.
ENGLISH: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Midiate hih lungzing unla, hih niam un:Amau leng Peor tungtang thu ah leh Peor tungtang thu a gawt ni a a sanggamnu uh, Midiate mi lian tanu a thah uh, Kozbi tungtang thu ah git louh pil a a honkhem uh bang in a hon khem lailai ngal ua, chi in.
ENGLISH: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

PAITE: Amau leng Peor tungtang thu ah leh Peor tungtang thu a gawt ni a a sanggamnu uh, Midiate mi lian tanu a thah uh, Kozbi tungtang thu ah git louh pil a a honkhem uh bang in a hon khem lailai ngal ua, chi in.
ENGLISH: for they harassed you with their wiles, with which they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

PAITE: Huan, Gawtna a daih nung in hich ahi a, TOUPA'N Mosi leh siampu Aron tapa Eleazar a houpih a,
ENGLISH: It happened after the plague, that Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante omkhawm tengteng, kum sawmnih a kipan tung lam, a chichi in Israel gam a galkap thei chiang teng sim vek un, chi in.
ENGLISH: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go forth to war in Israel.”

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab phai ah amaute a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

PAITE: Mipite kum sawmnih a kipan tung lam sim un, chi in; TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aigupta gam a kipan Israel suante kiang a thu a piak bang in.
ENGLISH: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward; as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those that came out of the land of Egypt.

PAITE: Israel ta chil Reuben: Reuben tapate: Hanokte innkuan lak a mi Hanok: Palute innkuan lak a mi Palu:
ENGLISH: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

PAITE: Hezronte innkuan lak a mi Hezron, Karmite innkuan inntek pen Karmi.
ENGLISH: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

PAITE: Hiaite Reubente innkuan ahi uh: Sim ching tengteng singli leh sangthum leh zasagih leh sawmthum ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

PAITE: Palu suan, Eliab.
ENGLISH: The sons of Pallu: Eliab.

PAITE: Huan, Eliab suante; Neumuel, Dathan, Ahiram ahi uh. Hiai Dathante leh Abiramte ahi ua, TOUPA a suallai ua Mosi leh Aron sualpa Kora pawl a tel omkhawmte telte:
ENGLISH: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called of the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against Yahweh,

PAITE: Huan, huai pawl a sih lai un lei in a kam a ka a, Korate toh a valh khawm a: mei in mi zanih leh sawmnga a velh lai in, huchi in chiamtehna a na hi ta uh.
ENGLISH: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; what time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

PAITE: Himahleh Kora tapate a si kei uh.
ENGLISH: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

PAITE: A innkuan uh kizomdan tang zel a suante: Nemuel suante Nemuelte. Jamin suante Maninte: Jakin suante Jakinte:
ENGLISH: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

PAITE: Zera suante Zerate: Sawl suante Sawlte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

PAITE: Hiaite Simeon suante ahi ua, singnih leh sangnih leh zanih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

PAITE: A innkuan kizomdan bang a Gad tapate: Zephon suan Zephonte: Haggi suante Haggite, Sunni suante Sunnite:
ENGLISH: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

PAITE: Ozni suante Oznite:
ENGLISH: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

PAITE: Eri suante Erite: Arod suante Arodte: Areli suante Arelite.
ENGLISH: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

PAITE: Hiaite a simdan bang ua Gad tapate suante ahi uh, singli leh zanga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

PAITE: Huan, Juda tapate, Er leh Onan: Er leh Onan Kanan gamah a si uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

PAITE: Huan, Juda suante innkuan paidan hichi ahi a: Sela suan Selate.
ENGLISH: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

PAITE: Perez suante Perezte: Zer suante Zerte ah uh: Huan, Peres suante: Hezron suante Hezronte: Hamul suante Hamulte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

PAITE: Hiaite a simdan bang un Juda tapate suante ahi uh, nuaiguk leh singkhat leh sangguk leh zanga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of Judah according to those who were numbered of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

PAITE: A innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Isakar suante: Tola suante Tolate: Pua suante Puate:
ENGLISH: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

PAITE: Jasub suante Jasubte: Simron suante Simronte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

PAITE: Hiaite a simdan bang un Isakar tapate suante ahi uh, singguk leh sangli leh zathum ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were numbered of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

PAITE: A innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Zebulun suante: Sered suante Seredte: Elon suante Elonte: Jaleel suante Jaleelte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

PAITE: Hiaite a simdan bang ua Zebulunte suante ah uh, singguk leh zanga ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were numbered of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

PAITE: A innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Joseph suante: Manase leh Ephraim.
ENGLISH: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

PAITE: Manase suante: Makir suante Makirte: Huan, Makir in Gilead a suang a: Gilead suante Gileadte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

PAITE: Hiaite Gilead suante ahi uh: Iezer suante Iezerte: Helek suante Helekte:
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

PAITE: Asriel suante Asrielte: Sekem suante Sekemte:
ENGLISH: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

PAITE: Semid suante Semidte: Hepher suante Hepherte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

PAITE: Huan, Hepher tapa Zelophedhad in tapa neilou in tanute a nei a: Zelophedhad tanute min Malate, Novate, Hoglate, Milkate, Zirzate ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

PAITE: Hiaite Manase suante ahi uh. A sim teng uh singnga leh sangnih leh za sagih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

PAITE: Hiai a innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Ephraim suante ahi uh: Suthela suante Suthelate: Beker suante Bekerte: Tahan suante Tahante ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

PAITE: Huan, hiaite Suthela suante ahi uh. Eran suante Erante ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

PAITE: Hiaite a simdan bang un Ephraim suante innkuan ahi ua, singthum leh sangnih leh zanga ahi uh. Hiai a innkuan kizomdan bang zel ua Joseph suante ahi uh
ENGLISH: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

PAITE: A innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Benjamin suante: Bela suante Belate: Asbel suante Asbelte: Ahiram suante Ahiramte.
ENGLISH: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

PAITE: Supham suante Suphamte. Hupham suante Huphamte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

PAITE: Huan, Bela suante Ardi leh Naaman ahi uh: Ardi suante Ardite: Naaman suante Naamante ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

PAITE: Hiaite a innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel in Benjamin suante ahi uh: Huan, a sim teng uh singli leh sangnga leh zaguk ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

PAITE: Hiaite a innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi uh: Saham suante Sahamte ahi uh. Hiaite a innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

PAITE: Saham suante tengteng a simdan bang un singguk leh sangli leh zali ahi uh.
ENGLISH: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

PAITE: A innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Aser suante: Imna suante Imnate: Isvi suante Isvite.
ENGLISH: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

PAITE: Beria suante Beriate ahi uh. Beria suante: Heber suante Heberte: Malkiel suante Makielte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

PAITE: Huan, Aser tanu min Ser ahi.
ENGLISH: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

PAITE: Hiaite Aser tapate suante a sim teng uh ahi ua, singnga leh sangthum leh zali ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.

PAITE: A innkuan uh kizomdan bang zela Naphtali suante: Jazeel suante Jazeelte: Guni suante Gunite;
ENGLISH: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

PAITE: Jezer suante Jezerte: Silem suante Silemte ahi uh.
ENGLISH: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

PAITE: Hiaite a innkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante ahi uh: a sim teng uh singli leh sangnga leh zali ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

PAITE: Hiaite Israel tate a sim teng uh ahi ua, nuaiguk leh sangkhat leh zasagih leh sawmthum ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Hiaite a min zah zel un gam hawm sak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

PAITE: A tam deuhte gam na pe tam ding a, a tawm deuhte gam na pe tawm ding hi: simdan bang in gam piak chiat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: to everyone according to those who were numbered of him shall his inheritance be given.

PAITE: Himahleh aisan a gam hawm ding ahi: a pute nam min kizomdan bang zel in gam a tang ding uh.
ENGLISH: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

PAITE: Aisan bang zel in gam a tam leh a tawmte kiang ah hawm ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

PAITE: Huan, hiaite Levite a innkuan kizomdan bang zel a simte ahi uh. Gerson suante Gersonte: Kohath suante Kohathte: Merari suante Merarite ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are those who were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

PAITE: Hiaite Levi suante ahi uh: Libni suante, Hebron suante, Mahli suante, Musi suante, Kora suante ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

PAITE: Huan, Kohat in Amram a suang a, Huan, Amram zi min Jokebed, Levi tanu, Aigupta gam a Levi lak a piang ahi a, huan, aman Amram lak ah Aron leh Mosi leh a sanggamnu Miriam a suang hi.
ENGLISH: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt: and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

PAITE: Huan, Aron in Nadabte, Abihute, Eleazarte, Ithamarte, a suang hi.
ENGLISH: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

PAITE: Huan, Nadab leh Abihu in TOUPA zat louh ding chi mei a zat lai un a si uhi.
ENGLISH: Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, sim tengteng pasal kha khat chiang tung lam teng singnih leh sangthum ahi uh. Israel mite lak ah gam hawm tang tei ding a hih louh ziak un Israel mite lak ah sim ahi kei uh.
ENGLISH: Those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

PAITE: Hiaite ahi uh Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab phai a Israel suante simpa Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in a sim uh.
ENGLISH: These are those who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

PAITE: Sinai gamdai a Israel mite Mosi leh siampu Aron in a simte khat lel leng a om ta kei.TOUPA'N, Gamdai ah a si ngeingei ding uh ahi, a na chi khin ta ngal a, Jephune tapa Kelep leh Nun tapa Josua loungal kuamah dam a omta kei uhi.
ENGLISH: But among these there was not a man of them who were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

PAITE: TOUPA'N, Gamdai ah a si ngeingei ding uh ahi, a na chi khin ta ngal a, Jephune tapa Kelep leh Nun tapa Josua loungal kuamah dam a omta kei uhi.
ENGLISH: For Yahweh had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. There was not left a man of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

PAITE: Huan, Joseph tapa Manase suan Manase ta Makir, huai mi ta Gilea, huai mi ta Hepher tapa Zelophehad tanute a hong pai ua: a tanute min: Mala bang, Nova ban, Hogla bang, Milka bang, Tirza bang ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

PAITE: Huan, kihoupihna puan inn kongkhak ah Mosi leh Siampu Eleazar leh mi liante leh omkhawmte tengteng maitam ah a va ding ua,
ENGLISH: They stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

PAITE: Gamdai ah ka pu uh a si a, TOUPA sual ding a kikhawm pawl, Kora pawl ah tel tei kei: Himahleh amah khelh ziak in a si a, tapa a neikei hi.
ENGLISH: “Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah: but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.

PAITE: Tapa a neih louh ziak lel in bang ding a ka pa uh min a suante lak a kipan mang ding ahia? Ka pa unaute lak ah tantuan hon pia in, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in a thu uh TOUPA ma ah a tun a.
ENGLISH: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Zelophehad tanute'n a hihdik uhi: a pa uh unaute lak ah tantuan na bawl ngei ding ahi, a pa uh tantuan na piak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: you shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers; and you shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante'n a kiang ah, Mi, tapa neilou a a sih leh a gou a tanute na piak ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

PAITE: Huan, tanu a neih kei leh a gou a unaute na piak ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

PAITE: Huan, unaute a neih kei leh a gou a pa unaute na piak ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

PAITE: Huan, a pa'n unaute a neih kei leh a gou a tanau na pe ding ua, aman a luah ding a: huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in Israel suante ding in dan thupiak kip ahi ding, chi in gen in, chi in.
ENGLISH: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be to the children of Israel a statute and ordinance, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”

PAITE: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Abarim tang ah hohtou inla, Israel suante ka piak ding gam va en in.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, na muh khit chiang in na unaupa Aron a chipihte kiang ah pi a hih mah bang in nang leng pi na hi ta ding hi!
ENGLISH: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

PAITE: Zin gamdai a a kikhawmte a phun lai ua a mitmuh ua tui a kei hon pahtawi ding a ka thu ka honpiak kalh a na hel ziak in, a chi a (Huaite Zin gamdai a Kadesa Mariba tuite ahi).
ENGLISH: because you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in TOUPA a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

PAITE: Khawmpite tung a om ding mi khat, sa tengteng khate Pathian, TOUPA'N sep hen.
ENGLISH: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

PAITE: TOUPA mi khawmpite chingmi neilou belam bang a a om louhna ding un, a ma uh kai ding, amaute pikhia a pilut ding in, chi in.
ENGLISH: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Yahweh not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Nun tapa mi lungsim neitak Josua pi inla, a tungah na khut nga inla:
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him;

PAITE: Siampu Eleazar leh khawmpite ma ah ding sak inla, a mitmuh uah thuneihna pia in.
ENGLISH: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante omkhawm tengteng in thu a man theihna ding un a tungah na thupina nga in.
ENGLISH: You shall put of your honor on him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

PAITE: Huchi in amah siampu Eleazar ma ah a ding diing a, aman TOUPA ma ah Urmin thu a laksak ding a: a thu in a pawt ding ua, a thu in a lut ding ua, amah leh Israel suante tengteng, omkhawmte toh a chi a.
ENGLISH: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in a hih a: Josua a pi a, Eleazar leh omkhawmte ma ah a ding sak a:Huan, a tungah a khut a nga a, Mosi zang a TOUPA'N a gen bang in thuneihna a peta hi.
ENGLISH: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

PAITE: Huan, a tungah a khut a nga a, Mosi zang a TOUPA'N a gen bang in thuneihna a peta hi.
ENGLISH: and he laid his hands on him, and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante thu pia inla, a kiang uah, Ka ann kei a dia gimlim mei a thillat, ka kiang ah thillat pen a hun geih zel chiah na lan ding uhi, chi in.
ENGLISH: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘My offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, you shall observe to offer to me in their due season.’

PAITE: Huan, a kiang uah, Hiai mei a thillat TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi; belamnou a pa, kum khat a upa, gensiatbei, ni teng in nih, halmang thillat lan gige ding in.
ENGLISH: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

PAITE: Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan ding ua, khat nitaklam in na lan ding uh:
ENGLISH: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;

PAITE: Tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte epha mun sawm a khen mun khat sathau suk hin mun li a khen mun khat a hel toh.
ENGLISH: with the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

PAITE: TOUPA ding a mai a thillat, gimlim ding a sinai tang a sehsa halmang a thillat lat gige ding chih ahi.
ENGLISH: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, belamnou khat latna a dawn ding thillat, hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi: TOUPA ding a uain, dawn ding thillat mun siangthou ah na bungkhe ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

PAITE: Huan, belamnou khat nitaklam in na lan ding hi: zingsang lam in tangbuang thillat bang leh huai a dawn ding thillat bangbang TOUPA ding a gimlim di'n mei a thillat na lat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The other lamb you shall offer at evening: as the meal offering of the morning, and as the drink offering of it, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, khawlni in belamnou, a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei nih leh tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte epha mun sawm a khen a mun nih sathau a helkhawm leh huai a dawn ding thillat toh na lat ding ahi;
ENGLISH: “‘On the Sabbath day two male lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and the drink offering of it:

PAITE: Hiai khawlni teng a halmang a thillat lat gige leh huai a dawn ding thillat sim louh a halmanga thillat lat ding ahi.
ENGLISH: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Huan, na kha thak teng un TOUPA ding halmang thil na lat ding uh ahi; bawngtal tung nih leh belamtal khat leh belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih;
ENGLISH: “‘In the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: Huan, bawngtal chih ah tangbuang thillat ding tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm epha mun sawm a khen a mun thum; huan, belam khat ah tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen a mun nih;
ENGLISH: and three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;

PAITE: Huan, belamnou chih ah tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen a mun khat: hiai halmang thillat gimlim TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
ENGLISH: and a tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, a dawn ding thillat uh bawngtal khat ah uain hin kimkhat ahi ding a belamtal khat ah hin mun thum a khen a mun khat, belamnou khat ah hin mun li a khen a mun khat: hiai kumtawn a kha teng halmang thillat ahi.
ENGLISH: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA kiang a khelh thoihna dia keltal khat na lat ding uh ahi; halmang a thillat lat gige leh huai a dawn ding thillat sim lou in.
ENGLISH: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Huan, kha khat na, ni sawm leh ni li ni TOUPA paikan ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

PAITE: Huan, huai kha ni sawm leh ni nga ni annkuanglui ni ahi ding; ni sagih tanghou silngou soh louh nek ding ahi.
ENGLISH: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

PAITE: Ni khat ni in khawmpi siangthou a om ding a: bang nna mahmah na sep ding uh ahi kei;
ENGLISH: In the first day shall be a holy convocation: you shall do no servile work;

PAITE: Mei a thillat bel TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi; bawngtal tung nih leh belamtal khat leh belamnou a pa kum khat a upa sagih: na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi:
ENGLISH: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without blemish;

PAITE: Tangbuang nelte, sathau helkhawm, a tangbuang thillat utoh: bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun thum belamtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun nih:
ENGLISH: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: you shall offer three tenth parts for a bull, and two tenth parts for the ram.

PAITE: Belamnou sagih bel belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun khat ahi ding ahi;
ENGLISH: You shall offer a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

PAITE: Huan nou a ding a kilemna bawlna ding in khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

PAITE: Hiaite zingsang a halmang thillat, halmang thillat lat gige leh huai a dawn ding thillat sim lou in
ENGLISH: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

PAITE: Hichibangin Toupa' dinga gimlim, mei a thillat nek ding ni tengin, ni sagih na lat ding uh ahi: halmang thilat lat gige leh huai dawn ding thillat sim lou in.
ENGLISH: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Huan, a ni sagih ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh hilou ahi.
ENGLISH: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation: you shall do no servile work.

PAITE: Huan, na nipikal annkuang luina na buh thak tung annkuang luina TOUPA ding a thil thak tangbuang thillat na lat ni un leng khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei;
ENGLISH: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work;

PAITE: TOUPA ding a gimlim halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi; bawngtal tung nih, belamtal khat, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa sagih;
ENGLISH: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun thum.
ENGLISH: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for each bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,

PAITE: Belamtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun nih, belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen a mun khat;
ENGLISH: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

PAITE: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding keltal khat toh.Halmang thillat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, huaite na lat ding uh ahi (na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi), dawn ding thillat toh.
ENGLISH: one male goat, to make atonement for you.

PAITE: Halmang thillat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, huaite na lat ding uh ahi (na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi), dawn ding thillat toh.
ENGLISH: Besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, you shall offer them (they shall be to you without blemish), and their drink offerings.

PAITE: Huan, kha sagihna, a ni khat ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei: nou a ding in pengkul mut ni ahi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

PAITE: TOUPA a ding in gimlim di'n halmang thillat na lat ding uh ahi, bawngtal tung khat, belamtal khat, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih:
ENGLISH: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun thum, belamtal khat ah mun sawma khen a mun nih,
ENGLISH: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the ram,

PAITE: Belamnou sagih, khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen a mun khat:
ENGLISH: and one tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

PAITE: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna di'n khelh thoihna keltal khat toh.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

PAITE: Kha thak halmang thillat leh huai a tangbuang thillatte, halmang thillat lat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillatte, dawn ding thillatte, a hihdan ngeina uh TOUPA ding a gimlim dia mei a thillatte sim lou in.
ENGLISH: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and the meal offering of it, and the continual burnt offering and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, hiai kha sagihna, ni sawm ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua: na hihna uh na hihgim ding ua, bang nna mahmah na sep ding uh ahi kei;
ENGLISH: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; and you shall afflict your souls: you shall do no kind of work;

PAITE: TOUPA ding a gimlim dia halmang thillat bel na lan ding uhi; bawngtal khat, belamtal khat, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi;
ENGLISH: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun thum, belamtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun nih.
ENGLISH: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,

PAITE: Belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen a mun khat:
ENGLISH: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs:

PAITE: Khelh thoihna di'n keltal khat toh; kilemna ding a khelh thoihnate, halmang thillat lat gigete, huai a tangbuang thillat leh a dawn ding thillatte uh sim lou in.
ENGLISH: one male goat for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings.

PAITE: Huan, kha sagihna, ni sawm leh ni nga ni in kikhawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei, TOUPA ding in ni sagih annkuang na lui ding uhi;
ENGLISH: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work, and you shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days:

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA ding a gimlim dia mei a thillat, halmang thillat na lat ding uh ahi: bawngtal tung sawm leh thum, belamtal nih, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa sawm leh li: gensiatbei chiat a hih ding ahi:
ENGLISH: and you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh sathau toh helkhawm bawngtal sawm leh thum, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belamtal nih, belamtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun nih;
ENGLISH: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,

PAITE: Belamnou sawm leh li, belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun khat:
ENGLISH: and a tenth part for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai a tangbuang thillatte, dawn ding thillatte sim lou in.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Huan, a ni nih ni in bawngtal tung sawm leh nih, belamtal nih, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm leh li na lat ding uh ahi;
ENGLISH: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh leh dawn ding thillat a dan bang tak in a tamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding bang, belamtal a ding bang, belamnou a ding bang;
ENGLISH: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat toh: halmang thillat gige bang huai a tangbuang thillatte, dawn ding thillatte sim lou in.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings.

PAITE: Huan, a ni thum ni in bawngtal sawm leh khat, belamtal nih, belamnou kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm leh li,
ENGLISH: “‘On the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh leh dawn ding thillat a dan bang tak in a tamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding bang, belamtal a ding bang, belamnou a ding bang:
ENGLISH: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huaia tangbuang thillat leh huai a dawn ding thillat sim lou in.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Huan, a ni li ni in bawngtal sawm, belamtal nih, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm leh li;
ENGLISH: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh leh dawn ding thillat, a dan bang tak in a tamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding bang, belamtal a ding bang, belamnou a ding bang:
ENGLISH: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat toh: halmang thillat gigete, huai a tangbuang thillat leh dawn ding thillatte sim lou in.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Huan, a ni nga ni in bawngtal kua, belamtal nih, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm leh li;
ENGLISH: “‘On the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh leh dawn ding thillat uh, a dan bang tak in a tam dan bang zel tangbuang thillat uh leh dawn ding thillat uh, a dan bang tak in a tamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding bang, belamtal a ding bang, belamnou a ding bang:
ENGLISH: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat toh; halmang thillat lat gigete, huai tangbuang thillat leh huai dawn ding thillatte sim lou in.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Huan a ni guk ni in bawngtal giat, belamtal nih, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm leh li:
ENGLISH: “‘On the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh leh dawn ding thillat a dan bang tak in a tamdan bangzel un bawngtal a ding bang:
ENGLISH: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat toh; halmang thillat lat gigete, huai a tangbuang thillat leh huai a dawn ding thillatte sim lou in.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offerings of it.

PAITE: Huan, a ni sagih ni in bawngtal sagih, belamtal nih, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm leh li:
ENGLISH: “‘On the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh leh dawn ding thillat, a dan bang tak in a tamdan bangzel un, bawngtal a ding bang, belamtal a ding bang, belamnou a ding bang:
ENGLISH: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat toh; halmang thillat lat gigete, huai a tangbuang thillat leh huai a dawn ding thillatte sim lou in.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Huan, a ni giat ni in khawmpi thupi tak na nei ding ua: bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei:
ENGLISH: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no servile work;

PAITE: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mai a halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi: bawngtal khat, belamtal khat, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih:
ENGLISH: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

PAITE: A tangbuang thillat uh leh dawn ding thillat uh, bawngtal a ding bang, belamtal a ding bang, belamnou a ding bang, a dan bangtak in a tamdan bang zel un:
ENGLISH: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:

PAITE: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat leh huai a dawn ding thillat sim lou in.
ENGLISH: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

PAITE: Na thuchiamte uh, utthu a thillatte, na halmang thillatte uh, na tangbuang thillatte uh, na dawn ding thillatte uh, na lemna thillatte uh sim lou in hiaite annkuangluina hunbi nei a na neihte uh ni in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uhi, chi in, chi in.Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak tengteng Israel suante Mosi in a hilh hi.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak tengteng Israel suante Mosi in a hilh hi.
ENGLISH: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Hiaite, Sinai tanga TOUPAN Mosi a houpih laia Aron leh Mosi suana mite ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

PAITE: Aron tapate min a upapen Nabad, Abihu, Elearzer, Ithamar ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

PAITE: Hiaite siampu dinga thuanilh, siampu na sem ding a hihtuam Aron tapate min ahi.
ENGLISH: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

PAITE: Huan, Nabad leh Abihu ahih uleh Sinia gamdaia mei zat louh ding chih, TOUPA maa a latlai un TOUPA maah a si ua, ta a neikei uh: Eleazar leh Ithamarin a pa uh Aron dam laiin siampu-nasep a sem uhi.
ENGLISH: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh, when they offered strange fire before Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Levi chite, siampu Aron kiangah pi inla, a na a sep theihna ding un a kianga-ah omsakin.
ENGLISH: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

PAITE: Huan amau biakbuka nasepna semin kihoupihna puanin chinah amah leh khawmpi tengteng tuam dingin na a sem ding uh.
ENGLISH: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

PAITE: Huan, kituahkhawmna puanin van tengteng a kem ding ua, Israel suante tuama biakbuk nasep na a sem ding uh.
ENGLISH: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

PAITE: Huan, Levite bel Aron leh a tapate kiangah na lan ding: Israel suante tuam din a kianga lat ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

PAITE: Aron leh a tapate bel na sep dinga, a siampu hihna uh a tang nilouh ding uh: Nam dang honkigolhte hihlup ding ahi uh, chiin.
ENGLISH: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Ngaiin, Levite Israel suante lak akipan Israel suante ta chil sul hong masapen siaka keimah ngeiin ka lak ahi uh: Levite keia ahi ding ua:
ENGLISH: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:

PAITE: Tachil tengteng lah keia ahi ngal ua; Aigupta gama tachil tengteng ka hihlup niin Israelte laka tachil tengteng, a mihing a ganin ka tuam dingin ka khama ahi; keia ahi ding uh; kei TOUPA ka hi, chiin.
ENGLISH: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Sinai gamdai ah Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

PAITE: Levi tate a inkuankuan un a khangkhang un sim inla: pasal peuhmah kha khat akipan tunglam an sim ding ahi, chiin.
ENGLISH: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosiin a hih dinga thupiak bangin TOUPA thu bangin a sim chiata.
ENGLISH: Moses numbered them according to the word of Yahweh, as he was commanded.

PAITE: Levit tapate min Gerson, Kohath, Merari ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

PAITE: Huan, amau suangpa Gerson tapate min Libni leh Simei ahi uh.
ENGLISH: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

PAITE: Amau suangpa Kohath tapate Amram, Izhar, hebron, Uziel ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

PAITE: Amau suangpa Merari tapate Mali leh Musi ahi uh. Hiaite a inkuan uh bangjela Levite suante ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

PAITE: Gerson bel Libnite leh Simeite suang pa ahi: hiaite Gersonte suante ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

PAITE: Pasal tengteng kha khat akipan tunglam a simte uh sang sagih leh ja nga tak a ching uhi.
ENGLISH: Those who were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those who were numbered of them were seven thousand five hundred.

PAITE: Gersonte suanten a puanin uh biakbuk tumlam pangah a kai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

PAITE: Huan, Gersonte inkuana lupen Lael tapa Eliasaph ahi ding.
ENGLISH: The prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

PAITE: Gerson taten kihoupihna puanina a kep ding uh biakbuk leh puanin ahi ding, a tung khawng, kihoupihna puanina kongkhak puanjak khawng,
ENGLISH: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

PAITE: A intual jakte, biakbuk china a intual kongkhak puanjak khawng, maitam kima khawng, huailaia zat ding khau tengteng.
ENGLISH: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

PAITE: Huan, Kohath bel Amram te, Izhar te, Hebron te, Uziel te suangpa ahi: hiaite Kohath suante ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

PAITE: Pasal tengteng kha khat akipan tunglam a simdan bang un sang giat leh za guk ahi un, mun siangthou kemmi ding.
ENGLISH: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

PAITE: Kohath tapate suanten biakbuk simlam pangah a puanin uh a kai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

PAITE: Kohathte suante inkuana lupen ding bel Uziel tapa Eliazaphan ahi ding.
ENGLISH: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

PAITE: A kep dingte uh, bawmte, dohte, sathau khawnvak koihna, maitam, mun siangthoua nasepna tuiumbelsuan tengteng, puanjakte, huailaia nasepna thil tengteng ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the screen, and all its service.

PAITE: Huan, siampu Aron tapa Eleazar bel Levite lupen ahi dinga, mun siangthou kemmite a heu ding hi.
ENGLISH: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

PAITE: Merari bel Malite leh Musite suangpa ahi. Hiaite Merari suante ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

PAITE: Pasal tengteng kha khat akipan tunglam a simdan bang un sang guk leh za nih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Those who were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

PAITE: Merari suan inkuana lupen Abihail tapa Zuriel ahi: biakbuk mallam pangah a puanin uh a kai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

PAITE: Merari tapate kep dinga sehte biakbuk khuam lepkhawm bang, bang kal te, a khuamte, a kingakna khukkuakte, a vanzat tengteng, nasepna vanzat tengteng ahi uh;
ENGLISH: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

PAITE: A kongpi umna khuamte, a kingakna khuakkuakte, akilhbelhna leh a khaute toh.
ENGLISH: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

PAITE: Biakbuk suahlam pang kihoupihna puanin chin, ni suahnalam puanin kai ding bel Mosi leh Aron leh a tapa hi ding ua, mun siangthou ah Israel suante tuam dingin a kul peuhpeuh a sem ding uh. Nam ding honkigolh peuhmah hihlup ding ahi, chiin,
ENGLISH: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

PAITE: TOUPA thupiaka Levite a inkuankuan ua pasal tengteng kha khat akipan tunglam Mosi leh Aronin a sim teng uh sing nih leh sang nih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi kiangah, Israel suante laka tachil, pasal kha khat akipan tunglam teng sim inla, a zah uh theiin,
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to Moses, “Number all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

PAITE: Huan, Levite bel (TOUPA ka hi) Israel suante laka tachil teng sikin non laksak ding ahi; huan, Levite gante Israel suante gan teng piang masapen sikin, a chi a,
ENGLISH: You shall take the Levites for me (I am Yahweh) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosiin TOUPAN thu a piak bangin Israel suante laka tachil teng a sim,
ENGLISH: Moses numbered, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

PAITE: A min uh kizom bangjelin kha khat akipan tunglam tachil pasal teng a sim uh sing nih leh sang nih leh za nih leh sawmsagih leh thum ahi uh.
ENGLISH: All the firstborn males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those who were numbered of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante laka tachil teng sikin Levite la inla, a gan uh sikin Levite gan; Levite keia ahi ding ua; kei TOUPA ka hi.
ENGLISH: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Levite sanga a tamna uh Israel suante tachil za nih leh sawmsagih leh thum tatna dingin,
ENGLISH: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, who exceed the number of the Levites,

PAITE: Sekel nga chiat na la ding ahi; mun siangthoua sekel bangin na la ding hi, (sekel bel gerah sawmnih ahi):
ENGLISH: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; after the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):

PAITE: Avalte tatna sum pen Aron leh a tapate na piak ding ahi, chiin,
ENGLISH: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosiin Leviten a tat ban ua a tatna sum uh a la a:
ENGLISH: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;
