PAITE: Israel suante tachil lak akipanin sum a la a; sum siangthou sekel bangin sang khat leh ja thum leh sawmguk leh nga a la hi:TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak, TOUPA thu bangin Mosiin tatna sum Aron leh a tapate a pia hi.
ENGLISH: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

PAITE: TOUPAN Mosi thu a piak, TOUPA thu bangin Mosiin tatna sum Aron leh a tapate a pia hi.
ENGLISH: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Israel suante namte inntek pente a houpih a, Hiai ahi, TOUPA'N thu a piaktak.
ENGLISH: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.

PAITE: Mi'n TOUPA kiang a thu achiam hiam, a lungsim thuchiam a kigak ding a a kichiam hiam a thu a bohse ding ahi kei; kam a pawt bangbang a a hih ding ahi.
ENGLISH: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

PAITE: Numei in leng a nungak lai a a pa inn a a om lai in TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a, thuchiam a a kigak a;
ENGLISH: “Also when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh, and binds herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

PAITE: A thuchiam leh thuchiam a a lungsim a gak a pa'n a zak a, a pa'n a daihsan maimah leh a thuchiam tengteng a piching ding: Huan, thuchiam chiteng a a lungsim a gaknate a om gige ding.
ENGLISH: and her father hears her vow, and her bond with which she has bound her soul, and her father holds his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

PAITE: Himahleh a pa'n a zak ni a a phal kei leh a thuchiamte a kigakna thuchiamte a koi mahmah a piching kei ding: a pa'n a phallouh a hihziak in TOUPA'N amah a ngaidam ding.
ENGLISH: But if her father disallow her in the day that he hears, none of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul, shall stand: and Yahweh will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

PAITE: Thuchiam in hiam, thu khual lou a a lungsim gakna in hiam a delh lai a pasal a neih a;
ENGLISH: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul,

PAITE: A pasal in a zak a, a zak ni a a daih dide leh a thuchiam a om gige ding a, a lungsim gakna khual lou a a thuchiam leng a om gige ding.
ENGLISH: and her husband hears it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

PAITE: Himahleh a pasal in a zak ni a a phal kei leh a tung a thuchiam leh a lungsim gakna khual lou a a thuchiam a hihmang ding; TOUPA'N a ngaidam ding.
ENGLISH: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he shall make void her vow which is on her, and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul: and Yahweh will forgive her.

PAITE: Himahleh huai meithai hiam, maak a omnu hiam thuchiam zaw, a lungsim a gakna tengteng in a delh gige ding.
ENGLISH: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul, shall stand against her.

PAITE: Huan, inn a thu achiam a, kichiam a a lungsim gak ding a thu a khun a:
ENGLISH: “If she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

PAITE: A pasal in a zak a leng a daih dide a, a phallouh kei leh a thuchiam tengteng a om gige ding a, a lungsim gak ding a a thuchiam chiteng leng a om gige ding.
ENGLISH: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and didn’t disallow her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she bound her soul shall stand.

PAITE: Himahleh a pasal in a zak ni a bangmah lou a bawl a, a thihmang leh a thuchiam hiam, a lungsim gakna hiam thu a a kam a thu pawt peuhmah a om nawn kei ding: a pasal in a hihmang khin ahi: huan, TOUPA'N amah a ngaidam ding.
ENGLISH: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband has made them void; and Yahweh will forgive her.

PAITE: Thuchiam tengteng leh hinna hihgim ding a gakna kichiamna tengteng a pasal in a kipsak thei in a hihmang thei hi.
ENGLISH: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

PAITE: Himahleh a pasal in a zak ni a kipan a a deih den leh a thuchiam chiam tengteng leh a tung a gakna om tengteng a kipsak ahi a: a zak ni a kipan a a daihsan ziak in a kipsak ahi.
ENGLISH: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows, or all her bonds, which are on her: he has established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

PAITE: Himahleh a zak khit nung a bangmah lou a bawl a a hihman leh a thulimlouhna moh a puak ding ahi, chi in.Hiaite, pasal leh a zi kal leh a pa inn a om gige lai a kikal ua dan ding a TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piakte ahi.
ENGLISH: But if he shall make them null and void after that he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

PAITE: Hiaite, pasal leh a zi kal leh a pa inn a om gige lai a kikal ua dan ding a TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piakte ahi.
ENGLISH: These are the statutes, which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Midiate tungah Israel suante phu la in: huai khit in na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding, chi in.
ENGLISH: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi in mipite a houpih a, Midiate tung a TOUPA phulakna tangtun ding a Midiate sual kidou ding in na lak ua mi kigalvan uhen.
ENGLISH: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.

PAITE: Israel nam tengteng lak a nam chih a mi sangkhat zel kidouna a na hoh ding uh ahi, chi in.
ENGLISH: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”

PAITE: Huchi in Israelte sang tamtak lak a kipan, nam chih a kipan in sangkhat chiat, kidouna a hoh ding in sepaih singkhat leh sang nih a pekhia uh.
ENGLISH: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi in chichih lak a mi sangkhat chiat leh siampu Eleazar tapa Phineha mun siangthou a tui-um-belsuante, thupiakna ding khawng a pengkulte tawi in kidouna ah a hohsak a.
ENGLISH: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in Midiate a dou ua; pasal teng a that uh.
ENGLISH: They warred against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses; and they killed every male.

PAITE: A mi thahte uh lak ah Midiate kumpipate leng a tel ua; Midiate kumpipa nga, Evite, Rekemte, Zurte, Hurte, Rebte: Beor tapa Balaam leng namsau in a that uh.
ENGLISH: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they killed with the sword.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante'n Midiate naupang hon sal in a pi ua; huan, a gan tengteng uh, a belam hon tengteng uh, a van tengteng uh a gallak sum ding un a la uh.
ENGLISH: The children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their livestock, and all their flocks, and all their goods, they took for a prey.

PAITE: A omna khua tengteng uh, a giahna mun tengteng uh a hal vek uh.
ENGLISH: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.

PAITE: Huan, mihing leh gan, sal leh gallak sum tengteng a paipih vek ua.
ENGLISH: They took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of man and of animal.

PAITE: Huan, salte, matte, gallak sumte Mosi leh siampu Eleazar leh Israel suante omkhawmte kiang ah, Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab phai a a giahna mun uh a hontun uhi.
ENGLISH: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi leh siampu Eleazar leh omkhawmte inntek penpente'n khomual ah a na dawn ua.
ENGLISH: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them outside of the camp.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi bel sepaih heutu, sang tung a heutute leh za tung a heutute, kidouna a kipan a hong tungah a heh a.
ENGLISH: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

PAITE: Mosi in a kiang uah, Numei tengteng na hinghawi vek uh maw?
ENGLISH: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

PAITE: Ngai un, Balaam lem theih in Peor tungtang thu ah Israelte TOUPA tung a tatlekna tungsak mite hiaite ahi uhi, TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah hii a hong leng a kei maw.
ENGLISH: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.

PAITE: Huaiziak in naupangte lak a pasal tengteng that unla, numei mi kithuahpih sa tengteng leng that un.
ENGLISH: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

PAITE: Numei naupang mi kithuahpih nailouh tengteng bel nou a ding in hawi un.
ENGLISH: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

PAITE: Huan, khomual ah ni sagih giak unla; kuapeuh mi that leh misi koih ni thum ni leh ni sagih ni in kisiangsak un, noumau leh na salte uleng.
ENGLISH: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days: whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

PAITE: Huan, van himhim leh savun a thilbawl tengteng kelmul a thilbawl tengteng, sing a thilbawl tengteng thu ah na kisiangsak ding uh ahi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”

PAITE: Huan, siampu Eleazar in kidouna a hoh kidou mite kiang ah, Hiai TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak dan thuseh ahi:
ENGLISH: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:

PAITE: Bangpeuh hi hen, dangka-engte, dangkasikte, dalte, sikte, langvate, ngente,
ENGLISH: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

PAITE: Bangpeuh mei a hal a se theilou peuhmahte mei ah na tholh paisuak ding ua, huchi in a hong siangthou ding: bangpeuh hi hen, silsiang na tui a hih siangthou ding ahi: huan, mei a hal thuak theilou peuhmah tui a na tholh paisuak ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity: and all that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

PAITE: Huan, a ni sagih ni in na puan uh na sawp ding ua, huan, na hong siangthou ding uh, huai khit in giahna mun ah na hong lut ding uh ahi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean; and afterward you shall come into the camp.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Nang toh, siampu Eleazar toh, omkhawmte innkuan inntek pente toh gallak sum dia a lak uh mihing leh gante sim vek unla:
ENGLISH: “Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

PAITE: Huan, gallak sum mun nih ah khen unla, kidouna a hoh kidoumite ding leh omkhawmte ding in:
ENGLISH: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

PAITE: Huan, kidouna a hoh galkap mi a kipan in TOUPA ding a siah piak ding sepkhe zel unla, thil hing zanga zel ah khat, mihing a kipan bang, bawng a kipan bang, sabengtung a kipan bang, belam hon a kipan bang in:
ENGLISH: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

PAITE: Huaite a tan kimkhat ua kipan la unla, TOUPA a di'n vei thillat ding in siampu Eleazar pia un.
ENGLISH: Take it of their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.

PAITE: 30 Huan, a kimkhat Israel suante tuam pen sawmnga a kipan khat sepkhe zel inla, mihing a kipan bang, bawng a kipan bang, sabengtung a kipan bang, belam hon a kipan bang, gan hon a kipan bang in; huan, huaite TOUPA biakbuk kem mi Levite pia in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the tabernacle of Yahweh.”

PAITE: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in a hih uh.
ENGLISH: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Sepaihte'n a mat uh gallak sum sim lou a a lak uh belam nuaiguk leh singsagih leh sangnga,
ENGLISH: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

PAITE: Bawng sing sagih leh sangnga,
ENGLISH: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

PAITE: Sabengtung singguk leh sangkhat,
ENGLISH: and sixty-one thousand donkeys,

PAITE: Mihing bel numei, pasal kithuahpih nailouh sing thum leh sang nih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

PAITE: Huan, a kimkhat, kidouna a hohte tantuan pen, belam nuai thum leh singthum leh sang sagih leh sang sagih leh za nga ahi:
ENGLISH: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA siah belam pen zaguk leh sawm sagih leh nga.
ENGLISH: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

PAITE: Huan, bawng singthum leh sangguk ahi a; huai a TOUPA siah sawmguk leh khat ahi.
ENGLISH: The cattle were thirty-six thousand; of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

PAITE: Huan, sabengtung sing thum leh zanga ahi; huai a TOUPA siah sawmguk leh khat ahi.
ENGLISH: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

PAITE: Huan, mihing singkhat leh sangguk ahi ua; huai a TOUPA siah mi sawmthum leh nih ahi uh.
ENGLISH: The persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in siah, TOUPA vei thillat Mosi in siampu Eleazar a pia a.
ENGLISH: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in galkapmite a kipan a a hawm Israel mite tantuan kimkhat,
ENGLISH: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who warred

PAITE: (Mipi tantuan kimkhat belam nuai thum leh singthum leh sangsagih leh zanga,
ENGLISH: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

PAITE: Bawng singthum leh sangguk
ENGLISH: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

PAITE: Sabengtung singthum leh zanga,
ENGLISH: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

PAITE: Mihing singkhat leh sangguk; )
ENGLISH: and sixteen thousand persons),

PAITE: Israel tantuan kimkhat a kipan Mosi in mihing leh gan sawmnga zel ah khat a la a, TOUPA thupiak bang in TOUPA biakbuk kem mi Levite a pia a.
ENGLISH: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the tabernacle of Yahweh; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

PAITE: Huan, sepaihte tung a heutu, sang tung a heutute, za tung a heutute'n Mosi a va naih ua;
ENGLISH: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses;

PAITE: Mosi kiang ah, Na sikhate'n ka khut ua om kidou mite ka sim ua, kuamah kimlou ka om kei uh.
ENGLISH: and they said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

PAITE: Huan, ka hinna ua ding a TOUPA ma a kilemna bawlna ding in TOUPA ding a thillat mi'n a neihlam uh, dangka-eng a bawl zep hoih van, khe ngawng a bulhte, khut ngawng a bulhte, min sawnna zungbuhte, bilbahte, khite, ko'n tawi uhi, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in dangka-eng a bawl van tengteng uh a na la ua.
ENGLISH: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

PAITE: Sang tung a heutute leh za tung a heutute dangka-eng TOUPA kiang a vei thillat dia a lat tengteng uh sekel singkhat leh sangguk leh zasagih leh sawmnga ahi.
ENGLISH: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

PAITE: (Galkap mite a gallak sum uh amau achiat dia la ahi uh).Huan, Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in sang tung a heutu leh za tung a heutute dangka-eng a la ua, Israel suante theih gigena ding in kihoupihna puan inn ah TOUPA ma ah a hon tawi uhi.
ENGLISH: (The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.)

PAITE: Huan, Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in sang tung a heutu leh za tung a heutute dangka-eng a la ua, Israel suante theih gigena ding in kihoupihna puan inn ah TOUPA ma ah a hon tawi uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.

PAITE: Reuben leh Gad tate'n gan a hau mahmah ua: huan, Jazer gam leh Gilead gam a muh un, a mun gan a dia mun hoih tak hi in a thei ua;
ENGLISH: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for livestock;

PAITE: Huchi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n Mosi leh siampu Eleazar leh omkhawm mipite a va houpih ua,
ENGLISH: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

PAITE: Israel omkhawmte ma a TOUPA'N a daisak gam Atarotte, Dibonte, Jazerte, Nimrate, Hesbonte,
ENGLISH: “Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

PAITE: Elealete, Sebamte, Nebote, Beonte gan ding a hoih gamahi a, huan, na sikhate'n gan ka nei ua,
ENGLISH: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

PAITE: Hoih na sak lam a hihleh hiai gam ka luah ding un hon pia inla, Jordan lui hon pi galkah dah mai ve, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession; don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate kiang ah, Na unaute uh kidouna ah a hoh ding ua, nou bel hiai lai ah na na om maimah ding uh maw?
ENGLISH: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to the war, and shall you sit here?

PAITE: Bang ding a TOUPA'N a piak gam a lut lou ding a Israel suante lungtang lunglel sak na hi ua?
ENGLISH: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?

PAITE: Kades-barnea a kipan a gam va enkhe ding a ka sawl in hichi mah bang in na pute un a hih ua.
ENGLISH: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

PAITE: Eskol guam a tuntouh un gam a va mu ua, TOUPA'N gam a piak a lut nop louhna ding un Israel suante lungtang a lunglel sak uh.
ENGLISH: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.

PAITE: Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA a heh mahmah a, a kichiam a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh’s anger was kindled in that day, and he swore, saying,

PAITE: Aigupta gam a kipan a hong pawt, kum sawmnih chiang tunglam mi himhim in Abrahamte, Isaakte, Jakobte, kiang a kichiam a ka piak gam kuamah in a mu kei ding uhi; a hon zuih taktak louh ziak un;
ENGLISH: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

PAITE: Keniz mi Jephune tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshuate kia lou ngal, amau TOUPA a zuih taktak ziak un, chi in.
ENGLISH: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have followed Yahweh completely.’

PAITE: Huan, Israelte tungah TOUPA a heh mahmah a, TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoihlou hih mi suan tengteng a man vek masiah uh gamdai ah kum sawmli a vak saksak a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, who had done evil in the sight of Yahweh, was consumed.

PAITE: Huan, ngai un, Israelte tung a TOUPA hehna kihtakhuai tak behlap in nou gilou in na pute uh sik in na ding ta uhi.
ENGLISH: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.

PAITE: TOUPA zui lou a na om himhim uleh aman amaute gamdai ah a omsak nawn mai sin ahi. Hiai mi tengteng na hihmang mai kei ding umaw? a chi a.
ENGLISH: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all this people.”

PAITE: Huan, a va naih ua, a kiang ah, Hiai lai ah ka gan ua ding in belam huangte leh ka tate uh a ding khua peuh ka bawl ding ua:
ENGLISH: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones:

PAITE: Kou bel a mun ding ka tun masiah uh Israel suante ma a pai zel ding in ka kigalvan ding uhi: hiai gam a mite ziak in ka tate uh kulh nei khuate ah a om ding uh.
ENGLISH: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

PAITE: Israel suante mi chih in a mun luah ding uh a luah chiat ma un ka inn lam uah ka pai kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

PAITE: Ka luah ding uh bel hiai lam gal Jordan suahlam a hih ziak in Jordan gal khat lam leh a khen lam zaw ka luahpih tei sin kei uhi, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in a kiang uah, Huchi bang a na chih ua, kidouna a TOUPA ma a hoh ding a na kigalvat ua, a ma a kipat melmate a delhkhiak a,
ENGLISH: Moses said to them, “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,

PAITE: TOUPA ma a gam zoh a hih masiah na lak ua kigalvan tengteng TOUPA ma a Jordan na galkah vek uleh,
ENGLISH: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh, until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

PAITE: Denchiang in na pai ding ua, TOUPA tungah leh Israelte tungah na moh kei ding ua; huchi in hiai gam TOUPA ma a na luah ding uh ahi ding a.
ENGLISH: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless towards Yahweh, and towards Israel; and this land shall be to you for a possession before Yahweh.

PAITE: Himahleh huchi bang a na hih kei uleh ngai un, TOUPA tungah na khial uh ahi ding a, na khelhna un a hon mukhe ngeingei ding chih thei un.
ENGLISH: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.

PAITE: Na tate uh ding khuate bawl unla, na belamte uh ding in leng huante bawl unla, na gen bangbang un hih un, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

PAITE: Huan, Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n Mosi kiang ah, Na sikhate'n ka pu uh thupiak bang in ka hih ding uh.
ENGLISH: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

PAITE: Ka zi, ka tate uh, ka belam honte uh, ka gan hon tengteng uh Gilead gam khuate ah a na om ding ua:
ENGLISH: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

PAITE: Himahleh na sikha, kidou ding a kigalvan tengteng in ka pu uh gen bang in TOUPA ma ah ka va galkah ding uhi, chi in, a gen uh.
ENGLISH: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”

PAITE: Huchi in Mosi in, a tungtang thu uah siampu Eleazarte, Nun tapa Josuate, Israel nam innkuan inntek pente thu a pia a.
ENGLISH: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in a kiang uah, Gad tate, Reuben tate, kidou ding a kigalvan tengteng in TOUPA ma a Jordan lui a hong galkah pih ua, huai gam na zoh uleh Gilead gam pen a luah ding ua na piak ding uh ahi:
ENGLISH: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle, before Yahweh, and the land shall be subdued before you; then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

PAITE: Himahleh kigalvan a hong galkah pih kei uleh Kanan gamah na lak uah a tel tei mai ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

PAITE: Huan, Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n, Na sikhate kiang a TOUPA'N a gen bang in ka hih ding uh,
ENGLISH: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.

PAITE: Kigalvan a TOUPA ma a galkah in Kanan gamah ka lut ding uh, huchi in ka gam luah ding uh Jordan lui khenlam ah ahi lai ding, chi in a dawng ua.
ENGLISH: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in, Gad tate leh Reuben tate leh Joseph ta Manase suan nam kim khatte Amor kumpipa Sihon gamte, Basan Kumpipa Og gam, huai gamte a khua om tengteng toh, a kim gam khuate nangawn toh a pia a.
ENGLISH: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

PAITE: Huan, Gad tate'n Dibonte, Atarote, Aroerte;
ENGLISH: The children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

PAITE: Atrot-sophante, Jazerte, Jogbehte;
ENGLISH: and Atrothshophan, and Jazer, and Jogbehah,

PAITE: Betnimrate, Betharante a lam ua, khopi kulh neite, belam huangte toh.
ENGLISH: and Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.

PAITE: Huan, Reuben tate'n Hesbonte, Elealete, Kiriathaimte, Nebote, Beal-meonte,

ENGLISH: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in Gilead gam Manase tapa Makir a pia; huai ah a om.
ENGLISH: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

PAITE: Huan, Manase tapa Jairin huai a khuate a vala a, Havot-jiar a sa hi.Huan, Nob in Kenat a vala a, khopelte toh, amah min tam in Nob a sa hi.
ENGLISH: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its towns, and called them Havvoth Jair.

PAITE: Huan, Nob in Kenat a vala a, khopelte toh, amah min tam in Nob a sa hi.
ENGLISH: Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

ENGLISH: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

PAITE: Huan, Sukot a kipan in a pawt ua, gamdai phak tung Etham ah giahbuk a sat uh.
ENGLISH: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

PAITE: Huan, Etham a kipan in a pawt ua, Baal-z-ephon bul a Pi-hahirot lam ah a kinungkhin ua, Migdol chin ah giahbuk a sat uh.
ENGLISH: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.

PAITE: Huan, Elim a kipan n a pawt ua, Tupi San ah giahbuk a sat uh.

PAITE: Huan, Tuipi San a kipan in a pawt ua, Sin gamdai ah giahbuk a sat uh.

PAITE: Sin Gamdai a kipan a pawt ua, Dopka ah giahbuk a sat uh.

PAITE: Huan, Mitka a kipan a pawt ua, Hasmona ah giahbuk a sat uh.

PAITE: Hasmona a kipan in a pawt ua, Moserot ah giahbuk a sat uh.

ENGLISH: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

PAITE: Himahleh huai gam a omte na delhkhiak kei uleh na omsakte uh na mit ua ding in sutna zum leh na chi ua ding in ling bang ahi ding ua, na omna gam uah hon hih nuammoh ding uhi.Huan, hichi ahi ding a, a tung a hih ka tup bang na tunguah ka hih ding, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides, and they will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi ding a, a tung a hih ka tup bang na tunguah ka hih ding, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so will I do to you.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,

ENGLISH: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

PAITE: Sim lam a na luah ding chiang uh Zin gamdai a kipan Edom gam zulzul ahi ding a, sim lam gamgi Tuipi Al tawp a kipan suah lam pang ahi ding.
ENGLISH: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;

PAITE: Huan, na gamgi uh Akrabim tungkahna sim lam pang ah a kawi ding a, huan, a hong pawtna Kades-barnea sim lam ah ahi ding: huan, Hazar-adar ah a pai ding a, Azmon ah a pai zel ding:
ENGLISH: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out of it shall be southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon;

PAITE: Huan, gamgi Azmon a kipan in Aigupta lui tan in a kawi ding a, a tunna tuipi ah ahi ding.
ENGLISH: and the border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

ENGLISH: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border: this shall be your west border.

PAITE: Huan, hiai mal lam a na gamgi uh ahi ding: tuipi zaa a kipan in Hor tang huap in na bawl ding a:
ENGLISH: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for you Mount Hor;

ENGLISH: from Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;

ENGLISH: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;

PAITE: Huan, gamgi Jordan ah a paisuk ding a, huan, a tunna Tuipi Al ah ahi ding: hiai a kimvel a gamgi paidan bang in na gam uh ahi ding, chi in, chi in.

PAITE: Nam nih leh nam kimkhatte'n a gam luah ding uh ni suahlam Jeriko zawn Jordan gal suah lam ah a tangta uh, chi in.

ENGLISH: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

PAITE: Huan, Jeriko zawn Jordan gei, Moab phai ah TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante thupia inla, a gam uah Levite omna ding khuate bawlsak uhen; huan, a gante uh tatna ding in kho dainawl kim khawng Levite na piak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “Command the children of Israel that they give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and you shall give suburbs for the cities around them to the Levites.

PAITE: Khuate a omna ding uh ahi ding a, a kimte khawng bel bawng leh a gante uh, a gan vulh tengteng uh a ding ahi ding.
ENGLISH: The cities shall they have to dwell in; and their suburbs shall be for their livestock, and for their substance, and for all their animals.

PAITE: Huan, dainawl Levite na piak ding kho kulh a kipan tong sangkhat a sau ahi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “The suburbs of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

PAITE: Huan, kulh polam a kipan in na teh ding a, suah lam pang ah tong sangnih, mal lam pang ah tong sangnih, khua lai tak a om in. Hiai amau dainawl tuam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the midst. This shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

PAITE: Huan, Levite na piak ding khuate tualthatte taina ding kihumbitna khopi guk ahi ding a; huaite lou kho sawmli leh kho nih na piak lai ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the manslayer to flee to: and besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

PAITE: Levite na piak ding khua tengteng kho sawmli leh kho giat ahi ding: dainawl toh na piak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their suburbs.

PAITE: Israel suante luah khua na piakdan ding, a tam deuh a kipan in pe tam ding a, a tawm deuh a kipan in na pe tawm ding a, michih in a luah uh gam tamdan dungzui a khua Levite a piak ding ahi, chi in
ENGLISH: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many; and from the few you shall take few: everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give of his cities to the Levites.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah,
ENGLISH: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

PAITE: Jordan lui na galkah ua Kanan gam na lut chiang un kihumbitna khua ding khua na seh ding uh ahi, tualthat kha mi taina ding in.
ENGLISH: then you shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

PAITE: Huai khuate phula mi a kipan na kihumbitna khua uh ahi ding; omkhawmte ma a vaihawm sak ding a a din ma a tualthatmi a sih louhna ding in.
ENGLISH: The cities shall be to you for refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer not die, until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

PAITE: Huchi in, nou a ding a kihumbitna ding na sehte uh khopi guk ahi ding.
ENGLISH: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

PAITE: Jordan galah khopi thum na sep ding ua, Kanan gamah khopi thum na sep ding ua, kihumbitna khopite ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.

PAITE: Israel suante leh nam dang leh a kiang ua tengte di'n hiai khopi guk kihumbitna ahi ding; huai lai ah kuapeuh mi that kha a tai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the foreigner living among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

PAITE: Himahleh sik zang a mi a sual a, a sih leh tualthat ahi a: tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

PAITE: Huan, si khop a suang a mi a den a a sih leh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
ENGLISH: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

PAITE: Huan, si khop a mi sing a a sat a, a sih leh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

PAITE: Sisan phula mi'n tualthat mi a that pah mai ding: a muh peuh chiang in a hihlum ding ahi.
ENGLISH: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death: when he meets him, he shall put him to death.

PAITE: Huan, mi a huat ziak a a sawm ek hiam, na guk tan a a den hiam a a sih in hiam,
ENGLISH: If he thrust him of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,

PAITE: Kiselna ziak a tuplup hiam a hihleh, a hihlum mi pen hihlup ngei ding ahi.
ENGLISH: or in enmity struck him with his hand, so that he died; he who struck him shall surely be put to death; he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meets him.

PAITE: A hihhang in kisel ziak hi khol lou a sawm guih hiam, huan, tang hi khol lou a, mi a om uh chih leng theilou a,
ENGLISH: “‘But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

PAITE: A melma leng hi lou a, a poikhoih tum leng hi tuan lou a suang hiam a den a, mi a na sih a, a hih leh:
ENGLISH: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;

PAITE: Omkhawmte'n hiai vaihawmna dan bang in a hihlum mi leh sisan phula mi vai a hawm sak ding uh ahi:
ENGLISH: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances;

PAITE: Huan, omkhawmte'n tualthat mi sisan phula mi lak a kipan a honkhe ding ua, omkhawmte'n a taina, kihumbitna khua ah a omsak nawn ding ua, sathau siangthou nilh siampu lian a sih mateng huailai ah a om ding hi.
ENGLISH: and the congregation shall deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he was fled: and he shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

PAITE: Himahleh chiklai peuh in tualthat mi a tai na, a kihumbitna kho gamgi po lam a pai a;
ENGLISH: “‘But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, where he flees,

PAITE: Sisan phula mi in a kihumbitna kho po lam a a muh a sisan phula mi in a thah leh sisan ah moh a tang kei ding;
ENGLISH: and the avenger of blood find him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kill the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,

PAITE: Siampu lian a sih mateng a kihumbitna khua om gige ding a hihziak in; siampu a sih nung in bel tualthat mi a omna gam a pai nawn ding ahi.
ENGLISH: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the manslayer shall return into the land of his possession.

PAITE: Hiai thilte na suante uh tan a na omna peuh ua na vaihawm dan ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

PAITE: Kuapeuh in mi a thah leh tualthat mi pen theihpihte kam a kipan thupawt a hihlup ding ahi: himahleh theihpih khat zaw mi hihlupna ding in a hun kei.
ENGLISH: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.

PAITE: Huan, tualthat mi zaw na tat ding uh ahi kei, sihna khop dia moh ahi a, hihlup ngei ding ahi zaw.
ENGLISH: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.

PAITE: Huan, siampu sih ma in, a kihumbitna khua a tai, a gam a om nawn ding a tatna na lak ding uh ahi kei.
ENGLISH: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

PAITE: Huchi in na omna gam uh na hih thanghuai kei ding ua, sisan in gam a hih thanghuai leh sisan suahna gam hih thanghuai silna di'n a suahmi sisan kia lou lah zat theih ahi ngal kei a.Na omna gam uh, ka omna na hih thanghuai ding uh ahi kei; kei TOUPA lah Israel suante lak ah ka om ngal a, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: “‘So you shall not pollute the land in which you are: for blood, it pollutes the land; and no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him who shed it.

PAITE: Na omna gam uh, ka omna na hih thanghuai ding uh ahi kei; kei TOUPA lah Israel suante lak ah ka om ngal a, chi in, chi in.
ENGLISH: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell: for I, Yahweh, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.’”

PAITE: Huan, Joseph innkuanpihte lak a mi, Manase ta Makir tapa Gilead tate innkuan inntek pente lak a mite'n a hon naih ua, Mosi leh heutu, Israel suante inntek pente ma ah thu a gen ua:
ENGLISH: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel:

PAITE: TOUPA'N ka pu Israel suante suante aisan a a luah ding gam uh pe ding in thu a pia a: huan, TOUPA'N ka pu, ka unaupa uh Zelophehad luah ding a a tanute pe ding in thu a pia a.
ENGLISH: and they said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

PAITE: Huan, amau Israel suante lak a mi, nam dang kuapeuh tate leng neita leh, ka pi-le-pute uh gam a luah uh lak sak a, a va kigawmpihte uh nam gam toh gawm ding ahi ding a; huchi bang in ka gam tantuan ua kipan lakkhiak a hong hi ding a.
ENGLISH: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante Jubili a hong tun chiang in a gam uh a va kigawm pih peuhpeuhna dingte uh nam gam toh gawm ding ahi ding a: huchi in ka pi-le-pute uh nam gam a kipan a gam uh lak hek a hong hi sin hi, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: When the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

PAITE: Huan, Mosi in, TOUPA thu bang in Israel suante thu a pia a, Joseph tate nam in a gen dik uhi.
ENGLISH: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Yahweh, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks right.

PAITE: Zelophehad tanute tungtang thu a TOUPA'N thu a piak pen hichi in ahi, Hoih a saksak uh kitenpih uhen la, himahleh a pate uh nampih lak a mi ngei a kitenpih ding uh ahi, chi in,
ENGLISH: This is the thing which Yahweh does command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them be married to whom they think best; only into the family of the tribe of their father shall they be married.

PAITE: Huchi in Israel suante gam pen nam dang kiang a suansuan ahi kei ding. Israel suante'n a pi-leh-pu uh nam gam a neih gige ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

PAITE: Huan, Israel suante lak a gouluah pen ding tanu peuhpeuh Israel suante'n a pi-leh-pute uh gam a luah chiat zel theihna ding un a pa nampih lak a mi ngei zi ahi ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every man the inheritance of his fathers.

PAITE: Huchi in gam bel nam dang namdang kiang ah suansuan ahi sin kei hi. Israel suante'n amau gam chiat a tang gige ding uh ahi ngal a, chi in.
ENGLISH: So shall no inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang geih in Zelophehad tanute'n a hih uhi.
ENGLISH: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:

PAITE: Zelophehad tanu Malate, Tirzate, Hoglate, Milkate, Novate'n a pa uh unau tapate a kitenpih uhi.
ENGLISH: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

PAITE: Joseph ta Manase tapate a kitenpih ua, a gam uh a pa uh nam in a om gige ahi.Hiaite TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab phai a Israel suante a piak, thupiakte leh vaihawmdante ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

PAITE: Hiaite TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab phai a Israel suante a piak, thupiakte leh vaihawmdante ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Levi tate laka Kohath tate, a khangkhang un, a inkuankuan un, sim vek in,
ENGLISH: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

PAITE: Kum sawmthum akipan tunglam, kum sawmnga tanin nasepna na, kihoupihna puanin a sem ding teng.
ENGLISH: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Kihoupihna puanin mun siangthou pen Kohath tapate nasep ding hiai ahi:
ENGLISH: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, the most holy things.

PAITE: Ommun a suan ding teng un Aron a tapate toh a lut ding ua, mun siangthou puanjak a hawkkhe ding ua, huaiin thukun bawm a khuh ding uh;
ENGLISH: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

PAITE: Tuapen ngalvang vunin a khuh ding ua, huaipen puandum buangin a khuh ding ua, ajawnna chiang a thuah ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: and shall put a covering of sealskin on it, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in its poles.

PAITE: Huan, etsakna tanghou dohkan tungah puandum buang a phah ding ua, huailaiah kuangte, keute, belhbute leh noute a but khiakna ding a koih ding uh ahi; huan, tatkakloua tanghou koih huailaiah a om ding ahi:
ENGLISH: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

PAITE: Tuapen puan sanin a khuh ding ua; a khuhna ngalvang vunin a khuh ding uh, a jawnna chiang a thuah ding uhi.
ENGLISH: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

PAITE: Huan, vaksak khawnvak koihna leh huai adinga a zat ding ua khawnvakte, a taitehte, a vu koihnate, thau bing tengteng puandum buangin a khuh ding uhi:
ENGLISH: “They shall take a blue cloth, and cover the lampstand of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

PAITE: Huai leh a vanzat tengteng a khuhna ngalvang vuna khuhin a jawnna ah a koih ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

PAITE: Huan, dangkaeng maitam puandum buangin a khuh ding ua, a khuhna ngalvang vunin a khuh nawn ding uh, a jawnna chiang a thuah ding uhi:
ENGLISH: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

PAITE: Mun siangthou, huailaia a vanzat uh, tuiumbelsuan tengteng a la vek ding ua, puandum buangin a tun ding ua, a khuhna ngalvang vunin a khuh ding uh, a jawnnna ah a koih uhi.
ENGLISH: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry, with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

PAITE: Huan, maitama meivu a la mang ding ua, a tungah puan sandup a phah ding uh:
ENGLISH: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

PAITE: Huan, a tungah a na sep vialvialna uh tuiumbelsuan tengteng, mei lakna te, sa thukna sikkhut te vutluahna te, tuikuang te, maitam tuiumbelsuan tengteng te a koih ding uhi; huan, a khuhna ngalvang vunin a khuh ding uh, a jawnna a bulh ding uh.
ENGLISH: They shall put on it all its vessels, with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the flesh hooks, the shovels, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

PAITE: Huan, Aron leh a tapaten mun siangthou leh mun siangthou van tengteng ommun suan dinga akhuh khit chiang un; huai khit chiangin a jawng dingin Kohath tapate a hongpai ding uhi: ahihhangin thil siangthou himhim a khoih ding uh ahi kei, huchilouin jaw a si kha ding uhi. Hiaite kihoupihna puanina Kohath tapate nasep ding ahi.
ENGLISH: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Huan, siampu Aron tapa Eleazar sep ding, det ding thau te, namtui te, tatlak loua tangbuang thillatte, sathau nilh chite, biakbuk, huailaia thil om tentengte, mun siangthou leh a vante ngaihtuah khawng ahi, chiin.
ENGLISH: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi leh Aron a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

PAITE: Kohath suan inkuan jaw Levite lak akipan mang mai loua:
ENGLISH: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

PAITE: Thil siangthoute khoih loua si loua a om theihna ding uh hichibangin hihih: Aron leh a tapate lut uhenla, a sep ding uh leh a tantuam ding chiat uh seh sakin:
ENGLISH: but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them everyone to his service and to his burden;

PAITE: Ahihhangin thil siangthou en dingin sawt lou chik leng lut kei uhen, a lut uleh a si ding uh, chiin,
ENGLISH: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
ENGLISH: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

PAITE: Gerson tapate leng a inkuankuan un, a khangkhang un sim vekin;
ENGLISH: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

PAITE: Kum sawmthum akipan a tunglam kum sawmngaa upa tanin nasepna na kihoupihna puanina sem thei ding teng zah sim vekin.
ENGLISH: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old; all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

ENGLISH: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

PAITE: Biakbuk puanjakte, kihoupihna puanin te, a khuhna te, a tung khuhna ngalvang vunte, kihoupihna puanin kongkhak puanjakte;
ENGLISH: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above on it, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

PAITE: Intual puanjak te, intual kongkhak puanjak te, abiakbuk leh maitam bula, akhaute, a vanzat tengteng uh toh a po ding ua, hih dia kiphamoh peuhmah a hih ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. Therein shall they serve.

PAITE: Gerson suante nasep a naseplam uleh puaklam ah a tantuam tengteng uh Aron leh a tapate ahi ding; ahih ding uh banghiam nengneng tana sehsak dingin thu na neisak ding.
ENGLISH: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

PAITE: Huaite kihoupihna puanina Gerson suante nasep ahi: a hihding uh siampu Aron tapa Ithamar seh ding ahi.
ENGLISH: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting: and their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

PAITE: Merari tapate, akhangkhang un, a inkuankuan un na sim ding ahi;
ENGLISH: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall number them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

PAITE: Kum sawmthum akipan tunglam kum sawmngaa upa tanin kihoupihna puanina sem ding zah na sim vek ding hi.
ENGLISH: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

PAITE: Kihoupihna puanina a nasep uh, a tantuan ding uh hiai ahi-biakbuk khuam lepkhawm te, a bangkal te, akhuam te, a kingakna khuakhuakte;
ENGLISH: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

PAITE: A intual umna khuamte, akingakna khuakkhuakte, a kilhbelhnate, a khau te, a vanzat tengteng leh a vanzat dang tengteng puak te: a min uh lou jel chiatin a tantuam ding uh na sehsak ding ahi.
ENGLISH: and the pillars of the court around it, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden.

PAITE: Huaite amau siampu Aron tapa Ithamar heua khoupihna puanina Merari tapate suanten a hihding uh banghiam nengneng tana a nasep dan ding uh, chiin.
ENGLISH: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

PAITE: Huchiin Mosi leh Aron leh khawmpi laka lupenten Kohathte tapate a khangkhang un, a inkuankuan un a simta ua,
ENGLISH: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
