ENGLISH: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

PAITE: Huailouin leng jija hiahsiang khoih mite leh puan ngou gan mite a zahlak ding uh
ENGLISH: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

PAITE: Huan, a suangkhuamte hihjanin a om dinga, kiloh sek mi tengteng a lungsim un a lungkham ding uh.
ENGLISH: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

PAITE: Zoan khuaa mi liante a hai hial ding ua, Pharo mipil pente lemtheihna sa lemtheihna bang lel a hong hita: Pharo kiangah, Mi pil tapa, nidanglai kumpipate tapa ka hi, bangchi dana chi sek na hi ua?
ENGLISH: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?”

PAITE: Na mi pilte koia om ahi ua? amau honhilh pah ngal uhen; Aigupta gam tunga thil tung ding, sepaihte TOUPA sehte, thei uhen.
ENGLISH: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what Yahweh of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

PAITE: Zoan khuaa mi liante mi hai a hong hita ua, Noph khuaa mi liante khem in a omta uh; Aigupta namte ninga suangten Aiguptate lah a vak mang saktaa.
ENGLISH: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

PAITE: TOUPAN Aiguptate lakah phengphitna kha a omsakta; huchiin zukham mi a luaka a hoidoidoi bangin Aiguptate a nasep chiteng uah a paikawi sakta uh.
ENGLISH: Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the midst of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

PAITE: Aiguptate adingin lutangin hiam, meiin hiam, tum nahhiangin hiam, pumpengin hiam a sepsak theih a om nawnta kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin Aiguptate numeite bang ahi ding ua: Sepaihte TOUPA khut sin a tung ua aki sin jiakin a ling un a lau ding uhi.
ENGLISH: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Yahweh of Armies, which he shakes over them.

PAITE: Juda gama omte aiguptate adingin mulkimhuaitak a honghita ding ua, a min uh alohna peuh uah a kikta ding ua, amau tunga tung ding sepaihte TOUPA thuseh jiakin.
ENGLISH: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of Yahweh of Armies, which he determines against it.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin Kanate paua pau leh, sepaihte TOUPA kiangah kichiamna thuchiam sekte, Aigupta gamsungah kho nga a om dinga: khat tuh Ni Khopi a chi ding uh.
ENGLISH: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin Aigupta laitakah TOUPA adingin maitam a om dinga, a gamgi-ah TOUPA adingin suangphuh a om ding.
ENGLISH: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.

PAITE: Huai tuh Aigupta gama sepaihte TOUPA adingin chiamtehna leh theihna ahi ding: nuaisiahtte jiakin lah TOUPA a sam sin ngala ua, huchiin aman hondampa leh humbitpa a sawl dinga, aman amaute a honkhe ding.
ENGLISH: It will be for a sign and for a witness to Yahweh of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to Yahweh because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPA Aiguptate theih a hita dinga, Aigupta miten huai ni chiangin TOUPA a theita ding uh: ahi, kithoihna leh thilpiakin a be ding ua, a tangtun lai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know Yahweh in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to Yahweh, and will perform it.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Aiguptate a vo ding a, a vo dinga, a hihdam lai ding; huchiin TOUPA kiangah a kik nawn ding ua, aman amaute ngetnate jain amaute a hihdamding hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin Aigupta gam akipanin Assuria gam phain lam lian a om dinga; huchiin Assuria mite Aigupta gamah a hoh ding uh; Aigupta leng Assuria gamah a hoh ding uh. Aigupta miten Assuria mite toh Pathian a be khawmta ding uhi.
ENGLISH: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin Israelte Aiguptate leh Assuriate toh a thumna ahi ding ua, lei laizang takah vualjawlna ahi ding uh:Sepaihte TOUPAN, Ka mi Aiguptate leh ka khut suak Assuriate leh ka goutan Israelte vualjawlin om uhen, chiin, vual a jawl ngala.
ENGLISH: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPAN, Ka mi Aiguptate leh ka khut suak Assuriate leh ka goutan Israelte vualjawlin om uhen, chiin, vual a jawl ngala.
ENGLISH: because Yahweh of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”

PAITE: Amoz tapa Isaiin Judate leh Jerusalem tungtang thu a muh.
ENGLISH: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

PAITE: Ni nanungte ah hichi ahi dinga, TOUPA in omna tang tuh tang lian tung te ah hihkipin a om dinga, tangneu khakhate tungah leng tawisanin a om ding; huailaiah nam chihte tuh a hoh juajua ding uhi.
ENGLISH: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

PAITE: Huan, chi tampite a hoh ding ua, Hongpai unla, TOUPA tangah, Jakob Pathian in ah, i hohtou ding uh; huchiin aman a lamte tanchinte a honsinsak dinga, a lampite ah ia ai ding, a chi ding uh; Zion akipanin dan thu lah a hongpawt sin ngala, TOUPA thu Jerusalem akipanin a hongpawt sin hi.
ENGLISH: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go forth, and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem.

PAITE: Huan, aman nam chih laka vai a hawm dinga, chi tampi tak leng a taihilh ding: huan, a temsaute uh leilahna muksum dingin a sek ding uh: nam dangin nam dang tungah tamsau a likta kei dinga, kidou dan leng a kisinta kei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

PAITE: Jakob inkuanpihte aw, hongpai un TOUPA vakah i vak ding uh.
ENGLISH: House of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of Yahweh.

PAITE: Suahlam akipana dan hongpawttea a nadim ua, Philistiate banga aisansiamte a hih ua, gam dang mite tate toh khut a kilet jiak un, Na mi, Jakob inkuanpihte, lah na paisanta ngala.
ENGLISH: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

PAITE: A gam uh dangka leh dangkaengin a dima, a sumte uhlah simseng vual ahi kei; a gam uh sakolin a dima, a kangtalaite ulah simseng vual ahi kei.
ENGLISH: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

PAITE: A gam uh milimin a dima; a khut ua a sep khiak uh, a khutzungte ua a bawl uh, a be sek uhi.
ENGLISH: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

PAITE: Mi neute hihniamin a om ua, mi liante leng niamsakin a om uh: huaijiakin amau ngaidam ken.
ENGLISH: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

PAITE: TOUPA kihtakhuaina akipan leh a kilawmna thupina akipan suangpi ah lut unla, leivui ah bu un.
ENGLISH: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.

PAITE: Mihing kideihnate hihniamin a om dinga, mite kisaktheihna niamsakin a om ding, huai niin TOUPA kia tawisanin a om ding hi.
ENGLISH: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the haughtiness of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPA ni lah kingaisang leh kisathei tengteng tungah leh tawisanga om tengteng tungah a om sin ngala; huchiin, niamsakin a om ding uh:
ENGLISH: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and haughty, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low:

PAITE: Lebanon tanga sidar sing sang pipite leh tawisanga om tengteng tungah, Bashan gama tosaw tengteng tungah,
ENGLISH: For all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

PAITE: Tang lian sangpipite tungah, tang neu tawisanga om tengteng tungah,
ENGLISH: For all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

PAITE: In sang sangpipite tungah, kulh bang tengteng tungah
ENGLISH: For every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

PAITE: Tarsish long lian tengteng tungah, thil lim deihhuai tengteng tungah leng hong om sin hi.
ENGLISH: For all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

PAITE: Mihing kideihnate hihniamin a om dinga, mite kisaktheihna niamsakin a om ding. Huainiin TOUPA kia tawisangin a om ding.
ENGLISH: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.

PAITE: Huan, milimte a mang vengveng ding hi.
ENGLISH: The idols shall utterly pass away.

PAITE: Huan, lei nakpipi-a lingsak dinga a thoh hun chiangin, TOUPA kihtakhuaina akipan leh a kilawmna thupina a kipanin mite suangpi hawmte leh lei kohawmte ah a lut ding uh.
ENGLISH: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

PAITE: Huai niin miten a dangka milimte uleh a dangkaeng milimte uh, biak dinga a bawlsak uh, buite leh bakte kiangah a pai ding uh;
ENGLISH: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

PAITE: Lei nakpipi-a lingsak dinga a thoh hun chiangin, TOUPA kihtakhuaina akipan leh a kilawmna thupian akipanin, suangpihawmte leh kawl suangpi hawmte ah a lut ding uh.A nak vang ua hu om mihing muan tawpsanta un: Banglamah ahia muan tak a hih mahmah?
ENGLISH: To go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

PAITE: A nak vang ua hu om mihing muan tawpsanta un: Banglamah ahia muan tak a hih mahmah?
ENGLISH: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?

PAITE: Assuria kumpipa Sargon sawla Tartan Ashdod khuaa a honga, Ashdod khua a suala, a lak kumin;
ENGLISH: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

PAITE: Huai laiin TOUPAN Amoz tapa Isai kamin, Kuan inla, na kawnga saiippuan phel inla, na khea na khedap koihin, chiin, a gena. Huchiin, huchibangin a hiha, vuaktang leh khedap bulh louin a paipai hi.
ENGLISH: at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your shoes from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN, Ka sikha Isai Aiguptate tungah leh Ethiopiate tungah chiamtehna leh thillamdang dinga kum thum suanga vuak tang leh khedap bun lou-a a pai bangin,
ENGLISH: Yahweh said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

PAITE: Assuria kumpipan Aigupta matte leh Ethiopia salte, a neu a lianin, vuaktang leh khedap bulh lou leh to dawkin Aiguptate zahlakna dingin a pi mang ding
ENGLISH: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

PAITE: Huchiin, a lamet pen uh Ethipiate leh a thupina pen uh Aiguptate jiakin mangbang tak leh zahlak takin a omta ding uhHuchiin, huai ni chiangin hiai tuipi geia miin, Ngaiin, i lamet pen, Assuria kumpipa laka honhumbit dinga honpanpihpa dinga i taina uh, lah hichi a hita ngala eite bangchiin i suakta ding ua? a chi ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

PAITE: Huchiin, huai ni chiangin hiai tuipi geia miin, Ngaiin, i lamet pen, Assuria kumpipa laka honhumbit dinga honpanpihpa dinga i taina uh, lah hichi a hita ngala eite bangchiin i suakta ding ua? a chi ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”

PAITE: Tuipi gamdai puakgik, Sim gama pingpei a pai suak bangin gamdai akipanin, gam lauhuai pi a kipanin a hong hi.
ENGLISH: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

PAITE: Kilakna thukhauh tak ka kiangah theihsak a hita; lepchiahtaka hihmun lepchiahtakin a hih a, lokmiin a lok hi, Elamte aw, pai tou un, Mediate aw, um un; a thumna tengteng uh ka daisakta hi.
ENGLISH: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

PAITE: Huaijiakin ka kawng natna thupitakin a dima, numei nauvei natna banga natnain a honmanta; bila za theilou khopin na ka thuaka; khomu theilou khopin ka mang a bang hi.
ENGLISH: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have taken hold on me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I so am dismayed that I can’t see.

PAITE: Ka lungtang a ha huaihuaia, thil mulkimhuai takin a honhihlaua; nitak ninem ka ngaklah sek kei dingin linna a honsuakta.
ENGLISH: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

PAITE: Dohkan lah a bawlkhol ua, galvengmi lah a vengsak ua, a ne ua, a dawn ua; mi liante aw, thou unla, lum tuh thau nuh un.
ENGLISH: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

PAITE: TOUPAN ka kiangah hichiin a gen hi, Kuan inla, galvengmi vengsakin, aman a thil muh gen hen;
ENGLISH: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

PAITE: Huan, Sepaih a pawlte, sakol tung tuang a kopkopa paite sabengtung pawl te, sangawngsau pawlte, a muh chiangin pilvangtakin a ngaikhe kilkel ding, chiin.
ENGLISH: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

PAITE: Huan, amah humpinelkai bangin a kikou a; TOUPA aw, sunin galven buk tungah ka ding seka, han khua khuain ka venna ah lah non omsak gige a;
ENGLISH: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

PAITE: Ngaiin, hiai laiah mihing pawl, sakol tung tuang a kopkopa pai a hong uh, chiin. Huan, amah mahin Babulon khua a pukta, a pukta, a milim pathian bawl tawmte tengteng uh leiah hihkhap janin a omta, chiin, a dawng hi.
ENGLISH: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

PAITE: Aw ka buh vuaksa, ka phuala buh; sepaihte TOUPA, Israelte Pathian akipana ka jak na kiang ua pulak ka hi.
ENGLISH: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

PAITE: dumah puak gik. Min Seir tang akipanin a honsam ua, Galvengpa jan bangchi a hitaa? Galvengpa, jan bangchi a hitaa? chiin
ENGLISH: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

PAITE: Galvengpan, Jingsang hi ding a hita, jan leng; na dot nop uleh dong un; kihei nawn unla, hongpai un, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

PAITE: Arabia gam tunga puakgik, Dedante khualzin pawl chihte aw, Arabia gama gamnuaiah na gik ding uh.
ENGLISH: The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, you caravans of Dedanites.

PAITE: Dangtak kiangah tui a hon tawi ding ua, Tema gama omten a an un taimangte a na dawn uh.
ENGLISH: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

PAITE: Amau lah namsaute akipan, temsau dohsa akipan leh, thalpeu laisaa kipan leh, kidouna thupi tak akipan taimang ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

PAITE: TOUPAN lah hichiin ka kiangah a chi ngala, Kilohmi kum sima kum khat sungin Kedarte thupina tengteng a mang khin dinga,Thalkapmi, Kedar suante laka mi hattak omsunte, tawmchik ahi ding uh; TOUPA Israelte Pathianin, huai lah a genta ngala chiin.
ENGLISH: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

PAITE: Thalkapmi, Kedar suante laka mi hattak omsunte, tawmchik ahi ding uh; TOUPA Israelte Pathianin, huai lah a genta ngala chiin.
ENGLISH: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”

PAITE: Kilanna guam puak gik, Bang na chi ua amai, in tung khawnga na kal touh vek uh?
ENGLISH: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

PAITE: Aw kikou husaa dim, khopi chiak vengvung, kho kipaktak, na sunga a thahte uh temsaua thah ahi kei ua, kikapnaa si leng ahi sam kei uh.
ENGLISH: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

PAITE: Na vaihawmmi tengteng a tai mang chiat ua, thalkap mite gakin a om ua, gamlapi akipana hongtai mangte
ENGLISH: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.

PAITE: Huaijiakin ken, Honen louin lehlam en un, nakpiiin ka kap sin; ka mite tanu gallaka a lak thu uah honnem nuam vang lak dah un, ka chi hi.
ENGLISH: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

PAITE: TOUPA, sepaihte TOUPA akipanin kilakna guamah buaina leh sikdenna leh mangbatna ni lah ahi ngala; kulhpi bang hihsiatna leh tangte sapna
ENGLISH: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”

PAITE: Huchiin, Elamten thalbawm a tawi ua, mihing tuanna kangtalaite leh sakol tung tuangmite toh; Kirten lum tuamna lah a phel ua.
ENGLISH: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi a, na guam hoihpente lah kangtalaiin a dimta a, sakol tungtuangmite lah kulh kongkhak bulah a kiphu noinoi uh. Huan, Judate khuhna a la mang hi.
ENGLISH: It happened that your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

PAITE: Huan, Judate khuhna a la mangta. Huchiin huai niin Gammang Ina galthuamna lam na enta uh.
ENGLISH: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

PAITE: David khopi kulhpi siatna tate leng na en ua, a tam chih na thei uh: huan, dil khangnungjaw tuite na luangkhawm sak uhi.
ENGLISH: You saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

PAITE: Huan, Jerusalem inte na sim ua, kulhpi bang bawl hoihna dingin inte khawng na phel uh.
ENGLISH: You numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

PAITE: Dil lui tui omna dingin kulhpi nih kikalah tuichin khawmna na bawl ua; himahleh huai hihmi lam lah na en ngal kei ua, nidanglaia anabawlpa lah na limsak het kei uh.
ENGLISH: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who purposed it long ago.

PAITE: Huai niin TOUPA, sepaihte TOUPAN, kap ding leh awm kitum ding leh lugiau sak ding leh saiip puan teng dingin a sam a:
ENGLISH: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth:

PAITE: Himahleh, ngaiin, nuamna leh kipahnate, bawng thahna leh belam thahnate, sa nekna leh uain dawnna te a om zota a, ne ni dawn ni, jingchiangin lah i si sin ngal ua, a chi uh.
ENGLISH: and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”

PAITE: Huchiin sepaihte TOUPA tuh ka bil ah a kilaka. Pellouin hiai khelhna na sih masiah uh na lak uah silsiang a hita kei ding, TOUPA, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi, chiin.
ENGLISH: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

PAITE: TOUPA, sepaihte TOUPAN, hichiin a chi, Kuan inla, hiai sumkempa vial kiangah, Shebna, in tunga heutu-a om kiang ngeingei ah, hohin.
ENGLISH: Thus says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

PAITE: Huan, a kiangah hichiin genin, Hiaia bang hih na hia? hiai ah kua na neia, han hiaia na khuak vial? Amah adingin sangpi-a a han a khuaka, amah adinga suangpi-a omna a bawl vial!
ENGLISH: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”

PAITE: Ngaiin, TOUPAN nang a paihin a honpai ek ding, mi hatin a paih bangin; ahi, a tunin nang a hontun ikek ding.
ENGLISH: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

PAITE: Pellouin aman nang lum bangin a honpei dinga, gam zapi-ah a honvawk lut ding: huailaiah na si dinga, huailai mahah, nang, na pu insung zahlaksakpa, na thupina kangtalaite a om ding hi.
ENGLISH: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you shame of your lord’s house.

PAITE: Na nasepna akipan ka hondelh khe ding a, aman heutu na hihnaa kipan a honkaikhesuk ding hi.
ENGLISH: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

PAITE: Huan, huai niin hichi ahi dinga, ka sikha Eliakim, Hilkha tapa, ka sam dinga; amah na puannnak tual ka silh sak dinga.
ENGLISH: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

PAITE: Na kawnggakin ka hihhat dinga, na vaihawmna amah khutah ka kem sak ding: Huchiin Jerusalema omte adin leh Juda inkuanpihte adingin pa ahi ding.
ENGLISH: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

PAITE: Huan, David inkuanpihte tahbi a liangjang ah ka koih dinga: aman a hong dinga, kuamahin a khak kei ding uh: a khak dinga, kuamahin a hong kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will lay the key of the house of David on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.

PAITE: Huan, amah, kilhna mun kiptaka a kilh ngiungeu bang un, ka hihkip ngiungeu dinga: huchiin amah tuh a pa inkuanpihte adingin laltutphah thupi mahmah ading ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

PAITE: Huan, amahah a pa inkuanpihte thupina tengteng a bang vek ding ua, a tate leh a suante, tuiumbelsuan neu chiteng, belhbu tuiumbelsuan akipan tui koihna tuiumbelsuan tengteng tanin.Huai niin, kilhna, mun kip taka kilh ngiungeu-a omin a nangzou kei dinga; sat khiaka omin, a keta dinga, a tunga thil gik om lah hihmanthatin a omta dinga; TOUPAN huai lah a genta ngala, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi, chiin.
ENGLISH: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.

PAITE: Huai niin, kilhna, mun kip taka kilh ngiungeu-a omin a nangzou kei dinga; sat khiaka omin, a keta dinga, a tunga thil gik om lah hihmanthatin a omta dinga; TOUPAN huai lah a genta ngala, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi, chiin.
ENGLISH: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down, and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”

PAITE: Tura kho puakgik. Tarsis long liante aw, mau tuaituai un; in himhim omlou khop leh lutna himhim om lou khpa hihsiatin a omta hi; huai lah Kittim gama kipanin a kiang ua hihlatin a om hi.
ENGLISH: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

PAITE: Tuikulha omte aw, dai sipsip un; Sidon kho sumsin tuipi-a paiten a honkiningchin sak uh.
ENGLISH: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

PAITE: Tuipi-a, Shihor chi, Nile lui buh lak, a punna hi naka, nam chih sumsinna mun ahi nak hi.
ENGLISH: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

PAITE: Sidon aw, zumin; tuipi kulh piin, thu a genta ngala, Nau ka vei ngei keia, ka nei ngei sam kei, tangval lah ka vak ngei sam keia, nungak leng ka khangliansak ngei sam kei hi, chiin.
ENGLISH: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor brought forth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

PAITE: Thuthang Aigupta gam a tun hun chiangin Tura thuthang a nak vei mahmah ding uh.
ENGLISH: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

PAITE: Tarsish ah va hoh unla; Tuikulha omte aw, mau tuaituai un.
ENGLISH: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

PAITE: Hiai maw na kho kipak uh, a upata upa, a khein gamlapi-a om dinga a pi sek?
ENGLISH: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

PAITE: Lallukhu khusaktu khua Tura tungah kuan ahia hiai tung dinga sep? huailaia sumsinmite lah mi liante ahi ua, huai laia sumsinmite lah leia mi zahtakhuaite ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honorable of the earth?

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPAN, thupina tengteng kisaktheihna nawngkaisak ding leh, leia mi zahtakhuai tengteng muhsithuaia omsak dingin, a sep hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

PAITE: Tarsish tanu aw, Nile lui bangin na gamah luang letin; na kawnggak na himhim lah a omta kei a.
ENGLISH: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

PAITE: Tuipi tungah a khut a jaka, gamte a lingsaka; TOUPAN Kanaan gam tungtangah thu a piaa, a kulhte hihse dingin.
ENGLISH: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

PAITE: Huan, aman, Sidon tanu nungak aw, mi nuaisiah, nuam na sa nawn kei ding; thou inla, Kittim gamah galkahin; huailaiah leng khawlna himhim na mu tuan kei ding hi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

PAITE: Enin, Kaldaite gam; hiai mite a omta kei uh; Assuria miin gamdaia gamsate adingin a septa hi; a insangte uh a lam ua, huaia inpite a hihmang ua, in siain a bawlta.
ENGLISH: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people was not. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

PAITE: Tarsish long liante aw, mau tuaituai un; na kulhte uh hihsiatin a om ta hi.
ENGLISH: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

PAITE: Huan, huai niin hichi ahi dinga, Tura khua, kumpipa khat kum sima, kum sawm sagih sung mangngilhin a om ding; kum sawmsagih man nungin kijuak laa a gen bang un Tura kho tungah a hongtung ding.
ENGLISH: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

PAITE: Nang kijuak mite mangngilhsa nung kaihging la inla, kho kimah vakin, kaihging kai inla, ka tampi sa in theiha na om nawn theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

PAITE: Huan, kum sawmsagih a man nungin hichi ahi dinga, TOUPAN Tura khua a pha dinga, huchiin huai minu a loh delhin a om nawn dinga, leitunga khovel gam tengteng lakah kijuakin a om ding.Huan, a sum muhkhiak leh a loh TOUPA adingin thil siangthou ahi ding; huailah kholkhawmin hiam, koihkhawmin hiam a om kei dinga, a sum muhkhiak TOUPA maa omte adingin ahi sin ngala, niang leh taia a nek ding uleh, puansilh thupi tak a neih theihna ding un.
ENGLISH: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre, and she shall return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

PAITE: Huan, a sum muhkhiak leh a loh TOUPA adingin thil siangthou ahi ding; huailah kholkhawmin hiam, koihkhawmin hiam a om kei dinga, a sum muhkhiak TOUPA maa omte adingin ahi sin ngala, niang leh taia a nek ding uleh, puansilh thupi tak a neih theihna ding un.
ENGLISH: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

PAITE: Ngaiin, TOUPAN lei a awngsakin, a sesak sina, a lumlet dinga, a omte a dalhsak sin hi.
ENGLISH: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

PAITE: Huan, vantang tunga om bangin siampu tungah leng a om ding; bawipa tunga a om bangin a pu tungah leng a om ding; bawinu tung a om bangin a pi tungah leng a om ding; a leimi tunga a om bangin, a khawngmi tungahleng a om ding; leitawisakmi tunga a om bangin a kianga apung pemi tungah leng a om ding.
ENGLISH: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

PAITE: Lei lah awnsak keuhkeuh inleh hih siat dimdemin a om ding; huai lah TOUPAN a chita ngala.
ENGLISH: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.

PAITE: Lei lah a kapin a tul a khovel lah bahin a tul a, leia mi tungnungte a bah uhi.
ENGLISH: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

PAITE: Lei lah a ommite nuaiah a buahkhinta; dan te ah a talek ua, thuseh lak a hihlamdang ua, khantawn thukhuna a tatlek jiak un.
ENGLISH: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

PAITE: Huaijiakin hamsiatin lei a ne khina, a ommite lah siam louh tansak in a omta uh: huaijiakin leia ommite lah a kanglum ua, mi tawm chik kia a om lai uh.
ENGLISH: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

PAITE: Uain thak lah a kapa, grepgui lah a baha, lungtang nuamte tengteng a mau uhi.
ENGLISH: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

PAITE: Khuangtate kipahna lah a daia, kaihging nuamsa ging lah a daita.
ENGLISH: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

PAITE: Lasa kawmin uai a dawm kei ding uh: ju lah a dawnmite adingin a kha mahmah ding.
ENGLISH: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

PAITE: Buaina khopi chipsakin a omta: kuamah himhim a lut louhnba ding un in chih khakin a omta.
ENGLISH: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

PAITE: Uain jiakin kongzingte ah kap husa a oma: nuamna tengteng mialsakin a oma, hiai gam nopna a gamgta.
ENGLISH: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

PAITE: Khopi ah siatna nutsiatin a oma, a kulh kongkhak lah vuak siatin a omta.
ENGLISH: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

PAITE: Lei laitakah mi chih lakah hichiin a om sing ngala, olive sing vuak nunga gah a om lai sek bangin leh, grep loh nunga grep maih loh ding a om lai sek bang maiin.
ENGLISH: For it will be so in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

PAITE: Huaiten a aw uh a suah ding ua, a kikou ding uh; TOUPA thupina jiakin tuipi akipanin ngaihtakin a kikou ding uh.
ENGLISH: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.

PAITE: Huaijiakin TOUPA tuh Suahlam ah pahtawi un.
ENGLISH: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

PAITE: Kawlmong tawpa lasak i ja, Mi diktatte kiangah thupina om hen, chih la. Himahleh, ken bel, Ka gawng huaihuaia, ka tung gik hi! lepchiahtaka gamtammiten lepchiahtakin a hih uhi, ka chi a.
ENGLISH: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

PAITE: Leia om aw, lauhuainate, kokhukte, thangte na tungah a om hi.
ENGLISH: Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabitant the earth.

PAITE: Huchiin hichi ahi dinga, lauhuai husa akipana taipa tuh kokhukah a ke dinga; kokhuk sunga kipana pawtkhe toumi thangah a awk ding; tunglama tohlette lah honin a om ngalam lei kingaknate lah a ling hi.
ENGLISH: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the midst of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

PAITE: Lei lah a kitam gawp veka, lei lah hihmanin a om vek a, lei lah nak pitakin a ling hi.
ENGLISH: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

PAITE: Leilah mi zukham bangin a hoi dongdong dinga, bawkta hawt bangin a kihawt ding; a tatlekna lah a tungah giktakin a om ding a, huchiin a puk dinga, a thou nawnta kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

PAITE: Huan, huai ni chiangin hichi ahi dinga, Toupan tunglama mi tungnung pawl lian pipite a gawt ding, leia lei kumpipate toh.
ENGLISH: It shall happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

PAITE: Huan, hentate kokhuka pi khawma a om bang un huaite pi khawmin a om ding ua, suangkulha khum in a om ding uh, ni sawttak nungin gawt in a om ding uh.Huai hun chiangin tunga kha zum takin a om dinga, tunga ni zahlak takin a om ding; sepaihte TOUPA lah Zion tang leh Jerusalem khuaah leh, a upate maah, thupitakin lalin a om sing ngala.
ENGLISH: They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.

PAITE: Huai hun chiangin tunga kha zum takin a om dinga, tunga ni zahlak takin a om ding; sepaihte TOUPA lah Zion tang leh Jerusalem khuaah leh, a upate maah, thupitakin lalin a om sing ngala.
ENGLISH: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders will be glory.

PAITE: TOUPA aw, nang lah ka Pathian na hi a; kon pahtawi ding, na min ka phat ding; thillamdang tak, nidanglaia vaihawmte, ginomte, ginomtak leh thutakin na hih ngala.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

PAITE: Khopi leng lei vumin na suaksaka; khua kulhpi nei leng kho sia na suaksaka; gamdang mite kumpipa in leng khua louin na bawl ngala; chik chiang maha lamin a on nawnta kei ding.
ENGLISH: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

PAITE: Huaijiakin mi hat mahmahten a honpahtawi ding ua, nam kihtakhuai mahmah khopiin a honkihta ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

PAITE: Mi kihtakhuaite hu huihpiin bang a hongom chiangin, nang jaw mi genthei adingin bukna, tagah mangbang lai adingin bukna, huihpi laka kihumbitna, nisa liahna lah na hisek ngala.
ENGLISH: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

PAITE: Mun keua kho lum na daisak jel bangin, gamdang mite husa na daihsak bangin; kho lum meipi liaha daihsaka a om sek bangin, mi kihtakhuaite lasa daihsakin a om ding hi.
ENGLISH: As the heat in a dry place will you bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

PAITE: Huan, hiai tangah sepaihte TOUPAN mi chih adingin thil thautein ankuang a lui ding, uainte a te toh kidiah, thil thau mahmahte guhngeka dim, uainte a te toh kidiah hoihtaka khit siang.
ENGLISH: In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of choice wines, of fat things full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

PAITE: Huan, khuhna mi tengteng tunga khiak, puanjak nam tengteng tunga jak hiai tangah a hihse ding hi..
ENGLISH: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

PAITE: Sihna a valh denta; TOUPA Pathianin mi tengteng maia kipan khitui a nul siang dinga; a mite min siatna lah leitung luah tengteng akipoanin a la mang ding: TOUPAN huai lah a chita ngala.
ENGLISH: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.

PAITE: Huan, huai niin, Ngai un, hiai tuh i Pathian ahi; amah i ngakngak ua, huchiin a honhondam ding: hiai tuh TOUPA ahi; amah i ngakngak ua; a hotdamnaah i kipakin i nuam ding uh, a chi ding uhi.
ENGLISH: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is Yahweh! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

PAITE: Hiai tangah TOUPA khut a kinga dinga, Moab, buhpawl ekkuaa sikden suka a om sek bangin, amah mun ah sikdenin a om sin ngala.
ENGLISH: For in this mountain the hand of Yahweh will rest. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

PAITE: Huchiin tuiliaumiin tuiliau dinga a khuat bangin, huai lakah a khuattein a khuat ding: huan a kisaktheina lah a khut lepchiahna tohin TOUPAN a koih niam ding.Huan, na kulh bangte in sang kulhpi lah a hihchimin, a koi niamin, leiah, leivui pha hialin a puksakta hi.
ENGLISH: He will spread out his hands in its midst, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

PAITE: Huan, na kulh bangte in sang kulhpi lah a hihchimin, a koi niamin, leiah, leivui pha hialin a puksakta hi.
ENGLISH: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin Judate gamah hiai la a sa ding uh. Khopi kip tak i nei ua: aman lah hotdamna kulh bangte le kulhpite adingin a sep ding hi.
ENGLISH: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

PAITE: Nam diktat thutakjui nam a lut theihna dingin kulh kongkhakte hong un.
ENGLISH: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

PAITE: Na tunga lungsim ngami, nangmah a hon muan jiakin, khamuang mahmaha om dingin na veng ding.
ENGLISH: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

PAITE: TOUPA khantawnin muang un: TOUPA Jehova ah lah khantawn suangpi a om ngala.
ENGLISH: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

PAITE: Aman lah sangpi-a omte a hihniamta ngala, khopi sangpi mah: huai tuh a koih niama, lei phain a koih niama, leivui pha hialin a puksak hi.
ENGLISH: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

PAITE: Khein a sikden ding; gentheite khe leh tagahte kalsuan mahmahin.
ENGLISH: The foot shall tread it down; Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.”

PAITE: Mi diktat lampi lah dikna ahi a; nang lungtang diktat puin mi diktat lampi na hihmam sek.
ENGLISH: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

PAITE: A hi, TOUPA aw, na vaihawmna lampi ah kon ngak nilouh uh: kou hinna deihlam jaw na min loh leh nangmah theihgigena ahi.
ENGLISH: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, have we waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

PAITE: Jan chiangin ka hinnain nangmah a honngaia; ahi, jingkhangin ka sunga ka kha omin ka honzong ding hi: na vaihawmnate leia a hongom chiangin khovela omten diktatna lah a sin jel ngal ua.
ENGLISH: With my soul have I desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

PAITE: Mi thulimlou jaw deihsakin om mahleh, diktatna a sin tuan sam kei ding: dikna gamah diklou tak in a hih dinga, TOUPA thupina a mu tuan kei ding.
ENGLISH: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.

PAITE: TOUPA, na khut lah jakin a oma, himahleh amau lah a mu tuan kei ua: ahihhangin mite adia na phatuamngaihna a mu ding ua, a zum ta ding uh; ahi, nang hondoute meiin a kang mang ding.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

PAITE: TOUPA nang lemna non sehsak ding: nang lah ka nasep tengteng uh non sep sak ngala.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also worked all our works for us.

PAITE: TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, nang kia hilouin kumpipa dangten leng ka tunguah thu a neikhin ta ngal ua, himahleh nang mahmah panpihin na min ka lou ta ding uh.
ENGLISH: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.

PAITE: Amau lah a sita uha, ahing nawn kei ding uh; a mangta ua, a thou nawn kei ding uh; huaijiakin nang amau na gawtin na hihsiaa, a theihgigena tengteng u leng na hihmangta hi.
ENGLISH: The dead shall not live. The deceased shall not rise. Therefore have you visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

PAITE: Hiai nam lah na pungsaktaa. TOUPA aw, hiai nam lah na pungsakta: nang lah pahtawiin na omta: hiai gam lah a gamgi tengteng na liansakta hi.
ENGLISH: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

PAITE: TOUPA, a dah lai un a honzong ua, na gawtna a tung ua a kiak laiin a thum zihzeh uh.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

PAITE: Numei nau pai, neih hun naita bangin; TOUPA aw, kou leng na maah ka om sek uh.
ENGLISH: Like as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs; so we have been before you, Yahweh.

PAITE: Nau ka pai ua, ka na ua, huih bang lel ka nei uh; leiah lah tatkhiakna lam himhim ka hihko kei ua; khovela omte lah a puk sam kei uh.
ENGLISH: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

PAITE: Na misite a hing nawn ding ua; ka mi luangte a thou nawn ding uh. Leivuia omte aw, halh unla, nuamtakin lasa un: na daitui lah khovak daitui bang ahi a, leiin lah misite a paikhe sin ngala, chih.
ENGLISH: Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast forth the dead.

ENGLISH: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

PAITE: Ngai un, TOUPA, a gitlouhna jiak ua leia omte gawt dingin a omnaa kipan a hong pawtkhe sin hi: lei mahin a sisan a hihlang dinga, a mi a thah te uh a khuhta kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: For, behold, Yahweh comes forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin TOUPAN, a namsau hoihtaka hiam, lianpi, muanhuaitakin, leviathan gulpi hattak leh leviathan gulpi kivial ngeingoi a gawt dinga, tuipi-a dragon om leng a that ding.
ENGLISH: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin: Uain grep huan khat, huai pahtawiin lasa un.
ENGLISH: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

PAITE: Kei TOUPA lah a vengpa ka hi a; mitphiatkal tengin tui ka buak dinga, kuamahin a khoih louh ding un sun leh janin ka veng ding.
ENGLISH: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

ENGLISH: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

ENGLISH: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

ENGLISH: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherim and the incense altars shall rise no more.

PAITE: Khua kulhpi nei lah a lungjuanga, omna nutsiat leh paisan, gamdai bang ahi: huailaiah bawngnou a ta dinga, huailai mahah a kual dinga, a selte a ne ding.
ENGLISH: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

PAITE: A hiangte lah a vuai chiang un khiahin a om dinga; numeite a hongpai ding ua a hal ding uh: amau lah theihtheihna himhim neilou mi ahi ngal ua: huaijiakin amau bawlpan amaute a hehpih kei dinga, amaute sutuahpan amaute deihsakna himhim a neikei ding hi.
ENGLISH: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

ENGLISH: It will happen in that day, that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, huai niin hichi ahi dinga, pengkul lianpi a mut ding ua: huchiin Assuria gama mangthang dekdekte leh, Aigupta gama delhkhiaka omte a hongpai ding ua: Jerusalem khuaa tang siangthouah TOUPA a be ding uhi.
ENGLISH: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

PAITE: Ephraimte zu khamhatte kisaktheihna lallukhu tung leh, a kilawmna uh thupi pak tul laitak, uain thazoha omte guam hausa tak lutang tunga om a tung a gik hi!
ENGLISH: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

ENGLISH: Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

PAITE: Ephraimte zu khamhatte kisaktheihna lallukhu lah sik denin a om dinga:
ENGLISH: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

PAITE: A kilawmna uh thupi paktul laitak, guam hausa tak lutang tunga om, nipi maa theipi min masapen, a enmiin a muha, a khuta a om taka a nek khit mai sek bang ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer; which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

ENGLISH: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

PAITE: Himahleh huaite leng uain jiakin a kipek a kipek ua, ju jiakin a hoihoi ua: siampute leh jawlneite lah ju jiakin a kipek pek ua, uain valh khitin a om ua, ju jiakin a hoihoi ua: kilakna thu-ah a kipekpek ua, vaihawmna thu-ah a hoihoi uh.
ENGLISH: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

PAITE: Mun siang mahmah om lou khopin dohkan tengteng lah luak leh thil ninin a dim hi.
ENGLISH: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

PAITE: Theihna lam aman kua ahia a sinsak sin laitei? thukhah leng aman kua ahia a theihsak sin laitei? nawinek tawp tungte leh nawi neksak nawnlouhte ahi ding uam?
ENGLISH: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

PAITE: Thuzohna thu tunga thuzohna thu chian touh, thuzohna thu tunga thuzohna thu chian touh: dan tunga dan chiantouh, dan tunga dan chiantouh: hiaiah tawmchik, huaiah tawmchik chih ngenta a hih jiakin.
ENGLISH: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

ENGLISH: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language;

ENGLISH: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

ENGLISH: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”

The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

ENGLISH: For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;
