PAITE: Sawmnga heutu leh, mi zahtakhuai leh, lemtheimi leh, khutsiam leh jawlaisiam te toh.
ENGLISH: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

PAITE: Huchiin a mi liante ding ua om dingin naupangte ka pe dinga, naungekten a tunguah vai a hawm ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

PAITE: Huchiin, mite nuaisiahin a om ding ua, mi chih kinuaisiahin a om ding uh, mi chih amau insakinkhangte toh kiuaisiahin a om ding uh: naupang upa tungah kisathei takin a om ding ua, mi thulimloupi nangawn mizahtakhuai tungah kisathei takin a om ding.
ENGLISH: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the base against the honorable.

PAITE: Min a unau a pa ina lenin, Nang silh leh ten na neia, ka vaihawmtu un om inla, hiai siatna na khut ah om heh, a chih chiangin:
ENGLISH: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

PAITE: Huaichiangin amah a pau khe dinga, kei jaw bawlhoihtuin ka om sin kei hi; ka in ah lah nekding a om keia, silh leh ten lah a om kei: mite vaihawmpain non bawl kei ding, chiin.
ENGLISH: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

PAITE: A thupina mit vuisak dinga a pau u leh a thilhihte uh TOUPA dou lam a hih jiakin Jerusalem a se khina, Judate a pukkinta uhi.
ENGLISH: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Yahweh, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

PAITE: A mel latdanin amau a hek tawma; a khelhna uh Sodom bang takin a langsak ua, a im kei uh. Atung uh gik e! thilhoihlouin a kithuk tawm ngal ua.
ENGLISH: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

PAITE: Mi diktat thu-ah A hoih sin uhi, chi un; a thilhih gahte ulah a ne sin ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.

PAITE: Mi giloute tung a gik hi! Lah a se sin ngal ua; a khut ua thilhih thukna tuh a kiang ua piak a hih ding jiakin.
ENGLISH: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.

PAITE: Ka mite jaw, amau nuaisiahtute naupangte a hita ua, numeiten a tunguah vai a hawmta uh. Ka mite aw, nou honpiten a honpi khial ua, na paina lamte a hihse sek uhi.
ENGLISH: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

PAITE: TOUPA tuh genpih dingin a hongding khiaa, mite vaihawm dingin a hongdingta hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

PAITE: TOUPAN a mite upate tungah leh amau mi liante tungah vai a hawm ding: TOUPA, Sepaihte TOUPAN, Noute na hi uh, grep huan ne gaite; mi tangahte akipan sum lak na in uahte ahi a om:
ENGLISH: Yahweh will enter into judgment with the elders of his people, and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The spoil of the poor is in your houses.

PAITE: Bang achia ahia ka mite na at ua, tagahte mai na gawijan uh? achia.
ENGLISH: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

PAITE: Huai louin TOUPA, Zion tanute kisathei taka a om ua, dak vuau vuau leh mi en loplopa a pai ua, a pai un a pai lohloh ua, a khete uh a suan ging thuapthuap jiak un.
ENGLISH: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking to trip as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

PAITE: TOUPAN Zion tanute lujangah maimakhem a omsak dinga, TOUPAN a zhmohte uleng a dawksak ding a chi hi.
ENGLISH: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin TOUPAN akizephoihnate uh a laksak dinga, khebulhte, len lukhu te, hakklote;
ENGLISH: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

PAITE: Bilbah kai ngaihngaihte, taute. kikhuhna puante;
ENGLISH: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

PAITE: Lutang puante, khebulh khainiang te, kawnga tente, gimlim bawmte, kikauna te;
ENGLISH: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume bottles, the charms,

PAITE: Min sawnna zungbuhte, nakbulhte;
ENGLISH: the signet rings, the nose rings,

PAITE: Ankuangluina vante, puannak tualte, puan silhte, kawljalte;
ENGLISH: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

PAITE: Limlangte, puanmalngatte, dial te, kituamhoihna puante.
ENGLISH: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

PAITE: Thau namtui tak sikin thil muat a om ding; huan, kawnggak sikin khaujen a om ding; huan, sam mam sikin talkolh a om ding; huan, puan kilawm tak sikin saiip puan ten a om ding: melhoih sikin melhoihloute a omding.
ENGLISH: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

PAITE: Na mite namsau vatpaihin a om ding ua, na mi hat mahmahte kidounaah a puk ding uh.A kulh kongkhakte a awm uh kitumin a kap ding ua; amah tuh a hawm dinga, leiah a tu ding hi.
ENGLISH: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

PAITE: A kulh kongkhakte a awm uh kitumin a kap ding ua; amah tuh a hawm dinga, leiah a tu ding hi.
ENGLISH: Her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

PAITE: TOUPAN, ta helhatte a tung uh a gik hi! huaiten lah mi a dong ua, kei lah hon dong kei uh, a khelhna tung ua khelhna a behlapna ding un, khuhnain a khuh ua, ka kha thuin lah a khuh tuan kei uh;
ENGLISH: “Woe to the rebellious children,” says Yahweh, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin,

PAITE: Pharo hatnaa kihatsak dingin leh, Aigupta lim bel dingin, ka kam dong tuan louin Aigupta gama paisuk tumin a kuan uh.
ENGLISH: who set out to go down into Egypt, and have not asked my advice; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

PAITE: Huaijiakin Pharo hatna noute zahlakna a hita dinga, Aigupta lim na na belh uhlah na maizumna uh a hita ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

PAITE: A mi liante lah Zoan khuaah a om ua, a palaite lah Hanes khua a tungta ngal uhi.
ENGLISH: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

PAITE: Amau adia phattuamna himhim neilou mi, huhna hilou, phattuamna nei mi leng hi lou, maizumna leh minsiatna hizote, a vek un a zumpih sin uh, achi a.
ENGLISH: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

PAITE: Sim gama sate puakgik, Buaina leh lunglauna gam, humpinelkainu leh humpinelkaipa, ngandekpak leh gul kuang leng thei pawtna, a sum uh sa bengtung nou tungte ah, a gou uh sangawngsau nungvumte ah po sakin, amau adia phattuamna neilou mite kaingah piak dingin, a pai ton dapdap uh.
ENGLISH: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

PAITE: Aiguptain lah phatuamlou tak leh pannaneilou takin a panpih jel ngala; huaijiakin ahi, amah, Rahab tu kinkennu, ka chih.
ENGLISH: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore have I called her Rahab who sits still.

PAITE: Tuin pai inla, huaite ama ua lai gelhna pekah gelh inla, laibu ah leng gelhin, tu nunga khantawn dong adig a hih theihna din.
ENGLISH: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

PAITE: Huaite lah mi helhatte, ta juautheite, ta TOUPA dan ngaikhe nuamloute ahi ngal ua;
ENGLISH: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the law of Yahweh;

PAITE: Mutheimite kianga, Mu kei un, jawlneite kianga, Thil dikte honhilh khol kei un, thil nuam lam ka kiang uah gen un, khemna thu gen un, khemna thu gen khol un;
ENGLISH: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and to the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

PAITE: Lam lou ah pai un, lam sikah pial un, Israelte Mi Saingthou ka ma ua kipan hihmang un, chi ngitnget-te
ENGLISH: Get out of the way. Turn aside from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

PAITE: Huaijiakin Israelte Mi Siangthouin hichiin ahi a. hiai thu na muhsit jiakun leh nuaisiahna leh phengphitna na muan ua, a tung ua na kingak jiak un.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it;

PAITE: Hiai thulimlouhna noute adingin suangbang sangpi selai, chim dekdek, puak engong, thakhata mitphialkal lou-a se gawp ding bang ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.

PAITE: Huchiin belvelmi bel a kitam gawp sak bang un, hawi om het lou-a kek nenin, a themnen lakah belpei thuka mei lakna ding hiam aw, tuikhuka tui dipna ding hiam aw, omlou khopin, a kitm nen sak ding, chiin.
ENGLISH: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken piece a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

PAITE: TOUPA PATHIAN Israelte Mi Siangthouin lah hichiin a chi ngala. Kik nawna khawla omin hotdamin na om ding ua; muang taka omna ah leh upna omnaah na hatna uh a om ding, chiin; himahleh nou lah na ut kei ua.
ENGLISH: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

PAITE: Hi lou e, sakol tunga tuangin i tai zozot ding uh, na chi zosop ua, huaijiakin na tai zozot ngei ding uh; Thil hat tak tungah i tuang ding, na chi ua; huaijiakin nou hondelh ding lah hat tak ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses”; therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift”; therefore those who pursue you will be swift.

PAITE: Mi khat phawnin sang khat a taikek dudup ding ua; mi nga phawn in na taikek dudup ding uh; a tawpin mualvuma puankhai khai bang leh, tang tunga chiamtehna om banga nutsiatin na om ding uhi.
ENGLISH: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

PAITE: Huaijiakin noute TOUPAN a honhehpih theihna dingin a hongak dinga, huaijiakin noute a honlainat theihna dingin pahtawiin a om ding; TOUPA lah vaihawm diktatna Pathian ahi ngala; amah ngakte teng tengin nuam a sa uhi.
ENGLISH: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

PAITE: Mite lah Jerusalema Zion ah a omsin ngal ua; na kap nawn kei ding uh; na kahna husa uah aman a hon hehpih mahmah ding a; a jak takin a hon dawng ding hi.
ENGLISH: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

PAITE: TOUPAN lungkhamna an leh haksatna tui noute honpe mahleh, nou honsinsakmite a kibu nawn kei ding ua, na mit un nou honsinsakmite a mu zota ding;
ENGLISH: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden anymore, but your eyes will see your teachers;

PAITE: Huan, taklama na pial un hiam, veilama na pial un hiam, na bil un na nunglam ua thu, Hiai lampi ahi, hiai-ah pai un, chiin, a za jel ding hi.
ENGLISH: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

PAITE: Huan na dangka uh milim bawl dangka chi-a zepna leh, na dangkaeng uh, milim sun dangkaeng tuia luanna lah na buahsak ding ua; thil nin bangin na paita ding ua, a kiangah, Pai mangin! na chi ding uh.
ENGLISH: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

PAITE: Huchiin, aman na buh chi uh leia na tuh ding uh adingin vuahtui a pe dinga; leia thil poute leng an din a pe ding, huailah hoihtak pung tak ahi ding; huai ni chiangin na ganta uh gantatna mun za pi ah a ta ding uh.
ENGLISH: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

PAITE: Bawngtal leh sabengtungnou leiletten an chisoh, ninluahna leh phajaha hihsiangsa a ne ding uh.
ENGLISH: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory provender, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

PAITE: Huan, kithahna thupitak ni-a galvenna singte a chip niin, tang sang teng ah leh mual vum sang tengah luipite leh luite tui luang khawng a hong om ding.
ENGLISH: There shall be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

PAITE: Huailou leng TOUPAN a mite kihehna a tuama, a liamna ma uh a damsak ni chiangin, kha vak ni vak phain a omta dinga, ni vak a mun sagihin, ni sagih vak phain a omta ding hi.
ENGLISH: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

PAITE: Ngaiin, TOUPA min tuh, a hehna kuang juajuain, meikhu sah moimoiin jamtou ngoingoi lakah, gamla pi-a kipanin a hongpai hi; a mukte khawng lunghihlouhnain a dima, a lei lah thil kat mang hat mei bang ahi.
ENGLISH: Behold, the name of Yahweh comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation, and his tongue is as a devouring fire.

PAITE: A hu lah, manna lohpi-a nam chih sep dingin, lui ngawng chiang pha hiala a kuanga let nawnaw bang ahi; huan mi chih kamah pi khelhsakna kaihgingna khau a om ding.
ENGLISH: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction; and a bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

PAITE: Huan, jana zehtan siangthou-a zeh a tan lai ua la a sak bangun, la a sa ding ua; TOUPA tanga Israelte Suangpi kiang tung dinga tamngai toh a pai lai ua lungtang nopsakna leng a nei ding uh.
ENGLISH: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to Yahweh’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN a aw thupitak a kijasakta dinga, a hehna thupitak leh thil kat mang ching mei kuangin, a huihpi leh vuahpi leh gialin, a khut khak dana ensakta ding.
ENGLISH: Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.

PAITE: TOUPA aw jiakin Assuria mi, khetbuka mi khen nakpa, kitapjan sakin a om ding a hita ngala.
ENGLISH: For through the voice of Yahweh the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

PAITE: Amah lah chiang sehsaa TOUPAN a jep peuhmah chiangin khuangtate leh kaihgingte toh a jep ding; achiang lika kisuaknate ah amau a sual ding.Tophet lhat lah tumaa nana bawlkholhsa ahi ngala; ahi, kumpipa adingin bawlzoh siang ahi a; thu tak za takin a bawla; a thil sek khawm tuh mei leh sing tamtak ahi a; TOUPA a hu, kat lui luang bangin, a kang sak juajua hi.
ENGLISH: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.

PAITE: Tophet lhat lah tumaa nana bawlkholhsa ahi ngala; ahi, kumpipa adingin bawlzoh siang ahi a; thu tak za takin a bawla; a thil sek khawm tuh mei leh sing tamtak ahi a; TOUPA a hu, kat lui luang bangin, a kang sak juajua hi.
ENGLISH: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. Yahweh’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.

PAITE: Aigupta gama panpihna zong dinga hoh suka, sakolte tunga muanga, a tam jiak ua kangtalaite leh a hat mahmah jiak ua sakol tungtuang mite muanga Israelte Mi Siangthou lam bel en lou-a, TOUPA leng dong loute jaw a tung uh a gik hi!
ENGLISH: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek Yahweh!

PAITE: Dong kei mahle uh amah leng pil tak ahi, thil hoihlou a hontung sak dinga, a thute laha khel nawn kei ding, thil hoihlou hihmite inkuan sual dingin a thou zo dinga, khialte panpihna dou dingin a thou ding.
ENGLISH: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.

PAITE: Aigupta mite jaw, PAthian ahi kei ua, mi lel ahi uh; huchiin TOUPAN a khut a jak hun chiangin a panpihtu pen a pai ekek dinga, a panpihpen leng a puk dinga, a vek un a mangthang chiat ding uh.
ENGLISH: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahweh stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.

PAITE: TOUPAN lah hichiin ka kiangah a chi ngala. Humpinelkai leh humpinelkai lun laiin sa a kham laiin belam chingmi tamtak a sual dingin a sap khiakin om mah le uh, a aw uh a lau kei ding ua, a bilap jiakun a kihta tuan kei ding bangin, sepaihte TOUPA jaw Zion tangah a mual pawnga sual dingin a hong paisuk ding hi.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so Yahweh of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.

PAITE: Vasate a bu tung ua a leng leng bang un sepaihte TOUPAN Jerusalem khua a veng ding; a veng dia a tankhe dinga, a paikanin a humbit ding hi.
ENGLISH: As birds hovering, so Yahweh of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”

PAITE: Israel suante aw, nakpi taka na helsan sa lam uh nga nawnta un.
ENGLISH: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.

PAITE: Huai niin mi chihin amau dangka milimte, amau dangkaeng milimte, khelhna dinga noumau khuta na kibawltawmte uh lah a pai mang uh ahi ngala,
ENGLISH: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.

PAITE: Huai hun chiangin Assuria mi bel, mi namsaua puk sak hi louin, nam sau hih puk sak hi louin, namsau hihpukin a om dinga; namsau mi te-a hi louin, amah a gai ding; huan, namsau laka kipan a tai mang dinga, a tangvalte lah siah liaumi a honghita ding uh.Huan, a suangpi lah thil mulkimhuai jiakin a mang dinga, a miliante lah chiamtehna jiakin a buaita ding, chiin, TOUPA, a mei Ziona omin leh, a haltuina mei Jerusalema omin, ahi.
ENGLISH: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.

PAITE: Huan, a suangpi lah thil mulkimhuai jiakin a mang dinga, a miliante lah chiamtehna jiakin a buaita ding, chiin, TOUPA, a mei Ziona omin leh, a haltuina mei Jerusalema omin, ahi.
ENGLISH: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says Yahweh, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

PAITE: Ngaiin, kumpipa khat diktat takin kumpipain a tu dinga, mi lainten vaihawmna diktakin vai a hawm ding uh.
ENGLISH: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

PAITE: Huan, mi khat huihpi laka bukna mun bang leh, vuahpi laka bitna mun bang ahi ding, mun keua tui luangte bang, gam tultaka suangpi lianpi nuamsa bang tak.
ENGLISH: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.

PAITE: Huchiin a mute mite a mial kei dinga, a zate bilin a ngaikhe ding.
ENGLISH: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

PAITE: Huan, sin-gammite lungin theihna thu a thei siam dinga, dang-awkte lei teltakin a pau thei ding.
ENGLISH: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

PAITE: Mi gilou tuh mi thilphal a chi nawnta kei ding uh, milepchiah lah mi siam a chi nawn kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

PAITE: Pathien zahlouhna thil hih ding leh. TOUPA hekna dia thu diklou gen dingin, gilkialte sung hawmsak ding leh, dangtakte dawn ding hihmang dingin, mi gilouin lah gitlouhna thu a gen ngal dia, a lung lah thil a hih khial ding.
ENGLISH: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against Yahweh, To make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

PAITE: Mi lepchiah vante jaw hoih lou ahi a; tangahten thu dik a gen un leng mi gentheite juau thu-a hihmang dingin aman lah thil lah thil gilou hih a ngaituah jel hi.
ENGLISH: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked devices to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

PAITE: Mi thilphal bel thilphal lam thilte a ngaihtuah: huchiin thilphal lam thilte ah a om gige ding.
ENGLISH: But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.

PAITE: Numei mawkomte aw, thou unla, ka aw ngaikhia un; tanu pilvangloute aw ka the genah bil doh un.
ENGLISH: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!

PAITE: Numei pilvangloute aw, kum khat leh ni bangzah hiam nungin na buaita ding uh; grep loh ding lah a om ngal kei dinga, grep loh khawm dingah leng bangmeh a suak sam kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage shall fail. The harvest won’t come.

PAITE: Nunei mawkomte aw, ling nun: mi pilvenagloute aw, buaitakin on un; kisuah unla, vuaktangin kibawl unla, na kawng uahte saiip puan teng un.
ENGLISH: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.

PAITE: Lou deihte jiak leh grep gui gah nuamte jiakin a awm a tumtum ding uh.
ENGLISH: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

PAITE: Ka mite gam loulingnei leh khaulingneiin a buak ding; ahi, khopi nopsakhuai taka nopsakna in tengteng tungah:
ENGLISH: Thorns and briars will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.

PAITE: Kumpipa in lah paisanin a om sin ngala; a mual pawng leh a galvanbuk lah khantawn kohawm ding leh, gam sanengtung kipahnate, ganhon tatna mun te ahi ding;
ENGLISH: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks;

PAITE: tung lama kipana kha ka tung ua suna a oma, gamdai lei hoih tak mun a suaha. lei hoihtak mun lah gammang banga sim a hih mateng.
ENGLISH: Until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.

PAITE: Huai hunin vaihawm diktatna tuh gamdaiah a teng dinga, diktatna tuh lei hoih tak munah a om ding.
ENGLISH: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.

PAITE: Huan, diktatna nasep tuh kituahna ahi dinga, diktatnaa thil pawt lah khantawna muang taka omna leh kitheihchetna ahi ding.
ENGLISH: The work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

PAITE: Huchiin ka mite bel galmuanga omnaah leh in kipakah te leh khawlna mun muanhuaitakahte a omta ding uhi.
ENGLISH: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places.

PAITE: Himahleh gammang bel hihpuk ding in gial a ke lomlom dinga; khopi lah hihniam mahmahin a om ding.Tui luanna piaua chi theh jel, bawngtal leh sanengtung khah jel te aw, nuam na sa uhi.
ENGLISH: Though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.

PAITE: Tui luanna piaua chi theh jel, bawngtal leh sanengtung khah jel te aw, nuam na sa uhi.
ENGLISH: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.

PAITE: Nang loh tuak ngei lou pi-a, aloka pang, lepchiah taka bawl tuak ngeilou pi-a, lepchiah taka pang, na tung a gik hi, Mi loh na tuak sam ding hi; lepchiah taka na hih khit chianain, na tungah lepchiah takin a hih ding uh.
ENGLISH: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed; and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have made an end of betrayal, you will be betrayed.

PAITE: Toupa aw, hon hehpihin; ka hon ngak nilouh uhi; jingsang tengin a ban uh honghi inla, buai hun chiangin leng hon hondampa honghi in.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

PAITE: Lum vengvung husain mi chih a taimang ta ua; nang na kisak hial chiangin nam chih hihdalhin a omta uh.
ENGLISH: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

PAITE: Na sum uh gallaka lak ding lungin thil a kaihkhawmin a om ding; khaupete a tawm duamduam uh bangin amaute tuh sum tungah a tawm duamduam ding uh.
ENGLISH: Your spoil will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

PAITE: Toupa tawisangin a omta; tunglamah lah a om ngala; aman Zion lah vaihawm diktakna leh diktatnain a dimsak ta hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

PAITE: Na dam sungin om kipna a om dinga. hotdamnate, pilnate, theihna te a om kikeih ding; TOUPA launa lah a gou ahi a.
ENGLISH: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.

PAITE: Ngaiin, a pasalphate uh polamah a kikou ua; kituahna palaite lah a kap hohhoh uhi.
ENGLISH: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

PAITE: Lamliante lah a mualta ua, mi zin vialvakte lah a om nawn kei uh; amah lah thukhun a bohsiaa, khuate lah a musita, mi khawk a sa ta kei.
ENGLISH: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

PAITE: Gam lah a kapin a gima; Lebanon tuh a zumin a vuaia; Sharon lah gamdai bang a hita; Bashan leh Karmelin a nah uh a sing khia uh.
ENGLISH: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

PAITE: TOUPAN, Tun ka thou dinga, tun ka kisa dinga, tun tawi sangin ka omta ding.
ENGLISH: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh; “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.

PAITE: Lou keu na pai ding ua, buhpawl na suang ding uh; na hu uh noumau kang mang ding mei ahi.
ENGLISH: You will conceive chaff. You will bring forth stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

PAITE: Mi chih lah chinai suang hal bang, loulingnei vat sa meia a paih bang uh, a chi ding uh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

PAITE: Gamlapi-a omte aw, ka thil hih bilin na ja un; naichika omte aw, ka thilhihtheihdan thei un.
ENGLISH: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

PAITE: Ziona mi gilou omten a lau ua; Pathian zahlou mite linnain a manta hi. I lak ua kua ahia thil kat mang ching mei kianga om ding? i lak uah kua ahia khantawna kang zoizoi kianga om ding?
ENGLISH: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

PAITE: Diktattaka oma diktaka gen jelmi; nuaisiahnate punna himhim bangmaha ngailou-a golhna la nuamlou-a bil huma, gilou himhim en nuamlou-a mitsi jel mi;
ENGLISH: He who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; He who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

PAITE: Huai mi bel tunglamah a om dinga; a kidalna mun sang lah suangpi kidalnate ahi ding; a an lah a kianga piak ahi dinga, a tuite lah a om ngeingei ding.
ENGLISH: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

PAITE: Na miten kumpipa lah a kilawmnain a mu dinga, gam kiphalh za tak a hon en ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

PAITE: A simmi koia omta ahia? siahliau tehmi koia omta ahia? galven insangte simmi koia omta ahia? chiin, na lungtangin thil mulkimhuai mahmah na ngaihtuah ding.
ENGLISH: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

PAITE: Mi hangtak, pau giltak na theihtheih louha pau mite, pau tuam na theihsiam louha pau mite, na mu nawnta kei ding.
ENGLISH: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.

PAITE: I zehtanna khopi Zion en dih; na mitin Jerusalem omna muanhuaitak, puanin chikchianga leng suan louh ding, kaih gakna khet chik chiang aleng boh louh ding, a kaihna khau himhim kitat lou ding bang, a mu ding.
ENGLISH: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

PAITE: Huailaiah TOUPA, lui za pipi leh luitate omna mun, thupitakin i kiang uah a omzo ta ding; huai tui tungah kidouna long lianpi kalhna chiang neite himhim a pai kei dinga, long lian thupitak inleng a khen sam kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of broad rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

PAITE: TOUPA lah i vaihawmpa ahi a, TOUPA lah dan hon pepa ahi a, TOUPA lah i kumpipa ahi; aman a honhondam ding hi.
ENGLISH: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.

PAITE: Na khaute tuh kolsakin a om dinga; a puanjak peu bul uh lah a kipsak theikei ua, puanjak lah a jak theikei uh; huai laitakin gallak sum tampi hawmin a oma; khebaiten leng gallak sum a lata uhi.Huai khuaa mi omin, ka chi a na, chi kei dinga, a sunga mite tuh khelh ngaihdamin a om ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great spoil was divided. The lame took the prey.

PAITE: Huai khuaa mi omin, ka chi a na, chi kei dinga, a sunga mite tuh khelh ngaihdamin a om ding uhi.
ENGLISH: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.

PAITE: Nam chihte aw, bila za dingin hong nai un; mi chihte aw, ngaikhia un; leitung leh a sunga om tengtengin bilin ja uhen; khovel leh a sunga pata pawt tengteng toh.
ENGLISH: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear; the world, and everything that comes from it.

PAITE: TOUPAN nam chiteng tunga lungkimlouhna neiin a sepaihte uh tengteng tungah lah hehna a nei ngala; amau tuh a hihmang veka, thah din a peta hi.
ENGLISH: For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.

PAITE: A lak ua thaha omte paih khiakin a om ding ua, a luang namsia uh a paitou vutvut dinga, tangte tuh a sisan ua zulsakin a om ding uh.
ENGLISH: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up; and the mountains will melt in their blood.

PAITE: Vana omte tengteng hihmanin a om ding ua, van tuh laibu jialchi a jial bang un jialin a om dinga, a omte tengteng tuh, grep gui akipan a nah a vuia a pulh jel bangin leh, theipi kung akipana a nah vuai a pulh jel bangin a vuai khin ua a pulh vek ding uh.
ENGLISH: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.

PAITE: Ka namsauin vanah taitakin a dawnta ngala, ngaiin, huai tuh vaihawm dingin Edomte tungah leh ka hamsiat mite tungah a ke ding.
ENGLISH: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.

PAITE: TOUPA namsau tuh sisanin a tai dinga, thaunaa thausakin a omta belam noute leh kelte sisanin, belampa gilthautein; TOUPAN Bozrah khuaah kithoihna a neia, Edom gamah leng thahna thupitak a nei hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

PAITE: Gambawngtalte leng kituaka sat paihin a om ding ua, bawngpate bawngtalte toh, a gam un sisan a kham dinga, a leivui uh thaunaa thausakin a om ding.
ENGLISH: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.

PAITE: TOUPA phulak ni lah a hita ngala, Zion selna lam thu-a thukna kum.
ENGLISH: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

PAITE: A lui tuite long nai dia suahsakin a om dinga, a gam tuh longnai kang luahluah a suak ding hi.
ENGLISH: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, And its land will become burning pitch.

PAITE: Sun leh janin mihsak ahi kei dinga; a meikhu lah khantawnin a tungkah ngoingoi ding; suan om lai siah a siain a om nilouh dinga; khantawn in leng kuamahin a ngap kei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: It won’t be quenched night nor day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.

PAITE: Tuivagik leh sakuhin huai gam a tang ding ua; simbu leh va-ak huaiah a om ding uh; siatna khau leh pomna sikmumkhat a tungah a khai ding hi.
ENGLISH: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.

PAITE: A mi hoihte uh gam uk dingin a sam ding ua, himahleh huailaiah kuamah sap ding a om kei ding uh; a mi lian tengteng uh bangmah ahi kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.

PAITE: A kumpipa un inah loulingneite a pou dinga, a kulhpi sung uah dailing leh lingnok a pou ding; sehalte omna ding leh vasa ngawngsaute adingin inumsung intual ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.

PAITE: Huan, gamdaia, gam sate ngiate toh a kituak ding ua, sathakin a lawm a sam ding; ahi, jan thil lauhuai piin huai laiah omna a bawl dinga, amah adingin khawlna mun ding a mu ding.
ENGLISH: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature literally, lilith, which could also be a night demon or night monster shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.

PAITE: Huailaiah simbu thupiin bu a bawl dinga, a tui dia, a keuh dinga, a op khawm ding; ahi, huaiah mute koppih nei chiatin a om khawm ding ding uh.
ENGLISH: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.

PAITE: TOUPA laibu-ah zong unla, sim un; huaite lakah khat leng kimlou a om kei dinga, khat leng koppih neilou a om kei ding; ka kam ngeiin thu a piaa, a kha ngeiin huaite a pi khawmta ngala.Aman lah amau adingin ai a sansaka, a khuta khaua tehin huai gam a hawmsak chiata; khanawnin a nei ding ua, suan om laiteng huailaiah a om ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Search in the book of Yahweh, and read: not one of these will be missing. none will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.

PAITE: Aman lah amau adingin ai a sansaka, a khuta khaua tehin huai gam a hawmsak chiata; khanawnin a nei ding ua, suan om laiteng huailaiah a om ding uhi.
ENGLISH: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

PAITE: Gamdai leh phaksap gam a kipan dinga; gam keuin nuamsain pawn pak bangin a pak ding.
ENGLISH: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

PAITE: A pak lun dinga, kipak tak leh lasain nuam a sa ding; Lebanon thupi na a kiangah piak ahi ding, Karmel leh Sharon kilawmna toh; TOUPA thupina a mu ding ua, i Pathian kilawmna toh.
ENGLISH: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory Lebanon will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see Yahweh’s glory, the excellence of our God.

PAITE: Khut hatloute hatsak unla, khuk jawte kipsak un.
ENGLISH: Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the feeble knees.

PAITE: Lungtang dawilokte kiangah, Hat takin om unla, lau kei un; ngai un, na Pathian uh phulakna toh a hongpai dinga, a honhondam ding, chi un.
ENGLISH: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong. Don’t be afraid. Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.

PAITE: Huai hun chiangin mittote mit hahsakin a om dinga bengngongte bil hihvakin a om ding.
ENGLISH: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

PAITE: Huai hun chiangin khebaite sakhi bangin a tawm ding ua, pautheiloute leiin nuamsa takin la a sa ding; gamdai ahte lah tuite a hongphul khe biabia sin ngala, gam keute ah luita tui a hong phulkhe buabua sin ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

PAITE: Huchiin piaunel sa mahmah munte dil a hongsuak dinga, lei dangtak mahmah tuinak a hongsuak ding; sehalte tennaa, a lupna uah, loupa, tuilou leh sikhapat toh, a om ding.
ENGLISH: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.

PAITE: Huan, huailaiah lamlian a om ding, kongpi toh, huai tuh siangthouna Lampi a chi ding uh; mi thanghuaiin lampi a tawn kei ding; ahihbangin huai mite adingin ahi zo ding; mi vialzinte, ahi, mi haite leng, huailaiah a mang kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called The Holy Way. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools will not go there.

PAITE: Humpinelkai himhim huailaiah a om kei dinga, sa hing ne himhim huailaiah a pai tou sam kei ding uh, huailah muh ding leng a om kei ding; tatte bel huailaiah a pai tou ding uh;Huan TOUPA tatte a kik nawn ding ua, lasa khawmin Zion a tung ding uh, khantawna kipahna a lu tunguah a omta dinga; nuamsakna leh kipahna leh thumna a mangta ding hi.
ENGLISH: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

PAITE: Huan TOUPA tatte a kik nawn ding ua, lasa khawmin Zion a tung ding uh, khantawna kipahna a lu tunguah a omta dinga; nuamsakna leh kipahna leh thumna a mangta ding hi.
ENGLISH: The Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”

PAITE: Huan, kumpipa Hezekia kum sawm leh kum lina kumin hichi ahi a, Assuria gam kumpipa Sennakerib tuh Juda gama khua kulhpi nei tengteng sim dingin a vahohtou-a a lata hi.
ENGLISH: Now it happened in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah, and captured them.

PAITE: Huan, Assuria kumpipan Rabsakeh sepaihhon tampi piin Lakish khua akipanin Jerusalem khuaa kumpipa Hezekia kiangah a sawla. Huan, dil saknung tuilakna kianga puansawpmi pawn lamlianah a dinga,
ENGLISH: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to king Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.

PAITE: Huchiin kumpipa inkuanpihte tunga heutu-a om Hilkia tapa Eliakim te, laigelhmi Shebnate, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joa te kiangah a hong suk uhi.
ENGLISH: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder came out to him.

PAITE: Huan Rabsakehin a kiang uah, Hezekia kiangah hichiin gen un, Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipain hichiin a chi, Na muanna kiangakna bang ahi maia?
ENGLISH: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

PAITE: Kidouna dinga na lemtheihna leh na hatna jaw thu lel ahi, ka chi; Kua muanga, ka tunga hel na hi maia?
ENGLISH: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

PAITE: Ngaiin, hiai sialluang chiang, kitan Aiguptate, muang neive; huaimin a muan aleh, a khutah a sun ding hi; Aigupta kumpipa Pharo jaw amah muang tengteng tungah hichibang ahi nakanak hi.
ENGLISH: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

PAITE: Ahihkeileh, ka kiangah, TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh, na chihleh, amah pen Hezekiain Judate kiangah leh Jerusalemte kiangah, Hiai maitam maah kia na biak ding uh ahi, chi-a, a mun sangte leh a maitamte lak mang sakpa hi lou hia?
ENGLISH: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar?’”

PAITE: Huchiin, hehpihtakin, ka pu Assuria kumpipa kiangah thu chiamin, huchiin ken sakol sang nih ke honpe ding, nang a tung ua tuangdingte na muh theihpeuh ding leh.
ENGLISH: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

PAITE: Bangchin, kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu-ah Aiguptate tunga na muanna ngaa, ka pu sikha neupente laka heutu khat leng na nan zoh ding?
ENGLISH: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

PAITE: Huan, hiai hihse dinga sim dingin TOUPA panglou-a hong pai tou ka hi-a hia? TOUPAN, ka kiangah, Huai gam sim dingin hoh tou inla, hihsia in, a honchi, chiin, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Have I come up now without Yahweh against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”

PAITE: Huan, Eliakim leh Shebna leh Joa ten, Rabsakeh kiangah, Hehpihtakin na sikhate Suria pauin honhoupihtain; huailah ka theithei ngal ua; kulh bang tunga mite jakin Juda pauin honhoupih nawn ken, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

PAITE: Himahleh Rabsakehin, Ka puin na pu kiang kiaah leh nang kiangah hiai thu gen dingin honsawl ahia? Kulh bang tunga tute, noute toh amau ek ne ding leh amau zun dawn dingte kiangah, a honsawl a hizo kei maw? a chi a.
ENGLISH: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

PAITE: Huan, Rabsakeh a dinga, Juda pauin ngaihtakin a kikou-a, kumpipa thupi Assuria kumpipa thute ngaikhia un.
ENGLISH: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

PAITE: Kumpipan hichiin a chi, Hezekia khemin om nuam dah un; aman lah a honhumbit thei sin ngal keia;
ENGLISH: Thus says the king, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.

PAITE: Hezekiain, TOUPAN pellouin honhumbit ding; hiai khopi jaw Assuria kumpipa khuta piakin a om kei ding, chiin, thu gen mahleh, TOUPA tuh Hezekia gen jiakin muang nuam tuan dah un.
ENGLISH: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’

PAITE: Hezekia thu ngaikhe kei un; Assuria kumpipan lah hichiin a chi ngala, Thilpiakin hon kituahpih unla, ka kiangah hongpai khia un; mi chihin a grep guia pat leh mi chihin a theipi kunga pat ne chiat unla, mi chihin a tuikhuka pat tui dawn chiat un.

PAITE: Huchiin Isaiin Hezekia kiangah, Sepaihte Toupa thu theiin.
ENGLISH: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of Yahweh of Armies:

PAITE: Ngaiin na in sunga om tengteng leh tuni tana na piputen a kholkhawmte uh Babulon khua paipihin a om vek ding; bangmah him him nutsiat in a om kei ding; hucibang nite a hong tung ding, Toupan achi.
ENGLISH: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, na tapa, na gila hong gah ding, na suan dingte ngei laka mi, a pai mang pih ding uh; amau Babulon kumpipa inah michilgeh dingin a om ding uh, a chih, a chi a.Huchiin Hezekiain, Isai kiangah, Toupa thu na gen a hoih hi, a chi a. Amah mahin, Ka damsung in lemna leh thutak a om sin ngala, a chi lai hi.
ENGLISH: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”

PAITE: Huchiin Hezekiain, Isai kiangah, Toupa thu na gen a hoih hi, a chi a. Amah mahin, Ka damsung in lemna leh thutak a om sin ngala, a chi lai hi.
ENGLISH: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”

PAITE: Huan, huai niin numei sagihin pasal khat a len din ua, Koumau an ka ne ding ua, koumau silh leh tenka silh un ka teng ding uh; na min lel honpu sak in; ka minsia uh honlak mangsak in, chiin, a gen ding uh.
ENGLISH: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing: only let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”

PAITE: Huai niin TOUPA hiang tuh kilawm takin leh thupitakin a om dinga, Israelte damlaite adingin leia gahte hoihtak leh kilawmtakin a om ding.
ENGLISH: In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

PAITE: Huan, Zion nutsiata om leh, Jerusalema omden tuh siangthou chihin a om ding, michihjerusalema damlaia min gelhte,
ENGLISH: It will happen, that he who is left in Zion, and he who remains in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem;

PAITE: Vaihawmna kha leh katna khaa TOUPAN Zion tanute buahte a sawp mangsaka, a sunga kipan Jerusalem sisan a suksiangkhit chiangin.
ENGLISH: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from its midst, by the spirit of justice, and by the spirit of burning.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN Zion tanga omna tengteng tungah leh a kikhawmpite tungah sunin mei leh meikhu, janin meikuang vak a bawlsak ding; thupina tengteng tungah lah banghiam jak a om sin ngala.Sunin ni sa liah ding leh vuahpi laka kihumbitna leh bukna mun dingin bawkta ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion, and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory will be a canopy.

PAITE: Sunin ni sa liah ding leh vuahpi laka kihumbitna leh bukna mun dingin bawkta ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.

PAITE: Lungmuan un, ka mite lungmuan un, na Pathian un a chi.
ENGLISH: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

PAITE: Jerusalemte kiangah lungmuan lamsangin thugen unla, a galdouna uh hih zoh a hitaa, a khelhna uh ngaihdam ahi a, a thil hih khelh tengteng gun ding in Toupa khutta kipan amunihin a muta uh chih hilh un.
ENGLISH: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem; and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh’s hand double for all her sins.”

PAITE: Tua! Kikou awin, Gamdaiah Toupa lampi bawl unla, gam keu-ah I Pathian adingin lamlian kilualsak un.
ENGLISH: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.

PAITE: Guam chih sansak ahivek dinga, tang chih mual chih niamsak ahi ding: lampi kawite tansak ahi dinga, a phokna lailai hihlual ahi ding:
ENGLISH: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.

PAITE: Huan, Toupa thupina hihlat ahi dinga, mi tengtengin huai a mu diamdiam chiat ding uh: Toupa kamin lah a genta ngala, a chi a.
ENGLISH: The glory of Yahweh shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

PAITE: Tua! awin, Kikou in, a chi. Huan, miin, bang thu gen din kaki kou dia? a chi-a. Mi tengteng loupa bang ahi ua, a thupina tengteng uleng pawna pak bang ahi.
ENGLISH: The voice of one saying, “Cry!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.

PAITE: Toupa huin a mut jiakin loupa a vuaia, a pak a tul nak: mite jaw loupa bang ahi mahmah uhi.
ENGLISH: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.

PAITE: Loupa a vuaia, a pak a tul jel: i Pathian thu ubel khantawn in a om gige ding, chiin, a chi a.
ENGLISH: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

PAITE: Zion kianga a tanchin hoih hilh mi aw, tangsang mahmahte khawngah vahoh tou un; Jerusalem kianga tanchin hoih hilh mi aw, ngaihtakin na aw suahin; suahin, lau ken; Juda khuate kiangah, En un, na Pathiah uh!
ENGLISH: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength. Lift it up. Don’t be afraid. Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”

PAITE: En un, Toupa Pathian mi hattak bang in a hongpai sin hi; a banin a sikin vai a hawm ding: en un, a kipahman lah a kiangah a om hi, a ditna leng amaah a om.
ENGLISH: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

PAITE: Aman belamchingpa bangin a belamhon a vak dinga, belamnoute a banin a pomkhawm dinga, a ang sunga koihin a paipih dinga, noukailaite bel awlawl in a pi hiathiat ding, chiin.
ENGLISH: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

PAITE: Kuan ahia tuite a khutpek kuak lela teha, tunga van khap lela teh a, leia leivui tehna khat lel a thun veka, tangte lah khaina lel a khaia, mualpawngte lah bukna lela buk?
ENGLISH: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

PAITE: Kuan ahia Toupa kha thilhih dan ding kawkmuh? ahih keileh kua ahia amah lemsehsak hi-a amah chi?
ENGLISH: Who has directed the Spirit of Yahweh, or has taught him as his counselor?

PAITE: Aman kua a dong a, kuan ahia amah theisaka, vaihawm lampi ensaka, theihna hilha, theihsaimna lampi ensak ngei?
ENGLISH: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

PAITE: Ngaiin, namchih lah baltina tui tak khat bang lel ahi ua, buknaa banghiam nen bang lela seh ahi ua, ngaiin, aman lah tuikulh gante thilneu neuchikte bangin a dom jel hi.
ENGLISH: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

PAITE: Lebanon nangawn khul tham ahi keia, a gama gante leng halmanga kithoihnatham ahi sam kei hi.
ENGLISH: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.

PAITE: Namchihte lah a maah bangmahlou bang ahi ua, amah ngaihtuahin bangmahlou sanga tawm jaw, huihkhua lel ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

PAITE: Pathian kua toh teh dia kisa na hi ua? Ahihkaleh, bang lim ahia amah toh na teh ding uh?
ENGLISH: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?

PAITE: Milim bawltawm zaw, nasem miin a sunga, dangkaeng sek min dangkaeng in a luan khum a, huai adingin dangka khainiangte a sunsak jel
ENGLISH: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

PAITE: Huchibang thilpiak pe zou lou-a, genthei lo mahmahin sing muat lou ding a tel jel, milim bawl tawm, ling lou ding, amah adia bawlkhiak sak ding khutsiam mi a zongjel hi.
ENGLISH: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up an engraved image for him that will not be moved.

PAITE: Na lungsim un na theingei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za ngei kei ua hia? a tunga kipan in hon hilh kei ua hia? Lei pian chila kipanin na theisiam kei ua hia?
ENGLISH: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard, yet? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

PAITE: Amah jaw lei kualkhumna tunga tupa ahi, amah mitmuhin leitunga omte khaupe bang lel ahi uh, amah jaw tunga van puanin tung banga kai palha, Puan in omna ding a jak a, miliante bangmahlou suaksakpa ahi.
ENGLISH: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in;

PAITE: Amah leitunga vaihawmmite bangmahlou-a bawl nakpa ahi.
ENGLISH: who brings princes to nothing; who makes the judges of the earth like meaningless.

PAITE: Ahia, suan ahi kei ua; ahi, a tuh ahi kei uh; ahi, a kung un leiah zung a kai kei: huailouin aman amau a muta, a vuai ua, pingpeiin buhsi a lak mang bangin a la mang nak hi.
ENGLISH: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

PAITE: Kua toh honteha, kua kimpih lela honsep dek na hi ua? Mi siangthouin a chi
ENGLISH: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

PAITE: Tunglam khawngah na mit uh haksak unla, huai thilte khawng kua siam hiam en un; aman tuh sepaihte kizomzom in a pi khe jela, a min chiat un a sam jela; a hatna thupina jiak leh thilhihtheihna lama a hat jiakin khat lel leng kimlo a om ngei kei uhi.
ENGLISH: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. by the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, Not one is lacking.

PAITE: Jakobte aw, Bangchia hichibanga chi na hi ua, Isrealte aw, bangchia, hichibanga thugen na hi ua, Ka lampi jaw Toupa laka sel ahi a, a honvaihawmsakna ka Pathian laka lak mang ahi, chih?
ENGLISH: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God?”

PAITE: Na lungsim in na theingei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za ngei kei ua hia? Khantawn Pathian. TOUPA kawlmong Siampa, a bah ngei keia, a gim ngei sam louhdan; a theihsiamdan zon khiak vual ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, The Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

PAITE: Bahte kiangah thilhitheihna a pe jela; hatna him him neiloute a hatsak naknak hi.
ENGLISH: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

PAITE: Tuailaite nangawn leng a bah un a gim ding ua, tangvalte leng a puk zou ding uh:TOUPA ngakten jaw a hatna uh a thaksak nawn ding ua; muvanlaite bangin khain a leng tou ding ua; gim louin a tai ding ua; bah louin khein a pai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

PAITE: TOUPA ngakten jaw a hatna uh a thaksak nawn ding ua; muvanlaite bangin khain a leng tou ding ua; gim louin a tai ding ua; bah louin khein a pai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

PAITE: Tuikulh gahte aw, ka maah dai sisip unla; michihin a hatna uh thaksak nawm uhenla: hongpai nai chiat le uh; huai khit chiangin gen uhen: vaihawm dingin kinaih tuah chiat ni.
ENGLISH: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.

PAITE: Suahlam akipan mikhat, diktatna jiak a khe bula a sap, kuan ahia kai halh? Aman lah nam chih a maah a piaa, kumpipate tungah vai a hawmsaka; amau leivui bangin a namsau kiangah a piaa, buhsi huih mut leng bangin a thalpeu kiangah leng a pia hi.
ENGLISH: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his foot in righteousness? He hands over nations to him, and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.

PAITE: Aman amaute a delha, bittakin a pai jela; a khea a pai nailouhna lampi-ah.
ENGLISH: He pursues them, and passes by safely, Even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.

PAITE: Atunga kipan suan tengteng samin, kuan ahia sema, hih khin? Kei TUOPA, a masapen leh nanungpen kia ka om, a hihpa tak ka hi
ENGLISH: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am he.”

PAITE: Tuikulh gamten amu ua; a lau ua; kawlmongte a ling ua: a honnaiha, a hongpai ua.
ENGLISH: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.

PAITE: Mi chihin amau lawmte a panpih ua; mi chihin a unaute uh kiangah, Khamuang takin om un, a chi chiat uh.
ENGLISH: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”

PAITE: Huchiin, a bulhkipna lam thu-ah, A noih hi, chiin, khutsiam miin dangkaeng sekmi a hasuana, seka sekmum sekdou sekmi a hasuana: huan, a linlouhna dingin kilhna tein a kilh kipta.
ENGLISH: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smoothes with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good”; and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.

PAITE: Himahleh nou Isrealte ka sikha, Jakopte kamitel, ka lawm Abraham suante aw,
ENGLISH: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend,

PAITE: Nou, lei tawpna akipana ka mi pi, a nawl akipana ka mi sap, ka sikhate na hi ua, honpaikhe louin ka hontel jaw hi, ka honchihte aw,
ENGLISH: You whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant, I have chosen you and not cast you away;’

PAITE: Lau kei un, kei lah na kiang uah ka om ngala; mangbang kei un, kei lah na Pathian uh ka hi ngala: ka honhatsak dinga; ahi, ka honpanpih ding; ahi, ka diktatna khut taklamin ka honlen gige ding.
ENGLISH: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

PAITE: Ngaiin, na tung ua lungkimlou tengtengzahlak tak leh zum takin a om ding uh: nou honselte lah bangmahlou bang ahi ding ua, a mang ding uh.
ENGLISH: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.

PAITE: Nou honselte na zong ding ua, namu tuan kei ding uh: nou hon doute lah bangmah lou bang ahi ding ua, thil omlou bang lel ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a non-existent thing.

PAITE: Kei TOUPA na Pathian un, Lau kei un, ka honpanpih ding, chiin, na khut taklam ulah ka len sin ngala.
ENGLISH: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

PAITE: Nou Jakob tangtel leh Isreal mite aw, lau kei un, ka honpanpih ding, TOUPAN a chi, nou hon tanpa tuh Isrealte Mi Siangthou a hi
ENGLISH: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh, “and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

PAITE: Ngaiin, buhsukna khawl thak mahmah, hiam mahmah, ha neiin ka honbawl ding; tangte khawng chilin na khen jan ding ua, mualpawngte lah buhsi bangin na bawl ding uh.
ENGLISH: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.

PAITE: Na jap ding ua, huihin a mut leng dinga, pingpeiin a hih dalh ding: huan, noute TOUPA ah na kipak ding ua, Isrealte Mi Siangthoupa na hon suang ding uh.
ENGLISH: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in Yahweh. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.

PAITE: Mi genthei leh tagahten tui a zong jel ua, a om ngal keia, a lei uh dangtakin a hul khinjel; kei TOUPAIN amau ka dawng dinga, kei Isrealte Pathianin amaute ka paisan kei ding.
ENGLISH: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, Yahweh, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

PAITE: Tangsang giau-ahte luite ka luangkhesak dinga, guam laizangahte tuinakte ka suaksak ding: gamdai dilin ka bawl dinga, gam keu leng tuinakin ka bawl ding hi.
ENGLISH: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the midst of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

PAITE: Gamdaiah sidar singte, singgite, muite, thau singte ka suan dinga, gam keuah meilah singte, phante, singgelh chite ka suan khawm vek ding:
ENGLISH: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set fir trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;

PAITE: TOUPA khutin huaite a hih ahi chih leh Isrealte Mi Siangthouin a siam ahi chih a muh ua, a theih ua, a ngaihtuah ua, a theisiam theina ding un.
ENGLISH: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the hand of Yahweh has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.

PAITE: Na thu uh hong gen un, TOUPAN achi; Pathianin na chihna sanpen uh sulang un, Jakopte Kumpipan a chi.
ENGLISH: Produce your cause,” says Yahweh. “Bring forth your strong reasons,” says the King of Jacob.

PAITE: Huaite sulang uhenla, thil hong tung dingte I kiang uah gen uhen; I ngaihtuah theina ding leh a tawpna ding I theih theina dingin, tuma thilte bang ahia gen un; ahihkeileh, thil hongtung dingte hontheisak un.
ENGLISH: “Let them announce, and declare to us what shall happen. Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.

PAITE: Pathian na hi uh chih ka theih theihna ding un tunungchianga thil hongtung dingte gen un; ahi, I mangbat chiatna ding un leh I et chiat ding un thil hoih hiam thil hoihlou hiam hih dih ua le.
ENGLISH: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

PAITE: Ngai un, bangmah nana hi kei uhi, na thil hih u leng bangmah ahi sam kei: nou hontelte lah mi kihhuaipi na hi uhi.
ENGLISH: Behold, you are of nothing, and your work is of nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.

PAITE: Mal lama kipan mi khat ka ding saka, amah a hontunga; ni suahna akipan ka min loupa; aman suang bulhkipna bawl bangin vaihawmmite a bawl dinga, belvelmiin bellei a chil mah bangin a chil ding hi.
ENGLISH: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come; from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name; and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.

PAITE: I theih theihna ding un kuan ahia a tunga kipan gen ngei? Amah jaw a dik hi, I chih theihna ding un kuan ahia gen khol ngei? A hi gen himhim a om kei uh, ahi, theisak him him a omkei uh, ahi, na thugente uh za himhim a om kei uh.
ENGLISH: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? And before, that we may say, ‘He is right?’ Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.

PAITE: Ken Zion kiangah, Enin amau en dih, ka chi masa dinga, Jerusalem kiangah tanchin hoih hontunmi khat ka pe ding.
ENGLISH: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.

PAITE: Huan, ka etin leng mi himhim a om kei ua; amau ka dotin leng. A lak ua lemtheimi, thu khat leng dawng thei, kua mah him him leng a om kei uh.En un, a vek un, a nasepte uh bangmah lou ahi a, thil om lou himhim ahi: a milim sunte u lah huaih leh huihkhua lel ahi hi.
ENGLISH: When I look, there is no man; even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask of them, can answer a word.

PAITE: En un, a vek un, a nasepte uh bangmah lou ahi a, thil om lou himhim ahi: a milim sunte u lah huaih leh huihkhua lel ahi hi.
ENGLISH: Behold, all of them, their works are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.

PAITE: Ka sikha, ka let gige, ka tel, ka lungin a pahtak mahmah en dih ua: a tungah ka kha ka koihta: Jentelte kiangah piak dingin vaihawmna thu a hong pawt ding.
ENGLISH: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold; my chosen, in whom my soul delights— I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.

PAITE: A kikou kei dinga, a aw leng a suaksak sam kei ding, kongzing ah a aw a kiza sak sam kei ding.
ENGLISH: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.

PAITE: Sialluang gawpsa a kitan siangsak kei dinga, pat khu a mitsak kei ding: vaihawmna thutakin a la kei ding.
ENGLISH: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.

PAITE: Lei tunga vaihwmna a omsak masiah, amah a bah kei dinga, a lungdong sam kei ding; huan, tuikulh gamten a dan thu a ngak nilouh ding uhi.
ENGLISH: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice in the earth, and the islands will wait for his law.”

PAITE: Pathian, toupa. van siampa leh phalhpa, lei leh a sunga kipana pawt tengteng hihlianpa, a tunga mite kiangah hatna pepa leh a tunga paite kiangah kha pepan hichiin a chi:
ENGLISH: Thus says God Yahweh, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it.

PAITE: Kei toupain diktatnain ka honsama, na khut ka len dinga, ka honhumbit dinga, mite thukhun ding leh Jentelte hihvakpa dingin ka honsep dinga:
ENGLISH: “I, Yahweh, have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations;

PAITE: Mitdelte mit hihvak ding leh. mi tengte suangkulha kipan pi khe ding leh, mial laka tute suangkulh akipana pi khe dingin.
ENGLISH: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.

PAITE: TOUPA ka hi; huai tuh ka min ahi: ka thupina mi dang kiangah ka pe kei dinga, phat ka lohna leng milim bawl tawmte kiangah ka pe sam kei ding.
ENGLISH: “I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.

PAITE: Ngai un, tuma thilte a hongtungta, thil thakte gen ka hi: a pou main a thachin ka honhilh hi.
ENGLISH: Behold, the former things have happened, and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”

PAITE: Tuipi-a hohsukte leh, a sunga om tengteng leh, tuikulh gamte leh, a tunga om tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawiin la thak sa unla, kawlmong akipanin leng amah phatna lasa un.
ENGLISH: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.

PAITE: Gamdai leh a khoiten a aw uh suaksak uhen, Kedarte omna khuaten; Suangpi khuaa omten nuamsain lasa uhenla, mual dawna kipanin kikou uhen.
ENGLISH: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!

PAITE: TOUPA hih thupi uhenla, tuikulh gamten a phatna thu gen uhen.
ENGLISH: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.

PAITE: toupa lah mihat mahmah bangin a pawt dinga, galdoumi bangin mulitna a tokthou ding: a kikou dinga, ahi, ngaih takin a kikou ding; amah doute tungah hat takin a gamtang ding.
ENGLISH: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.

PAITE: Sawtpi ka daitaa; ka om kinkenin ka kidek teitei; tun jawm numei nauvei bangin ka kikou tuaituai dinga; ka nak honhonin ka nak huhu ding.
ENGLISH: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.

PAITE: Tangte leh mualpawngte ka hihse dinga, a niam tengteng ka keusak vek ding; luite khawng tuikulh gamin ka bawl dinga, dilte ka kangsak ding.
ENGLISH: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.

PAITE: Mittote a theih ngei louh uh lam ah ka honpi dinga; a theih ngei louh uh lampi ah ka pi ding: a ma uah mial vakin ka bawl dinga, lam kawinate leng ka tangsak ding. Huai thilte ka hih dinga, amau leng ka nuse kei ding.
ENGLISH: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.

PAITE: Milim bawl tawmte muanga, milim sunte kianga, Ka Pathian uh na hi uh. chite kihei sakin a om ding ua, nakpitakin a zahlak ding uhi.
ENGLISH: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.

PAITE: Bengngongte aw, bilin ja unla; mittote aw na muh theihna ding un en un.
ENGLISH: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.

PAITE: Ka sikha loungal kua mit a tawa? Ahihkeileh, ka sawltak sawl bangin kua beng a ngonga? Hon kithuah pihmi bangin kua mit a tawa? TOUPA dikha bangin kua mit a tawa?
ENGLISH: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as Yahweh’s servant?

PAITE: Thil tampi na mu-a, himahleh na lungsimin na vom gige kei; a bilte lah a kihonga, himahleh a za kei jel hi.
ENGLISH: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.

PAITE: Dan lah a diktatna jiaka letsaka zah kaisaka om TOUPAN hoih a saa.
ENGLISH: It pleased Yahweh, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law, and make it honorable.

PAITE: Himahleh hiaite jaw guta guk sak leh loh tuak mite ahi ua; guama ahi vek ua, suangkulha khum mangte ahi ua; sal ding ahi ua, kuamahin lah a humbit ngal kei ua, gallaka lak ding ahi ua, kuamahin, penawnin, a chi tuan kei uhi.
ENGLISH: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become a prey, and no one delivers; and a spoil, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’

PAITE: Na lak uah huaitea bildoh ding kua na om ua? Hun hongtung ding adia ngaikhiaa za ding kua na om ua?
ENGLISH: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?

PAITE: Kuain ahia Jakobte gallak dia lak dinga piaa, Isreal gutate kianga pia? TOUPA, a tunga I khelhnapa un, a piak hilou hia? Amah lampi ah lah a pai nuam ngal kei ua. A dan thu lah a mang sam kei uh.Huaijiakin a heh mahmahna leh kibawlna tha amau tungah a sung buaa; huaiin amaute a kanga, himahleh a thei sam kei uh; huaiin amaute a hula, himahleh a lungsim un a ngaihtuah tuan kei uhi.
ENGLISH: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t Yahweh, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.

PAITE: Huaijiakin a heh mahmahna leh kibawlna tha amau tungah a sung buaa; huaiin amaute a kanga, himahleh a thei sam kei uh; huaiin amaute a hula, himahleh a lungsim un a ngaihtuah tuan kei uhi.
ENGLISH: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle; and it set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know; and it burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”

PAITE: Tuin jaw, Jakobte aw, Toupa nou honsiampa leh, Isrealte aw, nou honbawlpan, hichiin a chi; laukei un, ka hontanta hi; na min un ka honsama, keia na hi uhi.
ENGLISH: But now thus says Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

PAITE: Tuite na ngah tan lai un leng na kiang uah ka om dinga; luite na ngah tan lai un leng a hontum kei ding hi: meia na pai tan lai un leng ka honhun kei dinga; meikuangin leng a honliau kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

PAITE: Kei Toupa na Pathian uh, Israelte Mi Siangthou, nou honhumbitpa ka hi ngala; noute tatna ding in Aigupta gam ka piaa, Ethiopia leh Seba gamte na sik ding un ka pia hi.
ENGLISH: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.

PAITE: Ka ngaihin manpha mahmah na hi ua, mizahtakhuai mahmah leng na hi uh hi, itleng ka honit jiakin, na sik un mite ka pe dinga, na hinna sik ding un mi chih ka pe ding hi.
ENGLISH: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you; therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.

PAITE: Lau kei un, na kiang uah lah ka om ngala: na suante uh suahlam akipanin ka honpi dinga, tumlam akipanin ka honpi khawm ding hi;
ENGLISH: Don’t be afraid; for I am with you. I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west.

PAITE: Mal lam kiangah, Khah un, ka chi dinga; sim lam kiangah, Len kei un, ka chi ding; ka tapate gamlapi akipanin honpi unla, ka tanute kawlmong akipanin honpi un;
ENGLISH: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

PAITE: Ka min popeuhmahte leh ka thupina dinga ka siam peuhmahte; amau ka bawla, ahi, amau ka suktuah ahi uh hi.
ENGLISH: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”

PAITE: Mit nei ngala mittote leh, bil nei ngala bengngongte, pi khia un.
ENGLISH: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.

PAITE: Nam chih kikhawm uhenla, mi chih om khawm uhen: a lak ua kua ahia hiai gen theia, tumalam thilte hontheisak thei? Siamtansaka a om theihna ding un a palaite uh honpi uhen: ahihkeileh bilin ja uhenla, thutak ahi, chi uhen.
ENGLISH: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”

PAITE: Mi theiha, mi upa, amah kahi chih na theih theihna ding un, noute ka palaite na hi uh, ka tel ka sikha leng, Toupan a chi: ka om main Pathian himhim bawl a om keia, ka om nungin leng a om sak kei uh.
ENGLISH: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.

PAITE: Kei, keimahmah, toupa ka hi; keimah loungal hondampa himhim a om kei.
ENGLISH: I myself am Yahweh; and besides me there is no savior.

PAITE: Ken ka gena, ka hondama, ka theisaka, na lak uah gamdang Pathian himhim a omkei hi: huaijiakin noute ka palaite na hi uh, TOUPAN a chi, huan kei lah Pathian ka hi.
ENGLISH: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown; and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “and I am God.

PAITE: A hi, ni om nungsang kei amah ka hi; huchiin ka khuta kipan honkhe thei himhim kuamah a om kei uh; na ka sema, kuan ahia huai hei ding?
ENGLISH: Yes, since the day was I am he; and there is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”

PAITE: toupa, nou hontanpa, Israelte Mi Siangthouin hichiin a chi: Nou jiakin Babulon khuaah sepaihte ka sawla, huchiin, a vek un, Kaldaite, akipahna longpi uah taimangmi piin ka pi suk ding.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
