PAITE: Huaijiakin TOUPa a tangvalte uh tungah a kipak kei dinga, a tagahte uleh a meithaite uleng a hehpih sam kei ding; a vek un Pathian zahlou mi leh thil hoihlou hihmite ahi chiat un, kam tengtengin lah thuginalou a gen chiat ngal a. Hichi lawmlawma a hih inleng, a hehna lah a dai keia, a khut a lik lailai hi.
ENGLISH: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

PAITE: Gitlouhna lah mei bangin a kuang luahluah sek ngala, lou lingnei leh khaulingneite a kangmang sek; ahi, gammang nong lak khawngah a kang lualuaa, a khu tou ngoingoi.
ENGLISH: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPA heh jiakin gam a kang siaa, mite leng meia khulding sing bang ahi ua; kuamahin amau unau leng a hawi kei uhi.
ENGLISH: Through the wrath of Yahweh of Armies, the land is burnt up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

PAITE: Huchiin min a taklam ua mi a tuh ding ua, himahleh a tai tuan kei ding uh; mi chihin amau ban sa a ne chiat ding uh.Manasiten Ephraimte a ne ding ua, Ephraimten Manasite a ne ding ua; huan, a nih un Judate a dou khawm ding uh. Huchi lawmlawma a hihin leng, a hehna lah a dai keia, a khut a lik lailai hi.
ENGLISH: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

PAITE: Manasiten Ephraimte a ne ding ua, Ephraimten Manasite a ne ding ua; huan, a nih un Judate a dou khawm ding uh. Huchi lawmlawma a hihin leng, a hehna lah a dai keia, a khut a lik lailai hi.
ENGLISH: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

PAITE: Benjamin gama Anathoth khuaa siampute laka mi Hilkia tapa Jeremia thute;
ENGLISH: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

PAITE: Juda Kumpipa, Amon tapa Josia hun lai, a lal kum sawmlehthumna ah a kiangah TOUPA thu a hongtunga.
ENGLISH: to whom the word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

PAITE: Juda kumpipa, Josia tapa Jehoiakim lal laiin leng a hongtung a; Juda kumpipa Josia tapa Zedekia kum sawm leh kum khatna tawp, Jerusalem sala pi kha ngana tanin.
ENGLISH: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

PAITE: Huan TOUPA thu ka kiangah a hongtunga;
ENGLISH: Now the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

PAITE: Gil sunga ka honbawl main ka hontheia, sul akipana na pawtkhiak main leng ka honkoihtuama, namte kianga jawlnei din ka hon sep khina, chiin.
ENGLISH: “Before I formed you in the belly, I knew you. Before you came forth out of the womb, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

PAITE: Huan ken bel, E, Toupa Pathian, ngaidih, thu ka gen siam kei, ka naupang ngala, ka chi a.
ENGLISH: Then I said, “Ah, Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

PAITE: TOUPAN bel ka kiangah hichiin a chi a: Ka naupang, chi ken, ka honsawlna peuh mah kiangah na hoh ding a, ka honthupiak peuhmah na gen ding ahi.
ENGLISH: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for to whoever I shall send you, you shall go, and whatever I shall command you, you shall speak.

PAITE: Amau jiakin lau kenla, nang honhonkhe dingin na kiangah ka om hi,
ENGLISH: Don’t be afraid because of them; for I am with you to deliver you,” says Yahweh.

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPAN a honsawka, ka kam a khoiha, huan TOUPAN ka kiangah,
ENGLISH: Then Yahweh put forth his hand, and touched my mouth; and Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

PAITE: Ngaiin, na kam ah ka thute ka hoihta, endih, namte leh kumpipa gam tungah te, botkhe ding te, phel ding te, hihse ding te, paikhe ding te, bawl hoih ding leh dingkhesak dingin tuniin ka hon koih na hi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Behold, I have this day set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

PAITE: Huailou leng TOUPA thu ka kiangah a hongtunga, Jeremia, bang na mu a? chi in. Huan ken bel, vaisuaklu sing hiang ka mu, ka chi a.
ENGLISH: Moreover the word of Yahweh came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

PAITE: Huan TOUPAN ka kiangah, Na mu kha mahmah ve: ka thu tangtun dingin ka kigalging gige ahi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

PAITE: Huan Toupa thu a nihveina din ka kiangah a hongtung nawna, Bang na mu a? chiin. Huan ken bel, Bel sou bobolh, a gong mal-lam ngatsan ka mu, ka chi a.
ENGLISH: The word of Yahweh came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling caldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPAN ka kiangah hichiin a chi a: Gam a teng tengteng tungah mallam akipan thil hoihlou a hongtung ding.
ENGLISH: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

PAITE: Ngaidih, mallam kumpipa gam nam tengteng ka sam sin ngala; chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi; a hongpai ding ua, Jerusalem khongpi lutna ahte, a kivel kulh bang tengteng chinah te lah Juda khopi tengtengah te a mangtutphah uh a tung chiat ding uh.
ENGLISH: For, behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh; “and they shall come, and they shall each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

PAITE: Honpaisan ua, pathian dangte kiangah gimlim a hal ua: amau khutsuak mahmah a bia ua; hiai a thulimlouhna tengteng tungtang ua ka thugelte ka phuang ding hi.
ENGLISH: I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

PAITE: Huaijiakin puan teng inla, thou inla, ka honthupiak tengteng a kiang uah vagenin; a ma uah lunglel kenla, huchilouin jaw a ma uah ka honlunglel sak ding hi.
ENGLISH: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and speak to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

PAITE: Ngaiin, tuniin nang, a gam pumpite, Juda kumpipate, a heutute, a siampute leh a gam mipite dou-in khopi kulha um leh sik khuam leh dalsik khuamin ka hon bawl ahi.A honsual ding ua, himahleh a honzou kei ding uh: honhonkhe dingin na kiangah lah ka om ngala, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: For, behold, I have made you this day a fortified city, and an iron pillar, and bronze walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

PAITE: A honsual ding ua, himahleh a honzou kei ding uh: honhonkhe dingin na kiangah lah ka om ngala, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: They will fight against you; but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you,” says Yahweh, “to deliver you.”

PAITE: Aw, Israel inkote aw, na kiang ua TOUPA thu gen ngaikhia un,
ENGLISH: Hear the word which Yahweh speaks to you, house of Israel!

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Namte omdan ching kei unla, vana chiamtehnate jiakin leng lunglau sam kei un; namte lah huaite ah a lunglau sek nak ua.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

PAITE: Mite dante lah bangmahlou lel ahi ngala, Gamnuai ah sing a phuk ua, heipia mi khutsiam khutin asep ahi.
ENGLISH: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the axe.

PAITE: Dangkasik leh dangkaengin a jem ua, a tat louhna dingin sikkilhna leh sekin a kilh uh.
ENGLISH: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it not move.

PAITE: Leipia vasa lau ding milim bang ahi ua, a pau theikei uh. Amau a pai theihlouh jiak un, puak suan a kiphamoh sek uh; amaute lau kei un, thil sia a hih theikei ua, thil hoih leng a hih thei sam kei uh.
ENGLISH: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak: they must be carried, because they can’t go. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, nang bang kuamah a om kei ua, na thupi-a, na min hatnain a thang lian hi.
ENGLISH: There is none like you, Yahweh; you are great, and your name is great in might.

PAITE: Aw namte kumpipa, kuan ahia honkihta lou ding? huailah na tuakzou him ngala. Namte mi pil tengteng lakahte, a gam himhim lak uah leng, nang bang mahmah a om kei uh.
ENGLISH: Who should not fear you, King of the nations? For it appertains to you; because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is none like you.

PAITE: Amau jaw mi mawl leh mi hai ahi ua, milim sinsakna bel sing lel ahi.
ENGLISH: But they are together brutish and foolish: the instruction of idols! it is but a stock.

PAITE: Tarsis a kipan dangkasik sek a honla ua, Uphaz a kipan dangkaeng leng, mi khutsiam bawl, dangkaeng sekmi khutsuak, a puansilh uah dumbuang leh sandup, mi khutsiam khutsuak vek ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the artificer and of the hands of the goldsmith; blue and purple for their clothing; they are all the work of skillful men.

PAITE: TOUPA bel Pathian tak ahi, Pathian hing khantawn Kumpipa ahi hi, a hehin lei a linga, namten a hehna a nangzou kei uh.
ENGLISH: But Yahweh is the true God; he is the living God, and an everlasting King: at his wrath the earth trembles, and the nations are not able to withstand his indignation.

PAITE: A kiang ua hichibanga na chih ding uh ahi: Pathiante, lei leh van bawlte hi loupi lei a kipan a mangthang ding ua, vannuai a kipan a mang vek ding uh.
ENGLISH: You shall say this to them: The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, these shall perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.

PAITE: A thilhihtheihnain lei a bawla, a pilnain khovel a tungdinga, a lemtheihnain van a kaipalh hi.
ENGLISH: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens:

PAITE: A aw a suah leh, van ah tui a ging honhona, kawlmong a kipan meipi a kahtousaka, vuah zukna dingin khua a phesaka, a goubawm a kipan huih a nungsak hi.
ENGLISH: when he utters his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasuries.

PAITE: Mi chih a mawl ua, theihna a neikei uh, dangkaeng sekmiin leng a lim sek a zumpiha, a milim sun lah juau lel ahi ngala, amau ah hu leng a om kei hi.
ENGLISH: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge; every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

PAITE: Bangmahlou lel ahi ua, khemna nasep lel, a gawtna uh hun chiangin a mang mai ding uh.
ENGLISH: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

PAITE: Jakob tantuan bel hichibang ahi kei, thil tengteng bul ahi ngala; Israel a gouluah nam ahia, a min sepaihte TOUPA ahi.
ENGLISH: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Yahweh of Armies is his name.

PAITE: Aw nang, uma om lellelin, na puanthuah lei a kipan la khawmin,
ENGLISH: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi ahi: Ngai un, tuin gam a tengte ka singkhe ding, a phawk thamun ka hihgenthei ding.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.

PAITE: Ka natna jiakin ka tung a gik hi, ka liamna a na a, himahleh, Hiai hial haksatna ahi, ka thuak mai ding ahi, ka chi.
ENGLISH: Woe is me because of my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.

PAITE: Ka puanin a seta, ka khau tengteng a kitat veka, ka kianga kipan ka tate a pawt ua, a om nawn kei uh: Ka puanin jak ding a omta kei uh, ka puanjak tungding dingte.
ENGLISH: My tent is destroyed, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth from me, and they are no more: there is none to spread my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

PAITE: Belam chingmite a mawl ua, TOUPA a thudot nadan a theikei uh; huaijiakin a lamzang kei ua, a belam honte uh a dalhjak khinta.
ENGLISH: For the shepherds are become brutish, and have not inquired of Yahweh: therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks are scattered.

PAITE: Ngai un, husa a hongtung, mallam a kipan buaina thupi mahmah, Juda khopite hihgawpin, sehal tenna dinga suaksak dingin.
ENGLISH: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, mihing omdan bel, amah thu lel ahi kei chih ka theita hi: a tunga pai mihing ah, a pheikhai pi ding a om kei hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, honthunun inla, a hun lelin, heh louin, huchilouin jaw na honhihmang kha ding hi.Pautuam mi, nang thei ngeiloute tungah leh, na min lou ngeiloute tungah na hehna bungkhiain; Jakob a nekhin ua, ahi, a nekhin ua, a ne mang ua, a tenna gam a hihsia uhi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, correct me, but in measure: not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing.

PAITE: Pautuam mi, nang thei ngeiloute tungah leh, na min lou ngeiloute tungah na hehna bungkhiain; Jakob a nekhin ua, ahi, a nekhin ua, a ne mang ua, a tenna gam a hihsia uhi.
ENGLISH: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name: for they have devoured Jacob, yes, they have devoured him and consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

PAITE: Jeremia kianga TOUPA thu hongtung:
ENGLISH: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

PAITE: Hiai thukhun thute ngaikhia unla, Juda mite leh Jerusalema tengte kiangah gen un;
ENGLISH: Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

PAITE: Huan, nang a kiang uah, TOUPA Israel Pathianin hichiin a chi: Hiai thukhun thute ngaikhe loumi hamse thuakin om hen:
ENGLISH: and say to them, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,

PAITE: Huai bel na pipute uh, Aigupta gam, sik haltuina a kipana ka pikhiak nia, ka pau kamsuak mang unla, thu ka honpiak tengteng hih un, chia ka thupiak tak ahi: huchiin ka mite nahi ding ua, kei na Pathian uh ka hi ding:
ENGLISH: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;

PAITE: Na pipute uh kianga khuaiju leh nawituia luang gam kichiama piak ka chiam tak ka tangun theihna dingin tunia a om bangin, hichiin achia. Huan, ken, Amen, Aw TOUPA, chiin ka dawng a.
ENGLISH: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day. Then answered I, and said, Amen, Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan TOUPAN ka kiangah, Juda khopite ah leh Jerusalem kholakte ah hiai thu tengteng puang inla, Hiai thukhun thute ngaikhia unla, jui un.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.

PAITE: Na pipute un Aigupta gam a kipan ka pi khiak nia kipana tu tanin ka paukam suak mang un, chiin ka theisak seka.
ENGLISH: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

PAITE: Himahleh a mang kei ua, bil a doh sam kei ua, mi chih, amau lungtang gilou bang jelin a omjaw uh. Huaijiakin hiai thukhun thu, hih dinga thu ka piak, a hih louh tengteng uh a tunguah ka hontungsakta ahi, achia.
ENGLISH: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but walked everyone in the stubbornness of their evil heart: therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN ka kiangah, Juda mite leh Jerusalema tengte lakah phialgukna a om.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

PAITE: A pipute uh, ka thu ngaikhe nuam loute thulimlouhna lamah a kilehhei nawn ua; pathian dangte na sem ding in a kuan ua: Israel inkote leh Juda inkoten a pipute uh kianga ka thukhun bawl pen a hihseta uh.
ENGLISH: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words; and they are gone after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

PAITE: Huaijiakin TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaidih ua, a tunguah thil hoihlou, a pelh het louh ding uh ka hontungsak ding; a honsam ding ua, himahleh ka dawng kei ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will bring evil on them, which they shall not be able to escape; and they shall cry to me, but I will not listen to them.

PAITE: Huan, Juda khopite leh Jerusalem a tengten pathian, a kiang ua gimlim a hal seknate uh a sam ding ua, himahleh a buai hun chiang un huaiten amau a humbit het kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: Then shall the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense: but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

PAITE: Aw Juda, na pathiante lah nakhopi zah ahi ngal ua: thil zumhuai tak, Baal kianga gimlim halna ding maitam hialleng Jerusalem kongzing zah takin na nading sakta a.
ENGLISH: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have you set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.

PAITE: Huaijiakin hiaite thumsak kenla, amau dingin ngetna hiam aw hiam suah sam ken; a buai hun chiang ua a hon sap uh leh ka ngaikhe sin ngal keia.
ENGLISH: Therefore don’t pray for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.

PAITE: Thil kihhuai tak hih kawmin, ka deih mahmahin ka in ah tantuam bang ahia a neih? thukichiamte leh sa tanin na siatna ding uh a honpelsak thei ding ahia? Na suang thei ua hia?
ENGLISH: What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has worked lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from you? when you do evil, then you rejoice.

PAITE: TOUPAN na min dingin oliv sing hing, gah hoih kilawmpi, a honchia, lum honhonin a tungah mei a toha, ahiangte leng a kitan khinta.
ENGLISH: Yahweh called your name, A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPA, nang honphutpan, Israel inkote leh Juda inkote khelhna, Baal kianga gimlim lana, honhehsakna thil uh, amau adia a sepkhiak tung ua thil hoihlou ding thu na tungah a phuang kheta hi.
ENGLISH: For Yahweh of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have worked for themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

PAITE: TOUPAN hontheisaka, ka theita: huchiin nang mahmahin a thilhihte uh na honkawkmuhta.
ENGLISH: Yahweh gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it: then you showed me their doings.

PAITE: Kei bel belamnou nunnem tak, goh dinga pi bang ka hi, sing pen a gah toh, hihsia ni e, mihing gam a kipan amah jaw i hihmang vengveng ding uh, a min mawngmawng theih a hih louhna dingin, chia ka tunga a thil sawm uh ka nathei het kei.
ENGLISH: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter; and I didn’t know that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

PAITE: Himahleh, aw sepaihte TOUPA, dik taka vaihawm sekpa, sunggil lam leh lungtang entel sekpa, a tung ua na phulak honmu sakin, ka tungtangthu lah na kiangah ka hon kemsak ngala.
ENGLISH: But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I shall see your vengeance on them; for to you have I revealed my cause.

PAITE: Huaijiakin sepaihte TOUPAN Anathoth mi, na hinna zongpa, Ka khut ua na sih louhna dingin TOUPA minin thu gen ken, chimite tungtangah hichiin a chi:
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, You shall not prophesy in the name of Yahweh, that you not die by our hand;

PAITE: Ngai un, amau ka gawt dinga, tangvalte namsauin a si ding ua, a tanute uh, a tapate uh kialin a si ding uh;si val himhim a om kei ding uh: Anathoth mite tungah lah thil hoihlou ka tun sin ngala, a gawtna kum ding mahmah uh.
ENGLISH: therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine;

PAITE: si val himhim a om kei ding uh: Anathoth mite tungah lah thil hoihlou ka tun sin ngala, a gawtna kum ding mahmah uh.
ENGLISH: and there shall be no remnant to them: for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, na kianga ka phun in leng, nang jaw na dik nilouhlouha; himahleh ka vuina thu pen ka gen himhim sin. Bangchiin ahia mi thulimloute lam a lamzan sek nak? Bang chiin ahia khemhat peuhmah nuamsaa a om nak uh?
ENGLISH: You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would reason the cause with you: why does the way of the wicked prosper? why are all they at ease who deal very treacherously?

PAITE: Amau na phuta, ahi, zung a kaita ua, a khang ua, ahi, gah a suahta uhi: a muk uah na naia, a sunggil uah lah na gamla ngala.
ENGLISH: You have planted them, yes, they have taken root; they grow, yes, they bring forth fruit: you are near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, kei bel na hontheia, na honmua, nang lamah ka lungtang na entel seka, amaute belam goh ding bang maiin kaikhia inla, a gohna ni ding uh sep in.
ENGLISH: But you, Yahweh, know me; you see me, and try my heart toward you: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

PAITE: Gamin bangtan ahia a sun dinga, gam pumpi antehlouhingte a vuai ding uh? a tengmite thulimlouhna jiakin gamsate a mang khin ua, vasate leng; I hun nanung uh a mu kei ding uh a chih jiak un.
ENGLISH: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? for the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our latter end.

PAITE: Khea a pai mite na kitaitehpiha, nang a honbah khit sak uleh bangchiin ahia sakolte na kitaitehpih theih ding? muanna gamah bit takin om lechin leng, Jordan gam gammang ah bangchiin ahia na hih ding?
ENGLISH: If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? and though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

PAITE: Na unaute, na pa inkuante ngeiin, amau mahmahin nang a honkhemta ngal ua; amau nang hondelhin ngaihtakin a hon sam ua, thu hoihtak gen mahle uh taksang himhim ken.
ENGLISH: For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; even they have cried aloud after you: don’t believe them, though they speak beautiful words to you.

PAITE: Ka inlehlou paisanin ka gouluah ding ka pai mangta; ka hinnain a it mahmahnu, a melma kiangah ka peta.
ENGLISH: I have forsaken my house, I have cast off my heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

PAITE: Ka gouluah ding gamnuai humpinelkai bang a honghita, ka siatna dingin a aw a suaha, huaijiakin ka mudah ahi.
ENGLISH: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest: she has uttered her voice against me; therefore I have hated her.

PAITE: Ka gouluah ding keia dingin sasial ne vasa gial ahi hia? sasial ne vasaten a kimvelin a sual ua hia? gamsa teng vakaikhawm unla, nekbei dingin honpi un.
ENGLISH: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field, bring them to devour.

PAITE: Belamchingmi tampiin ka grephuan a hihsia ua, ka tan a sik den ua, ka tantuan nuam mahmah mai gamdai gamsegawp a suaksakta uh.
ENGLISH: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

PAITE: Gamsia in a bawlta ua, a segawpa, ka kiangah a vui hi, a gam pumpi a segawpa, himahleh kuamahin a donsak kei.
ENGLISH: They have made it a desolation; it mourns to me, being desolate; the whole land is made desolate, because no man lays it to heart.

PAITE: Gamdaia tang giau tengtengte ah, hihsemite a hongtungta ua, gam tawp khatlam a kipan leh khatlam phain TOUPA namsauin lah a nebeita ngala, muanna nei himhim a omta kei uh.
ENGLISH: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of Yahweh devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh has peace.

PAITE: Buh chi a tuh ua, ling a la ua, a kihihgim gawp ua, punna lah a om tuan kei, TOUPA heh mahmah jiakin gah na suahte uh na zumpih ding uh.
ENGLISH: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns; they have put themselves to pain, and profit nothing: and you shall be ashamed of your fruits, because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.

PAITE: Ka mi Israel kianga gouluah dinga ka piak khoihsemi, ka inveng giloute tengteng tungtangah TOUPAN hichibangin a chi: Ngai un, a gam ua kipan ka botkhe dinga, a lak ua kipan Juda inkote ka phawi khe ding.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh against all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi dinga, ka bohkhiak nungin amau ka hehpih nawn dinga, mi chih gouluah ding leh mi chih amah gam mahah ka honpi ding.
ENGLISH: It shall happen, after that I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them; and I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahi dinga, Baal kianga ka mite kichiam a sinsak mah bang un, ka mina, TOUPA a hin-a a hin sung, chia kichiam a kisin ua, ka mite omdan ngentel taka a sin uleh ka mite lakah ka dingkhe sak ding.Ahihhangin a ngaihkhiak kei ua leh huai nam a bohin ka botkhe dinga, ka hihse ding, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: It shall happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, As Yahweh lives; even as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built up in the midst of my people.

PAITE: Ahihhangin a ngaihkhiak kei ua leh huai nam a bohin ka botkhe dinga, ka hihse ding, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: But if they will not hear, then will I pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it, says Yahweh.

PAITE: TOUPAN ka kiangah hichiin a chi a: Puanmalngat kawnggak lei inla, kawtsak louin tengin.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh to me, Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPA thu bangbang in kawnggak ka leia, ka tengta hi,
ENGLISH: So I bought a belt according to the word of Yahweh, and put it on my waist.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA thu ka kiangah a hongtung nawna,
ENGLISH: The word of Yahweh came to me the second time, saying,

PAITE: Kawnggak na lei, huai na ten la inla, thou inla, Euphrates lui juan inla, huaia suang hengkalah selin, chiin.
ENGLISH: Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPAN thu a honpiak banginka kuana, Euphrates lui chin ah ka selta a.
ENGLISH: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as Yahweh commanded me.

PAITE: Huan, ni tampi nungin TOUPAN ka kiangah, Thou inla, Euphrates lui juan inla, kawnggak ka honselsak lakhia in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: It happened after many days, that Yahweh said to me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.

PAITE: Huchiin Euphrates lui lamah ka hohtaa, ka thaia, ka selna akipan kawnggak ka pholhkhiaa. Ngai dih, kawnggak a na ngotkhin veka; bang ding mahin leng a phatuamta kei hi.
ENGLISH: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA thu ka kiangah a hongtunga:
ENGLISH: Then the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: hichi mahbangin Juda kisathei pipi leh Jerusalem kiotsakna mahmahte ka hihse sin ahi.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, In this way I will mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

PAITE: Hiai nam gilou, ka thute ngaikhe nuam loua, amau lungsim paupeng juia pathian dangte nasem leh be dinga delh zomite kawnggak bangmah dinga phatuam lou bang ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and are gone after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.

PAITE: Kawnggak mi kawnga a belh gige bangin Israel inko pumpi leh Juda inko pumpi ka mite leh ka minthanna leh ka kilawmna leh ka thupina a honghih theihna ding ua ka kianga belh gige dinga ka bawl lah ahi ngal ua; himahleh a limsak kei uh.
ENGLISH: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so have I caused to cling to me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, says Yahweh; that they may be to me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

PAITE: Huan, hiai thu a kiang ua na gen ding ahi: TOUPA Israel Pathianin hichiin a chi: Hiang chiteng uain-in a dim ding, chiin. Huan, amau na kiangah, Hiang chiteng uain-in a dim ding chih ka theih louh uh ahi maw? a chi ding uh.
ENGLISH: Therefore you shall speak to them this word: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall tell you, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

PAITE: Huan, a kiang uah, TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaiun, hiai gama teng tengteng, David tutphaha tu kumpipate, siampute, jawlneite leh Jerusalema teng tengtengte zukhamnain ka dimsak ding.
ENGLISH: Then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

PAITE: Amau ka kiphusak dinga, pate a tate utoh, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi: amau ka hihman louhna khop dingin amau ka hehpihin ka hoihin ka lainat kei ding.
ENGLISH: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, says Yahweh: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have compassion, that I should not destroy them.

PAITE: Ngaikhia unla, bil doh un; kisathei kei unla, TOUPAN thu a khahta hi.
ENGLISH: Hear, and give ear; don’t be proud; for Yahweh has spoken.

PAITE: TOUPA na Pathian uh pahtawi unla, mialna a tunsak maa khomui tang tungate na khe uh a kipal main, vak na lamet lai tak un mial a suaksaka, mial bikbek dingin a bawl sin hi.
ENGLISH: Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it gross darkness.

PAITE: Ahihhangin na ngaihkhiak kei uleh na kisaktheihna uh jiakin mundaiah ka kap nilouh ding; ka khitui leng nakpi takin a luang gige ding, TOUPA belam hon sala kaih a hih jiak un.
ENGLISH: But if you will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret for your pride; and my eye shall weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because Yahweh’s flock is taken captive.

PAITE: Kumpipa leh a nu kiangah, Niam tut un, na lukhute ulah a keta ngala, na manglukhu thupi uh, chiin.
ENGLISH: Say to the king and to the queen mother, Humble yourselves, sit down; for your headdresses have come down, even the crown of your glory.

PAITE: Sim khopite a bing khina, kuamah hon vual louhin; Juda tengteng sal dingin a tang ua, a vek khojang un a tang khin uhi.
ENGLISH: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is none to open them: Judah is carried away captive, all of it; it is wholly carried away captive.

PAITE: Na mit uh dak tou unla, mallam akipana hongkuan en un. Na belam hon neih koiah, huai na belam hon deihhuai tak?
ENGLISH: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north: where is the flock that was given you, your beautiful flock?

PAITE: Nangmahin lawm dia na bawlte na tunga a koih hun chiang un bangchin na chi dia? numei nauvei bang maiin na nasa ngial kei ding maw?
ENGLISH: What will you say, when he shall set over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? shall not sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?

PAITE: Bangjiakin ahia hiaite ka tunga a hongtun? chi sim na hih leh, na thulimlouhna jiakin ahi na nik lem a hiha na vuaktanna a kimuh.
ENGLISH: If you say in your heart, Why are these things come on me? for the greatness of your iniquity are your skirts uncovered, and your heels suffer violence.

PAITE: Ethiopia mi vomin a vun a hihlamdangin gialbemin a jia a sel thei ahia? Huchi ahihleh nou thil gilou hihhat sek ten leng thil hoih hih thei na ve uteh!
ENGLISH: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.

PAITE: Gamdai huihin buhsi a mutleng bang maiin amau ka dalhsak ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore will I scatter them, as the stubble that passes away, by the wind of the wilderness.

PAITE: Hiai na tantuan, na tuam dia ka honsehsak ahi, na honmangngilha, juaua na kingak jiakin, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me, says Yahweh; because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

PAITE: Huchiin kei mahmahin na nik na mai khuh hial ka honlem sak dinga, na zumhuai a dawk ding.Gamlaka tangte a na angkawmnate, na huk kikou husate, na kiphalgai thupidante, huai na thilhih kihhuaite ka muta. Aw Jerusalem, na tung a gik hi: hihsiang na hih ma bangtan hi ding ahia?
ENGLISH: Therefore will I also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame shall appear.

PAITE: Gamlaka tangte a na angkawmnate, na huk kikou husate, na kiphalgai thupidante, huai na thilhih kihhuaite ka muta. Aw Jerusalem, na tung a gik hi: hihsiang na hih ma bangtan hi ding ahia?
ENGLISH: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries, and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean; how long shall it yet be?

PAITE: Khokheng tungtanga Jeremia kianga TOUPA thu hongtung:
ENGLISH: The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.

PAITE: Judain a sun-a, a kulh kongpite a ngui; leiah puan vom khuin a kun ua, Jerusalem kah ging a tungkah.
ENGLISH: Judah mourns, and its gates languish, they sit in black on the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

PAITE: A mi hoihten a sikhate uh tui a tawisak ua, tuichin a juan ua, tui a mu kei ua, a tuibel uh hawmin a kik ua; a lungdong ua, gending a theikei ua, a lu uh a khuh ua.
ENGLISH: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters: they come to the cisterns, and find no water; they return with their vessels empty; they are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

PAITE: Lei lah a khanga, gam puma vuahtui a om louh jiakin, leiletmite a lungdong ua, a lu uh a khuh ua.
ENGLISH: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed, they cover their heads.

PAITE: A hi, zukpiin leng pawnah nou a neia, a taisan ve, lou hing a omlouh jiakin.
ENGLISH: Yes, the hind also in the field calves, and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.

PAITE: Gam sabengtungte mualvum khengah a ding ua, awle bangin huihkhua ngaiin a nak huhu ua; peh ding om louh jiakin a mit uh a mial dundun hi.
ENGLISH: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights, they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail, because there is no herbage.

PAITE: Ka thulimlouhna un honhek mahleh na min jiakin aw TOUPA hongkuan in; ka puknate uh lah a tamta ngala, na tungah mahmah thil ka nahih khial uhi.
ENGLISH: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, Yahweh; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you.

PAITE: Aw nang Israelte lamet, mangbat laia hondampa, bangdia hiai gama mikhual bang jena jan khat giaka zin bang lela om na hia?
ENGLISH: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?

PAITE: Bangdia mi lungke gawp bang phet leh pasalpha, hondam thei kol lou bang lela om na hia? Himahleh nang jaw, aw TOUPA, ka lak uah na om laia, na min ka pu ua, honpaisan ken.
ENGLISH: Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, Yahweh, are in the midst of us, and we are called by your name; don’t leave us.

PAITE: TOUPAN hiai mite tungtang ah hichiin a chi: Vakmang a ut nak ua, a kalsuan uh a kidek kei uh; huchiin TOUPAN amau a pom keia, a thulimlouhna uh a theigige ta dinga, a khelhna uh a gawt ding.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh to this people, Even so have they loved to wander; they have not refrained their feet: therefore Yahweh does not accept them; now he will remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

PAITE: TOUPAN ka kiangah, Hiai mite hoihna ding ngetsak ken.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said to me, Don’t pray for this people for their good.

PAITE: An ngawl mahle uh a kikou uh ka ngaikhe kei dinga, halmang leh buhbal thillat lan mahle uh ka dawng kei ding; namsau te, kial te, hipi tein amau ka hihmang zo ding, a chi hi.
ENGLISH: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

PAITE: Huan, ken, Eh, Toupa Pathian, ngaidih, a kiang uah jawlneiten, Namsau na tuak kei ding ua, kial leng na thuak sak kei ding uh, hiai muhah muan mahmahna ka honpe zo ding hi, lah a chi sek ngal ua, ka chi a.
ENGLISH: Then I said, Ah, Lord Yahweh! behold, the prophets tell them, You shall not see the sword, neither shall you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN ka kiangah, Jawlneiten ka mina juau a gen jel eive ua leh; amau ka sawl keia, thu ka khak keia, ka houpih sam keia, ka houpih sam kei hi. Thil a muh khol louhte uh, aisan bangmaha pangloute leh a lungsim dohate uh honhilh eive ua, achia.
ENGLISH: Then Yahweh said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name; I didn’t send them, neither have I commanded them, neither spoke I to them: they prophesy to you a lying vision, and divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.

PAITE: Huaijiakin TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ka sawl khol louha ka min loua, Hiai gamah kial leh namsau a tung kei ding, chia genmi huai jawlneite namsau leh kialin a mangthang ding uh.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, and I didn’t send them, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land: By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

PAITE: Huan, a thugen uh nana tang nam leng kial leh namsau jiakin Jerusalem kongzingah paihkhiak ahi ding ua, a tanute uh a tapate uhtoh, vuimi himhim a neikei ding uh. A thulimlouhna uh amau tungah ka sung sin ngala.
ENGLISH: The people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them—them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness on them.

PAITE: Huan, a kiang ua hiai thu na gen ding ahi; Sun leh janin ka khitui luang hen, hul himhim kei hen, ka mi, ka tanu nungak siangthouin nakpia liamna a tuak hi, khutkhak na mahmah.
ENGLISH: You shall say this word to them, Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

PAITE: Ka gam pawt leh, maijen, namsaua thahte! Khopi a alut leh, maijen, kialpi-misi! gam chihah jawlneite, siampute a tamvak chiat ua, a dan mahmah a theikei uh, chiin.
ENGLISH: If I go forth into the field, then, behold, the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then, behold, those who are sick with famine! for both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.

PAITE: Juda pai khe siang na hi maw? Zion kih na hi maw? kou dia hihdamna om lou bikbeka bangdia honthuaksak oi? muanna ka zong ua, hoihna bangmah a hongtung kei; hihdamna hun ding leng, ngaidih khaphamna lel.
ENGLISH: Have you utterly rejected Judah? has your soul loathed Zion? why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, ka thulimlouhdan uh a kitheihmohbawl kei uhi, ka pipute uh ginatlouhna toh, na tungah lah ka hihkhialta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: We acknowledge, Yahweh, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.

PAITE: Na min jiakin honmusit kenla, na mangtutphah thupi minse sak kenla, ka kiang ua na thukhun theigigein hihse ken.Nam dang pathiante lakah vuah zusak thei a om uhia? ahihleh, vanin vuahpi a tungsak thei hia? aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, huai pen nang na hi kei maw? hiai thil tengteng na hih ahi ngala, ka lamet uh nang na hi hi.
ENGLISH: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake; do not disgrace the throne of your glory: remember, don’t break your covenant with us.

PAITE: Nam dang pathiante lakah vuah zusak thei a om uhia? ahihleh, vanin vuahpi a tungsak thei hia? aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, huai pen nang na hi kei maw? hiai thil tengteng na hih ahi ngala, ka lamet uh nang na hi hi.
ENGLISH: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh our God? therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN ka kiangah hichiin a chi a: Mosi leh Samuel ka maah hongding mahle uh, ka lungsim hiai mite lam a ngatuan kei ding. Ka muh phak louhah delhkhia inla, paimang uhen!
ENGLISH: Then Yahweh said to me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

PAITE: Huan, koiah ka pai ding ua? chia nang a hondot uleh hichiin a kiang uah na chi ding hi: Hichiin TOUPAN a chi: Sihna tuam sihna ah; namsau tuam namsau ah; kial tuam kial ah, saltanna tuam saltanna ah.
ENGLISH: It shall happen, when they tell you, Where shall we go forth? Then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh: Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.

PAITE: Thil li ka sehsak ding, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi: hihlum dingin namsau, kei zan dingin ui, ne khin leh hihmang dingin tunga leng vasa leh gam sahangte.
ENGLISH: I will appoint over them four kinds, says Yahweh: the sword to kill, and the dogs to tear, and the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

PAITE: Juda kumpipa Hezekia tapa Manasein Jerusalema a thilhih jiakin lei kumpipa gam tengteng laka vial sepsep dingin ka bawl ding.
ENGLISH: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

PAITE: Kuan a hon hehpih dia, aw Jerusalem? kuan hon lungkhampih dia? na omdan dong dingin kua a lampial dia oi?
ENGLISH: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? or who will bemoan you? or who will turn aside to ask of your welfare?

PAITE: Nang na honpai khiaa, na nungtawn tawna, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi. Huchiin kisik ka chimtaka, na tungah ka khut ka lika, ka honhihmang ahi.
ENGLISH: You have rejected me, says Yahweh, you have gone backward: therefore have I stretched out my hand against you, and destroyed you; I am weary with repenting.

PAITE: Gam pumpia kulh kongpite ah kijapnain amau ka japa, ta beiin ka bawla, ka mite ka hihmanga; a omdan uh a kihei san louh jiak un.
ENGLISH: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land; I have bereaved them of children, I have destroyed my people; they didn’t return from their ways.

PAITE: Tuipi piaunel sanga tamin a meithaite uh ka pungsak dinga, suntang laiin tangvalte siatna dingin a tunguah lokmi ka tungsaka, mangbatna leh thil mulkimhuai ka tungsak guih a.
ENGLISH: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas; I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday: I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

PAITE: Sagih suangnu a bahgawpa; kha tuh a khahta; sun a hih laiin a ni a keta, a zahlakin a lung buaia: huan a omlaite a melmate uh khut ah namsau thah dingin ka pe ding, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: She who has borne seven languishes; she has given up the spirit; her sun is gone down while it was yet day; she has been disappointed and confounded: and their residue will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Nu ei, gam pumpia kituahlouhna mi leh kikalhna mia non na suan ka tung gik hina tele! ka leitawi sak keia, miten leng a honlaitawi sak kei uh; ahihhangin a vek un hamsia a honloh himhim ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet everyone of them curses me.

PAITE: TOUPAN, chihtak ngialin thil hoih adingin ka honhihkip ding; chih tak ngialin saitna ni leh haksatna niin melma na kiangah khut ka dohsak ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Yahweh said, Most certainly I will strengthen you for good; most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

PAITE: Min sik, mallama sik leh ngen a kitansak thei sin ahia?
ENGLISH: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and brass?

PAITE: Na khelhna tengteng jiakin na sum lah pai lah na gou thilte man beiin gallak dingin ka pe ding, na gam tawnin.
ENGLISH: Your substance and your treasures will I give for a spoil without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

PAITE: Na theih ngeilouh gamah namelmate na ka honsem sak ding. Ka heh jiaka mei na tunga ampha ding lah a kuangkheta ngala, achia.
ENGLISH: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which shall burn on you.

PAITE: Nangman na thei hi, aw TOUPA; hontheigige inla, hongvehin, honsimmohte tungah phu honlak sak in. Na dohzohna ken manthat loh kei leng; nang jiaka minsiat thuak ka hi chih theiin.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, you know; remember me, and visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors; don’t take me away in your longsuffering: know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.

PAITE: Na thute hihlat ahia, ka ne a, na thute keia dingin kipahna leh ka lungtang nopna ahi; aw TOUPA, sepaihte Pathian, na min lah ka puta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Your words were found, and I ate them; and your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart: for I am called by your name, Yahweh, God of Armies.

PAITE: Nuamsip bawlmite lakah ka tel keia, ka kipahpih sam kei; nang khut jiakin ka tu tuama, lungkimlouhnain na hondimsak ngala.
ENGLISH: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of your hand; for you have filled me with indignation.

PAITE: Bang dia ka natna dai theiloua, ka liamna dam theilou ahi, hihdam ut lou bang maia? ka tungah guam khemhat tui kang sekte bang na hi sin ahia?
ENGLISH: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, as waters that fail?

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Na kihei leh a ngei kon bangsak ding, ka maah na ding nawn ding. Thil ginalou akipan thil manpha ngen na genkhiak leh keimah kam bang na hi ding. Amau nang lam hongnga uhenla, nang bel amau lam na nga ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh, If you return, then will I bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take forth the precious from the vile, you shall be as my mouth: they shall return to you, but you shall not return to them.

PAITE: Hiai mite laka jaw ngen kulh bangin ka honbawl dinga, a honsual ding ua, himahleh a honzou kei ding uh, nang honhondam ding leh honkhe dingin na kiangah ka om ngala, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.Mi giloute khut a kipan ka honhonkhe dinga, mi lauhuaite khut akipan ka honpawtkhe sak ding.
ENGLISH: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall; and they shall fight against you, but they shall not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Mi giloute khut a kipan ka honhonkhe dinga, mi lauhuaite khut akipan ka honpawtkhe sak ding.
ENGLISH: I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.

PAITE: TOUPA Thu ka kiangah a hongtunga:
ENGLISH: The word of Yahweh came also to me, saying,

PAITE: Ji na nei ding ahi keia, hiai mun ah tanu tapate leng na nei ding ahi sam kei, chiin.
ENGLISH: You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place.

PAITE: Tanu tapa hiai muna piangte leh hiai gama nu leh pa amaute suangte tungtang TOUPAN hichiin a chi a:
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who became their father in this land:

PAITE: Hipiin a si ding ua, kuamah vui louh lah kuamah sun louhin a om ding uh; leitung ekvut bang lel ahi ding uh. Namsaute, kialtein a mangthang ding ua, a luangte uh tunga leng vasate leh gamsate an ahi ding.
ENGLISH: They shall die grievous deaths: they shall not be lamented, neither shall they be buried; they shall be as dung on the surface of the ground; and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their dead bodies shall be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi hi: sunna in ah lut kenla, sun dingin hoh kenla, amau kah ken; hiai mite laka kipan ka lungmuanna ka hawkta ngala, chitna leh lainatnate toh, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh, Don’t enter into the house of mourning, neither go to lament, neither bemoan them; for I have taken away my peace from this people, says Yahweh, even loving kindness and tender mercies.

PAITE: Hiai gamah mi lian leh mi neute a si ding ua; vui ahi kei ding ua; kuamahin a sun kei ding ua, a ki-at un a kimet giau loh kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: Both great and small shall die in this land; they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them;

PAITE: Lusunmite a misi ngai uh lungmuan dingin kuamahin nek ding a lui kei ding ua, a nu luh hiam a pa uh hiam jiakin leng nepna nou dawn ding kuamahin a tun kei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: neither shall men break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

PAITE: Huan, ne leh dawn dingin a lak-ua tu dingin ankuangluina in ah na lut ding ahi kei.
ENGLISH: You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPA, Israel Pathianin hichiin a chi ngala: Ngai dih ua, na mitmuh un, na damsung un mou aw te, mouneipa aw te, nuamsakna husa te, kipahna ging te hiai mun ah ka daisak ding.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

PAITE: Hiai thu tengteng hiai mite kianga na hilh hun chiangin amau, Bangjiakin ahia TOUPAN ka tung ua hichi taka thil hoihlou a hon gen khiak? bang ahia ka thulimlouhna uh? TOUPA ka Pathian uh tunga ka thilhihkhelh bang ahia? a hon chih uleh,
ENGLISH: It shall happen, when you shall show this people all these words, and they shall tell you, Why has Yahweh pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against Yahweh our God?

PAITE: hichiin na chi ding hi: Na pipute un a honpaisan jiak uh ahi, pathian dangte a delh ua, a na uh a sem ua, a bia ua, a honpai san ua, ka dan a jui kei ua;
ENGLISH: Then you shall tell them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, says Yahweh, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshiped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

PAITE: Huan nouten na pipute uh sanga lekluain na hih ua, ngai un, mi chihin noumau lungtang gilou paupeng na jui ua, Kei non ngaikhe kei ua;
ENGLISH: and you have done evil more than your fathers; for, behold, you walk every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don’t listen to me:

PAITE: Huaijiakin ka gam akipan noute leh na pipute un leng na theih ngeilouh uh gamah ka hondelhkhe ding, huaiah sun leh janin pathian dangte na na sem ding ua, ka honhehpih sin ngal keia, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: therefore will I cast you forth out of this land into the land that you have not known, neither you nor your fathers; and there you shall serve other gods day and night; for I will show you no favor.

PAITE: Huchiin, ngaidih ua, nite a hongtung sin hi, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi; Israel tate Aigupta gama kipana pikhepa a hin-a a hin sung, chita louin,
ENGLISH: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that it shall no more be said, As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

PAITE: Mal lam gam leh a delh jakna gam tengteng a kipana Israel tate pikhepa TOUPA a hina a hin sung, a chi zota ding uh. A pipute uh kianga ka piak, amau gam mahmahah lah ka pi kik nawn sin ngala.
ENGLISH: but, As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them. I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.

PAITE: Ngamanmi tampi ka thukhak dinga, amau a man ding ua; huai khitin gamvakmi tampi ka thukhak dinga, tang chiteng leh mual chitenga kipan amaute a beng khe ding ua, suangpi hengkala leng.
ENGLISH: Behold, I will send for many fishermen, says Yahweh, and they shall fish them up; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.

PAITE: A omdan tengteng uah lah ka mit a tu nilouh ngala; keia kipan selin a om kei ua, a thulimlouhna uh leng ka mit akipan selin a om sam kei hi.
ENGLISH: For my eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from my face, neither is their iniquity concealed from my eyes.

PAITE: Huchiin a thil kihhuai luangte ua ka gam a hihnit u leh a kihhuaina ua ka goutan gam a dimsak jiak un a thulimlouhna uh leh a khelhna uh a zahnihin ka thuk ding, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, ka hatna leh ka kulhpi, mangbat nia ka kihumbitna, kawlmong akipanin namte a hongpai ding ua, Ka pipute un juau, thil ginalou, punna nei lah hilou kia loungal bangmah gouluahin a neikei uh.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, my strength, and my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, to you shall the nations come from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, vanity and things in which there is no profit.

PAITE: Min pathiante a kibawlsak thei ua hia? huaite pathian ahi sam ua, a chi ding uh.Huaijiakin, ngaidih ua, tutungin amau ka theisak peuhmah ding; ka khut leh ka thilhihtheihna ka theisak ding, ka min TOUPA ahi chih a thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: Shall a man make to himself gods, which yet are no gods?

PAITE: Huaijiakin, ngaidih ua, tutungin amau ka theisak peuhmah ding; ka khut leh ka thilhihtheihna ka theisak ding, ka min TOUPA ahi chih a thei ding uh.
ENGLISH: Therefore behold, I will cause them to know, this once will I cause them to know my hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is Yahweh.

PAITE: Juda khelhna sik kolom leh suangmantam hiam muk zuma gelh ahi; a lungtang pek ua khuakin a om a, a maitam uahte leng;
ENGLISH: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars;

PAITE: Sing hing bul leh mualpawngte ah a tate un a maitamte uleh a Aserahte uh a theigige ngal ua.
ENGLISH: while their children remember their altars and their Asherim by the green trees on the high hills.

PAITE: Aw nang gama ka tang, gam dung tawna na khelhna jiakin na sum leh na gou tengtengte, na mun sangte toh gallak dingin ka pe ding.
ENGLISH: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a spoil, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.

PAITE: Huai na tantuam ka honpiak na tan dinga, na gam theih ngeihlouh ah na melmate na ka hon semsak ding, ka hehna mei, khantawna kang ding lah na mut kuangta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: You, even of yourself, shall discontinue from your heritage that I gave you; and I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know: for you have kindled a fire in my anger which shall burn forever.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Mihing muanga, mihing ban hatna muanga, TOUPA lehngatsanna lungtang neimi hamse thuakin om hen.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh: Cursed is the man who trusts in man, and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.

PAITE: Gamaia loupa keu gaw bang ahia, thil hoih pawt ding himhim a mu kei ding. Gamdai gamkei, chi gam, kuamah luah louh ah a teng zo ding hi.
ENGLISH: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good comes, but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, a salt land and not inhabited.

PAITE: TOUPA muangmi, a lametpen TOUPA hi bel a nuamsa hi.
ENGLISH: Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose trust Yahweh is.

PAITE: Tui kianga sing phuh, lui geia zungkai, kho lum hongtung ding leng khawksa lou, a nahte hing gige ngal, khokhen kum khawksa lou, gah suan kikhelsak tuan lou bang ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and shall not fear when heat comes, but its leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

PAITE: Lungtang bel thil tengteng sangin khemhat pen, hoihlou pumlum ahia; kuan ahia thei thei ding?
ENGLISH: The heart is deceitful above all things, and it is exceedingly corrupt: who can know it?

PAITE: Kei TOUPA bel mi chih a om dan bang jel u leh a theilhih gah bang jela pe dinga lungsim enkhepa, lungtang enchianpa ka hi.
ENGLISH: I, Yahweh, search the mind, I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.

PAITE: Mi, kilawmloua honghausa bel vengkeng, amah tui loupi keuhsak dia opkhum bang ahi, a dam laiin amah a tuamsan ding ua, atawptawpin mi hai a honghi maimah ding.
ENGLISH: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right; in the midst of his days they shall leave him, and at his end he shall be a fool.

PAITE: Ka mun siangthou omna bel mangtutphah thupi mahmah, a tunga kipana tawisanga om ahi.
ENGLISH: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, Israel lamet, nang honpaisan mi tengteng a zahlak ding uh; kei hon lehngatsan mite leia leivuia gelh bang lel ahi ding uh, TOUPA, hinna tuikhuk pen lah a paisanta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you shall be disappointed. Those who depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahweh, the spring of living waters.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, honhihdam inla, huchiin ka dam dinga, honhumbit lechin, huchiin ka bit ding, ka phat gige lah na hi ngala.
ENGLISH: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for you are my praise.

PAITE: Ngaiin, ka kiangah, TOUPA thu koiah? hongtung leh ake, a chi sek uh.
ENGLISH: Behold, they tell me, Where is the word of Yahweh? let it come now.

PAITE: Thil hoihlou tungsak ding ka honphut keia, siatna ni lah ka deih het kei chih na thei hi; ka kama thu pawt lah na mai maa om ahi hi.
ENGLISH: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you; neither have I desired the woeful day; you know: that which came out of my lips was before your face.

PAITE: Kei ding in kihtakhuai hi kenla, mangbat nia ka kihumbitna na hi.
ENGLISH: Don’t be a terror to me: you are my refuge in the day of evil.

PAITE: Honsimmohte zahlak uhenla, kei bel zahlak kei leng; amau bel lungjing uhenla, kei bel lungjing kei leng; mangbat ni a tunguah tun inla, nakpiin amau hih mangin.
ENGLISH: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but let not me be disappointed; let them be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed; bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

PAITE: TOUPAN ka kiangah hichiin a chi: Kuan inla, Juda kumpipate lutna sek leh pawtna sek, mipite tate kongpi ah leh Jerusalem konpite tengteng ah va ding inla;
ENGLISH: Thus said Yahweh to me: Go, and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

PAITE: Huan a kiang uah, Nou Juda kumpipate, Juda tengtengte, Jerusalema teeng tengteng hiai kongpi khawnga lut sekte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un.
ENGLISH: and tell them, Hear the word of Yahweh, you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi hi: Na hinna uh pilvang mahmah dih ua, khawlniin puak neikei unla, Jerusalem kulh kongpi ah lutpih sam kei un.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

PAITE: Huan, khawlniin na in ua kipan puak na pokhe ding uh ahi keia, na himhim na sem ding uh ahi sam kei; na pipute uh kiang a ka thu piak bangin khawlni na tang siang thou zo ding uhi.
ENGLISH: neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day holy, neither do any work: but make the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

PAITE: Amau jaw a ngaikhe kei ua, bil a doh kei ua; thununna a jak ua a tan louhna ding un a kigenhaksak jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: But they didn’t listen, neither turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA thu pawtin hichiin a chi: Khawksa taka na honngaihkhiak ua, khawlnia hiai khopia kongpia thil na puaklut louh ua,
ENGLISH: It shall happen, if you diligently listen to me, says Yahweh, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;

PAITE: Na himhim na sep louh ua khawlni na tan siangthou uleh, hiai khopi kongpi ah leh heutute, David tutphaha tu dingte kangtalaite leh sakolte ah tuangin a honglut ding ua, amau leh a miliante uh Juda leh Jerusalema tengte toh; huchiin hiai khopi ah mi a teng denta ding uh.
ENGLISH: then shall there enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall remain forever.

PAITE: Juda khopi leh Jerusalem kim akipan, Benjamin gam akipan, gamniam gam akipan, tanggam a kipan leh Sim gam akipain a hongpai ding ua, halmang thillat leh kithoihnate buh leh bal thillat leh gimlimte, kipahna kithoihnate TOUPA in ah a hontawi ding uh.Himahleh khawlni tang siangthou ding leh khawlnia puak neilouh leh Jerusalem kulh kongpia lutpih louh ding thu ah na honngaihkhiak kei ua leh a kulh kongpite ah mei ka pawtsak dinga, Jerusalem kumpipa inte a kang bei dinga, a mit kei ding.
ENGLISH: They shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the lowland, and from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving, to the house of Yahweh.

PAITE: Himahleh khawlni tang siangthou ding leh khawlnia puak neilouh leh Jerusalem kulh kongpia lutpih louh ding thu ah na honngaihkhiak kei ua leh a kulh kongpite ah mei ka pawtsak dinga, Jerusalem kumpipa inte a kang bei dinga, a mit kei ding.
ENGLISH: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

PAITE: TOUPA akipana Jeremia kianga thu hongtung,
ENGLISH: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

PAITE: Thou inla, belvelmi in ah hohsuk inla, huaiah ka thute ka hon theisak ding, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.

PAITE: Huchiiin belvelmi in ah ka hohsukta a, a belbawlna khawl ah na a sem hi.
ENGLISH: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making a work on the wheels.

PAITE: Tunga bel a bawl lai a honghoih kei leh belvelmiin hoih a sak bangin bel dang din a bawl nawn mai sek hi.
ENGLISH: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

PAITE: Huchiin TOUPA thu ka kiangah a hongtung nawna:
ENGLISH: Then the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

PAITE: Aw Israel inkote aw, hiai belvelmi hih bangin nou ka honhih theikeia hia? chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi. Ngaidih ua, belvelmi khuta tung bang lelin ka khut ah na om uhi, aw Israel inkote aw.
ENGLISH: House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter? says Yahweh. Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.

PAITE: Chiklaiin leng nam hiam gam hiam tungtang thu ah, Ka hondokkhe dinga, ka honphel dinga, ka hon hihse ding, chiin na nagen zong hi leng,
ENGLISH: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it;

PAITE: Huai namin a tungthu ka gen jiaka a thil hoihlou a lehngatsan leh a tunga thil hoihlou hih ka tup ka kikhelsak ding.
ENGLISH: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

PAITE: Huan, chiklaiin leng nam hiam gam tungtang thu ah, ka honbawl dinga, ka hon dingsak dinga, chiin nagen zong hileng,
ENGLISH: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

PAITE: Ka paukam suak ngaikhe loua ka mitmuh a thilhoihlou a hih leh amah a dingin thil hoih hih ka tup ka kikhelsak sam ding.
ENGLISH: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they not obey my voice, then I will repent of the good, with which I said I would benefit them.

PAITE: Huaijiakin Juda mite leh Jerusalema tengte kiangah, TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaidih ua, na tunguah thil hoihlou ka ngaihtuaha, nou ka honsawm lai na hi uh, mi chihin a omdan hoihlou uh lehngatsan uhen la, na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh bawlpha un, vachi peuhmah in.
ENGLISH: Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return you now everyone from his evil way, and amend your ways and your doings.

PAITE: Himahleh amua jaw, Kilawm kei e! Koumau phasak bangbangin ka omding ua, mi chih koumau lungtang gilou genhak bangjelin ka om ding uh, a chi sek uhi.
ENGLISH: But they say, It is in vain; for we will walk after our own devices, and we will do everyone after the stubbornness of his evil heart.

PAITE: Huaijiakin TOUPAN chichiin a chi: Nam dangte dong him dih ua, hichibang mahmah kuan a theia? Nungak Israelin thil lauhuai mahmah a hihta.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Ask now among the nations, who has heard such things; the virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

PAITE: Lebanon vukin a mualvum a nose ngei ahia? gamlaa kipana tui vot hongluang sukte a kangtat ngei ahia?
ENGLISH: Shall the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Shall the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?

PAITE: Ka miten a honmangngilh ua, bangmahlou phet kiangah gimlim a hal ua, huaiten a tumalam lampi ua kipan a kisuisaka, lampipen hi lou lamkhem lam a jui uh;
ENGLISH: For my people have forgotten me, they have burned incense to false gods; and they have been made to stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up;

PAITE: A hihse gawpte uh-agam, khantawn a tek khum ding; kiviallehmin lamdangsain a lu uh a sing ua.
ENGLISH: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing; everyone who passes thereby shall be astonished, and shake his head.

PAITE: Suahlam hoihpi bangin melma maah ka thehjak ding, a vangtah ni un ka mel hilou, ka dek ka musak ding hi.
ENGLISH: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

PAITE: Huan, amau, Kisa un, Jeremia i sawm ding uh, siampu akipan lah dan a dai sin ngal keia, mi pil a kipan lah thudot a dai sam kei ding, jawlnei akipan lah thu a dai sam kei ding hi. Kisa un, i gense gawpgawp ding ua, a thu mawngmawng i limsak kei ding, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Then they said, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

PAITE: Honlimsak inla, aw TOUPA, kei honngetna thu limsakin.
ENGLISH: Give heed to me, Yahweh, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.

PAITE: Gilou thil hoih ditna hia hi ngei? amau lah ka khaa dingin kokhuk a tou ngal ua. Amau akipana na hehna heimang ding leh amaua dia thil hoih gen dinga na maa ka din sek theigigein.
ENGLISH: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.

PAITE: Huchiin a tate uh kialpi kiangah pe khia inla, namsau hatna kiangah piain; huan a jite uh taneilouin, meithai uhen; a pasalte uh hipiin si uhenla, a tangvalte uh leng kidouna ah namsauin.
ENGLISH: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword; and let their wives become childless, and widows; and let their men be slain of death, and their young men struck of the sword in battle.

PAITE: Simmite a kiang uh na tunsak guih laiin a in ua kipan kap husa thang khia hen: kei adingin kokhuk a tou ngal ua, ka khe awkna dingin thang a kam ngal ua.Himahleh nang aw TOUPA, kei honthat dinga a honsawmna tengteng uh na thei hi; a thulimlouhna uh ngaidam kenla, na mitmuhin a khelhna uh thai mang sam ken: Na maah kipuk uhenla, na ehih niin hih ekin.
ENGLISH: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when you shall bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

PAITE: Himahleh nang aw TOUPA, kei honthat dinga a honsawmna tengteng uh na thei hi; a thulimlouhna uh ngaidam kenla, na mitmuhin a khelhna uh thai mang sam ken: Na maah kipuk uhenla, na ehih niin hih ekin.
ENGLISH: Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me; don’t forgive their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from your sight; but let them be overthrown before you; deal you with them in the time of your anger.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Kuan unla, belvelmi lei bel valei un; huan, mipite upate leh siampu laka upate pi inla;
ENGLISH: Thus said Yahweh, Go, and buy a potter’s earthen bottle, and take some of the elders of the people, and of the elders of the priests;

PAITE: Harsith kongpi lutna china Benhinem guam ah hoh inla, huaiah na kianga thu ka honhilh ding na phuang ding.
ENGLISH: and go forth to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell you;

PAITE: Hichiin na chi ding hi: Juda kumpipate leh Jerusalema tengte aw, TOUPA thu ja un. Israel Pathian, sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaidih ua, hiai munah a ja pehmah bilam khop hiala thil hoihlou ka hontun sin hi.
ENGLISH: and say, Hear the word of Yahweh, kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears shall tingle.

PAITE: Miten a honpai san ua, hiai mun a hihnin un, amau leh a pate uh leh Juda kumpipaten leng a theih ngei nai het louh uh, pathian dangte kiangah gimlim a hal jiak uleh hiai mun mi hoih sisana a dimsak jiak un leh Baal kianga halmang thillat dinga a tate uh a halna ding ua Baal mun sangte a lamkhiak jiak un;
ENGLISH: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods, that they didn’t know, they and their fathers and the kings of Judah; and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,

PAITE: Huai jaw ka thupiak ahi keia, gen leng ka gen sam keia, ka lungsim ah leng a om ngeikei hi.
ENGLISH: and have built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal; which I didn’t command, nor spoke it, neither came it into my mind:

PAITE: Huaijiakin, ngaidih, nite a hongtung sin, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi: huai nite chiangin hiai mun Topheth chih ahita kei dinga, Benhinom guam chih ahi sam kei ding; kithahna guam chih ahi zota ding.
ENGLISH: therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that this place shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of Slaughter.

PAITE: Huan, hiai munah Juda leh Jerusalem thil tupte ka vuak suaksak dinga; huan, amau pen namsauin a melmate uh maah leh a hinna uh lak tummite khut ah ka puksak ding; a luangte uh tunga leng vasate leh leia gamsate an dingin ka pe ding.
ENGLISH: I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life: and their dead bodies will I give to be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth.

PAITE: Huan, hiai khopi lamdang sak ding leh tek khum dingin ka bawl dinga, a vialpai peuhin siatna a tuahte jiakin lamdang a sa ding ua, a tek khum lai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: I will make this city an astonishment, and a hissing; everyone who passes thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

PAITE: A tanute uleh a tapate uh sa ka nesak dinga; huan a melmate u leh a hinna uh lak tummiten a um ua a mangbat sak hun chiang un kuapeuhin a invengte uh sa a ne ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters; and they shall eat everyone the flesh of his friend, in the siege and in the distress, with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, shall distress them.

PAITE: Huan, na paipihte mitmuhin bel na hihtam dinga, a kiang uah hi-chiin na chi ding.
ENGLISH: Then you shall break the bottle in the sight of the men who go with you,

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Hichimahbangin hiai mite leh hiai khua ka hihtam ding; belvelmi bel min a kitam saka, bawl hoih nawn vual ahi lou bangin; huan, Tophethah a vui ding ua, vuina ding mun dang a om louh jiakin.
ENGLISH: and shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again; and they shall bury in Topheth, until there is no place to bury.

PAITE: Huchi hialin hiai mun ka bawl ding, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi; huan hichibang mahin hiai khua Topheth banga bawl hialin, a sunga tengte tungah leng ka hih ding:
ENGLISH: Thus will I do to this place, says Yahweh, and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth:

PAITE: Jerusalem inte leh Juda kumpipate inte-in chiteng mahmah a tunga van lam thilte kianga gimlim halkhitna tengteng leh pathian dangte kianga dawn ding thillat butkhiaksana tengtengte Topheth mun bang hiala hihnit ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: and the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, shall be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky, and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.

PAITE: Huan, Jeremia bel, TOUPAN thu gen dinga a sawlna mun Topheth akipan in a hongpaia; huan, TOUPA in um sungah a dinga, mipi tengteng kiangah hichiin a chi hi:Israelte Pathian, sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaihdih ua, thilhoihlou ka gen tengteng hiai khopi leh a kho dang tengteng ah ka hontungsak sin hi: ka thu ngaikhe lou dinga a lungtang uh a khuahsak jiak un.
ENGLISH: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of Yahweh’s house, and said to all the people:

PAITE: Israelte Pathian, sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaihdih ua, thilhoihlou ka gen tengteng hiai khopi leh a kho dang tengteng ah ka hontungsak sin hi: ka thu ngaikhe lou dinga a lungtang uh a khuahsak jiak un.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it; because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.

PAITE: Huan TOUPA thu ka kiangah a hongtunga, hichiin a chi:
ENGLISH: The word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

PAITE: Kuan inla, Jerusalem bil a jakin kikou in, TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Na tuailaia na migitdan te, kikham laia na honitdante ka theigige hi; gamdai a khohlouh gam a na honzuih dan bang.
