ENGLISH: “Go, and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Thus says Yahweh, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, the love of your weddings; how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

PAITE: Israel bel TOUPA adia hihsiangthou, a gah pung masa ahi, amah ne gaimi peuhmah a moh dinga, a tunguah siatna a hongtung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Israel was holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him shall be held guilty. Evil shall come on them,”’ says Yahweh.”

PAITE: Aw Jakob inkote leh Israel inko tengteng aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un;
ENGLISH: Hear the word of Yahweh, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Na pipute un kei ah diktatlouhna bang ahia a muh uh, kei akipan gamlapi ah a vakmang ua, bangmahlou phet a delh ua, a nakiotsak uh?
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

PAITE: TOUPA, Aigupta gam a kipan honpi khiaa, gamdai, gam keu, kokhuk mun, sihna limliap leh gam keu mun, kuamah paisuak ngeilouhna, kuamah omlouhna muna, honpi paisuakpa koihah? a chi sam kei uh.
ENGLISH: Neither did they say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that none passed through, and where no man lived?’

PAITE: Gam hoihtak ah, a gah leh hoihna ne dingin, ka honpilut a, himahleh na lut uleh ka gam na hihnin ua, ka goutan thil kihhuaiin na bawl uh.
ENGLISH: I brought you into a plentiful land, to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

PAITE: Siamputen leng, TOUPA koiah? a chi kei ua, Dan zangmiten lah a honthei sam kei uh, vaihawmmite ka tungah a hel ua, jawlneiten Baal minin thu a gen ua, thil phatuamlou dingte a delh uh.
ENGLISH: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

PAITE: Huchiin ka honglang dinga, na tate uh ta nawnte leng ka lang lailai ding, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says Yahweh, “and I will contend with your children’s children.

PAITE: Kittim tuikulh ah vahoh unla, en un, kedarah mi sawl unla, chik takin ngaihtuah un, hichibang thil a om ngeina hiam theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see; and send to Kedar, and consider diligently; and see if there has been such a thing.

PAITE: Namten a pathian uh a kheng u hia, pathian tak hilou pi leng? Ka miten bel a thupina uh, thil phatuamlou takin a khekzo ta uh.
ENGLISH: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which does not profit.

PAITE: Aw vante, lamdang sa unla, honmulkim sak henla, mau tuaituai un, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says Yahweh.

PAITE: Ka miten thil nih a hihkhial ngal ua, kei, hinna tuikhuk a honpai san ua, tuivungte a tou khia ua, tuiching, theilou ding.
ENGLISH: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

PAITE: Israel sikha ahi hia? Sikha mawnga piang hia? Bangdia nuaisiaha omta ahia oi?
ENGLISH: Is Israel a servant? Is he a native-born slave? Why has he become a prey?

PAITE: Humpinelkai lunlaiten humham khumin, a tungah aw a suah ua, a gam a hihgawp khinta uh, a khopite leng luahmi neilouin a kang siang khin.
ENGLISH: The young lions have roared at him, and yelled. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

PAITE: Nophmi leh Tahphanes miten leng, na lujang a giausak khinta uh.
ENGLISH: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

PAITE: TOUPA na Pathianin lampia a honpi laia, na taimangsan jiakin, huai tuh na tunga na tunsak ahi kei maw?
ENGLISH: “Haven’t you procured this to yourself, in that you have forsaken Yahweh your God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , when he led you by the way?

PAITE: Nile tuite dawn dinga Aigupta lampi na zuih, nang dinga banga hia phatuam sin? Luipi tui dawn dinga Assuria lampi na zuih leng, nang dinga bang ahia phatuam sin?
ENGLISH: Now what have you to do in the way to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or what have you to do in the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

PAITE: Na thulimlouhnain a honthuak sak dinga, na nungkin naknain nang a honsal ding hi; honlauna neiloua TOUPA na Pathian na paisan, thil gilou tak leh kha mahmah ahi na hih, na theikhia inla, mu telta in, chih Toupa, Sepaihte TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: “Your own wickedness shall correct you, and your backsliding shall reprove you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and a bitter, that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, and that my fear is not in you,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

PAITE: Nidanglai akipanin na hakkol hihtanin, na khaute leng na hihtatta ngala, Na na ka sem nawn kei ding, na chi a, tang sang chih ahte, singbawk nuai peuh ahte, kunin na hiha.
ENGLISH: “For of old time I have broken your yoke, and burst your bonds; and you said, ‘I will not serve;’ for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute.

PAITE: Chi dik mahmah zangin grep hoih mahmah ka honphuta, bangchidana kikhenga, kei dia grep taklou hongsuakta na hia oi?
ENGLISH: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, wholly a right seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me?

PAITE: Tangalin kisilin sahbon tampi zang mahlechin, na thulimlouhna ka mitmuhin a dawk teitei ahi, chih Toupa Pathian thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

PAITE: Ka kihihnin sama, Baalte leng ka delh sama, bangchia chi thei na hia, guam kuaka na om dante en inla, na thilhih sate thei in; sangawngsau la huk lai ngongngong na hi vele.
ENGLISH: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have done. You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

PAITE: Gam sa bengtung gamdaia om sek, a huk laia dak uau uaua dik vuvut bang; a utna kuan ahia dal sou ding? A zongmi kihihgim nuam dah leh, a hunin a mu na ding uh.
ENGLISH: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that snuffs up the wind in her desire. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her.

PAITE: Na khe ah khedap bun louin om ken la, na dang leng hul kei heh; nang bel, lamet a beita, pautuam mite ka ngaia, amau ka delh ding, na chi a.
ENGLISH: “Withhold your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’

PAITE: Guta a phawk ua a zum bangin, Israel inkote a zumta uh, amau, a kumpipate uh, a heutute uh, a siampute uh, a jawlneite u leng.
ENGLISH: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets;

PAITE: Sing bul kiangah, Ka pa na hi, chi a, suang bul kianga, Kei hongsuang na hi, chimite: masuan louin a dekkhuk sah uh a honsuan jaw ua, a mangbat hun un bel, Thou inla, honhondam tanla, a chi ding uh, na pathian, huai na bawlte koia om a hita ua?
ENGLISH: who tell wood, ‘You are my father;’ and a stone, ‘You have brought me out:’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face; but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us.’

PAITE: Amau thou jaw uhenla, na mangbat laiin a honhondam kha thei moh ding uhia; aw Juda, na pathiante bel na khopite zah phial ahi ve ua oi.
ENGLISH: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble: for according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah.

PAITE: Bangdia ka tunga vui nak? Na vek un ka tungah lah thil na hihkhial ngal ua, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.

PAITE: Na tate uh ka khena, a phatuam kei, a hoih loh tuan sam kei uh; humpinelkai duhgawl bang maiin, noumau namsauin na jawlneite uh a ne khin.
ENGLISH: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

PAITE: Aw khangthakte aw, TOUPA thu thei un, Israel ading gamdai gam bang ka hi maw? Mial sah meuhmouh gam ka hi maw? Ka miten bangdia, Ka pawt kichianta ua, na kiangah ka kik nawnkei ding uh, chi uh ahi ua?
ENGLISH: Generation, consider the word of Yahweh. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more?’

PAITE: Nungakin a kizephoihnate a mangngilh theiin, mou thakin a kivatna a mangngilh thei ding maw? Ka miten bel ni simsenglouh sungin a honna mangngilhta uh.
ENGLISH: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

PAITE: Deihtakmi muh theihna dingin na omdan ngentel na chia! Numei gilou kiangahte leng na omdan na sinsakta ve.
ENGLISH: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have taught even the wicked women your ways.

PAITE: Na nikte ah leng mi genthei poikhoihloute hinna sisan a lang a: mi in a loh lai uh khutmat leng lah ahi ngal kei a.
ENGLISH: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You did not find them breaking in; but it is because of all these things.

PAITE: Ka moh kei a, kei a kipan a hehna lak mang ahi, na chi nawn ngala, ngai in, Ka gilou kei hi, na chih jiakin, na tungthu ka ngaihtuah ding.
ENGLISH: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

PAITE: Na omdan kheng mengmenga, bangdia vialvak vak na hia? Assuria na zumpih bang mahin, Aigupta leng na zumpih lai ding hi.Na khutte lukhukin a kiang uakipan na pawt khe nawn dia, TOUPAN lah na muannate a paikheta ngala, amau ah na lamzang kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: Why do you go about so much to change your way? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

PAITE: Na khutte lukhukin a kiang uakipan na pawt khe nawn dia, TOUPAN lah na muannate a paikheta ngala, amau ah na lamzang kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: From there also you shall go forth, with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you shall not prosper with them.

PAITE: Huan Immer tapa, TOUPA ina heutupa pen, siampu Pashurin Jeremiain huai thute a gen chih a naja a.
ENGLISH: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the house of Yahweh, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

PAITE: Huchiin Pashurin jawlnei Jeremia a khena, TOUPA ina Benjamin Kongpi saknunga koltanna ah a tangsaka.
ENGLISH: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of Yahweh.

PAITE: A jingin Pashurin Jeremia a khahkhia a, huan Jeremiain a kiangah. TOUPAN na min dingin Pashur a chi kei hi, Mager-missabib a honchi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: It happened on the next day, that Pashhur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, Yahweh has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.

PAITE: TOUPAN lah hichiin a chi ngala: Ngai in, nanga ding leh na lawmte tengteng a dingin kihtakin ka honbawl ding: amau a melmate uh namsauin a puk ding ua, nang jaw na mitin na en lel ding. Judate tengteng Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe vek ding: aman Babulon ah salin a pi dinga, namsauin a that ding hi.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself, and to all your friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall see it; and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive to Babylon, and shall kill them with the sword.

PAITE: Huai banah, khopi hauhna tengteng, a sepkhiak tengteng, a thil manpha tengteng leh Juda kumpipate gou tengteng a melmate uh khut ah ka pe dinga, amau a lik ding ua, a man ding ua, Babulon ah a pi ding uh.
ENGLISH: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all the precious things of it, yes, all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies; and they shall make them a prey, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

PAITE: Huan, nang Pashur, na in sunga om tengtengte toh sal ah na tang ding ua; Babulon ah na pai tei ding; huai ah na si dinga, huaiah vuiin na om dinga, nang leh na lawm juau thu na hilhsekte tengteng toh, a chi a.
ENGLISH: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house shall go into captivity; and you shall come to Babylon, and there you shall die, and there you shall be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, nang non nakhema, khema om keita ve, nang jaw kei sangin na hata, non zoua; nitumin nuihsat ka hita, mi kuapeuhin a honnuih san uhi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded; you are stronger than I, and have prevailed: I am become a laughing-stock all the day, every one mocks me.

PAITE: Thu ka gen peuhmah chiangin, ka kikou khiaa, Hiamgamna leh siatna, chiin ka kikou; TOUPA thu bel kei adingin, nituma dem leh musit lohna kia ahi.
ENGLISH: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, Violence and destruction! because the word of Yahweh is made a reproach to me, and a derision, all the day.

PAITE: Amah ka kan kei dinga, a minin leng thu ka gen nawn sam kei ding, chi mahleng, ka guh sunga mei kang kikhumkhin bang maiin ka lungtang sungah lah a om ngal naka, ka pai kinken zou keia, ka pha zou mahmah kei hi.
ENGLISH: If I say, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I am weary with forbearing, and I can’t.

PAITE: Mi tampite phun gu ka ja, kil chih a lauhuai a om, Hek unla, i hek khawm ding uh, chiin. Ka lawmte ka puk chiang tang gige ten, Khemin a om dia, i zou ding, a tungah i phu uh i la ding, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: For I have heard the defaming of many, terror on every side. Denounce, and we will denounce him, say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall; perhaps he will be persuaded, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

PAITE: Himahleh TOUPA mihangsan kihtakhuai mahmah bangin ka kiangah a oma, a honsimmohte a puk ding ua, honzou kei ding uh. Zahlaktakin a om ding ua, a lohchin sin louh jiak un. Khantawna a minsiatna uh mangngilhin a om kei ding.
ENGLISH: But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail; they shall be utterly disappointed, because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which shall never be forgotten.

PAITE: Aw sepaihte TOUPA, mi diktatte enchianpa, lungtang leh lungsim mu paisuak sekpa, a tung ua na phulak honmusak dih ve, ka tungtang thu lah ka honkemsakta ngala.
ENGLISH: But, Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them; for to you have I revealed my cause.

PAITE: TOUPA kiangah lasa unla, TOUPA phat un; thil gilou hihmite khut akipan panpih deihte hinna lah a humbit ngala.
ENGLISH: Sing to Yahweh, praise Yahweh; for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.

PAITE: Ka piankhiak ni hamse thuakin om hen, ka nn a honpiaksak ni vualjawlin om dah hen.
ENGLISH: Cursed is the day in which I was born: don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

PAITE: Ka pa kianga, Tapa na neita hi, chih thu hontuna, hongkipaksakmi tak hamse thuakin om hen.
ENGLISH: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, A boy is born to you; making him very glad.

PAITE: Huai mi lah, TOUPAN hehpih het loua a sukgawp khuate bangin om hen, jingsang lamin kikou husa ja henla, sun ahih chiangin galdou husa;
ENGLISH: Let that man be as the cities which Yahweh overthrew, and didn’t repent: and let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime;

PAITE: Sul sunga a honhihlup louh jiakin; huchi hihle bel ka nu ka han hi mai ding hia, a sulin khantawna honpai mai ding hi ven.Bangdia sul akipan hongpawt chitchiat ka hia, semgim leh lungkhama om dinga zahlak mawngmawnga ka damsung nite zang dingin?
ENGLISH: because he didn’t kill me from the womb; and so my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.

PAITE: Bangdia sul akipan hongpawt chitchiat ka hia, semgim leh lungkhama om dinga zahlak mawngmawnga ka damsung nite zang dingin?
ENGLISH: Why came I forth out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

PAITE: Kumpipa Zedekia in Malkija tapa Pashur leh siampu Maasei tapa Zehpania Jeremia kianga a sawl laia Jeremia kianga TOUPA akipana thu hongtung,
ENGLISH: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

PAITE: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzarin lah a hondouta ngala, TOUPAN a thilhih thupi tak a hihsek bangin a honhuh nuamin, a kik nawn sak mai kha diam chih TOUPA hondot sak dih ve, chiin.
ENGLISH: Please inquire of Yahweh for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us: perhaps Yahweh will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

PAITE: Huan Jeremiain a kiang uah, Zedekia kiangah hichibangin vagen un: Israelte Pathian, TOUPAN hichiin a chi:
ENGLISH: Then Jeremiah said to them, You shall tell Zedekiah:

PAITE: Ngai in, Babulon kumpipa leh Kaldai mi, kulh puaa nang honumpa na douna galvan zat ka kiksak sin ahi; huan, hiai khopi sungah amau ka pi khawm ding.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you, without the walls; and I will gather them into the midst of this city.

PAITE: Keimah mahin leng heh leh lungkimlou mahmah leh thangpai takin ban jakin ban tha hat zangin nang ka hondou ding.
ENGLISH: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation.

PAITE: Hiai khua a teng mihingte leh gante ka hihlum dinga, hipiin a si ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal: they shall die of a great pestilence.

PAITE: Huai nungin, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi, kumpipa Zedekia leh a nungjuite leh mi dang hiai khuaa hi leh namsau leh kiala si loute, Babulon kimpipa leh a melmate uh khut ah leh amau that tummite khut ah ka pe ding. Namsau hiamin a that dinga, a hehpih het kei dinga, a hawi het kei ding, a lainat sam kei ding.
ENGLISH: Afterward, says Yahweh, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, even such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life: and he shall strike them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

PAITE: Huan hiai mipite kiangah hichiin vagenin: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngai un, sihna lampi leh hinna lampi ka honkoih saka.
ENGLISH: To this people you shall say, Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

PAITE: Hiai khopi sunga om namsauin hiam kialin hiam hiin hiam a si ding uh; Kaldai mite nou honumpa kianga pawta kipiate bel a hing ding uh, a hinna uh kidouna kipahman ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he who goes out, and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be to him for a prey.

PAITE: Hiai khopi hoihna ding hi lou, a siatna ding ka tum bilbel ahi; Babulon kumpipa khuta piak ahi dinga, aman meiin a hal ding, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good, says Yahweh: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

PAITE: Juda kumpipa inkote tungtang thu ah; TOUPA thu ngaikhia un,
ENGLISH: Touching the house of the king of Judah, hear the word of Yahweh:

PAITE: Aw David inkote aw! TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Jingsangin vai dik takin hawm unla, simmohmi khut akipan loh thuakmi hun khia unla, huchilouin jaw ka hehna mei bangin a pawt dinga, kuamah phelh vual louh dingin a kang dia, na thil hihgiloute uh jiakin.
ENGLISH: House of David, thus says Yahweh, Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

PAITE: Ngaidih ua, guam janga tengte aw, nou guam jang suangpia tenga, Kuate ahia i omna ua honglut ding? chite aw, nou ka honlang ding hi. TOUPA thu pawtin a chi.Na thilhih uh gah bang jelin ka hon gawt dinga, a gam gammang ah mei ka khah dinga, a kim tengteng a kangmang ding, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi.
ENGLISH: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain, says Yahweh; you that say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

PAITE: Na thilhih uh gah bang jelin ka hon gawt dinga, a gam gammang ah mei ka khah dinga, a kim tengteng a kangmang ding, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi.
ENGLISH: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says Yahweh; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all that is around her.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Juda kumpipa in ah hoh suk inla, hiai thu vagen in.
ENGLISH: Thus said Yahweh: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

PAITE: Aw Juda kumpipa, David tutphah tunga tu, nang leh na nungjuite leh na mi hiai kongkhaka lutte toh, TOUPA thu ngaikhia unla, chiin:
ENGLISH: Say, Hear the word of Yahweh, king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Diktak leh hoihtakin vai hawm unla; simmohmi khut akipan loh thuakmi hunkhhia unla; huan, mikhualte, pa neiloute leh meithai tungah te diklouhna hiam hiamgamna hiam ching kei un; hiai mun ah mi hoih sisan leng suah sam kei un,
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh: Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence, to the foreigner, the fatherless, nor the widow; neither shed innocent blood in this place.

PAITE: Hiai thu jui ngei hi le uchin jaw, David tutphah tunga kumpipate kangtalaite leh sakolte tunga tuangin, amaute leh a nungjuite uh leh a mite uh hiai na kongkhakte uah a lut ngeingei ding uh.
ENGLISH: For if you do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

PAITE: Himahleh hiai thute na ngaihkhiak kei uleh, hiai in a segawp dinga, chiin, kei leh kei kilouin ka kichiam ahi, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself, says Yahweh, that this house shall become a desolation.

PAITE: TOUPAN Juda kumpipa inkuan tungtang thu hichibangin a gen hi: Nang jaw kei ading in Gilead bang, Lebanon mual vum bang na hi: himahleh gamdai ka honsuaksak ding, luahmi omlou khopi bang maiin.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh concerning the house of the king of Judah: You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.

PAITE: Nang hihmang dingte, galvan nei chiatin, ka bawlkhol dinga; na sidar sing telte a phuk ding ua, meiah a khul ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons; and they shall cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

PAITE: Huan, nam dang tampiten hiai khopi a pal paisuak ding ua, mi chihin amau insakinkhangte kiangah TOUPAN hiai khopi thupi mahmah bangdia hichi taka hih hi ding ahia eita? a chi ding uh.
ENGLISH: Many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbor, Why has Yahweh done thus to this great city?

PAITE: A Pathian uh TOUPA thukhun a lehngatsanua pathian dangte a biak ua, a na a sep jiak uh ahi, chiin a dawng ding uh.
ENGLISH: Then they shall answer, Because they forsook the covenant of Yahweh their God, and worshiped other gods, and served them.

PAITE: Misi kah kei unla, sun sam kei un; paimangmi bel nakpi mahmahin kah un, a hongkik nawn sin ngal keia, a pianna gam a muh nawn louh ding jiakin.
ENGLISH: Don’t weep for the dead, neither bemoan him; but weep bitterly for him who goes away; for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

PAITE: Juda kumpipa Sallum, Josia sika vaihawmpa, hiai mun akipan paikheta tungtang thu bel TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Hiaiah a hongkik nawnta kei ding.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went forth out of this place: He shall not return there any more.

PAITE: Sala a pi na mun uah, huailai mahah a si dinga, hiai gam a mu nawnta kei ding.
ENGLISH: But in the place where they have led him captive, there shall he die, and he shall see this land no more.

PAITE: Diktatlouhnaa in lama, diklouhnaa a dantan tungnungte bawlmi, a thawna amah insakinkhangte tha zang, loh pe nuam loumite tung a gik hi;
ENGLISH: Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service without wages, and doesn’t give him his hire;

PAITE: In thupi mahmah ka kilam dinga, dantan tungnung zapite neiin, tohlette ka hong dinga, sidar singin ka thuap suak dinga, ze san ka nuh ding, chimi tung mah.
ENGLISH: who says, I will build me a wide house and spacious rooms, and cuts him out windows; and it is ceiling with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

PAITE: Sidar singa vuallehphai na khen jiakin, kumpipa kisa na hi maw! huan na pan a nein a dawna, diktakin vai a hawm ahi kei maw? huai tuh amah dingin a hoih ahi.
ENGLISH: Shall you reign, because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? then it was well with him.

PAITE: Mi genthei leh tasamte a vaihawm saka, huai tuh a hoih ahi. Hiai tak na hontheihdan ding ahi maw? chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well. Wasn’t this to know me? says Yahweh.

PAITE: Himahleh na huaihamnate adingin, mi hoih sisan suahna dingin, nuaisiahna ding leh hiamgamna ding leiin na mit leh na lungsim na pu ahi.
ENGLISH: But your eyes and your heart are not but for your covetousness, and for shedding innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.

PAITE: Huaijiakin Judate kumpipa Jehoiakim, Josia tapa tungthu bel TOUPAN hichiin a gen a: Aw ka unaupa, chiin hiam, Aw ka sanggamnu, chiin hiam amah a kah kei ding ua, Aw toupa, chiin hiam, Aw thupi pen, chiin hiam amah a sun sam kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! They shall not lament for him, saying Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

PAITE: Jerusamlem kulh po lama lot khiaka, paihin, sabengtung vuia vuiin a om ding.
ENGLISH: He shall be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

PAITE: Lebanon ah pai tou inla, kikouin, Basan ah na aw suah inla, Abarim akipanin kikou in, na mi itte tengteng a mangthangta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers are destroyed.

PAITE: Na lohchinin na kiangah thu ka gena, nang lah ka ngaikhe kei ding, na chi a, ka kamsuak na ngaihkhiak louh na tuailai akipanin hiai na omdan ahi hi.
ENGLISH: I spoke to you in your prosperity; but you said, I will not hear. This has been your way from your youth, that you didn’t obey my voice.

PAITE: Na belampute tengteng uh huihin a kivak ding ua, na miitte sal din a tang ding ua, nang leng gitlouna tengteng jiakin zahlak tak leh mangbang tak in na hongom ngei ding hi.
ENGLISH: The wind shall feed all your shepherds, and your lovers shall go into captivity: surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.

PAITE: Aw Lebanon tanga teng, sidar sing laka bu septu natna na tunga a hongtuna na honghehpihhuai dingdan mai jaw! numei nauvei na bang maiin.
ENGLISH: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!

PAITE: A hina ka hin sung, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi; Juda kumpipa Konia, Jehoiakim tapa bel ka khut taklama sawnna zungbuh himahle chin, huai a kipan ka honbot ngeingei ding.
ENGLISH: As I live, says Yahweh, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, yet would I pluck you there;

PAITE: Huan, thah dinga nang hongzongmi khut ah, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah leh Kaldaite khut ah ngeingei nang ka honpe ding hi.
ENGLISH: and I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

PAITE: Na pianna hi lou gam dangah nang leh na nu nang honsuang ka honpai khe dinga, huaiah na si ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will cast you out, and your mother who bore you, into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.

ENGLISH: But to the land whereunto their soul longs to return, there shall they not return.

PAITE: Hiai Konia pen bel kitam gawp, simmohhuai ahi ka hia? bel a sunga lungkimna omlouhna ahi kai maw? bangdia amah leh a suante paihkhiaka gam a theih ngeilouh ua paihkhiaka a om uh?
ENGLISH: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? is he a vessel in which none delights? why are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into the land which they don’t know?

PAITE: Aw, gam, gam, gam, TOUPA thu ngaikhia in,TOUPAN hichiin a chi, Hiai mi ta neilou, a damsunga lohching lou ding mi ahi, a suante kuamah lohchinga, David tutphah tunga tu ding lah Juda gama vaihawm nawn ding lah a om sin ngal kei ua, chiin gelh in.
ENGLISH: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of Yahweh.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi, Hiai mi ta neilou, a damsunga lohching lou ding mi ahi, a suante kuamah lohchinga, David tutphah tunga tu ding lah Juda gama vaihawm nawn ding lah a om sin ngal kei ua, chiin gelh in.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, Write you this man childless, a man who shall not prosper in his days; for no more shall a man of his seed prosper, sitting on the throne of David, and ruling in Judah.

PAITE: I Gam tatna muna belam hihmangthanga dalhjaksak belamchingmite a tung uh a gik hi, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! says Yahweh.

PAITE: Huaijiakin TOUPA Israelte Pathianin ka mite chingpa belamchingmite tungtang thu ah hichiin a chi: Ka gan honte na dalhsak ua, na delh mang ua, na veh kei uh, ngai un, na thilhih uh gilou jiakin nou ka hongveh sin ahi, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, against the shepherds who feed my people: You have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them; behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, ka gan hon om sunte ka delhjakna gam tengtenga kipan ka pi khawm nawn dinga, a huangsung uah ka hawl khawm dinga, gah nuam mahmah ahi ding ua, a pung ding uh.
ENGLISH: I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and multiply.

PAITE: Amau limsak ding amaua dingin belamchingmi ka koih dinga, a lau nawnta kei ding ua, a kuamahmah mang a om nawn sam kei ding uh, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: I will set up shepherds over them, who shall feed them; and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall any be lacking, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Ngaidih ua, David adin Hiang diktat ka suahsak hun ding a hong tung sina, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi; amah kumpipa in a tu dinga, pil takin a gamta dinga, gam pumpi ah dikna leh diktatna a tangtungsak ding.
ENGLISH: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.

PAITE: A hun sungin Juda hotdam ahi dinga, Israel bit takin a om ding. Huai a min dinga a sak ding uh hiai ahi, TOUPA i diktatna uh ahi, chih.
ENGLISH: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely; and this is his name by which he shall be called: Yahweh our righteousness.

ENGLISH: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that they shall no more say, As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

PAITE: Mal lam gam leh a delhjakna gam tengteng akipan Israel inkote suante pikhiaa, pi kik nawnpa TOUPA a hina a hin sung, a chi zota ding uh. Huan, amau gam ngei ah a teng ding uh.
ENGLISH: but, As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them. They shall dwell in their own land.

PAITE: Jawlneite tungtang thu pen, ka sungah ka lungtang a puakkham hi, ka guh tengteng a linga, zu kham bang mai ka hi, juin a zelh zoh mi bang maiin, TOUPA jiak leh a thu siangthou jiakin.
ENGLISH: Concerning the prophets. My heart within me is broken, all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahweh, and because of his holy words.

PAITE: Gam angkawm honin a dima, hamsia jiakin gamin a sun-a, gamdai lou hing munte a keu khinta; a lampi uh a giloua, a hatna uh a dik kei hi.
ENGLISH: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourns; the pastures of the wilderness are dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;

PAITE: Jawlneite leh siamputen Pathian khawk a sa kei ua, ka in sung mahmah ah leng a khelhna uh ka mu.
ENGLISH: for both prophet and priest are profane; yes, in my house have I found their wickedness, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Huaijiakin amau adingin a paina lampi uh, jan khomial lampi nal bang ahi dinga, huailaiah delhin a om ding ua a tolhpuk ding ua, a tunguah thilhoih lah ka tungsaksin ngala, amaute gawtna hun, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi.
ENGLISH: Therefore their way shall be to them as slippery places in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Samari jawlneite tungah kihhuai ka mu, Baal louin thu a gen ua, Israelte a pi mang ua.
ENGLISH: I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

PAITE: Jerusalem jawlneihon tungah leng thil mulkimhuai kamu, ang a kawm ua, juauin a gamta ua, thilgilou hihte khut a hatsak ua, kuamahin a gitlouh uh kisik a tup louh loh uhi; kei dingin Sodom khuaa mite bang a honghi vek ua, a kho sunga mite tengteng leng Gomorrah khua a mite bang hial.
ENGLISH: In the prophets of Jerusalem also I have seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies; and they strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them become to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.

PAITE: Huaijiakin jawlneihon tungtang thu ah sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaidih ua, gamsaiin ka vak dinga, thil kha ka dawnsak dinga; Jerusalem a jawlneite kiang akipanin gam pumpi ah Pathian poisaklouhna lah a pawt ta ngala.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies concerning the prophets: Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall; for from the prophets of Jerusalem is ungodliness gone forth into all the land.

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Jawlnei nakiang ua thugente thu ngaikhe kei un; bangmahlou a honsinsak ua. TOUPA kama kipan hilou amau lungsim geltawmte a gen sek uh.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you: they teach you vanity; they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahweh.

PAITE: TOUPA thu musitmite kiangah, Nang dingin a hoih ding, a chi vial ua; huan, amau deihlam engtata hih teiteimite kiangah, Thil hoihlou bangmah na tungah a hongtung kei ding, a chi uh.
ENGLISH: They say continually to those who despise me, Yahweh has said, You shall have peace; and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, No evil shall come on you.

PAITE: TOUPA thugelna ah kua apang ngeia, a thu sanga thei ding kua a oma? ahihleh a thu pen kuan ahia limsaka ngaikhia om?
ENGLISH: For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? who has marked my word, and heard it?

PAITE: Ngaidih ua, TOUPA huihpi, hehna a pawtta, ahi, pingpei huihpi; mi giloute lutang a nuai ding.
ENGLISH: Behold, the storm of Yahweh, his wrath, has gone forth. Yes, a whirling storm. It shall burst on the head of the wicked.

PAITE: TOUPA hehna a mawk kik kei ding, a lungsima a tup chinten a tangtungsaka, a hih khit phot masiah; ni nanung lamahte non theichian ding uh.
ENGLISH: The anger of Yahweh shall not return, until he has executed, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days you shall understand it perfectly.

PAITE: Jawlneite bel ka sawl louhpiin a tai ua, a kiang ua thu ka gen louhin leng thu a gen uh.
ENGLISH: I sent not these prophets, yet they ran: I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.

PAITE: Ka thugelnaa om tei hi le ujaw, ka thu ka mite kianga phuang ding hi ve un, a thilhih diklou ua kipan lehngatsak ding hi ve un.
ENGLISH: But if they had stood in my council, then had they caused my people to hear my words, and had turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

PAITE: Gamla pia om Pathian hi louin, Pathian nai gige ka hi hia? chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Am I a God at hand, says Yahweh, and not a God afar off?

PAITE: Mun kiselah ka muh theihlouh dia bu theimi a om sin ua hia? chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi. Lei leh vanah ka dim ahi kei maw? chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Can any hide himself in secret places so that I shall not see him? says Yahweh. Don’t I fill heaven and earth? says Yahweh.

PAITE: Mang ka nei, mang ka nei, chia ka mina juau gen jawlneite thugen ka zata hi.
ENGLISH: I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

PAITE: Jawlnei juau gen sek, amau lungtang kikhem tawma thu sekmite lungtang ah hiai bangtan ahia a om sin?
ENGLISH: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?

PAITE: Amau bel a invengte uh kiangah a mang uh a hilh ua ka mite ka min mangngilh sak a tum ua, a pate un Baal jiaka ka min a mangngilh khit bang un,
ENGLISH: who think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name for Baal.

PAITE: Jawlnei mang neiin a mang gen hen, ka thu neimiin ka thu tak dik takin gen hin. Buhpawl leh buhtangin kibatna bang a nei ua? chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat? says Yahweh.

PAITE: A thu bel mei bang, sek suang seknenna bang ahi ka hia? chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Isn’t my word like fire? says Yahweh; and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?

PAITE: Huaijiakin, ngaiun, jawlnei hon, ka thu kiguksak tuah sekte ka dou ahi, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahweh, who steal my words everyone from his neighbor.

PAITE: Ngaidih ua, Jawlnei amah dangnal saka, TOUPAN a chi, chi sekte ka dou ahi, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahweh, who use their tongues, and say, He says.

PAITE: Ngaidih ua, mang juau leltak gena, hilha, a juau thute uh leh a kiotsakna thu ginaloute uh jiaka ka mite pimang jawlneite ka dou ahi, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi; ka sawl ngal keia, thu lah ka pe keia, hiai mipite a lohtak sak himhim kei ding uh, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams, says Yahweh, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting: yet I didn’t send them, nor commanded them; neither do they profit this people at all, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Hiai mipite laka mi kuain hiam, jawlnei kua hiamin, siampu kuahiamin, TOUPA puakgik bang ahia? chia a hondot leh hichiin na dawng ding hi, Noumau mah puakgik pen na hi uh, ka honpai mang sin; chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask you, saying, What is the burden of Yahweh? Then you shall tell them, What burden! I will cast you off, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Jawlnei hiam, siampu hiam, mi kua hiam, TOUPA puakgik, chi a om uleh, huai mi leh a inkote ka gawt ding.
ENGLISH: As for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, who shall say, The burden of Yahweh, I will even punish that man and his house.

PAITE: Huchiin mi kuapeuhin a insakinkhangpa kiangah leh kuapeuhin a unaupa kiangah, TOUPAN bangchiin a dawnga. TOUPAN bang a gena? chiin na kidong ding uh.
ENGLISH: You shall say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, What has Yahweh answered? and, What has Yahweh spoken?

PAITE: TOUPA puakgik na loukha nawn kei ding ua, mi kuapeuh amah mah thu gen lah puakgik ahi din ngala. Pathian hing, sepaihte TOUPA, i Pathian thu u lah na lehbulh khinta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: You shall mention the burden of Yahweh no more: for every man’s own word shall be his burden; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of Yahweh of Armies our God.

PAITE: Jawlnei kiangah, TOUPAN bangchiin nang a hondawnga? TOUPAN bang ahia a gen? na chi ding.
ENGLISH: You shall say to the prophet, What has Yahweh answered you? and, What has Yahweh spoken?

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA puakgik, na chih peuhmah uleh, TOUPAN hichiin a chi: TOUPA puakgik na chi ding uh ahi kei, chia ka honsawla, TOUPA puakgik chia thu na gen jiakin;
ENGLISH: But if you say, The burden of Yahweh; therefore thus says Yahweh: Because you say this word, The burden of Yahweh, and I have sent to you, saying, You shall not say, The burden of Yahweh;

PAITE: Huchiin, ngaiun, ka honmangngilh keuhkeuh dinga, ka honpai mang dinga, noute leh hiai khopi na kiang uleh na pate uh kianga ka na piaksa toh.Huan, khantawn demsiatna leh zahlak nilouhna mangngilh vuallouh na tunguah ka hontun ding.
ENGLISH: therefore, behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off, and the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence:

PAITE: Huan, khantawn demsiatna leh zahlak nilouhna mangngilh vuallouh na tunguah ka hontun ding.
ENGLISH: and I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN a honensaka, ngaidih, thipi bawm nih TOUPA biakin maah a nakitunga, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzarin Judate kumpipa Jekonia, Jehoiakimtapa leh Juda heutute, mi khutsaimte leh siksekmite toh Jerusalem akipana Babulon sal dia a pi nungin.
ENGLISH: Yahweh showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs set before Yahweh’s temple, after that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

PAITE: Bawm khat ah theipi hoihtek, theipi min masa bang tak, a oma; bawm dangah bel theipi hoihlou hial, nek tak louh khopa sia a om hi.
ENGLISH: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN ka kiangah, Bang ahia na muh, Jeremia? a chi a. Ken, Theipi, theipi hoih, hoih mahmah; leh a hoihlou, nek tak louh khopa sia, ka chi a.
ENGLISH: Then Yahweh said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA thu ka kiangah a hongtung.
ENGLISH: The word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

PAITE: TOUPA Israelte Pathianin hichiin a chi: Juda sal tangte, Kaldaite gama a thatna ding ua ka sawl khiakte, hiai theipi hoih bangin ka en sin hi.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so will I regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, for good.

PAITE: A hoihna ding un a tunguah kamit ka tusak dinga, hiai gamah ka pikik nawn ding: amau ka dingsak dinga, ka phel kei ding; ka suan dinga, ka bot kei ding.
ENGLISH: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA ka hi chih na hontheihna dingin lungtang ka honpe dinga: ka mite ahi ding ua, a Pathian uh ka hi ding: a lungtang tengteng utoh ka kiangah a hongkik sin ngal ua.
ENGLISH: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Yahweh: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God; for they shall return to me with their whole heart.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Theipi sia, nek tak louh khopa sia bangin Juda kumpipa. Zedekia leh a heutute uh leh Jerusalema nituang hiai gama om laite leh Aigupta gama tengte, ka lehngatsan ngeingei ding:
ENGLISH: As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad, surely thus says Yahweh, So will I give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt,

PAITE: Haksa taka leitung gam tengteng laka sep lenlen dingin, ka delhmangna tengtenga gensiat leh tehpih leh tai leh hamsiat khum hi dingin ka tawpsan ding.Amau leh a pate uh kianga ka piak gam akipan valh khit a hih pha un a lak uah namsaute, kialte, a kianga ka piak gam akipan valh khit a hih pha un a lak uah namsaute, kialte, hite, ka sawl ding.
ENGLISH: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I shall drive them.

PAITE: Amau leh a pate uh kianga ka piak gam akipan valh khit a hih pha un a lak uah namsaute, kialte, a kianga ka piak gam akipan valh khit a hih pha un a lak uah namsaute, kialte, hite, ka sawl ding.
ENGLISH: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, until they be consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.

PAITE: Judate kumpipa, Jehoiakim, Josia tapa kum linaa Juda mite tengteng tungtanga Jeremia kianga thu hongtung: Huai hun bel Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kum khatna ahia,
ENGLISH: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (the same was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

PAITE: Huai thu jawlnei Jeremiain Juda mi tengteng leh Jerusalema om tengtengte kianga a gen ahi.
ENGLISH: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:

PAITE: Kum sawmnih leh kum thum sung tak, Judate kumpipa Josia, Amon tapa kum sawm leh kum thumna akipana tu tanin, TOUPA thu a hongtung seka, jing pipia thouin na kiang uah ka gengena, himahleh na ngaikhe kei uh.
ENGLISH: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, the word of Yahweh has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN na kiang uah a nasemmi jawlneite tengteng a sawla, jing pipia thouin a sawla, himahleh na ngaikhe kei ua, thei dingin na bil uh na doh sam kei uh;
ENGLISH: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened, nor inclined your ear to hear)

PAITE: Huai, jawlneiten, mi chih noumau lampi gilou akipan hongkik unla, TOUPAN na kiang ua leh na pate uh kianga nidanglai akipan khantawna dinga nou a honpiak gamah teng un:
ENGLISH: saying, Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forevermore;

PAITE: Pathian dangte kiangah a na uh sem ding leh amau be ding leh na khut nasep ua ka lung kimlou sak dingin hoh kei un; huchiin, ka honhihna kei ding hi, a chi sek uh.
ENGLISH: and don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; and I will do you no harm.

PAITE: Himahleh nou dinga hoih lou dinga na khut nasep ua honhehsak dingin na honngaikhe kei ua, TOUPAN a chi.
ENGLISH: Yet you have not listened to me, says Yahweh; that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.

PAITE: Huaijiakin sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ka thu na ngaihkhiak louh jiak un, ngaihdih ua,
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies: Because you have not heard my words,

PAITE: Mal lam nam tengteng ka thukhak dinga, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi. Ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzer leng ka thukhak dinga, amaute hiai gam leh a sunga omte leh hiai kima nam om tengteng sual dingin ka honpi dinga; ka hihmang sipsip dinga, lamdangsak ding leh tek khum ding leh segawp nilouh dingin ka bawl ding.
ENGLISH: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says Yahweh, and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around; and I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

PAITE: Huan a kiang ua kipan naumsakna husa leh kipahna husate, mouneipa aw leh mou aw te, buh gawi husa ging leh khawnvak vak te ka la mang ding.
ENGLISH: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

PAITE: Hiai avekin a se dinga, lamdangsak ahi ding; huan hiai namte Babulon kumpipa na kum sawmsagih a sem ding uh.
ENGLISH: This whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

PAITE: Huan, kum sawmsagih a man hun chiangin Babulon kumpipa leh huai nam, kaldaite gam, a gitlouhna uh jiakin ka gawt dinga; khantawnin ka segawp sak ding, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi hi.
ENGLISH: It shall happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, says Yahweh, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it desolate forever.

PAITE: Huai gam tungah ka thu a tung ua ka gen tengteng, Jeremiain nam tengteng tunga a gen, hiai laibu a gelhsa tengteng ka tungsak ding hi.
ENGLISH: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

PAITE: Nam tuamtuam leh kumpipa thupi takten amautein na a kisep un, amau mahmahin leng amau na a hon sepsak sin ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For many nations and great kings shall make bondservants of them, even of them; and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.

PAITE: TOUPA Israelte Pathianin ka kiangah hichiin a chi: Ka khuta hiai hehna uain nou la inla, ka honsawlna ding nam teng dawnsakin.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to me: take this cup of the wine of wrath at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.

PAITE: A dawn ding ua, a hoi dongdong ding ua, a hai ding ua, a kiang ua ka sawl ding namsau jiakin chiin.
ENGLISH: They shall drink, and reel back and forth, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

PAITE: Huan, TOUPA khuta nou ka laa, TOUPAN honsawlna nam teng ka dawnsaka:
ENGLISH: Then took I the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:

PAITE: Huai bel hiaite ahi uhi: Jerusalem leh Juda khopite, huai kumpipate leh heutute, siatgawpna te, lamdangsak te, tek khum ding te, hamsiat te tang dingin, tua a omdan bang uh:
ENGLISH: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and its kings, and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is this day;

PAITE: Aigupta kumpipa Pharo leh a sikhate, a heutute leh a mi tengtengte;
ENGLISH: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

PAITE: Milak-hel tengteng; Uz gama kumpipa teng; Philistia gama kumpipa tengteng, Askelon leh Gaza leh Ekron leh Ashdoda om sunte kumpipate;
ENGLISH: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of the Uz, and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

PAITE: Edom leh Moab leh Amon suante;
ENGLISH: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon;

PAITE: Tura kumpipa tengteng leh Sidon kumpipa tengteng leh tuipi gei kumpipate;
ENGLISH: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;

PAITE: Dedan leh Tema leh Buz leh a bak sam uh mette tengteng;
ENGLISH: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;

PAITE: Arabia kumpipa tengteng, Gamdaia teng nam kihelte kumpipate tengteng;
ENGLISH: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;

PAITE: Zimri kumpipa tengteng; Elam kumpipa tengteng; Media kumpipa tengteng;
ENGLISH: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

PAITE: Mal lam kumpipa tengteng, a gamla leh a naia mi a kizom jelin; kumpipan a dawn ding hi.
ENGLISH: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

PAITE: Huan, a kiang uah sepaihte TOUPA, Israelte Pathianin hichiin a chi: Dawn unla, kham unla, lau unla, kipuk unla kipuk unla thou nawn kei un, namsau na lak ua ka sawl ding jaikin, chiin.
ENGLISH: You shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

PAITE: Huan, na khuta nou pen dawn dinga a lak nop kei uleh hichiin na chi ding: sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Na dawn ngeingei ding uh; hiai,
ENGLISH: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: You shall surely drink.

PAITE: Ka min tam khopi ah thil hoihlou ka hih pana, noute gawt louh hialin na om ding umaw? gawt louhin na om kei ding ua; leia teng tengteng tungah namsau ka kan sin ngala, chih sepaihte TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh of Armies.

PAITE: Huaijiakin a tungah hiaite gen inla, a kiang uah hichiin chiin: TOUPA mun sang akipanin a thum ding, a tenna siangthou akipanin a aw a suah ding, a huang tungah nakpi petmahin a thum ding; grep sukmite bangin a kikou ding, lei luahte tengteng tungah.
ENGLISH: Therefore prophesy you against them all these words, and tell them, Yahweh will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he will mightily roar against his fold; he will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

PAITE: Lei tawp phain husa a thang kik dinga, TOUPAN namte a langa, sa tengteng tungah vai a hawm sin, mi thugina lou jaw namsau kiangah a pe ding, TOUPA thu pawtin a chi.
ENGLISH: A noise shall come even to the end of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with the nations; he will enter into judgment with all flesh: as for the wicked, he will give them to the sword, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngai in, thil hoihlouin nam chih a honnuai sin hi, huihpi hat mahmah lei mun tawp akipanin a hongkuan sin hi.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great storm shall be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

PAITE: Huai ni chia TOUPA thatten lei tawp akipanin lei tawp phain a khak ding ua; sun louh leh khop louh leh vui louhin a om ding ua; leitunga eklei lel ahi ding uh.
ENGLISH: The slain of Yahweh shall be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung on the surface of the ground.

PAITE: Belamchingmite aw kikou tuaituai unla, kap un, nou belam hon laka makaite aw, kitung buatbuat un, thaha na om ni u leh na dalhjak nite uh a hongtung petmahta hi. Bel deihhuai bangin na puk ding uh.
ENGLISH: Wail, you shepherds, and cry; and wallow in dust, you principal of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are fully come, and you shall fall like a goodly vessel.

PAITE: Belamchingmiten taimangna lampi a neikei ding ua, belam hon laka makaitenleng pelhna lampi a neikei ding uh.
ENGLISH: The shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

PAITE: Belamchingmite kah husa, belam hon laka makaite mau ging toh, TOUPAN a tatna mun uh a suksiat lel jiakin.
ENGLISH: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the principal of the flock! for Yahweh lays waste their pasture.

PAITE: Huang muanhuaite daihsak sipsipin a omta ua, TOUPA hehna mahmah jiakin.A bukna a pawtsanta, humpinelkai bangin, a gam uh lah a sekhinta ngala, nuaisiahna namsau lauhuai jiak leh, heh mahmahna jiakin.
ENGLISH: The peaceable folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.

PAITE: A bukna a pawtsanta, humpinelkai bangin, a gam uh lah a sekhinta ngala, nuaisiahna namsau lauhuai jiak leh, heh mahmahna jiakin.
ENGLISH: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.

PAITE: Juda kumpipa Josia tapa Jehoiakim lal pattungin hiai thu TOUPA kiang akipan a hongtunga,
ENGLISH: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word from Yahweh, saying,

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: TOUPA in huang sungah ding inla, Juda khopi tengteng Pathian be dinga TOUPA ina hongpaite kiangah a kiang ua gen dinga thu ka honpiak tengteng khat lel leng im louin gen vek in.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh: Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in Yahweh’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them; don’t diminish a word.

PAITE: Michihin a omdan gilou uh paisanin a ngaikhe zenzen moh ding uhia, a thilhih gilou uh jiaka a tung ua thil hoihlou hih ka tup ka hep theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: It may be they will listen, and turn every man from his evil way; that I may repent me of the evil which I purpose to do to them because of the evil of their doings.

PAITE: Huan, nang a kiang uah, TOUPAN hichiin a chi: non ngaihkhiak louh ua, ka dan na ma ua ka koih na zuih louh ua,
ENGLISH: You shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh: If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

PAITE: Jing pipia thoua amau ka sawl na kiang ua ka sawl ka nasemmi jawlnei thu na limsak kei uleh;
ENGLISH: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them, but you have not listened;

PAITE: Hiai in Siloh bangin ka bawl dinga, leitunga nam tengtengte hamsia thuak dingin ka bawl ding, na chi ding hi.
ENGLISH: then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

PAITE: Huan, siampute, jawlneite leh mipi tengtengin TOUPA ina Jeremiain hiai thu a gen a ngaikhia uh.
ENGLISH: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, hichi ahia, mipi tengteng kianga gen dinga TOUPAN a piak tengteng a gen khitin, siampute, jawlneite leh mipi tengtengin amah a manta ua, Si peuhmah ni teh.
ENGLISH: It happened, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold on him, saying, You shall surely die.

PAITE: Bangdia TOUPA min loua, Hiai in Siloh bang ahi ding, hiai khopi luahmi om louin a segawp ding, chia gen na hia? a chi ua. Huchiin TOUPA in ah mipi tengtengin Jeremia a boh lutlut uh.
ENGLISH: Why have you prophesied in the name of Yahweh, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate, without inhabitant? All the people were gathered to Jeremiah in the house of Yahweh.

PAITE: Huan, Juda heututen hiai thu a jak un, kumpipa in a kipanin TOUPA in lutna kongpi thak ah a tu uh.
ENGLISH: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the house of Yahweh; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house.

PAITE: Huan, siampute leh jawlneiten heutute leh mipi tengteng kiangah, Hiai mi sitak ahi, khopi siat ding thu, na bil ua na jak bang un a gen khol ngala, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Then spoke the priests and the prophets to the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy of death; for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.

PAITE: Huan, heutute leh mipi tengteng kiangah Jeremiain, Na thu ngaihkhiak khitsa uh tengteng bangin hiai in leh hiai khopi siat ding thu gen dingin TOUPAN kei a honsawl ahi.
ENGLISH: Then spoke Jeremiah to all the princes and to all the people, saying, Yahweh sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

PAITE: Huaijiakin tuin na omdan uleh na gamtatdan uh bawl hoih unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh thu mang un; huchiin TOUPAN na tung ua thil hoih lou tung ding a phuankhiaksa a kikhelsak thei ding.
ENGLISH: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of Yahweh your God; and Yahweh will repent him of the evil that he has pronounced against you.

PAITE: Kei ahihleh, na khut ua om keita ve. Dik leh hoih na chih bangbang un hon bawl un.
ENGLISH: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as is good and right in your eyes.

PAITE: Na honthah uleh, noumau leh hiai khopi leh khua leh tuite tungah mi hoih sisan na tungsak ngeisin uh chih thei mai un; a dikdikin na bil ua hiai thu tengteng gen dia TOUPAN na kiang ua honsawl ka hi hi, achia.
ENGLISH: Only know for certain that, if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on this city, and on its inhabitants; for of a truth Yahweh has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.

PAITE: Huchiin heutute leh mipiten, siampute jawlneite kiangah, Hiai mi a sih ding ahi kei, TOUPA i Pathian muna i kiang ua thu gen ahi ve, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahweh our God.

PAITE: Huan, huai gam upa kuate hiam a hongding ua, mipi omkhawmte kiangah,
ENGLISH: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

PAITE: Mika, Moraseth miin Juda kumpipa Hezekia lal laiin thu a gena, huan, Juda mi tengteng kiangah, Sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Zion lou banga leh ahi dinga, Jerusalem thil se omkhawm ahi ding, a in mual gammang mun sang bang ahi ding, achia.
ENGLISH: Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Zion shall be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

PAITE: Juda kumpipa Hezekia leh Judate tengtengin amah a that uhia? TOUPA lauin TOUPA deihsakna a ngen ua, TOUPAN a tung ua thil hoihlou tung ding a phuan a kikhelsak ahi kei maw? En jaw i tung ua thil hoihlou tungsak ding i hi ve ua.
ENGLISH: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? Thus should we commit great evil against our own souls.

PAITE: Huan, mi dang, TOUPA mina thu gen Keriath-Jenrima mi Semei tapa Uria mah leng a oma, Jeremia thu gen tengteng mahbang in hiai gam leh khopi siat ding thu a gen hi.
ENGLISH: There was also a man who prophesied in the name of Yahweh, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

PAITE: Kumpipa Jehoiakim leh a mi thupite tengteng leh heutute tengtengin a jak un kumpipan hihlup a tuma; himahleh Uriain a jakin a laua, a taimanga, Aigupta gamah a paita hi.
ENGLISH: and when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt:

PAITE: Huan, kumpipa Jehoiakimin Aigupta gamah mi sawla, Akbor tapa Elnathan leh mi dangte toh;
ENGLISH: and Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him, into Egypt;

PAITE: Huan, Aigupta gam akipanin Uria a pi khia ua, kumpipa Jehoiakim kiangah a honpi ua, huaiin namsauin a thata, a luang vantang han ah a pailut ua, a chi ua.Himahleh Saphan tapa Ahikamin Jeremia a guma, huchiin hihlup ding in mipite kiangah piak ahita kei.
ENGLISH: and they fetched forth Uriah out of Egypt, and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

PAITE: Himahleh Saphan tapa Ahikamin Jeremia a guma, huchiin hihlup ding in mipite kiangah piak ahita kei.
ENGLISH: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

PAITE: Juda Kumpipa Josia tapa Zekedia lal pattungin, TOUPA kiang akipanin hiai thu a hongtung.
ENGLISH: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

PAITE: TOUPAN ka kiangah hichiin a chi: Hakkolte leh a khaute bawl inla, na ngaawng ah bangin.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh to me: Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck;

PAITE: Huan, Edom kumpipa te, Moab kumpipa te, Amon mite kumpipa te, Tura kumpipa te, Sidon kumpipa te kiangah Juda kumpipa Zedekia kianga mi sawl, Jerusalema hongpaite khut ah khakin.
ENGLISH: and send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the children of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah;

PAITE: Hiai thute a pute uh kiangah gensakin: Hichiin Israel Pathian, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi: hichiin na pute uh kianga na gen ding uh ahi:
ENGLISH: and give them a command to their masters, saying, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, You shall tell your masters:

PAITE: Ka thilhihtheihna thupi tak leh ka ban jakin lei te, mihing te leh leitunga sate ka bawl veka, piak tuak ka chihte kiangah ka pia.
ENGLISH: I have made the earth, the men and the animals that are on the surface of the earth, by my great power and by my outstretched arm; and I give it to whom it seems right to me.

PAITE: Tuin leng ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah hiai gam tengteng ka pe khinta hi, gamsate leng amah nasem dingin ka pelai hi.
ENGLISH: Now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the animals of the field also have I given him to serve him.

PAITE: Amah gam hun tak a tun main nam tengtengin amah leh a tapate leh a tapa tate na a sem ding ua, huai nungin bel nam tempite leh kumpipa thupi mahmahten amah sikha din a bawl ding uh.
ENGLISH: All the nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land come: and then many nations and great kings shall make him their bondservant.

PAITE: Huan, hiai ahi dinga, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hakkol po nuam lou leh a na sem nuam lou nam leh lalna gam namsau leh kial leh hipi amah khuta ka hihman vek masiah amau ka gawt jel ding.
ENGLISH: It shall happen, that the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, says Yahweh, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

PAITE: Nouten a hileh na jawlneite uh, na aisansiamte uh; na mang te uh, na bumsiamte uh, na kiang ua, Babulon kumpipa na na sem kei ding uh, chia genmite ngaikhe kei un.
ENGLISH: But as for you, don’t you listen to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreams, nor to your soothsayers, nor to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon:

PAITE: Na gam ua kipana gamla pia pi manga na om theihna ding un, na kiang uah juau thu a gen khol uh ahi: ka hondelh khiaka na man that na ding un.
ENGLISH: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, and that I should drive you out, and you should perish.

PAITE: Ahihhangin Babulon kimpipa hakkol puaa, na sem nuam nam bel a gam ngei uah ka omsak dinga, lei a let ding uh, huailaiah a teng gige ding uh, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: But the nation that shall bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, that nation will I let remain in their own land, says Yahweh; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.

PAITE: Huan, Juda kumpipa Zedekia kiangah hiai thu tengteng bang jelin ka gena: Babulon kumpipa hakkol pua unla, amah leh a mite nasem unla, na hing ding uhi.
ENGLISH: I spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

PAITE: Babulon kumpipa nasem nuam lou nam tungtang TOUPAN a gensa bangin bangdia namsaute, kialte, hipitea nang leh na mite si ding na hi ua?
ENGLISH: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

PAITE: Huan, jawlnei na kiang ua, Babulon kumpipa na sem kei un, chite thu ngaikhe kei un; na kiang uah juau thu a gen lel uh ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon; for they prophesy a lie to you.

PAITE: Ka sawl lah ahi ngal kai ua, ka min sialin juau thu a gen nak ua, nou leh na kiang ua thu gen jawlneite ka delhkhiaa, na manthat theihna ding un TOUPAN a chi.
ENGLISH: For I have not sent them, says Yahweh, but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.

PAITE: Siampute leh hiai mipite tengteng kiangah leng ka gen sama: TOUPAN hichiin a chi ahi: Jawlnei na kiang ua thu gen, Ngai un, TOUPA ina belsuante Babulon akipanin hontut ahi pah ding hi, chimite thu ngaikhe kei un, na kiang uah juau a gen uh ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus says Yahweh: Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, Behold, the vessels of Yahweh’s house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon; for they prophesy a lie to you.

PAITE: Amaute ngaikhe het kei un; Babulon kumpipa na sem unla, na hing ding uhi; bangdin hiai khopi a segawp dia?
ENGLISH: Don’t listen to them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: why should this city become a desolation?

PAITE: Himahleh jawlnei a hih ua, TOUPA thu a kiang ua om etmah ahihleh TOUPA in leh Juda kumpipa in leh Jerusalema belsuan nutsiata om laite Babulona tut ahih louhna dingin sepaihte TOUPA kiangah ngen le uh ake.
ENGLISH: But if they be prophets, and if the word of Yahweh be with them, let them now make intercession to Yahweh of Armies, that the vessels which are left in the house of Yahweh, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPAN, khuam sangte, dal tuipangte, kingaknate leh hiai khopi a belsuan nutsiata om sunte,
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh of Armies concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that are left in this city,

PAITE: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzarin Juda kumpipa Jehoiakim tapa, Jekonia leh Juda leh Jerusalem a mi hoih tengteng Jerusalem akipana Babulon sala dia a pi laia a lak val tungtang thu hichiin a gen hi,
ENGLISH: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon didn’t take, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

PAITE: Ahi, sepaihte TOUPA, Israel Pathianin TOUPA in leh Juda kumpipa in leh Jerusalema belsuan nutsiata om lai tungtang thu a gen ahi:Babulon ah lak mang ahi ding ua, amaute ka hongveh masiah huailaiah a om nilouh ding uh; huan, amau ka la tou nawn dinga, hiai munah ka koih nawn dinga, chih TOUPA thu thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: yes, thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that are left in the house of Yahweh, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:

PAITE: Babulon ah lak mang ahi ding ua, amaute ka hongveh masiah huailaiah a om nilouh ding uh; huan, amau ka la tou nawn dinga, hiai munah ka koih nawn dinga, chih TOUPA thu thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be, until the day that I visit them, says Yahweh; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

PAITE: Huan, hichi a honghia, huai kum mahin, Juda kumpipa Zedekia lalpattung lam, a kum lina, kha ngana ah jawlnei Hanania, Azzur tapa Gibeon min siampute leh mipi tengteng maah, Toupa in ah, honhoupihna,
ENGLISH: It happened the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of Yahweh, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

PAITE: Sepaihte Toupa, Israel Pathianin hichiin a chi: Babulon kumipa hakkol ka hihtanta.
ENGLISH: Thus speaks Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

PAITE: Kum nih sung vengvengin Toupa ina belsuan Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzarin hiai mun akipana a laka, Babylon tana a paipih tengteng, hiai mun mahmah ah ka hontun nawn vek ding.
ENGLISH: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of Yahweh’s house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried to Babylon:

PAITE: Hiai mun ah Juda kumpipa Jehoiakim tapa, Jekonia leh Babulona hoh Juda sal tengteng ka pi nawn ding; Babulon kumpipa hakkol lah ka hihtan sin ngala, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi, chiin.
ENGLISH: and I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon, says Yahweh; for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

PAITE: Huan Jawlnei Jeremia in siampute leh TOUPA ina ding mipi tengteng maah jawlnei Hannania kiangah,
ENGLISH: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in the house of Yahweh,

PAITE: Jawlnei Jeremia ngeiin, Amen, TOUPAN huchibangin hih ngei heh; TOUPA ina belsuante leh saltannaa mi tengteng Babulon akipan hiai muna hontun dinga na gen TOUPAN hih ngei heh.
ENGLISH: even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: Yahweh do so; Yahweh perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of Yahweh’s house, and all them of the captivity, from Babylon to this place.

PAITE: Ahihhangin mipi tengteng leh nang bila ka thu gen ngaikhiain.
ENGLISH: Nevertheless hear you now this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:

PAITE: Kei leh nang maa niganga jawlneiten gam tampi tungah leh lalna gam thupi pite tungah kidouna te, thil hoihlou te, leh hipi thu te a gen sek uh.
ENGLISH: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

PAITE: Jawlnei muanna thu genmi thi gen a hongtun hin chiangin, huai jawlnei pen TOUPAN a sawl ngei ahi chih aki thei mai ding, achia.
ENGLISH: The prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet shall happen, then shall the prophet be known, that Yahweh has truly sent him.

PAITE: Huan, jawlnei Hananiain hakkol, jawlnei Jeremia puak a la a, a hihtana.
ENGLISH: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.

PAITE: Huan, mipi tengteng maah Hananiain, Hichiin TOUPAN a chi: Hichibang ngeiin Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hakkol kum nih sing vengvengin namte tengteng ngawng akipan ka hihtan ding achi a. Huan, jawlnei Jeremiain a paisanta hi.
ENGLISH: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus says Yahweh: Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon within two full years from off the neck of all the nations. The prophet Jeremiah went his way.

PAITE: Huan, jawlnei Hananiain jawlnei Jeremia ngawng akipan hakkol a hihtan nungin Jeremia kiangah TOUPA thi a hongtunga,
ENGLISH: Then the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

PAITE: Kuan inla, Hanania kiangah hichiin vachiin, Hichiin TOUPAN a chi: Sing hakkol na hihtana, a taing sik hakkol na bawlsak jaw ahi.
ENGLISH: Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus says Yahweh: You have broken the bars of wood; but you have made in their place bars of iron.

PAITE: Hichiin Israel Pathian, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi ngala, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar na a sep theihna ding un hiai nam tengteng sik hakkol ka po sak ding ahi: amah na a sem ding uh: gamnuaia gamsate leng amah ka pe lai ahi, chiin.
ENGLISH: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the animals of the field also.

PAITE: Huan, Jawlnei Jeremiain jawlnei Hanania kiangah, Ngaiin, Hanania, TOUPAN nang a honsawl peuhmah kei hi: Hiai mite juau na muangsak lel ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah: Yahweh has not sent you; but you make this people to trust in a lie.
