ENGLISH: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

PAITE: A lei uh thalpeu bangin juauin a zang ua, gamah a khang lian ua, thutaka khang louin, gilou lamah a khang jel ua, kei honthei louin, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood; and they are grown strong in the land, but not for truth: for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don’t know me, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Noumau inveng lakah pilvang chiat unla, na unaute himhim uh muang kei un; unaute lah khemhat ahi ngal ua; invengte leng gensiat hat ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Take heed everyone of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go about with slanders.

PAITE: Amau inveng chiat a khem ding ua, thudik leng a gen kei ding uh; a lei uh juau gen a kisin sak ding ua, thulimlouhna semin a gim sek uhi.
ENGLISH: They will deceive everyone his neighbor, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies; they weary themselves to commit iniquity.

PAITE: Khemhat lakah na tenga, a khemna uh jiakin kei a honthei nuam kei uh, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: Your habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Huaijiakin sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaiun, amau ka tuisuak sak dia, ka zeet ding: ka mi, ka tanu jiakin bang dang ahia ka hih tak ding aw?
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?

PAITE: A lei uh sihna thal ahia, khemna thu a gen jel, min kamin a inveng kiangah kituahna thu gen mahleh, alungtang ah amah a tang giugiau sek hi.
ENGLISH: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart he lays wait for him.

PAITE: Hiai thilhihte jiakin ka gawt kei dia hia? chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi: nam hichibang tungah phu ka la kei dia hia?
ENGLISH: Shall I not visit them for these things? says Yahweh; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

PAITE: Tangte a dingin ka kap dia, ka mau vungvung ding, gamdai loupa munte ka sun dinga, kuamahpai nawn louhna dinga a kan khittak jiakin, gan husa miten a za nawnta kei ding ua, tunga leng vasate leh gamsate leng a taikek ua, a pai mangta uh.
ENGLISH: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none passes through; neither can men hear the voice of the livestock; both the birds of the sky and the animals are fled, they are gone.

PAITE: Huan Jerusalem bel thilsia om khawm lelin ka bawl sin, sehalte tenna mun ahi ding; Juda khopite tengmi om louin ka hihgawp ding.
ENGLISH: I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

PAITE: Hiai theisiam dingin mi pilpen kua ahi? Phuang dinga TOUPA thugen nasangmi pen kua ahi? Bangjiakin ahia gam a siat khita, kuamah pai louhna dinga gamdai banga a kat khit?
ENGLISH: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of Yahweh has spoken, that he may declare it? Why is the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that none passes through?

PAITE: Huan, TOUPAN, Ka dan, a ma ua ka koih a paisan ua, ka pau kamsuak a mang kei ua, a jui sam kei ua,
ENGLISH: Yahweh says, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein,

PAITE: a lungtang khauh uh juia, a pipute un a sinsak uh Baalte a delh jawktak jiak un;
ENGLISH: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them;

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPA, Israel Pathianin hichiin a chi: Ngaiun, amau, hiai mite mahmah gamsai in ka vak dinga, tui kha leng ka dawn sak ding.
ENGLISH: therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

PAITE: Nam, amau leh a pipute un leng a theih ngeilouhte lakah ka dalhsak dinga; ka hihmanthat vek mateng namsau ka delhsak ding.
ENGLISH: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known; and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.

PAITE: Sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngaihtuah unla, numei kap mite hongpai dingin sam un, numei khutsiamte hongpai ding in sam lai un.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for the skillful women, that they may come:

PAITE: Hongkin uhenla, hongkah khum peuhmah le uh, ka khitui a luana, i mitte ua tui a pawt theihna din.
ENGLISH: and let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

PAITE: Zion a kipan kah husa jak ahi ngala, i naksiat khit tak dan uh: gen ding i thei mahmah kei ua, i gam i paisan jiak uleh, i tennate a paihkhiaktak jiak un.
ENGLISH: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we ruined! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.

PAITE: Aw nou numeite aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia unla, a kamsuak thu na bil uah lut henla, natanute uh kah sinsak unla, mi chihin a invengnu kiangah sunna la.
ENGLISH: Yet hear the word of Yahweh, you women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters wailing, and everyone her neighbor lamentation.

PAITE: I tawlet uahte sihna kal lutin i kumpipa in uahte a lutta ngal a; inpo lama kipana naupang hihmang ding leh, kholak a kipan a tangval hihmang ding.
ENGLISH: For death has come up into our windows, it is entered into our palaces; to cut off the children from outside, and the young men from the streets.

PAITE: TOUPA thu pawtin hichiin a chi: Mi luangte gamlakah ekvut bangin a puk dinga, buh lami buh maih bangin; kuamahin a lakhawmta kei ding hi, chiin.
ENGLISH: Speak, Thus says Yahweh, The dead bodies of men shall fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester; and none shall gather them.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Mi pilin a pilna suang kei henla, mi hatin a hatna suang sam kei henla, mi hauin a sum leh pai suang sam kei heh.
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh, Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, don’t let the rich man glory in his riches;

PAITE: A suang peuhmahin hiai suang uheh, kei TOUPA, chitnate, vaihawmdiknate, diktatnate leia zang sekpa ka hi chih a hontheiha, a theihsiamna tak; hiai thilte lah ka kipahlam ahi ngala, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi.
ENGLISH: but let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, says Yahweh.

PAITE: Ngai un, nite a hongtung hi, chih TOUPA thu pawt ahi, zeksum hi ngal, sumlouh bang jaw ka gawt ding;Aigupta te, Juda te, Edom te, Amon tate leh Moab te leh gamdaia teng, baksam met giaute; nam tengtengte lah zeksumlouhte ahi ngal ua, Israel inkote tengteng leng lungtanga zeksumlouh ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will punish all those who are circumcised in uncircumcision:

PAITE: Aigupta te, Juda te, Edom te, Amon tate leh Moab te leh gamdaia teng, baksam met giaute; nam tengtengte lah zeksumlouhte ahi ngal ua, Israel inkote tengteng leng lungtanga zeksumlouh ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that have the corners of their hair cut off, who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.

PAITE: Khopi mitea dim sek, bangchidana lungjuanga tu maimah ahia: bangchidana meithai banga hongom maimah ahia! namte laka thupi seka, bialte laka lalnu sek, bangchidana a mengsawm honghi ahia!
ENGLISH: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become tributary!

PAITE: Janin nakpi takin a kapa, a khituite a biangah a om: a itte tengteng lakah amah nem ding kuamah a neikeia: a lawmte tengteng a tungah lepchiahtakin a gamta ua, a melmate a honghi uhi.
ENGLISH: She weeps bitterly in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; among all her lovers she has none to comfort her: All her friends have dealt treacherously with her; they are become her enemies.

PAITE: Gimthuakna jiak leh, saltanna thupi jiakin. Juda saltannaah a paita hi; khovelmite lakah a tenga, tawldamna a mu kei: munkochik ahte amah sawite tengtengin a pha uh.
ENGLISH: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude; she dwells among the nations, she finds no rest: all her persecutors overtook her within the straits.

PAITE: Kikhopna thupia kuamah a hongpai louh jiak un. Zion lampiten a sun ua; a kongpite tengteng loihin a oma, a siampute a thum huthut uh: a nungak siangthoute gimthuakin a om ua, amah mah haksa thuakin a om hi.
ENGLISH: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn assembly; all her gates are desolate, her priests do sigh: her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.

PAITE: A melmate lupen a hong hi a galte a lohching uh; a tatlekna tam luat jiakin Toupan lah amah gim a thuak sak ngala: gal maah a ta tuailaite saitanna ah a pai uh.
ENGLISH: Her adversaries are become the head, her enemies prosper; for Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her young children are gone into captivity before the adversary.

PAITE: Huan Zion tate akipanin a letna tengteng a pai mangta; a lalte loupa hing mu lou zuktalte bang ahi ua, a delhmi maah hatna neilouin a pai uh.
ENGLISH: From the daughter of Zion all her majesty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

PAITE: A gimthuak ni leh a haksatniin Jerusalemin ni dang laia kipana om khinsa a thil nuamte tengteng a theigige: gal khuta a mite a puk lai un, amah kuamahin a panpih kei, galten amah a mu ua, a siatnaah a nuihsan uhi.
ENGLISH: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old: when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her, The adversaries saw her, they mocked at her desolations.

PAITE: Nakpitakin Jerusalemin thil a hihkhiala; huaijiakin thil nin bangin a hongom hi: a vuaktanna a muh jiak un, amah zahtak sakten a musit ta uhi: ahi, a nak huthuta, nunglamah a kiheita hi.
ENGLISH: Jerusalem has grievously sinned; therefore she has become as an unclean thing; all who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yes, she sighs, and turns backward.

PAITE: A nitna a nik ah a oma; a beina na nung a theigige kei; huaijiakin lamdangtakin a hong kuma; lungmuang mi a neikei hi: ngaiin, Aw TOUPA, ka gimthuakna; melmapa lah kiliansak ngala.
ENGLISH: Her filthiness was in her skirts; she didn’t remember her latter end; therefore is she come down wonderfully; she has no comforter: see, Yahweh, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.

PAITE: Galin amahnu thil nuamte tengteng tungah a khut a jaka: a munsiangthou sungah khovelmi a honglut chih a mu ngala, huai tungtunga na kikhopna uah amau a honglut louh ding uh ahi chia thu na piak.
ENGLISH: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things: for she has seen that the nations are entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.

PAITE: A mite tengteng a nak huthut ua, tanghou a zong ua; kha hihhalh dingin a thil nuamte uh sa khenna dingin a pia ua: Thei inla, Aw TOUPA, enin ka hong buah jiakin.
ENGLISH: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for food to refresh the soul: look, Yahweh, and see; for I am become abject.

PAITE: Nou dinga bangmah lou hi maw, nou honpai suaksante teng teng? Ngai unla, en un, ka tunga hiha om ka lungkhamna bang lungkhamna himhim a om hiam? a heh mahmah laia TOUPAN a honhihgimna bang.
ENGLISH: Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, With which Yahweh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

PAITE: Tung sanga kipanin ka guhte ah mei a honsawla, amaute a zou a: ka khe adingin len a jaka, a honkinung lehheisan; segawp leh ni tuma bahin a honbawl ta hi.
ENGLISH: From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them; He has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: He has made me desolate and faint all the day.

PAITE: Ka tatleknate hakkol a khuta khihin a om a; phial khawmin a om ua, ka ngawng jangah a hongtung ua; ka hatna a vuaksuak sak: amau ka dou zoh louhte, a khut uah TOUPAN kei a honpia a.
ENGLISH: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand; They are knit together, they have come up on my neck; he has made my strength to fail: The Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.

PAITE: Ka laka ka mi hatte TOUPAN bangmahlouin a om sak; ka tangvalte mekgawpna dingin ka siatna dingin aman kikhoppi poimoh a sama: uain sukna bangin TOUPAN Juda tanu siangthou a sikdenta hi.
ENGLISH: The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men in the midst of me; He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men: The Lord has trodden as in a winepress the virgin daughter of Judah.

PAITE: Hiai thilte jiakin ka kapa; ka mit, tuiin a tumaa; lungmuanding ka kha hihhalh ding lah keia kipan a gam la ngala; melma a vualzoh jiakin, ka tate lah amau kiaa nutsiatin a om uhi.
ENGLISH: For these things I weep; my eye, my eye runs down with water; Because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me: My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.

PAITE: Zionin a khutte a jak khiaa; amah lungmuan ding kuamah a om kei uh; TOUPAN Jakob tungthu ah thu a piaa, huchia a kim vela omte a galte a honghihna ding un: Jerusalem a lak uah thil nin bangin a om hi.
ENGLISH: Zion spreads forth her hands; there is none to comfort her; Yahweh has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries: Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.

PAITE: Toupa a diktata: a thupiak lah ka helsan ngala; Ja un, ka hon ngen hi, nou mite tengteng, ka lungkhamna en un: ka nungaksiangthoute leh ka Tangvalte saltanna ah a pai uhi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow: My virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

PAITE: Ka itte ka sama, himahleh a honkhem uh: ka siampute leh ka upaten khopi sungah kha a khah uh, amau khate hihhalh dinga sa amau kizon ngalin.
ENGLISH: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, While they sought them food to refresh their souls.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, ngaiin; ka dah ngala; ka lungsim a mangbanga; ka sungah ka lungtang a kilumleta; nakpitakin lah ka helta ngala: polamah namsauin a thata, in ah sihna bang a om.
ENGLISH: See, Yahweh; for I am in distress; my heart is troubled; My heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: Abroad the sword bereaves, at home there is as death.

PAITE: Ka thum aja ua: kuamah hongkhamuan ding a om kei uh; ka mangbatna ka melmate tengtengin aja ua, ahihjiakin a kipak uh: na phuan khiaksa ni na tun dinga, kei bang ahi ding uh.A gitlouhna tengtenguh na maah hongtung hen: ka tatlekna tengteng jiaka ka tung na hih bangin amau tungah leng hihin: ka thumna lah a tama, ka lungtang lah a bah ngala.
ENGLISH: They have heard that I sigh; there is none to comfort me; All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that you have done it: You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they shall be like me.

PAITE: A gitlouhna tengtenguh na maah hongtung hen: ka tatlekna tengteng jiaka ka tung na hih bangin amau tungah leng hihin: ka thumna lah a tama, ka lungtang lah a bah ngala.
ENGLISH: Let all their wickedness come before you; Do to them, as you have done to me for all my transgressions: For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

PAITE: Bangchidana a hehna a TOUPAN Zion tanu meipia tuam ahia: Israel kilawmna van akipan leiah a paikhe ta a, a heh niin a khengakna a theigige kei hi.
ENGLISH: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast down from heaven to the earth the beauty of Israel, And hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

PAITE: Jakob tenna tengteng Toupana nawmvalha, a hehpih kei; a hehna ah Juda tanu kulh hatte a lai chima, lei toh a kilual in a koih hi; gam leh huaia lalte a hihninta.
ENGLISH: The Lord has swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and has not pitied: He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He has brought them down to the ground; he has profaned the kingdom and its princes.

PAITE: A heh mahmah naah Israel ki tengteng a sat tan; melma maa kipan a khut taklam a la kikta: mei kuang, kimvel hul bei bangin Jakob a kang beita.
ENGLISH: He has cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel; He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy: He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.

PAITE: Melma bangin a thalpeu a laia, gal bangin a khut taklam toh a ding, mita dinga etnop huaite tengteng a that: Zion tanu puanin ah mei bangin a thangpaihna a sung bua hi.
ENGLISH: He has bent his bow like an enemy, he has stood with his right hand as an adversary, Has killed all that were pleasant to the eye: In the tent of the daughter of Zion he has poured out his wrath like fire.

PAITE: TOUPA melma bang a hong hi, Israel a nawmvalh ta; a inpite tengteng a nawmvalh veka, a kulh muanhuaite a hihseta: Juda tanu ah sunna leh kahna a pungsak.
ENGLISH: The Lord has become as an enemy, he has swallowed up Israel; He has swallowed up all her palaces, he has destroyed his strongholds; He has multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

PAITE: Huan hileh kilawm bangin, a biakbuk hiamgamtakin a la manga; a kikhopna mun a suseta: TOUPAN kikhawm thupi leh khawlni Zion ah mangngilhin a omsaka, a hehna thangpaihna in kumpipa leh siampu a musit hi.
ENGLISH: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden; he has destroyed his place of assembly: Yahweh has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion, Has despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

PAITE: TOUPAN a maitam a paimanga, a munsiangthou a kiha, ainpi kulhbangte melmate khutah a peta hi: kikhop thupi ni bangin TOUPA in sungah belam a bawl uh.
ENGLISH: The Lord has cast off his altar, he has abhorred his sanctuary; He has given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces: They have made a noise in the house of Yahweh, as in the day of a solemn assembly.

PAITE: Zion tau kulhbang TOUPAN suksiat a tumta; khau a zana, suse lou dingin a khut ala kei hi: himahleh leichian leh kulhbang a kap saka; a kigawp tuaktuak uh.
ENGLISH: Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion; He has stretched out the line, he has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall to lament; they languish together.

PAITE: A kongpite leiah a tum ua; a kalhna chiangte a hihsia a a kuaitan hi: dan om louhna namte lakah a kumpipa leh a lalte a om uh; ahi, a jawlneiten Toupa akipan meng a mu kei uh.
ENGLISH: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars: Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; Yes, her prophets find no vision from Yahweh.

PAITE: Zion tanu upate leitungah a tu ua, a pau kei uh; a lu jang ua leivui a khi ua; saiippuan a silh uhi: Jerusalem nungaksiangthouten lei lamah a lu uh a kun uh.
ENGLISH: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground, they keep silence; They have cast up dust on their heads; they have clothed themselves with sackcloth: The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

PAITE: Khituiin a ka mitte a juaua, ka lungsim a mangbang, leitungah ka sin puak khiakin a oma, ka mite tanu siatna jiakin; khopi kongzingtea naupang tuailaite leh nawinelaite a sihbub jiak un.
ENGLISH: My eyes do fail with tears, my heart is troubled; My liver is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, Because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.

PAITE: A nute uh kiangah, Buhlehbal leh uain kaw om ahia? a chi ua. Khopi kongzingte miliamte banga a sihbub lai un, a nute uh ang sunga a kha uh sun buaka a om laiin.
ENGLISH: They tell their mothers, Where is grain and wine? When they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, When their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

PAITE: Na kiangah bang ka theisak dia? Nang toh bang ka teh dia, Aw Jeursalem tanu? Aw Zion tanu siangthou, kon lungmuang theihna ding in, nang toh bang ka kikim sak dia? na siatna lah tuipi bangin a thupi ngala: kuan nang a honhih dam thei dia?
ENGLISH: What shall I testify to you? what shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is great like the sea: who can heal you?

PAITE: Na jawlneiten bangmahlou leh haina nanga dingin mengmuhin a mu ua; na koltanna pi nawn dingin, na gitlouhna a mukhe kei uh: himahleh bangmahlou puakgik leh pimanga omna jiakte nang honmuh sak uh.
ENGLISH: Your prophets have seen for you false and foolish visions; They have not uncovered your iniquity, to bring back your captivity, but have seen for you false oracles and causes of banishment.

PAITE: Honpai kheng tengtengin nang a khut a uh a honbet khum ua; Jerusalem tanu a tek khum ua; a lu uh a kun khum uh, hiai khopi miten kilawmna buching, lei tengtenga nuamsakna, a chih uh ahi maw? chiin.
ENGLISH: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men called The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

ENGLISH: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you; They hiss and gnash the teeth; they say, We have swallowed her up; Certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.

PAITE: TOUPAN a lunggel a hihtangtungta nidang laia a thu a piak a hihtangtunga; a paita, a hehpih kei: na tunga melma a kipak saka, na galte ki a tawisangta a.
ENGLISH: Yahweh has done that which he purposed; he has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old; He has thrown down, and has not pitied: He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you; he has exalted the horn of your adversaries.

PAITE: TOUPA kiangah a lungtang a kikou a: Aw Zion tanu kulhbang, sun leh janin khitui luipi bangin luang suk sakin; khawl kipe kenla; na mit tang khawl sak ken.
ENGLISH: Their heart cried to the Lord: wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night; Give yourself no respite; don’t let the apple of your eye cease.

PAITE: Thou in, janin ki kouin, vente kipatnaah; TOUPA mai maah tui bangin na lungtang sung khiain; na ta tuailaite hinna adingin amah lamah na khutte lik touin. kong chiteng tunga gilkial jiak-a bah.
ENGLISH: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches; Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord: Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, that faint for hunger at the head of every street.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, en inla, ngaiin, hichibanga na hihna; numeiten a gah uh a ne ding uam, khuta oiha om naupangte? TOUPA munsiangthou sungah siampu leh jawlnei thaha om ding uh hia?
ENGLISH: Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Shall the women eat their fruit, the children that are dandled in the hands? Shall the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

PAITE: Kongzingte ah leitungah tuailaite leh putek a um ua; namsauin ka nungaksiangthoute leh ka Tangvalte a puk uh: na heh niin amaute na thata; na thata, na hehpih kei.Kikhawmpi thupi lai bangin, mun cihah ka launate na sama, TOUPA heh niin kuamah suakta hiam, om hiam a om kei uh: huai ka donteia ka khoilette lah ka melmain a gaita hi.
ENGLISH: The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword: You have killed them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered, and not pitied.

PAITE: Kikhawmpi thupi lai bangin, mun cihah ka launate na sama, TOUPA heh niin kuamah suakta hiam, om hiam a om kei uh: huai ka donteia ka khoilette lah ka melmain a gaita hi.
ENGLISH: You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side; There was none that escaped or remained in the day of Yahweh’s anger: Those that I have dandled and brought up has my enemy consumed.

PAITE: A hehna chianga gimthuakna mu mipa ka hi.
ENGLISH: I am the man that has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

PAITE: Khovak ah hilouin khovela aman a honpi a, a honvak sak.
ENGLISH: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

PAITE: Ni tumtumin ka siatna dingin a khut a hei ahei petmah hi.
ENGLISH: Surely against me he turns his hand again and again all the day.

PAITE: Ka sa leh ka vun a upa saka; ka guhte a kitansak.

PAITE: Ka siatna dingin a lama, khatna leh nauveinain a honum suak hia.
ENGLISH: He has built against me, and surrounded me with gall and travail.

PAITE: Sawtpia sisate bangin, mun mialte ah a honteng saka.
ENGLISH: He has made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

PAITE: Ka pawt khiak theihlouhna dingin, ka kimvelin dai a kaia, ka khainiang a gik hi.
ENGLISH: He has walled me about, that I can’t go forth; he has made my chain heavy.

PAITE: A hi, ka kaha, panpihna ka nget laiin, ka thumna a daltan.
ENGLISH: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

PAITE: Suang sekin ka lampite dai a kaitou peka, ka lam zuihte a kawisak hi.
ENGLISH: He has walled up my ways with cut stone; he has made my paths crooked.

PAITE: Kei dingin amah vompi mibuk bang, mun guka humpinelkai bang ahi.
ENGLISH: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.

PAITE: Ka lampite a kaiheia, a honbot nena; a hon bawlgawp hi.
ENGLISH: He has turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he has made me desolate.

PAITE: A thalpeu a laia, a thal adia ngimding bangin kei a honbawl.
ENGLISH: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

PAITE: A thalbawma thalte ka sisan guijamah a lut saka.
ENGLISH: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

PAITE: Ka mite tengteng nuihsat ka honghia; ni tumtuma a la uh.
ENGLISH: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.

PAITE: Hehnain a hondim sak ua, gamsaiin a honvak.
ENGLISH: He has filled me with bitterness, he has sated me with wormwood.

PAITE: Suang tangin ka hate leng a kitamsak a, vutin a hontuam hi.
ENGLISH: He has also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he has covered me with ashes.

PAITE: Muanna akipan gamla piah ka kha na suana; hauhsakna ka mangngilhta.
ENGLISH: You have removed my soul far off from peace; I forgot prosperity.

PAITE: Ka hatna a manga, TOUPA akipan ka lametna, ka chi a.
ENGLISH: I said, My strength is perished, and my expectation from Yahweh.

PAITE: Ka gimthuakna leh ka haksatna, gamsai leh khatna theigigein.
ENGLISH: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

PAITE: Ka khain amaute a theigige lailaia ka sungah a kun ngiungiau hi.
ENGLISH: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

PAITE: Hiai ka thei thaka, huaijiakin lametna ka nei.
ENGLISH: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.

PAITE: TOUPA chitnate jiak ahi hihmanga i om louhna uh, lainatnate a juau ngei louh jiakin.
ENGLISH: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.

ENGLISH: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

PAITE: TOUPA ka tantuan ahi, ka khain a chi; huaijiakin amah lametna ka nei ding.
ENGLISH: Yahweh is my portion, says my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

PAITE: Amah ngakte kiangah TOUPA a hoih, amah zong mi tungah.
ENGLISH: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul that seeks him.

PAITE: Min TOUPA hotdamna a lameta a ngak vengveng a hoih hi.
ENGLISH: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.

PAITE: Min a tuailaia hakkol a puak amaha dingin a hoih ahi.
ENGLISH: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

PAITE: Amah tunga a ngaktak jiakin, tangtut henla, dai sipsip hen.
ENGLISH: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

PAITE: Leivui ah a kam koih hen; huchia lametna a om theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.

PAITE: Amah bengpa kiangah a biang doh hen; kounain amah dim vum hen.
ENGLISH: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him; let him be filled full with reproach.

PAITE: TOUPAN lah khantawnin a delh kei dinga.
ENGLISH: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

PAITE: Dahna suak sak mahleh, a chitna tamdan dungjuiin lainatna a nei ding ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For though he cause grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

PAITE: Kilawptakin mite tate a hihgim hiam a lungkham sak lah ahi ngal kei a.
ENGLISH: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

PAITE: Leia suangkulh tangte tengteng khenuai sik kham ding.
ENGLISH: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

PAITE: Tungnung Pen mai maa mihing thuneihna kai hei ding.
ENGLISH: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

PAITE: A thu mihing bawlsiat, TOUPAN pha a sa kei.
ENGLISH: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

PAITE: TOUPAN thu a piak louhin, hichi a honghi, chi kua ahia?
ENGLISH: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

PAITE: Tungnung Pen kama kipanin hoih lou leh hoih a hongpai kei maw/
ENGLISH: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

PAITE: Bangdinga mihing, a khelhna gawtna a dinga mi, phun ahia?
ENGLISH: Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

PAITE: I lampite zongin enchain ni, TOUPA lamah kik nawn ni.
ENGLISH: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.

PAITE: Vantea Pathian kiangah I lungtang uh I khutte uh lik tou ni:
ENGLISH: Let us lift up our heart with our hands to God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” in the heavens.

PAITE: Ka tatlek ua ka hel uh; na ngaidam kei hi.
ENGLISH: We have transgressed and have rebelled; you have not pardoned.

PAITE: Hehnain na khuha kou non delha; na thata, na hehpih kei.
ENGLISH: You have covered with anger and pursued us; you have killed, you have not pitied.

PAITE: Meipiin na kituama, huchia ka thumnain a pailet louhna dingin.
ENGLISH: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

PAITE: Mite lakah deihlouh leh ninneng bangin na honbawla.
ENGLISH: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.

PAITE: Ka siatna dingin ka melmate tengteng un a kam uh lianpiin a ka uh.
ENGLISH: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

PAITE: Launa leh kokhuk ka tunguah a hongtunga, siatgawpna leh siatna.
ENGLISH: Fear and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.

PAITE: Ka mite tanu suksiatna jiakin, ka mit tuiin a tum hi.
ENGLISH: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

PAITE: Khawllouin, ka mitin a buaka, a khawl kei hi.
ENGLISH: My eye pours down, and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

PAITE: Vana kipana TOUPAN a et suka, muh ma tan
ENGLISH: Until Yahweh look down, and see from heaven.

PAITE: Ka khopi tanute tengteng jiakin ka mitin ka kha a dah sak.
ENGLISH: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

PAITE: Vasa bangin hondelh bah ua, ajiak beia ka melma hiten.
ENGLISH: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

PAITE: Leikohawm sungah ka hinna a sat tat ua, ka tungah suang a khia uh.
ENGLISH: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

PAITE: Ka lutung ah tuite a luanga; sat khiakin ka om, ka chi hi.
ENGLISH: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, leikohawm niampen akipanin, na min ka sam hi.
ENGLISH: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.

PAITE: Ka aw na jaa; ka kahna ah, ka nakna ah na bil sel ken.
ENGLISH: You heard my voice; don’t hide your ear at my breathing, at my cry.

PAITE: Nang ka honsap niin nong pai naia: Lau ken, na chi hi.
ENGLISH: You drew near in the day that I called on you; you said, Don’t be afraid.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, ka kha thu na hon gen saka; ka hinna na tanta.
ENGLISH: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul; you have redeemed my life.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, ka diklouhna na mu a, ka thu ngaihtuahin.
ENGLISH: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

PAITE: Ka tunga a phulakna tengteng uh leh a thusawm tengteng uh na muta hi.
ENGLISH: You have seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.

PAITE: A kouna uh na jaa, Aw TOUPA, ka siatna dinga a thusawm tengteng uh;
ENGLISH: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their devices against me,

PAITE: Ka siatna dinga ding te mukte leh, ni tumtuma ka siatna dinga a ngaihtuahna uh.
ENGLISH: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

PAITE: a tu uh leh a din touh uh nang enin; a la uh ka hi.
ENGLISH: You see their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, a khut nasep uh dungjuiin, amau tungah thukna na pe ding hi.
ENGLISH: You will render to them a recompense, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.

PAITE: Lungtang sakna amau na pe ding a, a tung ua na hamsia.Hehin amau na delh dinga TOUPA vante nuaia kipan amaute na hihgawp ding.
ENGLISH: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

PAITE: Hehin amau na delh dinga TOUPA vante nuaia kipan amaute na hihgawp ding.
ENGLISH: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.

PAITE: Bangchidana dangkaeng mial ahia! bangchidana dangkaeng siangthou penpen lamdangta ahia! Kongzing chiteng tungah munsiangthou suangte sunkhiak ahi.
ENGLISH: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

PAITE: Zion tapa manphate, dangkaeng hoih toh tehpih theih, bangchidana leibel, belvelmi khutnasepbanga ngaih hita ahia!
ENGLISH: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, How are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

PAITE: Sehalte nasanin a nawi uh a suah ua, ata tuailaite uh a tepsak uh: ka mite tanu jaw honggiloua, gamdai vasa mulneilou bangin.
ENGLISH: Even the jackals draw out the breast, they nurse their young ones: The daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

PAITE: Nawitep lai naupang lai dangtak jiakin a kam dangtawngah a belha: naupang tuailaiten tanghou a ngen ua, amah dingin kuamahin a balkham kei uh.
ENGLISH: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst: The young children ask bread, and no man breaks it to them.

PAITE: Nuam taka nete kongzing khawngah a mangthang uh: puansandupa khanglianten ekvut a kawi uh.
ENGLISH: Those who fed delicately are desolate in the streets: Those who were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

PAITE: Ka mite tanu gitlouhna lah Sodom khelhna sangin a thupizo ngala, huai bel mitphiat kallouin a kizoua, amah tungah khut a kinga kei hi.
ENGLISH: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, That was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands were laid on her.

PAITE: A miliante vuk sangin a siangthou jaw ua, nawitui sangin a ngou jaw uh, suangmantam sandup sangin a pumpi uah a sandup jaw ua, a tetna uh a saphir suangmantam bang ahi:
ENGLISH: Her nobles were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk; They were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was as of sapphire.

PAITE: A mel uh suangkuangthei sangin a vom jaw a: kongzingtea theihin a om kei uh: a vun uh a guh uah a belh bikbeka; a keua, chiangkang a bang.
ENGLISH: Their appearance is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: Their skin clings to their bones; it is withered, it has become like a stick.

PAITE: Namsaua thaha om dingte kiala thaha om dingte sangina hoihjaw uh; gama gahte duh jiakin hiaite lah a gawng gawp un, nakpiin a se khin uh.
ENGLISH: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, for want of the fruits of the field.

PAITE: Hehpihthei numei khutten amau tate a huan ua, ka mite tanu hihsiatna ah a an uh ahi.
ENGLISH: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children; They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

PAITE: TOUPAN a thangpaihna a hihpichingta, a hehna mahmah a sung khiaa; Zion ah mei a toha, huaiin huaia suangphumte a suse vek hi.
ENGLISH: Yahweh has accomplished his wrath, he has poured out his fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.

PAITE: Leia kumpipaten a um kei ua, khovel a tengtengin leng, Jerusalem kongpi sungah gal leh melma a lut ding uh chih.
ENGLISH: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither all the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

PAITE: A jawlneite khelhna jiak leh a siampute ginatlouhna jiak ahi, huchibanga a lak taka midikte sisan suah a a om.
ENGLISH: It is because of the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.

PAITE: Mitto mite bangin kongzing khawngah a vakvai ua, sisana suknitin a om ua, huchiin miten a puante uh a lawng kei uh.
ENGLISH: They wander as blind men in the streets, they are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.

PAITE: Pai mang un, Nin! pai mang un, pai mang un, lawng kei un, chiin amau a kikou khum ua: a tai mang ua, a vialvak lai un, miten namte lakah, hiai ah a om nawn kei ding uh, a chi uh.
ENGLISH: Depart! they cried to them, Unclean! depart, depart, don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, They shall not live here any more.

PAITE: TOUPA hehnain amaute a hawmjaka; amaute a limsak nawnta kei ding: siampute mina a zahtak kei ua, upate a deihsak kei uh.
ENGLISH: The anger of Yahweh has scattered them; he will no more regard them: They didn’t respect the persons of the priests, they didn’t favor the elders.

PAITE: I mitte I panpihna juau sosan lametna ah a vaikhina: I ngakna uah nam hondam theilou ding I na ngak ta ua.
ENGLISH: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help: In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

PAITE: I kongzingte ua i pai theih louhna dingin, I kalsuante a zong ua: I tawp uh a naia, I nite a kimta: I tawp uh lah a hongtungta.
ENGLISH: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets: Our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end has come.

PAITE: Vana muvanlaite sangin ei hondelhte a man-gangjaw uh: mual tungahte a hon delh ua, gamdaiah a honna buak uh.
ENGLISH: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky: They chased us on the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

PAITE: I nakvangte hu, TOUPA thaunilh, a kokhuk ua lakin a om ua; amah thu genin. Alim nuaia namte lakah hing ding, I chi ua.
ENGLISH: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; Of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the nations.

PAITE: Nuamsa inla kipakin Aw Edom tanu. Uz gama teng: nou lah nang phain leng a hongpai suak ding; na kham dinga vuaktangin na kibawl ding.Aw zion tanu, na thulimlouhna gawtna zoh a hita; saltanna ah nang a honpi mang nawnta kei ding: na thulimlouhna a hongveh ding, Aw Edom tanu; na khelhnate a mukhe dinghi
ENGLISH: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, that dwell in the land of Uz: The cup shall pass through to you also; you shall be drunken, and shall make yourself naked.

PAITE: Aw zion tanu, na thulimlouhna gawtna zoh a hita; saltanna ah nang a honpi mang nawnta kei ding: na thulimlouhna a hongveh ding, Aw Edom tanu; na khelhnate a mukhe dinghi
ENGLISH: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion; he will no more carry you away into captivity: He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom; he will uncover your sins.

PAITE: Theigigein, Aw TOUPA, ka tung ua hongtung: a honkouna uh en inla, muin.
ENGLISH: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us: Look, and see our reproach.

PAITE: Ka gouluah uh mikhualte lama heiiin a oma, ka inte uh gamdangmite lamah.
ENGLISH: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, Our houses to aliens.

PAITE: Tagah leh pabei ka hi ua, ka nute uh meithaite bang ahi uh.
ENGLISH: We are orphans and fatherless; Our mothers are as widows.

ENGLISH: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold to us.

PAITE: A hondelhte ka ngawng jang uah a om ua, ka bah ua, khawlna ka neikei uh.
ENGLISH: Our pursuers are on our necks: We are weary, and have no rest.

PAITE: Aiguptate kiang leh, Assuriate kiangah, Tanghoua lungkimna dingin ka kipia uh.
ENGLISH: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, To the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

PAITE: Ka pipute uh a nakhial ua, aom kei uh; a gitlouhna uh kou ka pua uh.
ENGLISH: Our fathers sinned, and are no more; We have borne their iniquities.

PAITE: Sikhaten ka tunguah vai a hawm ua: a khut ua kipana kou hon tankhe ding kuamah a om kei uh.
ENGLISH: Servants rule over us: There is none to deliver us out of their hand.

PAITE: Ka hinna uh lauthawnna toh ka tanghou uh ka mu ua gamdai namsau jiakin.

ENGLISH: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.

ENGLISH: Princes were hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honored.

PAITE: Tangvalten khawl a pua ua, naupang te singnuaiah a kisui uh.

PAITE: Kongpi akipan upate a khawl ua, a lasakna ua kipanin Tangvalte a khawl uh.
ENGLISH: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.

PAITE: Ka lungtang kipahna uh a tawpa; ka lamnauh dahna a suak hi.
ENGLISH: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.

PAITE: Ka lu ua kipan ka lallukhu uh a kiaa, ka tung uh a gik hi! ka khelh jiakun.
ENGLISH: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe to us! for we have sinned.

PAITE: Hiai jiakin ka lungtang uh a baha; hiai thilte jiakin ka mitte uh a miala;
ENGLISH: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim;

PAITE: Suksiatna om, Zion mual jiakin; sehalte a tungah a vak uh.
ENGLISH: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: The foxes walk on it.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA, nang khantawnin na om gige; na laltutphah khang khata kipanin khang khat tanin a om hi.
ENGLISH: You, Yahweh, remain forever; Your throne is from generation to generation.

PAITE: Bangdinga khantawna kou honmanngilha, hichi tantan honnungngatsan na hia?
ENGLISH: Why do you forget us forever, And forsake us so long time?

PAITE: Nang lam hon ngasakin, Aw TOUPA huchiin bawlhoih nawnin ka om ding uh; nidang lai bangin ka nite uh thaksakin.Ahihkeileh non nialkhe hilhiala hia? Ka tunguah na heh lomahmaha hia?
ENGLISH: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we shall be turned. Renew our days as of old.

ENGLISH: But you have utterly rejected us; You are very angry against us.

PAITE: Juda kumpiap Jehiokim vaihawm kum thum kumin Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar Jerusalem ah a honga, a om a
ENGLISH: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Jerusalem, and besieged it.

ENGLISH: The Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” ; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god: and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

PAITE: Huan kumpipan a michilgehte heutupa Aspenaz, Israel tate laka kuate hiam, kumpi chite a kipan leh milian te akipan honpi dingin a kiangah thu a gena;

ENGLISH: youths in whom was no blemish, but well-favored, and skillful in all wisdom, and endowed with knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

PAITE: Huchiin kumpipan amau ni teng tantuan dingin kumpipan an akipan leh a dawn uain akipanin a sehsaka, huchia kum thum vakthaua a om theihna ding un; huchia huai bei chianga kumpipa maa a din theihna ding un.
ENGLISH: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s dainties, and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years; that at its end they should stand before the king.

PAITE: Huchiin hiaite lakah, Juda tate akipan, Daniel te, Hanania te, Misael te, leh Azaria te a om ua.
ENGLISH: Now among these were, of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

PAITE: Huan michilgehte lalpan amau kiangah minte a pia a; Danial kiangah Beltesazar min a piaa; Hanania kiangah, Sadrak; huan Misael kiangah, Mesak; huan, Azaria kiangah, Abed-nego.
ENGLISH: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abednego.
