ENGLISH: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.

PAITE: Israel ka sukdam chiangin, huaichiangin Ephraim thulimlouhna muhkhiak ahi, Samari gitlouhna toh; juauthei lah ahi ngal ua: huan, guta a luta, a po lamah suamhat pawlten a lok uh.
ENGLISH: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.

PAITE: A gitlouhna tengteng uh ka theigige chih a lungtangte un a ngaihtuah kei uh: tuin amau thilhihte ngeiin amaute a kainok hi; ka mai maah a om uh.
ENGLISH: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.

PAITE: A gitlouhna un a kumpipa uh a kipaksak ua, a juau un a lal uh.
ENGLISH: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

PAITE: A vek un angkawmte ahi uh; banghiam kangmiin silngouin a zelh suah masiah, tangbuang mekman jiaka mei sawn a tawp san thuk bang.
ENGLISH: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

PAITE: I kumpipa uh niin lalte uain sain amau leh amau a kichinasak ua; simmohhatte toh a khut a zankhia.
ENGLISH: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

PAITE: Mi a buk malam un, thuk bangin a lungtang uh lah mansain a bawl ngal ua; jankhuain a hehna uh a ama jingsangin meikuang bangin a kuang hi.
ENGLISH: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their baker sleeps all the night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

PAITE: Thuk bangin a sa vek ua, a vaihawmmite uh a negai uh; a kumpipa tengteng uh a pukta uh: kei lama hongpatau kua mah a om kei uhi.
ENGLISH: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.

PAITE: Ephraim, mite lakah a kidiaha; Ephraim lumlehlouh tanghou beu ahi.
ENGLISH: Ephraim, he mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

PAITE: Mikhualten hatna a gai ua, aman a theikei: ahi, a tung koilailai hiamah mulkang a om, a theikei hi.
ENGLISH: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.

PAITE: Huan, Israel kisaktheihnain a mai ah thu a gen hi: hinapiin lah TOUPA a Pathian lamah a kihei kei ua, hiai tengteng jiakin, amah lah a zong kei uh.
ENGLISH: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.

PAITE: Huan, Ephraim vakhu hai bang, theihsiamna bei ahi; Aigupta lam a sam ua, Assuria kiangah a pai uh.
ENGLISH: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

PAITE: A pai chiang un, a tunguah ka len ka jak ding; vana vasate bangin amau ka kaikhe suk ding: ka sawi dinga, a kikhawmpi un a jaksa bang un.
ENGLISH: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

PAITE: A tung uh a gik hi: kei akipanin a tamvakta ngal ua; a tunguah siatna: ka tungah a talekta ngal ua: a maute tat ut leng leng, ka siatna dingin juau a genta uhi.
ENGLISH: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

PAITE: A lungtang utoh ka kiang lamah a kap kei ua, a lupna tunguah achiau zosop uh: buhlehbal leh uain zongin a kikaikhawm ua, a tungah a hel uh.
ENGLISH: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

PAITE: A khut uh sinsakin hatsakta mahleng, ka siatna dingin a ngaihtuah uhi.A kik ua, himahleh tungsanga ompa kiangah ahi kei; thalpeu gilou bang ahi uh: a lei hehna jiakin namsauin a lalte uh a puk ding uh: Aigupta gamah hiai nuihsana a omna uh ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

PAITE: A kik ua, himahleh tungsanga ompa kiangah ahi kei; thalpeu gilou bang ahi uh: a lei hehna jiakin namsauin a lalte uh a puk ding uh: Aigupta gamah hiai nuihsana a omna uh ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.

PAITE: Na kam a pengkul bulhin, muvanlai bangin TOUPA inko dou dingin a hong hi: ka thukhun tunga a tatlek ua, ka dan tunga a tatlek jiak un.
ENGLISH: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over Yahweh’s house, because they have broken my covenant, and rebelled against my law.

PAITE: Ka Pathian, nang kou Israelin kon thei uh, chiin, kei lamah a kikou ding uh.
ENGLISH: They cry to me, ‘My God, we Israel acknowledge you!’

PAITE: Israel in a hoih a pai khe ta: melmain amah a delh ding.
ENGLISH: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.

PAITE: Kumpipate a tungkhia ua, himahleh keiin hilouin; lalte a bawl ua, ken ka theikei: a dangka uleh a dangkaeng un milimte a bawl ua, sat khiaka a om theihna ding un.
ENGLISH: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.

PAITE: Aw Samari, na bawngnou a sat kheta; amaute tungah ka hehna a sou: hoihna a tun ma un bangtan hi ding ahia?
ENGLISH: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?

PAITE: Israel akipanin hiai nangawn lah a om ngala: nasemmiin a bawlta, Pathian ahi kei: ahi, Samari bawngnou a kitam jan ding.
ENGLISH: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

PAITE: Huih a tuh ua, pingpei a at ngal ua: buhlehbal dinglai a neikei; a vuiin an a suah kei hi; huchi a hihleh suah hen, mikhualten a nawmvalh khin ding uh.
ENGLISH: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.

PAITE: Israel nawmval khitin a om: kipahna om louhna bel bangin tuin namte lakah a om uhi.
ENGLISH: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.

PAITE: Gam sabengtung a tangom bangin, Assuria juanin lah a pai tou ngal ua:
ENGLISH: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.

PAITE: Ephraim itmite a guaita. A hi, namte laka guai mah le uh, amaute tuin ka kaikhawm ding; huan lalte kumpipa puakgik jiakin a kiam panta uhi.
ENGLISH: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.

PAITE: Khial dinga Ephraimin maitamte a punsak tak jiakin, amaha din maitamte khelhna ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.

PAITE: Amah adingin ka dan thuseh sangsawmin gelh mahleng leng, thil lamdang banga simin a om uhi.
ENGLISH: I wrote for him the many things of my law; but they were regarded as a strange thing.

PAITE: Ka thillatte kithoihna thu a hihleh, sain a kithoih ua a ne uh; himahleh TOUPAN huaite a sang kei hi: tuin a gitnatlouna uh a theigige dinga, a khelhnate uh a veh ding; Aigupta ah a kik ding uhi.Israelin a bawlpa a mangngilhtaa mun sangte lah a lamta ngal hi: himahleh a khopite tungah mei ka sawl dinga, huaia kulhpite a hulmang ding hi.
ENGLISH: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it; But Yahweh doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.

PAITE: Israelin a bawlpa a mangngilhtaa mun sangte lah a lamta ngal hi: himahleh a khopite tungah mei ka sawl dinga, huaia kulhpite a hulmang ding hi.
ENGLISH: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”

PAITE: Nuamsain kipak hen, aw Israel, mite bangin; Pathian akipanin kijuakin na omkhinta ngala, phual tung tengah goihman na itta hi.
ENGLISH: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.

PAITE: Phual leh uain suknaten amau a vak kei dinga, uain thakin amah a juausan ding.
ENGLISH: The threshing floor and the winepress won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.

PAITE: TOUPA gamah a teng kei ding ua; himahleh Ephraim Aigupta ah a kik ding, Assuria ah an sianglou a ne ding uh.
ENGLISH: They won’t dwell in Yahweh’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.

PAITE: TOUPA kiangah uain thillatte a sungkhe kei ding ua, amaha dingin lungkimhuai ahi sam kei ding uh: a kithoihnate uh amaua dingin sungmite tnaghou bang ahi ding; huai ne tengteng hihnitin a om ding uh: a tanghou uh lah a gilkialna uh ading ahi ngala; TOUPA in sungah a hongpai kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: They won’t pour out wine offerings to Yahweh, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into the house of Yahweh.

PAITE: Kikhawmpi chik niin bang na hih ding ua, TOUPA ankuang lui niin?
ENGLISH: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Yahweh?

PAITE: Ngai un, Assuria ah a pai ding uh; Aiguptain amau a khawm ding, Memphisin amau a vui ding. Dang kaa bawl a gou manphate uh lahouin a nei ding; a puaninte uah lingte a om ding.
ENGLISH: For, behold, they have gone away from destruction. Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.

PAITE: Vehna nite a hongtung, thukna nite a hongtung; Israelin a thei ding hi jawlnei mi hai ahi, kha nei mi hai ahi, na thuginatlouhna a tam mahmah jiakin, leh muhdahna a thupi jiakin.
ENGLISH: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.

PAITE: Ephraim Pathian galvilmi ahi; jawlnei tungtang a hihleh a lampi tengtengah thangkampa thang a oma, a Pathian in ah muhdahna.
ENGLISH: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.

PAITE: Gibeah nitea bangin, nakpiin amau leh amau a kihihsia ua: a thulimlouhna uh a theigige dinga, a khelh nate uh a kan ding hi.
ENGLISH: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.

PAITE: Gamdaia grepte bangin Israel ka mua; theipi kung a hun masapenlaia min masa bangin na pipute uh ka muta; himahleh Baal-peor ah a hong ua, thil zumhuai lamah a kipumpiak ua, a thil it uh bang in kihhuai a honghita uh.
ENGLISH: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.

PAITE: Ephraim a hihleh, vasa bangin a thupina uh a leng mang ding: pianna a om kei dinga, kuamah nau toh, naupaina toh.
ENGLISH: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, none with child, and no conception.

PAITE: A tate uh khoi lian mahle uh, amau ka tansak dinga, pichinga hawi a om kei ding: ahi, amau akipana ka pai khiakna dingte tung leng a gik hi:
ENGLISH: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!

PAITE: Ephraim, Tura ka muhsa bangin, mun nuama phuhin a om: himahleh Ephraimin a tate thatmi kiangah a honpi khe ding.
ENGLISH: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.

PAITE: Aw TOUPA amau piain; bang na pe dia? sul naupai theilou leh nawi kang.
ENGLISH: Give them—Yahweh what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

PAITE: A gitlouhna tengteng uh Gilgal ah a om; huailaiah amau ka mudahta ngala; a thilhihte uh gitlouh jiakin ka in akipan amau ka delh khe ding: Ka it nawn kei dinga; a lalte tengteng uh mihel ahi uh.
ENGLISH: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.

PAITE: Ephraim satin a om, a zung uh a keu, gah a suang kei ding uh; a jhi, suang mahleh uh, a sul gah it uh ka that himhim ding.Ka Pathianin amau a pai mang-dinga, amah a ngaihkhiak louh jiak uh; huchiin namte lakah vakvaiin a om ding uh.
ENGLISH: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they bring forth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”

PAITE: Ka Pathianin amau a pai mang-dinga, amah a ngaihkhiak louh jiak uh; huchiin namte lakah vakvaiin a om ding uh.
ENGLISH: My God will cast them away, because they did not listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.

PAITE: Juda kumpipa Jotham te, Ahaz te, Hezekia te lal laia Moreseth mi Mika kianga TOUPA thu hongtung, Samari khua leh Jerusalem kho tungtang thu-a amuh.
ENGLISH: The word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

PAITE: Nou chite aw, na vek un ja unla: aw lei leh a sunga om tengteng aw, ngaikhia un: TOUPA PATHIAN, TOUPA a biakin siangthou akipanin, nou hondemin na tung thu theipa hi heh.
ENGLISH: Hear, you peoples, all of you. Listen, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

PAITE: Ngai dih ua. TOUPA a mun akipan in a hongpawta, a hongpai suk dinga, lei mun sangte a chil ngal sina.
ENGLISH: For, behold, Yahweh comes forth out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

PAITE: Mei kiang china khuainun bang leh mun kena tui kikhoh khia bang maiin, tangte a nuaiah a zul dinga, guamte a khang tat ding.
ENGLISH: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.

PAITE: hiaite tengteng Jakobte tatlekna jiak leh Israel inkote khelhna jiak ahi. Jakobte tatlekna bang ahia oi? Samari ahi kei maw? Juda mun sangte bang ahia? Jerusalem ahi kei maw?
ENGLISH: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?

PAITE: huaijiakin Samari bel gama thil se om khawm bangin ka bawl dinga. grep huan mun bang maiin: huan, huailai muna suangte lui guam lamah ka khuk khe dinga, suangphumte ka dawksak ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

PAITE: A milim siam tawm tengteng sukkhap vek ahi dinga, a kijuakna mante meia hal mang ahi dinga, a milim tengteng ka hihgawp ding: kijuakna man ding in a la vek ngala, ki juakna man mahin a pang nawn ding uh.
ENGLISH: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, and all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and all her images I will destroy; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”

PAITE: Hiai jiakin ka kap dinga, ka mau vongvong dinga, kisuah leh vuaktangin ka om ding: sehalte bangin ka kihou dinga, vangawnsaute bang in ka thum ding hi.
ENGLISH: For this I will lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will howl like the jackals, and moan like the daughters of owls.

PAITE: A liamna hihdam theih ahi kei: Juda gam a tungta ngala: ka mite kongpi, Jerusalem hial leng a tung hi.
ENGLISH: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

PAITE: Gath khua ah gen unlam kap het kei un; Beth-le-aphra khuaah leivui ah ka kitholhta ahi.
ENGLISH: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah Beth Ophrah means literally “House of Dust.” I have rolled myself in the dust.

PAITE: Aw Saphir mi, vaktang leh zum tak in pai mang in: Zaanan mi a hongpawt kei; Betezel kahna in nang a hon din tuh ding.
ENGLISH: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.

PAITE: Maroth miin tan hoih tan a ngaklah tuntun hi, TOUPA kianga kipan thil hoih lou Jerusalem kongpi chin tana a hongtun suk jiakin.
ENGLISH: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.

PAITE: Aw Lakis mi, kangtalai sakol hattak hen den in: amah pen Zion tanu khelhna kipatna ahi. Israelte tatlekna lah nanga muh ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; For the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

PAITE: Huaijiakin Moreseth-gat kiangah kikhakna thilpiak na piak ding ahi: Akzib inte Israel am kumpipate a din khemna ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.

PAITE: Aw maresa mi, nang honzoutu na kiang ah konpi ding: Israelte thupina Adullam phain a hongpai ding.Kimet giau inla, na ta deihtakte jiakin kimet giau in: musane bang in kihihgiau semsemin; na kianga kipana sala piin lah a omta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: I will yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

PAITE: Kimet giau inla, na ta deihtakte jiakin kimet giau in: musane bang in kihihgiau semsemin; na kianga kipana sala piin lah a omta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture; for they have gone into captivity from you!

PAITE: A lupna t ung ua thulimlouhna gelmite leh thil hoiholou ngaihtuah khemite a tung a gik hi: jingsanga khua a vakin huai lah a hih jel jiakin.
ENGLISH: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

PAITE: Mi loute a eng ua, a lak sak ua; inte a eng ua, lak leng a la mai jel uh: mi leh a inkote uh. mi leh a gou tan un a nuaisiah uhi.
ENGLISH: They covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

PAITE: Huaijiakin TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Ngai dih, hiai inko tungah thil hoih lou ka gel ahi, huai akipanin na ngawng uh na suan kei ding ua, kisathei tak in pai nawnsam kei ding uh; hun hoih lou ahi sin ngala.
ENGLISH: Therefore thus says Yahweh: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily; for it is an evil time.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin nou dem in gentehna thu a bawl ding ua, kah la kha siathuaia samin, Loh veka om i hi uh; ka mite tan a hihlamdanga; ka kiang akipan a kisuanta ahi; hel hatmite kiangah i lou uh a hawm jak ta hi, a chi ding uh.
ENGLISH: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”

PAITE: Huaijiakin TOUPA mite kikhomte lak ah aisana khaua teh sakmi kuamah na neikei ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the assembly of Yahweh.

PAITE: Thu gen kei un, chiin a gen jel ua, Hiai mite kiangah thu a gen kei ding uh: gen siatna a dai kei ding.
ENGLISH: “Don’t prophesy!” They prophesy. “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

PAITE: Aw Jakob inkote aw, TOUPA kha nehchihin a om ahia? hiaite a thilhih ahi hia, chih ding ahi maw? Dik taka om jel mi tungah ka thuten thil hoih a hih kei maw?
ENGLISH: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob: “Is the Spirit of Yahweh angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”

PAITE: Himahleh ka mite tu chinin melma bangin a hong ding khia uhi: kidou ut loua galmuang taka mi vialvakte lak akipanin a puansilh puannaktualte uh na suah sak ua.
ENGLISH: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.

PAITE: Ka mi numeite a in nuam tak ua kipanin na delh khia ua; a naupang noute ua kipanin ka thupina a la mang den uhi.
ENGLISH: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.

PAITE: Thou unla, pai mang un; hiai lah khawlna munh ding ahi ngal keia; siatna thupi tak tana hihse sek buahna a om jiakin.
ENGLISH: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.

PAITE: Mimal neilou leh diklou pia, Uain leh zu thu na kiang ah ka honhilh ding, chia min juau a gen leh hiai mite jawlnei ahi lel ding.
ENGLISH: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies: “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink”; he would be the prophet of this people.

PAITE: Aw Jakobte, na vek un ka sam khawm ngei dinga; Israel mi om sunte ka pi khawm ngei ding; Bozra kho belam bangin ka koihkhawm ding: gan hon a loupa mun ua om bang maiin, mipi a hih jiak un achiak vengvung ding uh.Phu pailetpa a ma uah a paia; a phu pai let ua, kongkhak phain a pai jel ua, huaiah a pai khia uhi: huan, a kumpipa uh a ma uah a paia, TOUPAN a ma uh a kai.
ENGLISH: I will surely assemble, Jacob, all of you; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the midst of their pasture; they will swarm with people.

PAITE: Phu pailetpa a ma uah a paia; a phu pai let ua, kongkhak phain a pai jel ua, huaiah a pai khia uhi: huan, a kumpipa uh a ma uah a paia, TOUPAN a ma uh a kai.
ENGLISH: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. And their king passes on before them, with Yahweh at their head.

PAITE: Aw nou Jakobte heutute leh Israel inko vaikhawmmite aw, Ngaikhia unla, ka honngen ahi, k a chi ahi: vaihawm dan na theih ding uh hilou hia?
ENGLISH: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

PAITE: Thil hoih na hua ua, thil hoih lou na deih ua, a vun uh na hawk sak ua, a guh ua kipanin sa na leu khia ua:
ENGLISH: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

PAITE: Ka mite sa na nei lai ua; a vun uh na lip ua, a guh uh na hihtan sak ua: ahi, bela huan ding bangin na at nen ua, sa-uina bel sunga sa at nen bang maiin.
ENGLISH: who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

PAITE: Huai hun chiangin TOUPA a sam ding ua, himahleh amau a dawng kei ding: ahi, huai hun chiangin a thilhih ua a hih hoihloudan bang bang un, amau akipan a mai a sel ding.
ENGLISH: Then they will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”

PAITE: Ka mite hihkhialsakmi, hai a neih ua, Muanna chia kikoua, a kam ua bak loumi peuhmah do dia kisa hial mi jawlneite tungtang thu TOUPAN hichiin a chi:
ENGLISH: Thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets who lead my people astray; for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:

PAITE: Huaijiakin kilakna na neih louhna ding un na kiangah jan a hongtung ding; ai na san theihlouhna ding un na kiang uah mialna a hongom dinga; jawlneite adingin niin mual a khum dinga, sun leng a mau tungah kho mial ahi ding.
ENGLISH: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

PAITE: Mutheimite a zum ding ua, aisansiamte a zahlak ding uh, ahi, a vek un a muk uh a hum ding uh: Pathian dawnna lah a om ngal kei a,
ENGLISH: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer from God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” .”

PAITE: Himahleh Jakobte kiangah a tatlekna uh theisak ding leh Israelte kiangah a khelhna uh theisak dingin TOUPA kha jiaka thilhihtheihna te, vaihawm na te, leh hatna tein ka dim petmah ahi.
ENGLISH: But as for me, I am full of power by the Spirit of Yahweh, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.

PAITE: Nou Jakobte inkote heutte leh Israel inko vaihawmmi, vaihawmna kiha, dikna chiteng lumlet mite aw, hiai ngaikhiaunla, ka honngen ahi.
ENGLISH: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity.

PAITE: Zion sisanin a lam ua, Jerusalem ginatlounain.
ENGLISH: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

PAITE: Huaia heututen kipahman lamenin vai a hawm ua, huaia siamputen lawh lamenin a sinsak ua, huaia jawlneiten dangka lamenin ai a san uhi: huchiin leng, TOUPA a lak uah a om ka hia? thil hoih lou i tunguah a hongtung kei ding, chiin TOUPA tungah a kinga uhi.Huaijiakin Zion, noute jiakin, lou banga leileh ahi dinga, Jerusalem thil sia omkhawm ahi dinga, biakin omna tang dawi mun sang bang ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money: yet they lean on Yahweh, and say, “Isn’t Yahweh in the midst of us? No disaster will come on us.”

PAITE: Huaijiakin Zion, noute jiakin, lou banga leileh ahi dinga, Jerusalem thil sia omkhawm ahi dinga, biakin omna tang dawi mun sang bang ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.

PAITE: Himahleh ni nanung chiangin hichi ahi dinga, TOUPA na omna tang uh tang lian tungtea hihkipin a om dinga, tang neute tungah tawisangin a om lai ding; huaiah tawisangin a om lai ding; huaiah chichihte a pai zungzung ding uh.
ENGLISH: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

PAITE: Huan, nam tampite a pai ding ua, Hong unla, TOUPA tangah, Jakob Pathian in ah. i hoh tou ding uh; huchiin aman a lampi tanchinte honsinsak dinga, a lampiahte i pai ding ua, a chi ding uh; Zion akipan in dan thu a hongpawt sin ngala. TOUPa thu bel Jerusalem a kipanin hong pawt sin ahi.
ENGLISH: Many nations will go and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion will go forth the law, and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem;

PAITE: Huan, aman chi tampi kalah vai a hawm dinga, gamla pia nam hat tak leng a sal ding; huan, a namsaute uh leilehna muk zum dingin a sek sing ua, a teipite uh thei kung attanna temkawi dingin a sek dung uh; nam dangin nam dang tungah namsaw a lik ta kei dinga, kidou dan leng a sinsakta kei ding uh.
ENGLISH: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

PAITE: Mi chihte a grep gui nuai uah leh a theipi kung nuai uah a tu zo ta ding ua; kuamahin a lausak kei ding uh: sepaihte TOUPA kamin a ganta ngal a.
ENGLISH: But they will sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and no one will make them afraid: For the mouth of Yahweh of Armies has spoken.

PAITE: Chi chih amau pathian min chiatin a om ding ua, ei leng TOUPA i Pathian minin khantawnin i om ding hi.
ENGLISH: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods; but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.

PAITE: TOUPAN hichiin a chi: Huai ni chiangin khebai ka kaikhawm dinga, delhmanga om leh ka sukgima om ka kaikhawm ding.
ENGLISH: “In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;

PAITE: Khebai bel a si valin ka bawl dinga, gamla pia delh mang bel nam hat takin na bawl ding: tuban siah Zion tangah khantawnin TOUPAN a tunguah vai a hawm ding.
ENGLISH: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”

PAITE: Aw nang, gan hon kalh, Zion tanu omna tang, na kiangah a hongtung ding; ahi, lalna masa pen a hongtung ding, Jeusalem tanu lalna tak.
ENGLISH: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come, yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

PAITE: Bang dia hichi nak kah na hia? Na sungah kumpipa a om ka hia, nang hon gelsakpa a mangthangta ahia, numei nauvei banga natnain nang a honmat?
ENGLISH: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?

PAITE: Aw Zion tanu, numei nauvei suak ding bangin natna thuak inla veiin: tuin khopi akipanin na pawt khe dinga, gamah na teng dinga, Babulon tanphain leng a pai sin ngala, huaiah hotkhiakin na om dinga, huaiah na melmate khut akipan TOUPAN nang a hon honkhe ding hi.
ENGLISH: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go forth out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

PAITE: Tuin tampi nang hondouin a ki khom ua, Hihbuai in om henla, i mit in zion tung a lunggulh pen mu hen, a chi ua.
ENGLISH: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”

PAITE: himahleh toupa ngaihtuahnate a theikei ua, a phatsakna leng a thei siam sam kei uh: phual a buhphal koih khom bangin amau lah a kaikhawmta ngala.Aw Zion tanu, thou inla chilin: na ki sik bang in ka bawl dinga, na khepek bomte dal bangin ka bawl ding ahi ngala; huan, chi tampite na sat ding: a thil lep uh TOUPA a dia na tuam koih ding ahi, a sum uh lei kumpi TOUPA adin ah tuam koih ding.
ENGLISH: But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.

PAITE: Aw Zion tanu, thou inla chilin: na ki sik bang in ka bawl dinga, na khepek bomte dal bangin ka bawl ding ahi ngala; huan, chi tampite na sat ding: a thil lep uh TOUPA a dia na tuam koih ding ahi, a sum uh lei kumpi TOUPA adin ah tuam koih ding.
ENGLISH: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion; for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs brass; and you will beat in pieces many peoples: and I will devote their gain to Yahweh, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.

PAITE: Aw sepaih hon tanu, tuin sepaih honin kikaikhawm inla: aman a hohumta ahi: Israelte vaihawmpa a biangah chiangin khen in.
ENGLISH: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

PAITE: Himahleh nang Bethlehem Ephratha, Juda gama sang tampi laka tel din neu tawk le chin leng, nanga kipanin Israelte vai hawmpa ding kei din a hongpawt ding; a hongpawtna sawtpi, tangali nite akipan ahi.
ENGLISH: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come forth to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.

PAITE: Huaijiakin nauveimiin a suahsak ma tenin amau a lehngat san ding: huchiin a unau om sunte Israel suante kiangah a kik nawn ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

PAITE: Amah a ding dinga, TOUPA a Pathian min thupina ngeiin: huan, amau a om nilouhta ding ua: amah leh lei tawp phain a thupi sin ta ngal a.
ENGLISH: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

PAITE: Huan, hiai mi kilepna ahi ding; Assuria mi gam ua a hong, i kumpipa uh inte a honsik hun chiangin, amah dou dingin belampu sagih leh mi thupi giat i kidok khe ding.
ENGLISH: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

PAITE: Assuria gam bel namsauin a hihse ding ua, Nimrod gam a lutnaah a hihse lai ding uh: huan, aman, i gam ua Assuria mi honga, i gam chiang uh a hongsik hunin, amah akipanin a hohhon khe ding.
ENGLISH: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

PAITE: Jakobte mi om sunte chi tampi lakah TOUPA akipana dai kia bang leh loupa tunga vuah ju bangin a om ding uh; huaiin mihing a ngak keia, mihing tapate a ngak sam kei hi.
ENGLISH: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples, like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man, nor wait for the sons of men.

PAITE: Jokobte mi om sunte namte lakah leh chi tampite lakah gamnuai sate laka humpinelkai bang leh belam hon laka humpinelkai lenlai bangin a om ding: aman, a pai suak peuhmah le, a sik den a, a bot nena, humbit ding leng kuamah a om kei uh.
ENGLISH: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

PAITE: Na khut nang hon doute tungah likin om henla, na melma tengteng hihmanin om hen.
ENGLISH: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.

PAITE: Huai ni chaingin hichi ahi dinga, TOUPAN a chi, nanga kipanin na sakolte ka hihmang dinga, na kangtalaite ka hihse ding:
ENGLISH: “It will happen in that day,” says Yahweh, “That I will cut off your horses out of the midst of you, and will destroy your chariots.

PAITE: Na khopite ka hihmang dinga, na kulh hat tengteng ka hihchim ding;
ENGLISH: I will cut off the cities of your land, and will tear down all your strongholds.

PAITE: Na khut akipan bumsiamnate ka hihmang dinga; aisansiamte ka hihmang dinga; aisansiamte na nei nawnta kei ding:
ENGLISH: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand; and you shall have no soothsayers.

PAITE: Nang akipan na milim bawl tawmte leh na suang phuhte ka hihmang dinga; na khut suak thil na be nawnta kei ding.
ENGLISH: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars out of your midst; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

PAITE: Nang akipan na Aser te ka bot khe dinga; na khopite ka hihse ding.Huan, thu ngaikhe lou namte tungah hehna leh thangpaihnain phu lakna ka piching sak ding.
ENGLISH: I will uproot your Asherim out of your midst; and I will destroy your cities.

PAITE: Huan, thu ngaikhe lou namte tungah hehna leh thangpaihnain phu lakna ka piching sak ding.
ENGLISH: I will execute vengeance in anger, and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”

PAITE: TOUPA thu gen tuin ngaikhia un; Thou inla, tang lian maahte langin, tang neuten na aw ngaikhia uhen,
ENGLISH: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

PAITE: Aw tang liante aw, TOUPA lanna ngaikhia unla, nou lei kingakna tawntungte aw, ngaikhia un: TOUPA a mite toh a kilang ua, Israelte a nem ding.
ENGLISH: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.

PAITE: Aw ka mite aw, na tunguah bang ka hihtaa ahia? bang lamin ahia kon hihgim? hon lang dih ua.
ENGLISH: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!

PAITE: Aigupta gam a kipanin nou ka honpi khiaa, sikha akipan nou ka hontan khiaa; na ma uah Mosi te, Aron te leh Miriam te ka honsawl hi.
ENGLISH: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

PAITE: Aw ka mite aw, TOUPa thilhih diktat na theihtheihna ding un, Moab kumpipa Balak thu sawm leh Boer tapa Belamin a dawn dan, Sittim akipana Gilgal phaa thil omdan khong tuin theigige un.
ENGLISH: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”

PAITE: Bang toh ahia TOUPA maa ka hongpai dinga, Pathian tungnung maa ka kun ding? haltum thillat te, bawng nou kum khata upate toh a maah ka hongpai dia hia?
ENGLISH: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

PAITE: TOUPA belamtal sang tampi hiam sathau lui singte hiamah a lungkim sin ahia? ka tatlekna jiakin ka ta chil ka piain, ka kha khelhna jiakin ka pumpi gah ka pe dia hia?
ENGLISH: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

PAITE: Aw mihing, hoih nang a honensakta hi; TOUPAN nang a honphut bang ahia? dik taka hih leh hehpihna it leh na Pathian toh kiniamkhiak tak a vak khawm ahi kei maw?
ENGLISH: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

PAITE: TOUPAN khopi a sam ahi, pilna nei min na min laudan a siam ding: khetbuk leh a bawlmi thei un.
ENGLISH: Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

PAITE: Mi thulimlou in a thulimlouhna gou bawmte a omlaiin, tehna dolon kihhuai tak a om lailai hia?
ENGLISH: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah An ephah is a measure of volume (about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel), and a short ephah is made smaller than a full ephah for the purpose of cheating customers. that is accursed?

PAITE: Bukna dik loute leh ip gik dan dohate toh siangthou ka hi sin ahia?
ENGLISH: Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?

PAITE: Huailaia mi hausate lah hiamgamnain a dim ngal ua, buaia tengten juau a gen ua, a kam sung ua a lei uh khem hat ahi.
ENGLISH: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

PAITE: Huaijiakin ken leng nakpia hon limsakin ka honkhena; na khelhnate jiakin ka honhihgam ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.

PAITE: Na ne dinga, himahleh na tai kei ding; na kiangah na daina a om ding a: na suan dinga, himahleh bit takin na nawn mang kei ding; na pai mangpihte namsau akipan ka lehngatsan ding.
ENGLISH: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your humiliation will be in your midst. You will store up, but not save; and that which you save I will give up to the sword.

PAITE: Na ching dinga, himahleh na la kei ding: oliv gahte na chil dinga, himahleh a thau na nilh kei ding; grep chil mah le chin, a uain na dawn kei ding.Omri thusehte lah vom gige ahi ngala, Ahab inko thihih tengteng toh; amau lemthehte ah na pai uhi; huchiin mun gamgawpin ka honbawl sinta hi, a tunga tengte ding a om kei; ka hinnain theipi min masa a lunggulh hi.
ENGLISH: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.

PAITE: Omri thusehte lah vom gige ahi ngala, Ahab inko thihih tengteng toh; amau lemthehte ah na pai uhi; huchiin mun gamgawpin ka honbawl sinta hi, a tunga tengte ding a om kei; ka hinnain theipi min masa a lunggulh hi.
ENGLISH: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and her inhabitants a hissing; And you will bear the reproach of my people.”

PAITE: Ka tung gikna mai e: nipi thei a sek khawm hun laia om bang leh grep loh hun laia grep maiah loh ding bang lah ka hi ngala: gah bom nek nek ding a om kei; ka hinnain theipi min masa a lunggulh hi.
ENGLISH: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard: There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

PAITE: Pathian limsakmi lei a kipan a mang ua, mihing lakah mi diktak mahmah a om kei uh: sisan suah dingin a tang vek ua; mi chihin amau unau lenin a gem uhi.
ENGLISH: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

PAITE: A khutte uh thil hoihlou tunga thanuam taka hih dingin a nga ua; kumpipan a ngena, vaihawmpan a phuta; mi lianin a lungsim thil hihkhelhna a gen khiaa: huchibang in a kithutuak uhi.
ENGLISH: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

PAITE: A lak ua mi hoihpen loulingnei bang ahi a; mi dik pen leng dai ling nei sangin a hoih kei jaw: nang vengmite ni, veha na om ni ngei a hongtung hi; huai bel a mangbat ni uh ahi ding.
ENGLISH: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

PAITE: Lawm ah muang kei unla, makai mi ah leng ginna koih kei un: na angsunga omnu akipanin na kam kongkhakte hoih takin vengin.
ENGLISH: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

PAITE: Tapain pa min a hihsiaa, tanuin a nu a dou a, mou-in a pi a dou ngal a; mihing melmate jaw amah inkote mah ahi uh.
ENGLISH: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

PAITE: Ken jaw TOUPA lam ka en dinga; ka hotdamna Pathian ka ngak ding; ka Pathianin a honngaikhe sin ahi.
ENGLISH: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

PAITE: Aw ka melma, honawi ken: ka puk hun chiangin ka thou nawn ding; miala ka tut in leng TOUPA kei din vak ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.

PAITE: TOUPA tunga thil ka hih khelh jiakin, a lunghihlouhna mahmah ka po ding, ka tung thu a hongen piha, kei dia vaihawmna a tangtun ma siah; vakah a honpi khe dinga, huan, diktatna ka mu ding.
ENGLISH: I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes judgment for me. He will bring me forth to the light. I will see his righteousness.

PAITE: Huchiin ka melma ka kianga, TOUPa na Pathian koiah, chipan huai a mu dinga, zahlaknam amah a tuam ding. Ka miten amah a en ding a: tun jaw kongzing buannawi banga sikden a hita ding.
ENGLISH: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me and will cover her shame. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

PAITE: Na kulh bangte bawlna ni ding: huai ni chiangin thusehpen gamlapi phaa zatsak ahi ding.
ENGLISH: A day to build your walls— In that day, he will extend your boundary.

PAITE: Huai ni chiangin Assuria gam leh Aigupta khopi akipan te, Aigupta leh Lui pha hiala kipan te, tuipi leh tuipi kikal akipan te leh tang leh tang kikal akipan tein na kiangah a hongpai ding uh.
ENGLISH: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

PAITE: Huchi piin leng gam, a sunga tengte jiak leh a thilhih gah uh jiakin hihgam ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

PAITE: Karmel tang kala gamnuaia lungjuang taka om na gou tan belam hon, na mite na khetbuk zangin vak inla: nidang lai bangin Basan leh Gilead ah vakin om chiat uhen.
ENGLISH: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest, in the midst of fertile pasture land, let them feed; in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

PAITE: Aigupta gam akipana na pai khiak lai bangin a kiang ah thillamdang mahmah te ka en sak ding.
ENGLISH: “As in the days of your coming forth out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

PAITE: Nam chihin huai a mu ding ua, a thilhihtheihna tengteng uh a zumpih ding uh: a muk uh a hum ding ua, a beng uh a ngong ding.
ENGLISH: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

PAITE: Gul bangin leivui a liak ding ua; khupboha paite bangin a omna kua ua kipanin ling kawmin a hongpai ding uh: TOUPA i Pathian kiangah laudansiam kawmin a hongpai ding ua, nang jiakin a lau ding uh.
ENGLISH: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to Yahweh our God, and will be afraid because of you.

PAITE: Nang banga thulimlouhna ngaidampa leh a goutan om sun tatlekna nelhsiahpa Pathian kua a oma? a hhna khantawnin a vom gige kei, hehpihna a a kipah mahmah sek jiakin.
ENGLISH: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
