PAITE: Huai jiakin Pathianin zahhuaipia huk phalin lehlam a ngatsan ahi; a numeite nangawn un leng a omdan pianpih uh danlou banga om dingin a kibawl lamdang ngal ua;
ENGLISH: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

PAITE: pasalten leng numei zatdan ngeina tawpsana, hukin a kienlah ua, pasal leh pasal zummoh thil hihin a om ua, a gitlouh man muh ding uh tuh a satung uah a mu uhi.
ENGLISH: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

PAITE: Huan, Pathian theih a ut louh jiak un, thil kilawmloute hih dinga a deih louhlam lungsim neih phalin Pathianin a lehngatsante;
ENGLISH: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

PAITE: Huchin diktatlouhna tengteng, gitlouhna tengteng, huaihamna tengteng, huatna tengteng khawng in, a nadim ua; hajatna te, tual thahna te, kiselna te, khemna te, nundan hoih lou tein a dim ua;
ENGLISH: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

PAITE: gensiatna te, migenna te, Pathian huat lam te, kisaktheihna te, kisatheimite, thil gilou bawlkhete,
ENGLISH: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

PAITE: nu leh pa thu mangloute, theihna beite, thuchiam susete, itna pianpih neiloute, hehpihna neiloute ahi ua.Huchi banga hihte tuh si tak him ahi uh chih Pathian dan tuh thei gigein, amau kiaa hih leng hi louin, mi dang hih jelte tungah leng a kipak uhi.
ENGLISH: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

PAITE: Huchi banga hihte tuh si tak him ahi uh chih Pathian dan tuh thei gigein, amau kiaa hih leng hi louin, mi dang hih jelte tungah leng a kipak uhi.
ENGLISH: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

PAITE: Unaute aw, ka lungtang deihlam leh amau adia Pathian kianga ka thumna pen jaw, hotdam a hong hihtheihna ding uh ahi
ENGLISH: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

PAITE: Pathian lamah phatuam a ngai uh chih ka theihpih ahi, himahleh theihna ahihvakin jaw ahi kei uh.
ENGLISH: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

PAITE: Pathian diktatna theilou in, amau diktatna lamkhiak a tum ua, Pathian diktatna ah a kipe lut samkei uhi.
ENGLISH: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

PAITE: Kris bel a gingta peuhmahte adin diktatna a muh theihna ding un dan tawpna ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For Christ is the fulfillment or, completion, or end of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

PAITE: Mosi in, Dana diktatna jui jaw, huai diktatna jiakin a hing ding, chiin, a gelh.
ENGLISH: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.” Leviticus 18:5

PAITE: Ginna a diktatnain bel hichin a gen: Na lungsimin, Kua ahia van ah kah ding? Hiam (huai tuh tunglama kipan Kris va pi suk ding, chihna ahi);
ENGLISH: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ Deuteronomy 30:12 (that is, to bring Christ down);

PAITE: Kua ahia khukthuk ah hoh suk ding? Hiam (huai tuh misi laka kipan Kris pi tou nawn ding chihna ahi) chi ken, chiin.
ENGLISH: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ Deuteronomy 30:13 (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

PAITE: Ahihleh, bang ahia a gen? Thuin a honnaih hi, na kam leh na lungtang ah a om, chiin, a gen ahi; (huai tuh ginna thu ka gengen a hi).
ENGLISH: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth, and in your heart”; Deuteronomy 30:14 that is, the word of faith, which we preach:

PAITE: Na kama Jesu Toupa ahi chih na gupa, misi laka kipan Pathianin a kaithou chih na lungtanga na gintak leh hotdamin na om ding, chih.
ENGLISH: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

PAITE: Min lungtangin a gingta ua, diktatna a mu jel uh; kamin a gum ua, hotdamna leng a mu nak uh ahi.
ENGLISH: For with the heart, one believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

PAITE: Laisiangthouin, kuapeuh amah gingta a zahlak kei ding, achi hi.
ENGLISH: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.” Isaiah 28:16

PAITE: Juda leh Grik mite bangmah ah a lamdanga tuan kei ua, Toupa khat a vek ua tungah Toupa ahi a, a min lou peuhmahte tungah hoihna a hau ngala.
ENGLISH: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

PAITE: Kuapeuh Toupa min lou tuh hotdamin a om ding hi.
ENGLISH: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.” Joel 2:32

PAITE: Ahihleh, a gintak louhpi uh bangchin a lou ding ua? A thu a jak louhpi uh bangchin a gingta ding ua? Thuhilhmi om louin bangchin a za ding ua?
ENGLISH: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

PAITE: Sawl a hih kei uleh bangchin thu a hilh ding ua? Thil hoih tanchin kipahhuai tunte khe kilawm natel e! chih gelh bangin.
ENGLISH: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!” Isaiah 52:7

PAITE: Himahleh, Tanchin Hoih tuh a vek un a ngaikhe kei uhi. Isaiin, Toupa, ka thugen uh kuan ahia gingta? A chi ngala.
ENGLISH: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?” Isaiah 53:1

PAITE: Huchiin, ginna tuh jakna jiakin a hong oma, huan, jakna tuh Kris thu kigen jiakin a hongom hi.
ENGLISH: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

PAITE: Ahihleh, a bil un a za kei ua hia? Za nake; A husa uh gam chih ah a thanga, a thu uh kawlmong phain a thangsuakta. Chih ahi.
ENGLISH: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.” Psalm 19:4

PAITE: Ahihleh, Isreal miten a za kei ua hia? Chi dia gen thamlouhte ka honhaza sak dinga; chi pilloute zangin ka honsuheh ding, chiin, Mosiin a gen masapen hi.
ENGLISH: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry.” Deuteronomy 32:31

PAITE: Huan Isai in hangtakin, hon zongloute muhin ka omta; hon kanloute ka kimusakta, chiin a gena.Ahihhangin Isreal mite thu ah, mi chihmoh leh selhatte din sun nilouh in kaban ka jak hi, achia.
ENGLISH: Isaiah is very bold, and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.” Isaiah 65:1

PAITE: Ahihhangin Isreal mite thu ah, mi chihmoh leh selhatte din sun nilouh in kaban ka jak hi, achia.
ENGLISH: But as to Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.” Isaiah 65:2

PAITE: Ahihleh, Pathianin a mite a pai khia ahia? Pai khelou hial. Kei leng Israel mi, Abraham suan, Benjamin nam ka hi ngala.
ENGLISH: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

PAITE: Pathianin a mi a theihkholhte a pai khe kei hi. Laisiangthouin Elija thu a gen na theikei ua hia? Aman Israel mite tungthu Pathian kiangah a tuna,
ENGLISH: God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

PAITE: Toupa, na jawlneite a hihlum ua, na maitamte a hihchim ua; keimah kia nutsiatin ka om, kei leng honhihlup a hontum uhi, a chih.
ENGLISH: “Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.” 1 Kings 19:10,14

PAITE: Himahleh, Pathianin bangchin a dawnga? Baal maa khukdin ngeilou mi sang sagih keimah adingin ka hawi ahi, chiin, a dawng hi.
ENGLISH: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.” 1 Kings 19:18

PAITE: Huchibangin, tulaiin leng a sibang, hehpihna a tel a om.
ENGLISH: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

PAITE: Hehpihnajiak a hih leh, nasep jiak a hita kei, huchi ahihkeileh, hehpihna tuh hehpihna a hita kei ding.
ENGLISH: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

PAITE: Bang chi a hita dia leh? Israel miten a zon uh a mu kei uh. Telten bel a mu uh, a dangte tengteng a nanggawpta uhi.
ENGLISH: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

PAITE: Pathianin tuni tanin a kiang uah lusukna kha a pia a, muh theihlouhna mitte, jak theihlouhna bilte toh, chih gelh bangin.
ENGLISH: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.” Deuteronomy 29:4; Isaiah 29:10

PAITE: Huan, Davidin, A dohkan uh amau adingin thang leh pial leh, pukna leh, phulakna honghi heh;
ENGLISH: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

PAITE: A theihlouhna ding un a mitte uh hongmial heh, nanga a nungjang uh kun sak gige in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always.” Psalm 69:22,23

PAITE: Ahihleh, a kisuih uh a kipuk denna ding uhia? Hilou hial ding. A puk jiak un Jentelte kiangah hotdamna a hong tungzota ahi, Israel mite hajat dingin.
ENGLISH: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

PAITE: Huchiin, a pukna u bawn khovel hihhauhsakna a hiha, a kiamna uh bawn Jentelte hauhsakna leng a hih leh, a buchin nawn na uh bangchi pheta hamphatna lianjawin a jui de aw!
ENGLISH: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?

PAITE: Huchiin, nou Jentelte kiangah ka gen ahi. Kei Jentelte kianga sawltak ka hih jiakin, ka nasepna pen ka pahtawi ahi,
ENGLISH: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;

PAITE: Huchi-a ka chipihte ka hajat sak theih teiteina ding leh a lak ua khenkhatte ka hotdam theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

PAITE: Amau paih khiakna bawn khovel toh kituah nawn na ahihleh, amau deih nawn na ding sihna akipan hin nawna loungal bang ahi dia?
ENGLISH: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

PAITE: Huan, gah masa thillat, tangbuang mek them a sianthou leh huchimah bangin a beupi a siangthou hi; huan, a zungpi a siangthou leh ahiangte leng huchi mahbang ahi uh.
ENGLISH: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

PAITE: Huan, ahiang khenkhat te hih tana a om in, nang, oliv taklou, amau laka phuhlutin na oma, oliv singa hauhna zung kikoppih sam na hih manin,
ENGLISH: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree;

PAITE: Hiang dangte lakah kisathei ken. Kisathei mahle chin, nang a zung vakpa na hi keia, huai a zung tuh nang honvakpa ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

PAITE: Huan, nang, Phutluta ka om theihna dingin hiangte hihtanin a om khinta vo oi, nachi dia.
ENGLISH: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

PAITE: Ahi, a gintak louhna jiak un hihtanin a om ua, nang na ginna jiakin na ding ahi, Uang kenla, lau jaw in:
ENGLISH: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

PAITE: Pathian in hiang taktepen bawn a hawi keingal leh, nang leng a honhawi tuan kei ding hi.
ENGLISH: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathian hoihna leh a thukhauhna ngaihtuah i: a pukte adingin a thukhauhna; nang adingin bel a hoihna, hoihnaa na om gige leh; huchi a hihkeileh, nang leng sat khiakin na om sam ding.
ENGLISH: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

PAITE: Huan, amau leng, gingta loua a om nilouh kei uleh, phuhlutin a om ding uh; Pathian in amau a phutlut nawn thei ngala.
ENGLISH: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

PAITE: Nang piandana oliv taklou akipana sat sup bawn, pian dan lou banga oliv sing hoiha phutluta na om leh, tua ahiang taktakte pen, amau oliv sing ngeingeiah phutlut ding nak hih natel unchia!
ENGLISH: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

PAITE: Unaute aw, hiai thuguk na theih louh uh ka ut keia, huchilou injaw na kipil sak ding uh: Jentelte buchinna a hongtun matan Israel mi khenkhatte tungah siatna a hongtung tadih ahi,
ENGLISH: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

PAITE: Huchiin, Israel mi tengteng hotdamin a om ding uh; Zion akipanin Hondampa a hong suak dinga, Jakob kianga kipan Pathian limsaklouhna a hihmang ding;
ENGLISH: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

PAITE: Huan, hiai a kiang ua ka thu khun ding ahi, a khelhnate uh ka lakmang chiangin, chih gelh bangin.
ENGLISH: This is my covenant to them, when I will take away their sins.” Isaiah 59:20-21; 27:9; Jeremiah 31:33-34

PAITE: Tanchin Hoih lam ngaihtuah in, nou jiakin melma ahi ua; tel thu lam ngaihtuahin bel a pipute uh jiakin deihtakte ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

PAITE: Pathianin a thilthawnpiak ah leh a sapna ah a lungsim a khel ngei kei hi.
ENGLISH: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

PAITE: Nidanglaiin Pathian thu na ging kei ua, himahleh tuin amau a gin louh jiak un zahngaihna na mu ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

PAITE: Huchi mahbangin, tuin, Pathian in nou a honhehpihna jiak a, zahngaihna a muh theihna ding un amau leng ging lou eita ve ua.
ENGLISH: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

PAITE: Pathianin a hehpih vek theihna dingin mi tengteng ginlouhnaah a khum vekta ngala.
ENGLISH: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

PAITE: Pathian pilna leh theihna hauhdan thuk hina tele! A vaihawmnate theihtheih vual leh, a lampite sui theih vual hi keina tele!
ENGLISH: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

PAITE: Toupa lungsim kuan ahia thei? Kuan a vaihawm saka?
ENGLISH: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?” Isaiah 40:13

PAITE: A dit nawn dingin leng a kiangah kuan ahia thil pe masa?Amah akipan leh, amah jiak leh, amah adingin thil tengteng a hongom ahi ngal a; amah kiangah khantawnin thupina om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?” Job 41:11

PAITE: Amah akipan leh, amah jiak leh, amah adingin thil tengteng a hongom ahi ngal a; amah kiangah khantawnin thupina om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

PAITE: Huchiin, unaute aw, Pathian zahngaihna jiakin, kithoihna hing leh siangthou leh Pathian lungtuak dingin na pumpi uh kilan dingin ka hon ngen ahi; huai tuh na biakna dan ding him uh ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

PAITE: Hiai khovel dan bangin om kei unla; Pathian deihlam a hoih leh, lungtuah huai tak leh, hoihkim, na theihtel theihna ding un, na lungsim uh a thaka omin honglamdang zota un.
ENGLISH: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

PAITE: Na lak uah kuamah na kilet sak ding hun val ua kilian sak louin, Pathianin mi chih kianga ginna hun a piak bang jela diktaka ngaihtuah zo dingin Pathianin honpiak hehpihna jiakin kon chi chiat ahi.
ENGLISH: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

PAITE: Pumpi khatah hiang tampi i nei ua, hiang tengteng nasep bel a kibang kei hi,
ENGLISH: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

PAITE: Huchi mahbangin, eite tampi himah lehang, Kris ah pumpi khat ihi ua: a tuamtuamin I kihiang tuah chiat uhi.
ENGLISH: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.

PAITE: Hehpihna a honpiak dan bang jelin thilthawnpiak tuamtuam i nei chiat uh: thugen ding a hih leh i ginna toh kihunin i gen ding u;
ENGLISH: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

PAITE: Nasepna ding ahihleh, na i sem chiatchiat ding uh; thuhilhmin leng hilh hiathiat hen;
ENGLISH: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

PAITE: Taihilhmin leng taihilh geihgeih heh; thilpemin it louin pia heh; vaihawmmin thanuam takin hawm heh; mi hehpihin kipaktakin hehpih heh.
ENGLISH: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with liberality; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

PAITE: Itna ahihleh lepchiahna tel louin hi heh. Gilou lam hua unla, hoih lam len chinten un.
ENGLISH: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

PAITE: Unaute it lamah, it takin kilainat tuah chiat un; pahtawi lamah, kideihsak tuah chiat un.
ENGLISH: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate one to another; in honor preferring one another;

PAITE: Thanop lamah, thadah kei un; Kha a vakna toh phatuamngaiin Toupa na sem un.
ENGLISH: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

PAITE: Lametna lamah, kipak unla; gimthuakna lamah, kuhkal unla; thumna lamah, thum teitei unla;
ENGLISH: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;

PAITE: Misiangthoute taksapna ah taksap awnghu unla; mikhualte kipahpihin om nilouh un.
ENGLISH: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.

PAITE: Honsawite vualjawl sak unla, vualjawl unla, hamsiat kei un.
ENGLISH: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

PAITE: Kipakte kipahpih unla, kapte kahpih un.
ENGLISH: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

PAITE: Ngaihtuah kibangin om chiat un, Kingaihtuah sang lo kei unla, mi neuneu kithuahpih jaw un. Kipil sak kei un.
ENGLISH: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

PAITE: Kua gitlouh leng gilouin thuk kei un. Mi tengteng muhin thil kilawm ngaihtuah un.
ENGLISH: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

PAITE: A theih liai leh, noumau lambek, mi tengteng toh kituakin om un.
ENGLISH: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

PAITE: Deihtakte aw, phu kila kei unla, Pathian tuh hehna awn jaw un, Phulak himhim kei lak ding ahi, ken ka thuk ding, Toupan a chi, chih gelh ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.” Deuteronomy 32:35

PAITE: Huaijiakin, na melma a gilkial leh nek ding pia inla; adangtak leh dawn ding pia in; huchibang na hih leh a lu tungah meiam na sekkhawm ahi ding hi.Gitlouh zohin om kenla, hoihnain gilou zou jaw in.
ENGLISH: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.” Proverbs 25:21-22

PAITE: Gitlouh zohin om kenla, hoihnain gilou zou jaw in.
ENGLISH: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

PAITE: Mi chih a tung ua vaihawmte thuthuin om heh. Pathian thu louin kuamah vaihawm a om ngal kei ua; vaihawmmi-a omte Pathian seh ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, kuapeuh vaihawmmi sel tuh Pathian seh kalh ahi; a selten amau tungah vaihawmna a mu ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Therefore he who resists the authority, withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

PAITE: Vaihawmmite thil hoih hihte dingin kihtakhuai ahi kei uhi; thil hoihlou hihte dingin bel kihtakhuai ahi uhi. Ahihleh, vaihawmmi kihtaloua om na ut uhia? Thil hoih hih le uchin a phat na loh ding uh;
ENGLISH: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the same,

PAITE: Amah tuh na hoihna dingua Pathian nasemmi ahi ngala. Himahleh, kihta un. temsau lah a mawk tawi ngal keia; amah Pathian nasemmi, thil hihkhial tunga heha phulami ahi ngal a.
ENGLISH: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, Pathian hehna kihtakna jiak kia hilouin, na sia leh pha theihna jiakun leng vaihawmmi thuthuin na om ding him uh ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

PAITE: Hiai jiakin siah leng na liau jel ve ua leh; huchibang thil ngei hih teitei dingin Pathian nasemmite ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, attending continually on this very thing.

PAITE: Mi tengteng kiangah piak ding peuhmah pia un; leiman piakna dingpa kiangah leiman pia unla, siah liauna dingpa kiangah siah liau unla; kihtak dingpa leng kihta unla; zahtak dingpa leng zahtak un.
ENGLISH: Give therefore to everyone what you owe: taxes to whom taxes are due; customs to whom customs; respect to whom respect; honor to whom honor.

PAITE: Kiittuahna loungal, kuamah bangmah ba kei un; amau mihinpih itpan dan a jui kimta ngal a.
ENGLISH: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

PAITE: Hiaite, Angkawm ken, Tualthat ken, Gu ken, Eng ken chih leh, thupiak dang om nalai himhimte, Nangmah na kiit bangin na invengte na it ding hi, chihin a khaikhawm vek ngala.
ENGLISH: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not give false testimony,” “You shall not covet,” TR adds “You shall not give false testimony,” Exodus 20:13-15,17; Deuteronomy 5:17-19,21 and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Leviticus 19:18

PAITE: Itna in innvengte a hihse ngeikei a; huaijiakin itna jaw dan zuih kimna ahi.
ENGLISH: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

PAITE: Huailou –in, tu bang hun ahia chih na thei ua, ihmu khanloh a hun mahmahta chih na thei uh. Tun jaw i gintak tung lai sangin i hotdamna a nai zota ngala;
ENGLISH: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

PAITE: Jan a bei dekdektaa, khua a vak dekta hi; huaijiakin miala thil hihte paiin vak thuamin i kithuam ding uh.
ENGLISH: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the works of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

PAITE: Sun-a om bangin kilawm takin i om ding uh, zu dawn buai leh zu khama om louin, huk leh kingaihhata om louin, kilai leh kihajaa om louin.Toupa Jesu Krisin kithuam jaw inla, na sa duhgawlna uh pichin dingin bangmah kibawl kei un.
ENGLISH: Let us walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

PAITE: Toupa Jesu Krisin kithuam jaw inla, na sa duhgawlna uh pichin dingin bangmah kibawl kei un.
ENGLISH: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

PAITE: Huan, ginnaa hatlou mi, a ngaihdante gense louin ngai un.
ENGLISH: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

PAITE: Mi khatin thil bangkim ne thei din a kigingtaa mi hatlou inbel antelouhing kia a ne hi.
ENGLISH: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

PAITE: Bangkim neten a neloute simmoh kei henla; nelouten leng a nete gense kei heh; Pathianin amah a kipahpih khin ngala.
ENGLISH: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

PAITE: Mi dang sikha gensepa kua na hia? a din leh a puk amah toupa ading ahi. Himahleh, amah jaw dinsakin a om ding, Toupan a dingsak thei ngala.
ENGLISH: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

PAITE: Mi khatin ni khat ni dang sangin a sep thupi tuama, mi dangin ni tengteng kibang chiatin a sep. Mi chih amah lungsim ah kitheichian heh aw.
ENGLISH: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

PAITE: Ni tangpan Toupa pahtawina dingin a tang ahi. Huan, bangkim nepan, Pathian kiangah kipahthu a gen jiakin, Toupa pahtawina dingin a nea; a neloupan leng Pathian kiangah kipahthu a gena, Toupa pahtawina dingin a ne kei a ahi.
ENGLISH: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

PAITE: Kuamah eimah adia hing i hi kei ua, kuamah eimah adia si leng i hi sam kei hi.
ENGLISH: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

PAITE: I hin leh, Toupa adingin i hinga; i sihin leng Toupa adia si ihi ngala: huaijiakin, i hin inleng, i sihin leng Toupaa i hi uhi.
ENGLISH: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

PAITE: Kris sihna leh honghinnawnna pen tuh, mi hing leh misi Toupa a hih theihna ding ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

PAITE: Himahleh nang bang achia na unau gensia na hia oi? Ahihkeileh, nang bang achia na unau simmoh na hia oi? Pathian thukhenna tutphah maah i vek un i ding ding ua.
ENGLISH: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

PAITE: Toupan, mi tengteng ka maah a kun ding ua, lei tengteng leng Pathian kiangah a kipulak ding uh, chiin, ka chiam ahi, achia, chih gelh ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’” Isaiah 45:23

PAITE: Huchiin, i vek un Pathian kiangah eimah tanchin i gen chiat ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, kigense nawn kei ni, kuapeuhin a unau lampi ah kisuihna hiam dalna hiam koih louh tum jaw hen.
ENGLISH: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

PAITE: Amah mawngmawng ah sianglou bangmah himhim a om kei chih Toupa Jesu ah ka thei mahmah ahi; bangkhat siangloua sehpen bel, aseppa adingin a sianglou ahi hi.
ENGLISH: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

PAITE: Na bangkhat nek jiaka na unau lungsim a nat leh, itna danin na gamta kei ahi. A sih sik Kris in a sih sakpa tuh na bangkhat nekin hihmang kei hen;
ENGLISH: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

PAITE: Huchiin, nou adia hoihna gilou lama genin om kei hen.
ENGLISH: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

PAITE: Pathian gam tuh nek leh dawn lam thu ahi ngal keia, diktatna khawng, kituahna khawng, Kha Siangthoua kipahna khawng ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: for the Kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

PAITE: Kuapeuh huai thu ah Kris nasem tuh Pathian kipahpih leh, mihing phatin a om nak ahi.
ENGLISH: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

PAITE: Huchiin, kituahna ding leh, kihihhat tuahna ding thilte i delh ding uh.
ENGLISH: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

PAITE: Na bangkhat nek jiakin Pathian nasep hihse ken. Thil tengteng a siangthou ngei a, himahleh a bangkhat nekin mi a hihpuk leh a nepa adingin gilou ahi.
ENGLISH: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

PAITE: Na unau pukna ding a hih leh, sa nek louhte, uain dawn louhte, thil bangpeuh hih louh a hoih ahi.
ENGLISH: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

PAITE: Ginna na neih Pathian maah nangmah kia theihin nei maiin. Amah hoih sak lama siamlouh kitangsak lou tuh a hampha hi.Ahihhangin, ginglelpan a nek leh, ginnaa a nek louh jiakin, siamlouh a tang ahi; bangpeuh ginna loua hih jaw khelhna ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

PAITE: Ahihhangin, ginglelpan a nek leh, ginnaa a nek louh jiakin, siamlouh a tang ahi; bangpeuh ginna loua hih jaw khelhna ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

PAITE: 
ENGLISH: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,

PAITE: 
ENGLISH: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;

PAITE: 
ENGLISH: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen. TR places verses 24-26 after Romans 16:24 as verses 25-27.

PAITE: Huchiin, ei mi hatten, eimah kipahna zong louin, mi hatloute hatlouhnate i thuak pih ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

PAITE: Eimah innvengte hihphatuamna dingin a hoihna ding un kipahsak i tum chiat ding uh.
ENGLISH: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

PAITE: Kris in leng amah kipahna a zong ngal keia; Nang hontaite taina tuh ka tungah a tuta, chih gelh bangin ahi jaw.
ENGLISH: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.” Psalm 69:9

PAITE: Laisiangthoua kuhkalna leh khamuanna mua lametna i neih theihna ding un, nidanglaia gelh peuhmahte eite hon hilhna dinga gelh ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through patience and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

PAITE: Huchiin, kuhkalna leh khamuanna Pathianin, Kris Jesu gen bangin, lungsim munkhat puin honom sak hen:
ENGLISH: Now the God of patience and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,

PAITE: I Toupa Jesu Kris Pathian leh a Pa, lungsim munkhat leh kithutuaka i pahtawi theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, Krisin Pathian hihthupina dia a honkipahpih mahbangin, kipahpihtuah chiat un.
ENGLISH: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, TR reads “us” instead of “you” to the glory of God.

PAITE: Huai ahi ka gen; pipute kianga thuchiamte hihkip dingin Kris tuh Pathian thutakdan theihsakna dingin zeksumte nasempa a honghita chih:
ENGLISH: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

PAITE: A hehpihna jiaka Jentelten Pathian a pahtawina ding un, Huaijiakin, Jentelte lakah kon phat dia, na min phatawina dingin la ka sa ding, chih gelh bangin.
ENGLISH: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.” 2 Samuel 22:50; Psalm 18:49

PAITE: Huan, Nou Jentel tengteng te aw, a mite toh kipak un, a chi nawna.
ENGLISH: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.” Deuteronomy 32:43

PAITE: Huan, Nou Jentel tengteng te aw, Toupa phat un, mi tengtengin leng amah phat uhen, a chi nawna.
ENGLISH: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.” Psalm 117:1

PAITE: Huan, Isaiin, Jesai zung jam a hongpai ding a, Jentelte tunga vaihawm dingpa; amah ah Jentelten a lametna uh a nga ding uh, leng a chi laia.
ENGLISH: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.” Isaiah 11:10

PAITE: Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna jiaka lametna na hauh theihna ding un, lametna Pathian, na gin jiak un, kipahna leh kituahna chitengin honhihdim hen.
ENGLISH: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

PAITE: Huan, ka unaute aw, nou tungthu jaw, noumau mah hoihnain na dim ua, na kihasuantuah thei uh chih keimahtakin leng diktakin ka thei hi.
ENGLISH: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” , that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

PAITE: Himahleh Pathianin a honpiak hehpihna jiakin nou hontheihpih dingin koi kalkal hiamah hangtakin ka gelh ahi,
ENGLISH: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

PAITE: Jentelte laka Kris Jesu nasema ka om theihna dingin, ka Jentel piakte, Kha Siangthou hihsiangthou a hih ua, pom tak a hih theihna dingun. Pathian Tanchin Hoih lamah siampu na ka sem ahi.
ENGLISH: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathian na ka sep lam thu ah Kris Jesu ah kisaktheihna ding ka nei ahi.
ENGLISH: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

PAITE: Krisin Jentelte thumang sak dingin, thugen leh thilhihin, keimah zanga a thilhihte loungal bangmah ka gen ngam ngal keia.
ENGLISH: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

PAITE: Chiamtehna te leh thillamdang te thilhihtheihna ah, Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihnaah Jerusalem khua leh a kim gam akipanin, Illirikam gam phain, Kris Tanchin Hoih gam chihah ka hilh kimta; keimah honzanga a thilhih tuh huchitel ahi.
ENGLISH: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

PAITE: Ahi, mi dang suangphum tunga lem ka hih louhna dingin, Tanchin hoih Kris min lohkhitna muna gen louin.
ENGLISH: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

PAITE: A tanchin gen ngei nailouhnaten a mu ding ua, za ngei nailouten a za ding uh, chih gelh bangin, gen ka tum jaw ahi.
ENGLISH: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.” Isaiah 52:15

PAITE: Huaijiak takin ahi, na kiang ua hong ka kikhel sak naknak.
ENGLISH: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

PAITE: Tuin bel hiai gam kim khawngah sepna mun himhim ka neita keia, kum tampi na kiang ua hong utin leng ka omta a;
ENGLISH: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

PAITE: Spain gama ka hoh chiangin ka pai kawma nou honmuh ka kilamen ngala, noumau honkithuahpih kham photin, tua lama ka hohna ah nouten non vakhak suk uh leng ka lamen ahi.
ENGLISH: whenever I journey to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

PAITE: Tuin bel, mi siangthoute nasem dingin Jerusalem khua ah ka hoh tadih dinga.
ENGLISH: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

PAITE: Masidonia leh Akaia gama miten lungdamtakin Jerusalem khuaa mi siangthoute laka gentheite adin sum a tuak chiat ta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

PAITE: Ahi, lungdam takin ahih ua ahi, a lak uah leng a ba gige him uhi; Jentelten a kha lam thilte uh a kikoppih ngal un, khovel lam thilin amaute taksap awng a huksak sam uh a kiphamoh him ahi.
ENGLISH: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, huai tuh ka hiha, gah leng amaute dik taka ka muhsak nungin, noute hontawnin, Spain gamah ka pai jel ding.
ENGLISH: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

PAITE: Huan, na kiang ua ka hong chiangin, Kris vualjawlna kim puin ka hong ding chih ka thei hi.
ENGLISH: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

PAITE: Unaute aw, Pathian kianga non thum sakna uah, honthum pih teitei dingin Toupa Jesu Kris leh Kha Siangthou itna in nget petmahin ka honngen ahi;

PAITE: Juda gama gingloute laka ka bit theihna ding leh, Jerusalem khua a dia huhna ka tawi misiangthoute kipahna lam tak a hihtheihna dingin.
ENGLISH: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

PAITE: Pathian hoihsak banga nuamtaka na kiang ua ka honga, i halh khawm vek theihna dingin.Lemna Pathian na vek ua kiangah om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

PAITE: Lemna Pathian na vek ua kiangah om hen. Amen.

PAITE: I sanggamnu, Phoibi, Kenkriai khuaa saptuamte nasem,

PAITE: Toupa mina misiangthoute banga nana kipahpihna ding uleh, na huh uh a kiphatmohna peuha na nahuh ding un honmel theihsak ka ut ahi. Amah mahin leng mi tampi a nahuha, kei ngei leng a honhuh jel ahi.
ENGLISH: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

PAITE: Kris Jesu-a honpanpihte Prisila leh Akuila chibai honbuk sak un.
ENGLISH: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

PAITE: Amau ka hinna adingin amau ngawng a peta ua: amau tung kiaah kipahthu ka gen kei hi, ahihhangin Jentel saptuam tengteng tungah leng, ka gen sam hi.
ENGLISH: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

PAITE: Mari, nou dia semgim, chibai honbuk sak un aw.
ENGLISH: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

PAITE: Ka chipih leh ka hentak pih, Andronika leh Junia, chibai honbuk sak un; amau tuh sawltakte laka minthang tak ahi ua, kei sanga Krisa om masa jaw ahi uh.
ENGLISH: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

PAITE: Ampliata, Toupa a ka deihtak, chibai honbuk sak un aw.

PAITE: Toupa a tel Rufa leh a nu, kei nu sam leng, chibai honna buk sak un.

ENGLISH: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

PAITE: Na omdan uh mi tengteng lakah a thangkheta ngala. Huaijiakin noumau tungthu ah ka kipak ahi; a hihhangin, hoih lamah na pil ua, gilou lamah na pil louh uh ka deih ahi.
ENGLISH: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

PAITE: Huan, lemna Pathianin na khepek nuai uah Setan a honsik den sak zok ding ahi. I Toupa Jesu Kris hehpihna na kiang uah om heh.
ENGLISH: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
