ENGLISH: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

PAITE: Kei, Tertia, hiai lai gelhin, Toupa minin chibai ka honbuk ahi.
ENGLISH: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

PAITE: Ka tunnapa Gaia leh, saptuam tengteng in chibai a honbuk uhi. Huaia sum kempa Erata leh, unaupa Kuartain chibai a honbuk uhi.
ENGLISH: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

PAITE: I Toupa Jesu Kris hehpihna na vek ua kiangah om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

PAITE: Tuin, Amah, ka Tanchinhoih gen bang leh thuguk kilakna bangbanga Jesu Kris ka tangkoupih banga noute honhihhatthei-pa, -huai thuguk tuh tanglai sawtpi mahmah sung selguka na om himahleh.
ENGLISH: TR places Romans 14:24-26 at the end of Romans instead of at the end of chapter 14, and numbers these verses 16:25-27.

PAITE: Tun bel ginna thumanna piangsak dingin jawlnei laibute zanga nam tengteng kianga theihsak leh tangtawn Pathian thupiak bangin taklatin a hongomta hiPilna Pathian kiang kia ah, Jesu Kris jiaka, thupina tangtawn dongin om hen! Amen.
ENGLISH: 

PAITE: Pilna Pathian kiang kia ah, Jesu Kris jiaka, thupina tangtawn dongin om hen! Amen.
ENGLISH: 

PAITE: Huaijiakin, mihing aw, mi selhat kuapeuh himahlechin, pau lam himhim na neikei hi; midang na selna mahah nangmah leh nangmah siamlouh kitang sak na hi; nang selhatin leng huchibang thilte tuh na hih sam ngala.
ENGLISH: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

PAITE: Huchibang thil hih nakte tungah Pathian vaihawmna tuh diktak in a tung chih i thei ngala.
ENGLISH: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

PAITE: Mihing aw, huchibang thil hih nakte gensia, nang leng huchibang na hih sam ngal naka Pathian vaihawmna pelh na kigingta ahia?
ENGLISH: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

PAITE: A hihkeileh, Pathian hoihna tuh kisiknaa nang honpi dinga om ahi chih theilouin, a hoihna, a thuaktheihna leh, a dohtheihna hauhnate na ngaineu ahi a?
ENGLISH: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

PAITE: Na chihmoh leh na lungtang khauh jiakin, hehna leh Pathian vaihawmna diktat hongkilatna ni chiang adingin, na tungah hehna na kikhol khawm tawm ahi.
ENGLISH: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God;

PAITE: Pathianin mi chih a thil hih bang jel un a hawmsak dinga;
ENGLISH: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:” Psalm 62:12; Proverbs 24:12

PAITE: thil hoih hih teiteia, thupina leh pahtawina leh manthat theihlouhna zong mite kiangah, khantawn hinna a pe ding;
ENGLISH: to those who by patience in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

PAITE: a hihhangin, genhaka, thutak jui lou a, gitlouhna jui zote tungah, hehna leh thangpaihna te, haksatna leh lungkhamna thupitakte a om dia;
ENGLISH: but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath and indignation,

PAITE: mihing thil hihkhial tengteng kha tungah a om ding, Juda mi kha tungah a masa dia, huan, Grik mi kha tungah a om nawn ding.
ENGLISH: oppression and anguish, on every soul of man who works evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

PAITE: Ahihhangin, thil hoih hih peuhmah kiangah thupinate, pahtawina te, khamuanna te piak ahi ding, Juda mi kiangah piak ahi masa dia, huan, Grik mi kiangah ahi nawn ding.
ENGLISH: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who works good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

PAITE: Pathianin mi deihsk tuam a nein gal keia.
ENGLISH: For there is no partiality with God.

PAITE: Kuapeuh dan neiloua thil hihkhial tuh, dan louin a mangthang ding hi; huan, kuapeuhmah dan neia thil hihkhial tuh, dana vaihawmin a om ding.
ENGLISH: For as many as have sinned without law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

PAITE: Dan zami phette tuh Pathian mitmuhin mi dik ahi kei ua; dan juite tuh mi dik a hizo ding uh.
ENGLISH: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

PAITE: Dan neilou Jentelten amau pianpiha dan thilte a hih un, huaiten dan neikeimahleh uh, amau leh amau danin a kinei tawm ngal ua.
ENGLISH: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

PAITE: A lungtang uah dan thilhih gelh ahi chih a ensak uh, huai tuh a sia leh pha theihna un a theihpih hi; a lungsimte uh tuh a kisela, a thupukna-un siamlouh a tan hiam siam a tan hiam ahi ding,
ENGLISH: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

PAITE: ka Tanchin Hoih gen banga, mihingte thugukte Pathianin, Jesu Krisa, a ngaihtuah ni chiangin.
ENGLISH: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

PAITE: Himahleh, nang Juda kichi na hi a, dan na muanga, Pathian na suanga,
ENGLISH: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, and rest on the law, and glory in God,

PAITE: a deihlam na theia, thil hoihjaw te hoih na saa, dana hilhin na om a,
ENGLISH: and know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

PAITE: nangmah mah mittawte pipa, mial laka omte vakna hiin na kigingta a;
ENGLISH: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

PAITE: dan ah pilna leh thutak omdan na theih jiakin, mi pilloute hilhpilpa, naungekte hilhpain nakigingta hi;
ENGLISH: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

PAITE: huchibang na hih ngal leh, nang, midangte hilhpa, nangmah na kihilh ka hia? Nang, mi guta lou dia hilhpa, nang nag u nak maw?
ENGLISH: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

PAITE: Nang, angkawm lou dia hilhpa, nang ang na kawm nak maw? Nang, milim hopa, nang milim biakina thilte nag u nak maw?
ENGLISH: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery. Do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

PAITE: Nang, dan suangpa, nang dana na tatlek jiakin Pathian na hihminse jel ahi maw?
ENGLISH: You who glory in the law, through your disobedience of the law do you dishonor God?

PAITE: A gelh bang ngei un Pathian min tuh noumau jiakin Jentelte lakah hihsiatin a om ta hi.
ENGLISH: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” Isaiah 52:5; Ezekiel 36:22 just as it is written.

PAITE: Dan juipa na hih leh zeksum a phatuam ngial hi; dana talekpa na hih lebel, na zeksum tuh sum louh bang phet a honghita hi.
ENGLISH: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, zeksum lou miin dan thu sehte a zuih leh, a zeksum louh tuh sum banga sim ahi kei dia hia?
ENGLISH: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

PAITE: Huan, amau saa zeksum louhin dan a zuih kim uleh, nang, danthu gelh leh zeksum nei ngala, dana talekpa a honmohpaih kei ding ua hia?
ENGLISH: Won’t the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

PAITE: Alang lela Juda mi hi jaw Juda mi tak ahi kei hi; a langa sa lela zeksum jaw zeksum tak leng ahi sam kei hi.Ahihhangin, a lang lel hi loua, Juda mi hi, Juda mi tak ahi; huan, zeksum tak tuh, lungsim lama sum ahi, lai thu phetah hi louin, kha ah ahi; huai miin tuh mihing phat a loh keia, Pathian phat a loh jaw ahi.
ENGLISH: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

PAITE: Ahihhangin, a lang lel hi loua, Juda mi hi, Juda mi tak ahi; huan, zeksum tak tuh, lungsim lama sum ahi, lai thu phetah hi louin, kha ah ahi; huai miin tuh mihing phat a loh keia, Pathian phat a loh jaw ahi.
ENGLISH: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

PAITE: Ahihleh, Juda min hamphattuamna bang ahia a neih tuan? Zeksum leng bang ahi a phattuamna?
ENGLISH: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

PAITE: Koi lam peuhah a phattuam hi; Pathian thute a kiang ua kep saka a om jiak ahi pen.
ENGLISH: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the oracles of God.

PAITE: Mi khenkhatten ginna neikei mahle uh, banga hi tuana eita? A gintak louhna un Pathian muanhuaidan bangmah louin a bawl tuan ahia?
ENGLISH: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

PAITE: Bawl tuan lou hial; Pathian tuh mi diktak hita hen, mi chih tuh juauthei hi uheh; Nang na thu genin siam na tan theia, vaihawm na omin leng na zoh theihna dingin, chih gelh bangin.
ENGLISH: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “That you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.” Psalm 51:4

PAITE: Himahleh, i diktatlouhnain Pathian diktatna a hihlat hoih sem leh, bang i gen dia? Pathianin mi a gawtin, mi diktat lou ahi hia? (Mihing dan bangin ka gen a hi).
ENGLISH: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

PAITE: Hilouhial; huchibang hih leh, Pathianin khovel vai bangchin a hawm dia?
ENGLISH: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

PAITE: Himahleh ka juauthu gen jiaka Pathian thu dikdan amah hihthupi khophiala a lat sem ngal leh, bangachia kei leng mi khial banga siamlouh tan saka om lai ka hia?
ENGLISH: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

PAITE: Bang a chi a (hon hek ua, mi khenkhatin gen louhpi hon gen sak bang un). Thil hoih a hongtun theihna dingin thil gilou i hih ding uh, chia i gen jawk louh? Huchibang miten huchibang tuh siamlouh a tan dik him uhi.
ENGLISH: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let us do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

PAITE: Ahihleh amau sangin i hoih zo khol ua hia? Hoihzo lou hial; Judate leh Grikte khelhna sikhaa om vekin tumalamin leng i ngohta vele;
ENGLISH: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin.

PAITE: Kuamah mi diktat himhim om kei uh, khat lel leng om het kei uh;
ENGLISH: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

PAITE: Kuamah theisiam himhim om kei uh, kuamah Pathian zong himhim om kei uh.
ENGLISH: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

PAITE: A hilou lamah a pial khinta ua, bangmaha phatuam lou in a naom khin vek ua, kuamah thil hoih hih himhim a om kei uh, khat lel leng a om kei uh.
ENGLISH: They have all turned aside. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not, so much as one.” Psalms 14:1-3; 53:1-3; Ecclesiastes 7:20

PAITE: A gawl uh han kihong ahia; a lei un khemna thu a gen ua. A kam sung uah gul gu a om hi.
ENGLISH: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” Psalm 5:9 “The poison of vipers is under their lips”; Psalm 140:3

PAITE: A kam uh hamse lohna leh thu khain a dima.
ENGLISH: “whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.” Psalm 10:7

PAITE: A khe uh sisan suah dingin a kin suan uhi;
ENGLISH: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

PAITE: A lampi uah manthatna leh gimthuakna a om a;
ENGLISH: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

PAITE: Khamuanna lampi leng a theikei uhi.
ENGLISH: The way of peace, they haven’t known.” Isaiah 59:7-8

PAITE: A mit uah Pathian laudansiamna himhim a om kei, chih gelh bangin.
ENGLISH: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.” Psalm 36:1

PAITE: Danin bangpeuh a gen, dan thuthua omte kiangah a gen ahi chi hi thei ngala; kam chiteng a chih theihna dingin leh khovela mi tengteng Pathian vaihawma a om theihna ding un.
ENGLISH: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

PAITE: Huchiin, dan thil hih jiakin mi kuamah a mitmuhin siamtangin a om kei ding uh; dan jiakin khelhna theih kimna a hongom ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight. For through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

PAITE: Ahihhangin, tun bel dan leh jawlneite natheihsak Pathian dikna tuh dan tellou-a hihlatin a omta;
ENGLISH: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

PAITE: huai tuh Jesu Kris gintak jiaka, a gingtate tengteng adia Pathian diktatna ahi. Lamdanna himhim a om kei:
ENGLISH: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

PAITE: mi tengtengin thil a hihkhelh ua, Pathian thupina a tan zohlouh nungun,
ENGLISH: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

PAITE: Kris Jesu-a om tatna jiakin, a hehpihnaa a thawna siamtansakin a om uh;
ENGLISH: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;

PAITE: amah tuh a sisan jiaka thuphatawina hiin, ginnaa muh dingin Pathianin a luikheta. Hiai tuh Pathian dikna latsakna ding ahi, aman a dohtheihna jiaka nidanglai khelhnate a paikan tak jiakin;
ENGLISH: whom God set forth to be an atoning sacrifice or, a propitiation , through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

PAITE: huan, amah ngei tuh a dika, chih leh Jesu-a ginna nei mi tuh siam a tangsak chih chetna dingin.
ENGLISH: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

PAITE: Na otna uh koia om ahia leh? Posiahin a omta. Bang danin ahialeh? Thil hihna danin hia? Hi lou hial, ginna danin ahi jaw.
ENGLISH: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

PAITE: Huchiin, dan thilhih hi louin, ginnaa min siam tangin i sep uhi.
ENGLISH: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

PAITE: Pathian, Judate Pathian ka hia? Jentelte Pathian leng ahi sam ka hia? Hi e, Jentelte-a leng ahi.
ENGLISH: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

PAITE: Pathian khat kia a hih jiakin; huan, aman zeksumte a ginna jiakun, huan, zeksumlouhte a ginna jiakun siam a tangsak ding.Huchi a hih leh dan tuh bangmah louin i bawl ua hia? Bawl lou hial. Dan tuh i hihkip jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.

PAITE: Huchi a hih leh dan tuh bangmah louin i bawl ua hia? Bawl lou hial. Dan tuh i hihkip jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

PAITE: Ahihleh, Abraham sa dana I pu un, bang ahia a muh i gen ding?
ENGLISH: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

PAITE: Abrahamin thilhih jiaka siam a tan ngalleh, suan ding a nei ahi, Pathian maah jaw hi hetlouin.
ENGLISH: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

PAITE: Laisiangthouin bang a gena ahia? Abrahamin Pathian a ging taa, huan, huai ginna tuh a diknaa seh ahi, chiin a gen ahi.
ENGLISH: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.” Genesis 15:6

PAITE: Huan, nasemmi loh tuh hehpihna a seh ahi keia, bata seh ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

PAITE: Ahihhangin, na sem loua, Pathian limsaklou siamtangsakpa gingta zomi ginna tuh, amah diktatna a seh ahi.
ENGLISH: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

PAITE: Mi, a thilhih ngaihtuah loua, Pathianin diktata a seh, vual a jawl sak thu David in leng,
ENGLISH: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,

PAITE: A tatleknate uh ngaihdama om leh, a khelhnate uh khuha omte, a hampha uhi,
ENGLISH: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

PAITE: Toupan khelhna neia a seh louhte a hampha uhi, chia a gen bangin.
ENGLISH: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.” Psalm 32:1-2

PAITE: Ahihleh, huai hamphatna zeksumte tungah kia hia a om, zeksumloute tungah leng? Abraham ginna a diktatna seh ahi, i chi ngala.
ENGLISH: Is this blessing then pronounced on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

PAITE: Huai bangchi seh ahia leh? A zeksum nungin hia, a zeksum main? A zeksum nungin ahi keia, a zeksum ma in ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

PAITE: Huchiin, zeksumlouh a hih laia ginna jiaka diktatna a muh chiamtehna dingin zeksum tuh a mu hi. Huchi-a amah tuh zeksumlouhte, ahihhanga gingtaa diktatna sehsaka omte, tengteng pa ahih theihna ding.
ENGLISH: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

PAITE: Huan, huchimah banga, zeksumte, ahihhanga zeksum phet hilou-a i pa uh Abrahamin zek a sum maa ginna a neih bang ginna neite pa a hihtheihna ding ahi.
ENGLISH: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

PAITE: Abraham; leh a suante kianga, khovel gouluah ding ahi ding uh chih thuchiam jaw dana kinga ahi keia, ginna jiaka diktatna a kinga ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: For the promise to Abraham and to his seed that he should be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

PAITE: Dan nei mite gouluahte hi ding hile ubel, ginna bangmahin a phatuam keia, thuchiam leng thuchiam ahita kei hi.
ENGLISH: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

PAITE: Danin hehna a tun nak ngala; himahleh dan omlouhna ah tatlekna leng a om kei hi.
ENGLISH: For the law works wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, thuchiam tuh hehpihna a piak a hihtheihna dingin ginnaa kinga ahi, suante tengtengin thuchiam pellou-a a luah theihna dingun. Dan nei mite kian a luah kei ding ua, Abraham neih bang ginna neiten leng a luah sam ding uhi; amah tuh i vek ua pa ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the seed, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

PAITE: Nam tampite pain ka honbawlta, chia gelh bangin, misite hihhingpa leh thil omloute om bang a genpa a gin Pathian mitmuh ah eite paa bawlin a om hi.
ENGLISH: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” Genesis 17:5 This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

PAITE: Lamet tuaka a om louhin leng aman jaw lamen takin a gingta a, chi tampite pa a honghih theihna dingin: Tua bangin na suante a honghi ding uh, chia hilha a om bangin.
ENGLISH: Who in hope believed against hope, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your seed be.” Genesis 15:5

PAITE: Huan, ginna kiplou tuan louin, a pumpi sisa banga om tuh a ngaihtuaha, (amah kum ja khawng mi ahi ngala), Sara ching leng a ngaihtuah sama.
ENGLISH: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

PAITE: Himahleh, ginna tasamin Pathian thuchiam a ging lel keia, Pathian a pahtawia,
ENGLISH: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

PAITE: A thuchiam a lohching sak thei chih leng a gingta mahmaha, a ginna a hongkip zota hi.
ENGLISH: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

PAITE: Huaijiakin a ginna tuh a diktatna a seh ana hita.
ENGLISH: Therefore it also was “reckoned to him for righteousness.” Genesis 15:6

PAITE: Huchiin, a ginna tuh a diktatna seh ahi chih amah jiak kiaa gelh ahi keia, eite jiakin leng ahi.
ENGLISH: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

PAITE: Jesu i Toupa misi laka kipana kaithoupa gingtate i hia. I ginna tuh diktatna a seh ahi ding hi.Huai Jesu tuh i tatlekna jiaka matsaka om a, siam i tanna dinga kaihthoha om ahi.
ENGLISH: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,

PAITE: Huai Jesu tuh i tatlekna jiaka matsaka om a, siam i tanna dinga kaihthoha om ahi.
ENGLISH: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, ginna jiaka siamtansaka omin i Toupa Jesu Kris pansanin Pathian toh kilemin i om uhi.
ENGLISH: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

PAITE: Amah pansan mahin hiai hehpihna ah I lut ua; huaia dingin Pathian thupina i tan ding lametna ah kipakin i om uhi.
ENGLISH: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

PAITE: Huai kia leng hilou in, I gimthuakna ah leng kipakin I om uh, gimthuaknain kuhkalna a tuna,
ENGLISH: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance;

PAITE: Kuhkalnain theihtelna a tuna, theihtelnain lametna a tun chih theiin;
ENGLISH: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:

PAITE: Huan, lametnain tuh honzahlaksak kei, huai Kha Siangthou i kiang ua honpiak pansana Pathian itna i lungtang ua suna a om tak jiakin.
ENGLISH: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

PAITE: I hat nai louhlaiin, a hun takin Kris tuh Pathian limsakloute sikin a hongsita ngala.
ENGLISH: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

PAITE: Mi dik sika sih, mi a ut ngel kei hial ding ua, mi hoih sikin bel mi kuahiam bekin sih a ngap khamoh kei ding.
ENGLISH: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.

PAITE: Himahleh, Pathianin a hon itna a langsakta mi khialte i hih laia Kris I sika a sihna ah.
ENGLISH: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

PAITE: Huchiin, a sisana siamtan saka i om khit nungin, amah jiakin Pathian hehna laka kipan hotdamin i om mahmah ngei ding hi.
ENGLISH: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

PAITE: Melma i hih laia bawn a Tapa sihna jiaka Pathian toh nakitam khin i hih ngal un tuh, kitama i om khit nung un a hinna jiakin hotdamin i om sem ding hi.
ENGLISH: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

PAITE: Huchi kia leng ahi keia, kitamna tua honmu sakpa i Toupa Jesu Kris jiakin Pathian ah leng i kipak ahi.
ENGLISH: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

PAITE: Huchiin, mi khat jiakin khelhna khovelah a luta, khelhna jiakin sihna a luta, huchimahbangin mi tengtenga jelsuakta hi.
ENGLISH: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.

PAITE: Dan om ma in khovel ah khelhna a om khin ngala; dan a om louh laiin khelhna tuh khelhna a sim ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

PAITE: Himahleh, Adam oma kipan Mosi om phain Adam tatlekna banga thil hih khial loute tungah leng sihnain vai a hawm jel hi. Adam tuh hongpai ding tehpihna ahi.
ENGLISH: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

PAITE: Himahleh, thilthawnpiak jaw tatlekna toh a kibang kei. Mi khat tatlekna jiaka mi tampi a sih ua leh Pathian hehpihna leh mi khat Jesu Kris hehpihna thilthawnpiak tuh a kiching zosema mi tampi tunga vuhin a om.
ENGLISH: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

PAITE: Huan, thilthawnpiak tuh mi khat tatlekna gah toh leng a kibang sam kei. Mi khat tatlekna tunga vaihawmna in siamlouh tansakna a tuna, mi tampi tatlekna tunga thilthawnpiakin bel siam tansakna a tun hi.
ENGLISH: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.

PAITE: Mi khat tatlekna jiaka sihnain huai mi khat mah pansana vai a hawm leh, hehpihna kiningching mahmah leh diktatna thawnpiak tangten mi khat Jesu Kris pansanin hinna a vai a hawm zosem ding uhi.
ENGLISH: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

PAITE: Huan, mi khat tatleknain mi tengteng adinga siamlouh tansakna a tut mah bangin, mi khat diktatna thilhih-in mi tengteng adingin suahtakna leh hinna a hontun hi.
ENGLISH: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

PAITE: Banghanghiam i chih leh, mi khat thumanlouhna jiaka mi tampi mikhiala bawl ahih bangun, mi khat thumanna jiakin mi tampi mi diktata bawl ahi ding uhi.
ENGLISH: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

PAITE: Khelhna latsak sem nadingin Dan a hongom behlapa; Ahihhangin khelhna a khanna peuh ah hehpihna a khang sem,Huchia, khelhnain sihnaa vai a hawm bangtaka, hehpihna inleng i Toupa Jesu Kris pansana diktatna jiaka khantawn hinna donga vai a hawm theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;

PAITE: Huchia, khelhnain sihnaa vai a hawm bangtaka, hehpihna inleng i Toupa Jesu Kris pansana diktatna jiaka khantawn hinna donga vai a hawm theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

PAITE: Bang i genta dia leh? Hehpihna a khan sem theihna dingin khelhna ah i om nilouh ding ua hia?
ENGLISH: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

PAITE: Om nilouh lou hial ding. Eite khelhna lama sisa, khelhna ah bangchin i hing thei lailai dia?
ENGLISH: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

PAITE: Eite Kris Jesu-a baptis luta om tengteng a sihna ah baptis lutin i om chih na theikei ua hia?
ENGLISH: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

PAITE: Huaijiakin a sihna a baptis luta omin amah toh vuikhawmin i om uhi, huchia Pa thupinain misi laka kipana Kris a kaihthohtak banga eite leng hinna thaka i khosak theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: We were buried therefore with him through baptism to death, that just like Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

PAITE: A sihna ki batpih a amah toh i kizop khit ngal un tuh, a thohnawnna kibatpihin leng i kizom sam ding hi.
ENGLISH: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

PAITE: I mihing lui a kiangah kilhdenin a om samta chih i thei; huchia khelhna pumpi hihmanthata a om theihna ding leh tua kipana khelhna sikhaa i om louhna dingin.
ENGLISH: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

PAITE: Kuapeuh sisa tuh, khelhna lakah a suakta ta ngala.
ENGLISH: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

PAITE: Huan, Kris kianga I suh sam tak aleh, a kiangah I hing sam ding chih I gingta ahi;
ENGLISH: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;

PAITE: Kris tuh misi laka kipan kaihthohin a oma, a si nawn kei ding chih i thei ngal ua; sihnain amah tungah thu a neita kei hi.
ENGLISH: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!

PAITE: A sihna tuh khelhna lam thu ah khantawna din khat vei kia a si ahi, a hinna bel Pathian lam thu ah a hing ahi.
ENGLISH: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

PAITE: Huchi mahbangin nou leng khelhna lam thu ah sisain kisep unla, Pathian lam thu ah bel Kris Jesu ah hingin kisep un.
ENGLISH: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, na pumpi uh duhgawlna thu mang dingin na pumpi si thei uah khelhna vaihawm sak kei un.
ENGLISH: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

PAITE: Na pumpi hiangte uh leng diklouhna vanzat dingin khelhna kiangah pe phal sam kei un; a hihhangin misi laka kipan hing nawn bangin Pathian kiangah kipia unla, na pumpi hiangte uh leng dikna vanzat dingin Pathian kiangah pe phal jaw un.
ENGLISH: Neither present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

PAITE: Banghianghiam i chih leh, khelhnain na tunguah thu a nei takei ding, dan vaihawma om na hi kei ua, hehpihna vaihawma om na hi jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.

PAITE: Bangchin ahi dia leh? Dan vaihawm a om i hih kei ua, hehpihna vaihawma om i hih jawk jiakin i khial ding uh ahi diam?
ENGLISH: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!

PAITE: Hilou hial ding. Kua kiang peuhah leng a thu mang dinga a sikha dia na lut un tuh sihna khopa khelhna sikha hiam, dikna khopa thu mang sikha hiam, a thu na man uh sikha na hi uh chih na theikei ua hia?
ENGLISH: Don’t you know that to whom you present yourselves as servants to obedience, his servants you are whom you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

PAITE: Ahihhangin, khelhna sikha nahita mahle uchin, thuginpi huaia na kipiakna uh, lungtang taktakin na juita ua, Pathian kiangah kipahthu om heh;
ENGLISH: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto you were delivered.

PAITE: Khelhna laka kipan suahtak sakin nong om ua, dikna sikhate na honghita uhi.
ENGLISH: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

PAITE: Na sa uh hat louh jiakin mihing danin thu ka gen hi; na sa hiangte uh nitna kiang leh, tatlekna dinga tatlekna kianga sikha dia na piak phal bang un, tuin na sa hiangte uh sangthouna dingin dikna kiangah sikha dingin pe phal un.
ENGLISH: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

PAITE: Khelhna sikhate na hih lai un dikna lakah na siang ua.
ENGLISH: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.

PAITE: Tua na thil zahpih sate uah, huai laiin gah bang ahia nanamuh jel uh?
ENGLISH: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

PAITE: Huai thil tawpna jaw sihna a nahi nak ahi. Tunah bel khelhna laka hihsianga omin, Pathian sikhate na honghih un, siangthouna mu khopin na gah uh na nei uh a keihiam, huai tawpna khantawna hinna toh.Khelhna man tuh sihna ahi ngala Pathian thilthawnpiak bel i Toupa Kris Jesu jiakin khantawna hinna ahi.
ENGLISH: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.

PAITE: Khelhna man tuh sihna ahi ngala Pathian thilthawnpiak bel i Toupa Kris Jesu jiakin khantawna hinna ahi.
ENGLISH: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

PAITE: Ahihleh, unaute aw, danin mi a dam sung teng a tungah vai a hawm nak chih na theikei ua hia? – dan thei mite kiangah ka gen ahi.
ENGLISH: Or don’t you know, brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

PAITE: Numei, pasal nei a pasal a dam sung teng dana a pasala henkhawmin a om ahi; himahleh, a sihin, pasal lamah dan akipan khahin a om ahi.
ENGLISH: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

PAITE: Hichiin, a pasal dam sunga mi dang a kitenpih leh, Angkawm, chih ahi ding hi; a pasal a sihin bel huai dan akipan khahin a oma, huchiin, mi dang nei leh leng angkawm ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

PAITE: Huan, ka unaute aw, Pathian lama i gah theihna dingin midang, misi laka kipan kaihthoh ngeingei na kitenpih theihna ding un, Kris pumpi pansanin dan lamah hihsihin na omta uhi.
ENGLISH: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bring forth fruit to God.

PAITE: Sa a i om lai un dan jiaka khelhna utna hongsuakten, i sa hiangte ah, sihna khopa gah dingin, a sem naka.
ENGLISH: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law, worked in our members to bring forth fruit to death.

PAITE: Tuin bel honlenpa lakah sikhinin, dan akipan khahin i omta, laigelh lui bang lel hi loua, Khaa hinna thaka na i sep theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

PAITE: Bang i genta dia leh? Dan khelhna hia? Hi lou hial. Himahleh, dan jiaka theih hi keileh, khelhna theilou ding hi ing a; danin, eng ken, chi kei leh, eng chih theilou ding hi inga.
ENGLISH: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin, except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting, unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.” Exodus 20:17; Deuteronomy 5:21

PAITE: Himahleh, khelhnain, thupiak jiakin, lemtan lai muin enna chiteng ka sungah a om saka.
ENGLISH: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

PAITE: Dan lou injaw khelhna si ahi. Huan, tumalamin kei dan louin ka hinga; himahleh thupiak a hongom takin khelhna a honghalh a, kei ka sita hi.
ENGLISH: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

PAITE: Huan, hinna thuchiam nei thupiak tuh keidin sihna a honghi chih ka na theita.
ENGLISH: The commandment, which was for life, this I found to be for death;

PAITE: Khelhnain thupiak jiakin, lemtan lai muin honkhema, thupiak zangin a honhihlumta hi.
ENGLISH: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

PAITE: Huchiin, dan tuh a siangthou ahi, thupiak leng a siangthou a, adika, a hoih ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

PAITE: Ahihleh, thil hoih keia din sihna a honghi ahia? Hilou hial. Khelhna kei sin sihna a honghi zo ta ahi. Huchiin, khelhna tuh khelhna ahi chih a lat theihna dingin thil hoih zangin a honhihlum ahi; thupiak jiaka khelhna tuh khelhna thupitak a honghih theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, by working death to me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceeding sinful.

PAITE: Dan tuh khalam thil ahi chih i thei ngal ua, kei bel sami khelhna a khotsa ka hi.
ENGLISH: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

PAITE: Thil ka hihpen, a dan ka theikei; ka thil hih jelpen, ka thihih utlam ahi ngal keia, ka thil huatlam tak ka hih zo nak ahi.
ENGLISH: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

PAITE: Ka hih ut louh lam ka hih ngalin, dan a hoih chih pompih ka hi ta hi.
ENGLISH: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

PAITE: Huaichiangin, ka thilhihpen keimah hih a hita keia, khelhna keimaha om hih ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

PAITE: Keimah ah, huai tuh ka sa ah, thil hoih himhim a teng kei chih ka thei: thil hoih hih utna jaw keimah ah a om na a, thil hoih ka hihthei kei.
ENGLISH: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

PAITE: Hoihna hih ka ut pen ka hih keia, khelhna hih ka ut louhpen, ka hih zo naka.
ENGLISH: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

PAITE: Ka utlouh lam pen ka hih ngal chiangin, a hihpa tuh kei ka hita keia, khelhna keimaha ompen ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

PAITE: Huchiin, hiai dan ka hontheita; thil hoih hih ka ut laiin gitlouhna ka kiangah a hongom nak ahi.
ENGLISH: I find then the law, that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

PAITE: Ka lungsim taktakin Pathian dan tungah ka kipak ngal naka;
ENGLISH: For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,

PAITE: Himahleh, ka sa hiangte ah dan tuam a om chih ka thei, huaiin ka lungsim dan a dou a, ka sa hiangtea khelhna dan om kiangah salin a honpi nak hi.
ENGLISH: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

PAITE: Mi genthei hina lawmlawm ing e! Hiai sihna pumpi lakah kuan ahia honsuakta sak ding?Jesu Kris i Toupa jiakin Pathian kiangah kipahthu ka gen ahi. Huchiin, keimah takin jaw ka lungsimin Pathian dan ka sema, ka sain tuh gitlouhna dan a sem hi.
ENGLISH: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

PAITE: Jesu Kris i Toupa jiakin Pathian kiangah kipahthu ka gen ahi. Huchiin, keimah takin jaw ka lungsimin Pathian dan ka sema, ka sain tuh gitlouhna dan a sem hi.
ENGLISH: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, the sin’s law.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, tun jaw Kris Jesu a omte adingin, siamlouh tansakna himhim a omta kei hi.
ENGLISH: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit. NU omits “who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit”

PAITE: Kris Jesu a Hinna Kha dan in khelhna leh sihna dan akipan honsuakta sakta ngala.
ENGLISH: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

PAITE: Sa jiaka dan a hat louh a, ahihtheih vual louh tuh, Pathianin, amah Tapa ngei, khelhna sa gilou bang puin, khelhna thoihna dia honsawlin, sa a khelhna om tuh siamlouh a tangsakta ahi,
ENGLISH: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh;

PAITE: Sa dan juilou a Kha dan jui zote eimaha danin a ngiat diktatna tuh tangtuna a om theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

PAITE: Sa dana omten sa lam thilte a lunggulh nak uh; Kha dana omten bel Kha lam thilte a lunggulh nak uhi.
ENGLISH: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

PAITE: Sa lam thilte deih jaw sihna ahi ngala, Kha lam thil deih bel hinna leh khamuanna ahi;
ENGLISH: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

PAITE: Sa deihdan jaw Pathian douna a hih jiakin. Huai tuh Pathian danin a om ngal keia, om leng a om theikei himhim ahi.
ENGLISH: because the mind of the flesh is hostile towards God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

PAITE: Huchiin, saa omten Pathian a kipaksak theikei uh.
ENGLISH: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

PAITE: Himahleh, Pathian Kha noumaua a om taktak leh, saa om na hi kei ua, Khaa om na hi jaw uhi. Ahihhangin kuapeuh Kris Kha neilou jaw amaha ahi kei.
ENGLISH: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

PAITE: Kris noumaua om ngal leh, khelhna jiakin pumpi a si ahi; kha tuh dikna jiakin a hing ahi.
ENGLISH: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

PAITE: Himahleh misi laka kipan Jesu kaithou nawnpa Kha nou maua a om leh, misi laka kipan Kris Jesu kaithou nawnpan, noumaua om a Kha pansanin na pumpi sitheite uh a hihhing sam ding hi.
ENGLISH: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, unaute aw, bat i nei; sa dana om dingin sa lakah bel ahi kei;
ENGLISH: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

PAITE: Sa dana na om u leh, na si mahmah ding uhi; ahihhangin pumpi thilhihte Kha a na hihlup jel u leh na hing ding uhi.
ENGLISH: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

PAITE: Pathian Kha pia om peuhmah te jaw, Pathian tate ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

PAITE: Laua om nawn dingin sikha hihna kha na tang uh ahi ngal keia; ta hihna kha na tang uh ahi jaw. Abba! Pa! chia, i kikou chiangin,
ENGLISH: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba Abba is an Aramaic word for father or daddy, often used affectionately and respectfully in prayer to our Father in heaven. ! Father!”

PAITE: Kha mahmahin, eimah kha toh, Pathian tate i hi chih hontheisak hi;
ENGLISH: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

PAITE: Huan, tate i hih leh, gou luahpihte i hi hi; Pathian gouluahte, Kris luahpihte i hi a; a kianga pahtawia i om sam theihna dinga amah i thuakpih taktak leh.
ENGLISH: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint heirs with Christ; if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

PAITE: Tulai a thuaknate peuh denchianga i tunga thupina hihlat ding toh tehpihthamin kasep kei.
ENGLISH: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

PAITE: Thilsiam tengteng ten, lamen mahmah in, Pathian tate honglatna a ngaklah mahmah ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

PAITE: Thilsiam tengtengte thil thulimlou thuthua om sakin a omta uh; a ut ua om ahi kei ua, lametnaa a omsakpa jiak ahi jaw hi;
ENGLISH: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

PAITE: Thilsiam tengteng leng siatna sikhaa kipan suahtaksakin a om ding ua, Pathian tate noplenna thupia lut ding ahi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

PAITE: Thilsiam tengteng tu tanin thum leh nauveina thuakin a om uh chih i thei ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

PAITE: Thilsiamte kia hilou-in, eite ngei, Kha gahmasa tengte leng, ta hihna kilatna, i pumpi tatna ngakin i lungsimin i mau sam ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

PAITE: Hiai lametnaa hotdam i hi ngal ua. Himahleh muh theih gige lametna jaw lametna ahi kei. Kuan a muh theih gige a lamena?
ENGLISH: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

PAITE: I muh louhpen i lamet lebel i ngak teitei hi.
ENGLISH: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

ENGLISH: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

ENGLISH: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.

ENGLISH: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers. The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

PAITE: Huan, a seh kholhte tuh a sam laia; huan a sapte tuh siam a tangsak laia; huan, siam a tansakte tuh a pahtawi lai hi.
ENGLISH: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

PAITE: Huai thu ah bang i gen dia leh? Pathian ei lama a pan leh kuan ahia hondou thei ding?
ENGLISH: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

ENGLISH: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

PAITE: Pathian mi telte kuan ahia hek ding? Siamtangsakpapen Pathian ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

ENGLISH: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

ENGLISH: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

ENGLISH: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

ENGLISH: Not only so, but Rebecca also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

PAITE: Naupangte a pian ma un, sia leh pha a hih ma un, thilhih jiak hilou in, a sampa deih jiak hi jawin, tel lam thu ah Pathian thu seh tuh a kip theihna dingin-a kiangah;
ENGLISH: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls, NA puts the phrase “not of works, but of him who calls” at the beginning of verse 12 instead of the end of verse 11.

PAITE: A upa jawin a naupang jaw na a sem ding, Pathianin a chi ahi.

PAITE: Laisiangthou in Pharo kiangah, Hiai jiak takin ka hontungding ahi, nanga ka thilhihtheihna ka taklat theihna ding leh, leitung tengtenga ka min a than theihna dingin, achi ngal a.

ENGLISH: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

ENGLISH: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?” Isaiah 29:16; 45:9

PAITE: Himahleh, dan thilhihte jiakin mi siamtangin a om kei hi, Jesu Kris gin jiak kia in siamtangin om jaw uh chih i thei ngala-en leng dan thilhih jiak hi louin, Kris ginna jiaka siamtanga i om theihna dingin, Kris Jesu tuh i ging ahi; dan thilhihte jiakin mihing himhim siamtanga om lou ding uh ahi ngala.

ENGLISH: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

PAITE: Pathian lama dia ka honghin theihna dingin, kei jaw dan jiakin dan lamah ka si khinta ngala.
ENGLISH: For I, through the law, died to the law, that I might live to God.

PAITE: Kris toh kilhdenin ka omta; himahleh ka hing ahi; keimah pen ka hita keia, Kris tuh keimah ah a hing ahi jaw; huan, tua saa ka hin bel ginnaa hing ka hi-Pathian Tapa, a honita ka sika kipepa, ginna ah.Pathian hehpihna tuh bangmah louin ka bawl kei, dan jiaka diktatna a om ngal injaw Kris a thawna si ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ living in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.

PAITE: Pathian hehpihna tuh bangmah louin ka bawl kei, dan jiaka diktatna a om ngal injaw Kris a thawna si ahi ding hi.
ENGLISH: I don’t make void the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

PAITE: Galatia gama mihaite aw, kuan honbumhai a maijena? na mitmuh ngei ua Jesu Kris kilhdena kichian taka latsak a hihhih toh.
ENGLISH: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth among you as crucified?

PAITE: Hiai leltak kon dong ding: Dan thilhihte jiakin hia Kha tuh na muh uh, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak jiak un?
ENGLISH: I just want to learn this from you. Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

PAITE: Hichitelin na hai umaw? Khaa pan khinta ngalin, sain na khin ding ua hia?
ENGLISH: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

PAITE: Thil huchi zahzah a thawna thuak na hi umaw? -a thawn hi taktak hita leh.
ENGLISH: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

PAITE: Huan, na kiang ua Kha honpepa leh na lak ua thillamdang hihpan dan thilhihte jiakin hia a hih, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak jiak un.
ENGLISH: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and works miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

PAITE: Abrahamin Pathian a gingtaa, huan, huai ginna tuh diktatnaa simsak a hihtak mahbangin.
ENGLISH: Even as Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

PAITE: Huchiin thei un, ginnaa omte, huaite mah tuh Abram tate ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.

PAITE: Huan, laisiangthouin, Pathianin ginna jiakin Jentelte siamtangsak dingin a kisa chih theikholin, Nangmah ah namte vualjawl sakin a om ding uh, chiin, Abraham kiangah tanchin hoih tuh a nagenkholta hi.
ENGLISH: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.” Genesis 12:3; 18:18; 22:18

PAITE: Huchiin ginnaa omte tuh ginna nei Abraham toh vualjawl sakin a om sam nak uhi.
ENGLISH: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

PAITE: Dan thilhiha kinga peuhmahte tuh hamse nuaiah a om ngal ua; Dan laibua thugelh tengteng banga hih gige lou peuhmah tuh hamsiatin om hen, chia, gelh ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.” Deuteronomy 27:26

PAITE: Tuin Pathian mitmuhin kuamah dana siamtang a om kei chih a lang kilkel hi. Ginnaa mi diktat tuh a hing ding, chih a hih jiakin.
ENGLISH: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.” Habakkuk 2:4

PAITE: Himahleh dan tuh ginnaa kinga ahi kei; Huchibanga hihpa tuh huaitein a hing ding, chih ahi jaw.
ENGLISH: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.” Leviticus 18:5

PAITE: Kris tuh ei sika hamsiatin a hongoma, dan hamsiatna akipanin a hontan kheta-Singa khailup peuhmah jaw hamsiat hi hen, chih gelh ahi ngala-
ENGLISH: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,” Deuteronomy 21:23

PAITE: Huchia Abraham tunga vulajawlna tuh Kris Jesu jiaka Jentelte tunga hongtun theiha, hucia kha chiam tuh ginna jiaka i muh theih nadingin.
ENGLISH: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

PAITE: Unaute aw, mihing hih dan gen leng: mihing thukhun lel leng, hihkipsa nung a phel kei ua, behlap leng a behlap ngeikei uhi.
ENGLISH: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.

PAITE: Huan, Abraham kiangah ahi, thuchiamte piak a nahih, a chisuan kiangah leng. Mi tampi tungthu gen bangin, Chisuante kiangah leng, a chi keia; mi khat tungthu gen bangin, Nang chisuan kiangah leng, a chi ahi jaw, huai tuh Kris ahi.
ENGLISH: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He doesn’t say, “To seeds,” as of many, but as of one, “To your seed,” Genesis 12:7; 13:15; 24:7 which is Christ.

PAITE: Huan, huchiin ka chi ahi: huai thuchiam tuh bangmahlou suaksaka hihmang dingin, thukhun Pathianin ana hihkipsa tuh, anung kum za li leh kum sawnthum khita hongom danin a hihmang theikei hi.
ENGLISH: Now I say this. A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

PAITE: Gouluah ding tuh dan jiak a hih leh, thuchiam jiak a nahita kei dinga; himahleh, Pathianin thuchiam jiakin ahi, Abraham kiangah a napiak.
ENGLISH: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

PAITE: Ahihkeileh, bangchithua dan tuh om ahia leh? Chisuan, thuchiamna tuh, a hongom masiah tatleknate jiakin behlapin a oma, angelte zanga palai khuta hihkip ahi.
ENGLISH: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

PAITE: Huan palai himhim mi khat lakah palai ahi ngei kei hi; Pathian bel khat ahi.
ENGLISH: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

PAITE: Ahihkeileh, danin Pathian thuchiam te a kalh ahia? Kalh lou hial, dan mi hihhingthei himhim piaka omkhin hita leh, diktanna tuh dan jiakin a om ngei ding hi.
ENGLISH: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

PAITE: Himahleh, Jesu Kris gin jiaka thilchiam tuh a gingtate kianga piak a hih theihna dingin laisiangthouin khelhna nuaiah bangkim a khakkhum vekta ahi.
ENGLISH: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

PAITE: Himahleh, ginna a hongtun main, ginna hongkilang ding ah khakkhumin, dan nuaia ven i nahi uhi.
ENGLISH: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

PAITE: Huchiin ginna jiaka siam i tan theihna dingin dan tuh Kris kiang lama honna chilpa ahi hi.
ENGLISH: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

PAITE: Himahleh, tua ginna a hongtun nungin, honchilpa nuaiah i omta kei uhi.
ENGLISH: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

PAITE: Kris Jesu gin jiakin Pathian tate na hi vek ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

PAITE: Na lak ua Krisa baptisluta om peuhmah tuh Krisin na kithuamta ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

PAITE: Huaiah tuh Juda mi a om theikeia, Grik mi leng a om theikei; huaiah tuh bawi a om theikeia, bawi lou leng a om theikei; huaiah tuh pasal leh numei leng a om theikei hi. kris Jesu ah na vek un pumkhat na hi ngal ua.Huan, Krisa na hih uleh, Abraham suan, thuchiam banga gouluah dingte na hi uhi.
ENGLISH: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

PAITE: Huan, Krisa na hih uleh, Abraham suan, thuchiam banga gouluah dingte na hi uhi.
ENGLISH: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to promise.

PAITE: Himahleh, hichiin ka chi: Gouluah dingpa tuh bangkim tungah toupa hi mahleh, naupang a hih laiteng bawi toh bangmahin a kidang tuan kei hi;
ENGLISH: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;

PAITE: A pa hun seh a hongtun masiah a donpate leh a kempate nuaiah a om jaw hi.
ENGLISH: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

PAITE: Huchibangin ei leng naupang i hih laiin, khovel thubulte nuaiah bawi hihna ah i om uhi;
ENGLISH: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

PAITE: Himahleh, a hunbi a hongkimin, Pathianin a Tapa, numei suanin, dan nuaia hongsuakin, a honsawl kheta,
ENGLISH: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

PAITE: Ta hihna i muh theihna dinga, dan nuaia omte tankhe dingin.
ENGLISH: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.

PAITE: Huan, tate na hih jiak un Pathianin a Tapa Kha tuh, Abba, Pa, chia kikouin, i lungtang uah a honsawl hi.
ENGLISH: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Abba is a Greek spelling for the Aramaic word for “Father” or “Daddy” used in a familiar, respectful, and loving way. Father!”

PAITE: Huchiin bawi na hita keia, ta na hi zota; huan, ta na hih leh, Pathian vanga gouluah dingpa na hi hi.
ENGLISH: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

PAITE: Himahleh tua Pathian na theih louh lai un, a piandan mawng ua Pathian hi lou hialte bawi na hi ua.
ENGLISH: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

PAITE: Tua Pathian na hontheih nung un bel-hi lou, Pathian theihmi na honghih nung un, chih ding ahi jaw-thubul jawngkhal leh namanloua bawia om nawn na utnate uh lama, bangchi dana kihei nawn na hi ua?
ENGLISH: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

PAITE: Nite, khate, hunte, kumte na tang jel ua.
ENGLISH: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

PAITE: Na tunguah tha ka seng thawn kha ding e aw, chih ka lau ahi.
ENGLISH: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

PAITE: Unaute aw, ka hongngen ahi, keimah bangin om un, kei leng noumau bangin ka om ngala, ka bangmah na suse kei uhi.
ENGLISH: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

PAITE: Tanchin Hoih na kiang ua ka gen masakna pen ka sa hat louh jiak ahi chih na thei ngal ua.
ENGLISH: but you know that because of weakness of the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

PAITE: Huan, ka saa nou dia khemna om tuh na simmoh kei ua, na kih sam kei uh; Pathian angel bangin, Kris Jesu bang hialin na honnapakta jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

PAITE: Vangpha na kisakna uh koiah a omta aleh? Hihtheih liai hi le houh, na mit khawng uh khelkhiain na honpe khin ding uh chih ka hontheihpih ahi.
ENGLISH: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

PAITE: Huchiin, thu tak ka honhilhna jiakin na melma uh ka honghita ahia?
ENGLISH: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

PAITE: Hoih lamah hi het lou napiin phatuam ngai takin nou a honzong khe jel uhi; ahi, amau lama hon zoh theihna ding un noute hon pokhakkhiak a ut uhi.
ENGLISH: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

PAITE: Thu hoih lamah bel chiklai peuhin phatuamngai taka zona om gige tuh a hoih ahi, na kiang ua ka om lai kia hi louin.
ENGLISH: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

PAITE: Ka unaute aw, Kris noumaua siam pichinga a om masiah, nauveiin ka honvei hi.
ENGLISH: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

PAITE: A hi, tulaiin na kiang ua oma, ka aw hihlamdan ka ut theihdan; na tungthu uah ka mang a bang ahi.
ENGLISH: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

PAITE: Dan nuaia om utte aw, honhilh un, dan thu na ngaikhe jel kei ua hia?
ENGLISH: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

PAITE: Hichibanga gelh ahi ngala. Abrahamin tapa nih a neia, khat tuh bawinu toh. khat tuh noplennu toh.
ENGLISH: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the free woman.

PAITE: Himahleh, bawinu laka pen tuh sa danin a pianga, noplennu laka pen bel thuchiam jiaka piang ahi, chih.
ENGLISH: However, the son by the handmaid was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

PAITE: Huai thute bang, gentehna ahi; huai numeite tuh thukhun nih ahi uhi; khat tuh Sinai tanga, bawi hi dinga, ta neinu; huai tuh Hagar ahi.
ENGLISH: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

PAITE: Huan, Hagar bel Arabia gama Sinai tang ahi a, Jerusalem tulaia om toh kibang ahi, a tate toh bawiin a om ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

PAITE: Tunglam Jerusalem bel noplen ahi; huai ngeingei tuh eite nu ahi hi.
ENGLISH: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

PAITE: Nang, ching, ta nei ngei lou, nuam in, nang, nauvei ngei lou, kikou khia in; pasal nei sangin lungjuangnun, tate a nei tam zo ngala, chih gelh ahi.
ENGLISH: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break forth and shout, you that don’t travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.” Isaiah 54:1

PAITE: Huchiin unaute aw, eite Isaak bangin thuchiam tate i hi a.
ENGLISH: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

PAITE: Himahleh, huailai bangin tuin leng ahi; sa dana piangin tuh Kha dana piang a sawi ahi.
ENGLISH: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

PAITE: Himahleh, laisiangthouin bangchi bangin a gena? Bawinu tuh, a tapa toh, hawlkhia un; bawinu tapain noplennu tapa tuh gou a luahpih louh ding jiakin, a chi a.Huchiin, unaute aw, bawinu tate i hi kei ua, noplennu tate i hi jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: However what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the handmaid and her son, for the son of the handmaid will not inherit with the son of the free woman.” Genesis 21:10

PAITE: Huchiin, unaute aw, bawinu tate i hi kei ua, noplennu tate i hi jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: So then, brothers, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the free woman.

PAITE: Noplen dingin Krisin a honsuaktasaktaa, huaijiakin ding kip unla, bawi hakkol ah jaw lut nawnta kei un.
ENGLISH: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

PAITE: Ngai un, kei Paulain na kiang ua ka gen tuh, zek na sum sak uleh Kris nou adingin bangmah phattuamna tuan hi lou ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

PAITE: A hi, dan thu tengteng jui dinga bate a na hi uh chih zeksumte tengteng kiangah ka theisak nawn ahi.
ENGLISH: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

PAITE: Nou dana siamtan tumte aw, Kris toh kikhenta na hi uh, hehpihna na puksanta uhi.
ENGLISH: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

PAITE: Kou bel Kha jiakin ginnain diktanna lametna ka ngak uhi.
ENGLISH: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

PAITE: Kris Jesu ah bel zeksum bangmah a phatuam keia, zeksum louh leng bangmah a phatuam sam kei; ginna, itnaa sem a phatuam ahi.
ENGLISH: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.

PAITE: Hoih takin na tai uh; thutak tuh na zuih louhna ding un kuan a hondala ahia?
ENGLISH: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

PAITE: Hiai khemna jaw nou honsampa kianga kipan ahi kei hi.
ENGLISH: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

PAITE: Silngou tawm chikin tanghou beupi a jel suakzou hi.
ENGLISH: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

PAITE: Kei ngaihtuahna banglouin na ngaih tuah lamdang tuan kei ding uh chih, Toupa ah ken jaw nou ka honmuang ahi; himahleh, nou honhih hai, kuapeuh hitaleh zong, a tunga thupuk ding a thuak ding hi.
ENGLISH: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

PAITE: Unaute aw, ken zeksum thu ngen lailai ka hihin, bang jiaka sawia om lai ka hia? Huchibang a hih ngal leh kros kisuihna tuh hihmang a hita ding hi.
ENGLISH: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

PAITE: Nou honhihbuaite amau leh amau kisat khe vanglak le uh ka deih ahi.
ENGLISH: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

PAITE: Nou, unaute aw, bawi hilou dingin sap na hi ngal ua; himahleh, na bawi hih louhna u tuh sa adinga lemtannan zang kei unla, itnain akua akua adinga kisepsakte hi jaw un.
ENGLISH: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

PAITE: Nangmah na kiit bangin na vengte na it ding ahi, chih thu kam khat ah dan thu tengteng kimsakin a om ngal a.
ENGLISH: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Leviticus 19:18

PAITE: Himahleh, na kikeih ua, na kinek tuah uleh na kinekgaih louhna ding un, pilvang un.
ENGLISH: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

PAITE: Huchiin hiai ka chi ahi, Kha ah om un, huan sa utna tuh na hihtangtung kei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

PAITE: Sain Kha dou a ut naka, Khain leng sa dou a ut sam nak ahi; thil hih na tupte uh na hih theihlouhna ding un huaite khawng a kikalh uh ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

PAITE: Himahleh Kha pia na om uleh, dan nuaiah na om kei uhi.
ENGLISH: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

PAITE: Huan sa thilhihte tuh a kilang chian ahi, huaite tuh hiaite ahi uh: angkawmna, kingaihna, thanghuaina, hukna,
ENGLISH: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

PAITE: Milimbiakna, bumna, huatna, kinakna, hajatna, hehna, kilanna, omtuamna, gintuamna
ENGLISH: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

PAITE: Deihgohna, tualthahna, zumunnopna, zukhamna, hichite khawng; huchibanga thil hih chingten Pathian gam a tang kei ding uh, chia tumaa ka honhilh kholh mahbangin, ka honhilh khol ahi.
ENGLISH: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.

PAITE: Kha gah ahihleh, itna, kipahna, lemna, thuaktheihna, migitna, hoihna, muanhuaina,
ENGLISH: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, or, faithfulness

PAITE: Nunnemna, kidektheihna khawng ahi jaw uh; huchibang kalh lamin dan thu piak himhim a om kei hi.
ENGLISH: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

PAITE: Huan, Kris Jesu-a hitaten tuh sa, a lunggulhna leh a duhgawlna toh a kilhdenta uhi.
ENGLISH: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

PAITE: Khaa hing i hih leh kha mahah i om ding uhi.Kitoutuah chiata, kihaza chiatin, i kikoih lian kei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

PAITE: Kitoutuah chiata, kihaza chiatin, i kikoih lian kei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

PAITE: Unaute aw, mi takhial bangpeuh a hihlai phawkin naom leh, nou kha mite aw, Khemna ka tuak sam kha ding e, chia kiveng hoih kawmin, huchibang mi tuh nunnemna lungsim toh dingsak thak nawn un.
ENGLISH: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

PAITE: Na puakgikte uh kidawn chiat un, huchiin Kris dan thu na jui uh ahi ding.
ENGLISH: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

PAITE: Mi bangmah hi lou piin, mi lian kuama a kibawl leh, a kikhem tawm lel ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

PAITE: Mi chihin amah thilhih tuh enchian chiat jaw hen; huchia midang toh kiteha-ki-uangsak lou-a amahmaha suanhuai thil ahih theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.

PAITE: Mi chihin amah puak po ding ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For each man will bear his own burden.

PAITE: Huan, thuhilha omin thil hoih tengteng a hilhpa kiangah pe sam hen.
ENGLISH: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

PAITE: Khemin om kei un; Pathian jaw zekhema mawkbawl vual ahi kei; min a tuh peuh uh huaimah a at nawn ngei ding a hih jiakin.
ENGLISH: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

PAITE: Amah salama tuhin saa om siatna a at ding. Khalama tuhin bel khaa kipan khantawn hinna a at ding.
ENGLISH: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

PAITE: Huchiin, thil hoih hih chimtak kei ni; i lungkiak keileh a hun takah i at ngei ding ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.

PAITE: Huchiin, lemtang hun i neihdan bang jelin mi tengteng tungah thil hoih hih ni, ginna inkuanpihte laka omte tungah hi khol diak hen.
ENGLISH: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

PAITE: Keimah khut mahmaha na kiang ua lai gol pipia ka hichi gelh en un.
ENGLISH: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

PAITE: Saa mel kilawmsak utte peuhmahin zeksuma om dingin nou a honsawl teitei nak ua; bangmah dang jiak leng ahi keia, Kris kros jiaka sawi a thuak louhna ding lel uh ahi.
ENGLISH: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

PAITE: Zeksumte nangawnin leng dan thu a jui tuan sam kei ua, na sa uah, suan ding a neih theihna dingun na zek uh kisum leh chih a ut lel uh ahi.
ENGLISH: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

PAITE: Ken jaw i Toupa Jesu Kris kros loungal ka suan louh dingdan, huai kros jiakin khovel kei adingin kilhdenin ka om hi.
ENGLISH: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

PAITE: Siamthak nawnna lou jaw, zeksum chih bangmah ahi keia, zeksumlouh leng bangmah ahi sam kei hi.
ENGLISH: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

PAITE: Huan, huai dan banga om peuhmahte tungah lemna leh hehpihna om hen, Pathian Isrealte tung ngei ah.
ENGLISH: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

PAITE: Tubansiah kuamahin honhihbuai nawn kei hen; ka pumpi ah Jesu chiamtehnate ka pu ngala.Unaute aw, Toupa Jesu Kris hehpihna na kha kiang uah om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

PAITE: Unaute aw, Toupa Jesu Kris hehpihna na kha kiang uah om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

PAITE: Paula, Pathian deihlama Kris Jesu sawltakin, misiangthou Ephesa khuaa om Kris Jesu-a mi ginomte kiangah:
ENGLISH: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

PAITE: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Kris kianga kipan hehpihna leh lemna na kiang uah om hen.
ENGLISH: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PAITE: I Toupa Jesu Kris Pa leh Pathian phatin om hen. Aman vanmun khawnga khalam vualjawlna chitengin eite kris ah honvualjawlta,
ENGLISH: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;

PAITE: Amah maia siangthou leh dembeia om dinga leitung pian maa eite honnateltak bang ngeiin.
ENGLISH: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without blemish before him in love;

PAITE: Aman a deiha a tup bangbangin, eite Jesu Kris vanga a tate hi dingin, itna jiakin honnasepkhol khinta,
ENGLISH: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

PAITE: Huchi-a It-a a honpiak hondeihsakna thupi mahmah pahtawina i hih theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely bestowed favor on us in the Beloved,

PAITE: A sisan jiakin Amah ah tatkhiakna, huai a hehpihna hauhdan bangbanga i tatleknate ngaihdamna ngei i tangta hi,
ENGLISH: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

PAITE: Tua hehpihna tuh chillou hialin aman eite a honpeta.
ENGLISH: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

PAITE: A thiltup, Kris-a a gelkhiak, bangbangin a deihlam thuguk tuh pilna leh theihsiamna ngenin eite hontheisakta ngala;
ENGLISH: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

PAITE: Huai a deihlam thilgel bel; hunbi hongkim chianga, thil tengteng-vana omte leh leitunga omte-Kris-a gawmkhawma a suktuah vek ding tuh ahi.
ENGLISH: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;

PAITE: Amah deihlam, a lunggel bangbanga thilbangkim semkhepa tup bang ngeiin, amah mah-ah
ENGLISH: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his will;

PAITE: Koute, Kris-a ana lamen masate, a thupina pahtawina dinga hing dingin sehkholhin kana omkhinta uhi.
ENGLISH: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

PAITE: Huan, noute, thutak thu, na hotdamna tanchinhoih uh ngaikhiaa gin leng gingtate leng, amah ah chiamsa Kha Siangthou-a chiamtehin na om uhi;
ENGLISH: in whom you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

PAITE: Huai Kha Siangthou bel i gouluah ding tatna kim i luah matenga, Pathian thupina dinga, khamna ahi.
ENGLISH: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

PAITE: Huaijiakin ken leng Toupa Jesua ginna na lak ua om, misiangthoute tengteng tunga na kitheihsak jel uh ka najakin,
ENGLISH: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,

PAITE: Ka thumnate ah na min uh lou-in nou jiaka kipahthu gen ka tawp kei hi;
ENGLISH: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

PAITE: I Toupa Jesu Kris Pathian, thupina Pan Amah theihna lam thu-a pilna leh kilakna kha nou a honpiak theihna dingin,
ENGLISH: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

PAITE: Huchia, na lungsim mitte uh hihvaka hongoma, na theihna ding un-huaibel, Aman nou a honsapna lametna bang; misianthoute-a a gouluah hauhsaknate bang;
ENGLISH: having the eyes of your hearts TR reads “understanding” instead of “hearts” enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
