PAITE: Huan, a gingta eite-a A thilhihtheihna thupina tehvuallouh, huai A hatna thupi sep bang jela,
ENGLISH: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

PAITE: Kris-a a sepzohtak, huchia amah misi lak akipana a kaihthoha, vanmun khawnga A taklama a tutsaka,
ENGLISH: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

PAITE: Lalnate, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate, vaihawmna tengteng tung leh tu khovel kia hilou-a khovel hongtung ding nangawna minsak chiteng tung tham peka a koih laia a sepzoh chih bang.
ENGLISH: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

PAITE: Huan Aman bangkim a khe nuai ah a koiha, amah tuh bangkim tengteng tunga Suptuam lutangin a bawl,Huai saptuam tuh a pumpi a hi-a, amah bang kima bangkim hihdimpa tangchinna ngei.
ENGLISH: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

PAITE: Huai saptuam tuh a pumpi a hi-a, amah bang kima bangkim hihdimpa tangchinna ngei.
ENGLISH: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

PAITE: Nou leng na tatlekna uleh na khelhnate uh jiaka si na hih lai un a honhihhinga;
ENGLISH: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

PAITE: Huaite ah, tumalamin hiai khoveldan bangin na naom ua, huihkhuaa thuneihna lal, tua thumanglou tate sunga sem lelpa kha dan bangin.
ENGLISH: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience;

PAITE: Huai thumanglou tate lakah eite leng tumalamin sa duhgawlna hihin, i sa utnate bangin i om vek ua, midangte bangmahin thangpaihna taa piang him i hi uhi.
ENGLISH: among whom we also all once lived in the lust of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

PAITE: Himahleh, Pathianin hehpihna hauin a honitna thupitak jiakin,
ENGLISH: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

PAITE: Tatleknate jiaka si i hih hilhial laiin leng, Kris toh a honhihhinga (hehpihnaa hotdam na hita uh),
ENGLISH: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved),

PAITE: Kris Jesu ah amah toh a honkaithou-a van munte ah amah kiangah a hontusak hi:
ENGLISH: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

PAITE: Huchia hun hong tung ding te khawnga, Kris Jesu-a i tunga migitna neia, a hehpihna nak hauhdan tuh a etsak theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

PAITE: Ginna jiaka hehpihnaa hotdam na hi ngalua; huai leng noumaua suak ahi keia, Pathian thawnpiak ahi;
ENGLISH: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

PAITE: Thilhih jiak ahi kei, huchilou injaw min a suang kha ding uhi.
ENGLISH: not of works, that no one would boast.

PAITE: Thil hoih hih dingin Kris Jesu ah siamna omin, amah khut suak i hi ngalua; huai thil hoih hih tuh i khosakdan dingin Pathianin a bawlkhol ahi.
ENGLISH: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, tumalama nou saa Jentelte, saa khuta sum, zeksum, a chihteun zeksumlouh, honchihte u aw,
ENGLISH: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision,” (in the flesh, made by hands);

PAITE: Huchihlaiin, Kris lou-in Isrealte khua-leh-tui toh kimidangin khovel ah lametna neilou leh Pathian lou-a omin, thuchiam thukhun lakah mikhualin na om uh chih thei gige un.
ENGLISH: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

PAITE: Tun bel, Kris Jesu ah nou nidanglaia gamlapia omte, Kris sisana hihnaiin na hongomta uhi.
ENGLISH: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

PAITE: Amah tuh i kilemna ahi ngala; aman ei nihte tuh khata siamin i kikala kimelmakna banglai tuh a hihchimta,
ENGLISH: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of partition,

PAITE: Thusehte leh dan thupiakte a saa hihmangin; huchia nihte tuh Amaha mihing thak khata siama kilemna a bawl theihna dingin;
ENGLISH: having abolished in the flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace;

PAITE: Huan, kros jiaka nihte tuh pumpi khata Pathian toh honkilemsak theiha, kimelmakna a beisak theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility thereby.

PAITE: Huan, a hongpaiin, nou gamlapia omte kiangah lemna tanchin hoih honhilha, naichika omte kiangah leng lemna tanchin hoih a hilh sam hi.
ENGLISH: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

PAITE: Amah jiakin Kha kibanga Pa kiang lut theihna i nei tuaktuak uhi.
ENGLISH: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

PAITE: Huchiin, tun tuh zin leh leng na hi nawnta kei ua, misiangthoute toh tualsung khat leh Pathian inkuanpihte na hi zota uhi.
ENGLISH: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

PAITE: Kris Jesu ngei tuh a ninga suang kiphamoh pen hiin, sawltakte leh jawlneite suangphum tunga lam na hi uhi;
ENGLISH: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

PAITE: Amahah tuh suang lep tuam chiat, kituak tak a suktuahin, Toupa ah temple siangthou a suak hi;Noute leng amah ah, Khaa Pathian omna ding huaia lep khawm na hi uhi.
ENGLISH: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

PAITE: Noute leng amah ah, Khaa Pathian omna ding huaia lep khawm na hi uhi.
ENGLISH: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

PAITE: Huchi a hih jiakin, kei Paula, nou Jentelte jiaka Kris Jesu hentain,
ENGLISH: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

PAITE: Nou adinga Pathian hehpihna kepna na a honpiak lam na theita ngei ding ua;
ENGLISH: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you;

PAITE: Huchia thuguk ka kianga theihsaka a omdan, tumaa tom chika ka gelh bangin.
ENGLISH: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

PAITE: Huaia na sim un Kris thuguk ka theihdan na theithei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;

PAITE: Huaituh tulaia a sawltak siangthoute leh a jawlnei siangthoute kiangah Kha theihsakin a omta bangin, tumalamin leng mihing tate kiangah theihsakin a om ngei kei hi;
ENGLISH: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

PAITE: Huaituh hiai ahi, Tanchin Hoih jiakin Kris Jesu ah, Jentelte gouluahpihte, pumpi hiangte, thuchiam tanpihte ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

PAITE: A thilhihtheihna sepdan banga, a thawna piak Pathian hehpihna tuh a honpiak bang jelin huai tanchin hoih nasemtu dinga bawl ka hi.
ENGLISH: of which I was made a servant, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

PAITE: Kei, misiangthou tengtenga neupen sanga neujaw kiangah hiai hehpihna piak ahi: Kris hauhsakna suikhiak vuallouh Jentelte kiangah gen dingin;
ENGLISH: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

PAITE: Huan, Pathian thil bangkim siampaa tangtawna sela naom, thuguk thilseh tuh bang ahia chih mi tengteng musak dingin;
ENGLISH: and to make all men see what is the administration TR reads “fellowship” instead of “administration” of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ;

PAITE: Huchia, Pathian pilna chiteng tuh vanmun khawnga lalnate leh thuneihnate kianga, saptuamte zanga, tu huna theihsak ahihna dingin;
ENGLISH: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

PAITE: Hiai tuh tangtawn thiltup, Toupa Jesu Kris Jesua a tup leh sep dan ahi.
ENGLISH: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

PAITE: Huai Kris Jesu i gin jiakin amahmahah maingalna leh hangtaka lut theihna i nei hi.
ENGLISH: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

PAITE: Huchiin, noute jiaka ka gimthuak jiakin lungkelou dingin ka honngen hi, huaite tuh na thupina uh ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

PAITE: Huai jiakin Pa maah ka khukdin jela;
ENGLISH: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

PAITE: Lei leh vana inkuan chiteng min phuah khiakna pa,
ENGLISH: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

PAITE: A thupina hauhdan bang jela, a Kha jiaka mihing sung lama thilhihtheihnaa hihhata a honom sak theihna dingin,
ENGLISH: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;

PAITE: Huan, Kris ginna jiaka na lungtang ua a ten theihna dingin, nou itnaa zungkai leh kingakna neia omin,
ENGLISH: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

PAITE: Misiangthou tengteng toh a zatdan, a saudan, a sandan, leh a thukdan khawng theih chian theihna leh,
ENGLISH: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

PAITE: Kris itna theih phaklouh, Pathian tangchinna chitengteng banga hihdima na om theihna ding un.
ENGLISH: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

PAITE: Huan, eimaha sem jel thilhihtheihna bangin, i nget leh i ngaihtuah tengteng sanga thupi zo tham hih theipa kiang ngeiah,Khantawnin suan tengteng tanin, saptuam te leh Kris Jesu ah thupina om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

PAITE: Khantawnin suan tengteng tanin, saptuam te leh Kris Jesu ah thupina om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, noute sapa na omna utoh kikhoma om dingin kei Toupaa hentain ka honngen hi,
ENGLISH: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

PAITE: Kingaihniamna leh migitna tengteng, thuaktheihna toh, itnaa kithuakzou zo chiata,
ENGLISH: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;

PAITE: Lemnaa Khaa kipumkhatna vom chinten dingin.
ENGLISH: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

PAITE: A Honsapna pen lametna mun khata sap na hih mahbang un pumpi khat leh Kha khat kia a om;
ENGLISH: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;

PAITE: Toupa khat, ginna khat, baptisma khat,
ENGLISH: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

PAITE: Bangkim Pathian leh Pa khat kia a oma; amah tuh bangkim tungah a oma, bangkim a mu suaka, bangkim sungah a om hi.
ENGLISH: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.

PAITE: Himahleh, Kris thilpiak tehna bang jelin hehpihna tuh i kiang chiat ah piak a om hi.
ENGLISH: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

PAITE: Huaijiakin ahi, Tung lama a kahtouh laiin matte tampi a pia, mihingte kiangah leng thilpiakte a pia, a chihna.
ENGLISH: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.” Psalm 68:18

PAITE: Huchiin, A kah tou, chih tuh, lei mun nuainung pente banga a hongsuk masak phot keileh, bangchi a hita ding leh?
ENGLISH: Now this, “He ascended,” what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

PAITE: Hongsukpen tuh, thil tengteng a hihdim theihna dingin, van tengteng tung peka kah toupa mah ahi.
ENGLISH: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

PAITE: Huan, khenkhatte sawltak hi dingin, khenkhatte jawlnei hi dingin, khhenkhatte Tanchin Hoih gen dingin, khenkhatte pastor hi dingin, khenkhatte thuhilh dingin a pia hi:
ENGLISH: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds or, pastors and teachers;

PAITE: Huai tuh misiangthoute thopna ding, nasepna sepna ding, Kris pumpi lam touhna dingin:
ENGLISH: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;

PAITE: Huai tuh ginna leh Pathian Ta theihna lama thukituaka, pichinga, Kris tangchinna latdan banga i vek ua i hongom masiaha ding ahi.
ENGLISH: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;

PAITE: Huchi-a mihingte diklouhna zekhemna banga lepchiah pila khem tawmtawma oma thuhilhna huih chitenga langkhat langkhata sep leh mut lengleng, naupang i hih nawn louhna dingun.
ENGLISH: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

PAITE: Itnaa thutak gena, bangkima Amah, lupen, Kris ngeia i khanlet jawk ding uh ahi.
ENGLISH: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;

PAITE: Amah akipan pumpi tengteng, kizopna chiteng sep jiaka, lemtaka suktuah leh kizomkhawma, hiang chihin sep dingdan bangtaka a sep chiangin pumpi a khanga itna ah amah leh amah akilam tou hi.
ENGLISH: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

PAITE: Tuin hiai ka genin Toupa ah kontheisak ahi, Jentelte a lungsim ginatlouhna uh pu-a a om bangun, na om nawn mahmah ding uh ahi kei;
ENGLISH: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

PAITE: Amau tuh a lungtang uh tak jiaka theihtheihlouhna jiakin Pathian hinna theihtheihna a pan posiahin a om uhi;
ENGLISH: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;

PAITE: A khenggawpta ua, sianglou chiteng hihna lama huaihamin jautatna ah a kipumpiak uhi.
ENGLISH: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

PAITE: Nou jaw huchibangin kris thu na zil kei uhi!
ENGLISH: But you did not learn Christ that way;

PAITE: A thu jaa amaha thuhilhna om khin na hih peuhmah uleh, jesua thutak a om bangin.
ENGLISH: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

PAITE: Na pianken lui uh, na nidanglai hindan uh segawpsa suahkhia unla,
ENGLISH: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;

PAITE: Na lungsim Kha uah a thakin hongom unla,
ENGLISH: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

PAITE: Pianken thak, diktatna leh sianthounaa Pathian batpiha siampen silh un.
ENGLISH: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

PAITE: Huchiin, juaugen tawpsanin, noumau inveng kiangah thudiktak gen chiat un; kihiang tuah chiat na hi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

PAITE: Heh unla, khelh jaw khial kei un; na hehna uh niin tum pih kei hen.
ENGLISH: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Psalm 4:4 Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

PAITE: Diabol leng mun awn sam kei un.
ENGLISH: neither give place to the devil.

PAITE: Gutain gu nawnta kei hen; tasam kianga piak ding a neih theihna dingin, a khuta thil hoih semin gim jaw hen.
ENGLISH: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

PAITE: Thu sia peuhmah na kam ua kipanin pawt kei hen; a khawk dan bang jela bawl hoih dingin thu hoih peuhmah pawt jaw hen, a ngaikhete adinga hehpihna a hohnghih theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for building up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

PAITE: Huan, Pathian Kha Siangthou tuh hihlungkham kei un, tatna nia dingin amahah chiamteh na hi uhi.
ENGLISH: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

PAITE: Khatna bang, thangpaihna bang, hehna bang, hanna bang, gensiatna tengteng tawpsanin omta hen, gitlouhna tengteng toh.Huan, kihehpih chiata lainatna neiin om unla, Pathianin Krisa a honngaihdam bangin, noumau leng kingaidam tuah chiat un.
ENGLISH: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.

PAITE: Huan, kihehpih chiata lainatna neiin om unla, Pathianin Krisa a honngaihdam bangin, noumau leng kingaidam tuah chiat un.
ENGLISH: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

PAITE: Huchiin, a ta deihtakte bangin Pathian omdan late hi un;
ENGLISH: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

PAITE: Huan, Krisin a honit a, namtui dinga Pathian kianga thilpiak ding leh kithoihna dinga i sika dia a kipiak bang mahin itnaah om un.
ENGLISH: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

PAITE: Himahleh, mi siangthoute hiha kilawm himin kingaih leh sianglou tengteng huaihamna toh, na lak uah loh khakin om kei hen.
ENGLISH: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

PAITE: Zahmohte, thuginalou gente, chiamniuh thu nangawn huaite bang a kilawm lou hi; huaite hih sangin kipahthu gen jaw un.
ENGLISH: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.

PAITE: Kingaihhat leh mi thanghuai leh, mi huaiham himhimin (mi huaiham jaw milim bemi a hi) Kris leh Pathian gamah tanding himhim a neikei uh chih na thei mahmah ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

PAITE: Kuamahin thuginalou peuhin honkhem kei uhen; huai thilte jiakin Pathian thangpaihna tuh thumanglou tate tungah a tung naknak ahi.
ENGLISH: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

PAITE: Huaijiakin amau kikoppih kei un.
ENGLISH: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

PAITE: Tuma lamin mial na hi ua, tun jaw Toupa ah vak na honghita uhi; vak tate bangin om un;
ENGLISH: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

PAITE: Vak gah tuh hoihna leh, diktatna leh, thutak tengteng ahi;
ENGLISH: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

PAITE: Toupa kipahna lamtak bang ahi hiam zong un.
ENGLISH: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

PAITE: Huan, mial thilhih gah nei ngei loute ah leng panna himhim neikei unla, pan naksangin a diklouhdan uh theisak jaw un.
ENGLISH: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

PAITE: A guka a thilhih nakte utuh a gen leng a zumhuai ngala.
ENGLISH: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.

PAITE: Himahleh, thil bangkim a diklouhdan muhtheiha om tuh vak hihlat ahi nak hi; muhtheiha om peuhmah tuh vak ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, Nang ihmu! hak inla, misi laka kipan thou in. Huchiin, Krisin vak honpe ding, chih ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

PAITE: Huan, mi pil loute banga om louin, mi pilte banga om jawin, na omdan uah pilvang un;
ENGLISH: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

PAITE: Nite a hoih louh jiakin hun na neih sungun atam theipen sem jel un.
ENGLISH: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

PAITE: Huaijiakin hai nuam dah unla, Toupa deihlam bang ahia chih thei jaw un.
ENGLISH: Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

PAITE: Huan, uain khamin om kei un, huaiah tuh kideklouhna a om ngala; Khaa dimin om jaw un,
ENGLISH: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

PAITE: Phatna late, Pathian late, khalam latea kihoupih chiata Toupa kianga na lungtang tengteng ua ging kilawm bawl leh lasain, leh.
ENGLISH: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

PAITE: I Toupa Jesu Kris mina, Pathian, Pa ngei kianga, bangkim tunga kipahthu gen gigein.
ENGLISH: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

PAITE: Kris laudansiamin kiniamkhiak chiat un.
ENGLISH: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.

PAITE: Jite aw, Toupa kianga na kiniamkhiak bang un, noumau pasalte kiangah kiniamkhiak un.
ENGLISH: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

PAITE: Kris tuh amah ngei pumpi hondampa hi a, saptuamte lutang a hih mahbangin, pasal tuh ji lutang ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

PAITE: Huchiin, saptuamte Kris kianga a kiniamkhiak mahbang un jite tuh bangkim ah a pasalte uh kiangah kiniamkhiak uhen.
ENGLISH: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

PAITE: Pasalte aw, na jite uh it un, Krisin saptuamte a ita, a sik ua a kipiak bangin,
ENGLISH: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;

PAITE: Huchia amau tuh tuia sila thua a hihsiangthou theihna dingin;
ENGLISH: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

PAITE: Huan, huchia, saptuamte tuh ninbang lou leh, vuai lou leh, huchibang thil mawngmawng pu loua, siangthou leh gensiatbeia om jawa, amah leh amah tuh saptuamte thupi taka a kipiak theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

PAITE: Huchimahbangin pasalten leng amau pumpi mah bangin amau jite tuh a it ding uh ahi. Amah ji itpa tuh amah kiit ahi.
ENGLISH: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

PAITE: Kuamahin amah sa mah aho ngei ngal keia, a vakin a deihthoh zo nak hi, Krisin saptuamte a vaka a deihthoh mah bangin;
ENGLISH: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;

PAITE: A pumpi hiangte i hi ngal ua.
ENGLISH: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

PAITE: Huaijiakin pasalin a nu leh a pa paisanin a ji a len chinten dinga, huan, a nih un sa pumkhat a honghita ding uh.
ENGLISH: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.” Genesis 2:24

PAITE: Hiai thuguk tuh a thupi hi, himahleh ken jaw Kris leh saptuamte thu ahi ka gen.Abang abang hileh, nou laka kuapeuhmah in amah a kiit bang in a ji it hen; ji mahin leng a pasal zahtak dingin pilvang hen.
ENGLISH: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.

PAITE: Abang abang hileh, nou laka kuapeuhmah in amah a kiit bang in a ji it hen; ji mahin leng a pasal zahtak dingin pilvang hen.
ENGLISH: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

PAITE: Naupangte aw, Toupa ah na nute uleh na pate uh thu mang un: huai tuh thil dik ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

PAITE: Na nu leh na pa zahtak in, (hiai tuh thupiak chiam nei masapen a hi),
ENGLISH: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

PAITE: Huchiin nang adingin a hoih dia, lei ah leng na dam sawt ding hi.
ENGLISH: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.” Deuteronomy 5:16

PAITE: Huan, nou pate aw, na tate uh hihthangpai kei unla, Toupa thuzohna ah leh hilhna ah kem jaw un.
ENGLISH: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

PAITE: Sikhate aw, Kris thumang bangin laudansiam leh linga lungtang khatin sa dana na pute uh thu mang un:
ENGLISH: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

PAITE: Mihing hihkipakte maimah banga mitmei kia veng louin, Kris sikha banga lungtanga Pathian deihlam hih jawin,
ENGLISH: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

PAITE: Mihing nasem phet hi louin, Toupa nasem bang jawa chitaktak kawma nasemin,
ENGLISH: with good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men;

PAITE: Mi chihin thil hoih a hih chiat peuhmah uh Toupa kianga kipanin a ngei mah a mu nawn ding uh chih theiin, bawi hiam, bawi louin hiam himahleh.
ENGLISH: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

PAITE: Huan, nou heutute aw, huchimahbangin, amau leh noumau Heutupa tuh van ah a om chih leh, aman mi deihsak tuam a neikei chih theiin vau louin a tunguah hih sam un.
ENGLISH: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

PAITE: A tawppenin, Toupa ah leh a hatna thagui ah thilhihtheihna neiin hongom un.
ENGLISH: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

PAITE: Diabol zekhemnate na dou zoh theihna ding un Pathian galvan kimin kivan un.
ENGLISH: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

PAITE: I doute jaw sa leh sisan ahi ngal kei ua, lalnate leh, thuneihna te leh, tu -a omlel mial tunga khovel vaihawmte leh, van mun khawnga kha gilouhon omte ahi jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, ni hoih loua na dou zohna ding un leh na hihzoh vek nung ua leng na din theihna ding un, Pathian galvan kim la un.
ENGLISH: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

PAITE: Huan, na kawng uh thutaka gakin, diktatna awmphaw zangin,
ENGLISH: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

PAITE: Lemna tanchin hoih vanzat tuh na khe ua bunin ding un:
ENGLISH: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;

PAITE: Huaite ban ah ginna lum la unla, huaiin mi gilou thal kuangthei tengteng na hihmit thei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

PAITE: Huan, hotdamna lukhu leh Kha namsau, Pathian thu la unla.
ENGLISH: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word from Greek rhema, which means spoken word of God;

PAITE: Thumna leh ngetna chitengin bangchik laipeuhin leng Khaah thum un. Huailam pangah tuh misiangthou tengteng adingin phatuamngai leh ngen bilbelin limsak un;
ENGLISH: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:

PAITE: Tanchin hoih thuguk hangsan taka theisak dinga, ka kam ka kata thugen saka ka om theihna dingin kei dingin leng honnget sak un.
ENGLISH: on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

PAITE: Ka gen ding bang hangsan taka ka gen theihna dingin. Huai tanchin hoih palai khainiang bun ka hi.
ENGLISH: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

PAITE: Himahleh, nou leng bangchibanga ka om, ka tanchin na theihtheihna ding un, Taikika, Toupaa unau deihtak leh nasempa muanhuaiin bangkim a honthei sak ding.
ENGLISH: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things;

PAITE: Huaijiakin amah na kiang uah ka honsawl ahi, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uh leh, aman na lungtang uh a khamuan sak theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.

PAITE: Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu kris kianga kipan lemna leh ginna tel itna unaute kiangah om hen.I Toupa Jesu Kris tul loua itte tengteng kiangah hehpihna om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PAITE: I Toupa Jesu Kris tul loua itte tengteng kiangah hehpihna om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

PAITE: Paula Pathian deihdana Kris Jesu sawltak leh Timothi i unauin.
ENGLISH: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

PAITE: Kolossa khuaa Kris mi siangthoute leh unau muanhuaite kiangah: Pathian i Pa kianga kipan hehpihna leh lemna n akiang uah om hen.
ENGLISH: to the saints and faithful brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PAITE: Nou adinga thum gigein Pathian i Toupa Jesu Kris Pa kiangah kipahthu ka gen uhi,
ENGLISH: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

PAITE: Kris Jesu na gindan uh leh misiangthou tengteng tunga itnna na neihdan uh ka jak tak jiakun,
ENGLISH: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

PAITE: Huaibel nou adinga lametna vana koihkholha a om jiak ahi. Huai lametna tanchin mah, tumain, tanchin hoih thutak thu ah na nazata ua;
ENGLISH: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News,

PAITE: Huai tanchin hoih tuh khovel tengteng ah gaha a khan jel mah bangin, na kiang uh hongtung a, chih taktaka Pathian hehpihna tuh na ngaihkhiak ua na jak ni ua kipanin, noumau ah leng gahin a khang jel ahi;
ENGLISH: which has come to you; even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;

PAITE: Huaimahbangin Epaphra i sikha hihpih ngaihtak laka na zil bang un, amah tuh kou sikin Kris nasempa muanhuai tak ahi a,
ENGLISH: even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on our behalf,

PAITE: Aman tuh Khaa na itna uh a honhilh hi.
ENGLISH: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, ka jak ni ua kipan kou leng noua dia thum leh nget ka tawp kei uhi; huchia khalam pilna leh theihna tengteng a a deihlam theihnaa hihdima nongom theihna dingun,
ENGLISH: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

PAITE: Huan, nasep hoih chitenga gaha, Pathian theihnaa hongkhanga, Amah kipah lamtaka Toupa a dia kilawmhima na hintheihna dingun.
ENGLISH: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

PAITE: Kipahna toh kithuah thuak-hatna leh kuhkalna nei dingin, A hatna thupi bangjela hihhatin hongom un;
ENGLISH: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy;

PAITE: Vaka misiangthoute gou luahpih dia honchingsak Pa kianga kipahthu genin.
ENGLISH: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;

PAITE: Aman tuh mial thuneihna lak akipan honsuaktasakin, a Tapa ittak gamah honkaisakta;
ENGLISH: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love;

PAITE: Amah ah tuh i tatkhiakna uh i mu un i khelhnate ngaihdamna tak.
ENGLISH: in whom we have our redemption, TR adds “through his blood,” the forgiveness of our sins;

PAITE: Amah tuh muh theih louh Pathian batpih, thilsiam tengtenga piang masapen ahi a;
ENGLISH: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

PAITE: Amah ah tuh bangkim siam ahi a, vana omte, leia omte toh, muhtheihte, muhtheihlouhte toh, laltutphahte leng, thuneihnate leng; bangkim amah siam ahi, amah ading maha siam ahi.
ENGLISH: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him.

PAITE: Huan, amah jaw bangteng om main leng a om him ahi, amah ah tuh bangteng a ding khawm chiat uhi.
ENGLISH: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

PAITE: Amah tuh pumpi (huai tuh saptuamte) lutang ahi a; bangkima tungnungpen a honghih theihna ding in, a bulpi, misi laka kipana piang masapen tuh ahi.
ENGLISH: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

PAITE: Amaha Pathian tangchinna tengteng a om Pa deihlam tak ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him;

PAITE: A kros sisana lemna nabawlin, amah ah bangkim amah toh a kilemsak hi; amah ngeiah leia thil omte leng, vana thil omte leng amah toh a kilemsak hi.
ENGLISH: and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth, or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

PAITE: Huan, nou, tumalamin na lungsim uah a melma na hi ua, na thilhih gilou ua amaha kipana khena naom na hi ua, himahleh tuin aman,
ENGLISH: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil works,

PAITE: A sihnain a pumpi ah amah toh noute a honkilemsakta hi, a maa siangthou tak leh, gensiatbei leh, mohsaktheihlouha a hondin sakna dingin,
ENGLISH: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without blemish and blameless before him,

PAITE: Kingakna neia kip taka oma, tanchin hoih na jak ua lametnaa kipana suan manga om loua, ginnaa na om gige peuhmah uleh; huai tanchin hoih tuh van nuaia thil siam tengteng laka tangkoupih ahi a; kei Paula leng huai nasem dia bawl ka hi.
ENGLISH: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

PAITE: Nou jiaka tu-a ka gimthuaknate ah ka kipak hi; huan, a pumpi jiaka Krisin a gimthuaknate ban zom jel ka hi: a pumpi tuh Saptuam ahi.
ENGLISH: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly;

PAITE: Noua dinga Pathian nasepna kei kianga piaka om bangjelin huai saptuam nasempa ka honghita, Pathian thu bukim taka theisak dingin.
ENGLISH: of which I was made a servant, according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,

PAITE: Huai Pathian thu tuh khantawn leh akhang akhanga kipana thuguk kisel pen ahi; tun bel misiangthoute kiangah latsakin a omta hi.
ENGLISH: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

PAITE: Amau kiangah, Jentelte laka huai thuguk thupina hauhsakna tamdan Pathianin theihsak a ut him ahi; huai thuguk tuh Kris noumaua om, thupina lametna pen tuh ahi:
ENGLISH: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory;

PAITE: Mi chih Krisa hoihkima ka piak theihna ding un, mi chih hilhin, mi chih pilna chitenga zilsakin, Amah tanchin ka gen jel uhi.Huchibang dingin, nakpi taka keimaha a sep sak thahatna tengteng zangin theih tawpin ka sem jel hi.
ENGLISH: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

PAITE: Huchibang dingin, nakpi taka keimaha a sep sak thahatna tengteng zangin theih tawpin ka sem jel hi.
ENGLISH: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

PAITE: Noumau leh Leodisia khuaa omte leh, saa ka mel mu lou peuhmahte adingin bangchibanga thupiin ahia nou adia ka kisuk na theih uh ka ut ngala;
ENGLISH: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

PAITE: Pathian thuguk a theihtheih ua, theihsiamna theihchetna kim hauhna tengteng lama, phan khawma a om ua, a lungtangte uh lungmuanga a om theihna dingin;
ENGLISH: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

PAITE: Pilna leh theihna gou tengteng tuh amah Krisa selguka om ahi.
ENGLISH: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.

PAITE: Kuamahin paukamsiama a honkhem louhna ding un, huaite ka gen ahi.
ENGLISH: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

PAITE: Sain na kiang uah omta kei leng zong, kipak taka omin, na kizen dan uleh Kris na gin kipdan uh enin, khain na kiang uah ka om ngala.
ENGLISH: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

PAITE: Huaijiakin Kris Jesu, Toupa tuh na kipahpih bang un, amah ah om un.
ENGLISH: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,

PAITE: Amaha zungkai leh lamtouha omin, a honzilsak bang un na ginna ua kiptaka omin, kipahthugenna hauin, amah ah om un.
ENGLISH: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

PAITE: Pilvang un, huchilouin jaw kuapeuhin Kris thu bang hi louin, mihing thugousiah leh khovel thubulte bang jawin a thupil uh leh khemna peuhin gallakin a honla kha ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.

PAITE: Amah ah Pathianna tangchinna chiteng tuh pumpi neiin a om gige ngala.
ENGLISH: For in him all the fullness of the Godhead dwells bodily,

PAITE: Amah ah tuh hinna tangchinna na neita ngal ua; amah tuh vaihawmna leh thuneihna tengteng lutang ahi.
ENGLISH: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;

PAITE: Kris zeksumna ah sa pumpi suah vekin amah mah ah khuta zeksum hi lou, zeksum na hi ua;
ENGLISH: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

PAITE: Baptismaa amah toh vui na hita ngal ua, huaimahah misi laka kipana Pathian nasep gintak jiakin amah toh kaihthoh na hi uhi.
ENGLISH: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

PAITE: Huan, noute na tatleknate a leh na sa uh zeksum louhnaa si na hi ua, noumau ngei tuh amah toh a honhing sak ahi;
ENGLISH: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

PAITE: I tatlekna tengteng hongaidama, batna lai thupiaka gelh i tung ua om eimah hondou gige tuh a thaimangta ngala; huai ngei tuh krosa kilhlumin a la kheta hi.
ENGLISH: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;

PAITE: Huan, lalna leh thuneihnate suankhiain, huai krosah huaite tuh zouin a langtangin theihsaknan a zangta hi.
ENGLISH: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

PAITE: Huchiin, nek thu ah hiam, dawn thu ah hiam, ankuanglui thu ah hiam, kha thak thu ah hiam, khawlni thu ah hiam, kuamahin hondem kei uhen;
ENGLISH: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

PAITE: Huaite tuh thil hongtung ding lim ahi a, a tak tuh Kris-a ahi.
ENGLISH: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

PAITE: Kuamahin amau deihthu lela thunuailutna leh angel biakna zangin, na kipahman uh honsuh sak kei uhen, a thil muhte uh pansanin, a sa lam lungsim jiak ua kisathei mawk mawkin,
ENGLISH: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

PAITE: Lutang tuh len chinten louin a om uhi. Amah akipanin pumpi tuh a pumin a guhtuah leh thaguite a vak leh zop khawma omin, Pathian apan khanletnain a khang lian jel hi.
ENGLISH: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

PAITE: Khovel thubulte tuh Kris kianga na nasihsan sam uleh, bang achia khovela nungta lailai banga thupiakte laka na nakipelut na hi ua?
ENGLISH: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

PAITE: Mihingte thuchiam leh zilsakna, Lawng ken, Chiam ken.
ENGLISH: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

PAITE: Khoih ken, chihte huchi bang thil tengteng tuh zat kawma mangthang ding ahi.Huchibang thil tuh, ut banga biak leh, thunuailut leh, pumpi engbawl ah jaw hihtuak hileh a kilawm naa, himahleh sa deihlam zuih khamna lamah tuh bangmah himhim a phatuam kei hi.
ENGLISH: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

PAITE: Huchibang thil tuh, ut banga biak leh, thunuailut leh, pumpi engbawl ah jaw hihtuak hileh a kilawm naa, himahleh sa deihlam zuih khamna lamah tuh bangmah himhim a phatuam kei hi.
ENGLISH: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

PAITE: Huchiin, Kris toh kaihthoh khawma na omtak ngal uleh, tunglama Pathian taklama tu Kris omnaa thil omte tuh zong un,
ENGLISH: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

PAITE: Tung lama thil omte ah na lungsim uh nga un, leia thil omtea nga louin.
ENGLISH: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

PAITE: Na sita ua, tuin na hinna uh Pathian ah Kris toh selin a om hi.
ENGLISH: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

PAITE: Kris i hinna uh a hongkilak chiangin nou leng amah kiangah thupiin na kilak sam ding uhi.
ENGLISH: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

PAITE: Huchiin, noumaua leilam thil deihna omte hihlum un, kingaihnate, nitnate, huknate, utna giloute, huaihamnate; huaihamna tuh milimbiakna ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

PAITE: Huai thilte jiakin ahi, Pathian thangpaihna tuh thumanglou tate tunga a tun nak;
ENGLISH: for which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

PAITE: Nou leng tumalama huai thiltea na nuntak lai un, huaite ah na om jel uhi.
ENGLISH: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;

PAITE: Tun jaw, nou leng hiai tengteng, hehnate, thangpainate, huatnate, gensiatnate, na kam ua pau zahmohte koih mang un.
ENGLISH: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

PAITE: Juau kihilh tuah kei un, mihing lui tuh a thilhih toh na suahkheta ua.
ENGLISH: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

PAITE: Mihing thakin na kivanta ngal ua; huai mihing thak tuh a siampa batpih banga theihnaa siamthakin a om lellel hi.
ENGLISH: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

PAITE: Huai ah tuh Grik mi leh Juda mi leh Juda mi, zeksum leh sumlouh, melmak mite, Skithia mite, bawite, bawiloute leng a om theih kei; Kris tuh bangkim hijawin, bangkim ah a om behlap lai hi.
ENGLISH: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathian mi tel, misiangthou leh deih takte bang in lainatna lungtang te, migitnate, kingaihniamna te, thunuailutnate, thuakzohnatein kivan un.
ENGLISH: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

PAITE: Kua peuhin kua tungah leng thubuai nei bang hile uchin, kithuakzou chiat in, kingaidam tuah unla, Toupan a honngaihdamtak bangin, kingaidam sam un.
ENGLISH: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

PAITE: Huan, huai tengteng tungah leng itna kisilhthuah un; huaiin thil bangkim kituak takin a gakkhawm hi.
ENGLISH: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

PAITE: Huan, Kris khamuannain na lungtang uah vaihawm hen, huchibang hi dingin pumpi khata sap na hi him uhi; kipahna dan leng thei un.
ENGLISH: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

PAITE: Kris thu tuh a hauhna tengtoh noumau ah omsak kiihkeih un, pilna chitenga kisinsak leh kihilh tuaha oma kipahna lungtang toh pathian kianga phatna la bang, Pathian la bang, khalam la bang saa omin.
ENGLISH: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

PAITE: Huan, na hih peuhmah uh, thugen ah hiam, thilhih ah hiam amah jiaka Pa Pathian kianga kipahthugen kawmin Toupa Jesu minin hih vek un.
ENGLISH: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

PAITE: Jite aw, Toupa ah a kilawm hun bang jelin na pasalte uh kiang ah kingainiam un.
ENGLISH: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

PAITE: Pasalte aw, na jite uh it unla, a lak uah hanhat kei un.
ENGLISH: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

PAITE: Naupangte aw, bangkim ah na nu u leh na pate uh thumang un, huai tuh Toupa pahtak lam ahi.
ENGLISH: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

PAITE: Pate aw, na tate uh hihnuak kei un, huchilou injaw a lunglel kha ding uh.
ENGLISH: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

PAITE: Sikhate aw, saa na heutute uh thu bangkim ah mang un, mihing hihkipakte lel banga mit nasem hi louin, lungtang sakhata Toupa kihta kawmin.
ENGLISH: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

PAITE: Na hih peuhmah uh, mihing ading banga hih louin, Toupa ading banga hihin, kilawp takin hih un;
ENGLISH: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

PAITE: A itna, gouluah ding tuh, Toupa akipanin na mu ding uh chih theiin, Toupa Kris nasem na hi uhi.Thil dik lou hihpan a thil diklou hih man a mu nawn ding hi; mi khentuamna himhim a om ngal keia.
ENGLISH: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

PAITE: Thil dik lou hihpan a thil diklou hih man a mu nawn ding hi; mi khentuamna himhim a om ngal keia.
ENGLISH: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

PAITE: Heutute aw, nou leng vanah Heutupa na neih uh theiin, na sikhate u tungah a dik a tang leh a kilawm hih un.
ENGLISH: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

PAITE: Thum ngitnget unla, huaiah tuh kipahthu gen kawmin limsak un.
ENGLISH: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

PAITE: Hena ka omlouh pen kris thuguk tuh gen dingin Pathianin thu adia kong a honhonsak theihna dingin, kou leng honthum sak un,
ENGLISH: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

PAITE: Ka gen ding bangtaka ka gen khiak theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

PAITE: Hun na neih sungun atam theipen sem jel unla, polama mite lakah pil takin om un.
ENGLISH: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

PAITE: Mi chih bangchibanga dawn chiat ding ahi ua chih na theihna ding un, na paukamsuak utuh, chi soh, hehpihna hi gige hen.
ENGLISH: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

PAITE: Toupaa unau ngaihtak, nasempa muanhuai, sikha hihpih Tukikalin ka tanchin tengteng nou a hontheisak ding hi.
ENGLISH: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

PAITE: Hiai jiak mahin, amah tuh na kiang uah ka honsawl ahi, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uleh, na lungtang uh a hihkhamuan theihna dingin;
ENGLISH: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

PAITE: Onesima, unau muanhuai leh ngaihtak noumau laka mi mah toh. Amau tuh hiai lama thil omdan tengteng a honthei sak ding uh.
ENGLISH: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

PAITE: Aristarkha ka hentakpihpan nou chibai a honbuk hi. Marka, Barnaba tupain leng, chibai a honbuk hi (amah tungtang thu ah thupiakte na mu uh; na kiang ua a hongpai leh, na kipahpih un);
ENGLISH: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

PAITE: Jesu, Justa a chih un chibai nou a honbuk hi. Huaite tuh zeksum mi ahi ua, huaite kia Pathian gam thu lamah ka seppih, a honkhamuante ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for the Kingdom of God who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

PAITE: Epaphra noumau laka, Kris Jesu sikhain chibai nou a honbuk hi, aman tuh Pathian deihlam phot pichin leh gin bikbekna neia na din theihna ding un, a thumna ah nou adingin a kisuk gige hi.
ENGLISH: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

PAITE: Noumau ading bang, Leodisia khuaa omte ading bang, Hierapoli khuaa omte ading bangin phatuam a ngai mahmah chih ka theihpih ngel hi.
ENGLISH: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

PAITE: Luka daktor ngaihtak leh Demain nou chibai a honbuk uhi.
ENGLISH: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.

PAITE: Leodisia khuaa unau omte, huaite chibai honbuk sak un.
ENGLISH: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.

PAITE: Huan, hiai laikhak na lak ua na sim nung un, Leodisia saptuamte lakah leng sim sak un aw; nou leng leodisia khuaa pen nana sim sam ding ua.
ENGLISH: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

PAITE: Huan, Arkippa kiangah, nasepna Toupaa i muh pen tangtun dingin pilvang in, na chi un.Kei Paulain keimah khut ngeingeia hiai chibai honbukna kon-gelh ahi. Ka kolbulhte theigige un. Hehpihna na kiang uah om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

PAITE: Kei Paulain keimah khut ngeingeia hiai chibai honbukna kon-gelh ahi. Ka kolbulhte theigige un. Hehpihna na kiang uah om hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

PAITE: Pathian, nidang laia pi leh pute kiang a seh tampi leh lamchiteng a Jawlneite a thu nagen pan,
ENGLISH: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

PAITE: tulai hun nanung ah eite kiang ah a Tapa ah thu a hon genta hi. Huai mi tuh bangkim gouluahpa ding in a siam a, huai mi mah in khovelte leng a siam hi;
ENGLISH: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

PAITE: Amahtuh a thupina vak leh atak batpih ngei leh, amah thil hihtheihna thu a bangkim tungding pa hi in, ikhelhna te sianna a bawl khit nung in tunglama Thupipen taklam ah a va tuta a;
ENGLISH: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself made purification for our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

PAITE: Angelte sang a min ngaihzaw a muh bang ngei in amausang a thupi zaw a na hita himhim ngal a.
ENGLISH: having become so much better than the angels, as he has inherited a more excellent name than they have.

PAITE: Angelte lak ah kua kiang ah ahiai thute, agen ngei? Nangzaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia, chih leh, Amah ding in Pa ka hi dia, amah tuh kei ding in Tapa ahi ding chih.
ENGLISH: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today have I become your father?” Psalm 2:7 and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?” 2 Samuel 7:14; 1 Chronicles 17:13

PAITE: Huan, Tachil khovel a a pi lutnawn in, Pathian angelte tengteng inleng amah chibai buk uhen, achi a.
ENGLISH: Again, when he brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

PAITE: Huan, angelte tungtangthu ah hiai agen a; Aman zaw a angelte huih in a suaksak a, anasemte leng meikuang in a suaksak hi, chih.
ENGLISH: Of the angels he says, “Who makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.” Psalm 104:4

PAITE: Tapa tungtangthu ah bel hiai thu agen hi; Pathian aw, na mangtutphah tuh khanthawn in a om ding hi; dikna lal chiang leng na gam lal chiang ahi.
ENGLISH: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

PAITE: Diktatna tuh na it a, tatlekna tuh nahua a; huaiziakin, Pathian in, na Pathian in na lawmte sangin kipahna thau nang a hon nak nilh hi.
ENGLISH: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.” Psalm 45:6-7

PAITE: Huan, nang Toupa, atung in, leilung kingakna na phum khin a, Van khawngleng na khutsuak ahi;
ENGLISH: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

PAITE: Huaite tuh a hong mangthang ding ua, nang bel om tawntung ding na hi; huan, huaite tengteng tuh puansilh bangin a hong lui ding ua,
ENGLISH: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

PAITE: Puan bang in na zial ding in, puansilh bang lellelin, huan, a hong lamdang ta dia; nang bel na ngeingei nilouh hi, na kumte leng amang kei ding hi, chiin.
ENGLISH: As a mantle, you will roll them up, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years will not fail.” Psalm 102:25-27

PAITE: Himahleh, Angelte tungtangthu ahiai gen ngei ahi? Na melmate na khepek ngakna a ka bawl ma siah ka taklam ah tu in, chih.Amaute tengteng tuh nasepna khate, hotdamna gou luah dingte a dia na sem ding a sawlkhiak ahi kei ua hia?
ENGLISH: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?” Psalm 110:1

PAITE: Amaute tengteng tuh nasepna khate, hotdamna gou luah dingte a dia na sem ding a sawlkhiak ahi kei ua hia?
ENGLISH: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

PAITE: Dan thuin thil hoih, hongom dingte a taktak lohkhiakna neilouin, a limkia aneih jiakin, kumtenga kithoihna ngeingei alat jelte un, a honnaih mite bangchik mahin a bukimsak thei ngei kei hi.
ENGLISH: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

PAITE: Huchi hita kei leh, lat tawp thamta lou ding uhia? Abemite khatvei a hihsiangthou pahngal hile uh, khelhna kitheihna lah nei nawnlou ding hi ua.
ENGLISH: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshippers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

PAITE: Himahleh, huai kithoihna ah kum tengin khelhnate theihnawnna a hongom nak hi.
ENGLISH: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

PAITE: Bawngpate leh kelte sisanin khelhnate lamang thei vual ahingal keia.
ENGLISH: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

PAITE: Huchiin, khovela ahonglut laiin, Kithoihna leh thillat na deih keia, keia dingin pumpi non bawlsak jawa:
ENGLISH: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire, but you prepared a body for me;

PAITE: Halmanga pumpiaknate leh, khelhna dinga kithoihnate khawngah kipahna himhim na neikei hi.
ENGLISH: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

PAITE: Huaitakin, ken, Pathian aw, ngaiin, Laibu jiala ka tungthu gelh ahih bangin, Na deihlam hih dingin ka hongpai, ka chia, achi a.
ENGLISH: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’” Psalm 40:6-8

PAITE: A tungah, Kithoihna te, thillatte, halmanga pumpiaknate, khelhna dinga kithoihnate na deih keia, huaiahte kipahna na nei sam kei, a chi a, (huaite tuh danthu banga lat ahi a),
ENGLISH: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

PAITE: huaitakin, Ngaiin, na deihlam hih dingin ka hongpai, a na chita a, A nihna a tunding theihna dingin a masapen a lamangta ahi.
ENGLISH: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

PAITE: Huai deihlamin, Jesu Kris pumpi khatvei thu a lat pah jiakin, hihsiangthouin I omta hi.
ENGLISH: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

PAITE: Huan, siampu chitengin kawla nisuak sima na semin, khelhnate bangchik mah a hihmang theilou kithoihna ngeingei lan gige in, a ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and often offering the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

PAITE: Amah bel, khantawna dinga khelhnate adia kithoihna khat kia alat nungin, Pathian taklam ah a vatuta jaw hi,
ENGLISH: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God;

PAITE: huai nungsiah tuh, a melmate a khepek ngakna asiama hih masiah uh a ngak nilouh a.
ENGLISH: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

PAITE: Thillat khat kiain hihsiangthou sate khantawna dingin hihkim ta ngala.
ENGLISH: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

PAITE: Huan, Kha Siangthouin leng a hoh theisak sam a:
ENGLISH: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

PAITE: Huai ni khit chiangin a kiang ua thu ka khun ding tuh hiaite ahi, Toupan achi: a lungtang uah ka thupiakte ka koih dinga, a lungsim uah ka gelhna lai ding, chia a gen khitin,
ENGLISH: “This is the covenant that I will make with them: ‘After those days,’ says the Lord, ‘I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;’” Jeremiah 31:33 then he says,

PAITE: A khelhnate uh leh a tatleknate uh ka theigige ta kei ding, a chi ngala.
ENGLISH: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.” Jeremiah 31:34

PAITE: Huchiin, huchibangte ngaihdamna omna peuh ah khelhna adingin thillat a om nawn kei ahi.
ENGLISH: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

PAITE: Huchiin, unaute aw, Jesu sisan jiaka Mun Siangthoua lutngamna neiin,
ENGLISH: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

PAITE: Lam a honbawlsak, lam thak leh hing ah, puanjak (huai tuh a pumpi chihna ahi) kantan in,
ENGLISH: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

PAITE: Pathian inkuante tunga Siampu thupi tak ineih jiakin,
ENGLISH: and having a great priest over God’s house,

PAITE: I lungtanga sia leh pha theihna sianglou thehsiansaka oma, I pumpi leng tuichima sila omin, ginna a theih chetna kimneiin lungtang tak mah puin I naih ding uhi.
ENGLISH: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having our body washed with pure water,

PAITE: I lamet thugin, ling-lou in I pomkip ding uh, thuchiampa lah a muanhuai ngala;

ENGLISH: Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

ENGLISH: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.

PAITE: Pathian Tapa sikdena, thukhun sisan amah hihsiangthouna pen thil namaia bawla, hehpihna Kha hihvui mi tuh, huaimi sanga bangchi pheta gawtna thupijaw ahia, thuak taka naseh uh?
ENGLISH: How much worse punishment, do you think, will he be judged worthy of, who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

ENGLISH: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me,” says the Lord, “I will repay.” Deuteronomy 32:35 Again, “The Lord will judge his people.” Deuteronomy 32:36; Psalm 135:14

PAITE: Pathian hing khuta puk tuh thil mulkimhuai taka hi.
ENGLISH: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

ENGLISH: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions; and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

ENGLISH: For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

PAITE: Sawtlou nung chiangin hongpai dingpa hongpai ding ahi, sawt a halta kei ding.

PAITE: Huaiah tuh nidanglai miten phat aloh ngal ua.
ENGLISH: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.

ENGLISH: By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

PAITE: Ginnain Abelin Kaina sangin kithoihna hoihjaw Pathian kiangah a lana, huai jiakin mi dik hihna a mu chih, Pathianin a thilpiakte a pomna ah a theisaka; huan huai ginna jiakin aman tuh sih khit nungin thu a gen nalai ahi.
ENGLISH: By faith, Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

PAITE: Ginnain Enok leng sihna chiamlou dinga lakmangin ana oma; huan, Pathianin alakmang jiakin muhtheih ahita keia; lakmanga aom main Pathian pahtak lam mi ahi, chih theihsakna amukhinta him hi.
ENGLISH: By faith, Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

PAITE: Himahleh, ginna louin amah pahtak lammi hihvual ahi kei; Pathian kianga hongpaiin, amah tuh a om chih leh, a zong mite lohchingsakpa ahi chih, gin ding ahi.
ENGLISH: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

PAITE: Ginnain Noa tuh thil muh nailouhte lam thu ah Pathian hilha naomin, Pathian laudan siamin, a inkuansung hotdamna dingin longa bawla; huaiin khovel siamlouh a tangsakta a, ginna jiaka om diktatna gouluahpa ahong hi hi.
ENGLISH: By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, or, reverence prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

ENGLISH: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

ENGLISH: By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

ENGLISH: For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

ENGLISH: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

ENGLISH: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

ENGLISH: Let brotherly love continue.
