ENGLISH: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

PAITE: Hen a awmte tuh hen hisam bangin thei gige unla; gimthuakte tuh sa a awmsam nahih ziakun thei gige un.
ENGLISH: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

PAITE: Mi tengteng lak ah kitenna pahtawi in awm henla, lupna leng hihbuah louh in awm hen; kingaite leh angkawmte tuh Pathian in a ngaihtuah dek ngala.
ENGLISH: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

PAITE: Na lungsim putdan uh tuh dangka deihtakna panglou hihen; na thil neih sun tunguah lungkim un; amah mah in, bangchikmah in kawn dawn lou kei ding a, paileng ka hon paisan kei hial ding, a chi ngal a.
ENGLISH: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” Deuteronomy 31:6

PAITE: Huchiin, hangtakin Toupa tuh hon panpihpa ahi, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang a hon chih thei dia? Ichi uhi.
ENGLISH: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?” Psalm 118:6-7

PAITE: Nou hon heu, Pathian thu honhilhte, theigige unla, a awmdan ua thil suakte ngaihtuah in a hindan uh ching un.
ENGLISH: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

PAITE: Jesu Kris tuh zan tawh, tuni tawh, chiklai peuh inleng angeingei in a awm gige ding hi.
ENGLISH: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

PAITE: Ki sinsakna tuamtuam leh lamdang mutleng in awmkei un; lungtang hehpihna a hihkip a awm tuh a hawih ngal a, nekdingte bang a hihkip a awmlou in; huchibang lam lungkhamten huaite ah phattuamna a mu tuan kei uhi.
ENGLISH: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

PAITE: Enzaw maitam khat inei; huaituh biakbuk nasemten anek theihlouhna mun uh ahi.
ENGLISH: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

PAITE: Gan, asisan Siampu Lianpenin Mun Siangthou a khelhna a dia lana a lutpih zel luangte tuh, dainawl ah a hal zel uhi.
ENGLISH: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp. Leviticus 16:27

PAITE: Huchiin, Jesu in leng amah sisan mahmah a mite a hih siangthou theihna ding in, kulh kongkhak pawlam ah ana thuakta hi.
ENGLISH: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

PAITE: Huchiin, amah a muhsitna uh pu in dainawl ah a kianglam ah ipai khe ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

PAITE: Hialai a zaw khaw munkip inei ngalkei a, khaw hong awm ding izong ahizaw hi.
ENGLISH: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

PAITE: Huchiin, amah vangin phatna kithawihna Pathian kiang ah ilan gige ding uh, huaituh amin gupna mukte gah ahi.
ENGLISH: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God Psalm 50:23 continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

PAITE: Himahleh, thil hihhawih leh thil phal khawng mangngilh kei un; tuabang kithawihna tungah Pathian a lunghi mahmah ngal a.
ENGLISH: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

PAITE: Nou hawn heutute thu mang unla, a thuthu un awm un, anasepte uh tanchin gen nawn ngei dinga, na khate uh ching a hon veng ahi hi, kipak takin lungkham kawm hilou in, semsak un; huchilouinzaw nou-a ding a khawk ahi zaw ding hi.
ENGLISH: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

PAITE: Hon thumsak un; bangkima diktat taka awm tuma, sia leh pha theihna siangtak nei ka hi uh chih diktak in ka kithei ngal ua.
ENGLISH: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

PAITE: Huan, kintak a nakiang ua sawlnawna ka awm theihna ding in, huai tuh hih ding in ka hon ngennawn diak ahi.
ENGLISH: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

PAITE: Huan lemna Pathian belam Chingpa thupi tak, I Toupa Jesu mah, khantawna thukhun na sisan vang a misi lak a kipan a pikhenawn pan,
ENGLISH: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

PAITE: amitmuha a kipahlam peuhmah, Jesu Kris ziakin eimah a sem in, a deihlam hih ding in thil hoih chiteng lam ah nou hawn hihkim hen: Jesu Kris kiang ah thupina khantawn in awm hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

PAITE: Himahleh, unaute aw, ka hawnngen hi, hasawtna thu ngai thei teitei un; na kiang uah thu tawmchik ka gelh ngal ua,
ENGLISH: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

PAITE: I unaupa Timothi apawtsak ta uh chih na nathei sam un; ahongpai ma deuh in, amah tawh nou ka hon mu ding hi.
ENGLISH: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

PAITE: Nou hawn heute tengteng leh, misiangthoute tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Italy gam a mi ten chibai a hon buk uhi.Navek ua kiangah hehpihna awm hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

PAITE: Navek ua kiangah hehpihna awm hen. Amen.
ENGLISH: Grace be with you all. Amen.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, bila ijakte khawng phatuamngai takin I khawksa nawn diak ding uhi, huchilouin jaw I tolh mang san zenzen kha ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

PAITE: Angelte zanga thugen nangawn anakipa, tatlekna leh thumanlouhna chi tengtengin thukna diktathuaitak a muh jel ngal un tuh,
ENGLISH: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense;

PAITE: huchi tela hotdamna thupi ngeingaih kei leng, bangchin ahia isuahtak theih mahmah ding? Huai hotdamna thutuh a tunga Toupa zanga gen khit ahi a, azaten honna hihkipsak uhi;
ENGLISH: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard;

PAITE: Pathianin leng, chiamtehnate leh thil lamdangte leh thilhihtheihna chiteng toh, amahdeih bangjela Kha Siangthou thil hawmte khawng toh, amaute a theihpih hi.
ENGLISH: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

PAITE: Khovel hongom ding a tanchin I gen uh, angelte nuaiah jaw a koih kei hi.
ENGLISH: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

PAITE: Himahleh, mi kuahiamin koilai hiamah hiai thu tuh genin a theisak zota hi; Mihing bang atela, na theihgige? Mihing tapa leng bang a tela, na veh nak?
ENGLISH: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

PAITE: Amah tuh angelte sanga nuaiin na bawl tadiha; thupina leh pahtawina a khusaka, na khutsuak tungahte heutuin na bawl laia;
ENGLISH: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor. TR adds “and set him over the works of your hands”

PAITE: A khe nuaiahte khawng bangkim na koiha, chiin. Huchiin bangkim a nuaia a koih jiakin anuaia koih louh bangmah a neikei hi. Ahihhangin tun ah jaw bangkim a nuaiah omin I mu nai tadih kei uhi.
ENGLISH: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” Psalm 8:4-6 For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t see all things subjected to him, yet.

PAITE: Himahleh, Jesu, angelte sanga nuaia a bawl tadih tuh, sihna thuak jiaka thupina leh pahtawina khuksaka omin I muta jaw ahi, Pathian hehpihna jiakin sihna tuh mi chih a chepsakna ding.
ENGLISH: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

PAITE: Amah a ding leh amah jiaka bangkim om-pan ta tampi thupinaa piluta amaute hotdamna Bawlpa pen, a thuakna jiaka, a hihbukim tuh amaha dia kilawm him ahi.
ENGLISH: For it became him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

PAITE: Hihsiangthoupa leh hihsiangthoute tuh avekun Mi khata pawt ahi ngal ua; huaijiakin amah tuh amaute, Unaute, chih a zum kei hi.
ENGLISH: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” ,

PAITE: Ka unaute kiangah na min ka gen dia; omkhawmte lakah lasain ka honphat ding, chiin.
ENGLISH: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. In the midst of the congregation I will sing your praise.” Psalm 22:22

PAITE: Huan, Amah ah ka ginna ka nga dia, a chi nawna. Huan, endih ua, kei leh Pathian honpiak tate, achi nawn nalaia.
ENGLISH: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Isaiah 8:17 Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.” Isaiah 8:18

PAITE: Huchiin, naupangte tuh sa sisan tangte a hih chiat jiak un, amah ngeiin huai bangmah a tang samta a; sihnaa sihna thuneipa (huai tuh Diabol) ahihmang theihna ding leh,
ENGLISH: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

PAITE: Sih kihtak jiaka damsunga sikha a om tengtengte tuh a suahtak sak theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

PAITE: A awlmoha, panpih jelte tuh angelte ahi dek kei ua, Abraham suante ahi jaw uhi.
ENGLISH: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the seed of Abraham.

PAITE: Huchiin, mite adinga khelhna thuphatawina bawlsak dingin, Pathian lamthilte ah Siampu Lianpen, mi lainatthei leh muanhuai taka hih theihna dingin, bangkima a unaute banga hongom tuh amah adingin a kiphamoh him ahi.Amah ngeiin khemna tuakin a na thuaktak jiakin khemna tuakte tuh a panpih thei ahi.
ENGLISH: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

PAITE: Amah ngeiin khemna tuakin a na thuaktak jiakin khemna tuakte tuh a panpih thei ahi.
ENGLISH: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

PAITE: Huchiin, unau siangthou, van sapna tangsamte aw, I thugina Sawltak leh Siampu Lian, Jesu tuh, ngaihtuah un;
ENGLISH: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;

PAITE: Pathian inkuante tengteng lakah Mosi tuh a muanhuai bangmahin, amah tuh a seppa lakah amuanhuai ahi.
ENGLISH: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

PAITE: Insunga papen tuh ainkuante sanga apahtawi jawk bang ngei un, amah tuh Mosi sanga thupi jawkna sem mu dia kilawma seh a hita ngala.
ENGLISH: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who built the house has more honor than the house.

PAITE: Inkuan chihin papen kuahiam bek a nei chiat ngal ua; bangkim papen bel Pathian ahi.
ENGLISH: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

PAITE: Huan, huai nunga thugen nalai dingte theihsakna dingin, Mosi tuh Pathian inkuante tengteng laka nasempa injaw a muanhuai ngei hi;
ENGLISH: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

PAITE: Kris bel Pathian inkuante tunga Tapa-in a muanhuai ahi. A inkuante tuh eite I hi uhi, atawp tana I hansanna leh I lametna suanna kiptaka I vom hoih photphot leh.
ENGLISH: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

PAITE: Huchiin, Kha Siangthou gen bangin, Tuni a a aw na jak chiangun,
ENGLISH: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

PAITE: Gamdaia zeet na nia hel bang un, na lungtang uh khauh sak kei un;
ENGLISH: don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

PAITE: Huailai ah tuh na pi leh pute un honjeet in hon khem ua, kum sawmli sunga ka thil hihte a mu ua;
ENGLISH: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my works for forty years.

PAITE: Huchiin huai suan te tungah ka lung hita keia, a lungtangun a ngaihtuah khial gige ua, Kalampite leng a theikei uhi, ka chi a,
ENGLISH: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways;’

PAITE: Ka thangpaihna aka kichiam bangin ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh, chiin.
ENGLISH: as I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’” Psalm 95:7-11

PAITE: Unaute aw, pilvang un, huchi lou in jaw, Pathian hing tawpsan ding in na lak uah kuapeuh sungah ginlouhna lungtang gilou ahong om kha ding hi.
ENGLISH: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

PAITE: Tuniin achih lai un niteng in ki hasuan tuah jaw un, huchia nalak ua mi kuamah khelhna khemhat jiaka hihkhawla na om louhna ding un,
ENGLISH: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

PAITE: Kris neite ina hita ngal ua, i ginna pen kipat na tuh a tawptan a kiptaka I vom hoih phot leh,
ENGLISH: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:

PAITE: Tuniin a aw nazak chiangun a hel lai bang un, na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un. a kichih laiteng.
ENGLISH: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.” Psalm 95:7-8

PAITE: Ahihleh, kuate ahi ua theinapi a helte? Aigupta akipana Mosi pi pawt tengteng hi lou uhia?
ENGLISH: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn’t all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?

PAITE: Huan, kuate tungah ahia, kum sawmli sung a alunghihlouh? Hihkhialte a luang uh gamdaia puk tate tungah hilou hia?
ENGLISH: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

PAITE: Huan, thu mangloute kiangah kia loungal kua kiangah ahia a khawlna a lut lou dinga a kichiam?Huchiin, ginlahna jiakin a lut theita kei uh chih I thei uhi.
ENGLISH: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

PAITE: Huchiin, ginlahna jiakin a lut theita kei uh chih I thei uhi.
ENGLISH: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.

PAITE: Huaijiakin I lau ding uh, huchilouin jaw a khawlna a lutna thuchiam om lai napiin, na lak ua kuapeuh leng chinglou bangin na om kha zenzen ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Let us fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

PAITE: Amau kianga gena hih mahbangin tanchin hoih I kianga gen ahi ngei ngal a; himahleh, a thu jak un amaute a suphatuam ngal keia, azatea ginna toh kizoma a om louh jiakin.
ENGLISH: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

PAITE: Ei gingta khinte tuh huai khawlna ah I lut lellel ahi, Ka thangpaiha ka kichiam bangin ka khawlna ah a lut kei ding uh, chih bangin; leilung pian tung akipan nate tuh sep zoh a hikhinta na a.
ENGLISH: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest”; Psalm 95:11 although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

PAITE: Koilaimun ahi hiam ah ni sagih ni thu hichibangin agenve: Huan, ni sagih niin Pathianin anasep tengteng a khawlsanta a, chiin.
ENGLISH: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works”; Genesis 2:2

PAITE: Huan, hiai munah, Ka khawlna ah a lut kei ding uh, a chi nawn a.
ENGLISH: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.” Psalm 95:11

PAITE: Huchiin, khenkhat tuh huai khawlna a a lutna ding ua thuchiam a om lai jiak leh, ni danga tanchin hoih gen tangte thumanlouh jiaka a lut tak louh jiak un,
ENGLISH: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter therein, and they to whom the good news was before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,

PAITE: sawttak nungin David ah, Tuniin, chiin, bang ni hiam a sep tuan nawna, Tuniin a aw na jak chiangun na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un, chia a maa kigensa bangin.
ENGLISH: he again defines a certain day, today, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.” Psalm 95:7-8

ENGLISH: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathian mite a dingin khawlni a khawlna a om lai ahi.
ENGLISH: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

PAITE: Pathianin amah nasepte a khawlsan bangin, A khawlna a lut khinsa miin leng anasepte a khawlsan samta ahi.
ENGLISH: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

PAITE: Huchiin, kuamah huai thumanlouhna bang a om a ipuk louhna ding un huai khawlna a lut ding in phatuam ingai ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

PAITE: Pathian thu ahing a, thil ahihthei a, namsau hiamtuah bang chibang sangin leng ahiam a, hinna leh kha, guhlawi leh guhngek tuamkhen hial hel khopin a sun thei a, lungtang a ngaihuah leh tup te a theipah ngal thei ahi.
ENGLISH: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

PAITE: Huaziakin, thil siam amah mitmuh a langlou himhim a omkei; Itan chin itutna ding mitmuh a zaw bangkim vuaktangleh kihongsa in a om zaw hi.
ENGLISH: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

PAITE: Hichiin, van khawng bang a paisuak khinsa Siampu Lianpen thupitak, Jesu Pathian Tapa, ineih ziakin I gin tuh, I pomkip ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Having then a great high priest, who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold tightly to our confession.

PAITE: Siampu Lianpen ihatlouhdan kitheihna te hon theihpih phalou nei ihi ngal kei a; eimah bang a lam tuamtuam a khemna tuaksa, khelh bel khiallou, nei ihi zaw uhi.Huchiin, zahngaihna imuh theihna ding leh huh ideih chiang a huhna hehpihna imuh theihna ding in, hehpihna mangtutphah tuh hangtakin inaih ding uhi.
ENGLISH: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

PAITE: Huchiin, zahngaihna imuh theihna ding leh huh ideih chiang a huhna hehpihna imuh theihna ding in, hehpihna mangtutphah tuh hangtakin inaih ding uhi.
ENGLISH: Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.

PAITE: Siampu Lianpen peuhmah khelhnate jiaka thialpiak leh kithoihnate a lat kop theihna ding ua, mihing laka mi lak tuama naomin, Pathian lam thil bangah mihingte adia seh ahi ngal ua:
ENGLISH: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

PAITE: Huaiten tuh bangmah theiloute leh lamhaihte tungah migit a suah thei nak uhi, amau ngei leng hatlouhna a tuama om sam jiakun.
ENGLISH: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

PAITE: Huan, huaijiak takin, mite a dinga a latsak bangun, amau ading ngei leng khelhnate jiakin lan sam loutheilou ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

PAITE: Huan, huai pahtawina tuh kuamah amau akipe ngeikei uh, Aron banga Pathian sap a hih ngal kei uleh.
ENGLISH: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

PAITE: Huchibang mahin Kris leng Siampu Lianpena bawldingin amaha kihihthupikei hi, Nang jaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuniin, ka honnei khia, chia, a kianga genpan a hihthupizota hi;
ENGLISH: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.” Psalm 2:7

PAITE: Nang jaw, Melkisedek omdan banga khantawna Siampu na hi, chia, mun danga a gen bangmahin.
ENGLISH: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.” Psalm 110:4

PAITE: Amah tuh, a sa put laini khongin, sihna laka amah hondam theipa kiangah nakpitaka kikou leh khitui ke kawmin thumnate leh ngetnate a lana, a kihtakdan a siam jel jiakin ngaihkhiakin a om hi;
ENGLISH: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

PAITE: Ta hilhial leng hi mahleh a thil thuakahte khawng thuman a zilta ahi.
ENGLISH: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

PAITE: Huchiin, hihhoih kimtaka hongomin, a thumangte peuhmah adingin khantawna hotdamna bulpi ahonghita hi;
ENGLISH: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

PAITE: Melkisedek omdan banga Siampu Lianpenin Pathianin a bawlta hi.
ENGLISH: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

PAITE: Huai mi tanchin a hihleh gen ding tampi I nei ua, genchet leng a haksa, na bil uh a nangawntak jiakin.
ENGLISH: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

PAITE: A hun ngaihtuahin jaw heutu hi khinta hial le uchin kilawm hiven, Pathian thubulte khawng hilh kiphamoh nawn neive ua, an gum hilou nawitui kiphamoh nong hita ve ua.
ENGLISH: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the oracles of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

PAITE: Nawitui ne peuhmahin diktatna thu ah theihna a nei ngal kei ua, naungek a hih jiak un.An gum bel piching ading ahi, huaiten a zat gige jiak un sia leh pha theichian dingin a theihtheihnate uh tuh a sin zongsangta uhi.
ENGLISH: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

PAITE: An gum bel piching ading ahi, huaiten a zat gige jiak un sia leh pha theichian dingin a theihtheihnate uh tuh a sin zongsangta uhi.
ENGLISH: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

PAITE: Huchiin, Kris thubulte gen nawn louin pichinlam I manoh ding uh; thilhih sisa kisiknate, Pathian lama ginnate,
ENGLISH: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let us press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

PAITE: baptisma leh, khutngak leh misi thohnawnna leh, khantawn vaihawmnalam thu hilhnate suang khawng phum nawnta louin.
ENGLISH: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

PAITE: Pathianin pha a sak leh huai bang I hih ngei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: This will we do, if God permits.

PAITE: Khatvei hihvaka omkhina, van thilpiak chiamkhina, Kha Siangthou dongkhina,
ENGLISH: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

PAITE: Pathian thu hoihna leh hun hongom dinga thil hihtheihnate chiamkhin hinapia,
ENGLISH: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,

PAITE: ginna a kiheimangsan uleh bel, huchibang mite jaw a kisik nading ua bawlthak theih ahi kei uhi; Pathian Tapa amau adinga kilhlum tuan nawna selphou a hih jiakun.
ENGLISH: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

PAITE: Lou, a tunga vuahtui ke gige na dawnkhina, huai khohsaka ompa adia nek theih antehlouhing honsuah penin Pathian vualjawlna a tang hi.
ENGLISH: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it, and brings forth a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

PAITE: A hihhangin lou lingnei leh khaulingnei khawng a suahnak inbel, a phatuam keia; hamsiat loh phialin a oma; a tawpna tuh hal himai ding ahi.
ENGLISH: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

PAITE: Himahleh, deihtakte aw, huchibang thu gen mahleng zong, nou jaw huchibang thil sanga thil hoihjaw, hotdamna jui thilte, nein a hih uh ka um uhi.
ENGLISH: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

PAITE: Na nasep u leh a min jiaka itna na latsak uh, mi siangthoute na nasepsak uh, tutana leng na seplai uh, mangngilh dingin Pathian mitak lou ahi ngal kei ahi.
ENGLISH: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

PAITE: Himahleh, atawp tana lametna theihchetna kim mu dingin na thanop ngeingei bang un thanop suah gige chiat le uchin ka chi mahmah uhi.
ENGLISH: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

PAITE: Huchiin, na kithadahsak kei ding ua, ginna leh kuhkalna jiaka thuchiamte gouluah khin khawngte entawnte na hi zo ding uhi.
ENGLISH: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherited the promises.

PAITE: Pathianin Abraham kianga thu achiam laiin, amah sanga thupi jaw loua a kichiam theihlouh jiakin, amah leh amah kilouin,
ENGLISH: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by none greater, he swore by himself,

PAITE: Taktakin vual ka honjawl ngeingei dinga, hih leng ka honhih pung ngeingei ding, chiin, a kichiamta a.
ENGLISH: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.” Genesis 22:17

PAITE: Huchiin, kuhkal taka a thuak khiak nungin, thilchiam tuh a muta ngei hi.
ENGLISH: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

PAITE: Mihingte jaw a sang ua thupi jaw louin a kichiam ua; a kiselna chiteng uah leng hihkipna dingin kichiam tuh thutawp ahi.
ENGLISH: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathianin thuchiam gouluah dingte kiangah a thiltup lamdan tuan theihlouhdan nakpi mahmaha theihsak utin, kichiamna tuh a palaisaka;
ENGLISH: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;

PAITE: Pathian juau vual ahihlouhna thil lamdang theilou nih jiakin, ei I kihumbitna delhten I maa lametna koih tuh la dinga hasotna thupi tak i neih theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

PAITE: Huai lametna tuh hinna sikkipin I neia, muanhuai leh kiptak ahi, huai lametna tuh puanjak sung ah leng a lutta hi;huaiah tuh Jesu, Melkisedek omdan banga khantawn a Siampu Lianpen nahitain ei adingin makaipain a na lutta hi.
ENGLISH: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil;

PAITE: huaiah tuh Jesu, Melkisedek omdan banga khantawn a Siampu Lianpen nahitain ei adingin makaipain a na lutta hi.
ENGLISH: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

PAITE: Huai Melkisedek, Salemkumpipa Tungnungpen Siampu, Abraham kumpipate that hongpai na dawn a vualzawlpa,
ENGLISH: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

PAITE: Abraham in bangkim ah sawmakhat a pia. Amin khiakna genchian in amasa pen in Diktatna Kumpipa, azom nawn in Salem Kumpipa ahinawna; huaituh Lemna Kumpipa chihna ahi.
ENGLISH: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace;

PAITE: Amahtuh pa neilou in, nu neilou in, khangthu bei, ompatni neilou hintawpni leng neisamlou in. Pathian tapa bang a siam tangtawn a siampu hi gige ahi zaw hi.
ENGLISH: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

PAITE: Huchi in, chikhah Abraham in a galllak hoihpeuhmah laka sawmakhat apiakna pa, huaimipa thupi dan ngaihtuah dih ua.
ENGLISH: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best spoils.

PAITE: Levi suante laka siampuna tang peuhmah in dan thu bangin mite lak ah sawmakhat lak ding thu amu ngei uhi, huaituh a unaute uh lak ah ahi, huaite tuh Abraham khal a pawt hisam mahle u leng.
ENGLISH: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

PAITE: Himahleh, alak ua a suante suikhawmsak sam louh pan Abraham lak ah sawmakhat ala a, thuchiamte kempa tuh vual ana zawlta hi.
ENGLISH: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

PAITE: Himahleh, sel vuallouhin a neujaw tuh thupi zaw vualzawl sak in a om hi.
ENGLISH: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

PAITE: Huan, hiai ah mihing si zel ten sawmakhat a mu ua, huai ah bel, ahing nilouh, chi a, a thu a theisak un a mu ahi.
ENGLISH: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

PAITE: Huan, Levi, sawmakhat lazelpa nangawn in, Abraham khut ah sawmakhatte a peta, chih theih ahi;
ENGLISH: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

PAITE: Melkisedek in a na dawn lai in apakhal ah a om lai- ngal a.
ENGLISH: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

PAITE: Huchiin, Levi ten siampu hihna ziaka bukimna muhtheih na hi leh (huainuai ah miten tuh dan thu ana mu ngal ua), Aaron omdan bang a bawl louh Melkisedek omdan bang a siampu dang hong om bang kiphamawh ding ahia?
ENGLISH: Now if there were perfection through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

PAITE: Siampu hihna tuh ahong lamdan tak ziakin dan thu tuh hihlamdan sam a hong kiphamawh himhim ahi.
ENGLISH: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

PAITE: Hiai a thu agenpa namtuam mi ahi ngal a, huai nam laka a mi tuh kuamah maitam ah a gamtang ngeikei uhi.
ENGLISH: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

PAITE: I Toupa lah Juda nam lak a hong suak ahi chih a kichian ngal a: Huai nam thu ah tuh Mosi in siampu te lam thu bangmah a gen kei hi.
ENGLISH: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

PAITE: Huan, Melkisedek bang a siampu dang hong suah tuh nakpi takin I thugen pen a kichian nawn diak hi;
ENGLISH: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

PAITE: Amahtuh sa thupiak dan thu bang a siam bang hilou, hin tawpneilou thil hihtheihna bang zaw a, siam ahi.
ENGLISH: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life:

PAITE: Nang zaw, Melkisedek omdan bang a khantawn a siampu na hi chih theihsak ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.” Psalm 110:4

PAITE: Ahatlouh leh a phattuamlouhna ziakin thupiak awm masa tuh paihkhiak ahi.
ENGLISH: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

PAITE: (Dan thu in bangmah a hihkim ngal kei a). Lametna hoih zaw, Pathian I naihna zel tuh, pilutin a om zawta hi.
ENGLISH: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

PAITE: Huan, kichiamna tellou lou-in amah tuh Siampu a bawl ahita hi:
ENGLISH: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

PAITE: Amau zaw kichiamlou a siampu a siam ahi ngal ua; amah bel, nang zaw khantawna Siampu na hi, chi in, Toupa a kichiam a, ka khelkik kei ding, chi a a kiang a genpa khut ah kichiam in:
ENGLISH: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’” Psalm 110:4

PAITE: Huchitaka thupi in Jesu tuh thukhun hoih zaw hihkip pa a hong hita hi.
ENGLISH: By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.

PAITE: Huan, amau zaw sih ziaka omden theilou ahih ziakun, siampu a siam a tam ngei ua;
ENGLISH: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

PAITE: Amahbel khantawna a om gige ziakin, a Siampu hihna tuh khen theih vuallouh in a nei zaw hi.
ENGLISH: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

PAITE: Huchiin, amaha Pathian kianga hongpaite tuh a tawp dong in a hondam thei ahi, amau thumsak in khantawna a hin gige ziak in.
ENGLISH: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

PAITE: Huchibang Siampu Lianpen, misiangthou, zulhzau lou, ninbanglou, khialte laka omtuam, vante sang a tungnung zaw a, siam, tuh eia ding in a kilawm him hi.
ENGLISH: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

PAITE: Aman tuh huai siampu lianpente lat bang in, niteng in amah khelh ziak a kithoihna lan masa phawt a, huainung a mite khelhna ziaka lat a kiphamoh kei; Amah a kilat laitak in setden ding in khat vei in ana hihkhinta ngal a,Dan thu in, mihing hatlouhna neite tuh, siampu lianpen ding in a sep zel a; ki chiam thu, dan thu nung a a hong om in bel, Tapa, khantawna ding a hihkim khitsa tuh, asep zouta ahi.
ENGLISH: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

PAITE: Dan thu in, mihing hatlouhna neite tuh, siampu lianpen ding in a sep zel a; ki chiam thu, dan thu nung a a hong om in bel, Tapa, khantawna ding a hihkim khitsa tuh, asep zouta ahi.
ENGLISH: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath which came after the law appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

PAITE: Huchiin, I thugente lakah tuh a poimohpen hiai ahi: huchibang Siampu Lianpen van khawng banga Thupipen mangtutphah taklama vatu a;
ENGLISH: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this. We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

PAITE: Mun siangthou leh biakbuk taktak, mihinglam hilou, Toupa lam jawa nasempa tuh I nei chih.
ENGLISH: a servant of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

PAITE: Siampu Lianpen peuhmahte thilpiak leh kithoihnate lan ding a seh ahi ngal ua; huchiin hiai Siampu Lianpenin leng bang hiam bek lat ding a neih a kiphamoh ahi.
ENGLISH: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

PAITE: Leia om lai hile jaw, siampu mawngmawng hi lou ding ahi, dan thu bangjela thilpiak lante na om masa a naom jiak un.
ENGLISH: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law;

PAITE: Huaiten tuh van thilte etsakna leh a lim na asem jel ua. Mosi biakbuk lam dia a kisak lai a Pathian hilh a aom bang in; Mual vuma zuihding a honmuh sak bang un bangkim siam ding in pilvangin, a chih.
ENGLISH: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.” Exodus 25:40

PAITE: Tunbel thukhun hoih jaw sem palai a hihdan bangjel in, nasepna hoih jaw A na tangta, huai thukhun tuh thuchiam hoih jaw tunga kinga leh bawl ahih jiakin.
ENGLISH: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

PAITE: Huai thukhun masa tuh dembei na hileh, a nihna adia mun zong lou mah ding hi ve un.
ENGLISH: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

PAITE: Amau demin hiaite a gen ngala, Ngaiin, nite a hong tung dek, Toupan a chi, huaini khong chiangin Israel inkuante leh, Juda inkuante kiangah thukhun thak ka siam ding:
ENGLISH: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days come,” says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

PAITE: A pi leh pute uh Aigupta gam akipana pikhe dinga a khut ua ka let nia a kiang ua ka khunpen bang hilou in; ka thukhun ah lah a om gige ngal kei ua, huchiin amau thu ka limsak ta keia, Toupan achi.
ENGLISH: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers, in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

PAITE: Huai ni khawng nung chiangin Israel inkuante kianga thu ka khun ding tuh hiaite ahi. Toupan achi; a lungsim uah ka thupiakte ka koih dia, a lungtang uah ka gelh nalai dia, huan amau adingin Pathian ka hi dia, keia dingin amau tuh ka mite ahi sam ding uhi;
ENGLISH: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel. After those days,” says the Lord; “I will put my laws into their mind, I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

PAITE: Huan, michihin, Toupa theiin, chiin, amah khopih leh amah unau a thuhilhta kei ding uhi; a neupen akipanin a lianpen tanin a vek un a honthei chiat ding uhi.
ENGLISH: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen, TR reads “neighbor” instead of “fellow citizen” and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

PAITE: A tatlek nate uah jah kangai dia, a khelhnate uleng ka theigige nawnta kei ding, chiin.Thukhun Thak, chia agen jiakin a masa tuh a luisakta ahi. Huchiin, na luia na upata tuh a mang thei ahita hi.
ENGLISH: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.” Jeremiah 31:31-34

PAITE: Thukhun Thak, chia agen jiakin a masa tuh a luisakta ahi. Huchiin, na luia na upata tuh a mang thei ahita hi.
ENGLISH: In that he says, “A new covenant,” he has made the first old. But that which is becoming old and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

PAITE: Huan, thukhun masa mahin leng Pathian nasepna dan te leh mun siangthou, hiai khovel mun siangthou tuh a nei ahi.
ENGLISH: Now indeed even the first TR adds “tabernacle” covenant had ordinances of divine service, and an earthly sanctuary.

PAITE: Biakbuk a bawl ua, tuah masak tuh khawnvak koihna bang, dohkan bang tanghou- koihnabang omna ahi; huai tuh Mun Siangthou achi uhi.
ENGLISH: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lampstand, the table, and the show bread; which is called the Holy Place.

PAITE: Huan, puanjak nihna khenah biakbuk, Mun Siangthoupen achih uh a oma;
ENGLISH: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

PAITE: huailaiah dangkaeng gimlim halna bawm leh, thukhunna bawm dangkaenga luan a oma, huai thukhunna bawm tungah Manna omna dangkaeng belbang, Aron chiang sel bang, thukhunna bang a omhi;
ENGLISH: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

PAITE: a tunglamah jahngaihna tutphah liahin, thupina Cherubte a om ua; huaite khawng tuin jaw a kim sipsip in I gen theikei ding uh.
ENGLISH: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

PAITE: Huan huai thilte tuh huchibangabawl a nahi ua, Siamputen Pathian na semin, biakbuk tuahmasak ah a lut jel uh;
ENGLISH: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

PAITE: a zom ah tuh Siampu Lianpen kia kumtengin khatvei, sisan tawi lou louin a luta; huai tuh amah khelhna ading leh mite khelhna adingin alan jel ahi.
ENGLISH: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for the errors of the people.

PAITE: Kha Siangthouin hiai a theisak: Mun Siangthoua lutna lam a kilang naitadih keia, biakbuk tuah masak tuh adin laiteng, chihpen;
ENGLISH: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing;

PAITE: (huai tuh tulai hun genteh na ahi). Huai bang jelin thilpiak leh kithoihnate leng a lan jel uh, a hihhangin huaiten sia leh phatheihna lam ah a bemi a hihkim theikei hi:
ENGLISH: which is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshipper perfect;

PAITE: huai tuh (nekdingte, dawndingte, silhding tuamtuamte, toh) sa lam dante kia, bawlhoih hun ma adinga, chih ahi.
ENGLISH: being only (with meats and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

PAITE: Himahleh, Kris bel thilhoih hongom dingte Siampu Lianpen dinga hongpaiin, biakbuk, khuta lamlouh (huai tuh hiai thilsiamte laka ahi kei chihna ahi),
ENGLISH: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

PAITE: thupi leh kim jaw pai tanin, eia dinga khantawna tatkhiakna mu khinin kelte leh bawngnoute sisan jiak hilouin, amah sisan jiak jawin, Mun Siangthouah setden dingin khatveiin ana lutta ngala.
ENGLISH: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

PAITE: Kel leh bawngpate sisan leh, bawngla vu, minin tunga thehin bawn sa siang khopa a hihsiangthou ngalleh,
ENGLISH: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh:

PAITE: Kris, khantawna Kha jiaka gensiatbeia Pathian kianga kilan sisanin, Pathian hing nasem dingin na sia leh pha theihna uh thilhih sisa lakah nak hihsiangthou natel inchia!
ENGLISH: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

PAITE: Huan, hiaijiakin, amah tuh thukhunthak palai ahi, thukhun masa nuaia tatleknate laka kipan tatna dinga mi a na sihtak jiakin sapten tuh khantawna gouluah ding thuchiam a tang thei ding uhi.
ENGLISH: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

PAITE: Thusiah omna peuhah a siahmi sihna leng a om teitei ding ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

PAITE: Mi a sih nungun thusiahin thua neingal naka, a siahmi adamlai teng bel thu himhim a neikei hi.
ENGLISH: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

PAITE: Huchiin thukhun masa leng sisan louin a hihkip kei uhi,
ENGLISH: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

PAITE: Dan thupiak peuhmah tuh Mosiin mipi tengteng kianga a phuan nungin, bawngnoute leh kelte sisan tuh, tui toh, samulkhau sandup toh, husop toh a la a, laibu ngei leh mi tengteng leng a theha,
ENGLISH: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

PAITE: Huai tuh Pathianin na kiang ua a piak kip thukhun sisan ahi, chiin.
ENGLISH: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.” Exodus 24:8

PAITE: Huailou leng, biakbuk leh nasepna van tengteng huchibang mahin sisanin a theh samta hi.
ENGLISH: Moreover he sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

PAITE: Huan, dan thuin bangkim phial sisana hihsiangthouin a om a, sisan suahlouin ngaihdamna himhim a om kei hi.
ENGLISH: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

PAITE: Huchiin, vana thil om batpihte tuh huaitea hihsiangthoua om ding him ahi, van thil taktakte bel huaisanga kithoihna hoihjawtea hihsiangthoua om ding ahi.
ENGLISH: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

PAITE: Kris tuh khuta lam mun siangthou, a tak batpih ah a lut ngal kei a; tunah Pathian maah I sik ua ding dingin van ngei ah, a lut jaw ta hi.
ENGLISH: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

PAITE: Himahleh, Siampu Lianpen kum tenga amah sisan lou, sisan tawi kawma Mun Siangthoua lut jel bangin, amah bel amah kilan dingina lut sam kei;
ENGLISH: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

PAITE: huchi hita kei leh, leilung piantung akipan tam veipi a thuakta ding hi; himahleh, tulai hun tawp ah kithoihna dinga kizang tawmin khelhna hih mangna dingin khatvei in setden din amah hong langta ahi.
ENGLISH: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

PAITE: Huan, mihinga dingin khatvei sih seh ahi, huai nungin vaihawmna aom ding.huchi bangmahin Kris leng, mitampi khelhnate paipih dinga khatvei lata omkhinin, hotdamna mu dinga, amah nangakte kiangah, khelhna panglouin nihveina ah a honglang nawn ding hi.
ENGLISH: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

PAITE: huchi bangmahin Kris leng, mitampi khelhnate paipih dinga khatvei lata omkhinin, hotdamna mu dinga, amah nangakte kiangah, khelhna panglouin nihveina ah a honglang nawn ding hi.
ENGLISH: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, Isaiah 53:13 will appear a second time, without sin, to those who are eagerly waiting for him for salvation.

PAITE: Jakob, Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Kris sikha in, Nam Sawm leh Nih dalhte chibai a buk hi.
ENGLISH: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

PAITE: Ka unaute aw, na ginna uh zeetnain kuhkalna a siam chih theiin, khemna chiteng na tuah chiang un, kipahna ngenin sim un,
ENGLISH: Count it all joy, my brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” , when you fall into various temptations,

PAITE: Hiai, na ginna zeetna un kuhkalna a siam chih theiin.
ENGLISH: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

PAITE: Huan, bangmah tasam loua na kim ua, na pum ua na bit theihna ding un, kuhkalna in semkim hen.
ENGLISH: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

PAITE: Na lak ua kuapeuhin pilna a taksap leh, mi tengteng kianga tai lou leh it loua pepa Pathian tuh ngen hen, huchiin a kiangah piaka hi ding hi.
ENGLISH: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.

PAITE: Himahleh, ginglel het louin ginna neiin ngen hen, ginglelmi tuh tuipi kihot huih mutleng leh sep banga hi ngala.
ENGLISH: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

PAITE: Huchibang min tuh Toupa kiangah bangmah muh kiging kei hen.
ENGLISH: For let that man not think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

PAITE: Lungsim det neilou tuh a thilhih tengtengah a kip kei hi.
ENGLISH: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

PAITE: Unau daikilkala om, pahtawia a om jiakin kipak hen;
ENGLISH: But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

PAITE: Mihau tuh, hihneua a om jiakin kipak jaw hen; loupa pak banga a man ding jiakin.
ENGLISH: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

PAITE: Ni a hongsuaka huihlum tak a hongnunin loupa tuh a vuaisaka; huai pak tuh a kia a; a omdan hoih tuh a mangthang hi; huchibang maha mihau tuh a paina a vuai ding ahi ngala.
ENGLISH: For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.

PAITE: Khemna thuak teitei mi a hampha hi; zeeta om nungin hinna lallukhu, Toupan amah itte kianga achiam a muh ding jiakin.
ENGLISH: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.

PAITE: Kuamahin, khemna a tuah laiin, Pathian khem ka hi, chi kei hen. Pathian tuh gitlouha khem vual ahi kei, aman leng kua mah a khem ngei kei hi.
ENGLISH: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

PAITE: Mi chih amau utnaa pimang leh hipa a om un, khemna a tuak uh ahi jaw hi.
ENGLISH: But each one is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

PAITE: Huan, utnain nou a paia, gilou a hongpichinin sihna a suak sak jel hi.
ENGLISH: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, brings forth death.

PAITE: Ka nau deihtakte aw, khemin om kei un.
ENGLISH: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

PAITE: Thilpiak hoih leh thil piak buching tuh tunglama kipana vakte Pa kianga kipana hongsuk ahi a, amahah tuh lamdanna leh kiheina lim himhim a om theikei hi.
ENGLISH: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

PAITE: A thilsiamte makaite I honghih theihna dingin, amah deihlamin thutak lakah a honsuak sak ahi.
ENGLISH: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

PAITE: Unau deihtakte aw, huaite na thei uhi; himahleh, mi chih ngaihkhiak kilawp henla, thugen kituhpih kei henla, heh hak leh:
ENGLISH: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

PAITE: Mihing thangpaihna in Pathian diktatna a bawl ngal kei a.
ENGLISH: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

PAITE: Huaijiakin, nin tengteng leh gilou dimval koih mang unla, thu tuh, na kha uh hondam thei, thunuai lut takin pom un.
ENGLISH: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls or, preserve your life. .

PAITE: Himahleh, noumau kikhemin ngaikhete kia hi louin thujuite honghi jaw un.
ENGLISH: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

PAITE: Kuapeuh thu ngaikhia hi a, jui hi tuan lou tuh, mi limlanga a pianpih maitang hoih taka kien bang phet tuh ahi.
ENGLISH: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

PAITE: Hoih takin a kiena, a pai manga, mi bang chi ahia a hih chih a kimangngilh nawn pah ngal hi.
ENGLISH: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

PAITE: Himahleh kuapeuh dan kim, noplenna dan tuh, vela, huchibanga om gigea, ngaikhiaa, mangngilhnawn maimah nak bang hi loua, juia na sem gige hi jaw tuh, huai mi tuh a thilhih ah vual jawlin a om ding hi.
ENGLISH: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

PAITE: Kuapeuh sabiak limsak hia kigingtaa a lei veng hoih loua, amah lungtang kikhemjaw tuh huai mi sabiak dan tuh bangmah ahi kei hi.I Pathian leh Pa mitmuha sabiak siangthou leh gilou pang lou jaw hiai ahi, tagah leh meithaite gimthuak laia veh leh, khovel buahna bang loua kibawl jel.
ENGLISH: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

PAITE: I Pathian leh Pa mitmuha sabiak siangthou leh gilou pang lou jaw hiai ahi, tagah leh meithaite gimthuak laia veh leh, khovel buahna bang loua kibawl jel.
ENGLISH: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

PAITE: Ka unaute aw, I Toupa Jesu Kris, Thupina Toupa gingta kawmin, mi khentuam neikei un,
ENGLISH: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.

PAITE: Na kikhopna in uah mi dangkaeng zungbuh bun, puan hoih tak silh honglut leh, huan, mi genthei puan se tak silh honglut samta leh;
ENGLISH: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue or, meeting , and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;

PAITE: huchiin, puan hoih tak silhmi tuh na limsak ua, a kiangah, Nang hiai mun hoih ah tuin, na chi ua, mi genthei kiang abel, Nang jaw huaiah ding inla, a hih keileh, ka khe ngakna nuaiah tuin, na chih uleh,
ENGLISH: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, “Sit here in a good place”; and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”;

PAITE: na lungsim uah khentuam neia ngaihtuahna gilou pu, gense mite na hong hi kei ding ua hia?
ENGLISH: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

PAITE: Ka unau deihtakte aw, Pathianin hiai khovela gentheite ginnaa hau ding leh, amah itte kianga achiam gam luah ding khawng bangin a chi kei ahia?
ENGLISH: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

PAITE: Nou bel migentheite bang na zahlaksak zota ua. Mihaute hilou uhia nou honnuaisiah? Mihaute hilou uhia vaihawmna ina nou honkailut?
ENGLISH: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

PAITE: Amaute hilou uhia min manpha na put uh gensete?
ENGLISH: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

PAITE: Himahleh laisiangthouin, Nangmah na kiit bangin na vengte na it ding ahi, chih kumpi dan na zop uleh, na hih hoih uh;
ENGLISH: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” Leviticus 19:18 you do well.

PAITE: Himahleh mi khentuam na neih uleh, na hih khial uhi, danin talekte na hih uh a honthei sak ngala.
ENGLISH: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

PAITE: Kuapeuhin dan jui kim mahleh, munkhata a hihkhelh ngalin tuh, a vekah siamlouhtangin a om khinta ahi.
ENGLISH: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

PAITE: Angkawm ken, chipan, Tualthat ken, a chi laingala. Huchiin angkawm keimah lechin tual na thah ngalin tuh, dana talekpa na hita himhim ahi.
ENGLISH: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” Exodus 20:14; Deuteronomy 5:18 also said, “Do not commit murder.” Exodus 10:13; Deuteronomy 5:17 Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

PAITE: Huaijiakin noplenna dana vaihawm sakdingte bangin thugen unla, thil hih belap un.
ENGLISH: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.

PAITE: Mi tunga chitna neilou tuh chitna pang louin vaihawm a zou nak ahi.
ENGLISH: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

PAITE: Ka unauate aw, min ginna ka nei chimahleh, thil hih aneihkei leh, bang a phatuam dia? Huchibang ginna in amah a hondam thei ding hia?
ENGLISH: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

PAITE: Unaupa hiam, unau nu hiam, vuaktanga om in a niteng annek tasam le uh,
ENGLISH: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

PAITE: Huchiin nalak ua kuahiam in a kiang ah, khamuang takin pai unla, lum tak leh vahtak in awm un chi unla, asa a ding a thil kiphamawh pe tuankei le uchin bang a phatuam dia?
ENGLISH: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace, be warmed and filled”; and yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

PAITE: Huchibangmahin ginna leng thilhih neiloua amah kiaa a om leh a si ahi.
ENGLISH: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

PAITE: Ahi, mi kuahiamin, Nang ginna na neia, ken thilhih ka nei ahi; na ginna tuh na thilhih panglouin hon ensak in huan ken ka thilhihin ka ginna ka hon ensak ding,
ENGLISH: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.

PAITE: Pathian tuh khat ahi, na gingta maw? Na hih hoih e: dawiten leng a gingta ua, a ling zel uhi, a chi ding.
ENGLISH: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.

PAITE: Mi thulimlou aw, thilhih panglou a ginna lel bangmah ahi kei chih na thei nuam hia?
ENGLISH: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

PAITE: I pu Abrahamin a tapa Isaak maitam tung a alat laiin thilhih ziaka siamtang ahika hia?
ENGLISH: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

PAITE: Ginna in a thilhih toh a sem khawm khawma, huan, thilhih ziakin ginna uh akimta chih I thei hi.
ENGLISH: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;

PAITE: Huan, Abrahamin Pathian a gingtaa, huai ginna tuh a diktatna a sim ahi, chih Laisiangthou hihkim in a om a; huchiin mah tuh Pathian lawm chih in a om hi.
ENGLISH: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness”; Genesis 15:6 and he was called the friend of God.

PAITE: Ginna ziak maimah hilou in, thilhih ziak zaw in, min siam a tang jel uh chih natheita uhi.
ENGLISH: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.

PAITE: Huchibangmah in, Rahab kizuaknun leng sawltakte a nakipahpih a lam tuama a pai sak laiin, thilhih ziakin siam a tang ahi kei maw?Kha panglou in sa tuh si ahi, huchibangmahin thilhihte panglou in ginna leng si ahi.
ENGLISH: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?

PAITE: Kha panglou in sa tuh si ahi, huchibangmahin thilhihte panglou in ginna leng si ahi.
ENGLISH: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

PAITE: Ka unaute aw, na lak uah mi tampi heutuin hongom kei un, heutuin vaihawmna thupi sem I tuak ding chih I thei ngala.
ENGLISH: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

PAITE: Thil tampi ah I vek un I gilou nak ngal ua. Kuapeuh thugen lam a a gitlouh kei leh, huai mi tuh piching ahi a, a pumpi leng vengthei mi ahi.
ENGLISH: For in many things we all stumble. If anyone doesn’t stumble in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.

PAITE: Ngai un, I thu a man theina ding un, Sakol kamte khawng ah sikkual I bah leh a pumpi uh ikaihei hi.
ENGLISH: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

PAITE: Ngai un, longte khawng a lian mahmah ua, huih hattak mutleng in a om nak uh, himahleh a kiheksakpan a paisak utna lam peuhah a heksakna neuchik pet mahin a kihek sak hi.
ENGLISH: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

PAITE: Hichibangmahin lei leng pumpi hiang neuchik phet ahi a, nakpitakin a kiuang sak nak hi. Ngaiun, mei neuchik phet in sing nak katsak natel e!
ENGLISH: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

PAITE: Huan, lei tuh mei ahi. I pumpi hiangte lak a gitlouhna lumpi, pumpi aveka ninsak a, mihing ki suansawn dan pian phungpi kangsak ahi; huai lei mah tuh gawtmun mei in a pehloh ahi.
ENGLISH: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna. or, Hell

PAITE: Sa chichih, vasa chichih, ganhing chichih tuipi a te khawizual theih ahi ngal ua, mite khawizual in a awm uhi.
ENGLISH: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and thing in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind.

PAITE: ahihhangin lei zaw kuamahin a khawizual theikei uhi; sihna gu-a dim gilou awm kinken theilou ahi.
ENGLISH: But nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

PAITE: huai in Toupa leh Pa iphat ua; huaimah in Pathian bang a bawl mihingte ihamasiat zel uhi.
ENGLISH: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who are made in the image of God.

PAITE: Kam khat mah a kipan in phatna leh hamsiatna a pawtkhenak hi. Ka unaute aw, huchibang thilte tuachi ding hilou hi.
ENGLISH: Out of the same mouth comes forth blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

PAITE: Tuikhuk in nak khat mah a kipan in tui lim leh tui limlou a suaksak zel ahia?
ENGLISH: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

PAITE: Ka unaute aw, theipi kung ah Olive thei a gahthei ahia? Ahihkeileh, grape gui ah theipi a gah thei ahia? huchimahbangin chikhuk in tui allou a suaksak thei samkei hi.
ENGLISH: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

PAITE: Nalak uah kua a pil in, thu theithei a awm a? thunuailut tak leh piltakin a thilhihte awmdan hoih in ensak hen.
ENGLISH: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

PAITE: Himahleh na lungtang uah hazatna thupitak leh kidemna naneih uleh, thudik zuausan kei un.
ENGLISH: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

PAITE: Huai pilna tuh tunglam a kipan a hong paisuk ahi kei a, khovel leh pumpi utna dawi a kipan ahi zaw hi.
ENGLISH: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

PAITE: Ki hazatna leh ki demna awmna ah buaina leh thil hihkhelhna chiteng a om naknak ngal a.
ENGLISH: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

PAITE: Tunglam a kipan pilnabel, a tungin a siangthou phawt a, huakhitin kituah a ut a, anunnema, a chihnuam a, hehpihna leh gah hoih in a dim a, khentuam a neikei a, a lepchiah kei hi.Diktatna gah tuh kituahna bawlte kituahna tuh ahi.
ENGLISH: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

PAITE: Diktatna gah tuh kituahna bawlte kituahna tuh ahi.
ENGLISH: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

PAITE: Nalak ua ki douna leh kinaknate koia kipan a hong suak ahi ua? Na pumpi hiangte ua kidouna bawlnak, na duhgawlna ua kipante a pawt ahi kei ua hia?
ENGLISH: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

PAITE: Na lunggulh ua, na nei tuankei ua; huchi in tual nathat uh. Na eng ua, na ngah thei tuankei ua na kidou ua, gal na bawl uh. Na ngetlouh ziakun na neikei uh.
ENGLISH: You lust, and don’t have. You kill, covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

PAITE: Na ngen ua, na nget diklouh ziak un na mu kei uh, na nawpsak bawlna ding ua zat na tup ziakun.
ENGLISH: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it for your pleasures.

PAITE: Nou angkawm hatte aw, khovel lawm hihna Pathian melma hihna ahi chih nathei keiua hia? Huchi in kuapeuhmah khovel lawm hih ut tuh Pathian melma in a kibawl nak hi.
ENGLISH: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

PAITE: Ahihkeileh, Kha eimah a teng in haza phial in a hondeih hi, chih Laisiangthou in bangmahlou in gen in na gingta ua hia?
ENGLISH: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

PAITE: Himahleh hehpihna tamsem a pe nak; huaziakin Laisiangthou in, Pathian in mi kisatheite a dou a, ki ngaineute bel hehpihna a pe nak, a chi ahi.
ENGLISH: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Proverbs 3:34

PAITE: Huchiin, Pathian thuthu in awm un; ahihhangin diabol dou un, huchiin a hon taimang san ding hi.
ENGLISH: Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

PAITE: Pathian naih unla, huchiin aman a hon naih ding. Khialte aw, na khut uh silsiang un: lungsim bulbal neiloute aw, na lungtang uh hih siangthou un.
ENGLISH: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

PAITE: Haksa sa unla, lungkham unla, kap un; nanuih uh lungkham suak henla, na kipah uh nguina suak hen.
ENGLISH: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

PAITE: Toupa mitmuh in kingaineu un, huchi in a hon hihlian ding hi.
ENGLISH: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

PAITE: Unaute aw, ki gensia tuah kei un. Kuapeuh in a unau a gensiat in hiam aw, a unau a vaihawm khum in hiam, dan a gensia in dan a vaihawm khum ahi; himahleh dan na gensiat leh dan zuimi na hi kei a, vaihawmpa na hizaw hi.
ENGLISH: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

PAITE: Dan pepa leh vaihawmpa khatlel om, hondam theipa leh hihmang thei pa Nang na vengte vaihawm khumpa kua na hia?
ENGLISH: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

PAITE: Tunah ngai un, nou, tuni hiam zingchiang hiam in, huai khawpi ah ihawh ding ua, huailai ah kumkhat iva tam ding ua, I sumsin ding ua, punna imu ding, chite aw.
ENGLISH: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

PAITE: Jingchiangin bang hongawm ding ahia chih nathei ngalkei ua. Na hinna uh bang ahia? Mei sawtlou kal a hongdawk a, mangnawn lel jel bangphet na hi ngal ua,
