ENGLISH: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

PAITE: Huan nau a paia; huan nau vei leh suak khe ding natnain a kap kheta a.
ENGLISH: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

PAITE: Huan van thil lamdang a dang khat ahongkimu a; huan ngaiin, dragon san lianpi, lu sagih leh ki sawm neia, a lu tunga lallukhu sagih nei.
ENGLISH: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

PAITE: Huan a meiin vana aksite mun thuma khen mun khat a kaia, huan leitungah a pai kheta a; huan dragon tuh huai numei nau nei dia kisa maah a dinga, a neih chianga a nau tuh nekzoh vek tumin.
ENGLISH: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

PAITE: Huan tapa, nau pasal, sik chianga nam tengteng tunga vaihawm ding a neita a; huan a ta tuh Pathian leh a laltutphah ah lak touhin a omta hi.
ENGLISH: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God, and to his throne.

PAITE: Huan numei tuh gamdai ah, Pathian amaha dia a mun bawlsak ah, huaia amah ni sangkhat leh ni zanih leh ni sawmguk a khawia om ding in, a lata hi.
ENGLISH: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

PAITE: Huan van ah kidouna a omta a: Mikael leh angelte tuh dragon toh kidou dingin a kuan khia ua; huan dragon leh a angelten a dou ua;
ENGLISH: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

PAITE: Huan a zou kei ua, a mun uh van ah muh himhim a om nawnta keia.
ENGLISH: They didn’t prevail, neither was a place found for him any more in heaven.

PAITE: Huan dragon lian, gulpi tek, Diabol leh Setan chiha ompa, khovel pumpi khempa tuh paih khiak sukin a omta a, huan amah toh a angelte leng a paih khiak sukin a omta uhi.
ENGLISH: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

PAITE: Huan van ah aw ngaihtak mai ka zata a, Tun ah hongtungta i Pathian hotdamna, thilhihtheihna, leh Kris thuneihna; i unaute hekpa, i Pathian maa sun leh jana amau hekpa paih khiak suka a om jiakin.
ENGLISH: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

PAITE: Huan Belamnou sisan jiak leh theihpih uh thu jiakin amah tungah tuh a vual zouta ua; huan sihtan phain leng a hinna uh a it kei uhi.
ENGLISH: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

PAITE: Huaijiakin kipak un, aw van leh nou a sunga tengte. Lei leh tuipi adingin atung uh a gik; diabolin tuh hun tom chikphet a nei chih a kitheih jiakin a heh mahmaha na kiang uah a hongpai sukta ngala, chiin.
ENGLISH: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

PAITE: Huan dragon leitunga paih khiak a hita chih a kithei takin, huai numei nau pasal neinu tuh a gawtta a.
ENGLISH: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

PAITE: Huan numei kiangah tuh munvanlai thupi tak kha nih piakin a omta a, huan gulpi maia kipan gamdai muna a len lut theihna dingin, huailai ah tuh hun khat sung leh hun teleh hun kimkhat sung khawiin a om hi.
ENGLISH: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

PAITE: Huan gulpiin tuh a kama kipanin tuipi bang tui numei nungah a sekheta a, huai tuiluanga amah tuh a taih mangsak theihna dingin.
ENGLISH: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

PAITE: Huan leiin tuh numei a panpihta a, huan leiin tuh a kam a kata a, huan dragonin a kama kipana a lui tui siat khiak tuh a navalh zoh sak vekta hi.Huan dragon tuh numei tungah a heh mahmaha, huan a suan dangte, Pathian thupiak juite leh Jesu thutheihpihna juite vakidou pih dingin a pai mangta hi.
ENGLISH: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

PAITE: Huan dragon tuh numei tungah a heh mahmaha, huan a suan dangte, Pathian thupiak juite leh Jesu thutheihpihna juite vakidou pih dingin a pai mangta hi.
ENGLISH: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

PAITE: Huan tuipa piaunel tunga dingin, tuipa akipan gamsa khat, ki sawm leh lu sagih neia, a a kite tunga lallukhu sawm nei, a lu tungtea Pathian gensiatna om, hong paikhe tou tuh ka muta hi.
ENGLISH: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

PAITE: Huan ka gamsa muh tuh gialbem a banga, a khe tuh vompi khe a banga, huan a kam tuh humpinelkai kam a banga: huan dragonin a thuneihna thupi leh a laltutphah leh a thilhihtheihna amah a peta hi.
ENGLISH: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

PAITE: Huan a lute laka khat tuh sihpih khop hial dia liam hileh kilawm in ka mu a; huan sihpih khop hial dia liam tuh hihdamin a omta a; huan leitung pumpiin huai gamsa tuh lamdang a sa ua, a jui uhi;
ENGLISH: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

PAITE: huan dragon tuh a beta ua, gamsa kianga a thuneihna a piak jiakin; huchiin gamsa tuh a beta ua. Gamsa toh kibang kua ahia? Huan amah kidou pih thei kua ahia? chiin.
ENGLISH: They worshiped the dragon, because he gave his authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

PAITE: Huan amah kiangah tuh thil thupite leh Pathian gensiatnate genna ding kam piakin a omta a; huan amah kiangah thuneihna piakin a oma, kha sawmli leh kha nih gamtang jel dingin.
ENGLISH: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

PAITE: Pathian gensiatna ding, a min gense ding leh a omna, huai vana tengte ngei gensiain akamkata hi.
ENGLISH: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his dwelling, those who dwell in heaven.

PAITE: Huan misiangthoute kidou pih ding leh amau zou dingin amah kiangah tuh phalna piakin a omta a: huan chi tengteng leh mite leh paute leh namte tunga thuneihna a kiangah piakin a omta hi.
ENGLISH: It was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

PAITE: Huan leitunga teng tengtengin amah a be ding ua, khovel om tunga kipata belamnou thahsa hinna laibua a min ua gelh louha om tengtengin.
ENGLISH: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

PAITE: Kuapeuh bil neiin, ja hen:
ENGLISH: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

PAITE: Kuapeuh sal pi tuh sala piin a om ding; kuapeuh namsaua that tuh namsaua thahin a om ding. Hiaiah misiangthoute kuhkalna leh ginna neidinga chialna a om hi.
ENGLISH: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. TR reads “If anyone leads into captivity, into captivity he goes. If anyone will kill with the sword, he must be killed with a sword.” instead of “If anyone has captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is with the sword, he must be killed.” Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

PAITE: Huan gamsa ding leitunga kipata hongpawt khe tou ka muta a; huan belamnou bangin ki nih a neia, dragon bangin thu a gen hi.
ENGLISH: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.

PAITE: Huan gamsa masapen thuneihna tengteng a mitmuhin a nei a. Huan leitung leh a sunga teng tengteng tuh gamsa masapen si khop hial dia liama hihdama om tuh be dingin a bawl hi.
ENGLISH: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

PAITE: Huan mite mitmuhin van akipanin leitung mei bang ke suk thei khop dingin thillamdang pipi a hiha.
ENGLISH: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

PAITE: Huan gamsa mitmuha thillamdang hihtheihna piaka a omnain aman tuh leitunga tengte a khemta a; huai gamsa temsaua sat liam leh dam nawn lim bawl dingin amau, huai leia tengte a hilhta hi.
ENGLISH: He deceives my own NU omits “my own” people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast; saying to those who dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

PAITE: Huan gamsa lim tuh a pau theihna ding leh, gamsa lim be nuam lou tengteng leng a thah sak theina dingin gamsa lim kiangah tuh nakna piak ahi.
ENGLISH: It was given to him to give breath to it, to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

PAITE: Huan mi tengteng, a lian a neu, a jawng a pha, sikha leh sikha lou, a khut taklam uah hiam, a tal uah hiam chiamtehna tuh piakin a om sak chiata;
ENGLISH: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands, or on their foreheads;

PAITE: Huchia kuamahin huai chiamtehna hiam, gamsa min ngei hiam, a hih keileh a nambat hiam a neih keileh lei theilou, juak theilou a a omna dingin.Hiai ah pilna a kilang, kuapeuh theihsiamna neiin, gamsa nambat sim hen; mihing nambat ahi ngala; huan a nambat tuh zaguk leh sawmguk leh guk ahi.
ENGLISH: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell, unless he has that mark, the name of the beast or the number of his name.

PAITE: Hiai ah pilna a kilang, kuapeuh theihsiamna neiin, gamsa nambat sim hen; mihing nambat ahi ngala; huan a nambat tuh zaguk leh sawmguk leh guk ahi.
ENGLISH: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

PAITE: Huan ka et leh, ngaiin, Zion tang tunga Belamnou ding leh a kianga upa nuai kha leh singli leh sangli, amin leh a Pa min a tal ua kigelh chiat ka muta a.
ENGLISH: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

PAITE: Huan aw tui tampi leh vanpi ging bang aging van akipanin ka zata a; huan ka aw jak tuh gosem tumten a gosem uh a tum ging uh ahi:
ENGLISH: I heard a sound from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

PAITE: Huan laltutphah ma leh gan hing lite ma leh upate maah la thak hileh kilawm khat a sa ua: huan leitunga kipata huai lei khiaksate, nuai khat leh singli leh sanglite lou ngalin, kuamahin huai la tuh a thei theita kei uhi.
ENGLISH: They sing a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

PAITE: Hiai tuh numei laka kihinin loute ahi ua; nungak siangthou bang ahi ua. Hiaite tuh a paina lamlama Belamnou juite ahi uhi. Pathian ading leh Belamnou adinga gah masapen hi dinga, mite laka kipana leisa ahi ua,
ENGLISH: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

PAITE: huan a kam uah tuh juau a om kei a; gensiatna bei ahi uhi.
ENGLISH: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless. TR adds “before the throne of God”

PAITE: Huan angel van laijawla leng khantawn tanchin hoih leitunga tengte kiang leh nam chih leh chi chih leh pau chih leh mi chihte kianga genkhiak ding nei ka muta a;
ENGLISH: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

PAITE: Huan aw ngaihtakin, Pathian kihta unla, amah thupina pia un; a vaihawmna hun a hongtungta ngala: huan van leh lei leh tuipi leh tuikhukte siampa amah bia un, a chi a.
ENGLISH: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

PAITE: Huan a dang, angel nihnain a honjuia, Pukta, pukta Babulon kho thupi, nam tengteng a mingaihhatna hehna uain dawn saknu, chiin.
ENGLISH: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

PAITE: Huan angel dang, a thumnain, amau a honjuta a aw ngaihtaka, Kuapeuhin gamsa leh a limtuh a biaka, a tal ah hiam a khut ah hiam chiamtehna a neih aleh,
ENGLISH: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead, or on his hand,

PAITE: huaimi inleng Pathian hehna uain a dawn ding, huai uain tuh a thangpaihna noua bangmah toh hel louh hiala bawl ahi; huan angel siangthoute leh Belamnou muhin amah tuh mei lah katin hihnatin om in teh:
ENGLISH: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb.

PAITE: huan a hihnatna meikhu uh khantawn khantawnin a jamtou dia; huan huai gamsa leh a limbete, leh kuapeuh a min chiamtehna nei photin sun leh janin leng tawlngakna a neikei uh, chiin.
ENGLISH: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

PAITE: Hiai ah misiangthou, Pathian thupiakte leh Jesu ginna juite kuhkalna nei dinga chialna a om hi.
ENGLISH: Here is the patience of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

PAITE: Huan van akipanin awin hichi banga, Gelhin, tua kipanin misite, Toupaa site tuh a hampha uhi: Khain, A hi, a sepgimna uh a khawlsanta ding ua, a thilhihte un honjui ding a hih jiakin, a chi, a chih ka zata a.
ENGLISH: I heard the voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.”

PAITE: Huan ka et leh, ngaiin, meipi ngou ka muta a; huan huai mei tungah tuh mi khat mihing tapa toh kibang, a lu-a dangkaeng lallukhu khu-a, a khuta kawite hiam tawi ka muta a.
ENGLISH: I looked, and behold, a white cloud; and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, Daniel 7:13 having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

PAITE: Huan angel dang Pathian biakin hong pawta, meipi tunga tupa kiangah ngaihtakin, Na kawite lik inla, at in: at hun a tungta hi; lei buh a kuai gawpta, chiin a kikoua.
ENGLISH: Another angel came out from the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send forth your sickle, and reap; for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

PAITE: Huan huai mei tunga tupan leitung ah a kawite a lik a; huan leitung tuh atin a omta a.
ENGLISH: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

PAITE: Huan vana om Pathian biakin akipanin angel dang a hongpai khia a, aman leng kawite hiam a tawi a.
ENGLISH: Another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

PAITE: Huan mei tunga thilhihtheihna nei, angel dang maitam maa kipanin a hongpai khia a; huan aman tuh aw ngaih takin, huai kawite tawipa tuh samin, Na kawite hiam tak lik inla, leitunga grep gah bomte khawm in; grepte tuh a min mahmah ta hi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send forth your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

PAITE: Huan huai angelin leitungah a kawite a lik a, huan leitunga grep gahte tuh a khawmta a, huan Pathian hehna, uain sukna thupi, uain sukna ah a pai lutta hi.Huan kho polamah uain suknaa chilin a om ta a, huan sakol kamkaihna tanpha hialin ching sang khat leh zaguka gamlain uain sukna akipanin sisan a hong luang kheta hi.
ENGLISH: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

PAITE: Huan kho polamah uain suknaa chilin a om ta a, huan sakol kamkaihna tanpha hialin ching sang khat leh zaguka gamlain uain sukna akipanin sisan a hong luang kheta hi.
ENGLISH: The winepress was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out from the winepress, even to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia. 1600 stadia = 296 kilometers or 184 miles

PAITE: Huan, chiamtehna dang van ah ka mu a, thupi leh lamdang: angel sagih hi sagih tawite; huaite a Pathian hehna tuh khit a hihtak jiakin, ananung pente ahi uh.
ENGLISH: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

PAITE: Huan, limlang tuipa hileh kilawm, mei toh kihel, leh gamsa leh a lim leh a min nambat tunga valzoute, a khut ua Pathian gosem tawia, huai limlang tuipa kianga ding ka muta a,
ENGLISH: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, TR adds “his mark,” and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

PAITE: Huan, Pathian sikha, Mosi la leh Belamnou lasaiin. Na thilhite a thupiin a lamdang hi. Aw Toupa Pathian, Bangkimhihthei! Na lampite a kijem un a dik uhi, Aw tangtawn Kumpipa.
ENGLISH: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

PAITE: Toupa aw, kuan ahia na min hihthupi loua, laulou ding? Nang kia siangthou lah na hi ngala. Nam tengteng hongpaiin Na ma ah hong be ding uh, Na thilhih diktakte lah hihlatin omta ngal ua, a chi uhi.
ENGLISH: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

PAITE: Huan hiai thilte ka muh nungin, huchiin vana theihsakna biakbuk dantan sungnung tuh honin a omta a:
ENGLISH: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

PAITE: Huan hiai dantan sungnung akipanin angel sagih gawtna sagih neia, suang mantam, siangthou leh vaka kijema dangkaeng kawnggaka a awm khawng ua kigakte a hongpai kheta ua.
ENGLISH: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their breasts.

PAITE: Huan gan hing lite laka khatin angel sagihte kiangah dangkaeng belhbu sagih khantawn khantawna hing, Pathian hehnaa dimte tuh a peta hi.Huan Pathian thupina akipan leh a thilhihtheihna akipan meikhuin dantansungnung tuh hihdimin a omta a; huan angel sagihte gawtna sagih zoh veka a om tan phaiin, huai sung ah tuh kuamah a lut theita kei uhi.
ENGLISH: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

PAITE: Huan Pathian thupina akipan leh a thilhihtheihna akipan meikhuin dantansungnung tuh hihdimin a omta a; huan angel sagihte gawtna sagih zoh veka a om tan phaiin, huai sung ah tuh kuamah a lut theita kei uhi.
ENGLISH: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

PAITE: Huan huai dantan sungnunga hongsuak aw thupiin, angel sagihte kianga, Kuan unla, leitungah Pathian hehna belhbu sagihte tuh sung khia un, a chih ka zata a.
ENGLISH: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

PAITE: Huan a masapen tuh a kuanta a, huan leitungah a belhbu a sung kheta a, huan huai gamsa chiamtehna neia, a lim bia, mite tungah tuh meima sia leh nain a hongsuakta hi.
ENGLISH: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and evil sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

PAITE: Huan a nihnapenin tuh a belhbu tuipi tungah a sung kheta a; huan misi si bangin sisan a hongsuakta a; huan tuipi sunga thil omte tan phain hinna nei peuhmah tuh a sita uhi.
ENGLISH: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

PAITE: Huan a thumnapenin a belhbu tuh luite lui tuikhukte tungah a sungkhe ta a; huan sisan a hongsuakta ua.
ENGLISH: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

PAITE: Huan tuite angelin, Nang omsa leh omlel, nang mi siangthou, hichi banga vai na hawmtak jiakin, na diktat hi:
ENGLISH: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, you Holy One, because you have judged these things.

PAITE: Amau tuh misiangthoute leh jawlneite sisan a bung khia ua huan nang tuh a dawn ding un sisan tuh na pe ta ngala; hichi tuak ahi him uhi.
ENGLISH: For they poured out the blood of the saints and the prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

PAITE: Huan maitamin, A hi, Toupa Pathian aw, Bangkimhihthei, na vaihawmte tuh a dikin a diktathuai hi, a chih ka zata hi.
ENGLISH: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

PAITE: Huan a linapenin a belhbu tuh ni a sun khumta a; huan amah kiangah tuh mite meia hainat theihna piakin a omta hi.
ENGLISH: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

PAITE: Huan a sata-sa mite tuh hainatin a omta ua; huan hichibang natnate tunga thilhihtheihna nei, Pathian min tuh a genseta ua; huan Pathian kianga thupina pe dingin a kisik tuan kei uhi.
ENGLISH: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

PAITE: Huan, Belamnou-in chiamtehna sagihte laka khat a phel lai ka mua, huan ganging lite laka khatin, aw, van ging bang main, Hongpai in, a chih ka zata a.
ENGLISH: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

PAITE: Huan ka et leh, ngaiin, sakol kang leh a tunga tupa thalpeu tawi ka muta a; huan amah kiangah lallukhu piakin a oma; huan amah tuh vualzou kawm leh vualzou jel dingin a hongpai kheta a.
ENGLISH: And behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came forth conquering, and to conquer.

PAITE: Huan sakol dang, sakol san, hongpai khia a: huan huai a tung a tupa kiangah leitunga kipan lemna lakhe dinga thupiak ahi a, huchia amau a kithah tuahna ding un: huan amah kianga namsau thupi piak a hita a.

ENGLISH: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

PAITE: Huan gan hing lite laiah aw hileh kilawm in, Huit-buh tehna dan khat shilling khat, huan barli buh tehna dan thumin shilling khat, huan thau leh uain jaw hihse ken, a chih ka ja a.
ENGLISH: I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix A choenix is a dry volume measure that is a little more than a litre (a little more than a quart). of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

PAITE: Huan achiamtehna lina a phel lain, gan hinglina, awin, Hongpai in, a chih ka ja a.

ENGLISH: And behold, a pale horse, and he who sat on it, his name was Death. Hades or, Hell followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

PAITE: huan amau tuh aw ngaih taka kikouin, Toupa Tungnungpen aw, siangthou leh dik, bangtan ka sisan man uh amau leitunga tengte tunga thuk lou leh vaihawm loua om ding na hia? a chi ua.
ENGLISH: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

PAITE: Huan amau kiangah puan ngouthupi piakin aom chiat ua: huan amau tuh a sikha- hihpihte uleh a unaute uh, amau banga thaha om dingte a hongkim mateng un, na khawl tadih un chia hilhin a om uhi.
ENGLISH: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

PAITE: Huan achiamtehna gukna a phel lai ka mu a, huan jinling thupitak a oma: huan ni tuh samul saiip puan bangin a dumta a, huan kha leng a pumin sisan bangin a hongomta a;
ENGLISH: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

PAITE: Huan vana aksite theipi kung huihpiin a mut linga a gah min nai loute a pulh bangin, leitungah a pulhta ua,
ENGLISH: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

PAITE: Huan laibu jail, a kizialzou bangin, van tuh suan mangin a omta: huan tangsang teng leh tuikulh gam teng a mun ua pat suanin a omta uhi.
ENGLISH: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

PAITE: Huan leitunga kumpipate leh lalte leh, heutute lah a hat leh a haute, leh salteng leh sallou teng tangsang khawnga suangpi khawngah leh kokhuk khawngah a kiselta ua:
ENGLISH: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

PAITE: Huan tangsangte kiang leh suangpite kiangah, Hondelh lum unla, amah laltutphah tunga tupa mai akipan leh Belam-nou thangpaihan akiapan honsel un:A thangpaihna ni thupi hongtung hi; kua a ding zou dia? a chi ua.
ENGLISH: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

PAITE: A thangpaihna ni thupi hongtung hi; kua a ding zou dia? a chi ua.
ENGLISH: for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”

PAITE: Hiai khitin angel li, lei kil lia dinga, leitunga huih lite, leitunga nung lou ding leh tuipi tung hiam, a hihkeileh sing tung hiama nung louding in a khawlsak ua.
ENGLISH: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

PAITE: Huan huai amau chiamtehna apat angel dang kuan tou tuhl ka muta a, huaiin Pathian hing chiamtehna a neia; huan aman huai angel lite leitung leh tuipi hihse dia piaka omte kiangah aw ngaihtak a kikouin,
ENGLISH: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

PAITE: Lei tung leh tuipi leh singte tuh hihse kei un, i Pathian sikhate a tal ua i chiamteh zoh main, a chi a.
ENGLISH: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

PAITE: Huan huai amau chiamteha omte laka tampi, nuai khat leh singli leh sangli, Israel suante chi tenga kipan chiamteh zah ka zata a;

ENGLISH: of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

PAITE: Aaher chi akipan sing khat leh sangnih; Napthali chi akipa singkhat leh sangnih; Manassi chi akipan sing khat leh sangnih;
ENGLISH: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

PAITE: Simeon chi akipan singkhat leh sangnih; Levi chi akipan singkhat leh sangnih; Isskar chi akipan singkhat leh sangnih;
ENGLISH: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

PAITE: Hiai thil teng zohin ka et leh, ngaiin, mipi tampi kuamah sim theih louh, nam chih leh chi tengteng leh mi tengteng leh pau tengteng akipan laltutphah leh Belamnou maa dinga, puan ngou thupia kijema, tumnah tawi ka mu a;
ENGLISH: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

PAITE: Huan amau tuh aw ngaih takin, Laltutphaha tu i Pathian uh leh Belamnou kiangah hotdamna, chiin a kikou ua.

ENGLISH: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

ENGLISH: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

PAITE: Amen Vualjawlna bang, thupina bang, pilna bang, zahtakhuaina bang, thilhihtheihna bang, hatna bang, khantawn, khantawnin i Pathian kiangah om hen, chiin.

PAITE: Huan ken a kingah, Ka Toupa, nang na thei hi, ka chi a. Huan aman ka kiangah, Hiaite gimthuakna thupi akipan hongpai ahi uh, huan a puan thupi uh sawpin, Belamnou sisanin ahih ngou uhi.
ENGLISH: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes, and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

PAITE: Huaijiakin Pathian laltutphah maah a om ua, huan sun leh janin a Pathian biakin uah amah a sep sak uhi; huan amah laltutphah tunga tupan amau tungah a puanin ajak ding.
ENGLISH: Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

PAITE: A gil uh kial nawn kenchin, a dang uh leng tak nawn himhim kenteh amau tuh niin kang kenchin, satnain leng a hihgim nawn kei ding hi.Belamnou huai laltutphah laka om tuh a Belamchingpa uh a hih ding jiakin, amau tuh hinna tuh tuhkhuk ah a pi ding a; huan Pathianin a mit ua kipan khitui tengteng a nul hulta ding hi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: They will never be hungry, neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on them, nor any heat;

PAITE: Belamnou huai laltutphah laka om tuh a Belamchingpa uh a hih ding jiakin, amau tuh hinna tuh tuhkhuk ah a pi ding a; huan Pathianin a mit ua kipan khitui tengteng a nul hulta ding hi, a chi a.
ENGLISH: for the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne shepherds them, and leads them to springs of waters of life. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

PAITE: Huan chiamtehna sagihna a phel laiin dakkal kimkhat khawng van tuh a dai sipsipa.
ENGLISH: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

PAITE: Huan Pathian maa angel sagih dingte tuh ka muta a, huan amau kiangah pengkul sagih piakin a omta a.
ENGLISH: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

PAITE: Huan angel dang khat a hong pai a, gim namtui halna dangkaeng bel tawiin, maitam kiangah a dingta a, huan a kiangah gim namtui tampi, laltutphah maa om dangkaeng maitam tenga misiangthou tengteng thumna toh hel dingin, piakin a oma.
ENGLISH: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

PAITE: Huan huai gim namtui khu leh mi siangthoute thumna tuh angel khut akipan Pathian maah a jam kheta a.
ENGLISH: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

PAITE: Huan angelin gim namtui halna dangkaeng bel a la a; huai tuh maitama meiin a hihdima, huan leitungah a paikheta a: huan van gingte leh khophia te leh jinlingte a hongomta hi.
ENGLISH: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it on the earth. There followed thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake.

PAITE: Huan angel sagih pengkul sagih tawite mut dingin a kisata uhi.
ENGLISH: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

PAITE: Huan a masapenin a mutta a, gial leh mei sisan toh kihel a hongomta a, huaite tuh leitunga paihkhiakin a omta a; huan leitung mun thuma khen mun khat a kang beita a, huan sing mun thuma khen mun khat a kang beita a; huan, loupa hing tengteng a kang beita hi.
ENGLISH: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burnt up, TR omits “One third of the earth was burnt up” and one third of the trees were burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

PAITE: Huan angel nihnain a mutta a, huan tang lianpi hileh kilawm meia kanglai tuipa ah paih khiakin a om ta a;
ENGLISH: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

PAITE: Huan tuipi min thuam khen mun khat tuh sisan a hongsuakta a; huan huai tuipia ganhingte, hiai hina neite nngei tuh mun thuma khen mun khat a sita uh; huan long min thuma khen mun khat hihsiatin a omta hi.
ENGLISH: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

PAITE: Huan angel thumnain a mutta a, huan vana kipanin aksi lianpi, meisel banga kuangin a kete a, huan lui mun thuma khen mun khat leh tui tuikhukte a delhta a.
ENGLISH: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of the waters.

PAITE: Huan huai aksi min tuh Gamsai ahi; huan tui mun thumakhen mun khat gamsai a hongsuakta a; huan mi tampi huai tuitein a sita ua, amau tuh hihkhata a om jiak un.
ENGLISH: The name of the star is called “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

PAITE: Huan angel linain a mutta a, huan ni mun thuma khen mun khat leh kha mun thuma khen mun khat leh aksi mun thuma khen mu khat hihsiat a hita; huchiin avaknata uh mun thuma khen mun khat hihmialin a omtaa; sun tuh mun thuma khen mun khat vaksak louhin a omtaa, jan leng huchi mah bangin.Huan ka et leh, mupi van laijawla lengin, aw ngaihtakin, Angel thum pengkul mut lai dingte, huai ging hongom lai dingte jiakin, leitunga omte tung a gik, a gik, a gik; a chih ka zata hi.
ENGLISH: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars; so that one third of them would be darkened, and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

PAITE: Huan ka et leh, mupi van laijawla lengin, aw ngaihtakin, Angel thum pengkul mut lai dingte, huai ging hongom lai dingte jiakin, leitunga omte tung a gik, a gik, a gik; a chih ka zata hi.
ENGLISH: I saw, and I heard an eagle, TR reads “angel” instead of “eagle” flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth, because of the other voices of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

PAITE: Huan angel nganain a mutta a, huan van akipan aksi leitunga kesa ka mu a; huan amah kiangah guamkhuk thukpi honna tahbi piakin a oma.
ENGLISH: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

PAITE: Huan amah guam khuk thukpi tuh a hongta a; huan huai guam akipanin meikhu, meipi khu bangmai a pawt touta a huai guama meikhu jiakin ni leh huihkhua hihmialin a omta hi.
ENGLISH: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a TR adds “great” burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

PAITE: Huan meikhu a kipanin khaupe leitung ah a hong suakta a; leia aikamten thil hihtheihna a nei bangin, amau tuh thilhihtheihna piakin a omta ua.
ENGLISH: Then out of the smoke came forth locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

PAITE: Huan amau tuh leitunga loupate bang, thil hing himhim bang, sing peuhmah leng, hihse loua, mi kuapeuh a tal ua Pathian chiamtehna neiloute kia hihse dia hilhin a om ua.
ENGLISH: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

PAITE: Huan amau that lou dinga, kha nga amau hih genthei zo dinga hilhin a om ua; huan a hihgentheihna uh tuh aikamin mi a teha, gentheihna bangmai ahi.
ENGLISH: They were given power not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion, when it strikes a person.

PAITE: Huan huai ni chiangin min sihna a zong ding ua, huan bangchi mah a mu kei ding uh; huan sih a ut ding ua, himahleh sihnain amau a taimang san ding.
ENGLISH: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

PAITE: Huan huai khaupete mel tuh sakol kodounaa pang dia bawl bangmai ahi ua; huan a lu tunguah lallukhu hileh kilawm dangkaeng bangtak a oma, huan a mai uh mihingte mai bangmai ahi.
ENGLISH: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

PAITE: Huan numei sam bangtak sam a nei ua, a ha uh humpinelkai ha bangmai ahi.
ENGLISH: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

PAITE: Huan awmphaw, sik awmphaw hileh kilawm a nei ua; huan a kha jap ging uh kidouna lama sakol tampi tai dupdup, kidouna kangtalai tampi ging bangmai ahi.
ENGLISH: They had breastplates, like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, or of many horses rushing to war.

PAITE: Huan aikam bangmai mei a nei ua, gu leng; huan a mei uah a thilhihtheihna uh, mihingte kha nga hihnatna ding a oma.
ENGLISH: They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

PAITE: Guam khukthukpi angel tuh a tung ua kumpipa-in a nei ua: Hebru pauin a min tuh Abaddon ahi a, huan Grik pauin a min tuh Appolion ahi.
ENGLISH: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon,” “Abaddon” is a Hebrew word that means ruin, destruction, or the place of destruction but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon.” “Apollyon” means “Destroyer.”

PAITE: Tunggikna masapen tuh a beita a ngaiin, tunggikna nih tunung chiangin a hongtung nalai ding hi.
ENGLISH: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

PAITE: Huan angel guknain a mutta a, huan Pathian maa om dangkaeng mitam ki akipanin aw ka zata a
ENGLISH: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

PAITE: Huai awin tuh angel gukna pengkul nei kiangah, Luipi Euphratisa angel li hena omte phel in, a chi a.
ENGLISH: saying to the sixth angel who had one trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

PAITE: Huan, angel lite tuh phelin a omta ua, amau tuh mi mun thuma khen mun khat a thah theihna ding un, dak khat leh ni khat leh kha khat leh kumkhat kisain, a na omta ua.
ENGLISH: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

PAITE: Huan huai sakol tungtuang mi sepaih tam lam tuh sing ngen mun sing nih ahi: a tam uh kigen ka ja a.
ENGLISH: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million literally, “ten thousands of ten thousands” . I heard the number of them.

PAITE: Huan huchibangin kilaknain sakolte leh a tung ua tuangte, mei banga san, engdup leh kat banga eng, awmphaw neite tuh ka muta a: huan sakolte lu tuh humpinelkai lu bangmai ahi ua; huan a kam ua kipanin mei leh meikhu leh kat a suak khe ta a.
ENGLISH: Thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the heads of lions. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

PAITE: Huan hi thumte mei leh meikhu leh kat, a kam ua kipana hongpawt khiain mi munthuma khen mun khat tuh thahin a omta ua.
ENGLISH: By these three plagues were one third of mankind killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

PAITE: Huai sakolte thilhihtheihna tuh a kam ua leh a mei ua om ahi ngala; a mei khawng uh tuh gulpi toh a kibang ua, lu leng a nei uhi; huan huaitein mi a hihna uhi.
ENGLISH: For the power of the horses is in their mouths, and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads, and with them they harm.

PAITE: Huan midang huai gawtnaa siloute, dawite, dangkaengte milimte, dangka milimte, suang milimte, leh sing milimte; huai amau muhjtheihna neiloute, be nawn lou dingin a khut ua a nasep khiakte uah tuh a kidik kei uhi;Huan a tualthahna uah leh a mibumna uah leh a kingaihna khelhna uah leh a guktakna uah tuh a kisik tuan kei uhi.
ENGLISH: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk.

PAITE: Huan a tualthahna uah leh a mibumna uah leh a kingaihna khelhna uah leh a guktakna uah tuh a kisik tuan kei uhi.
ENGLISH: They didn’t repent of their murders, nor of their sorceries, The word for “sorceries” (pharmakeia) also implies the use of potions, poisons, and drugs nor of their sexual immorality, nor of their thefts.
